体锥上的量子引力

Quantum gravity on the bulk cone

Ahmed Almheiri, Matthew Dodelson, Zohar Komargodski · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：全息关联函数中的体锥奇点编码了沿体类光测地线的传播。典型例子是 AdS 黑洞，其中入射类光测地线可以绕光子球并返回边界。这些奇点在有限体积的热两点函数中以实时形式出现。我们证明，在有限 G_N 下，对偶于引力理论的共形场论不能具有此类奇点。我们对单个微观态和热态都排除了这些奇点。论证的主旨是采用温度解析延拓。作为微观例子，我们构造了一个具有两个碰撞激波的 AdS3 几何，它表现出体锥奇点。我们通过在 CFT 中的显式计算表明，该奇点在有限 G_N 下被抹平。定性上，奇点分辨是量子引力中体解模糊性的结果。

English: Bulk-cone singularities in holographic correlators encode propagation along bulk null geodesics. The prototypical example is an AdS black hole, where incoming null geodesics can wind around the photon sphere and return to the boundary. These singularities appear in real time in the thermal two-point function at finite volume. We show that conformal field theories dual to gravitational theories at finite $G_N$ cannot have such singularities. We rule out these singularities both for individual microstates and for the thermal state. The main thrust of the argument is to invoke an analytic continuation in the temperature. As a microscopic example, we construct an AdS$_3$ geometry with two colliding shocks which exhibits a bulk cone singularity. We show by an explicit calculation in the CFT that this singularity is smoothed out at finite $G_N$. Qualitatively, the singularity resolution is a consequence of the fuzziness of the bulk solution in quantum gravity.

一句话导读：论文论证在有限 G_N 下全息 CFT 不应出现体锥奇点，并通过 AdS3 双激波例子的 CFT 计算展示其被量子引力效应抹平。

相关度：low — 论文属于 AdS/CFT 基础与量子引力，不直接匹配用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、探针膜、经典引力等支线，因此相关度较低。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

大中心荷下的谱边缘与黑洞统计

The Spectral Edge at Large Central Charge and Black Hole Statistics

Eric Perlmutter · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：本文提出一种研究 AdS3/CFT2 高能谱的新方法，旨在把谱统计纳入模 bootstrap。作者利用二维 CFT 的 L 函数解析理论，通过高能态之间的模约束推导出联系谱边缘与体态谱涨落的求和规则。作为应用，他们给出改进的模 bootstrap 界：设 Δ1 为中心荷 c 的幺正 CFT 中最轻激发 Virasoro 主算符的共形维数，则 Δ1-(c-1)/12 ≤ o(c)，且在足够大的 c 下至多有一个标量 gap 例外值；若在某个 c 序列上实现这种例外 gap，则其余 gap 满足更强界 Δ1-(c-1)/12 ≤ O(1)。该结果适用于具有如随机矩阵理论中谱计数涨落对数刚性的理论。

English: We introduce a new approach to high-energy spectra in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$, addressing the open challenge of incorporating spectral statistics into the modular bootstrap. Using the analytic theory of $L$-functions attached to two-dimensional CFTs, we leverage modular constraints among high-energy states to derive a sum rule relating the spectral edge to bulk spectral fluctuations. As an application, we establish a refined modular bootstrap bound: letting $\Delta_1$ be the conformal dimension of the lightest excited Virasoro primary of a unitary CFT of central charge $c$, we show that $\Delta_1 - {c-1\over 12} \leq o(c)$, with at most one exceptional value of the scalar gap at each sufficiently large $c$; moreover, along any sequence in $c$ for which such exceptional gaps are realized, the remaining gaps obey the stronger bound $\Delta_1 - {c-1\over 12} \leq O(1)$. The result applies to theories with logarithmic rigidity of spectral counting fluctuations, as in random matrix theory.

一句话导读：用 L 函数与模约束把谱统计引入 AdS3/CFT2 高能谱，导出改进的谱边缘求和规则与模 bootstrap 界。

多Regge运动学中引力子发射的经典两圈振幅的领头对数精度

The classical two-loop amplitude at leading logarithmic accuracy for graviton emission in multi-Regge kinematics

Federico Buccioni, Vittorio Del Duca, Emanuele Rosi · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-23

中文摘要：使用引力冲击波形式，我们计算了描述两个无质量标量碰撞中在多Regge运动学（MRK）下发射一个引力子的 O(G^{7/2}) 五点振幅的经典部分，并达到领头对数精度。结果分为两粒子可约项和三粒子可约项，后者是 H-图在 MRK 极限下取发射的辐射对应物。根据经典引力中领头对数振幅的普适性猜想，同一振幅也可通过应用光学定理，由相应有质量振幅的超相对论极限等价地算出。

English: Using the gravitational shockwave formalism, we compute the classical part of the $\mathcal{O}(G^{7/2})$ five-point amplitude at leading logarithmic accuracy describing the emission of a graviton in the collision of two massless scalars in multi-Regge kinematics (MRK). The result splits into a two-particle reducible term and a three-particle reducible one, the latter being the radiative counterpart of the $H$-diagram with the emission taken in MRK limit. The same amplitude can be equivalently calculated as the ultrarelativistic limit of the corresponding massive amplitude by applying the optical theorem according to the conjectured universality of the leading logarithmic amplitudes in classical gravity.

English: In this thesis we compute the impulse of a classical black hole scattering encounter in the Post-Minkowskian (PM) expansion - a weak-field expansion in Newton's constant $G$ - up to the fifth order. We describe the black holes as point particles within an effective field theory framework and couple them through gravity. The classical equations of motion are solved diagrammatically using the worldline quantum field theory (WQFT) formalism, in which the solution with causal boundary conditions is encoded in tree-level Feynman diagrams built from graviton and worldline fields. The Feynman integrals arising at each order are reduced by advanced IBP reduction techniques and evaluated with the method of differential equations. We find that, in the solution of these integrals, periods over Calabi--Yau manifolds - familiar from string theory - appear and contribute to the classical impulse at the fifth Post-Minkowskian order. The results of this work are the first analytic results for the scattering observables at fifth Post-Minkowskian order, together with the appearance of Calabi--Yau threefold periods in a classical physics observable.

English: We compute the static contribution to the conservative two-body potential in massless scalar-tensor theories through fifth post-Newtonian (5PN) order, with the strong-field scalar responses of the compact objects encoded in scalar-dependent masses. 中文摘要：黑洞奇点隐藏在视界后，难以判断量子引力或弦效应是否将其消解。对于 AdS-Schwarzschild 黑洞，已知对偶 CFT 的两点函数具有与从奇点反弹的零测地线相关的奇异性。本文把正则 AdS 黑洞视为正则化几何，研究奇点消解如何编码在对偶 CFT 中。利用 WKB 分析计算正则 AdS 黑洞的准正模，并由模读出对偶两点函数。我们发现，奇异性黑洞中对应反弹零测地线的奇异性被一个与复（而非实）零测地线相关的光滑隆起取代。复测地线奇点的位置通过分析两点函数算符乘积展开的结构得到支持。结果给出黑洞奇点消解的全息特征，并阐明正则内部信息如何编码在边界关联函数中。

English: The black hole singularity is hidden behind its horizon, and it is difficult to determine whether it is resolved by quantum gravity or stringy effects. For an AdS-Schwarzschild black hole, it is known that the two-point function of the dual conformal field theory has a singularity associated with a null geodesic that bounces off the black hole singularity. In this paper, we investigate how the resolution of the black hole singularity is encoded in the dual conformal field theory by considering regular AdS black holes as regularized geometries. Using WKB analysis, we compute the quasinormal modes of regular AdS black holes and read off the dual two-point functions from the modes. We find that the singularity corresponding to the bouncing null geodesic for singular black holes is replaced by a smooth bump associated with a complex, rather than real, null geodesic. The location of the complex geodesic singularity is supported by analyzing the structure of the operator product expansion for the two-point function. Our results provide a holographic signature of black hole singularity resolution and clarify how information about the regular interior is encoded in boundary correlation functions.

Its invertible symmetries, which include fractional $B$-field shifts, organize the boundaries into three orbits: free, mixed and torsion. Boundaries in different orbits are related only by gauging. For two pairs, the handlebody sum is the uniform average over the free theories. Recovering the average over all twenty-two theories requires one additional contribution, a solid torus with the torsion lines along its core. English: The Euclidean saddles of 3D Einstein gravity with positive cosmological constant are spherical three-manifolds. In addition, we analyze examples with knotted worldlines and reproduce their spherical volumes. We also apply our prescription to Seifert manifolds, which are off-shell in AdS$_3$ gravity but admit dS$_3$ saddles, and find agreement with their spherical volumes semiclassically. Finally, using Dehn surgery on torus knots and links, we obtain partition functions on smooth spherical three-manifolds.

Robert de Mello Koch, Minkyoo Kim, Sinong Liu · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：有限 $N$ 的迹关系可以产生没有稳定大 $N$ 祖先的 $Q$-上同调类。$SU(3)$ 处的膜融合构造表明，这类态可以保留一个伴随标量毛的 $SU(2)$ 非阿贝尔核心。我们将这一想法发展为适用于每个 $SU(N)$、$N\geq3$ 的一般构造。从 $SU(2)$ 阈值算符 $O_{24}$ 出发，我们选取一个标量的本征值对，并构造修正的双色字母，使其 $Q$-变换精确满足 $SU(2)$ 规则。代入 $O_{24}$ 后，对每个本征值对给出一个封闭的有理算符。乘以本征值间隔因子消去分母，并对所有对求和，得到一个规范不变多项式。一个精确的块限制恒等式可恢复 $O_{24}$ 的非零倍数。该限制将每个稳定类映射到稳定的 $SU(2)$ 类，从而证明所得算符是非恰当的且是偶然的，即使包含非库仑稳定的类时也是如此。这证明了在每个 $N\geq3$ 都存在偶然 BMN 上同调。该构造是非阿贝尔核心加标量修饰的精确代数实现。

English: Finite-$N$ trace relations can produce $Q$-cohomology classes with no stable large-$N$ ancestor. The brane-fused construction at $SU(3)$ suggests that such states can retain an $SU(2)$ nonabelian core accompanied by scalar hair. We develop this idea into a general construction for every $SU(N)$, $N\geq3$. Starting from the $SU(2)$ threshold operator $O_{24}$, we select pairs of eigenvalues of one scalar and construct corrected two-colour letters whose $Q$-transformations obey the $SU(2)$ rules exactly. Substitution into $O_{24}$ gives a closed rational operator for each pair. Multiplying by eigenvalue-separation factors removes the denominators, and summing over all pairs produces a gauge-invariant polynomial. An exact block-restriction identity recovers a nonzero multiple of $O_{24}$. The restriction maps every stable class to a stable $SU(2)$ class, proving that the resulting operator is non-exact and fortuitous, even when non-Coulombic stable classes are included. This proves the existence of fortuitous BMN cohomology at every $N\geq3$. The construction is an exact algebraic realization of a nonabelian core with scalar dressing.

一句话导读：构造并证明了对每个 $N\geq3$ 都存在无稳定大 $N$ 祖先的偶然 BMN $Q$-上同调类，给出非阿贝尔核心加标量毛的精确代数实现。

中文摘要：尽管渐近平直黑洞通常缺乏热力学相变，本文表明在 Einstein-Maxwell-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet 理论中，电中性黑洞的曲率诱导标量化可自然产生非平凡热力学行为，而无需外部束缚机制或扩展热力学形式。作者在正则系综中采用欧几里得方法，识别出局部稳定的标量化态与 Reissner-Nordström 热态共存，使自由能交叉成为真正的平衡相之间相变。弱耦合时，二级相变与第二个分叉点重合，标量化支与 Reissner-Nordström 支重新连接并自发脱去标量毛。随耦合增强，该相变变为零级，标量化支收缩，其 Helmholtz 自由能出现鱼状结构，使局部稳定热态部分变为亚稳，并可产生最多三次相变。强耦合极限下，标量化支退化为类 Schwarzschild 解，Reissner-Nordström 相最终成为唯一热力学偏好构型。

English: Although asymptotically flat black holes generically lack thermodynamic phase transitions, we show that curvature-induced scalarization of electrically charged black holes in Einstein-Maxwell-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet theory provides a natural setting for nontrivial thermodynamic behavior, without invoking external confining mechanisms or an extended thermodynamic formalism. Working within the canonical ensemble and employing the Euclidean approach, we identify the coexistence of locally stable scalarized and Reissner-Nordstr\"{o}m thermal states, which promotes free-energy crossings to bona fide phase transitions between equilibrium phases. For weak coupling, a second-order phase transition coincides with the second bifurcation point, at which the scalarized branch reconnects with the Reissner-Nordstr\"{o}m branch and scalar hair is spontaneously shed. As the coupling strength increases, this transition becomes zeroth order, the scalarized branch shrinks, and a fish-like structure develops in its Helmholtz free energy, rendering locally stable thermal states partially metastable, and yielding up to three phase transitions. In the strong-coupling limit, the scalarized branch reduces to a Schwarzschild-like solution, and the Reissner-Nordstr\"{o}m phase ultimately emerges as the sole thermodynamically preferred configuration.

English: In this article we study uniqueness of the Black String, i.e. the product of 4-dimensional Schwarzschild space with a circle of length L. In arXiv:2410.20967, this was reduced to a non-linear elliptic PDE, and we use this setup to show that for small L the Black String is infinitesimally rigid as a Ricci-flat metric. Using a fixed point theorem, we prove that this implies local uniqueness, i.e. there exist no other Ricci-flat metrics near the Black String, and we give bounds for the size of the neighborhood in which the Black String is unique. We compare this with the toy problem of a scalar field satisfying an elliptic equation that was already solved in arXiv:2410.20967 using different methods. English: A recent work [Senovilla, Port. Math. 80 (2023)] has shown that accretion of matter by a Schwarzschild-de Sitter black hole can take this object beyond a critical limit where the event and cosmological horizons coalesce, transforming it into a collapsing universe resembling a Kantowski-Sachs cosmology. Integrating the absolute square of the cosmological wavefunction over boundary moduli gives cosmological observables. Carrollian Symmetries and Dynamical Entropy

中文摘要：Carroll 几何近来被视为从内禀视角理解零超曲面几何的合适语言。本文表明，Carroll 流形内禀共形对称性对应的 Noether 电荷恰好给出 Hollands、Wald 和 Zhang 最近提出的动力学熵公式。该结果直接来自在协变相空间意义下要求有限距离零超曲面上诱导的引力相空间无反常。随后作者证明，由穿过该超曲面的外部物质扰动源化的该动力学熵电荷的线性化扰动满足物理过程第一定律；并且在施加经典零能量条件时，动力学熵满足线性化第二定律。文章进一步转向半经典推广，论证通过考虑外部量子物质源化的扰动，可以得到动力学广义熵的概念；在施加量子零能量条件（QNEC）后，发现动力学广义熵的线性化扰动满足广义第二定律。最后，作者用这些结果推测其与量子聚焦猜想的联系。

English: Carrollian geometry has recently emerged as the proper language to understand the geometry of null hypersurfaces from an intrinsic perspective. In this paper, we demonstrate that the Noether charge associated with the intrinsic conformal symmetry of Carrollian manifolds yields exactly the dynamical entropy formula recently proposed by Hollands, Wald and Zhang. This result follows directly from the requirement that the gravitational phase space induced on a finite distance null hypersurface be anomaly-free, in a covariant phase space sense. We then show that a linearized perturbation of this dynamical entropy charge, sourced by an external matter perturbation falling across the hypersurface, satisfies a physical process first law. Moreover, upon imposing the classical null energy condition, a linearized second law holds for the dynamical entropy. We then turn to a semi-classical generalization of this construction, where we argue that a notion of dynamical generalized entropy follows from considering perturbations sourced by external quantum matter. By imposing the quantum null energy condition (QNEC), we find a generalized second law for a linearized perturbation of the dynamical generalized entropy. Finally, we use our results to speculate on relations to the quantum focusing conjecture.

Graviphoton mixing with KK modes in the 2D effective theory of charged black holes

Yoshihiko Abe, Tetsutaro Higaki, Yu Miyauchi · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文研究大质量Kaluza-Klein模对四维Einstein-Maxwell理论在Reissner-Nordström黑洞背景上经S^2约化所得二维低能有效理论的影响。除无质量部分外，还保留第一激发（l=1）Maxwell Kaluza-Klein模。背景电场通量使Maxwell Kaluza-Klein标量与引力光子发生混合，大质量标量的树级交换产生正比于黑洞电荷平方的引力光子动能项修正。在领先局域近似下，还微扰计算了引力光子动能项的一圈修正，发现其不依赖于黑洞电荷。作者发现，在近极端情形下，依赖电荷的树级修正与经典引力光子动能项在参数上可比。

English: We study the effects of massive Kaluza--Klein modes on the two-dimensional low-energy effective theory obtained by the $S^2$ reduction of four-dimensional Einstein--Maxwell theory on a Reissner--Nordstr\"om black hole background. We retain the first excited ($l=1$) Maxwell Kaluza--Klein modes in addition to the massless sector. The background electric flux mixes the Maxwell Kaluza--Klein scalars with the graviphotons, and tree-level exchange of the massive scalars generates a correction to the graviphoton kinetic term proportional to the square of the black hole charge. Within the leading local approximation, we also perturbatively evaluate the one-loop correction to the graviphoton kinetic term and find no dependence on the black hole charge. We find that near extremality, the charge-dependent tree-level correction becomes parametrically comparable to the classical graviphoton kinetic term.

Extended Local Infrared Cutoff for the Holographic Density

L. N. Granda · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文为全息密度提出一种扩展的局域红外截断，使宇宙学方程线性化并给出精确解析解。该模型可移除基于 H 和 \dot H 的局域构造中残余的类物质和类辐射项，从而清晰分离标准宇宙学流体与全息部分。齐次解产生特征模式，导致不同宇宙学行为；扩展包含至三阶导数，其中两个模式可修改复合前膨胀并减小声视界，同时在 BBN 时期保持次主导。一个轻微 phantom 模式提供额外的晚期几何自由度，可进一步提高 CMB 兼容的 H0 值。利用 BAO 约束优化得到 H0 约 70.5–72.4 km/s/Mpc。

English: We propose an extended local infrared cutoff for the holographic density that leads to linear cosmological equations and gives exact analytical solutions. The model allows to remove the residual matter and radiation-like terms of the local construction based on $H$ and $\dot{H}$, resulting in a clear separation between the standard cosmological fluids and the holographic sector. The homogeneous solution generates characteristic modes that give rise to different cosmological behaviors. The extension includes derivatives up to third order, where two of the characteristic modes can modify the pre-recombination expansion and reduce the sound horizon while remaining subdominant at BBN. A slightly phantom mode provides an additional late-time geometrical freedom that can further increase the CMB-compatible value of $H_0$. Optimizations using BAO constraints yield values of $H_0$ in the approximate range $70.5-72.4\ {\rm km\;s^{-1}\;Mpc^{-1}}$.

Orientifold 与可积性：RP^4 上的 N=4 超 Yang-Mills 理论

Orientifold and Integrability: $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super-Yang-Mills on $\mathbb{RP}^4$

Joao Caetano, Shota Komatsu, Paolo Soresina, Anders Wallberg · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：我们利用可积性、全息与超对称局域化研究实射影空间 RP^4 上的平面 N=4 超 Yang-Mills 理论，并讨论其与弦论中 orientifold 的关系。我们证明，将定义 RP^4 的 Z2 对合与 SU(N) 规范群的电荷共轭作用结合时，N=4 SYM 的可积性仍得以保持。我们通过在弱耦合下计算各子扇区中非 BPS 单迹算符的单点函数来证明这一点；这些单点函数可映射为可积自旋链中能量本征态与 crosscap 态的重叠。结果表现出宇称选择定则（可积性的一个标志），并以行列式之比给出。基于这些结果，我们猜测一般单迹算符的闭式公式。我们进一步通过在 pp-wave 极限下构造相应的世界面 crosscap 态，提供证据表明该构造全息对偶于 AdS5×S5 中的探针 orientifold O1-膜。最后，我们使用超对称局域化在有限 g_YM 和 N 下精确计算半 BPS 算符的单点函数。该计算约化为 RP^2 上由电荷共轭扭曲的二维 Yang-Mills 理论，并导出一个 Wishart-Laguerre 型矩阵积分。在平面极限下，精确结果在弱耦合规范理论结果、orientifold 的强耦合超引力预言以及 pp-wave 极限下的世界面 crosscap 之间插值。

English: We study planar $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory (SYM) on the real projective space $\mathbb{RP}^4$ using integrability, holography and supersymmetric localization, and discuss its relation to orientifolds in string theory. We show that the integrability of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM is preserved when combining the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ involution defining $\mathbb{RP}^4$ with the action of the charge conjugation of the SU$(N)$ gauge group. We demonstrate this by calculating one-point functions of non-BPS single-trace operators in various subsectors at weak coupling, which can be mapped to overlaps between energy eigenstates and crosscap states in integrable spin chains. The results exhibit a parity selection rule, a hallmark of integrability, and are given in terms of a ratio of determinants. Building on these results, we conjecture a closed formula for general single-trace operators. We further provide evidence that this construction is holographically dual to a probe orientifold O1-plane in $\text{AdS}_5\times \text{S}^5$ by constructing the corresponding worldsheet crosscap states in the pp-wave limit. Finally, we use supersymmetric localization to compute one-point functions of half-BPS operators exactly at finite $g_{\rm YM}$ and $N$. The computation reduces to two-dimensional Yang-Mills theory on $\mathbb{RP}^2$ twisted by charge conjugation and leads to a matrix integral of a Wishart-Laguerre type. In the planar limit, the exact result interpolates between the weak-coupling gauge-theory result, the strong-coupling supergravity prediction for the orientifold, and the worldsheet crosscap in the pp-wave limit.

一句话导读：利用可积性、全息与超对称局域化研究 RP^4 上 N=4 SYM 的单点函数及其 orientifold O1 对偶。

来自调和超空间的扭曲关联函数

Twisted Correlators from Harmonic Superspace

Dennis le Plat, Torben Skrzypek · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：我们为 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论的 N=2 orbifold 建立了调和超空间表述。我们通过在 N=4 SYM 的平面超图中引入拓扑缺陷线来计入 orbifold 投影。这些扭曲线由扭曲扇区算符提供源，对矢量多重态透明，但当双基本超多重态场穿过时会产生 orbifold 相位。该形式在超图层面给出了 orbifold 继承原理的一种细化。作为直接应用，我们计算了对 BPS 两点和三点关联函数的领头扭曲相关修正，在极端情形下与局域化结果一致，并为非极端关联函数产生新数据。我们进一步将这些修正映射到扭曲六边形形式中的有限尺寸效应。这为 orbifold 结构常数的全阶可积性方案开辟了道路。

English: We establish a harmonic superspace formulation for $\mathcal N=2$ orbifolds of $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang-Mills (SYM) theory. We account for the orbifold projection by introducing topological defect lines to the planar supergraphs of $\mathcal N=4$ SYM. These twist lines are sourced by twisted sector operators, transparent to vector multiplets but generate orbifold phases when crossed by bifundamental hypermultiplet fields. This formalism establishes a refinement of the orbifold inheritance principle at supergraph level. As a direct application, we compute leading twist-dependent corrections to BPS two- and three-point functions, finding agreement with localisation results in extremal cases and generating new data for non-extremal correlators. We further map these corrections to finite-size effects in the twisted hexagon formalism. This opens a path towards an all-order integrability prescription of orbifold structure constants.

一句话导读：在调和超空间中用拓扑扭曲线研究 N=2 orbifold N=4 SYM 的 BPS 关联函数修正，并联系六边形可积性。

引力 EFT 中的准正规模稳定性界限：可分辨性、可预测性与正定性

Quasinormal-mode stability bounds in gravitational EFT: resolvability, predictivity, and positivity

Leonardo Juliano, Enrico Trincherini · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：该文讨论一个曾被提出的观点：在广义相对论推广中，一致性会限制黑洞铃宕的最慢衰减，EFT 修正至多把准正规模衰减时间延长约一个振荡周期，即 Re[ω_GR] δτ ≲ 1。作者论证，在标准幂次计数下，这个条件并不给出新的、模型无关的引力 EFT 约束。首先，其动机不能直接推广到黑洞：振荡频率的倒数并不是经典波形阻尼时间中普适且与探测器无关的不确定度。主要论证仅依赖 eikonal 幂次计数：衰减时间移动随模式角动量 ℓ 增长，但高阶导数算符的权重也同样增长；当曲率和导数由单一能标 Λ 控制时（已知紫外完成均如此），半径为 r_s 的黑洞周围 EFT 可预测到 ℓ ∼ (r_s Λ)^2，而移动在此处才变为一阶，此时无限多个算符同阶贡献。若要在可预测范围内得到可分辨的移动，需要大数值系数或双尺度幂次计数，而后者没有已知紫外完成。两种情形下四阶曲率算符都占主导，该条件在参数上与平直空间引力子振幅在标准紫外假设下给出的正定性界限重合。只有在标量-张量理论中，双尺度窗口才可能探测正定性之外，且至多涉及一族十维算符。Einstein-dilaton-Gauss-Bonnet 引力的轴向扇区和 Einstein-Maxwell 理论被用来说明这些结果。

English: It has been proposed that consistency limits how slowly black holes can ring down in extensions of General Relativity: effective-field-theory (EFT) corrections may lengthen the decay time of a quasinormal mode by at most about one oscillation period, $\Re[\omega_{\rm GR}]\,\delta\tau\lesssim1$. We argue that, under standard power counting, this condition yields no new, model-independent constraint on gravitational EFTs. First, its motivation does not extend straightforwardly to black holes: the inverse oscillation frequency is not a universal, detector-independent uncertainty in the damping time of a classical waveform. Our main argument, however, rests on eikonal power counting alone. The decay-time shift grows with the angular momentum $\ell$ of the mode, but so does the weight of higher-derivative operators. When curvature and derivatives are controlled by a single scale $\Lambda$, as in every known ultraviolet completion, the EFT around a black hole of radius $r_s$ remains predictive up to $\ell\sim(r_s\Lambda)^2$, and the shift becomes of order one only there, where an infinite tower of operators contributes at the same order. A resolvable shift within the predictive regime requires either large numerical coefficients or a two-scale power counting, which has no known ultraviolet completion. In both cases the quartic-curvature operators dominate, and the condition coincides parametrically with the positivity bounds that flat-space graviton amplitudes impose under standard assumptions on the ultraviolet completion. Only in scalar--tensor theories could the two-scale window probe beyond positivity, and then at most one family of dimension-ten operators. The axial sector of Einstein--dilaton--Gauss--Bonnet gravity and Einstein--Maxwell theory illustrate these results.

一句话导读：作者用 eikonal 幂次计数表明，标准单尺度引力 EFT 下 QNM 衰减时间的“稳定性界限”不能给出新的模型无关约束，通常与四阶曲率正定性界限参数上重合。

具有交叉物态的混合星

Hybrid Stars with a Crossover Equation of State

G. A. Tsalis, Ch. C. Moustakidis · nucl-th, astro-ph.SR · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：超致密核物质中是否发生相变仍是核物理的开放问题，尤其是从纯强子物质到假定退禁闭夸克物质的转变备受关注。除基础意义外，该转变对致密天体物理（包括中子星、夸克星和混合星）有重要影响。传统方法采用 Maxwell 和 Gibbs 构造，二者已被广泛研究和应用。本工作关注第三种替代方案，即通过所谓切换函数实现从强子物质到夸克物质的平滑过渡。具体而言，本文有两个主要目标：第一，系统研究对称能对与向夸克物质转变相关的转变密度和化学势的影响；第二，尝试对刻画切换函数的两个参数进行物理约束和参数化，使强子到夸克物质的转变不仅是连续的，而且符合相关物理要求。主要结论是，在适当选择上述参数时，该唯象模型更具物理动机，可作为研究混合致密天体结构与性质的有用工具。此外，该方法能够灵活预测超出标准中子星理论范围的致密天体性质，例如近来在观测研究中受到关注的相对低质量和小半径天体。

English: The possible occurrence of a phase transition in superdense nuclear matter remains an open problem in nuclear physics. In particular, the transition from purely hadronic matter to the hypothesized deconfined quark matter is a subject of considerable interest. Beyond its fundamental significance, this transition has important implications for the physics of compact objects, including neutron stars, quark stars, and hybrid stars. The conventional approaches to this problem involve the Maxwell and Gibbs constructions, both of which have been extensively studied and applied. In the present study, we focus on a third, alternative approach based on a smooth transition from hadronic to quark matter through the so-called switching function. More specifically, the present work focuses on two main objectives. The first is to systematically investigate the influence of the symmetry energy on the transition densities and chemical potentials associated with the transition to quark matter. Subsequently, we attempt to physically constrain and parametrize the two parameters characterizing the switching function, ensuring that the transition from hadronic to quark matter is not merely continuous but also consistent with relevant physical requirements. The main conclusion is that, with an appropriate choice of the aforementioned parameters, the phenomenological model becomes more physically motivated and can serve as a useful tool for investigating the structure and properties of hybrid compact objects. Moreover, this approach offers the flexibility to predict the properties of compact objects that lie beyond the scope of standard neutron-star theory, such as objects characterized by relatively low masses and small radii, which have recently attracted considerable attention in observational studies.

一句话导读：用切换函数实现强子到夸克物质平滑过渡的交叉物态，并研究对称能影响与混合星性质。

X-ADM 质量的共形约化

A conformal reduction for the X-ADM mass

Stephen McCormick · math.DG, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：X-ADM 质量是 Mantegazza 与 Oronzio 最近为渐近平坦流形引入的 ADM 质量推广，他们在三维且满足某拓扑条件下证明了该量的正质量定理。本文在所有维度 n≥3 且无拓扑限制下证明带刚性的 X-正质量定理。为此，先证明 X-正质量定理中出现的标量曲率条件蕴含度量为正 Yamabe 型；随后证明给定度量的 X-ADM 质量等于其共形类中标量平坦代表度量的 ADM 质量加上一个显式非负项。由此，X-正质量定理可由标准正质量定理推出。作为推论，得到所有维度中广义相对论的黎曼质量-电荷不等式，而此前仅对自旋流形成立。最后，给出带边界流形的 X-正质量定理版本。

English: The X-ADM mass is a generalisation of the ADM mass for asymptotically flat manifolds, recently introduced by Mantegazza and Oronzio [arXiv:2602.11372], who proved a positive mass theorem for this quantity in dimension $3$ under a certain topological condition. In this article, we prove the X-positive mass theorem with rigidity in all dimensions $n\geq3$ without any topological restrictions. To this end, we first prove that the scalar curvature condition appearing in the X-positive mass theorem implies the metric is of positive Yamabe type. We then show that the X-ADM mass of the given metric is equal to the ADM mass of a scalar-flat representative in its conformal class plus a term that is explicitly non-negative. From this, the X-positive mass theorem follows from the standard positive mass theorem. As a corollary, we obtain the Riemannian mass--charge inequality of general relativity in all dimensions, which was previously only known for spin manifolds. Finally, we give a version of the X-positive mass theorem for a manifold with boundary.

一句话导读：通过共形约化在所有维度且无拓扑限制下证明带刚性的 X-正质量定理，并得到黎曼质量-电荷不等式。

用星际任务检验黑洞：II. 飞掠探测器

Testing Black Holes with Interstellar Missions: II. Flyby Probes

Yi Fan, Cosimo Bambi, Leda Gao, Abdurakhmon Nosirov, Andrea Santangelo · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：近期研究表明，尽管前往最近黑洞的星际任务仍高度推测性且极具挑战，但在未来数十年内并非完全不可行。鉴于此类任务可能耗时约一百年并需要大量财力和人力投入，必须评估它能否以可预见的未来太阳系观测站无法达到的程度研究黑洞并检验广义相对论。在第一篇论文中，作者假设具备航天器减速能力，并初步研究了轨道探测器如何检验该致密天体的性质。在这第二篇论文中，作者研究如何在不减速航天器的情况下，利用飞掠探测器检验黑洞。

English: Recently, we demonstrated that while an interstellar mission to the nearest black hole remains highly speculative and extraordinarily challenging, it is not entirely implausible within the coming decades. Given that such a mission would likely take about a hundred years and require substantial financial and human investment, it is essential to assess whether it could investigate black holes and test General Relativity to a degree that cannot be achieved by Solar System observatories for the foreseeable future. In Paper I, we assumed the capability to decelerate the spacecraft and presented a preliminary study of how orbiting probes could test the nature of the compact object. In this second paper, we study how the black hole can be tested without decelerating the spacecraft, using flyby probes.

一句话导读：研究不减速航天器、以飞掠探测器检验黑洞并检验广义相对论的可行性。

面向致密双星并合引力波的深度学习搜索

Deep Learning Search for Gravitational Waves from Compact Binary Coalescence

Lorenzo Mobilia, Tito Dal Canton, Gianluca Maria Guidi · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v3 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：引力波搜索依赖于匹配滤波、相干分析以及近年来基于机器学习的流程等多种方法。对于致密双星并合——其信号来源于致密天体的相对论动力学——匹配滤波仍是核心要素，但随着下一代干涉仪（如爱因斯坦望远镜）所需的数据量和参数空间覆盖范围增加，其计算成本将大幅上升。因此，发展能够在保持探测性能的同时降低计算负担的补充策略十分必要。我们研究了一种将匹配滤波思想与卷积神经网络相结合的混合方法，从而在不依赖通常的χ²剔除检验的情况下实现高效信号搜索。利用包含注入信号的高斯噪声、瞬态噪声以及模板库未涵盖的物理效应（如偏心率、进动和高阶模式）的模拟数据集，我们表明：在信号所含物理未在模板库中体现或数据受到毛刺影响的所有情形下，该方法达到与标准匹配滤波搜索相当或更好的探测效率，同时提供更节省资源的流程。反之，分析也揭示出，在纯高斯噪声中对标准BNS/BBH搜索存在一定的探测能力损失。这些结果表明，深度学习辅助搜索可以支撑未来探测器时代的可持续引力波数据分析。

English: Gravitational-wave searches rely on a combination of methods, including matched filtering, coherent analyses, and more recent machine-learning-based pipelines. For compact binary coalescences --- where signals originate from the relativistic dynamics of compact objects --- matched filtering remains a central element, but its computational cost will increase substantially with the data volumes and parameter-space coverage required by next-generation interferometers such as the Einstein Telescope. Developing complementary strategies that reduce computational load while preserving detection performance is therefore essential. We investigate a hybrid approach that combines matched-filtering concepts with Convolutional Neural Networks, enabling efficient signal searches without relying on the usual $\chi^2$ rejection test. Using simulated data sets that include injected signals in Gaussian noise, transient noise, and physical effects not represented in the template bank --- such as eccentricity, precession and higher-order modes --- we show that the method achieves a detection efficiency comparable to or better than a standard matched-filtering search while offering a more resource-efficient pipeline in all the cases where the physics included in the signals were not represented in the template bank or when glitches were affecting the data. Conversely, the analysis also reveals some loss of detection capability for standard BNS/BBH searches in pure Gaussian noise. These results indicate that deep-learning-assisted searches can support sustainable gravitational-wave data analysis in future detector eras.

一句话导读：该文提出匹配滤波与卷积神经网络结合的混合搜索方法，以更低计算成本探测致密双星并合引力波，并在非模板物理与毛刺场景中保持或提升效率。

持久的mEMRIs：活动星系核盘中多个黑洞极端质量比旋近的信号

Lasting mEMRIs: Signatures of Multiple Black Hole Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals from AGN discs

Jordan W. N. Moncrieff, Evgeni Grishin, Fiona H. Panther, Alessandro A. Trani · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：活动星系核盘中的恒星级黑洞相遇会自然形成黑洞对的平均运动共振。当引力波辐射超过气体力矩时，这些平均运动共振可在靠近中心超大质量黑洞处被破坏。我们推导出一个仅依赖恒星级黑洞质量比和共振指数的简单条件，用来判断一对处于平均运动共振的恒星级黑洞能否保持完整，并作为多重极端质量比旋近（mEMRIs）在LISA波段被探测到。我们首次给出处于平均运动共振、共同迁移的一对恒星级黑洞的引力波应变信号，包括与单个EMRI轨道会合相关的额外引力波谐波。其频率演化和相应啁啾质量与不同质量的孤立EMRI存在简并。然而，mEMRI的质量比被共振阶数量子化，并大于真实质量比；若能从单个应变振幅推断真实恒星级黑洞质量比，则可打破该简并。我们认为，若盘驱动的EMRI能被LISA探测到，mEMRIs应当常见，在本地宇宙（z≲0.2）中约为每年10个，这凸显了未来LISA数据分析中建模mEMRI系统的必要性。

English: Encounters of stellar-mass black holes (sBH) in active galactic nuclei discs naturally form mean-motion resonances of sBH pairs. These mean-motion resonances can be broken close to the central supermassive black hole when gravitational-wave emission dominates over gas torques. We derive a simple condition that depends only on the sBH mass ratio and the resonance index for which a pair of sBH in a mean-motion resonance will remain intact and can be detectable as a multiple Extreme-Mass-Ratio-Inspirals (mEMRIs) in the LISA band. We present for the first time the gravitational-wave strain signatures of a pair of co-migrating sBH in mean-motion resonance, including additional gravitational-wave harmonics associated with orbital conjunctions of the individual EMRIs. The frequency evolution and the associated chirp mass is degenerate with isolated EMRIs of different masses. However, the mEMRI mass ratio is quantised by the resonance order and is larger than the true mass ratio. The degeneracy can be broken if the true sBH mass ratio can be inferred from individual strain amplitudes. We argue that mEMRIs should be common if disc driven EMRIs are to be detected by LISA, with $\sim 10$ mEMRIs per year in the local universe ($z \lesssim 0.2$), highlighting the need to model mEMRI systems in future LISA data analysis.

快速旋转中子星中r模非线性演化的广义相对论模拟

General Relativistic Simulations of the Nonlinear Evolution of r-modes in Rapidly Rotating Neutron Stars

Justin K. Yu, Andrew Melatos · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：旋转中子星中的r模是连续引力波的一个有希望来源，并可能增长或被激发到振幅 α≲1。我们对自转频率约 792 Hz 的快速旋转中子星中非线性 l=|m|=2 r模进行了广义相对论模拟，放松了 Cowling 近似和小 α 近似。恒星被理想化为无磁场、单组分、完美流体，并采用多方物态方程。对于初始振幅 α0=0.2，测得 r模频率为 1014 Hz；无量纲频率 κ≈0.7197 与线性微扰理论估计在 1.7% 以内一致。f_r-mode 随振幅二次增加，而在 0.2≤α0≤1.2 范围内改变 α0 的模拟中 κ 下降 3.4%。由 Newman-Penrose 标量计算出的引力波应变给出：当 α0=0.2 时，在 10 kpc 处 h_r-mode≈9.7×10^-22，与爱因斯坦四极矩公式在 35% 以内一致。我们还报告了模拟中观察到的非线性现象，例如较差自转、振幅衰减以及时空振荡中非线性模式耦合的迹象。

English: The r-modes in rotating neutron stars are a promising source of continuous gravitational waves, and may grow or be excited to amplitudes $\alpha\lesssim1$. We perform general relativistic simulations of nonlinear $l=|m|=2$ r-modes in a rapidly rotating neutron star with spin frequency $f_{spin}\approx792$ Hz, relaxing the Cowling and small-$\alpha$ approximations. The star is idealised as an unmagnetised, one-component, perfect fluid with a polytropic equation of state. The r-mode frequency is measured to be $f_{r-mode}=1014$ Hz for initial amplitude $\alpha_0=0.2$. The dimensionless frequency $\kappa\approx0.7197$ agrees with an estimate from linear perturbation theory to within 1.7%. $f_{r-mode}$ increases quadratically with amplitude, and $\kappa$ decreases by 3.4% across simulations where $\alpha_0$ is varied through the range $0.2\leq\alpha_0\leq1.2$. The gravitational wave strain calculated from the Newman-Penrose scalar implies $h_{r-mode}\approx9.7\times10^{-22}$ at $10$ kpc for $\alpha_0=0.2$, which agrees with Einstein's quadrupole formula to within 35%. We also report on nonlinear phenomena observed in our simulations, e.g. differential rotation, amplitude decay, and signatures of nonlinear mode coupling in the spacetime oscillations.

一句话导读：用广义相对论数值模拟研究快速旋转中子星中非线性r模的频率、引力波应变与非线性耦合现象。

English: We investigate weak lensing effects of a chiral gravitational wave background (GWB) as a new mechanism for generating parity-odd correlations in the cosmic microwave background (CMB). Accounting for both photon deflection and polarization rotation, we derive the resulting parity-odd EB and TB angular power spectra. For representative GWB energy density spectra, we find parameter choices that provide good fits to existing measurements. This mechanism provides a potential observational probe of chiral GWB, which can arise in a wide range of theoretical scenarios.

先验体积效应抬高脉冲星计时阵列中的引力波背景

Prior volume effect inflates the gravitational-wave background in pulsar timing arrays

Biwei Dai, Matias Zaldarriaga, Yacine Ali-Ha\"{\i}moud · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.IM, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）已发现纳赫兹引力波背景（GWB）的证据，其振幅超过基于超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）的大多数预言。利用 NANOGrav 15 年数据，我们表明这一超出部分的相当大比例来自先验体积效应。GWB 振幅主要受脉冲星自相关约束，其中 GWB 与每颗脉冲星的内禀红噪声简并。通过分解 GWB 后验，我们发现对标准对数均匀红噪声先验进行边缘化会引入一个偏爱更强 GWB 的先验体积项，将推断振幅拉高到最大似然估计以上超过 2σ。仅测量 GWB 的 Hellings-Downs（HD）交叉相关不足以抵消该体积项。轮廓似然、仅交叉相关估计量，以及对功率均匀或由脉冲星族群信息给出的先验，都能避免或减弱这一效应，并将振幅降低到与 SMBHB 一致。修正后的先验还给出更接近 SMBHB 预言的更陡 GWB 谱，增强 HD 相关的证据，并削弱对新物理源优于 SMBHB 的偏好。

English: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) have found evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background (GWB) whose amplitude exceeds most predictions based on supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs). Using NANOGrav 15-year data, we show that a substantial part of this excess arises from a prior volume effect. The GWB amplitude is constrained mainly by the pulsars' auto-correlations, where the GWB is degenerate with each pulsar's intrinsic red noise. By decomposing the GWB posterior, we find that marginalizing over the standard log-uniform red-noise priors introduces a prior volume term that favors a stronger GWB, pulling the inferred amplitude more than $2\sigma$ above the maximum-likelihood estimate. The Hellings-Downs (HD) cross-correlations, which measure the GWB alone, are not strong enough to counter the volume term. The profile likelihood, a cross-correlation-only estimator, and priors that are uniform in power or informed by the pulsar population all avoid or reduce this effect and lower the amplitude into agreement with SMBHBs. The revised priors also yield a steeper GWB spectrum closer to the SMBHB predictions, strengthen the evidence for HD correlations, and weaken the preference for new-physics sources over SMBHBs.

一句话导读：利用 NANOGrav 15 年数据表明，GWB 振幅相对 SMBHB 预言的超出部分主要源于红噪声先验体积效应；修正先验后振幅回到与 SMBHB 一致的范围。

并合致密双星的后绝热有效单体波形

Post-adiabatic effective-one-body waveforms for coalescing compact binaries

Rossella Gamba · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文将 Damour 等（2004）和 Lynch 等（2026）的密切轨道形式应用并推广到偏心有效单体（EOB）模型，以高效且准确地描述潮汐、自旋致密双星从旋近到 plunging 的动力学，并通过扭转原本平面运动来包含进动情形。方法改用 equinoctial 轨道根数，以避免零偏心率极限相关的奇点。该形式具有通用性，可应用于任何 EOB 模型；本文聚焦 TEOBResumS-Dalí 家族，并展示该技术如何加速波形生成而不显著牺牲模型精度。对超过 10^4 个双中子星（BNS）和同样数量的双黑洞（BBH），初始偏心率在 20 Hz 时最高达 0.6，相对于该模型优化版本的中位加速约为 BNS 2.6 倍、BBH 1.5 倍，与完整数值解的失配始终低于 5×10^-7。单个系统的最大加速可达约 7 倍，出现在低偏心率（e0≲0.1）的轻 BBH（M≲8 M⊙）中。绝对而言，生成 BNS 波形的中位时间约为 0.5 秒，99.7% 的系统低于一秒；对于长信号，该模型比先前版本最多快约 26 倍。将该方法用于 e→0 极限下的初始条件计算时，引入辐射反作用效应可使模型输入偏心率与规范不变波形偏心率一致到初始值约 7×10^-8。除时域应用外，同一构造还通过多谐波驻相近似给出偏心致密双星的频域 EOB 波形。

English: I apply and extend the formalism of osculating orbits of Damour et al. (2004) and Lynch et al. (2026) to eccentric effective one body (EOB) models, in order to obtain an efficient yet accurate description of the inspiral-to-plunge dynamics of tidal, spinning compact binaries, including precessing ones by twisting the otherwise planar motion. The method is recast in terms of equinoctial orbital elements, to circumvent singularities associated with the zero-eccentricity limit. While the formalism is general and can be applied to any EOB model, I focus here on the TEOBResumS-Dal\'i family and demonstrate how this technique speeds up waveform generation without significantly compromising the accuracy of the model. Over $10^4$ binary neutron stars (BNSs) and as many binary black holes (BBHs) with initial eccentricities up to $0.6$ at $20$ Hz, the median speedup against an optimized version of the model is $\sim 2.6$ for BNSs and $\sim 1.5$ for BBHs, with mismatches against the full numerical solution always below $5 \times 10^{-7}$. The largest speedups, up to $\sim 7$ for individual systems, are obtained for light BBHs ($M \lesssim 8 M_\odot$) with low eccentricities $(e_0 \lesssim 0.1)$. In absolute terms, the median time needed to generate a BNS waveform is $\sim 0.5$ s, with $99.7\%$ of the systems below one second, and for long signals the model is up to $\sim 26$ times faster than a previous version. Applied to the calculation of initial conditions in the $e \rightarrow 0$ limit, the inclusion of radiation-reaction effects allows the model's input eccentricity to agree with the gauge-invariant waveform eccentricity down to initial values of $\sim 7 \times 10^{-8}$. Beyond time-domain applications, the same construction also gives frequency-domain EOB waveforms for eccentric compact binaries via a multi-harmonic stationary phase approximation.

Jun-Xi Shi, Zhen-Tao He, Tingyuan Jiang, Yu Tian, Dan-Dan Yuan, Hongbao Zhang · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：对双星引力波形做准正规模（QNM）滤波后剩余的波形常被称为直接波，近来引发了相当多讨论。该残余波形的解析模型涉及多层近似，而滤波对建模的影响仍不清楚，这些问题需要进一步研究。本文考察这些模型中的近似误差、适用极限以及滤波的作用。我们发现，所考察的点粒子模型与滤波后的双黑洞波形存在明显差异。基于稳相近似的解析粒子模板对(ℓ,m)=(2,2)多极表现尚可，但对(4,4)多极存在显著局限。尽管滤波器是全通的，它仍会显著影响建模结果。我们在Schwarzschild背景上的解析计算进一步表明，具有高斯初始数据的真空扰动在滤波后也可以呈现类似直接波的波形，其形态取决于初始数据相对于光子环的位置。

English: The waveform left after quasinormal modes filtering of binary gravitational waveforms, often called the direct wave, has recently attracted considerable debate. Analytic models of this residual waveform involve several levels of approximation, while the effects of filtering on the modeling remain unclear. These issues require further investigation. In this paper, we examine the approximation errors, limits of applicability, and role of filtering in these models. We find that the point-particle models examined here show notable discrepancies with the filtered Binary-black-holes waveforms. Analytic particle templates based on the stationary-phase approximation perform reasonably well for the \((\ell,m)=(2,2)\) multipole, but exhibit substantial limitations for the \((4,4)\). Although the filter is all-pass, it substantially affects the modeling results. Our analytic calculations on a Schwarzschild background further show that vacuum perturbations with Gaussian initial data can also exhibit direct-wave-like waveforms after filtering, with their morphology depending on the location of the initial data relative to the light ring.

中文摘要：我们给出旋转 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞的非线性 3+1 演化。我们用谱求解器构造稳态旋转 drainhole 解，直至赤道旋转速度达到光速的 99%，用已发表的对称解验证求解器，并修正已发表场方程中的一处不一致。仅由截断误差扰动的演化表明，旋转会减慢静态虫洞的径向不稳定性。在接近极值角动量的 30% 时，未受扰动的喉部会膨胀而不是坍缩，而不是像二阶微扰论所暗示的那样不稳定性消失。从 58% 往上，在演化时间内未发现不稳定性证据；在最快自旋下，这一结论在三种分辨率下成立。坍缩的旋转喉部会发出轴对称四极引力波暴，其能量随自旋增长。二阶微扰初始数据会通过其自身的截断误差触发不稳定性，因此不适合用于稳定性研究。

English: We present nonlinear 3+1 evolutions of rotating Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes. We construct stationary rotating drainhole solutions with a spectral solver up to an equatorial rotation velocity of 99% of the speed of light, validate the solver against published symmetric solutions, and correct an inconsistency in a published field equation. Perturbed only by truncation error, the evolutions show that rotation slows the radial instability of the static wormhole. Near 30% of the extremal angular momentum the unperturbed throat expands instead of collapsing, rather than the instability disappearing as second-order perturbation theory suggests. From 58% upward we find no evidence of instability over the evolved times; at the fastest spin this holds at three resolutions. Collapsing rotating throats emit an axisymmetric quadrupolar gravitational-wave burst whose energy grows with spin. Second-order perturbative initial data trigger the instability through their own truncation error, so they are unsuitable for stability studies.

Teng Zhang, Amit Singh Ubhi, Huan Yang, Alan V. Cumming, Mark Barton, Angus Bell, Fabio Bergamin, Giacomo Bruno, Katherine L. Dooley, Johannes Eichholz, Mariana Fazio, Aaron Goodwin-Jones, James Hough, Keiko Kokeyama, Haixing Miao, Xingrui Peng, Geraint Pratten, Stuart Reid, Sheila Rowan, Patricia Schmidt, Alberto Vecchio, Giles Hammond, Hartmut Grote, Denis Martynov · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM, physics.ins-det · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

English: The unique underground location of the Einstein Telescope (ET) is expected to substantially suppress seismic and gravity-gradient noise, providing a favorable environment for gravitational-wave detection at low frequencies compared with surface-based observatories. The baseline ET design aims to achieve broadband sensitivity through a xylophone configuration, in which separate cryogenic and room-temperature interferometers are optimised for low- and high-frequency gravitational-wave detection. However, achieving the target low-frequency sensitivity introduces substantial technical complexity caused by vertical suspension thermal noise, vibrations of the cryocooler, and detuned optical configuration. In this paper, we demonstrate an alternative, entirely room-temperature, fully resonant, single-interferometer architecture that addresses these challenges and achieves broadband sensitivity superior to that of the conventional ET xylophone configuration. Using mature fused-silica suspension technology, recent advances in optical coatings, and novel inertial isolation, we show that 4-m-long fused-silica fibres can meet the required suspension thermal-noise performance. We further demonstrate that vibrations, optical rigidity, and quantum back-action noise can be controlled through appropriate design of the interferometer, test mass suspensions, optical seismometers, and quantum states.

中文摘要：下一代引力波探测器（如LISA、爱因斯坦望远镜和宇宙探索者）需要准确且高效的长时标偏心黑洞双星波形模型。作者此前通过将无自旋偏心有效单体动力学用密切轨道根数表述，并应用近恒等平均变换去除旋进阶段的快速轨道时标结构，降低了演化成本；但以偏心率和相对论近点角为参数的表述在圆轨道极限下奇异，排除了准圆双星和偏心旋进后期，且波形生成成本使总加速仅1.5-8倍。本文改用偏心率矢量的笛卡尔分量，使平均化方程在0≤e<1所有偏心率下正则；同时将波形模式分解为径向谐波，其系数作为平均变量的函数制表，从而在输出时间网格上以固定单样本成本直接组装波形。作者在陆基探测器可观测双星参数空间（现包括圆轨道）内用完整有效单体演化验证该方法：在第二后绝热阶，波形中位失配约10^{-8}，最大1.1×10^{-5}，相对串行EOB波形在单核上加速3-100倍，八核上最高约300倍。作者计划未来将该技术应用于最新SEOBNR模型。

English: Next-generation gravitational-wave detectors, such as LISA, the Einstein Telescope, and Cosmic Explorer, will require accurate and efficient models of long-lived, eccentric black-hole binary signals. In previous work, we reduced the cost of evolving nonspinning eccentric effective-one-body dynamics by recasting the equations of motion in terms of osculating orbital elements and applying near-identity averaging transformations to remove the fast orbital-timescale structure during the inspiral. However, the parametrization in terms of the eccentricity and relativistic anomaly becomes singular in the circular-orbit limit, excluding quasicircular binaries and the late stages of eccentric inspirals. Moreover, the cost of generating the waveform from the averaged dynamics limited the overall speed-up to a factor of $1.5-8$. In this work, we replace the eccentricity and relativistic anomaly by the Cartesian components of the eccentricity vector, in which the averaged equations are regular for all eccentricities $0 \leq e < 1$. We also decompose the waveform modes into radial harmonics whose coefficients are tabulated as functions of the averaged variables, so that the waveform is assembled directly on the output time grid at a fixed cost per sample. We validate the method against the full effective-one-body evolution across the parameter space of binaries observable by ground-based detectors, now including circular orbits. At second postadiabatic order, the waveforms reach median mismatches of $\sim 10^{-8}$ with a maximum of $1.1 \times 10^{-5}$, while achieving speed-ups of $3-100 \times$ on a single core or up to $300 \times$ on eight cores against the serial EOB waveform. Given the speed-ups demonstrated here, we plan to apply these techniques to state-of-the-art SEOBNR models in future work.

Shiyang Hu, Dan Li, Chen Deng, Lina Zhang, Wenfu Cao · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：相对论光线追踪算法是研究引力理论与高能天体物理不可或缺的数值工具。本文开发并发布 SpinOctopus，一个面向任意轴对称时空的多功能相对论光线追踪代码，采用 Fortran/Python 混合架构并由 OpenMP 多线程加速。该数值工具能够模拟类时轨道及其对应光变曲线、零测地线，以及由多种唯象源照亮的黑洞图像，包括几何薄/厚吸积盘、几何薄倾斜盘、相对论喷流、球对称吸积流和点源。执行这些任务时，用户只需在专用配置文件中指定目标时空的协变度规张量和模拟参数。得益于为测地线积分定制的自适应步长策略，SpinOctopus 在模拟几何厚吸积盘图像时，于 Intel Core i7-14700 平台上达到每线程每秒约 800 条光线的处理效率。此外，代码提供透明接口，允许用户无缝修改光源的几何与运动学性质。未来版本将引入模拟 Fe Kα 荧光线轮廓和几何厚倾斜吸积盘图像等附加功能。

English: Relativistic ray-tracing algorithms serve as indispensable numerical tools for investigating gravitational theories and high-energy astrophysics. In this paper, we develop and release SpinOctopus, a versatile relativistic ray-tracing code tailored for arbitrary axisymmetric spacetimes, powered by a Fortran/Python hybrid architecture and OpenMP multi-threading acceleration. This numerical toolkit is capable of simulating timelike orbits and their corresponding light curves, null geodesics, as well as black hole images illuminated by a wide array of phenomenological sources, including geometrically thin and thick accretion disks, geometrically thin tilted disks, relativistic jets, spherically symmetric accretion flows, and point sources. To execute these tasks, users are solely required to specify the covariant metric tensor of the target spacetime and the simulation parameters within a dedicated configuration file. Benefiting from our customized adaptive step-size strategy for geodesic integration, SpinOctopus achieves an impressive processing efficiency of $\sim 800$ rays per second per thread on an Intel Core i7-14700 platform when simulating geometrically thick accretion disk images. Furthermore, the code provides transparent interfaces, allowing users to seamlessly modify the geometric and kinematic properties of the light sources. Additional capabilities, such as simulating Fe K${\alpha}$ fluorescent line profiles and geometrically thick tilted accretion disk images, will be introduced in future releases of the framework.

English: We show that the photograph of a Schwarzschild black hole can be written in closed form. The image plane is embedded as a plane tangent to a sphere centred on the black hole, and the map between a point source and its image point, which we call the photograph function, is treated as the analytic object. Explicit expressions are obtained for sources on the celestial sphere at infinity and for sources in the equatorial plane, without solving for the intermediate null geodesics. The construction is exact, and it makes the multivalued branch structure, the relation to the photon sphere and to the shadow boundary, and the self-similar higher-order images directly readable.

全天全频引力波辐射计搜索对连续波源的取向依赖敏感性

Orientation-dependent sensitivity of the all-sky all-frequency gravitational-wave radiometer search to continuous-wave sources

Stavros Venikoudis, Giacomo Bruno · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：全天全频（ASAF）引力波辐射计搜索以相同权重交叉关联两个探测器的数据，并同时使用 + 和 × 张量偏振。这对非偏振随机背景是最优的，但对连续波（CW）源并非最优，因为其偏振取决于倾角 ι 和偏振角 ψ。除非源正对观测者，否则搜索测得的功率低于同样内禀振幅的正对源，从而低估其强度。两种功率之比即投影因子 μ²(ι,ψ)，此前辐射计研究已给出。我们展示 μ² 如何进入 ASAF 统计量，推导其对 ψ 的精确依赖，并证明其对取向的平均恰为 2/5，且与天区位置、基线几何、噪声加权和频率无关。我们将该形式应用于四个模拟脉冲星信号，位于四个天区位置，偏振从圆偏振到近线偏振，注入 O2 期间的 LIGO 探测器。一个近侧向注入以信噪比 5.20 被测量，低于 6.19 的阈值，而同一信号若正对观测则信噪比为 31.1 ± 6.0。对应变振幅 h0 的贝叶斯上限在对取向和校准不确定度边缘化后，是正对情形的 2.7 至 2.9 倍。对于 O4a 的 505 个亚阈值候选，上限增加 2.5 至 2.9 倍，同样强度的源只有在偏离正对小于 34.7° 至 50.3° 时才能达到阈值。每个候选的测量信噪比和显著性不变。

English: The all-sky all-frequency (ASAF) gravitational-wave radiometer search cross-correlates the data of two detectors with equal weight on the $+$ and $\times$ tensor polarizations. This is optimal for an unpolarized stochastic background, but not for continuous-wave (CW) sources, whose polarization depends on the inclination angle $\iota$ and the polarization angle $\psi$. Unless the source is seen face-on, the search measures less power than a face-on source with the same intrinsic amplitude, and underestimates its strength. The ratio of the two powers, the projection factor $\mu^2(\iota,\psi)$, is known from earlier radiometer studies. We show how $\mu^2$ enters the ASAF statistic, derive its exact dependence on $\psi$, and prove that its average over orientations is exactly $2/5$, independent of sky position, baseline geometry, noise weighting, and frequency. We apply the formalism to four simulated pulsar signals at four sky positions, with polarization from circular to nearly linear, injected into the LIGO detectors during the second observing run (O2). A nearly edge-on injection is measured with a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of $5.20$, below the threshold of $6.19$, while the same signal seen face-on would have an SNR of $31.1 \pm 6.0$. Bayesian upper limits on the strain amplitude $h_0$, marginalized over orientation and calibration uncertainty, are $2.7$ to $2.9$ times the face-on values. For the $505$ sub-threshold candidates of the first part of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run (O4a), the upper limits increase by a factor of $2.5$ to $2.9$, and a source of the same strength would reach threshold only when inclined by less than $34.7^{\circ}$ to $50.3^{\circ}$ from face-on. The measured SNR and the significance of every candidate are unchanged.

How general relativity stacks up: Testing gravity by coherently combining gravitational-wave observations

Lachlan Passenger, Nir Guttman, Paul D. Lasky, Eric Thrane · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：引力波天文学的核心任务之一是在高曲率、高速度区域检验广义相对论。本文提出一个框架，用于相干组合多个引力波测量，从而在族群层面检验超越广义相对论的物理。作者假设偏离广义相对论的效应在并合附近最强、随双星总质量平滑变化，并且在 ℓ=|m|=2 模式中最显著。将该框架应用于 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第五次引力波瞬变星表中的 28 个高信噪比双黑洞并合事件，未发现偏离广义相对论的证据。该框架可展示偏离如何随系统总质量变化，并被认为有助于区分波形系统误差与真实的广义相对论违反。

English: A core mission of gravitational-wave astronomy is to test general relativity (GR) in the high-curvature, high-velocity regime. The field has already seen significant progress in this space, though a remaining challenge is how to combine data from a population of binary mergers. This can both boost the significance of potential GR violations, and develop a phenomenological picture of how deviations manifest in different mergers. We propose a framework to coherently combine gravitational-wave measurements to build a population-level test of physics beyond GR. We assume that deviations from GR are (i) strongest near the merger, (ii) vary smoothly with the total mass of the binary, and (iii) are most prominent in the $\ell=|m|=2$ mode. While these assumptions do not describe every possible deviation of GR, they provide us with a plausible starting point upon which a more general framework can be built. We apply our framework to 28 high signal-to-noise ratio binary black hole mergers from LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA's Fifth Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog, finding no evidence for deviations from GR. Our framework allows one to show how deviations could vary as a function of total mass of the system. We argue that such a reconstruction can be used to convincingly distinguish between systematic waveform errors and genuine GR violations.

Vegh–dRGT 大质量引力中的虫洞：零能量透明性定理、视界阻碍与精确各向同性解

Wormholes in Vegh--dRGT massive gravity: a null-energy transparency theorem, horizon obstruction, and exact isotropic solutions

Sudan Hansraj, Ayan Banerjee · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文研究在具有空间退化 Vegh 参考度规的 de Rham–Gabadadze–Tolley (dRGT) 大质量引力中的静态球对称虫洞。大质量引力子所携带的有效流体对 flare-out 条件所约束的密度与径向压强组合没有贡献，因此沿径向光线的零能量条件对其不可见。该结论适用于整个退化参考度规类、全部四种相互作用势以及任意静态球对称几何；同一性质也使 Vegh 选择成为唯一自洽的选择。于是物质本身必须在每个喉部违反零能量条件，与广义相对论情形完全一致；这纠正了大质量引力虫洞文献中反复出现的一个断言。随后我们确定喉部可以位于何处。各向同性压强的虫洞分为两族：一族位于该理论自身真空的宇宙学视界之外，没有静态外部，在广义相对论中为空，并由引力子耦合开启；另一族位于该视界之内，需要陡峭下降的红移。我们给出两族的精确完美流体解。在第二族中，引力子项可将喉部张力转化为普通压强。一个薄壳闭合该构型，其表面应力和奇异物质含量以闭合形式给出。这些壳层在径向不稳定，喉部附近的光线形成不稳定圆轨道。

English: We study static, spherically symmetric wormholes in deRham--Gabadadze--Tolley massive gravity with the spatially degenerate Vegh reference metric. The effective fluid carried by the massive graviton contributes nothing to the combination of density and radial pressure that the flare-out condition constrains, so it is invisible to the null energy condition along radial light rays. This holds for the whole degenerate class of reference metrics, for all four interaction potentials, and for any static spherically symmetric geometry; the same property singles out the Vegh choice as the only consistent one. The matter alone must therefore violate the null energy condition at every throat, exactly as in general relativity. This corrects a claim repeated across the massive-gravity wormhole literature. We then determine where throats may sit. Wormholes with isotropic pressure fall into two families. One lies beyond the cosmological horizon of the theory's own vacuum and has no static exterior; it is empty in general relativity and is switched on by the graviton coupling. The other lies inside that horizon and needs a steeply falling redshift. We give exact perfect-fluid solutions for both. In the second family the graviton term can turn the tension at the throat into ordinary pressure. A thin shell closes the configuration, and its surface stresses and its exotic-matter content follow in closed form. The shells are radially unstable, and light rays near the throat trace an unstable circular orbit.

一句话导读：证明在 Vegh–dRGT 大质量引力中引力子有效流体对径向零能量条件透明，虫洞喉部仍须由物质违反 NEC，并给出两类精确各向同性虫洞解及薄壳稳定性分析。

Leonel Bixano, Tonatiuh Matos · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文将黑洞视界和虫洞喉与 Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton 引力的调和分支几何联系起来。在统一的 Ernst 框架中，先求解调和方程再固定空间调和函数，然后联合重构度规、Maxwell 四势和标量场。守恒测地线能量固定子午 Weyl 求积，初始测地线数据对应渐近荷。选择 Schwarzschild 调和函数时，正则非极端视界固定归一化 H=1 及相关物质场正则性要求。这重现 Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordstrom 族（含 NUT 扩展）、Gibbons-Maeda 解、dyonic string 和 Kaluza-Klein 解，并保留更一般分支。若标量部分延拓到 phantom 符号，则得到互补的扁椭球构造：光滑延拓选择 H=-1 并产生有质量和超静态的 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞。通过与真空环几何比较，说明全局延拓的进一步重要性。这些结果给出重构解中电荷关系和正则性约束的统一黑洞--虫洞几何解读。

English: We relate black-hole horizons and wormhole throats to the geometry of the harmonic branches of Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton gravity. In the unified Ernst framework, we first solve the harmonic equations prior to fixing the spatial harmonic, and then jointly reconstruct the metric, Maxwell four-potential, and scalar field. The conserved geodesic energy fixes the meridional Weyl quadrature, whereas the initial geodesic data capture the asymptotic charges. Choosing the Schwarzschild harmonic function, regular nonextremal horizons fix the normalization \(H=1\) along with the associated matter-field regularity requirements. This reproduces the Schwarzschild and Reissner-Nordstrom families (including the NUT extension), the Gibbons-Maeda solution, and the dyonic string and Kaluza--Klein solutions, while also preserving their more general branches. If the scalar sector is continued to the phantom sign, one obtains a complementary oblate construction: smooth continuation selects \(H=-1\) and produces the massive and ultrastatic Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes. By comparing with the vacuum ring geometry, we make clear the further importance of the global extension. Altogether, these findings offer a unified black-hole--wormhole geometric reading of the charge relations and regularity constraints for the reconstructed solutions.

一句话导读：在 Ernst 框架下构造 Einstein--Maxwell--dilaton 引力的调和分支精确解，并统一描述黑洞与虫洞的正则性及电荷关系。

Francisco Silva · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：本文研究无质量标量场、狄拉克场和麦克斯韦场在由 C-metric 描述的加速与超加速黑洞时空中的传播。超加速区域最近才被识别，仍 largely 未被探索。作者研究这些背景的线性稳定性和模式稳定性，并在若干时空极限下给出准正规模谱与灰体因子的解析表达式，对准正规模家族进行分类，特别关注超加速区域中出现的新家族。文章还通过 Christodoulou 的 β 判据研究强宇宙监督，发现参数空间中可能存在违反该猜想的区域，包括超加速区域；这些违反可能出现在无质量标量场和麦克斯韦场情形，而狄拉克场保持该猜想。

English: We investigate the propagation of massless scalar, Dirac, and Maxwell fields on accelerating and super accelerating black hole spacetimes described by the C-metric. The latter regime has only recently been identified and remains largely unexplored. We study the linear and mode stability of these backgrounds and derive analytical expressions for the quasinormal mode spectra and greybody factors in various spacetime limits. We classify the quasinormal mode families, paying particular attention to new families arising in the super accelerating regime. We also investigate strong cosmic censorship through Christodoulou's $\beta$ criterion, finding regions of parameter space where it may be violated, including in the super accelerating regime. These violations are possible for massless scalar and Maxwell fields, whereas Dirac fields preserve the conjecture.

Rustam Ibadov, Najibullokhon Shukurullokhon · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-22

中文摘要：我们在爱因斯坦框架的标量-张量引力中构造静态、渐近平坦的规则黑洞，其源为与磁非线性电动力学耦合的规范标量场。通过给定密度和标量剖面，我们重构度规、标量-光子耦合和势。规则性要求质量函数在中心消失，从而固定ADM质量，并要求密度的中心r^2增长由标量梯度能平衡。这些解具有由负势支持的AdS核心和近似Reissner-Nordström外部；无鬼条件将磁荷限制在一个于有限核心深度处闭合的窗口内。轴向扰动约化为对称的双通道主系统，其正定势保证模式稳定性；谱方法和时域方法得到的准正规模频率一致。中心附近的角Laplacian不稳定性可隐藏在内视界之后，这排除了无地平线解。

English: We construct static, asymptotically flat regular black holes in Einstein-frame scalar--tensor gravity, sourced by a canonical scalar coupled to magnetic nonlinear electrodynamics. Prescribing the density and scalar profiles, we reconstruct the metric, the scalar--photon coupling and the potential. Regularity requires the mass function to vanish at the centre, which fixes the ADM mass, and the central $r^2$ growth of the density to be balanced by the scalar gradient energy. The solutions have an anti-de Sitter core supported by a negative potential and a nearly Reissner--Nordstr\"om exterior; the no-ghost condition confines the magnetic charge to a window that closes at a finite core depth. Axial perturbations reduce to a symmetric two-channel master system whose positive-definite potential guarantees mode stability; spectral and time-domain quasinormal frequencies agree. An angular Laplacian instability near the centre can be hidden behind the inner horizon, which excludes horizonless solutions.

B_(s)→D_(s) 衰变半轻子形状因子与 Isgur–Wise 函数的全息计算

Miguel Angel Martin Contreras, Alfredo Vega · hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：我们在软墙模型（SWM）和非二次软墙模型（NQSWM）中分析半轻子衰变 B→Dℓν̄ℓ 和 B_s→D_sℓν̄ℓ。通过体波函数的重叠积分提取 Isgur–Wise 函数，并用重轻介子谱固定模型参数。我们在零反冲处施加重夸克对称性，并讨论与无质量体矢量场对偶的电弱流不守恒这一表观悖论。我们认为，由夸克质量导致的味道对称性显式破缺所引起的不守恒不会产生反常维度，因此体场保持无质量，而不守恒性编码在独立的边界耦合 g_+ 和 g_- 中。我们对分支比的预言与 LHCb 的 B_s→D_s 衰变数据吻合良好；轻子味普适性比值 R(D) 和 R(D_s) 与标准模型及格点 QCD 预言一致。我们发现全息模型在零反冲附近重现 Isgur–Wise 函数的普适性，而在最大反冲处的偏差表明需要更完整地处理高阶 1/m_Q 修正。

English: We present a holographic analysis of the semileptonic decays $B \to D \ell \bar{\nu}_\ell$ and $B_s \to D_s \ell \bar{\nu}_\ell$ within the Softwall Model (SWM) and the Non-Quadratic Softwall Model (NQSWM). We extract the Isgur-Wise function from the overlap integral of bulk wavefunctions, with model parameters fixed by the heavy-light meson spectra. We impose Heavy Quark Symmetry (HQS) at zero recoil and address the apparent paradox of a non-conserved electroweak current dual to a massless bulk vector field. We argue that the non-conservation, arising from explicit flavor-- symmetry breaking by quark masses, does not generate an anomalous dimension. Hence the bulk field remains massless, and the non-conservation is \emph{encoded} in the independent boundary couplings $g_+$ and $g_-$. Our predictions for the branching fractions are in good agreement with LHCb data for $B_s \to D_s$ decays. The lepton-flavor universality ratios $R(D)$ and $R(D_s)$ are consistent with Standard Model and lattice QCD predictions. We find that the holographic models reproduce the universality of the Isgur-Wise function near zero recoil, while discrepancies at maximum recoil suggest that a more complete treatment of higher-order $1/m_Q$ corrections is needed.

T. H. Nadai · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：本文研究大质量粒子渐近轨迹的对数修正，这些修正进入四维引力散射中零无穷处辐射场软对数部分的计算。作者首先分离出进入粒子运动方程的度规部分，表明非线性源只能通过双曲面上的齐次模影响该部分；与所提出的软塔匹配后，这些模除第一模外均消失，而第一模在领头阶 G 下不能影响轨迹系数。随后通过在粒子世界线上反演物质能量动量张量，并利用 Legendre 多项式，得到领头阶 G 下以及各对数阶的轨迹系数；前两个系数重现了 G 阶和 G^2 阶的已知结果。

English: We study the logarithmic corrections to the asymptotic trajectories of massive particles. These corrections enter the calculation of the soft-log sector of the radiative field at null infinity in four-dimensional gravitational scattering. We first isolate the part of the metric which enters the particle equations of motion. We show that the nonlinear source can only affect this sector through homogeneous modes on the hyperboloid, and that matching to the proposed soft tower implies that these modes vanish, except for the first mode. We show that this mode cannot affect the trajectory coefficients at leading order in $G$. We then invert the matter energy-momentum tensor on the particle worldlines to obtain the trajectory coefficients at leading order in $G$ and at every logarithmic order using Legendre polynomials. The first two coefficients reproduce the known results at orders $G$ and $G^2$.

高阶曲率有效理论中偏振相关光子传播、准正规模与引力透镜

Polarization-Dependent Photon Propagation, Quasinormal Modes, and Gravitational Lensing in Higher-Curvature Effective Theories

Takamasa Kanai · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：我们在有效场论框架下研究高阶曲率修正对光子传播的影响及其在强引力场中的观测后果。考虑静态球对称时空中光子轨迹的偏振相关修正，聚焦于 Schwarzschild 和 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞背景。利用几何光学近似，我们推导支配光子传播的有效度规，并研究光子球产生的偏振相关移动。我们在 eikonal 极限下计算相应的准正规模并分析其偏振依赖性。进一步研究引力透镜，关注弱场和强场区域中偏折角的偏振相关修正。在强偏折区域，我们发现即使微扰小的 EFT 修正也会改变偏折角对数发散部分的系数，从而可能产生相对于无修正情形可观测的差异。这表明强引力透镜可能为小的高阶曲率修正提供灵敏探针。虽然直接从 QNM 频率提取 EFT 信息更为微妙，QNM 可能在未来研究中为引力透镜提供互补信息。我们的结果建立了一个通过偏振相关强场观测量探测高阶曲率效应的框架。

English: We investigate the impact of higher-curvature corrections on photon propagation within an effective field theory framework and their observational consequences in strong gravitational fields. We consider polarization-dependent modifications to photon trajectories in static and spherically symmetric spacetimes, focusing on Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordstr\"om black hole backgrounds. Using the geometrical optics approximation, we derive the effective metrics governing photon propagation and study the resulting polarization-dependent shifts of the photon sphere. We compute the corresponding quasinormal modes in the eikonal limit and analyze their polarization dependence. We further investigate gravitational lensing, focusing on polarization-dependent corrections to the deflection angle in both weak- and strong-field regimes. In the strong-deflection regime, we find that even perturbatively small EFT corrections modify the coefficient of the logarithmically divergent part of the deflection angle, resulting in a potentially observable difference from the uncorrected case. This suggests that strong gravitational lensing may provide a sensitive probe of small higher-curvature corrections. While extracting EFT information directly from QNM frequencies is more subtle, QNMs may provide complementary information to gravitational lensing in future studies. Our results establish a framework for probing higher-curvature effects through polarization-dependent strong-field observables.

Energy Conservation and Cosmological Redshift from the Brown-York Quasi-Local Energy

Bjoern S. Schmekel · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：能量在膨胀宇宙中是否守恒，仍是相对论宇宙学的核心概念问题之一。整体类时Killing矢量的缺失以及局域引力能量密度的缺乏，常导致人们认为宇宙学红移代表能量守恒的真正破坏。本文在Brown-York准局域能量及其相应平衡定律的框架内重新考虑该问题。对于FLRW时空中的共动球对称边界，我们证明对任意理想流体，通过边界的普通应力-能量通量恒为零，而未参照的Brown-York能量完全由于纯几何的边界贡献而演化。我们进一步证明，类时边界世界管具有自然的动力学参考几何。相应的参考减除去除了未参照Brown-York能量的普适背景贡献，并导致一种准局域能量，其领头非平凡项精确重现所包围的物质能量。对于辐射主导宇宙学，所得展开为 E_BY = H^2R^3/2 - H^4R^5/8 + O(R^7)，其中领头项恰好与导致宇宙学红移的所包围辐射能量一致。高阶贡献自然具有引力自能修正所预期的结构。这些结果表明，宇宙学红移可在完全准局域的守恒框架内理解。因此，光子的表观能量损失未必表明能量守恒的崩溃，而可能反映广义相对论中引力能量本质上的准局域特征。

English: The question whether energy is conserved in an expanding universe remains one of the central conceptual issues of relativistic cosmology. The absence of a global timelike Killing vector and the lack of a local gravitational energy density often lead to the conclusion that cosmological redshift represents a genuine violation of energy conservation. In this work we reconsider this problem within the framework of Brown-York quasi-local energy and its associated balance law. For comoving spherical boundaries in FLRW spacetimes we show that the ordinary stress-energy flux through the boundary vanishes identically for arbitrary perfect fluids, while the unreferenced Brown-York energy evolves entirely due to a purely geometrical boundary contribution. We further demonstrate that the timelike boundary world tube possesses a natural dynamical reference geometry. The corresponding reference subtraction removes the universal background contribution of the unreferenced Brown-York energy and leads to a quasi-local energy whose leading nontrivial term exactly reproduces the enclosed matter energy. For radiation dominated cosmologies, the resulting expansion is $E_{\rm BY} = H^2R^3 /2 - H^4R^5 / 8 + \mathcal{O}(R^7)$, where the leading term coincides precisely with the energy of the enclosed radiation responsible for cosmological redshift. Higher-order contributions naturally possess the structure expected for gravitational self-energy corrections. These results suggest that cosmological redshift can be understood within a fully quasi-local conservation framework. The apparent loss of photon energy therefore need not indicate a breakdown of energy conservation but may instead reflect the fundamentally quasi-local character of gravitational energy in general relativity.

一句话导读：利用Brown-York准局域能量及其平衡定律，论证FLRW宇宙中的宇宙学红移可由准局域能量守恒框架理解，而不必视为能量守恒破坏。

由 Fredholm 行列式给出的大 Wilson 环

Giant Wilson loops from Fredholm determinants

Ludvig Chen, Victor Mishnyakov, Konstantin Zarembo · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：我们研究 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中 large-k 的对称与反对称 Wilson 环。我们将其生成函数表示为 Fredholm 行列式，该行列式由 Hermite 核与一个编码表示的符号函数加权构成。利用核的可积结构，我们系统应用 Tracy-Widom 方法，推导出一组封闭的积分-微分方程。随后通过 WKB 拟设按 1/N 逐阶求解这些方程，同时保持符号函数一般。我们得到了生成函数领头阶与次领头阶贡献的闭式表达式。最后，针对这两种表示，我们进行 large-k 鞍点分析，并求出 Wilson 环的次领头阶贡献。我们的结果确认了此前观测到的与巨 Wilson 环的对偶 D-膜描述之间的差异。

English: We study large-k symmetric and antisymmetric Wilson loops in N=4 super-Yang-Mills theory. We represent their generating functions as Fredholm determinants built from the Hermite kernel weighted by a symbol function that encodes the representation. Using the integrable structure of the kernel, we systematically apply the Tracy-Widom approach to derive a closed system of integro-differential equations. The equations are then solved order by order in 1/N by a WKB ansatz, while keeping the symbol function general. We find a closed-form expression for the leading and subleading order contributions to the generating functions. Finally, specializing to the two representations, we perform the large-k saddle-point analysis and find the subleading contribution to the Wilson loop. Our results confirm the previously observed discrepancies with the dual D-brane description of giant Wilson loops.

一句话导读：用 Fredholm 行列式与 Tracy-Widom/WKB 方法计算 N=4 SYM 中大对称/反对称 Wilson 环的 1/N 展开，并确认与对偶 D-膜描述的偏差。

相关度：medium — 论文属于 AdS/CFT 中 Wilson 环与 D-膜对偶的精确计算，与全息基础字典相关；但未直接涉及用户列出的全息超流、p波、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等具体支线。

双标度平面 N=4 SYM 与 Carroll 全息

Doubly-scaled planar $\mathcal{N} = 4$ SYM & Carroll Holography

Arjun Bagchi, Prateksh Dhivakar, Alok Laddha, Partha Paul · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：Okuda 和 Penedones（OP）在其开创性论文中提出了渐近平直时空全息的一个有趣方案。他们证明 AdS5×S5 中四点玻色树级弦振幅的平直空间极限对偶于四维 N=4 超 Yang-Mills（SYM）理论中四点关联函数的特定双重标度极限。本文表明所得边界关联函数可用于在未来零无穷上定义四维 Carrollian 共形场论（CFT）。这是通过将 SYM 中一组双标度关联函数映射到零无穷（渐近平直时空的共形边界）实现的。因此 Carroll CFT 在 N=4 SYM 的无穷 't Hooft 耦合极限中出现。我们将 OP 分析推广到更高点函数，并展示平直空间振幅的 Gram 条件如何约束 SYM 关联函数的双重标度极限。然后利用伸缩子弦振幅的软因子定理，在双重标度极限下为 N=4 SYM 的 (1/2)-BPS 部分写出递推关系。最后，我们表明这种双重标度极限的基本思想可作为一种工具包，通过非引力有效场论平直空间振幅的某些积分变换构建一类 Carrollian 关联函数，从而定义 Carrollian CFT。

English: In their seminal paper, Okuda and Penedones (OP) put forward an intriguing proposal towards holography in asymptotically flat spacetimes (AFS). They showed that the flat space limit of 4 point bosonic tree-level string amplitude in AdS$_{5}\, \times\, S^{5}$ is dual to a specific double scaling limit of 4 point correlator in four dimensional (4d) $\mathcal{N} = 4$ super Yang-Mills (SYM) theory. In this paper, we show that the resulting boundary correlators can be used to define a 4d Carrollian conformal field theory (CFT) on future null infinity. This is done by mapping the set of doubly scaled correlators in SYM to null infinity, the conformal boundary of AFS. A Carroll CFT thus emerges in the infinite 't Hooft coupling limit of $\mathcal{N} = 4$ SYM. We extend the OP analysis to higher point functions and show how the Gram conditions on flat space amplitude put constraints on the double scaling limit of SYM correlators. We then use the soft factorization theorem for dilatonic string amplitude to write a recursion relation for the $({1}/{2})$-BPS sector of $\mathcal{N} = 4$ SYM in the double scaling limit. Finally, we show that the essential ideas underlying such a double scaling limit can be used as a tool-kit to build a class of Carrollian correlators, and hence define a Carrollian CFT, via certain integral transforms of flat space amplitudes of non-gravitational effective field theories.

一句话导读：利用 N=4 SYM 关联函数的双重标度极限在未来零无穷上构造 Carrollian CFT，并推广平直空间全息字典。

Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中的魔术与虫洞

Magic and Wormholes in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model

Val\'erie Bettaque, Brian Swingle · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, gr-qc, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：任意量子态完全由一组完备厄米算符的期望值所指定。对于 Majorana 费米子系统（例如 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型），这组可观测量可取为所有可能的 Majorana 费米子算符串。热态中这些费米子串的期望值对指定 SYK 哈密顿量的微观耦合依赖不规则，我们利用路径积分技术直接在热力学极限下研究其统计性质。当底层 SYK 哈密顿量是混沌的时候，我们发现这些期望值可以很好地建模为零均值、方差可计算的实高斯随机变量。相反，对于 SYK 的可积变体，我们发现期望值实际上是非高斯的。然后我们利用这些结果研究 SYK 热态中的魔术度量，包括魔术的鲁棒性和稳定子 Rényi 熵。我们还表明，在混沌情形且足够低的温度下，这些结果可以由对偶引力计算定量重现。在这个对偶引力模型中，给定微观算符串的方差与一个由对应于该算符串的大质量粒子所稳定的虫洞几何相关。因此，我们的结果提供了一个具体且定量的场景，用于研究随机性、虫洞和闭合宇宙之间的关系，以及量子魔术的全息对偶。

English: Any quantum state is fully specified by the expectation values of a complete set of Hermitian operators. For a system of Majorana fermions, such as the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model, this set of observables can be taken to be all possible strings of Majorana fermion operators. The expectation values of these fermion strings in a thermal state depend erratically on the microscopic couplings that specify the SYK Hamiltonian, and we study their statistical properties directly in the thermodynamic limit using path integral techniques. When the underlying SYK Hamiltonian is chaotic, we find that these expectation values are well-modeled as real Gaussian random variables with zero mean and a variance that we compute. In contrast, for the integrable variant of SYK, we find that the expectation values are actually non-Gaussian. We then use these results to study measures of magic in the SYK thermal state, including the robustness of magic and the stabilizer R\'enyi entropy. We also show that our results can be quantitatively reproduced with a dual gravity calculation in the chaotic case at sufficiently low temperature. In this dual gravity model the variance of a given microscopic operator string is related to a wormhole geometry stabilized by a massive particle which is dual to the operator string. Our results thus provide a concrete and quantitative setting in which to study the relationship between randomness, wormholes and closed universes, as well as a holographic dual of quantum magic.

一句话导读：在 SYK 模型中利用路径积分研究 Majorana 算符串期望值的统计性质，并用于量子魔术度量，发现混沌情形下可由虫洞引力对偶定量重现。

缺陷共形场论中的重全息关联函数

Heavy holographic correlators in defect conformal field theories

Georgios Linardopoulos, Chanyong Park · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：我们用自底向上的方法研究对偶于探针膜的全息缺陷共形场论。首先，我们确定余维1界面膜在AdS空间中的嵌入。然后，我们计算强耦合下重标量算符的缺陷一点和两点函数。我们使用测地线近似，以两种方式计算反射两点函数，以及环境道和缺陷道两点函数。在适当的极限下，我们的结果与算符乘积展开（OPE）和边界算符展开（BOE）一致。

English: We study holographic defect conformal field theories which are dual to probe branes with bottom-up methods. First we determine the embedding of codimension-1 interface branes in AdS space. Then we compute defect one and two-point functions of heavy scalar operators at strong coupling. We use geodesic approximations to compute reflected two-point functions in two ways, as well as ambient and defect-channel two-point functions. In appropriate limits, our results agree with the operator product expansion (OPE) and the boundary operator expansion (BOE).

一句话导读：用自底向上探针膜与测地线近似计算缺陷CFT中重标量算符的全息关联函数，并检验其与OPE/BOE的一致性。

大码中的 JLMS 公式与近似量子纠错

The JLMS formula in a large code with approximate error correction

Xi Dong, Donald Marolf, Pratik Rath · hep-th, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：规范/引力对偶常被描述为量子纠错码。然而，如 JLMS 公式所示，具有互补恢复（因而纠缠楔重构）的精确量子纠错只在 G→0 极限出现。因此，控制误差项的精确论证集中于所谓“小码”：当 G→0 时，它们只描述给定经典解附近的微扰激发。此类设定限制很强，尤其禁止讨论会改变经典背景的模块流，从而无法考虑由半经典体态在一阶模块参数下产生的模块流。相反，我们提出一个单一的体理论“大码”，可容纳此类流，并在 G→0 极限包含与不同经典背景相关联的态的叠加。该大码由满足近似 Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena 公式的小码组装而成。在此扩展设定中，我们阐明体与边界模块哈密顿量之间（近似）JLMS 关系的含义，并在适当态类中量化其有效性。

English: Gauge/gravity duality is often described as a quantum error correcting code. However, as seen in the Jafferis-Lewkowycz-Maldacena-Suh (JLMS) formula, exact quantum error correction with complementary recovery (and thus entanglement wedge reconstruction) emerges only in the limit $G \to 0$. As a result, precise arguments controlling error terms have focused on what we call `small' codes which, as $G \to 0$, describe only perturbative excitations near a given classical solution. Such settings are quite restrictive and, in particular, they prohibit discussion of any modular flow that would change the classical background. As a result, they forbid consideration of modular flows generated by semiclassical bulk states at order-one modular parameters. In contrast, we present a single `large' code for the bulk theory that can accommodate such flows and, in particular, in the $G \to 0$ limit includes superpositions of states associated with distinct classical backgrounds. This large code is assembled from small codes that each satisfy an approximate Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena formula. In this extended setting we clarify the meaning of the (approximate) JLMS relation between bulk and boundary modular Hamiltonians and quantify its validity in an appropriate class of states.

一句话导读：提出由小码组装的大码，将近似 JLMS 关系推广到包含不同经典背景叠加的体态。

相关度：medium — 论文讨论 AdS/CFT 量子纠错、纠缠楔重构与模块哈密顿量，属于全息对偶基础与量子信息交叉；但与用户列出的全息超流、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等具体重点支线不直接重合。

高维近超冷时空中准正规模与灰体因子的几何诱导半经典极限

Geometrically Induced Semiclassical Limit for Quasinormal Modes and Greybody Factors in Higher-Dimensional Near-Ultracold spacetimes

Bogeun Gwak · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-21

中文摘要：本文基于无质量标量场研究高维 Reissner–Nordström–de Sitter 黑洞中的准正规模（QNM）与灰体因子（GBF）的对应关系。分析集中于内、外和宇宙学视界彼此接近的近超冷族 QNM。在几何极限条件下，对固定角量子数与维度，QNM 的首阶 WKB 项占主导，无需采用 eikonal 极限；相应的 GBF 也保留两个参数的显式形式。作者进一步证明 GBF 的半透射频率及其导数与零测地线相关，可用角频率和 Lyapunov 指数表述，并给出任意维度下的关系。文章还研究了 Nariai 极限下以及视界分离的近超冷几何中 QNM 的高阶修正。

English: In this work, we investigate the correspondence between quasinormal modes (QNMs) and greybody factors (GBFs) in higher-dimensional Reissner--Nordst\"{o}m--de Sitter black holes based on the massless scalar field. Our analysis focuses on the QNMs in the near-ultracold family where the inner, outer, and cosmological horizons are close together. Under the geometric limit condition, the leading-order Wentzel--Kramers--Brillouin term of the QNM is dominant for fixed angular quantum numbers and dimensionality without imposing the eikonal limit. Particularly, the corresponding GBFs also retain the explicit form of both parameters. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the half-transmission frequency of the GBF and its derivative are related to null geodesics, in terms of aspects such as the angular frequency and Lyapunov exponent, with the use of both parameters. We provide their relationships in arbitrary dimensionality. Furthermore, the higher-order corrections to the QNMs are investigated at the Nariai limit and in the near-ultracold geometry with separated horizons.

一句话导读：研究高维 RN-dS 黑洞近超冷几何中 QNM 与灰体因子的几何/WKB 半经典极限及其与零测地线的关系。

相关度：medium — 涉及用户重点标签中的 QNM 与经典黑洞引力，但未涉及全息、超流、探针膜等全息研究支线；与经典引力/QNM 支线相关，故相关性中等。
