MADGRAV：应用于 LIGO 数据的引力波搜索多级异常检测流程

MADGRAV: a multilevel anomaly-detection pipeline for gravitational-wave searches applied to LIGO data

Gianluca Inguglia, Huw Haigh, Ulyana Dupletsa, Alessandro Longo · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM, cs.LG · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文介绍 MADGRAV 的结果：这是一个基于深度学习的搜索流程，用于寻找高质量致密双星并合，并应用于 LIGO 干涉仪在第三次观测运行以及第四次观测运行第一和第二部分收集的数据。MADGRAV 由一系列顺序卷积神经网络组成，执行异常检测、毛刺分类、相干性检验和信号排序。研究使用 1 秒 Q 变换窗口分析 Hanford 和 Livingston 探测器数据，包括单独分析和相干分析。通过所有流程阶段的候选体中有 48 个达到显著性阈值；作者报告 47 个引力波探测，其虚警率低于 1/yr，天体物理来源概率 p_astro>0.9。47 个探测中有 44 个与最小模型化的相干 WaveBurst 搜索共享。根据官方引力波瞬变星表提取的源架总质量范围为 14–236 太阳质量，中位数 69 太阳质量，中位信噪比为 16。作者指出，置信探测的回收比例随质量上升：对于 LIGO 探测器网络 SNR>10，流程回收 30 太阳质量以下置信星表事件的 8.1%，30 至 100 太阳质量之间的 39.8%，100 太阳质量以上的 53.3%；在同一质量分箱中，这分别对应相干 WaveBurst 探测事件的 33.3%、45.5% 和 53.3%。这些结果表明，异常检测流程可作为独立探测通道，在高质量、高信噪比区间补充匹配滤波。

English: We present the results of \textbf{MADGRAV}, a deep-learning-based search for high-mass compact binary coalescences, applied to the data collected by the LIGO interferometers during the third observing run and during the first and second part of the fourth observing run. The \textbf{MADGRAV} pipeline consists of a series of sequential convolutional neural networks that perform anomaly detection, glitch classification, coherence testing, and signal ranking. Data from the Hanford and Livingston LIGO detectors are studied (both individually and in coherence) by way of 1 second Q-transform windows. Of the candidates that survive every stage of the pipeline, 48 reach the significance threshold, and we report 47 gravitational wave detections characterised by a false alarm rate below $1\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$ with a probability of astrophysical origin $p_{\rm astro}>0.9$. Of the 47 detections, 44 are shared with the minimally modelled coherent WaveBurst search. The observed total source-frame masses, extracted from official gravitational wave transient catalogues, are in the $14-236 M_{\odot}$ range with a median of $69 M_{\odot}$, and a median SNR of 16. We note that the recovered fraction of confident detections rises with mass: for LIGO detectors network SNR $>10$ the pipeline recovers $8.1\%$ of confident catalog events below $30 M_{\odot}$, $39.8\%$ between $30$ and $100 M_{\odot}$, and $53.3\%$ above $100 M_{\odot}$, corresponding to $33.3\%$, $45.5\%$ and $53.3\%$ of the events detected by coherent WaveBurst in the same bins. These results suggest that anomaly detection pipelines can serve as an independent detection channel complementary to matched filtering in the high-mass high-SNR regime.

一句话导读：MADGRAV 使用多级卷积神经网络异常检测在 LIGO 数据中搜索高质量致密双星并合，并报告 47 个达到显著性阈值的引力波探测。

Rastall 引力中带电 Kiselev 黑洞的轴向模式稳定性与准正规模

Axial Mode Stability and Quasinormal Modes of Charged Kiselev Black Holes in Rastall Gravity

Yan Wang, Yun-tao Gu, Wen-Di Guo · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们研究 Rastall 引力中带有尘埃状 Kiselev 型各向异性物质的带电黑洞的轴向引力电磁扰动。我们推导轴向物质相容条件，并通过保持协变各向异性方向矢量不被扰动来构造相容响应。由此得到的引力扰动与电磁扰动服从两个耦合的薛定谔型主方程。在 Reissner-Nordstr"om 极限与广义相对论尘埃状极限中存在与 r 无关的代数退耦；在具有非零周围物质的普通带电 Rastall 背景中，额外的径向结构阻碍这种退耦。我们证明，在所选闭合方案下，对满足所述外部条件的每一个非极端背景，轴向模式稳定性成立，并覆盖所有物理轴向多极。矩阵 S-形变排除了 l >= 2 的指数增长耦合模式，而物理电磁偶极具有正的有效势。Chebyshev 伪谱计算经 Reissner-Nordstr"om 谱与谱收敛性验证，用于确定基频。在所考察的参数范围内，小耦合区域中增大 Rastall 耦合会降低振荡频率与阻尼率；大耦合区域中振荡频率升高，而阻尼率非单调变化。较大的电荷通常提高振荡频率，而更强的周围物质贡献产生寿命更长的模式。

English: We investigate axial gravitoelectromagnetic perturbations of charged black holes surrounded by dust-like Kiselev-type anisotropic matter in Rastall gravity. We derive the axial matter compatibility condition and construct a compatible response by holding the covariant anisotropy-direction vector unperturbed. The resulting gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations obey two coupled Schrodinger-type master equations. An r-independent algebraic decoupling exists in the Reissner-Nordstrom and general-relativistic dust-like limits; additional radial structure obstructs it in generic charged Rastall backgrounds with nonzero surrounding matter. We prove axial mode stability under the adopted closure for every nonextremal background satisfying the stated exterior conditions, covering all physical axial multipoles. A matrix S-deformation excludes exponentially growing coupled modes for l >= 2, while the physical electromagnetic dipole has a positive effective potential. A Chebyshev pseudospectral calculation, validated against the Reissner-Nordstrom spectrum and spectral convergence, determines the fundamental frequencies. In the parameter ranges examined, increasing the Rastall coupling lowers both the oscillation frequency and the damping rate in the small-coupling region; in the large-coupling region, the oscillation frequency rises while the damping rate varies nonmonotonically. A larger charge generally raises the oscillation frequency, whereas stronger surrounding-matter contributions produce longer-lived modes.

一句话导读：研究 Rastall 引力中带电 Kiselev 黑洞轴向扰动的稳定性，并用伪谱法计算其准正规模频率。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

二次 f(R) 引力中的屏蔽标量毛发与黑洞/中子星的弱透镜区分

Screened Scalar Hair and the Weak-Lensing Separation of Black Holes from Neutron Stars in Quadratic $f(R)$ Gravity

Yashmitha Kumaran, Il\'idio Lopes · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：二次 f(R) 引力包含有质量标量自由度 scalaron，其有限作用范围 λ 会屏蔽致密天体外部几何中的影响。作者表明，这种屏蔽使同质量黑洞与中子星的外场不同：对 Schwarzschild 度规的修正受到 Yukawa suppression，按 e^{-r/λ} 衰减，因此对耦合的幂展开不可见；且外部度规本质上是各向同性的，仅反演时间分量无法求解场方程。将 Gibbons & Werner 的 Gauss-Bonnet 定理方法用于该几何，得到主导偏折角精确等于广义相对论结果，scalaron 贡献在使光线偏折的组合中恒等抵消；第一阶修正具有 λ^{-1/2}b^{-3/2}e^{-b/λ} 形式，在 scalaron 作用范围外被屏蔽，并在 b=4λ 处与直接求积符合到约 20%，在 b=12λ 处改善到 7%。静态黑洞没有标量毛发，其透镜效应与广义相对论一致；中子星获得由支撑其抗坍缩的压力加权的标量荷，因此不同。弱透镜因而成为该理论的判别手段，而视界与物质表面在原则上仍有区别。观测优势在于光子球强场成像以及恒星内部，其中标量荷由状态方程确定。

English: Quadratic $f(R)$ gravity carries a massive scalar degree of freedom, the scalaron, whose finite range $\lambda$ screens its influence on the geometry outside a compact object. We show that this screening severs the exterior of a black hole from that of a neutron star of the same mass. Correction to the Schwarzschild metric is Yukawa-suppressed, falling as $e^{-r/\lambda}$ in the coupling, and is thus invisible to any expansion in powers of that coupling; the exterior is moreover intrinsically isotropic, so that inverting the temporal potential alone, as one does for single-potential solutions, fails to solve the field equations. Applying the Gibbons & Werner method of the Gauss-Bonnet theorem to this geometry, we find the leading deflection angle to be exactly the general-relativistic, ($b$: impact parameter), scalaron contributions cancelling identically in the combination that bends light. First correction carries the unfamiliar signature $\lambda^{-1/2}b^{-3/2}e^{-b/\lambda}$, screened beyond the scalaron range and confirmed against direct quadrature to around 20% at $b=4\lambda$, improving to 7% at $b=12\lambda$. What survives is the ingredients that deliver it, namely, non-analyticity in the coupling, the intrinsically isotropic gauge, the closed-form screened correction and the pressure-weighted scalar charge, are obtained within a single, self-consistent derivation here. A static black hole carries no scalar hair, and lenses precisely as general relativity requires; a neutron star acquires a scalar charge weighted by the pressure supporting it against collapse, and does not. Weak lensing therefore closes as a discriminant of the theory, whilst the horizon, as against a material surface, remains one in principle. The observational advantage lies in the strong-field imaging of the photon sphere, and in the stellar interior, where the scalar charge is fixed by the equation of state.

利用机器学习生成的替代波形进行引力波参数估计

Gravitational-wave parameter estimation with machine-learning generated surrogate waveforms

Suyog Garg, Kipp Cannon · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM, cs.LG · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：全球引力波探测器网络迄今已探测到超过350个双星并合事件。未来的第三代探测器（如爱因斯坦望远镜）预计将探测到数量级更多的信号，且源特征更复杂，包括偏心轨道和大质量比双星。众所周知，这类源信号的参数估计计算成本极高。特别是，如果用于似然计算的理论波形预测生成得更快，整个过程就能加速。近期已有多种机器学习技术被提出用于此目的。本文提出一种两阶段确定性条件自编码器模型，用于生成四参数SEOBNRv4波形。模型第一阶段生成波形的振幅和相位序列，第二阶段校准预测中的残差误差。我们的模型与目标偏振波形达到约10^-2的中位失配，而校准后的振幅/相位序列达到10^-6量级的余弦距离误差。随后我们提出波形条件化步骤，使这些替代波形可用于下游参数估计任务。最后，我们进行了大量参数估计测试，使用机器学习波形和EOB波形注入，并尝试恢复源参数的后验估计。我们发现，当使用机器学习波形恢复EOB目标参数估计时，推断的后验存在一些系统性偏差。这种固有偏差可以被估计并校正，然后对后验样本进行重要性重加权，从而能够在低信噪比下使用低精度替代波形。

English: The worldwide network of gravitational-wave detectors have detected more than 350 binary coalescence events till date. Future third-generation detectors, like Einstein telescope, are expected to detect orders-of-magnitude more signals from sources with more complicated characteristics, including eccentric orbits and high-mass ratio binaries. It is well-established that the computational cost of parameter estimation for signals from these kinds of sources will be extremely high. In particular, the process could be sped-up if generating theoretical waveform predictions, used for likelihood calculation becomes faster. Recently, various machine-learning techniques has been proposed to this end. In this work, we propose a two-stage deterministic conditional-autoencoder model for generating four-parameter SEOBNRv4 waveforms. The first-stage of the model generates amplitude and phase series of the waveform, while the second-stage calibrates the residual error in the predictions. Our model achieves a median mismatch of around $10^{-2}$ with the target polarization waveforms, while the calibrated amplitude/phase series achieve $10^{-6}$ level cosine distance error. We then propose a waveform conditioning step to enable use of these surrogate waveforms for downstream parameter estimation tasks. Finally, we perform extensive parameter estimation tests, with ML and EOB waveform injections and try to recover posterior estimates for the source parameters. We find that when ML waveforms are used to recover EOB target parameter estimates, the inferred posterior have some systematic bias. This inherent bias can be estimated and corrected for, and then importance reweighting of posterior samples can enable use of low-accuracy surrogate waveforms at low SNRs.

Kata Kar\'acsonyi, L\'aszl\'o \'Arp\'ad Gergely · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：自旋反转出现在多种情形中。解析工作预测不等质量超大质量双星旋进期间发生单次自旋翻转，而数值相对论和后牛顿计算显示可比质量双星中会出现反复的flip-flop运动。长期自旋演化还预测由自旋诱导质量四极矩驱动的额外情形。这些效应能否在引力波数据中被区分仍不清楚。作者将长期自旋角方程与准圆二阶后牛顿频率演化结合，构建按天空平均LISA灵敏度加权的限制性波形。研究五个近等质量注入，探测器系总质量M=2×10^5 M_⊙，包括Kerr flip-flop和一个四极矩诱导情形。每个注入与受限于无轨道面交叉的物理演化波形比较。搜索所有四个无反转扇区，变化质量、自旋大小和初始自旋角，并对时间、相位和整体振幅最大化。在该限制性模型中，大的自旋运动本身不会导致明显不同的波形。比较不同自旋大小、相对自旋取向和角度偏移的构型，在0°到90°的十一个观测者倾角下。每个注入归一化到信号SNR ρ⋆=100时，五个情形中有四个在沿总角动量的0°视角下残差SNR低于1。在非零倾角下，最大匹配对应的残差在双活跃自旋、55°情形达到7.07。这些在允许模板族内最小残差的上界表明自旋反转具有潜在可区分性，并推动使用更完整波形和全LISA响应的研究。

English: Spin inversions appear in several settings. Analytical work predicts a single spin flip during unequal-mass supermassive binary inspiral, while numerical relativity and post-Newtonian calculations show repeated flip-flop motion in comparable-mass binaries. Secular spin evolution also predicts additional cases driven by spin-induced mass quadrupoles. Whether these effects can be distinguished in gravitational-wave data is still unclear. We combine the secular spin angle equations with a quasi-circular second post-Newtonian frequency evolution and build a restricted waveform weighted by the sky-averaged LISA sensitivity. We study five near-equal-mass injections with detector-frame total mass $M=2\times10^5M_\odot$, including Kerr flip-flops and one quadrupole-induced case. Each injection is compared with physically evolving waveforms constrained to have no orbital-plane crossings. We search all four no-inversion sectors, vary the masses, spin magnitudes, and initial spin angles, and maximize over time, phase, and overall amplitude. Large spin motion does not by itself lead to a clearly different waveform in this restricted model. We compare configurations with different spin magnitudes, relative spin orientations, and angular excursions at eleven observer inclinations between $0^\circ$ and $90^\circ$. With each injection normalized to signal SNR $\rho_\star=100$, four of the five cases leave a residual SNR below unity for the $0^\circ$ viewing direction along the total angular momentum. At nonzero inclinations, the residual associated with the largest match found reaches $7.07$ in the two-active-spin case at $55^\circ$. These upper bounds on the minimum residual within the allowed template family suggest potential distinguishability of spin inversions and motivate studies with more complete waveforms and the full LISA response.

English: We investigate the interplay between thermodynamic phase transitions and the dynamical behavior of quasi-normal modes (QNMs) in weakly nonlinear charged anti-de Sitter black holes. In a non-extended phase space, we identify a reentrant large-small-large(intermediate) phase transition for these black holes. Employing the shooting method to solve the Klein-Gordon equation for a massless scalar field, we compute QNM frequencies across these phases, revealing distinct behaviors in different phases. Specifically, to our knowledge, this is the first report of utilizing QNMs as dynamical probes of thermodynamic phases during reentrant phase transitions including zeroth and first-order transitions. These findings establish QNMs as a powerful dynamical probe for thermodynamic phase transitions, providing new insights into the thermodynamic and dynamical properties of nonlinear charged black holes as well.

Searching for Extra Dimensions with Gravitational Waves: Dark-Siren Constraints from GWTC-4

Anson Chen, Jun Zhang · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：高维引力理论预言引力波可以传播到额外空间维度，从而在宇宙学距离上导致振幅衰减被修改。因此，引力波光度距离的测量为探测时空维度提供了独特手段。本文使用引力波瞬变星表GWTC-4，通过暗汽笛方法限制高维引力波传播。作者采用受膜世界场景启发的现象学参数化，其中对广义相对论的偏离由时空维度数 D 和描述四维与高维引力之间过渡的交叉尺度 R_c 刻画。作者将GWTC-4中141个致密双星并合事件与GLADE+星表中的视线方向星系信息结合，进行分层贝叶斯分析。对于先验 H_0 ∈ [65,77] km s^{-1}Mpc^{-1} 和 log(R_c/Mpc) ∈ [2.7,4.0]，得到 D = 4.38^{+1.91}_{-1.01}（68%可信区间）。作者还发现 R_c 的后验分布在上先验边界附近累积，表明当前观测对交叉尺度限制仍很弱。进一步表明，对 D 的限制敏感依赖于所假设的 R_c 先验范围，而该范围决定了偏离广义相对论变得显著的特征距离尺度。结果给出了GWTC-4对高维引力波传播的首个暗汽笛限制，并表明当前观测仍与四维广义相对论一致。

English: Higher-dimensional theories of gravity predict that gravitational waves (GWs) can propagate into extra spatial dimensions, leading to modified amplitude damping over cosmological distances. Measurements of GW luminosity distances therefore provide a unique probe of the dimensionality of spacetime. In this work, we constrain higher-dimensional GW propagation using the dark-siren method with the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog 4.0 (GWTC-4). We adopt a phenomenological parameterization motivated by braneworld scenarios, in which deviations from General Relativity are characterized by the spacetime dimension number $D$ and a crossover scale $R_c$ governing the transition between four- and higher-dimensional gravity. We perform a hierarchical Bayesian analysis combining 141 compact binary coalescences from GWTC-4 with line-of-sight galaxy information from the GLADE+ catalog. For a prior $H_0 \in [65,77]\ {\rm km~s^{-1}Mpc^{-1}}$ and $\log(R_c/{\rm Mpc}) \in [2.7,4.0]$, we obtain $D = 4.38^{+1.91}_{-1.01}$ (68\% credible interval). We also find that the inferred posterior distribution of $R_c$ accumulates near the upper prior boundary, indicating that the crossover scale remains poorly constrained by current observations. We further show that the inferred constraint on $D$ depends sensitively on the assumed prior range of $R_c$, which determines the characteristic distance scale at which deviations from General Relativity become significant. Our results provide the first GWTC-4 dark-siren constraints on higher-dimensional GW propagation and demonstrate that current observations remain consistent with four-dimensional General Relativity.

SPLIT：针对建模与数据离群稳健的长旋进引力波源宽松相干推断

SPLIT: Loosely-coherent inference of long-inspiral gravitational-wave sources for robustness against modeling and data outliers

Shubham Kejriwal · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：LISA 将探测数十个由极端质量比旋进和中等质量比旋进（EMRI/IMRI）产生的引力波，这些源会在带内持续数月至数年。当前流程采用的全相位相干分析对波形精度要求极高；若无法在如此长时间内准确建模信号，会产生显著系统偏差。为此，我们提出一个稳健的贝叶斯推断框架：将数据分块，对每块进行相干推断，再用宽松相干相位信息重组结果。通过把完整相位跟踪限制在更短的块时长内，该方法可避免相位误差显著累积。我们在 GPU 加速的 Python 包 SPLIT（Segmented Posteriors for Long-Inspiral Templates）中实现该框架。对一个环境丰富的注入案例，SPLIT 表明：完全相干的真空 GR 分析相对真值最大一维系统偏差约为 4.8σ，而宽松相干方法因积分窗口更短，将偏差限制在 ≲0.5σ。尽管最优信噪比有分数损失，但参数精度的大幅改善使该方法对 LISA 和其他未来引力波探测器而言是很有利的权衡。

English: The Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) will detect gravitational waves (GWs) from dozens of extreme- and intermediate-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs/IMRIs). These sources will stay in-band for months to years, offering extraordinary scientific potential. However, their fully phase-coherent analysis standard in current pipelines imposes stringent waveform accuracy requirements; failing to model the signal over such long durations can result in significant systematic biases. To address this, we formulate a robust Bayesian inference framework that segments the data into blocks, infers each block coherently, and recombines the results using loosely-coherent phase information. By restricting full phase-tracking to much shorter block durations, this approach prevents significant accumulation of phase errors. We implement this methodology in \textsc{SPLIT} (Segmented Posteriors for Long-Inspiral Templates), a GPU-accelerated Python package. Applying \textsc{SPLIT} to an environment-rich injection, we demonstrate that while a fully-coherent vacuum-GR analysis incurs a maximum 1D systematic bias of $\approx 4.8\sigma$ from the truth, the shorter integration window of our loosely-coherent approach restricts such biases to $\lesssim 0.5\sigma$. Overall, despite a fractional loss of optimal signal-to-noise ratio, the substantial improvement in parameter accuracy offered by our method presents a highly advantageous trade-off for LISA and other future GW detectors.

Gravitational Wave Propagation in K-essence Cosmology: Theory and Observational Constraints

Sougata Bhunia, Goutam Manna, Eduardo Guendelman, Debashis Gangopadhyay, Ram\'on Herrera, Abhijit Bhattacharyya · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文研究 k-essence 宇宙学中线性张量模的传播；暗部门由一个非正则标量场描述。作者在 FRW 背景的高频（短波）极限下并限制在横向无迹扇区，得到修改后的演化方程：引力波速度仍严格为光速（与 GW170817 相容），但背景场在产生含时有效质量项。该背景诱导质量改变色散关系且不引入额外传播自由度，并在宇宙学距离上积累频率相关相位移动。有效质量由背景宇宙学参数唯一确定，可写成随红移变化的函数，从而直接联系引力波观测量与标量场动力学。引力波光度距离保持与电磁光度距离相同，维持标准汽笛一致性。作者联合宇宙计时器、BAO、Pantheon+SH0ES 以及 GWTC-2.1/3/4 标准汽笛测量进行贝叶斯分析，并用 χ²、χ²_red、AIC、BIC、DIC 评估；重建与当前数据一致，重现晚期膨胀历史，并对有效质量的红移演化给出数据驱动约束。

English: Gravitational waves (GWs) provide a powerful, theory-independent probe of the dynamical structure of spacetime and the cosmological background. We investigate the propagation of linearized tensor modes in k-essence cosmology, where the dark sector is described by a non-canonical scalar field. Working in the high-frequency (short-wavelength) limit on a Friedmann-Lema\^{\i}tre-Robertson-Walker background and restricting to the transverse-traceless sector, we obtain a modified evolution equation in which the GW speed remains strictly luminal (compatible with GW170817), while the background field $\bar{\phi}$ generates a time-dependent effective mass term $m_{\rm eff}$. This background-induced mass alters the dispersion relation without introducing extra propagating degrees of freedom, producing an accumulated, frequency-dependent phase shift over cosmological distances. We show that $m_{\rm eff}$ is uniquely determined by background cosmological parameters and can be expressed as a redshift-dependent function $m_{\rm eff}(z)$, providing a direct connection between GW observables and scalar-field dynamics. The GW luminosity distance stays identical to the electromagnetic one, preserving standard-siren consistency. We confront the model with a joint Bayesian analysis combining cosmic chronometers, BAO, Pantheon+SH0ES, and standard-siren measurements from GWTC-2.1/3/4, and assess performance using $\chi^2$, $\chi^2_{\rm red}$, AIC, BIC, and DIC. The reconstruction is consistent with current data, reproduces the late-time expansion history, and provides data-driven constraints on the redshift evolution of $m_{\rm eff}(z)$.

Static spherically symmetric Kundt vacuum solutions of higher-derivative gravities

Breno L. Giacchini, Ivan Kol\'a\v{r}, Vojt\v{e}ch Pravda, Alena Pravdov\'a · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们研究带宇宙学常数的二次引力真空场方程以及特定六导数引力模型的静态球对称Kundt解。对于二次引力，我们找出所有在耦合常数满足 α≠3β 时的解；α=3β 情形用Frobenius方法研究，并推导幂级数递推关系。对于六导数引力，我们选取若干模型以展示闭式解的多样性，并分析Frobenius解可能的指标族。对所有解，我们分析曲率奇点及其对测地线观测者的可达性。随后，我们在二次和六导数引力中于部分背景上构造精确引力波解。已知在Einstein引力中，Nariai背景上的引力波不可避免地含有奇点，这些奇点被解释为产生引力波的物理源；相比之下，除奇异解外，高阶引力在适当耦合常数下还允许代表引力波的全局光滑解。

English: We study static spherically symmetric Kundt solutions to the vacuum field equations of quadratic gravity with a cosmological constant, as well as specific models of six-derivative gravity. In quadratic gravity, we identify all solutions for coupling constants satisfying ${\alpha\neq3\beta}$, while the case ${\alpha=3\beta}$ is studied using the Frobenius method, where we derive the recurrence relations for the power series. In contrast, in six-derivative gravity, we focus on selected models to illustrate the variety of closed-form solutions; we also analyze possible indicial families of Frobenius solutions. For all solutions, we analyze curvature singularities and their accessibility to geodesic observers. We then construct exact gravitational-wave solutions propagating on some of these backgrounds in quadratic and six-derivative gravity. It is known that in Einstein gravity, gravitational waves on the Nariai background unavoidably contain singularities, which are interpreted as physical sources generating these gravitational waves. In contrast, in addition to singular solutions, for appropriate values of the coupling constants, higher-order gravities allow for globally smooth solutions representing gravitational waves.

暗物质包围的旋转黑洞阴影

Shadow of rotating black hole surrounded by dark matter

Haiyuan Feng, Ziqiang Cai, Rong-Jia Yang, Jinjun Zhang · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文用 Newman-Janis 算法将暗物质包围的 Schwarzschild 黑洞推广为轴对称 Kerr 黑洞，并研究其事件视界与能层结构。作者利用零测地线考察暗物质质量 ΔM 对黑洞阴影半径、畸变以及相关能量发射率的影响。分析表明，暗物质在临界质量以下影响可忽略；超过该阈值后，所有黑洞结构显著膨胀。暗物质还使阴影即使在高自旋下也保持接近圆形。高暗物质质量导致的结构膨胀可能超出当前观测限制，因此若要与天体物理观测一致，黑洞近邻区域要么没有暗物质，要么其局域质量须低于该临界值。

English: Dark matter (DM), a fundamental cosmic component, motivates the study of its influence on black hole (BH) shadows, especially for spinning BHs confirmed by EHT observations. This work generalizes the Schwarzschild BH surrounded by DM to an axisymmetric Kerr BH using the Newman-Janis Algorithm (NJA), investigating the resulting event horizon and ergosphere structures. Employing null geodesics, we examine the effects of DM mass $\Delta M$ on BH shadow, including its radius, distortion, and the associated energy emission rate. Our analysis reveals that DM has a negligible effect below a critical mass, once this threshold is surpassed, all BH structures expand significantly. Furthermore, DM robustly contributes to the shadow maintaining a near circular shape, even for highly spinning BHs. This pronounced structural expansion under high DM mass may potentially exceed current observational constraints, suggesting that DM must either be absent in the immediate vicinity of the BH or its localized mass must remain below this critical value to be consistent with astrophysical observations.

流体表面重力波中的模拟正则黑洞与黑洞模仿体

Analog regular black holes and black hole mimickers for surface-gravity waves in fluids

Valentin Pomakov, Stefano Liberati · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：近期黑洞候选体观测的进展重新激发了对近视界结构以及偏离广义相对论标准奇点解的探索。在此背景下，正则黑洞和无视界黑洞模仿体因量子引力效应而受到大量关注。根据正则化参数相对于物体质量的不同取值，典型的球对称解可描述这两类情景。正则黑洞构型通常具有包围最大对称核心的外视界和内视界；内视界会引发质量膨胀和半经典不稳定性。同一解的无视界分支则在足够致密时支持稳定的内光球，但本身也受到与长寿命准正规模相关的不稳定性的影响。本文研究如何在基于浅水盆中表面重力波的模拟引力平台上模拟这些时空，以期在实验上重现这些不稳定性。我们首先识别复制相关有效几何所需的流剖面和边界条件。特别地，我们说明可用非旋转中心排水构型模拟核心内部度规，并提出一种梯度排水剖面将其连接到渐近平坦的外部区域。随后我们评估用当前技术研究上述不稳定性的实验可行性。我们的结论是，虽然所需装置在原则上可实现，但诸如玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体等替代介质可能为忠实捕捉目标物理特征提供更实际的途径。

English: Recent advances in the observation of black-hole candidates have renewed interest in probing their near-horizon structure and in searching for departures from the standard singular solutions of general relativity. In this context, significant effort has been devoted to regular black holes and to horizonless black-hole mimickers, motivated primarily by quantum-gravitational effects. Depending on the value of the regularization parameter relative to the object mass, typical spherically symmetric solutions can describe either of these two scenarios. Regular black-hole configurations generically feature an outer and an inner horizon surrounding a maximally symmetric core; the inner horizon in turn triggers mass inflation and semiclassical instabilities. The horizonless branch of the same solutions, by contrast, supports stable inner light rings when sufficiently compact, yet is itself subject to instabilities associated with long-lived quasinormal modes. Here we investigate how to emulate these spacetimes in an analogue-gravity platform based on surface-gravity waves in a shallow-water basin, with the aim of reproducing these instabilities experimentally. We begin by identifying the flow profiles and boundary conditions required to replicate the relevant effective geometries. In particular, we show that the inner-core metrics can be simulated with a non-rotating central-drainage configuration, and we propose a graded-drainage profile to connect them to an asymptotically flat exterior region. We then assess the experimental feasibility of studying the instabilities mentioned above with current technology. Our conclusion is that, while the required setup is realizable in principle, alternative media, such as Bose-Einstein condensates, may offer a more practical route to faithfully capturing the targeted physical features.

用 IndIGO-D 探测分赫兹引力波波段的致密双星并合

Probing Compact Binary Coalescences in the Decihertz GW Band with IndIGO-D

Abhishek Sharma, Divya Tahelyani, Anand S. Sengupta, Sanjit Mitra · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文对分赫兹引力波任务概念 IndIGO-D 开展天体物理科学案例研究，聚焦 0.1–10 Hz 波段、连接 LISA 与下一代地面干涉仪的致密双星源。作者考虑由三艘航天器构成的 L 形干涉仪，两条正交臂长 1000 km 并共享顶点，计算随时间变化的 antenna response 及星座轨道运动引起的调制，并以 IndIGO-D 合作组给出的应变灵敏度曲线为输入。对于假定灵敏度，估计双中子星探测率约为每年 76–767 个，计算不同源类的视界距离，发现 10^2–10^3 太阳质量的中等质量黑洞双星在其形成历史中可被探测，双中子星可观测到红移 z≲0.3。对类似 GW170817 的双星进行贝叶斯参数估计，显示天区定位面积在并合前一个月约 21 平方度、一周约 1 平方度、六小时约 0.3 平方度，并可由 Rubin 天文台高 cadence 覆盖对应千新星。

English: We present an astrophysical science-case study of IndIGO-D, a decihertz gravitational-wave mission concept, focusing on compact binary sources across the 0.1-10 Hz band bridging LISA and next-generation ground-based interferometers. For these science projections, we consider three spacecraft forming an L-shaped interferometer in a heliocentric orbit, with two orthogonal 1000 km arms sharing a common vertex. We calculate the time-dependent antenna response of this geometry, including modulation produced by the orbital motion of the constellation. We treat the strain-sensitivity curve supplied by the IndIGO-D collaboration as an input. For the assumed sensitivity, we estimate a BNS detection rate of $\sim76$-$767\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$. We compute horizon distances for different source classes and find that intermediate-mass black-hole binaries with masses $10^2$-$10^3\,M_\odot$ are detectable throughout their formation history, complementing the reach of LISA and terrestrial detectors. Binary neutron star systems are observable to a horizon redshift of $z\lesssim0.3$, allowing continuous multi-band coverage with Voyager-class interferometers from the decihertz regime to merger. A Bayesian parameter-estimation study of a GW170817-like binary shows that the sky localization area improves from $\sim21\,{\rm deg}^2$ at one month, $\sim1\,{\rm deg}^2$ at one week, down to $0.3\,{\rm deg}^2$ at six hours pre-merger. These sky areas are readily tiled by the Rubin Observatory, whose $9.6\,{\rm deg}^2$ field of view and r-band depth enable high-cadence, repeated coverage of GW170817-like kilonovae at this distance and beyond. IndIGO-D bridges the gap between millihertz and terrestrial observations, enabling early warnings on timescales from months to hours and enhancing the prospects for multi-band and multi-messenger discoveries. (abridged)

Beyond dust in local cosmography: perturbative Vlasov predictions

Chris Clarkson, Roy Maartens · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：宇宙学制图中的尘埃近似忽略了结构形成产生的速度弥散。该弥散产生各向同性和各向异性压强，其梯度即使单粒子沿测地线运动也会加速平均物质流，并在局域距离-红移关系中引入内禀偶极。作者在FLRW背景上的线性Vlasov微扰理论中计算该偶极以及膨胀和剪切的相应变化，采用由晕估计激发的平均弥散历史。假定FLRW背景使宇宙学原理无法被独立检验，数值预言也依赖所采用的LCDM宇宙学。压强还改变结构增长，修改剪切和决定距离各向异性随红移变化的空间梯度。在红移最低阶，最大修正来自剪切；在下一阶，膨胀梯度的变化可产生更大偶极。所得内禀偶极远小于观测到的低红移偶极，后者的近观测者行为由物质参考系与CMB参考系之间的运动主导。

English: The dust approximation used in cosmography neglects the velocity dispersion generated during structure formation. This dispersion produces isotropic and anisotropic pressure, whose gradients accelerate the mean matter flow even though individual particles follow geodesics. The acceleration introduces an intrinsic dipole into the local distance-redshift relation. We calculate this dipole and the accompanying changes in expansion and shear using linear Vlasov perturbation theory about an FLRW background, with a mean dispersion history motivated by halo estimates. The assumed FLRW background prevents an independent test of the cosmological principle; the numerical predictions also depend on the adopted LCDM cosmology. Pressure also changes the growth of structure, modifying the shear and the spatial gradients that govern how the distance anisotropy varies with redshift. The largest correction at the lowest order in redshift is to the shear, while changes in the expansion gradient can produce a larger dipole at the next order. The resulting intrinsic dipole is far smaller than the observed low-redshift dipole, whose behaviour nearest the observer is dominated by motion between the matter and CMB frames.

一句话导读：在线性Vlasov微扰下计算速度弥散压强对局域距离-红移偶极、膨胀和剪切的修正，发现内禀偶极远小于观测低红移偶极。

黑膜/玻色气体对偶与热力学第三定律

Black Brane/Bose Gase Duality and Third Law of Thermodynamics

Irina Aref'eva, Daniil Stepanenko, Igor Volovich · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：在渐近平直空间黑洞热力学中，热力学第三定律被破坏，熵无法通过常规统计力学一致建模。值得注意的是，Schwarzschild黑洞违反热力学第三定律，其熵只能用非常规模型描述，例如负维玻色气体。相反，对于某些黑膜解，如Poincare AdS黑膜、Lifshitz黑膜和类各向异性Lifshitz黑膜，第三定律得以保持，熵在温度趋于零时消失。本文把先前建立的黑洞与玻色气体热力学对偶推广到黑膜。具体而言，D维时空中的Poincare黑膜对应于2(D-2)空间维的非相对论玻色气体。此外，Lifshitz膜与玻色气体的对偶将D维时空中指数为α的Lifshitz膜与D-2空间维中能量为k^α的准粒子玻色气体联系起来。

English: In the thermodynamics of black holes in asymptotically flat space, the third law of thermodynamics is violated, and entropy cannot be consistently modeled through conventional statistical mechanics. Notably, the third law of thermodynamics is violated for the Schwarzschild black hole, and its entropy can only be described using an unconventional model, such as a Bose gas in negative dimensions. In contrast, for certain black brane solutions such as Poincare AdS black branes, Lifshitz black branes, and anisotropic Lifshitz-type black branes, the third law is preserved, with entropy vanishing as temperature approaches zero. In this paper, we extend the previously established duality between black hole and Bose gas thermodynamics to black branes. Specifically, the Poincare black brane in $D$ spacetime dimensions corresponds to a non-relativistic Bose gas in $2(D-2)$ spatial dimensions. Furthermore, the duality between Lifshitz branes and Bose gases relates a Lifshitz brane with exponent $\alpha$ in $D$-dimensional spacetime to a Bose gas of quasi-particles with energy $k^\alpha$ in $D-2$ spatial dimensions.

一句话导读：将黑洞/玻色气体热力学对偶推广到AdS与Lifshitz黑膜，讨论第三定律与熵的低温行为。

Schouten-Codazzi 引力中带尘埃与辐射源的球对称解

Spherically symmetric solutions with dust and radiation sources in Schouten-Codazzi Gravity

Sebasti\'an N\'ajera, Roberto A. Sussman, Juan Carlos Hidalgo · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文研究 Schouten-Codazzi 引力（SCG）的精确解。该理论在 Einstein 场方程中加入一个 Codazzi 张量，是二阶度规理论。作者考虑描述零辐射和非均匀尘埃的两种球对称几何，分别对应广义 Vaidya 与 Lemaître-Tolman-Bondi（LTB）时空。Codazzi 张量须满足 Codazzi 方程，这限制时空几何，并由两个积分函数确定，自然产生有效“宇宙学常数”和额外自由度。结果表明，在 Vaidya 几何中 Codazzi 贡献修正 Misner-Sharp 质量；LTB 模型的演化方程是系数依赖 Codazzi 积分函数的立方多项式。这给出比广义相对论更广的动力学，并可在不引入“暗能量”的情况下实现加速膨胀和永远膨胀模型。

English: We examine in this paper exact solutions of Schouten-Codazzi gravity (SCG), a second order metric theory in which a Codazzi tensor is added to the Einstein field equations. We consider two spherically symmetric geometries that describe null radiation and inhomogeneous dust, corresponding to generalized Vaidya and Lema\^itre-Tolman-Bondi (LTB) spacetimes. The Codazzi tensor has to comply the Codazzi equations, this imposes restrictions on the geometry of spacetime that are determined up to two integration functions that naturally generate an effective ``cosmological constant'' and an additional degree of freedom. We show that for the Vaidya geometry, these Codazzi contributions modify the Misner-Sharp mass, while the LTB models have as an evolution equation a cubic polynomial whose coefficients depend on the Codazzi integration functions. This leads to a broader class of dynamics than those of General Relativity, and allows for an accelerated expansion and ever-expanding models without the introduction of ``dark energy''. Overall, our analysis suggests that Schouten-Codazzi gravity provides an appealing framework for applications in cosmology.

面向衍射引力波信号的 GPU 加速贝叶斯推断

GPU-accelerated Bayesian inference for diffracted gravitational wave signals

Zihao Lin, Jef Heynen, Mick Wright, Thomas C. K. Ng, Chris Van Den Broeck, Justin Janquart · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：随着引力波探测数量的持续增长，观测到引力透镜化引力波的概率也随之上升。当透镜的史瓦西半径与引力波波长相当时，波动光学效应会在信号上引入随频率变化的调制。针对波动光学透镜的基于 CPU 的参数估计分析计算量巨大，限制了判定潜在透镜候选显著性的研究规模。本工作中，我们在高性能 GPU 参数估计流水线 Jim 中实现了点质量透镜模型。这首次实现了全波动光学下的 GPU 加速贝叶斯推断，包括无需训练数据即可计算贝叶斯因子。我们将该框架称为 Jim-lensing。利用该框架，与当前最先进的基于 CPU 的流水线相比，我们能把点质量透镜假设下的完整参数估计运行从超过 10 小时加速到约 10 分钟量级。我们表明该实现是稳定的，并得到与该最先进流水线相当的结果。相对于现有 CPU 流水线的显著速度提升，为在更广泛的透镜模型下分析引力波数据铺平了道路，并具备更强能力给出稳健的频率学派显著性估计。

English: As the rate of gravitational wave detections continues to grow, the probability of observing a gravitationally lensed gravitational wave also increases. When the Schwarzschild radius of the lens is comparable in size to the gravitational wave wavelength, wave-optics effects induce a frequency- dependent modulation on the signal. CPU-based parameter estimation analyses for wave-optics lensing are computationally intensive, limiting the scale of studies to determine the significance of any potential lensing candidate. In this work, we implement a point-mass lens model in Jim, a high-performance GPU-based parameter estimation pipeline. This enables, for the first time, GPU-accelerated Bayesian inference in full-wave optics, including the computation of Bayes factors, without the need for training data. We call this framework Jim-lensing. Using this framework, we are able to speed up a full parameter estimation run under the point-mass lens hypothesis from more than 10 hours to the order of 10 minutes compared to the current state-of-the-art CPU-based pipeline. We show that our implementation is stable and obtains comparable results to this state-of- the-art pipeline. The substantial speed gain over existing CPU pipelines paves the way for analyzing gravitational wave data under a broader range of lensing models with greater capacity to produce robust frequentist significance estimates.

一句话导读：在 GPU 流水线 Jim 中实现点质量透镜模型，把全波动光学下的引力波透镜贝叶斯参数估计从十余小时加速到约十分钟。

Outer trapped surface formation from gravitational waves collision

Junbin Li · gr-qc, math-ph, math.AP, math.DG, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文在无对称性假设的光滑真空时空中，给出外部捕获面形成的一种新严格构造。该捕获面由两列横向局域、近似平面波前的引力波碰撞产生，所用数据为短脉冲数据。作者通过沿一条曲线拼接两片光滑部分，并要求其未来指向的外向零法向连续匹配，从而得到外部捕获面；随后改造 Penrose 的原始论证，证明最大未来发展的不完备性。该构造受 Penrose 关于两束超相对论粒子碰撞（以 Aichelburg-Sexl 解建模）中构造边缘外捕获面的论证启发。

English: We give a new rigorous construction of outer trapped surface formation in smooth vacuum spacetimes without symmetry assumptions. The outer trapped surface is produced by the collision of two transversely localized, nearly plane-fronted gravitational waves described by short pulse data. The outer trapped surface is obtained by joining two smooth pieces along a curve with their future-directed outer null normals matching continuously. The incompleteness of the maximal future development is then established by adapting Penrose's original argument. This construction is inspired by Penrose's argument in constructing a marginally outer trapped surface in the collision of two ultra-relativistic particles modeled by the Aichelburg--Sexl solution.

非线性电动力学中旋转带电黑洞周围极端质量比旋进的周期轨道与引力波辐射

Periodic orbits and gravitational-wave emission from extreme-mass-ratio inspirals around rotating charged black holes in nonlinear electrodynamics

Xi Luo, Meirong Tang, Zhaoyi Xu · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：在广义相对论框架下，无毛定理限制黑洞只有质量、角动量和电荷三个内禀量。非线性电动力学（NED）黑洞等价于各向异性物质组成的黑洞，并可在视界附近形成“毛”结构，是检验修改引力理论的理想对象。本文在爱因斯坦引力中采用引力与NED物质的耦合构造，聚焦幂指数参数 s=2 的 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg（EEH）情形；该框架下旋转带电NED黑洞在Kerr-Newman几何上增加修正项。以自旋 a 和NED电荷 q 为主要控制变量，研究极端质量比旋进（EMRI）中的试验粒子动力学，推导赤道面类时测地线和有效势；通过数值计算 marginally-bound orbits（MBO）与最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO），考察参数如何重塑能量-角动量（E-L）相空间。利用 (z,w,v) 整数轨道分类，在绝热近似和四极辐射 prescription 下计算 h+ 与 hx 两种引力波偏振模。较大的 a 与 q 使束缚轨道向内收缩，并把 E-L 相空间移向更小角动量；周期轨道的 zoom-whirl 特征更显著，而较大参数值缩短波形周期并增强信号幅度。结果可为 LISA、天琴等空间引力波天文台提供理论支持，并有助于区分NED黑洞时空和检验无毛定理。

English: Within general-relativistic descriptions, the no-hair theorem dictates that black-hole geometries possess just three intrinsic physical quantities: mass, angular momentum, and electric charge. Black holes in nonlinear electrodynamics (NED) are equivalent to those composed of anisotropic matter and can develop "hair" structures near the event horizon, serving as ideal testbeds for modified theories of gravity. Working within Einsteinian gravitational theory, we adopt a coupling construction between gravity and NED matter, focusing explicitly on the Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg (EEH) variant with the power-index parameter fixed at s = 2. In this framework, a rotating, charged NED black hole extends the Kerr-Newman geometry with extra correction terms. Treating spin a and NED charge q as primary control variables, we examine test-particle dynamics inside extreme-mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) configurations. We derive equatorial timelike geodesics and the effective potential. Through numerical evaluation of marginally-bound orbits (MBO) and innermost stable circular orbits (ISCO), we explore how these parameters reshape the energy-angular-momentum (E-L) phase-space. Using the (z, w, v) integer-valued orbit taxonomy, we compute the two gravitational-wave polarization modes h+ and hx via the adiabatic approximation and quadrupole radiation prescription. Larger values for a and q drive inward contraction for bound trajectories while displacing the E-L phase-space toward smaller angular-momentum values. Periodic-orbit zoom-whirl signatures grow increasingly prominent, while larger parameter values shorten the waveform periods and enhance signal amplitudes. Our results provide theoretical support for space-borne gravitational-wave observatories including LISA and TianQin, enabling prospects for discriminating NED black-hole spacetimes and performing observational checks on the no-hair theorem.

用未透镜模板搜寻透镜化引力波

Searching for lensed gravitational waves with unlensed templates

Digvijay Wadekar, Barak Zackay, Mark Ho-Yeuk Cheung, Tousif Islam, Javier Roulet, Ajit Kumar Mehta, Tejaswi Venumadhav, Jonathan Mushkin, Miguel Zumalacarregui, Matias Zaldarriaga · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：引力透镜可把双星并合的引力波信号分成两个像，这两个像可能重叠并干涉，也可能作为分离事件到达。作者表明，每个双像模板的匹配滤波输出都可以直接由现有未透镜模板搜索已经计算的信噪比时间序列构造出来。由此得到一个边缘化检测统计量，无需额外匹配滤波即可提高搜索灵敏度，且比显式透镜模板库快150倍以上。在几何光学区间的重叠像情形下，该双像方法可从点质量透镜和奇异等温透镜中恢复约97%以上的最优信噪比，而未透镜模板最多只捕获约67%；对Chang-Refsdal透镜和带核等温透镜也有显著增益。重叠的透镜化信号还会无法通过用于降低噪声瞬变排序的信号一致性检验，而双像方法可恢复一致性，并使被强烈降序信号的敏感体积增大约2至4倍。对于分离像，该方法可对两个像单独都不显著的成对信号进行高效相干搜索；在折叠焦散附近，相比要求两次独立探测，敏感体积提高1.8至2.6倍，相比针对性对应体搜索最高提高1.6倍。该方法适用于任何匹配滤波搜索。

English: Gravitational lensing can split the signal of a binary merger into two images, which either overlap and interfere or arrive as separate events. We show that the matched-filter output of every two-image template can be straightforwardly constructed from the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) time series that searches already compute with unlensed templates. This enables a marginalized detection statistic that increases search sensitivity without additional matched filtering and is more than 150 times faster than an explicit lensed template bank. For overlapping images in the geometric-optics regime, our two-image method recovers $\gtrsim97\%$ of the optimal SNR from point-mass and singular isothermal lenses, compared with as little as $67\%$ captured by unlensed templates, with substantial gains also for Chang-Refsdal and cored isothermal lenses. Overlapping lensed signals moreover fail the signal-consistency test that is used to down-rank noise transients. Our two-image method restores the consistency and increases the sensitive volume by roughly $2$-$4\times$ for the strongly down-ranked signals. For separated images, our method enables an efficient coherent search for pairs in which neither image is significant alone. Near fold caustics, this increases the sensitive volume by factors of 1.8-2.6 over requiring two independent detections, and up to 1.6 over a targeted counterpart search. Our method is applicable to any matched-filtering search.

爱因斯坦-标量-Gauss-Bonnet引力中标量化黑洞对标量波的散射

Scattering of scalar waves by scalarized black holes in Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity

Junyi Li, Yinrong Fang, Yang Huang, Qian Li, Junji Jia · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们系统研究了在具有四次耦合 f(φ)=α(φ^2+βφ^4) 和指数耦合 f(φ)=α(1−e^{−βφ^2}) 的爱因斯坦-标量-Gauss-Bonnet引力中，大质量标量场被标量化黑洞散射和吸收的问题。背景解通过切比雪夫赝谱法数值获得，使得可以在纯数值黑洞背景上进行分波分析。分波结果与测地线近似、glory近似以及史瓦西极限交叉验证，符合得很好。我们发现标量化相对于史瓦西情形抑制了总吸收截面，并在微分散射截面中产生独特特征。两种耦合模型之间存在定性差异：对于四次耦合模型，偏离史瓦西的结果集中在约(70°,140°)的中间角区域，前向角和glory峰附近变化相对较小；对于指数耦合模型，偏离出现在整个角范围，并显著修改glory峰，在某些参数区间甚至可超过史瓦西值。这种独特的角分布为从散射可观测量区分EsGB耦合函数提供了潜在诊断。

English: We systematically investigate the scattering and absorption of a massive scalar field by scalarized black holes in Einstein-scalar-Gauss-Bonnet gravity with quartic coupling $f(\phi)=\alpha(\phi^{2}+\beta\phi^{4})$ and exponential coupling $f(\phi)=\alpha(1-\operatorname{e}^{-\beta\phi^{2}})$. The background solutions are obtained numerically via a Chebyshev pseudospectral method, enabling a partial-wave analysis on purely numerical black hole backgrounds. The partial-wave results are cross-validated against geodesic and glory approximations and the Schwarzschild limit with excellent agreements. We find that scalarization suppresses the total absorption cross section relative to the Schwarzschild case, and produces distinctive signatures in the differential scattering cross section. A qualitative difference between the two coupling models is identified: for the quartic coupling model, deviations from Schwarzschild are concentrated in the intermediate-angle region $\sim(70^{\circ},140^{\circ})$, with comparatively small changes at forward angles and near the glory peak; for the exponential coupling model, deviations appear across the full angular range and substantially modify the glory peak, which in some parameter regimes can even exceed the Schwarzschild value. This distinctive angular pattern provides a potential diagnostic for distinguishing EsGB coupling functions from scattering observables.

一句话导读：数值分波分析显示EsGB标量化黑洞抑制标量波总吸收截面，且不同耦合函数在微分散射角分布上留下可区分的诊断特征。

用极端质量比旋近探测宇称破坏黑洞几何

Probing parity-breaking black-hole geometry with extreme-mass-ratio inspirals

Zhen-Bo Wu, Qing Ou, Peng-Cheng Li · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文研究围绕宇称破坏共形 Kerr 黑洞的极端质量比旋近（EMRI）中，赤道反射对称性破缺的引力波信号。针对与赤道 Kerr 轨道相连的圆轨道分支，作者在无量纲形变参数 ε 的二阶展开下导出动力学，并用质量四极矩方案构造绝热旋近和引力波信号。赤道反射将 ε 映射为 -ε，使极向位移为奇、轨道频率和能量为偶。诱导的一阶谐波在所研究构型中直接贡献较小，而二阶动力学修正会在多周期累积后产生可观的退相位。研究发现黑洞快速旋转会增强这些相位效应及相应的噪声加权波形失配。对于 10 M⊙ 天体旋近至 10^6 M⊙、a/M=0.9、观测倾角 ι=2π/3 的一年旋近，固定参数失配在不优化时间、相位或 Kerr 参数时约在 ε=10^-3 达到比较基准 M=0.01；单参数 Fisher 分析也表明高自旋下对 ε 的局域灵敏度有所提高。结果将圆轨道分支的反射性质与累积源相位效应联系起来，并补充传播双折射检验。灵敏度估计仍依赖于绝热四极矩模型和所采用的比较流程；稳健的观测约束需要更精确的辐射建模和完整参数估计分析。

English: We investigate the gravitational-wave signatures of equatorial reflection symmetry breaking in extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) around a parity-violating conformal Kerr black hole. For the circular-orbit branch connected to equatorial Kerr orbits, we derive the dynamics through second order in the dimensionless deformation parameter $\varepsilon$ and construct adiabatic inspirals and gravitational-wave signals using a mass-quadrupole prescription. Equatorial reflection maps $\varepsilon$ to $-\varepsilon$, making the polar displacement odd and the orbital frequency and energy even in the deformation. The induced first harmonic has a small direct contribution for the configurations studied, while second-order dynamical corrections accumulate over many cycles to produce appreciable dephasing. We find that rapid black-hole rotation enhances these phase effects and the associated noise-weighted waveform mismatch. For a one-year inspiral of a $10M_\odot$ object into a $10^6M_\odot$ black hole with $a/M=0.9$ and viewing inclination $\iota=2\pi/3$, the fixed-parameter mismatch reaches the comparison benchmark $\mathcal M=0.01$ at approximately $\varepsilon=10^{-3}$, without optimization over time, phase, or Kerr parameters. A single-parameter Fisher analysis also indicates improved local sensitivity to $\varepsilon$ at high spin. These results connect the reflection properties of the circular branch to accumulated source-phase effects and complement tests of propagation birefringence. The sensitivity estimates remain conditional on the adiabatic quadrupole model and the adopted comparison procedure; robust observational constraints require more accurate radiation modeling and a full parameter-estimation analysis.

超越准正规模并重新解释双黑洞并合-铃宕中的直接波

Moving Beyond Quasinormal Modes and Reinterpreting Direct Waves in Binary Black Hole Merger-Ringdowns

Richard Dyer, Anuj Kankani, Gareth Arturo Marks, Sean T. McWilliams, Christopher J. Moore · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：基于黑洞微扰论和双黑洞并合的有效单体图像，已有工作提出铃宕中可能存在可测量的直接波，并认为其可能来自残余黑洞光球层内部甚至视界附近。本文给出三条独立证据反对这些主张；同时表明铃宕早期确有一部分信号不能直接用准正规模建模，但没有证据表明这就是此前定义的直接波，且该成分的性质与残余黑洞的光球层而非视界相关。

English: Based on black-hole perturbation-theory calculations and an effective-one-body picture of binary black hole mergers, it has been suggested that a direct wave may be present and measurable in the ringdown. Furthermore, it has been suggested that this signal might originate from substantially inside the light ring (or photon sphere) of the remnant black hole, perhaps even from close to the event horizon. In this paper, we present three independent strands of evidence against such claims. In the process, we show that there is indeed an early-time part of the ringdown signal that cannot be directly modeled by quasinormal modes. However, there is no evidence that this is a direct wave as it has previously been defined, and we show that the properties of this component are related to the remnant's light ring rather than its horizon.

强场透镜对旋转对数熵与指数熵虫洞的光学约束

Optical constraints on rotating logarithmic- and exponential-entropy wormholes from strong-field lensing

A. Errehymy G. Yergaliyeva, S. K. Maurya, B. Turimov, I. Ibragimov, J. Rayimbaev · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：针对无地平线致密天体能否在视界尺度模仿黑洞的问题，本文把慢旋转可穿越虫洞的光学外观表述为赤道零测地线导出的可观测量，并给出多参数指纹的必要充分条件。采用在对数/指数红移 profile 间插值的 lapse function，得到光子球条件、强偏折透镜系数和 Lyapunov 指数的闭式表达式，得到依赖对数熵和指数熵参数的两族虫洞解，并与 Kerr 及四个正则黑洞比较。阴影直径可调到 Kerr 的 5%–11% 内，因此仅靠阴影无法区分；结合旋转不对称性、透镜系数、Lyapunov 指数和轨道频率的五分量指纹可打破退化，各分量相对 Kerr 偏差 |Δ_i| ≳ 0.05，最大偏差在第二透镜系数与 Lyapunov 指数，联合判别信噪比约 3.8–3.9 对 Kerr、约 3.7 对 Kazakov–Solodukhin 基准，足以在 10% 测量水平打破阴影直径退化。

English: The longstanding issue of whether horizonless compact objects can mimic black holes at horizon scales is addressed, a problem that persists because the shadow diameter alone is degenerate across a wide class of geometries. For slowly rotating traversable wormholes, we precisely formulate the optical appearance as a set of observables derived from equatorial null geodesics, yielding necessary and sufficient conditions for a multi-parameter fingerprint. Using a new lapse function that interpolates between exponential and rational redshift profiles, we obtain the photon-sphere condition, the strong-deflection lensing coefficients, and the Lyapunov exponent in closed form. The equations yield two families of wormhole solutions dependent on logarithmic and exponential entropy parameters. We compare the resulting quantum-modified spacetimes with Kerr and four regular black holes. The shadow diameter is shown to be tunable to within $5\%$ to $11\%$ of Kerr for all models considered, so that $|R_{\rm sh}^{\rm WH}/R_{\rm sh}^{\rm Kerr}-1| \lesssim 0.11$ and the shadow alone cannot separate the models. The degeneracy is lifted when the rotational asymmetry, lensing coefficients, Lyapunov exponent, and orbital frequency are combined: for the $5$-component fingerprint $\mathbf{F}=(\Arot,\abar,\bbar, \Lya,\Oph)$, the fractional deviation $\Delta_i=(F_i^{\rm WH}-F_i^{\rm Kerr})/ F_i^{\rm Kerr}$ satisfies $|\Delta_i|\gtrsim 0.05$ for every component, with the largest departures in the second lensing coefficient and the Lyapunov exponent. The combined discrimination signal reaches a signal-to-noise ratio of about $3.8$ to $3.9$ against Kerr and about $3.7$ against the Kazakov--Solodukhin benchmark, which is sufficient to break the shadow-diameter degeneracy at the $10\%$ measurement level.

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

旋转黑洞能层内磁重联形成的等离子体团的命运

Destinies of Plasmoids Formed from the Magnetic Reconnection Occurring within the Ergo Region of a Rotating Black Hole

Ho-Yun YuChih, Ye Shen · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：广泛认为，黑洞吸积流中会连续发生磁重联，尤其是在赤道面上，这是由于赤道电流片的形成。当磁重联发生在旋转黑洞的能层内时，一个被抛射的等离子体团（记为 p_-）可能获得负的无穷远能量密度，而伴随的等离子体团（记为 p_+）相应地携带从黑洞提取的能量。该机制被称为 Comisso-Asenjo 过程，为从旋转黑洞提取能量提供了可行的天体物理途径。一般来说，成功提取能量需满足两个条件：第一，p_- 通过磁重联产生且具有负的无穷远能量密度；第二，携带被提取能量的 p_+ 必须逃逸到无穷远。尽管已有许多研究推进了 Comisso-Asenjo 过程理论，但对 p_+ 的逃逸缺乏考虑。在本工作中，我们采用测地线方法系统考察 p_+ 被抛射后的命运，从而建立通过磁重联从旋转黑洞提取能量的完整条件。我们重新定义覆盖因子，其中只计入逃逸的 p_+。该量反映吸积系统中成功能量提取发生的概率。通过分析这一修正覆盖因子，我们确定了黑洞自旋的下界 a=0.8005；低于该值时，无论体等离子体磁化程度多高，通过磁重联提取能量都永远无法成功。这一极限表明，由连续磁重联引起的黑洞自旋减慢将在自旋降至约 0.8005 时终止。

English: It is widely accepted that magnetic reconnections occur successively in black hole accretion flows, especially on the equatorial plane, owing to the formation of the equatorial current sheet. When magnetic reconnection takes place within the ergosphere of a rotating black hole, one of the ejected plasmoids (denoted as $p_-$) may acquire negative energy-at-infinity density, while the companion plasmoid (denoted as $p_+$) correspondingly carries the energy extracted from the black hole. This mechanism, known as the Comisso-Asenjo process, provides a viable astrophysical pathway for extracting energy from a rotating black hole. Generally speaking, two conditions have to be satisfied for successful energy extraction. First, $p_-$ is generated via magnetic reconnection with negative energy-at-infinity density. Second, the associated $p_+$, which carries the extracted energy, must escape to infinity. Though a number of studies have promoted the theory of the Comisso-Asenjo process, the escape of $p_+$ lacks consideration. In this work, we adopt geodesic approach to systematically examine the destinies of $p_+$ after ejection, thereby establishing the complete conditions for energy extraction from a rotating black hole via magnetic reconnection. We redefine the covering factor, for which only escaping $p_+$ are counted. This quantity reflects how probable the successful energy extraction occurs in an accretion system. Through analysis of this revised covering factor, we identify a lower bound on the black hole spin, $a=0.8005$, below which energy extraction via magnetic reconnection can never succeed, no matter how high the magnetization of the bulk plasma is. This limit suggests that the spin-down of a black hole caused by successive magnetic reconnections would terminate once the spin decreases to approximately 0.8005.

一句话导读：用测地线追踪 p_+ 逃逸，完善 Comisso-Asenjo 能量提取条件并给出自旋下界 a=0.8005。

完美流体暗物质包围的史瓦西黑洞周围引力透镜效应对中微子振荡的影响

Gravitational lensing effects on neutrino oscillations around a Schwarzschild black hole immersed in perfect fluid dark matter

Sojida Mannobova, Farruh Atamurotov, Ahmadjon Abdujabbarov, Phongpichit Channuie, Chengxun Yuan, Chen Zhou · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文研究静态球对称黑洞在完美流体暗物质（PFDM）包围下弱引力透镜区域的中微子味振荡。在协变量子力学框架内，推导超相对论中微子径向和非径向传播的振荡相位。径向领先相位与度规函数无关，而非径向轨迹获得由PFDM参数λ控制的依赖碰撞参数的修正。针对两条相干透镜路径构造味跃迁概率，并分析二味和三味情形下的干涉。改变λ会移动振荡极值并改变振幅和对比度，且对中微子质量标度、透镜质量、味通道和质量顺序呈非单调依赖。在所考虑构型中，P_{μτ}通道对PFDM贡献尤为敏感。此外，路径干涉项保留绝对中微子质量标度的信息。这些结果刻画了PFDM引起的透镜中微子振荡修正，并为更真实的处理（包括退相干、平均化、探测器分辨率以及透镜轨迹和放大率修正）提供基础。

English: We investigate neutrino flavor oscillations in the weak gravitational-lensing regime of a static, spherically symmetric black hole surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM). Within a covariant quantum-mechanical framework, we derive the oscillation phases for radial and non-radial propagation of ultrarelativistic neutrinos. While the leading radial phase is independent of the metric function, non-radial trajectories acquire impact-parameter-dependent corrections governed by the PFDM parameter $\lambda$. We construct the flavor-transition probability for two coherent lensed paths and analyze the resulting interference in two and three flavor scenarios. Varying $\lambda$ shifts the oscillation extrema and modifies their amplitudes and contrast, with a non-monotonic dependence on the neutrino mass scale, lens mass, flavor channel, and mass ordering. The $P_{\mu\tau}$ channel shows particularly strong sensitivity to the PFDM contribution for the considered configurations. Moreover, the path-interference terms retain information about the absolute neutrino mass scale. These results characterize PFDM-induced modifications of lensed neutrino oscillations and provide a basis for more realistic treatments including decoherence, averaging, detector resolution, and corrections to lens trajectories and magnifications.

一句话导读：研究PFDM包围的史瓦西黑洞弱透镜区中微子味振荡，给出径向/非径向相位及双路径干涉对暗物质参数的依赖。

Einstein-Born-Infeld 黑洞中的弱宇宙监督：参数空间分析

Weak Cosmic Censorship in Einstein-Born-Infeld Black Hole: A Parameter-Space Analysis

M. L. Pe\~nafiel, F. T. Falciano, J. C. Fabris · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：Einstein-Born-Infeld 是广义相对论中带 Born-Infeld 非线性电动力学的带电黑洞解，具有违反 Bekenstein 熵上界、相对 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞可过充电等特征，是检验宇宙监督猜想的理想对象。通常该分析需要计算黑洞附近检验粒子的自能，但由于电磁非线性一般不可行。本文提出一种替代方法，可探索 Einstein-Born-Infeld 黑洞的整个参数空间并检验宇宙监督猜想的有效性。

English: Einstein-Born-Infeld is a charged black hole solution of general relativity with Born-Infeld nonlinear electrodynamics, which has interesting physical features. It violates Bekenstein's entropy upper bound, and it can overcharge with respect to the Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole. It presents an optimum situation to test the cosmic censorship conjecture, which is another important conjecture in black hole physics. In principle, this analysis requires the calculation of the self-energy of a test particle in the vicinity of the black hole, which, in general, is not feasible because of the electromagnetic nonlinearities. In this work, we propose an alternative approach that allows us to explore the whole parameter space of the Einstein-Born-Infeld black hole and test the validity of the cosmic censorship conjecture.

一句话导读：在 Einstein-Born-Infeld 黑洞全参数空间中检验弱宇宙监督猜想，并提出规避非线性电动力学自能计算困难的替代方法。

Radius of the innermost stable circular orbit of black-holes with localized Astrophysical Dark Matter halo

Anup S. Karekar, Siba Prasad Das · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文研究静态球对称黑洞在局域天体物理暗物质晕背景下的测地线结构。暗物质晕采用含核心半径 r0 的正则化密度剖面，在视界处为零，指数因子保证总晕质量有限；作者在刚性物质 w=1 状态方程下数值求解 Einstein 场方程，并通过有效势及其一、二阶导数计算有毛发黑洞附近大质量粒子的类时 ISCO 半径。数值结果与近期提出的归一化上界 r_ISCO≤6 一致，并表明暗物质晕使 ISCO 相对 Schwarzschild 情形内移，且核心半径越大移动越明显；对 r0=2.0、10.0、20.0 分别得到约 5.97、5.61、5.53。

English: We investigate the geodesic structure of a static, spherically symmetric black-hole in the background of a localized Astrophysical Dark Matter (ADM)-halo. The halo is modeled by a core-radius ($r_0$), regularized density profile that vanishes at the event horizon and exponential factor ensures the finite total halo mass. We solved the Einstein field equations numerically with equation of state with $p=w\rho$ for stiff matter $w=1$ scenario. By analyzing the effective potential and its first and second derivatives, we evaluated the characteristic radius of the time-like innermost stable circular orbit ($r_{\text{ISCO}}$) of massive particle in the vicinity of hairy black-hole. Our numerical analysis is consistent with the recently proposed theoretical upper bound $r_{\text{ISCO}} \le 6$ normalized to unit mass black-hole. We showed that the ADM-halo shifts $r_{\text{ISCO}}$ inward with respect to the Schwarzschild (bald) scenario and the shifts are larger for larger halo core-radius. In particular our numerical finding enumerate $r_{\text{ISCO}}$ are approximately $5.97$, $5.61$, $5.53$ for $r_0=2.0,10.0,20.0$ respectively. We believe that our analysis with ADM-halo model shed light on probing black-hole hair through high-energy astrophysical observables.

一句话导读：该文用数值方法研究暗物质晕背景下黑洞的类时测地线与 ISCO，发现暗物质晕使 ISCO 相对 Schwarzschild 黑洞内移。

谱爱因斯坦代码（SpEC）有多准确？是什么限制了其准确性？

How accurate is Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC)? And what limits its accuracy?

Himanshu Chaudhary, Mark A. Scheel, Robert Owen, Saul A. Teukolsky, Michael Boyle, Lawrence E. Kidder, Harald P. Pfeiffer · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：即将升级的引力波探测器灵敏度将要求相应更准确的双黑洞（BBH）模拟。鉴于此类模拟成本很高，理解其误差来源并高效利用计算资源至关重要。我们研究使用谱爱因斯坦代码（SpEC）进行的BBH模拟中的误差来源，并试图理解是什么限制了其准确性。特别地，我们关注旋近阶段，因为它是模拟中运行时间最长的部分，并占波形误差的大部分。我们发现，对计算域不同部分的模拟参数和分辨率进行有针对性的调整，可以减少约束违反和引力波形差异。我们还讨论了在更高分辨率下变得重要的更根本的准确性限制：浮点误差以及基本变量尺度上的巨大差异。解决这些限制将需要对SpEC代码及其用于演化爱因斯坦方程的表述进行重大修改。本文讨论的许多改进和修改很可能与其他数值相对论代码相关。

English: The improved sensitivity of upcoming gravitational-wave detectors will require correspondingly more accurate binary black hole (BBH) simulations. Given the high cost of such simulations, it is essential to understand their sources of error and use computational resources efficiently. We study sources of error in BBH simulations performed with the Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC) and seek to understand what limits their accuracy. In particular, we focus on the inspiral phase because it is the longest-running part of the simulation and accounts for the majority of the waveform error. We find that targeted changes to simulation parameters and resolution in different parts of the computational domain reduce constraint violations and gravitational waveform differences. We also discuss more fundamental limitations on our accuracy that become important at higher resolutions: floating-point errors and large differences in the scales of the fundamental variables. Addressing these limitations will require substantial changes to both the SpEC code and the formulation it uses to evolve Einstein's equations. Many of the improvements and changes discussed in this paper are likely to be relevant to other numerical relativity codes.

一句话导读：该文分析SpEC双黑洞数值相对论模拟的误差来源与精度极限，指出旋近阶段主导波形误差，并讨论浮点误差和变量尺度差异等根本限制。

用零点长度修饰裸奇点

Dressing a naked singularity with zero-point length

Kimet Jusufi, Francisco S. N. Lobo · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们用受零点长度启发的归一化核正则化 Joshi–Malafarina–Narayan 时空的中心密度尖峰。对无界尖峰，卷积与包围质量可解析得到；截断该密度得到正则、无视界、切向压强的内部，并与 Schwarzschild 匹配。对有限云做卷积则保持总质量并给出光滑物质尾。紧致度上界证明第二种方案避免视界。我们确定中心 lapse，证明尽管存在极端光学延迟仍测地完备，导出跨临界紧致度的统一光学延迟公式，并识别超紧致位形的稳定内部光环。无质量标量探针算符非负，半经典束缚模泄漏被强烈抑制。显式压力闭合比较将稳健几何性质与依赖闭合的延迟指数分开。普朗克尺度例子展示极端红移和延迟，但其光子解释需要核心中超出经典传播的物理。该构造给出有效静态源，而非微观物质理论或坍缩的动力学解决。

English: We regularize the central density cusp of the Joshi--Malafarina--Narayan spacetime using a normalized kernel motivated by a zero-point length. For an unbounded cusp, the convolution and enclosed mass are obtained analytically; truncating this density gives a regular, horizonless tangential-pressure interior matched to Schwarzschild. Convolving the finite cloud instead preserves its total mass and yields a smooth matter tail. A compactness bound establishes horizon avoidance for this second prescription. We determine the central lapse, establish causal geodesic completeness despite extreme optical delays, derive a uniform optical-delay formula across the critical compactness, and identify the stable interior light ring of ultracompact configurations. The massless scalar probe operator is nonnegative, while semiclassical trapped modes exhibit strongly suppressed leakage. An explicit pressure-closure comparison separates robust geometric properties from closure-dependent delay exponents. Planck-scale examples illustrate extreme redshifts and delays, but their photon interpretation requires physics beyond classical propagation in the core. The construction specifies an effective static source, rather than a microscopic matter theory or a dynamical resolution of collapse.

旋转 Weyl 黑洞周围的混沌起始与轨道不稳定性

Onset of Chaos and Orbital Instabilities around Rotating Weyl Black Holes

Shubham Kala, M. Yousaf, Pradeep Singh, Faisal Javed, Hemwati Nandan, G. Mustafa · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们利用 Poincare 截面、Lyapunov 指数、快速 Lyapunov 指标（FLI）、Kolmogorov-Sinai（KS）熵和离散混沌指标（DIG）图，研究 Weyl 共形引力（WCG）中旋转黑洞附近的非线性光子运动。黑洞自旋与由参数 ξ 和 γ 控制的高阶曲率修正的联合影响，导致强场区域从近可积轨迹向明显混沌动力学转变。随着 ξ 和 γ 增大，不变环面越来越变形并最终破裂。随后形成共振岛和随机层，在相空间中产生大范围混沌区域，尤其在接近极端自旋的区域。增大的 Lyapunov 指数、更快的 FLI 增长和更高的 KS 熵，为增强的动力学不稳定性、对初始条件敏感性的增加以及相应的信息产生率提供了定量度量。DIG 图显示光子球周围的规则区域缩小、混沌区域扩大，表明共形引力修正使零测地圆轨道失稳。总体而言，这些发现阐明了相对论参考系拖曳和高阶曲率项如何共同控制光子混沌，并指出非线性光子动力学可作为强引力区偏离广义相对论的潜在探针。

English: We investigate nonlinear photon motion in the vicinity of a rotating black hole (BH) within Weyl conformal gravity (WCG) by employing Poincare sections, Lyapunov exponents, Fast Lyapunov Indicators (FLI), Kolmogorov-Sinai (KS) entropy, and Discrete Indicator of Chaos (DIG) maps. The joint influence of BH spin and higher order curvature corrections, governed by the parameters $\xi$ and $\gamma$, induces a transition from nearly integrable trajectories to markedly chaotic dynamics in the strong field domain. As $\xi$ and $\gamma$ increase, the invariant tori are increasingly deformed and eventually break up. Resonance islands and stochastic layers then form, producing large chaotic regions in phase space, especially near the extremal spin regime. Increasing Lyapunov exponents, faster FLI growth, and higher KS entropy provide quantitative measures of the enhanced dynamical instability, the increased sensitivity to initial conditions, and the corresponding rate of information production. DIG maps show shrinking regular regions and expanding chaotic domains around the photon sphere, indicating that conformal gravity corrections destabilize null circular orbits. Taken together, these findings clarify how relativistic frame dragging and higher order curvature terms jointly control photon chaos and point to nonlinear photon dynamics as a potential probe of departures from General Relativity in the strong-gravity regime.

反德西特与德西特时空中的半经典宇宙学常数

Semiclassical Cosmological Constant in Anti-de Sitter and de Sitter Spacetimes

Milton C. Mamani-Leqque · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们研究四维反德西特（AdS）和德西特（dS）时空中量子化标量场的半经典爱因斯坦方程。首先，将裸宇宙学常数固定为其几何值，并要求重整化真空应力-能量张量为零，以确定自洽位形。在AdS中，所得质量-曲率关系依赖于曲率耦合和边界条件；最小耦合下的一个形式Neumann根因可允许参数范围而被排除，而共形耦合下Dirichlet和Neumann解均被允许。在dS中，我们重现了已知的最小耦合大质量场自洽解。随后，我们在四个无质量位形中计算给定背景上的有效宇宙学常数，每种情形均呈 Λ_eff=A/ℓ^2+B/ℓ^4 形式。经典曲率与真空极化之间的竞争在最小耦合AdS情形产生一个极小值和一个零点，而其他位形是单调的。最后，形式延拓 ℓ→iℓ 无法重现直接计算的量子系数：其AdS到dS的比值在最小耦合下为29/61，在共形耦合下为-1。这些结果表明，仅对曲率尺度作延拓并不能建立AdS与dS半经典真空贡献之间的等价性。

English: We investigate the semiclassical Einstein equation for a quantized scalar field in four-dimensional anti-de Sitter (AdS) and de Sitter (dS) spacetimes. We first determine self-consistent configurations by fixing the bare cosmological constant to its geometric value, requiring the renormalized vacuum stress-energy tensor to vanish. In AdS, the resulting mass-curvature relations depend on the curvature coupling and boundary conditions; one formal Neumann root for minimal coupling is excluded by the admissible parameter range, whereas both Dirichlet and Neumann solutions are allowed for conformal coupling. In dS, we recover the known self-consistent solution for a minimally coupled massive field. We then evaluate the effective cosmological constant on prescribed backgrounds in four massless configurations. In each case, it takes the form \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{eff}}=A/\ell^2+B/\ell^4\). The competition between classical curvature and vacuum polarization produces a minimum and a zero in the minimally coupled AdS case, while the other configurations are monotonic. Finally, the formal continuation \(\ell\rightarrow i\ell\) fails to reproduce the directly calculated quantum coefficients: their AdS-to-dS ratios are \(29/61\) for minimal coupling and \(-1\) for conformal coupling. These results show that continuation of the curvature scale alone does not establish equivalence between the semiclassical vacuum contributions in AdS and dS.

一句话导读：研究AdS/dS时空中量子标量场对半经典爱因斯坦方程的自洽解与有效宇宙学常数，并指出ℓ→iℓ延拓不能联系两种时空的量子真空贡献。

A computer assisted existence proof for a non-Schwarzschild black hole in Einstein--Weyl gravity

Kevin Goldstein, Vishnu Jejjala · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：四维 Einstein–Weyl 引力中静态、渐近平坦的非 Schwarzschild 黑洞此前已通过数值打靶构造，而局部场方程在视界和渐近区域具有全阶展开。本文给出一个计算机辅助存在性证明：证明一个无量纲视界半径（以有质量自旋二标度为单位）为 1、参数接近既有数值分支的非 Schwarzschild 解存在。外部区域被分为收敛的视界级数域、由带定向舍入的参数依赖 Taylor 模型包围的紧致核心，以及作为中心稳定流形不动点问题处理的无穷渐近域。核心与尾部之间的五维匹配映射在严格给定的盒子上连续；经精确有理预条件后，相对面上的符号满足 Poincaré–Miranda 定理假设，从而证明匹配零点存在。该解具有正则非退化视界、无额外外部视界、Ricci 标量为零且 Ricci 张量非零。严格界还蕴涵在充分接近的每个视界半径处解存在，并在固定耦合下存在局部连续族。该证明确立存在性，但不证明匹配零点的唯一性。

English: Static, asymptotically flat, non-Schwarzschild black holes in four-dimensional Einstein--Weyl gravity have previously been constructed by numerical shooting, while the local field equations admit horizon and asymptotic expansions to all orders. We give a computer assisted existence proof for a non-Schwarzschild solution whose dimensionless horizon radius is one in units of the massive spin-two scale, with parameters close to the previously reported numerical branch. The exterior is divided into a convergent horizon series domain, a compact core enclosed by a parameter dependent Taylor model with directed rounding, and an infinite asymptotic domain treated as a centered stable manifold fixed point problem. The resulting five-dimensional matching map between the core and tail is continuous on a rigorously specified box. After exact rational preconditioning, the signs on opposite faces satisfy the hypotheses of the Poincar\'e--Miranda theorem and therefore certify a matching zero. The solution has a regular nondegenerate horizon, no additional exterior horizon, vanishing Ricci scalar, and nonvanishing Ricci tensor. The strict bounds also imply existence at every sufficiently nearby horizon radius and a local continuous family at fixed coupling. The proof establishes existence, but not uniqueness of the matching zero.

一句话导读：用计算机辅助 Poincaré–Miranda 论证证明 Einstein–Weyl 引力中存在非 Schwarzschild 黑洞解。

相关度：medium — 论文属于经典/修改引力中的黑洞解存在性证明，直接对应“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息。

Spin-mediated modulation of chaos bound violation in Lorentz-violating black hole spacetimes

Chuang Yang, Deyou Chen, Bingbing Chen · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文在Bumblebee引力框架下研究粒子自旋如何调制洛伦兹破缺黑洞时空中的混沌界限破坏。利用Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon形式，分析自旋-曲率耦合、洛伦兹对称性破缺和宇宙学常数对静态球对称(A)dS黑洞轨道不稳定性的影响。发现粒子自旋提供了调制与破坏起始相关的临界角动量的额外机制；洛伦兹破缺参数通过减少可及参数空间和临界电荷来抑制破坏；负宇宙学常数减小破坏区域，但对允许位形增强破坏幅度。结果表明自旋与洛伦兹对称性破缺共同调控轨道不稳定性与黑洞视界性质之间的相互作用。

English: In this paper, we investigate how the particle spin modulates chaos bound violations in Lorentz-violating black hole spacetimes within the framework of Bumblebee gravity. Using the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon formalism, we analyze the effects of spin-curvature coupling, Lorentz symmetry breaking, and the cosmological constant on the orbital instability in static spherically symmetric (A)dS black holes. We find that the particle spin provides an additional mechanism for modulating the critical angular momentum associated with the onset of violation. The Lorentz-violating parameter suppresses the violations by reducing the accessible parameter space and the critical charge. Meanwhile, a negative cosmological constant decreases the violation region but enhances the violation magnitude for allowed configurations. Our results demonstrate that the spin and Lorentz symmetry breaking jointly regulate the interplay between orbital instability and black hole horizon properties.

由各向异性源与流体动力学状态方程得到的正则黑洞

Regular Black Holes from Anisotropic Source with Hydrodynamic Equation of State

Hassan Firouzjahi · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文研究由各向异性能量动量张量作为源的正则黑洞解。球对称正则黑洞内部几何通常趋近 de Sitter 度规；作者将能量动量张量分解为各向同性和各向异性部分，并对压强采用流体动力学状态方程 P=P(ρ)，寻找球对称正则黑洞解。文中考虑多种 P(ρ) 形式，既能重现已知正则黑洞解，也给出新度规。结果表明 P(ρ) 在远距离趋于 0^+ 时具有一个根和一个极大值，因此微扰声速平方 c_s^2 在 P 达到极大值处变号，暗示可能存在流体动力学不稳定性。此外，对 c_s 施加速度上限会强烈限制模型参数，并排除能量密度指数衰减的模型。作者还建立了强能量条件被破坏的位置、P 的根以及 P 取极大值位置之间的相对位置等级关系。

English: We study regular black hole solutions sourced by an anisotropic energy momentum tensor. It is well known that the geometry of the interior of a spherically symmetric regular black hole approaches the dS metric. Having decomposed the energy momentum tensor into its isotropic and anisotropic components, we assume a hydrodynamic equation of state, $P= P(\rho)$, for the pressure, and look for spherically symmetric, regular black hole solutions. We consider different forms of $ P(\rho)$ which yield the previously known regular black hole solutions, as well as various new metrics. We show that the profile of $ P(\rho)$ has a root and a maximum as it approaches $0^+$ at large distances. Consequently, the square of the sound speed of perturbations, $c_s^2$, changes sign at the point where $P$ reaches its maximum, indicating a potential hydrodynamic instability. In addition, imposing the subluminal bound on $c_s$ puts strong constraints on the model parameters, excluding models in which the energy density has an exponential fall off. We establish a universal hierarchy among the relative positions at which the strong energy condition is violated, at which $P$ has its root, and at which $P$ attains its maximum.

一句话导读：用各向异性源和流体动力学状态方程构造正则黑洞解，并分析声速、能量条件与参数约束。

中文摘要：本文通过对近期报道的 Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson（KBR）解进行去磁化，构造了一个新的 Ricci 平坦度规。该度规是以参数 B 标记的 Kerr 度规的变形，使渐近 Kerr 区域变为具有南北极的规则纺锤形穹顶。尽管不存在渐近平坦区域，作者仍建立了黑洞热力学第一定律，并发现部分热力学关系与 Kerr 黑洞相同，仿佛常数 B 不存在。该 Ricci 平坦旋转度规可作为多种对 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 黑洞磁化方案的中性种子。

English: We construct a new Ricci-flat metric by demagnetizing the recently reported Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson (KBR) solution. The metric is a deformation of the Kerr metric characterized by a parameter $B$, so that the asymptotic Kerr becomes a regular dome of spindle shape with north and south poles. Despite lacking an asymptotically-flat region, we find that the first law of black hole thermodynamics can be established. Some thermodynamic relations are identical to those of the Kerr black hole, as if the constant $B$ is absent. Our Ricci-flat rotating metric serves a neutral seed for a variety of inequivalent schemes of magnetizing the Schwarzschild and Kerr black holes.

一句话导读：通过去磁化 KBR 构造了一个无渐近平坦区但满足黑洞热力学第一定律的新 Ricci 平坦旋转度规。

Gravitational waves from cosmic superstrings and gauge strings

Danny Marfatia, Ye-Ling Zhou · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ex, hep-th · v4 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们对宇宙规范弦网络与由多种弦类型组成的超弦网络所预期的引力波谱进行唯象比较。我们展示标度行为的破坏以及早期宇宙相对论自由度数目的演化如何影响引力波谱。我们给出适用于脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）和激光干涉仪所有相关频率的简析表达式。我们分析PTA最新数据并表明：超弦网络与NANOGrav的32 nHz数据一致，但除非弦耦合 g_s<0.2 或弦仅在高维空间约10%的体积中演化，否则在3σ水平上被3.2 nHz数据排除。我们还指出，规范弦网络虽被NANOGrav-15数据在3σ水平排除，却与EPTA和PPTA数据完全兼容。最后，我们研究PTA与激光干涉仪引力波信号之间的关联。

English: We perform a phenomenological comparison of the gravitational wave (GW) spectrum expected from cosmic gauge string networks and superstring networks comprised of multiple string types. We show how violations of scaling behavior and the evolution of the number of relativistic degrees of freedom in the early Universe affect the GW spectrum. We derive simple analytical expressions for the GW spectrum from superstrings and gauge strings that are valid for all frequencies relevant to pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) and laser interferometers. We analyze the latest data from PTAs and show that superstring networks are consistent with 32 nHz data from NANOGrav, but are excluded by 3.2 nHz data at $3\sigma$ unless the string coupling $g_s<0.2$ or the strings evolve in only about 10% of the volume of the higher-dimensional space. We also point out that while gauge string networks are excluded by NANOGrav-15 data at $3\sigma$, they are completely compatible with EPTA and PPTA data. Finally, we study correlations between GW signals at PTAs and laser interferometers.

一句话导读：比较宇宙规范弦与多类型超弦网络的引力波谱，并用脉冲星计时阵列数据约束弦耦合与高维空间演化体积。

中文摘要：正宇宙学常数的 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力是研究膨胀 de Sitter 宇宙如何从量子态涌现的玩具模型。其密度矩阵是满足 Wheeler-DeWitt 方程的双喇叭振幅的叠加。我们比较此类混合态对经典膨胀宇宙的预言与无边界波函数的相应预言。与全息一致、且半经典极限匹配 Schwarzian 边界涨落的双喇叭振幅，给出宇宙大小的平坦概率分布，与暴胀模型一致；这与无边界波函数预言的大宇宙被压低形成对比。

English: Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity with positive cosmological constant is a toy model to study the emergence of expanding de Sitter universes from a quantum state. Its density matrix is a superposition of double-trumpet amplitudes which are solutions of a Wheeler-DeWitt equation. We compare predictions of such mixed states for classical expanding universes with the corresponding predictions of no-boundary wavefunctions. Double-trumpet amplitudes consistent with holography, whose semiclassical limit matches the result from Schwarzian boundary fluctuations, lead to a flat probability distribution for the size of the universe, consistent with models of inflation. This is in contrast to the suppression of large universes predicted by no-boundary wave functions.

AdS/BCFT 中的多分纠缠几何

Multipartite Entanglement Geometry in AdS/BCFT

Debarshi Basu, Qiang Wen, Mingshuai Xu · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：多分纠缠度量探测的是无法仅由成对熵推断出的量子关联组织方式。我们研究在全息 BCFT 中物理边界如何重塑这种结构。世界尽头膜为多分纠缠打开新的相对同调通道，使连通的体纠缠网络可在不一定与普通 Ryu--Takayanagi 转变重合的尺度上重组和因子化。在静态 AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$ 中，这产生特征性的多分相层级，以及真正多熵对边界的非平凡依赖。在热场双态中，真正连通的网络反而可通过 Einstein--Rosen 桥支撑，导致不同于通常 Hartman--Maldacena 转变的增长、重连和饱和尺度。这些结果表明，多分纠缠不仅敏感于极值面面积，也敏感于有边界时体纠缠结构被允许如何连接、分裂和终止。

English: Multipartite entanglement measures probe how quantum correlations are organized beyond what can be inferred from pairwise entropies. We study how this structure is reshaped by a physical boundary in a holographic BCFT. The end-of-the-world brane opens new relative-homology channels for multipartite entanglement, allowing connected bulk webs to reorganize and factorize at scales that need not coincide with any ordinary Ryu--Takayanagi transition. In static AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$, this produces a characteristic hierarchy of multipartite phases and a nontrivial dependence of genuine multi-entropy on the boundary. In the thermofield-double state, genuinely connected webs can instead be supported through the Einstein--Rosen bridge, leading to growth, reconnection and saturation scales distinct from the usual Hartman--Maldacena transitions. These results show that multipartite entanglement is sensitive not only to extremal-surface areas but also to how bulk entanglement structures are allowed to join, split and terminate in the presence of a boundary.

一句话导读：在 AdS/BCFT 中，世界尽头膜与 ER 桥改变多分纠缠连通网的连接、分裂与终止，产生新的多分相和标度。

N=4 超对称杨-米尔斯中的表面缺陷：精确结果与全息 bootstrap

Surface defects in $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills: exact results and holographic bootstrap

Lorenzo Bianchi, Davide Bonomi, Maddalena Ferragatta, Valentina Forini · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们研究了在存在半BPS表面缺陷时，N=4 超对称杨-米尔斯理论中手征主算符的两点函数。该缺陷仅保持横向旋转与整体 U(1) R-对称性的对角组合，因此关联函数多依赖一个交比，并分解为具有确定角电荷的扇区。我们求解超共形 Ward 恒等式，并在所有扇区（包括对保持横向旋转的缺陷没有对应的带电扇区）构造体与缺陷超共形块。该解包含一个全纯扇区，我们通过将其映射到手征代数关联函数来非微扰地固定它。我们将此映射推广到破坏横向旋转的缺陷，其中需要对二维流代数的模式重新定义，并用它来固定带电扇区。随后我们利用缺陷色散关系，在大 N 强耦合领头阶重构维度二手征主算符的完整关联函数。在带电扇区中长多重态不存在，答案在 N 和耦合常数上被猜想为精确；将其在弱耦合展开，我们发现与已知结果完全一致。从这些关联函数中我们提取了无穷多新的缺陷 CFT 数据。最后，我们通过在旋转不变轨迹上的独立 Witten 图 bootstrap 复现了强耦合答案。

English: We study two-point functions of chiral primary operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills in the presence of a half-BPS surface defect. Such a defect preserves only the diagonal combination of transverse rotations and of a global U(1) R-symmetry, so that the correlator depends on one additional cross-ratio and splits into sectors of definite angular charge. We solve the superconformal Ward identities and construct the bulk and defect superconformal blocks in all sectors, including the charged ones, which have no analogue for defects preserving transverse rotations. The solution contains a holomorphic sector, which we fix non-perturbatively by mapping it to a chiral algebra correlator. We extend this map to defects breaking transverse rotations, where it requires a redefinition of the modes of the two-dimensional current algebra, and use it to fix the charged sectors as well. We then use the defect dispersion relation to reconstruct the full correlator of the dimension-two chiral primary at leading order at large N and strong coupling. In the charged sectors long multiplets are absent and the answer is conjecturally exact in both N and the coupling; expanding it at weak coupling, we find perfect agreement with known results. From these correlators we extract infinitely many new pieces of defect CFT data. Finally, we reproduce the strong-coupling answer by an independent Witten diagram bootstrap on the rotation-invariant locus.

一句话导读：利用超共形 Ward 恒等式、手征代数与缺陷色散关系，研究 N=4 SYM 半BPS表面缺陷中手征主算符两点函数的精确与全息 bootstrap 结果。

Alexander Gorsky, Elizaveta Kovalenko, Sergei Nechaev · hep-th, cond-mat.stat-mech · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们讨论KPZ普适类中的随机生长模型、DSSYK模型与低维膨胀引力之间的三重对偶。以TASEP为主要对象，将其识别为二维量子引力的强耦合极限。DSSYK哈密顿量与ASEP转移矩阵在相差一个加性常数下相同，并给出有限区间ASEP对应转移矩阵预解式的精确表达式。我们还提到累积量与交叉图（弦图对偶）的Tutte多项式T(1,q)的关系，从而表明所考虑模型与耦合引力的Q=0 Potts模型相关。进一步利用二维流形上离散和连续随机行走的不同版本来实现这些模型，这些随机行走参数化各理论的希尔伯特空间。将TASEP表示为堆的生长模型为强耦合引力提供新见解，暗示其可解释为涌现现象。发展了ASEP与q-TASEP模型及提供有用生长解释的堆模型之间的新对偶。

English: We discuss the triality between stochastic growth models in the KPZ universality class, the DSSYK model, and low dimensional dilaton gravity. The TASEP model, which will be our primary focus, is identified with the strong-coupling limit of two-dimensional quantum gravity. The Hamiltonian of DSSYK and the transfer matrix of ASEP coincide up to an additive constant, and we derive the exact expression for the resolvent of the corresponding transfer matrix in ASEP on a finite interval. We also mention the relation of cumulants with the Tutte polynomial $T(1,q)$ of the crossing graph dual to the chord diagram, which implies the relationship of the models considered with the $Q=0$ Potts model coupled with gravity. We further exploit the realization of all these models in terms of different versions of discrete and continuous random walks on two-dimensional manifolds, which parameterize the Hilbert spaces of the respective theories. The representation of TASEP as the growth model of heaps provides new insight into strong-coupling gravity, suggesting its interpretation as an emerging phenomenon. The new dualities between ASEP and q-TASEP models and heap models providing a useful growth interpretation have been developed.
