3d Lovelock gravity and the holographic c-theorem: Proof at all orders and resummation

Gokhan Alkac, Luis Guajardo, Hikmet Ozsahin · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们证明，三维Lovelock引力——由三维正则化Lovelock不变量得到的Horndeski理论——在任意耦合取值下、在所有阶数上都满足全息c定理。在畴壁解的minisuperspace中，Horndeski标量方程在每一阶都是全导数，这使我们考虑的流中标量导数被锁定为warp因子的导数，并允许将零能条件积分成单调c函数。所得真空的线性标量剖面破坏特殊共形变换，因此对偶理论是尺度不变但非共形的，中心荷定义为球面上在壳作用量对数发散项的系数。我们对Gauss-Bonnet情形精确计算，对完整塔渐近计算，发现它线性依赖于耦合，并与c函数的UV值匹配。由于所有结果仅通过两个生成函数依赖耦合，我们针对导致正则黑洞的耦合选择，以闭式形式给出重求和后的Lagrangian、c函数和中心荷，并根据真空上有效Newton常数的正性以及具有非平凡标量真空的唯一性对重求和理论分类。

English: We prove that 3d Lovelock gravity, the Horndeski theory obtained from the regularized Lovelock invariants in three dimensions, admits a holographic c-theorem at all orders and for arbitrary values of the couplings. In the minisuperspace of domain wall solutions, the equation of the Horndeski scalar is a total derivative at every order, which locks the derivative of the scalar to that of the warp factor along the flows we consider and allows the null energy condition to be integrated into a monotonic c-function. The linear scalar profile of the resulting vacuum breaks the special conformal transformations, so the dual theory is scale-invariant but not conformal, and the central charge is defined as the coefficient of the logarithmic divergence of the on-shell action on the sphere. We compute it exactly for the Gauss-Bonnet case and asymptotically for the full tower, and find that it is linear in the couplings and matches the UV value of the c-function. Since all results depend on the couplings only through two generating functions, we give the resummed Lagrangians, c-functions and central charges in closed form for the choices of couplings that lead to regular black holes, and classify the resummed theories by the positivity of the effective Newton constant on the vacuum and the uniqueness of the vacuum with a non-trivial scalar.

一句话导读：证明三维Lovelock/Horndeski引力在任意耦合与全阶下存在全息c定理，并给出c函数、中心荷及重求和形式的闭式结果。

相关度：medium — 属于AdS/CFT基础与经典高阶引力，涉及畴壁解与c定理；但与用户重点的全息超流超导、p波、多分量序参量等具体支线不直接重合。

纠缠熵的上同调方面：从信息论到非交换几何

Cohomological Aspects of Entanglement Entropy: From Information Theory to Noncommutative Geometry

R. C. Rashkov · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们建立了一个纠缠熵的上同调框架，统一信息论、算子代数和非交换几何。熵是信息上同调中的1-余循环；我们通过Hochschild和循环上同调将其推广到量子情形。对于von Neumann代数包含 N⊂M，具有忠实正规态w，允许循环分离向量，以及条件期望 E:M→N（其存在性由Takesaki定理等价于N的模不变性），我们在相对循环复形上构造纠缠复形作为transgression映射τ_w的像，其中A是M的稠密*-子代数，B=A∩N。主要结果将纠缠上同调识别为限制映射HC*(A)→HC*(B)的核，模去配对(A,B)长正合序列的连接同态d；当d=0时，识别是精确的。相对模余循环 u_t=(Dw:D(w|_N)∘E)_t 在E非w不变时生成显式纠缠类，Araki相对熵作为其无穷小生成元。该框架适用于不存在局域密度矩阵的III型von Neumann代数，并导出一个全息提议：H^1_ent的一个子空间猜想对偶于体纠缠楔的线性化模Hamiltonian扰动。我们在有限维、II_1型和III_1型例子中验证了构造。

English: We develop a cohomological framework for entanglement entropy that unifies information theory, operator algebras, and noncommutative geometry. Entropy is a 1-cocycle in information cohomology; we generalize this to the quantum setting via Hochschild and cyclic cohomology. For an inclusion of von Neumann algebras N contained in M with a faithful normal state w admitting a cyclic and separating vector, and a conditional expectation E: M -> N (whose existence is equivalent to modular invariance of N by Takesaki's theorem), we construct the entanglement complex as the image of the transgression map tau_w on the relative cyclic complex, where A is a dense *-subalgebra of M and B = A intersect N. Our main result identifies entanglement cohomology with the kernel of the restriction map HC*(A) -> HC*(B), up to the connecting homomorphism d of the long exact sequence of the pair (A,B); when d = 0, the identification is exact. The relative modular cocycle u_t = (Dw : D(w|_N) o E)_t generates explicit entanglement classes when E is not w-invariant, with the Araki relative entropy as its infinitesimal generator. The framework accommodates Type III von Neumann algebras, where no local density matrix exists, and leads to a holographic proposal: a subspace of H^1_ent is conjecturally dual to linearized modular Hamiltonian perturbations of the bulk entanglement wedge. We verify the construction in finite-dimensional, type II_1, and type III_1 examples.

一句话导读：用Hochschild/循环上同调刻画von Neumann代数包含的纠缠熵，并提出其与体纠缠楔模哈密顿量扰动的全息对应猜想。

相关度：low — 摘要核心是算子代数与上同调框架下的纠缠熵表述，仅在结尾提出全息对偶猜想；未涉及用户重点的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动等支线，故相关性低。

MacDowell-Mansouri σ-模型

MacDowell-Mansouri $\sigma$-model

Egor Pluzhnikov, Stanislav Alexeyev · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：标准的前几何机制可以重现 ΛCDM 模型，但缺乏暴胀的自然来源。我们提出一种机制，通过将 MacDowell-Mansouri 模型的李代数扩展为李代数胚，使标量耦合的拓扑项得以出现。这些项在有效弦作用量中通常被视为宇宙学暴胀的来源。在额外施加挠率约束后，该理论约化为属于 Horndeski 类的标量-张量理论，并重现满足现有约束（Planck/BICEP/Keck 和 GW170817）的暴胀动力学。

English: Standard pre-geometric mechanisms reproduce the $\Lambda$CDM model but lack a natural source for inflation. We propose a mechanism for the emergence of scalar-coupled topological terms by extending the Lie algebra of a MacDowell-Mansouri model to a Lie algebroid. These terms are commonly regarded as a source for cosmological inflation in effective string actions. With an additional constraint on torsion imposed, the theory reduces to a scalar-tensor theory belonging to the Horndeski class, and reproduces inflationary dynamics that meet existing constraints (Planck/BICEP/Keck and GW170817).

一句话导读：将 MacDowell-Mansouri 模型扩展为李代数胚以产生标量耦合拓扑项，并在挠率约束下得到可满足观测约束的 Horndeski 暴胀。

Quiver 理论的解耦极限与极端 C-度规的角谱

Decoupling Limit of Quiver Theories and the Angular Spectra of Extreme C-metrics

Peng Yang, Kilar Zhang · hep-th, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, hep-ph, math-ph, math.MP · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们研究极端带电 C-度规的角向本征值问题。从非极端角向方程的受约束五点 Fuchsian 描述出发，通过对偶四维 N=2、SU(2)×SU(2) 线性 quiver 规范理论中一个 hypermultiplet 的解耦，得到其极端极限。我们导出参数字典和重整化 Matone 关系，并通过显式坐标变换将物理极限 Q→M 与 quiver 解耦联系起来。正则端点条件给出代数量子化条件。由截断瞬子预势得到的本征值在近极端和较大加速度下与独立角谱进行检验。轴对称扇区恢复已知精确谱。

English: We investigate the angular eigenvalue problem of the extreme charged C-metric. Starting from a constrained five-point Fuchsian description of the non-extremal angular equation, we obtain its extreme limit by decoupling a hypermultiplet in the dual four-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=2$, $\mathrm{SU(2)}\times \mathrm{SU(2)}$ linear quiver gauge theory. We derive the parameter dictionary and renormalized Matone relations, and connect the physical limit $Q\to M$ to the quiver decoupling by an explicit coordinate transformation. Regular endpoint conditions give an algebraic quantization condition. Eigenvalues obtained from the truncated instanton prepotential are tested against independent angular spectra near extremality and at larger acceleration. The axisymmetric sector recovers the known exact spectrum.

一句话导读：研究极端带电 C-度规的角向本征值问题，并将其与 N=2 线性 quiver 规范理论的解耦极限及参数字典相对应。

中文摘要：尽管存在种种谜题、奥秘和疑团，基本粒子理论50年来没有改变。我们论证当前范式——Wilsonian量子场论——不足以解决这些难题，应被基于全息原理的新范式取代。我们展示一个简化但仍非常丰富的标准模型如何从平直空间极限下的de Sitter全息中涌现，并解释为什么宇宙学常数巨大量子修正的难题在全息范式中根本不会出现。

English: Despite riddles, mysteries, and enigmas the theory of elementary particles has not changed for 50 years. We argue that the current paradigm -- Wilsonian quantum field theory -- is inadequate for resolving the puzzles, and should be replaced by a new paradigm based on the Holographic Principle. We show how a simplified but still very rich standard model emerges from de Sitter holography in the flat-space limit and explain why the puzzle of huge quantum corrections to the cosmological constant simply does not occur in the holographic paradigm.

一句话导读：文章主张用de Sitter全息原理取代Wilsonian量子场论，并说明标准模型可在平直空间极限下从全息中涌现。

从费米子谱学习有效体场：应用于铜氧化物奇异金属的扩展幂律液体模型

Learning Effective Bulk Fields from Fermionic Spectra: Application to an Extended Power-Law Liquid Model for Cuprate Strange Metals

Hong-Zhi Xiao, Zhan-Zhi He, Zhuo-Yu Xian, Shao-Feng Wu · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, cond-mat.supr-con, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们发展了一个 Neural-ODE 框架，在静态平面黑洞拟设下，从边界费米子谱推断有效体度规函数和带电荷权重的规范势。受控基准测试可恢复 Einstein--Maxwell 与 Gubser--Rocha 模型的已知体轮廓。随后，我们使用由扩展幂律液体模型生成、并用角分辨光电子能谱测量校准参数的归一化相互作用自能目标，在半全息设定下检验所提出的铜氧化物奇异金属谱的几何解释。对于该应用，我们使用具有共形到 AdS2×R2 渐近背景中的无质量探针，并从守恒的径向 Dirac 流推导谱提取公式。我们识别出坐标/Weyl 冗余以及归一化逆问题中标度 Hawking 温度的退化。共形因子仍未被确定，因此体熵及相应的电子比热贡献需要独立输入。低温目标在所研究掺杂范围内拟合准确。然而，在高温测试中，当前拟设与优化搜索尚未给出一个精炼几何，能在保持频率对称性的同时准确复现热谱形状。这些结果可能指导铜氧化物半全息模型的进一步发展，该框架也可能应用于其他强关联电子系统。

English: We develop a Neural-ODE framework to infer effective bulk metric functions and the charge-weighted gauge potential from boundary fermionic spectra within a static, planar black-hole ansatz. Controlled benchmarks recover the known bulk profiles of the Einstein--Maxwell and Gubser--Rocha models. We then use normalized interaction self-energy targets generated from an extended power-law liquid model with parameters calibrated by angle-resolved photoemission measurements to test the proposed geometric explanation of cuprate strange-metal spectra in a semi-holographic setting. For this application, we use a massless probe in backgrounds with conformal-to-$\mathrm{AdS}_2\times\mathbb{R}^2$ asymptotics and derive a spectral extraction formula from the conserved radial Dirac flux. We identify coordinate/Weyl redundancy and a degeneracy in the scaled Hawking temperature of the normalized inverse problem. The conformal factor remains undetermined, so bulk entropy and the associated contribution to electronic specific heat require independent input. Low-temperature targets are fitted accurately across the studied doping range. In the high-temperature test, however, the present ansatz and optimization search have not yielded a refined geometry that accurately reproduces the thermal spectral shape while preserving frequency symmetry. These results may guide the further development of semi-holographic models for cuprates, and the framework may also find applications in other strongly correlated electron systems.

一句话导读：Neural-ODE 从边界费米谱反演全息体几何，并用 ARPES 校准的幂律液体模型检验铜氧化物奇异金属；低温成功、高温受限。

Ladislav Hlavat\'y, Petr Novotn\'y, Ivo Petr · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：最近给出的广泛4+4维Manin三元组列表可通过Poisson-Lie T-对偶性用于寻找超引力方程的新解。为获得这些解，我们从对应于半阿贝尔Manin三元组的Poisson-Lie群上的1+3维平坦背景出发。为应用Poisson-Lie T-对偶性，我们识别出构成同一Drinfeld double各种分解的Manin三元组。除了满足超引力方程的平坦背景和平面平行波外，对偶变换还产生带挠率、满足（广义）超引力方程的弯曲背景。许多Poisson-Lie变换可理解为齐次Yang-Baxter形变。特别值得关注的是导致广义超引力方程解的非幺模形变。

English: Extensive list of 4+4-dimensional Manin triples that was presented recently can be used to find new solutions of supergravity equations via Poisson-Lie T-plurality. To get the solutions we start with 1+3-dimensional flat backgrounds on Poisson-Lie groups corresponding to semi-Abelian Manin triples. For application of the Poisson-Lie T-plurality we identify Manin triples that form various decompositions of the same Drinfeld double. Beside flat backgrounds and plane-parallel waves solving supergravity equations, plurality transformation also produces curved backgrounds with torsion satisfying (generalized) supergravity equations. Many of the Poisson-Lie transformations can be understood as homogeneous Yang-Baxter deformations. Of special interest are the non-unimodular deformations leading to solutions of generalized supergravity equations.

一句话导读：利用八维Manin三元组和Poisson-Lie T-对偶性生成超引力方程的新背景，并联系Yang-Baxter形变。

跨所有真空扇区的有限-N BMN 指数

Finite-$N$ BMN index across all vacuum sectors

Chi-Ming Chang, Sarthak Duary, Kangning Liu · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们计算 BMN 矩阵量子力学在求和所有以配分标记的超对称真空扇区之后的有限-N Witten 指数。从每个扇区的幺正矩阵积分出发，我们将两种互补的求值方法用于 BMN 指数：其一是对称群特征标展开，它把每个固定逸度阶约化为有限组合和；其二是留数展开，其中贡献极点按有根树组织，并对多配分扇区作有色树推广。在可行时，直接积分以及从展开被积函数中提取常数项给出逐系数的独立检验。我们对 N≤9 的每个真空扇区进行了计算。在等逸度展开中，电荷 j∼N^2 附近的系数在真空扇区之间表现出显著抵消，这倾向于降低总指数熵的有效 N^2 系数。有限-N 数据还揭示出非平凡的扇区组织：在 j=N^2 附近，给出最大贡献的扇区随 N 改变，从小阶数的单配分扇区变为从 N=6 开始的双配分扇区。我们称这一现象为主导扇区切换。这些结果为把 BMN 指数用作受保护平面波黑洞扇区的诊断提供了定量有限-N 输入，并提示在受控的 type-IIA 区域可能存在一种 D2 修饰黑洞解释：其中 D0 黑洞扇区伴随宏观球面 D2 膜自由度，类似于 AdS_5×S^5 中的对偶修饰黑洞。

English: We compute the finite-$N$ Witten index of BMN matrix quantum mechanics after summing over all partition-labeled supersymmetric vacuum sectors. Starting from the unitary-matrix integral for each sector, we adapt two complementary evaluation methods to the BMN index: a symmetric-group character expansion, which reduces each fixed fugacity order to a finite combinatorial sum, and a residue expansion in which the contributing poles are organized by rooted trees, with a colored-tree generalization for multi-partition sectors. Where practical, direct integration and extraction of the constant term in the expanded integrand give independent coefficient-by-coefficient checks. We evaluate every vacuum sector for $N\leq 9$. In the equal-fugacity expansion, the coefficients near charges $j\sim N^2$ exhibit substantial cancellations between vacuum sectors, which tend to reduce the effective $N^2$ coefficient of the total index entropy. The finite-$N$ data also reveal a nontrivial sectoral organization: near $j=N^2$, the sector giving the largest contribution changes with $N$, from single-partition sectors at small rank to double-partition sectors starting at $N=6$. We call this phenomenon dominance switching. These results provide quantitative finite-$N$ input for using the BMN index as a diagnostic of protected plane-wave black-hole sectors and suggest in the controlled type-IIA regime a possible D2 dressed black-hole interpretation in which D0 black-hole sectors are accompanied by macroscopic spherical D2-brane degrees of freedom, analogous to dual dressed black holes in $AdS_5\times S^5$.

一句话导读：计算 BMN 矩阵量子力学有限-N Witten 指数并汇总所有真空扇区，发现高电荷区强抵消与主导扇区切换，为平面波黑洞扇区诊断提供定量输入。

弱耦合下 IKKT 模型中的量子时空与量子涨落

Quantum spacetime and quantum fluctuations in the IKKT model at weak coupling

Harold C. Steinacker · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文旨在澄清 IKKT 型矩阵模型中涌现结构的概念性问题。即使作用量不含可调参数，非平凡矩阵真空仍可获得有意义的耦合常数，以及两个不同的不确定度尺度：a) 矩阵背景的非对易尺度；b) 路径积分下矩阵量子涨落的尺度。针对 Moyal-Weyl 量子平面和协变量子时空两类原型矩阵背景估计了这些尺度。它们的相对重要性区分两个区域：1) 以半经典非对易几何解释的半经典区域；2) 通常以全息解释的深度量子区域。结果表明，在弱耦合区域，背景周围的量子涨落可忽略。这为先前关于合适真空中涌现 3+1 维半经典几何和（量子）引力的工作中的一个基本假设提供了依据。

English: This paper aims to clarify conceptual aspects of emergent structure in IKKT-type matrix models. Even without any adjustable parameters in the action, non-trivial matrix vacua do acquire a meaningful coupling constant, as well as two distinct uncertainty scales: a) the scale of noncommutativity of the matrix background, and b) the scale of quantum fluctuations of the matrices under the path integral. These scales are estimated for two prototypes of matrix backgrounds, known as Moyal-Weyl quantum plane and covariant quantum spacetime. Their relative importance separates two regimes: 1) the semi-classical regime interpreted in terms of semi-classical noncommutative geometry, and 2) the deep quantum regime usually interpreted in terms of holography. The quantum fluctuations around the background are shown to be negligible in the weak coupling regime. This justifies a basic assumption in previous work on the emergent 3+1-dimensional semi-classical geometry and (quantum) gravity in suitable vacua.

一句话导读：IKKT 矩阵模型中弱耦合下背景非对易尺度与量子涨落尺度分离，为涌现半经典几何/量子引力假设提供支撑。

含正则或幻影整体单极子的量子修正 AdS 黑洞的不可分性

The indivisibility of a quantum-corrected AdS black hole with phantom global monopoles

Tiantong Cheng, Hongbo Cheng · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们研究含两类整体单极子（正则或幻影）的量子修正 AdS 黑洞的不可分性，以揭示量子涨落、单极子因子和负宇宙学常数对黑洞演化的影响。我们重点关注这种黑洞是否会因热力学第二定律而分裂为两部分。我们分别推导并计算初始黑洞与分裂后各部分的熵，熵差与黑洞结构相关，包括量子引力振荡、整体单极子以及 AdS 环境的影响。结果发现，两类整体单极子都使黑洞保持完整而不分裂，因为熵差为负。显著的量子涨落会迫使熵差为正，因此当一个分裂后黑洞质量很小、另一个质量很大时，黑洞可能发生碎裂。AdS 半径会增大熵变化的总值，并使质量比中点附近的熵差变为正值，因此足够大的半径可能使孤立黑洞分裂成质量近似相等的两部分。

English: We study the indivisibility of a quantum-corrected AdS black hole involving two kinds of global monopoles, regular or phantom ones to declare the effects from the quantum fluctuation, monopole factors and the negative cosmological constant on the evolution of black holes. We focus our attention on the possibility that this kind of black holes break into their own two parts because of the second law of thermodynamics. We derive and calculate the entropies of the initial black hole and the broken parts respectively and the entropy difference relates to the black holes structure including the quantum-gravity oscillation, global monopoles and the influence from AdS environment. It is found that the two kinds of global monopoles both keep the black holes intact instead of splitting because the entropy difference is negative. The considerable quantum fluctuation compels the defference to be positive and the fragmentation of the black holes may happen in the case that the mass of one fragmented black hole is tiny and the other one's mass is huge. The AdS radius can increase the whole value of change in entropy and the difference near the midpoint of mass ratio will become positive, so the large enough radius may lead the isolated black hole to become two parts nearly equal in the mass.

一句话导读：该文通过比较熵差研究含正则或幻影整体单极子的量子修正 AdS 黑洞能否热力学分裂，发现单极子抑制分裂，而量子涨落和足够大的 AdS 半径可促成碎裂。

相关度：medium — 论文属于 AdS 黑洞热力学与引力热力学范畴，涉及整体单极子和熵差稳定性，与经典引力及相变/热力学支线有一定关联；但未使用 AdS/CFT 字典或全息方法，也未直接涉及全息超导、QNM 或探针膜等用户重点支线。

全息熵不等式的组合性质

Combinatorial properties of holographic entropy inequalities

Guglielmo Grimaldi, Matthew Headrick, Veronika E. Hubeny, Pavel Shteyner · hep-th, math.CO, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：全息熵不等式（HEI）是Ryu-Takayanagi全息纠缠熵满足的线性不等式，等价于加权图上的最小割函数满足的不等式。我们建立一个研究HEI的新组合框架，并用它证明若干共同性质，包括两个与majorization相关的性质，以及一个不等式成为HEI的充要条件。由此解决arXiv:2508.21823中的全部猜想，证明其中两个并反驳另外两个。特别地，我们证明任意superbalanced HEI的null reduction通过该文定义的majorization检验，从而为所有HEI在含时全息态中成立提供强有力的新证据。

English: A holographic entropy inequality (HEI) is a linear inequality obeyed by Ryu-Takayanagi holographic entanglement entropies, or equivalently by the minimum cut function on weighted graphs. We establish a new combinatorial framework for studying HEIs, and use it to prove several properties they share, including two majorization-related properties as well as a necessary and sufficient condition for an inequality to be an HEI. We thereby resolve all the conjectures presented in [arXiv:2508.21823], proving two of them and disproving the other two. In particular, we show that the null reduction of any superbalanced HEI passes the majorization test defined in [arXiv:2508.21823], thereby providing strong new evidence that all HEIs are obeyed in time-dependent holographic states.

一句话导读：建立全息熵不等式的组合框架，解决相关猜想并给出含时全息态中HEI成立的新证据。

相关度：low — 论文聚焦全息纠缠熵不等式的组合与majorization性质，属于形式化全息量子信息研究；未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或D3-D7探针膜等方向。

Differential Equations for Wilson Loops in ABJM Theory

Takao Suyama · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们推导出 ABJM 理论中 BPS Wilson 环的真空期望值与 't Hooft 耦合所满足的一组微分方程。它们是相应矩阵模型平面预解式的导数所定义代数曲线的 Picard-Fuchs 方程。通过其在正则奇点附近的局部解，可以重现弱耦合与强耦合行为。我们还得到一个递推关系，可用于确定任意表示下 BPS Wilson 环的平面真空期望值。

English: We derive a system of differential equations which are satisfied by the vevs of BPS Wilson loops and 't Hooft coupling of ABJM theory. They are Picard-Fuchs equations of an algebraic curve defined by the derivative of the planar resolvent of the corresponding matrix model. The weak and strong coupling behaviors can be reproduced by their local solutions around regular singularities. We also obtain a recursion relation which can be used to determine the planar vevs of BPS Wilson loops in arbitrary representations.

宇宙学 pole-skipping、冲击波与 de Sitter 视界的量子混沌动力学

Cosmological pole-skipping, shock waves and quantum chaotic dynamics of de Sitter horizons

Yongjun Ahn, Sa\v{s}o Grozdanov, Hyun-Sik Jeong, Juan F. Pedraza · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们对宇宙学时空中的标量、Maxwell 和引力波的 pole-skipping 进行了系统分析。具体而言，在空 de Sitter 空间和 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞几何中，我们定位了这些场的 pole-skipping 点塔，并表明它们对相应的体两点函数施加非平凡约束。聚焦引力声学通道，我们提取了刻画每个视界处假设的对偶多体量子混沌的 Lyapunov 指数和蝴蝶速度。这些混沌数据与引力冲击波计算的结果精确匹配，确认相关 pole-skipping 点编码了视界量子的高能散射。有趣的是，蝴蝶速度可能变为超光速或虚数，后者标志着混沌的空间调制传播。假设存在全息对偶，我们将结果翻译为场论语言，并提出对偶理论可分为两个纠缠扇区，分别捕捉黑洞和宇宙学视界自由度。我们的结果表明，黑洞扇区随着黑洞收缩而变得越来越非局域，而宇宙学视界扇区表现出与厄米性破缺相容的行为。最后，我们勾勒了由双标度 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (DSSYK) 型链的长程和非厄米形变构建的简单微观玩具模型，以实现这些特征，为未来探索提供具体平台。

English: We present a systematic analysis of pole-skipping for scalar, Maxwell, and gravitational waves in cosmological spacetimes. Specifically, working in empty de Sitter space and in Schwarzschild-de Sitter black hole geometries, we locate the tower of pole-skipping points of such fields and show that they impose nontrivial constraints on the corresponding bulk two-point functions. Focusing on the gravitational sound channel, we then extract the Lyapunov exponent and butterfly velocities that characterize hypothetical dual many-body quantum chaos at each horizon. These chaotic data precisely match the outcome of a gravitational shock wave calculation, confirming that the relevant pole-skipping points encode high-energy scattering of horizon quanta. Interestingly, the butterfly velocities can become superluminal or imaginary, with the latter signaling a spatially modulated propagation of chaos. Assuming that a holographic dual exists, we translate our results into field theory language and propose that the dual theory can be divided into two entangled sectors that capture the black hole and cosmological horizon degrees of freedom. Our results suggest that the black hole sector becomes increasingly nonlocal as the black hole shrinks and that the cosmological horizon sector exhibits behavior compatible with violations of Hermiticity. Finally, we outline simple microscopic toy models, built from long-range and non-Hermitian deformations of the Double Scaled Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (DSSYK)-type chains, that realize these features, providing a concrete arena for future exploration.

一句话导读：系统分析 de Sitter 与 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 视界的 pole-skipping，并用冲击波和 DSSYK 型玩具模型刻画视界量子混沌。

相关度：low — 论文属于全息量子混沌与 de Sitter 视界 pole-skipping 方向，未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM非线性演化、冷原子或 D3-D7/D3-D5 探针膜等具体支线。

Holographic free energy and integrated correlators of ${\cal N}=1^*$ theory

Nakwoo Kim, Hoseob Shin · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们考虑 ${\cal N}=4$、$D=4$ 超杨-米尔斯理论的第二积分关联函数，特别是那些可与 ${\cal N}=1^*$ 质量形变理论相联系的关联函数。我们给出超引力树图层面这些积分的解析推导，此前尚不可得。我们的结果与对偶超引力模型中 BPS 解研究得到的先前结果一致。

English: We consider the 2nd integrated correlators of ${\cal N}=4$, $D=4$ super Yang-Mills theory, especially those which can be associated with ${\cal N}=1^*$ mass-deformed theories. Brane expansions for anti-symmetric line operator index

Yosuke Imamura, Masato Inoue · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：基于反称表示中 Wilson 线算符的 D5-膜实现，我们为 I_{N,k} 提出膜展开公式；I_{N,k} 是由秩 k 反称表示线算符修饰的 N=4 U(N) SYM 的 Schur 指标。对于大 N 指标 I_{\infty,k}，我们提出双求和展开；对于有限 N 指标 I_{N,k}，我们提出四重求和展开。导致有限 k 和有限 N 修正的对象是终止于 D5-膜上的盘状 D3-膜。

English: Based on the D5-brane realization of Wilson line operators in anti-symmetric representations, we propose brane expansion formulas for $I_{N,k}$, the Schur index of ${\cal N}=4$ $U(N)$ SYM decorated by line operators in the anti-symmetric representation of rank $k$. For the large $N$ index $I_{\infty,k}$ we propose a double-sum expansion, and for finite $N$ index $I_{N,k}$ we propose a quadruple-sum expansion. Objects causing finite $k$ and finite $N$ corrections are disk D3-branes ending on the D5-brane.

一句话导读：用 D5-膜及端点在其上的 D3-膜给出反称表示线算符修饰的 N=4 U(N) SYM Schur 指标的膜展开公式。

轴子 RG 流与瞬子密度的全息动力学

Axion RG flows and the holographic dynamics of instanton densities

Yuta Hamada, Elias Kiritsis, Francesco Nitti, Lukas T. Witkowski · hep-th, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文在一般 Einstein-Axion-Dilaton 理论中研究轴子全息 RG 流解。非平凡的轴子剖面与相应瞬子密度算符的 θ 项非微扰跑动对偶。文章表明，非平凡轴子解与不平凡的全息红外共形不动点不相容；施加合适的轴子正则条件可唯一地选择红外几何。作者在渐近 UV 和 IR 区域解析求解，并说明这些区域中轴子反作用总是可忽略；轴子反作用可能在体时空中等区域变得重要。为联系轴子探针极限解，文章发展了系统的展开，并给出若干数值例子。结果表明，正则条件总意味着 UV 中轴子源参数有一个有限允许范围，这对应于大 N_c 极限下存在有限但很大数目的鞍点，并与轴子 swampland 猜想相吻合。

English: Axionic holographic RG flow solutions are studied in the context of general Einstein-Axion-Dilaton theories. A non-trivial axion profile is dual to the (non-perturbative) running of the $\theta$-term for the corresponding instanton density operator. It is shown that a non-trivial axion solution is incompatible with a non-trivial (holographic) IR conformal fixed point. Imposing a suitable axion regularity condition allows to select the IR geometry in a unique way. The solutions are found analytically in the asymptotic UV and IR regimes, and it is shown that in those regimes the axion backreaction is always negligible. The axion backreaction may become important in the intermediate region of the bulk. To make contact with the axion probe limit solutions, a systematic expansion of the solution is developed. Several concrete examples are worked out numerically. It is shown that the regularity condition always implies a finite allowed range for the axion source parameter in the UV. This translates into the existence of a finite (but large) number of saddle-points in the large $N_c$ limit. This ties in well with axion-swampland conjectures.

一句话导读：研究 Einstein-Axion-Dilaton 中轴子全息 RG 流，表明非平凡轴子剖面与红外 CFT 不相容，正则条件唯一选择红外几何并限制 UV 轴子源。

Palatini Kalb-Ramond 引力中一个黑洞解的引力指纹

Gravitational fingerprints of a black hole solution in Palatini Kalb-Ramond gravity

Carlos F. S. Pereira, Ara\'ujo Filho, Marcos V. de S. Silva, N. Heidari · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：本文研究宇宙学常数为零的 Palatini Kalb-Ramond 引力中静态黑洞周围的粒子运动、光学可观测量和线性波传播。分析区分守恒质量 M 与轨道质量 \bar{M}=M/\rho，并分离出径向形变 \sigma^2=1-q/2，其中 q=\ell_2/(1-\ell_1)。在固定 \bar{M} 时，光子球、临界碰撞参数和最内稳定圆轨道保持 Schwarzschild 值。对于相同的面积释放和粒子半径，径向频率比也保持 Schwarzschild 轮廓，而固有距离、下落时间和累积轨道角依赖 \sigma。对于径向下落，潮汐本征值获得 \sigma^{-2} 因子，光子轨道的不稳定指数按 \sigma^{-1} 缩放。此外，我们考察弱场和强场区域的光偏折，并显式考虑锥形渐近。与 Sgr A* 和 M87* 的阴影比较显示，在固定轨道质量和面积距离时存在耦合简并。标量、电磁和无质量 Dirac 扰动探测物理度规，而具有 \delta B_{\mu\nu}=0 的均匀轴向引力扇区允许精确的 Schwarzschild 谱映射。在该扇区中，固定 \bar{M} 时振荡率和衰减率均按 \sigma^{-1} 缩放。对于所报告的基本模，三阶 WKB 估计与从时间演化提取的频率在 0.7% 以内一致。

English: We investigate particle motion, optical observables, and linear wave propagation around a static black hole in Palatini Kalb Ramond gravity with a vanishing cosmological constant. The analysis distinguishes the conserved mass $M$ from the orbital mass $\bar{M}=M/\rho$ and isolates the radial deformation $\sigma^2=1-q/2$, where $q=\ell_2/(1-\ell_1)$. At fixed $\bar{M}$, the photon sphere, critical impact parameter, and innermost stable circular orbit retain their Schwarzschild values. Radial frequency ratios also preserve their Schwarzschild profiles for the same areal release and particle radii, while proper distances, infall times, and accumulated orbital angles depend on $\sigma$. For radial fall, the tidal eigenvalues acquire a factor $\sigma^{-2}$, and the instability exponent of the photon orbit scales as $\sigma^{-1}$. In addition, we examine light deflection in the weak and strong regimes with an explicit account of the conical asymptotics. The shadow comparison with Sgr A* and M87* exhibits a coupling degeneracy when the orbital mass and areal distance are set. Scalar, electromagnetic, and massless Dirac perturbations probe the physical metric, whereas a homogeneous axial gravitational sector with $\delta B_{\mu\nu}=0$ admits an exact Schwarzschild spectral map. In this sector, both oscillation and attenuation rates scale as $\sigma^{-1}$ at fixed $\bar{M}$. Third order WKB estimates agree with frequencies extracted from time evolution to within $0.7\%$ for the reported fundamental modes.

一句话导读：研究 Palatini Kalb-Ramond 黑洞的粒子运动、光学观测量与线性扰动/QNM，并分析径向形变参数的影响。

一类具有标量毛发的新型旋转黑洞解

A new class of rotating black hole solutions endowed with a scalar hair

Hugo Candan, Philippe Grandclement · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们给出新的带毛稳态轴对称黑洞解。这些解属于 Horndeski 标量-张量理论的一个子类，其中没有与曲率的非最小耦合。完整的旋转解利用基于谱方法的 Kadath 库数值获得。度规不依赖显式拟设，而是使用一组数值坐标。所得黑洞一般不同于 Kerr 黑洞，并依赖于一个来自标量场线性时间依赖的新独立参数，即初级毛发。这些解与 Kerr 黑洞一样具有 Killing 视界，但不是圆对称的，并且破坏黑洞热力学的第零定律。

English: We present new hairy stationary and axisymmetric black hole solutions. These solutions belong to a subclass of Horndeski scalar-tensor theories, in which there is no non-minimal coupling to curvature. The full rotating solutions are obtained numerically using the Kadath library based on spectral methods. The metric does not rely on an explicit ansatz but rather on the use of a set of numerical coordinates. Black holes obtained differ from Kerr in general, and depend on a new independent parameter, a primary hair, coming from a linear time dependence in the scalar field. These solutions admit a Killing horizon like the Kerr black hole, but are non-circular, and break the zeroth law of black hole thermodynamics.

一句话导读：在无曲率非最小耦合的 Horndeski 理论中数值构造出非圆对称、破坏黑洞热力学第零定律的带毛旋转黑洞解。

局域源产生的宇宙学扰动：规范不变多极理论

Cosmological perturbations from localized sources: a gauge-invariant multipolar theory

Geoffrey Comp\`ere, Sk Jahanur Hoque · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们在空间平坦、具有任意光滑膨胀历史的Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker宇宙中，从第一性原理出发描述局域源的线性化引力场。该构造由给定的源应力和宇宙学平稳的过去场确定完整的推迟度规以及周围宇宙流体的诱导扰动。它包含所有多极阶，并计入曲率尾效应，使场依赖于源在光锥内的过去历史。我们推广Blanchet-Damour多极形式，识别出规范不变的质量多极和电流多极，以及一个决定独立标量响应的正则宇宙流体多极。该响应在Minkowski时空和纯de Sitter时空中消失，尽管de Sitter中曲率尾仍然存在。规范不变多极直接在位置空间中求得，从而给出外部描述，而无需通常标量-矢量-张量分解所要求的穿过源内部的非局域空间投影。我们还将正则多极度规与宇宙学扰动理论的标准变量联系起来。该推迟构造既不需要慢速近似，也不需要几何光学近似。我们通过将缓慢变化的亚哈勃尺度延展源的矩截断到指定笛卡尔多极阶来定义有效多极源，并恢复de Sitter时空中先前的四极和八极模型。我们恢复已知的Minkowski和de Sitter多极场，并给出包含辐射的LambdaCDM模型中引力传播的解析表示。

English: We develop a first-principles description of the linearized gravitational field of localized sources in spatially flat Friedmann-Lema\^{\i}tre-Robertson-Walker universes with arbitrary smooth expansion histories. The construction determines the complete retarded metric and the induced perturbation of the surrounding cosmic fluid from prescribed source stresses and a cosmologically stationary past field. It includes all multipole orders and accounts for curvature tails, through which the field depends on the source's past history inside the light cone. Generalizing the Blanchet-Damour multipolar formalism, we identify gauge-invariant mass and current moments together with a canonical cosmic fluid moment that determines an independent scalar response. This response vanishes in Minkowski and pure de Sitter spacetime, although curvature tails persist in de Sitter. The gauge-invariant multipoles are obtained directly in position space. This gives an exterior description without the nonlocal spatial projection through the source interior required by the usual scalar-vector-tensor decomposition. We also relate the canonical multipole metric to the standard variables of cosmological perturbation theory. The retarded construction requires neither a slow-motion nor a geometric-optics approximation. We define effective multipolar sources by truncating the moments of slowly varying sub-Hubble extended sources at a prescribed Cartesian multipole order, recovering the earlier quadrupolar and octupolar models in de Sitter spacetime. We recover the known Minkowski and de Sitter multipolar fields and obtain an analytical representation for gravitational propagation in the $\Lambda$CDM model including radiation.

中文摘要：五维Kerr-(A)dS黑洞中测地线运动的Hamilton-Jacobi方程在Boyer-Lindquist坐标下可分离，但由此得到的一阶系统此前只能依据径向和极角多项式的实根情形逐例积分。我们给出闭式通解。在无量纲变量下两个多项式均为四次，Biermann-Weierstrass定理由此将径向和极角坐标写成一对显式实公式，以轨道上任意点而非转向点为参数，且对类时和类光测地线以及任意根结构均适用。时间坐标和两个方位角由求积给出，且仅化为第三类椭圆积分，仿射参数再需一个同类积分。文中还修正了已发表的逆度规和径向势。

English: The Hamilton-Jacobi equation for geodesic motion in the five-dimensional Kerr-(A)dS black hole separates in Boyer-Lindquist coordinates, but the resulting first-order system has so far been integrated case by case, according to the real roots of the radial and the polar polynomial. We give the general solution in closed form. In dimensionless variables both polynomials are quartic, and a theorem of Biermann and Weierstrass then yields the radial and the polar coordinate as one pair of manifestly real formulas, parametrized by an arbitrary point of the orbit rather than by a turning point, and valid for timelike and null geodesics alike whatever the root structure. The time coordinate and the two azimuthal angles follow by quadratures that reduce to elliptic integrals of the third kind alone, and the affine parameter by one more of the same type. Along the way we correct the inverse metric and the radial potential as published.

English: We apply gravitational path integral factorization to provide a semiclassical interpretation of generalized black hole free energy landscapes at fixed external temperature and angular velocities. English: Grey-body factors describe the frequency-dependent transmission of fields through the effective potential generated by a black hole or another compact object. We also review methods for their computation and survey recent developments, including the correspondence between grey-body factors and quasinormal modes, their stability under deformations of the effective potential, wormhole transmission and superradiance, and their behavior in modified theories of gravity. English: We study holographic $U(1)$ charge transport using a probe Maxwell field in a five-dimensional Gauss-Bonnet-AdS black-brane background. To first order in the Gauss-Bonnet coupling, the leading diffusion constant remains unchanged in our normalization, while its frequency dependence and the electric conductivity receive nontrivial corrections. The deformation also generates a nonvanishing leading magnetic conductivity. Beyond the hydrodynamic regime, it modifies the transport profiles while preserving the damped behaviour of the diffusion function. The corresponding memory kernel vanishes at negative times, supporting a retarded constitutive response.

English: Finite boundary drives ending at the same charge density can select different relaxation channels. Calculated from the low-order equations alone, this total coefficient predicts the compensating pulse. Full nonlinear evolution confirms the reduction from $O(\epsilon^3)$ to $O(\epsilon^5)$ in the source amplitude $\epsilon$, with approximately 600-fold suppression for the representative protocol at $\epsilon=0.05$. Fully tuned two- and three-pulse preparations suppress one and two slow modes, respectively, within numerical resolution. English: We extend the holographic test of entanglement cohomology from $d=2$ to higher-dimensional conformal field theories. 中文摘要：我们在固定角动量和电荷下研究四维 Kerr-Newman-AdS 黑洞的超临界交叉。由精确焓出发，我们证明在整个电荷-旋转族中物理临界点的唯一性以及四阶 Landau 系数为正，并将无电荷 Kerr-AdS 端点置于单独的标度变量中处理。精确的四次约化确定了整个亚临界区域内的共存熵与潜热。在临界之上，两个物理旋节线继续以复共轭对形式存在；其实温度投影定义了一条 Widom 型线，改变电荷-旋转比可将这些线组装成一张交叉面。Landau 尖点将虚熵和温度固定为随偏离临界压力的平方根与三二分之三次方标度。投影折叠与局域热容脊共享一条临界切线；我们导出它们领先的二次温度分离，并证明在临界附近该脊位于更高温度。精确端点解与数值延拓检验了这些预言。尖点指数对该族是共同的，而交叉温度依赖于用来定义它的热力学判据。

English: We study supercritical crossovers in four-dimensional Kerr-Newman-AdS black holes at fixed angular momentum and charge. An exact quartic reduction determines the coexistence entropies and latent heat throughout the subcritical regime. Above criticality, the two physical spinodals continue as a complex conjugate pair. Their real temperature projection defines a Widom-type line, and varying the charge-rotation ratio assembles these lines into a crossover surface. The Landau cusp fixes the imaginary entropy and temperature to scale with the square root and three-halves powers of the pressure displacement from criticality. The projected fold and the local heat capacity ridge share a critical tangent. We derive their leading quadratic temperature separation and prove that the ridge lies at a higher temperature near criticality. Exact endpoint solutions and numerical continuation check these predictions. The cusp exponents are common to the family, while the crossover temperature depends on the thermodynamic criterion used to define it.

Every Schur class is a normal polynomial in their components and derivatives, even when its gauge-theory representative involves fermions and arbitrarily many derivatives. This supplies a uniform set of local inputs for meromorphic operator products, bounds protected state multiplicities before cancellations in an index, and gives an algebraic account of the finite-rank reorganization of protected trace operators.

中文摘要：我们观察到 d≥2 维大 N 共形场论中一个看似普适的行为：单迹高自旋能隙满足参数化上界 Δ_gap ≲ (δc)^{1/d}，其中 δc 是相邻理论之间的中心荷增量。该上界的起源通过一种推广的膜图像启发式解释，这些膜在理论空间中连接不同共形点。为寻求更精确的框架，作者提出“CFT 族”这一核心概念，并借鉴数论中 L-函数族的思路给出工作定义，进而表述族层面的能隙上界。在全息解释下，该上界适用于 AdS_{d+1} 真空族时，可排除 Planck 尺度分离、约束额外维的大小与数目，并解释弦/M 理论中的简单标度模式；它也说明了为何所有已知的大 N 矢量模型都具有有界能隙。

English: We observe an apparently universal behavior in large $N$ conformal field theory (CFT) in $d\geq 2$ dimensions: the single-trace, higher-spin gap obeys the parametric bound $\Delta_{\rm gap} \lesssim (\delta c)^{1/d}$, where $\delta c$ is the central charge increment between successive theories. The origin of this bound is explained heuristically, using a generalized notion of branes that interpolate between conformal points in theory space. Seeking a more precise framework for this picture leads to the central concept of families of CFTs, which tacitly underlies various features and puzzles of AdS/CFT. We develop a working definition of families, with inspiration from families of $L$-functions in number theory, and formulate a family-level version of the gap bound. Interpreted holographically for families of AdS$_{d+1}$ vacua, this bound, when applicable, rules out Planckian scale separation, constrains the size and number of extra dimensions, and explains simple scaling patterns in string/M-theory. It also accounts for why all known large $N$ vector models have a bounded gap.

来自杨-米尔斯瞬子的引力柴郡效应

Gravitational Cheshire effect from Yang-Mills instantons

Borja Diez · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们证明，四维杨-米尔斯瞬子的维数约化会自然产生三维中的非平凡物质位形，并表现出一种不寻常的引力屏蔽机制。从欧几里得杨-米尔斯理论出发，我们沿由瞬子背景的 U(1) 等距所生成的紧致方向约化（反）自对偶规范位形。在此约化下，规范联络分解为三维杨-米尔斯场与伴随希格斯场，而度规照常给出伸缩子与阿贝尔规范联络。对于 Taub-NUT 背景上的瞬子，约化后的场组织成两对相互屏蔽的配对：阿贝尔部分的背反作用在内部抵消，非阿贝尔部分也独立发生同样情况。因此，全部物质内容在平直三维空间上支持一个复合 stealth 位形。相比之下，Eguchi-Hanson 背景上瞬子的维数约化给出一个非阿贝尔物质部分，其引力背反作用抵消，而阿贝尔部分仍具有引力活性，因而使三维背景几何发生形变。这些例子揭示了四维（反）自对偶性与三维 BPS 型关系之间的直接联系，并说明在四维中引力不可见的瞬子部分如何在维数约化后降为完全复合的 stealth 位形或部分 stealth 的物质位形。

English: We show that the dimensional reduction of four-dimensional Yang-Mills instantons naturally gives rise to nontrivial matter configurations in three dimensions exhibiting an unusual mechanism of gravitational screening. Starting from Euclidean Yang-Mills theory, we reduce (anti-)self-dual gauge configurations along a compact direction generated by a $U(1)$ isometry of the instanton background. Under this reduction, the gauge connection decomposes into a three-dimensional Yang-Mills field and an adjoint Higgs field, while the metric gives rise, as usual, to a dilaton and an Abelian gauge connection. For instantons on the Taub-NUT background, the reduced fields organize themselves into two mutually screening pairs: the backreaction of the Abelian sector cancels internally, and the same occurs independently in the non-Abelian sector. As a result, the full matter content supports a composite stealth configuration on flat three-dimensional space. By contrast, the dimensional reduction of instantons on the Eguchi-Hanson background yields a non-Abelian matter sector whose gravitational backreaction cancels, while the Abelian sector remains gravitationally active and therefore deforms the three-dimensional background geometry. These examples reveal a direct connection between four-dimensional (anti-)self-duality and three-dimensional BPS-type relations, and illustrate how instantonic sectors that are gravitationally invisible in four dimensions can descend into either fully composite stealth configurations or partially stealth matter configurations after dimensional reduction.

一句话导读：四维杨-米尔斯瞬子经维数约化可在三维产生完全或部分引力 stealth 的物质位形，展示引力柴郡效应。

在非自旋流形上包裹 M5 膜：Spin^h 结构与 AdS7 黑洞

Wrapping M5-branes on a non-spin manifold: Spin$^h$ structures and AdS$_7$ black holes

Okan G\"unel, Cameron Gibson, C. N. Pope · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们构造了七维最大规范超引力中形式为 AdS2×M5 的解，其中 M5 是五维 Wu 流形 SU(3)/SO(3)。该解是超对称的，尽管 Wu 流形既不允许 spin 结构也不允许 spin^c 结构；它允许的是 spin^h 结构：普通旋量因和乐中的负号而定义不良，但该负号由旋量携带 SO(3) Yang-Mills 荷、处于 SO(3) 的 SU(2) 双覆盖的半整数同位旋表示所产生的另一个负号补偿。我们展示如何将该位形提升为 D=11 超引力中 AdS2×M9 的解，其中 M9 是 Wu 流形的单位切丛；讨论 M9 的几何与拓扑，并从十一维角度研究超对称。我们将七维解扩展为黑洞，并讨论其全息解释及 UV 到 IR 流的一些方面。我们还重新审视此前已知的 AdS2×H3×H2 解及其 UV 到 IR 流，表明该流方程事实上允许精确解。此外，我们详细讨论 AdS2×S5 解到 D=11 的提升，展示其内部空间 M9（S^5 的单位切丛）的性质与本文主要讨论的 Wu 流形例子之间的异同。我们还构造 Wu 流形解的非紧对偶，其中 M5 取为 SL(3,R)/SO(3)。

English: We construct a solution of seven-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity of the form AdS$_2\times M_5$, where $M_5$ is the five-dimensional Wu manifold $SU(3)/SO(3)$. The solution is supersymmetric, despite the fact that the Wu manifold admits neither a spin structure nor a spin$^c$ structure. Rather, it admits a spin$^h$ structure, wherein the ill-definedness of ordinary spinors due to a minus sign in their holonomy is compensated by a further minus sign arising through the spinors carrying $SO(3)$ Yang-Mills charge, in a half-integer isospin representation of the $SU(2)$ double cover of the $SO(3)$. We show how the configuration can be lifted to a solution of $D=11$ supergravity of the form AdS$_2\times M_9$, where $M_9$ is the unit tangent bundle of the Wu manifold. We discuss the geometry and topology of $M_9$, and study the supersymmetry from the eleven-dimensional standpoint. We extend the seven-dimensional solution to a black hole, and discuss some aspects of its holographic interpretation and the UV to IR flow. We revisit a previously-known AdS$_2\times H^3\times H^2$ solution, and its UV to IR flow, showing that the flow equations in fact admit of an exact solution. Additionally, we give a detailed discussion of the lift of the AdS$_2\times S^5$ solution to $D=11$, exhibiting similarities and differences between the properties of its internal space $M_9$ (the unit tangent bundle of $S^5$) and the Wu manifold example of our main discussion. We also construct the non-compact dual of the Wu manifold solution, where $M_5$ is taken to be $SL(3,\mathbb R)/SO(3)$.

一句话导读：构造了七维规范超引力中 AdS2×Wu 流形的超对称解并提升到 D=11，讨论其黑洞扩展与全息解释。

四阶后闵可夫斯基阶的角动量损失

Angular Momentum Loss at Fourth Post-Minkowskian Order

Alessandro Georgoudis, Carlo Heissenberg, Gustav Mogull, Rodolfo Russo · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-20

中文摘要：我们计算了两个非自旋点状物体引力散射在 O(G^4) 阶的总角动量损失。方法结合了振幅方法与世界线方法：从两份引力波形的乘积导出被积函数，其中大质量线上的割来自世界线；再将两份拷贝粘合，并用逆向幺正性以振幅思路计算相空间积分。我们分别得到辐射角动量与静态贡献；在该阶，静态贡献完全由初始剪切和线性记忆决定。合并两项后，我们给出角动量损失以及质量偶极损失红外有限部分的相对论表达式，并在低速极限下与文献结果一致。我们还利用该结果导出 O(G^5) 且含一阶自力修正的保守偏转角。

English: We calculate the total loss of angular momentum for a gravitational scattering of two non-spinning point-like objects at $\mathcal{O}(G^4)$. Our methodology combines use of both amplitudes and worldline-based methods. We derive the integrand from two copies of the gravitational waveform with cuts on massive lines arising naturally from the worldline. We then glue these two copies and evaluate the resulting phase-space integrals using reverse unitarity, in the amplitudes spirit. We obtain separately the radiated angular momentum and the static contribution that, at this order, is entirely determined by the initial shear and the linear memory. Combining these two terms, we derive relativistic expressions for the angular momentum loss and for the infrared-finite component of the mass dipole loss, which in the low-velocity limit match results available in the literature. We also use this result to derive the conservative deflection angle at $\mathcal{O}(G^5)$ and first self-force order.

一句话导读：用振幅与世界线方法计算 O(G^4) 引力散射角动量损失，并导出 O(G^5) 保守偏转角。

黑洞磁层的电阻性对齐

Resistive alignment of a black-hole magnetosphere

Ruben Lier, Oliver Porth · astro-ph.HE, hep-th, physics.plasm-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：近期数值模拟显示，黑洞磁层会迅速演化至磁轴与自旋轴对齐，但其物理起源仍不清楚。我们在电阻性相对论磁流体力学框架下建立该对齐的解析理论。以慢旋转的 Blandford-Znajek 单极子解作为外部磁场，将感应方程约化为电流片倾角的弛豫方程。分析表明，对齐源于 Blandford-Znajek 解中的二阶自旋效应与显式电阻耗散的共同作用。我们用多个自旋和电阻率的电阻性 GRMHD 模拟检验该预言，并将测得的晚期长期衰减与解析预言比较。因此，该对齐时标携带了结合等离子体耗散与时空旋转的独特特征。

English: Recent numerical simulations have shown that black-hole magnetospheres evolve rapidly toward alignment between the magnetic axis and spin axis but the physical origin of this process has remained unclear. We develop an analytic theory of this alignment within resistive relativistic magnetohydrodynamics. Taking the slow-spin Blandford-Znajek monopole solution as the exterior magnetic field, we reduce the induction equation to a relaxation equation for the current-sheet inclination angle. Our analysis shows that alignment results from second-order spin effects in the Blandford-Znajek solution combined with explicit resistive dissipation. We test this prediction using resistive-GRMHD simulations at several spins and resistivities and compare the measured late-time secular decay with the analytic prediction. This alignment timescale hence carries a unique signature which combines plasma dissipation with spacetime rotation.

Vacuum stability in Geometric Trinity of Gravity

Vincenzo Branchina, Salvatore Capozziello, Filippo Contino, Carmen Ferrara · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们研究广义相对论、其远平行等价表述和对称远平行等价表述之间的经典等价性是否在半经典领头阶延伸到假真空衰变。对于最小耦合引力的实标量场，我们比较决定衰变率指数抑制的隧穿指数 B=S_b-S_fv 与欧几里得反弹作用量 S_b 和假真空作用量 S_fv。三种表述给出相同的 O(4) 对称 Coleman-De Luccia 反弹，但联系它们作用量的边界项可能对 B 有贡献。我们显式计算了正则原点 r=0 和渐近端点 r→∞ 处的挠率与非度规性边界贡献。对于反弹与假真空边界数据一致匹配的正则位形，这些贡献在 TEGR 和 STEGR 中均消失。因此得到 B_GR=B_TEGR=B_STEGR，表明在所考虑的位形和边界条件类别内，三种表述预言相同的半经典领头阶假真空衰变抑制。

English: We investigate whether the classical equivalence of general relativity, its teleparallel equivalent, and its symmetric teleparallel equivalent extends to false-vacuum decay at leading semiclassical order. For a real scalar field minimally coupled to gravity, we compare the tunnelling exponent $B=S_{\rm b}-S_{\rm fv}$, which determines the exponential suppression of the decay rate, $\Gamma\sim e^{-B}$, with the Euclidean bounce, $S_{\rm b}$, and false-vacuum actions, $S_{\rm fv}$. The three formulations admit the same $O(4)$-symmetric Coleman-De Luccia bounce, but the boundary terms relating their actions can contribute to $B$. We explicitly evaluate the torsion and non-metricity boundary contributions at the regular origin, $r=0$, and at the asymptotic endpoint, $r\to\infty$. For regular configurations with consistently matched bounce and false-vacuum boundary data, these contributions vanish in both TEGR and STEGR. We therefore obtain $B_{\rm GR}=B_{\rm TEGR}=B_{\rm STEGR}$, establishing that the three formulations predict the same leading semiclassical suppression of false-vacuum decay within the class of configurations and boundary conditions considered.

一句话导读：在 GR、TEGR 与 STEGR 中比较 Coleman-De Luccia 反弹，表明边界项不改变领头半经典假真空衰变指数。

非广延视界熵与拓扑校准的热力学引力

Thermodynamic Gravity with Non-Extensive Horizon Entropy and Topological Calibration

Marco Figliolia, Petr Jizba, Gaetano Lambiase · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：论文重新审视Jacobson从视界热力学推导引力的框架，针对广义非广延视界熵S(A)建立一致描述。把S(A)视为进入热力学本构关系的粗粒化熵后，在局部Rindler楔构造中只有参考面积A_*处的局部斜率影响宏观动力学；Clausius关系被改写为固定Unruh温度下Massieu泛函的平稳条件，熵斜率s0控制有效引力耦合，线性熵恢复Einstein方程且G_eff=1/(4s0)。作为独立检验，标量响应扩展加内部熵产生可重现f(R)引力场方程。文章还采用幂律熵S(A)=η(A/4G)^δ，并引入基于Gauss-Bonnet定理的拓扑校准原则以消除粗粒化尺度歧义，得到由Euler示性数控制的拓扑相关有效耦合，并讨论对广延性的偏离及可能的宇宙学观测效应。

English: We revisit Jacobson's thermodynamic derivation of gravity for generalized, non-extensive horizon entropies and develop a consistent framework in which modified gravitational dynamics emerge from horizon thermodynamics. By interpreting $S(A)$ as a coarse-grained entropy entering the thermodynamic constitutive relation, we show that only its local slope at a reference area $A_*$ contributes to macroscopic dynamics within a local Rindler-wedge construction. In this setting, the Clausius relation is reformulated as a stationarity condition for a Massieu functional at fixed Unruh temperature, allowing the entropy slope $s_0=(dS/dA)|_{A_*}$ to be identified as the parameter controlling the effective gravitational coupling. For entropy linear in area, Einstein's equations are recovered with $G_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/(4s_0)$. As a separate consistency check, we demonstrate that a scalar-response extension of the horizon entropy density, supplemented by internal entropy production, correctly reproduces the field equations of $f(R)$ gravity. Motivated by group-entropic arguments and generalized thermodynamics, we adopt a power-law entropy $S(A)=\eta(A/4G)^{\delta}$ and study its implications across scales. To remove the ambiguity in the coarse-graining scale, we introduce a Topological Calibration Principle linking the reference area to intrinsic geometric data through the Gauss-Bonnet theorem. For compact cross-sections admitted by the chosen theory or boundary conditions, this yields a topology-dependent effective coupling governed by the Euler characteristic. Consistency requirements constrain deviations from extensivity and generate scale-dependent modifications with potentially observable cosmological signatures. The resulting framework provides a systematic setting for testing non-extensive horizon thermodynamics and its phenomenological implications.

一句话导读：从非广延视界熵的局部斜率出发重构热力学引力，并用Gauss-Bonnet拓扑校准得到拓扑相关的有效引力耦合。

暗物质晕中极端质量比旋进引力波中的混沌印记

Chaotic Imprints in Gravitational Waves from Extreme-Mass-Ratio-Inspirals Embedded in Dark Matter Halo

Surajit Das, Surojit Dalui, Bum-Hoon Lee, Yi-Fu Cai · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th, nlin.CD · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们研究嵌于Dehnen型暗物质晕中的超大质量Schwarzschild类黑洞周围，一个受外部谐振子势约束的恒星级天体所构成极端质量比旋进构型中，引力波携带的混沌印记。基于此前用Poincaré截面、轨道演化和Lyapunov指数展示该系统由非混沌到混沌转变的工作，本文采用numerical kludge方案计算小天体沿不同混沌与非混沌轨道的引力波形，并对波形做谱分析。结果显示，当系统处于混沌态时，所考虑混沌轨道的引力波信号具有更宽且有限宽度的频谱、不规则的波形调制和相对较大的应变偏离，并伴随改变的能量辐射特征，从而明显区别于非混沌态信号。我们还讨论LISA、天琴和太极等未来探测器对这些轨道的潜在可探测性，强调探测引力波中的混沌印记对理解黑洞物理和星系核暗物质环境的意义。

English: We investigate imprints of chaos in gravitational waves from extreme-mass-ratio inspirals configuration, where a stellar massive object, confined in an external potential as a harmonic oscillators, orbits a supermassive Schwarzschild-like black hole embedded in a Dehnen-type dark matter halo. In our previous work (Das S, et al., Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals embedded in dark matter halo: Existence of homoclinic orbit and horizon-induced chaos, Sci. China-Phys. Mech. Astron. 69, 290413 (2026)), we demonstrated the system's transition from non-chaotic to chaotic dynamics by analyzing Poincar\'e sections, orbital evolution, and Lyapunov exponents across different energies and dark matter halo parameters. In this work, we compute the gravitational waveforms of the small celestial object along different chaotic and non-chaotic orbits by implementing the numerical kludge scheme. We further perform spectral analysis of the gravitational waveforms from such orbits. In particular, we show that when the system is in a chaotic state, the gravitational wave signals are characterized by broader frequency spectra with finite widths, irregular waveform modulations with comparatively large strain excursions for the chaotic trajectories considered here, together with modified energy-emission characteristics, distinctly differentiating them from the signals generated during the system's non-chaotic state. Furthermore, we discuss the potential detectability of these orbits for upcoming observatories like Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), TianQin, and Taiji, emphasizing the significant potential for detecting chaotic imprints in gravitational waves to substantially enhance our understanding of chaotic dynamics in black hole physics and the dark matter environments of galactic nuclei.

Extremal black hole mimickers: geometry, stability, and long-delay signal trains

Sergey N. Solodukhin · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们提出一种作为极端黑洞无视界模拟体的时空。与先前研究的非退化视界黑洞模拟体不同（其几何为虫洞型，由长喉道连接两个渐近平直区域），极端黑洞模拟体一端只有一个渐近平直区域，另一端为无限长喉道。在喉道区域，时空趋近于直积几何 M_{1,1}×S^2，其中 M_{1,1} 为二维闵可夫斯基时空，S^2 为二维球面。我们研究标量场动力学以及 Aretakis 不稳定性的命运。尽管在喉道的局部分析中出现类 Aretakis 模式，它们并不导致该模拟体的物理不稳定性。初始局域于喉道的标量扰动在晚期产生一系列信号，其特征间隔为 t_delay~1/λ，其中 λ<<1 为形变参数。该时间尺度在参数上大于非极端黑洞模拟体特征的 echo 时间 t_echo~ln(1/λ)。我们称此序列为长延迟信号列。几何上，长延迟信号的周期性关联于 S^2 上的周期测地线。随后我们将构造推广到极端 Kerr。此时喉道区域趋近于涉及 M_{1,1} 与二维曲面 Σ_2 的广义直积几何。相应信号预计形成准周期信号列，反映 Σ_2 上的准周期测地运动。我们还评论了对非极端黑洞虫洞型模拟体的推广，以及这些结果在 AdS/CFT 对应背景下对幺正性的启示。

English: We present a spacetime that serves as a horizonless mimicker of extremal black holes. Unlike previously studied mimickers of black holes with non-degenerate horizons, whose geometries are of the wormhole type and consist of two asymptotically flat regions connected by a very long throat, the mimicker of an extremal black hole possesses a single asymptotically flat region at one end and an infinitely long throat at the other. In the throat region, the spacetime approaches the direct-product geometry $M_{1,1} \times S^2$, where $M_{1,1}$ is two-dimensional Minkowski spacetime and $S^2$ is the two-sphere. We investigate scalar-field dynamics and the fate of the Aretakis instability. Although Aretakis-like modes arise in a local analysis of the throat, they do not lead to a physical instability of the mimicker. A scalar perturbation initially localized in the throat gives rise, at late times, to a sequence of signals with a characteristic separation $t_{\rm delay}\sim 1/\lambda$, where $\lambda\ll 1$ is a deformation parameter. This timescale is parametrically larger than the echo time $t_{\rm echo}\sim \ln(1/\lambda)$ characteristic of non-extremal black-hole mimickers. We refer to this sequence as a {\it long-delay signal train}. Geometrically, the periodicity of the long-delay signals is associated with periodic geodesics on $S^2$. We then extend the construction to extremal Kerr. In this case, the throat region approaches a generalized product geometry involving $M_{1,1}$ and a two-dimensional surface $\Sigma_2$. The corresponding signals are expected to form a quasi-periodic signal train, reflecting the quasi-periodic geodesic motion on $\Sigma_2$. We also comment on the generalization to wormhole mimickers of non-extremal black holes and on the implications of these results for unitarity in the context of the AdS/CFT correspondence.

一句话导读：构造无视界极端黑洞模拟时空，分析标量场稳定性并发现由 S^2 测地线导致的长延迟信号列。

相关度：medium — 论文主要属于经典引力/黑洞模拟时空与标量扰动稳定性研究，并涉及长延迟信号列；仅在结尾提及 AdS/CFT 幺正性，未展开全息计算，因此与全息主线相关性中等。

Courant–Hilbert 变形的引力实现

A gravitational realization of Courant--Hilbert deformations

Osamu Fukushima, Miyabi Kurihara, Takaki Matsumoto, Kentaroh Yoshida · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：Courant–Hilbert（CH）变形统一了包括 T\bar{T} 和 root-T\bar{T} 在内的多类可解应力张量流。然而，一个能够系统地给出这类一般变形的引力作用量此前仍属未知。本文构造了一个二维有质量引力理论，其在壳作用量可完整重现 CH 变形。引力部分由相对 zweibein 本征值比 y 的任意函数定义。为绕过直接消去辅助 zweibein 的技术困难，我们采用涉及 y 和秩一投影算符 K 的 2×2 谱分解来重新表述物质部分。依次求解运动方程（先对 K 后对 y）自然将体系映射到 CH 流的 Russo–Townsend 形式。我们的工作将 Tolley 关于 T\bar{T} 流的有质量引力表述推广到 CH 范围，为可解应力张量流提供了清晰的几何机制。

English: Courant--Hilbert (CH) deformations unify broad classes of solvable stress-tensor flows including $T\bar{T}$ and root-$T\bar{T}$. However, a gravitational action that systematically yields such general deformations has remained unknown. In this Letter, we construct a two-dimensional massive gravity theory whose on-shell action reproduces the complete CH deformation. The gravity sector is defined via an arbitrary function of the eigenvalue ratio $y$ of the relative zweibein. To bypass the technical difficulty of directly eliminating the auxiliary zweibein, we reformulate the matter sector using a $2 \times 2$ spectral decomposition involving $y$ and a rank-one projector $K$. Sequentially solving the equations of motion---first for $K$ and subsequently for $y$---naturally maps the system onto the Russo-Townsend form of the CH flow. Our work extends Tolley's massive gravity formulation of $T\bar{T}$ flows to the CH landscape, providing a clear geometric mechanism for solvable stress-tensor flows.

一句话导读：构造二维有质量引力作用量，使其在壳作用量重现一般 Courant–Hilbert 变形，并将 Tolley 的 T\bar{T} 引力表述推广到 CH 范围。

English: We study Witten's induced gauge theory associated with the D1-D5 Higgs-branch CFT${}_2$, in which the non-dynamical vector multiplet becomes reanimated by integrating out the fundamental hypermultiplets. We propose a BRST quantisation of this theory and derive its induced propagators. We show that the ghost sector first contributes at subleading order, that the induced $A\phi^2$ vertex satisfies the Slavnov-Taylor identity and that gauge-invariant correlators are independent of the gauge parameter. Together with our chosen regularization prescription, this gives a perturbative framework for computing observables in the induced theory.

Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS引力中洛伦兹Taub-NUT时空的热力学

Thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub-NUT spacetimes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS gravity

Borja Diez · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们研究任意偶数维Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS引力中洛伦兹Taub-NUT时空的热力学，这些时空构造为Einstein-Kähler底流形上的U(1)纤维丛。我们用表面引力计算温度，并使用离壳Abbott-Deser-Tekin形式将能量作为与稳态Killing矢量相关的守恒荷。在同一框架下，我们得到熵作为视界Noether荷。结果与Iyer-Wald公式一致，并包含对Bekenstein-Hawking面积律的Gauss-Bonnet修正。只要存在Misner弦就予以保留，我们建立具有完全同质性的第一定律，其中NUT参数独立于视界半径变化。这需要额外的NUT相关热力学变量及其共轭势，我们显式确定它们。我们还简要讨论静态极限。

English: We study the thermodynamics of Lorentzian Taub-NUT spacetimes in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet AdS gravity in arbitrary even dimensions, constructed as $U(1)$ fibrations over Einstein-K\"ahler base manifolds. We compute the temperature from the surface gravity and the energy as the conserved charge associated with the stationary Killing vector using the off-shell Abbott-Deser-Tekin formalism. Within the same framework, we obtain the entropy as a horizon Noether charge. The result agrees with the Iyer-Wald formula and includes a Gauss-Bonnet correction to the Bekenstein-Hawking area law. Retaining the Misner strings whenever present, we formulate a first law of full cohomogeneity in which the NUT parameter varies independently of the horizon radius. This requires an additional NUT-related thermodynamic variable and its conjugate potential, which we determine explicitly. We also briefly discuss the static limit.

一句话导读：在任意偶数维EGB AdS中计算洛伦兹Taub-NUT时空的温度、能量、熵，并建立含Misner弦与独立NUT参数的第一定律。

超对称 SYK 中的偶然性与脆弱性

Fortuity and fragility in supersymmetric SYK

James Chryssanthacopoulos, David Vegh · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：在具有 N 个费米子的 N=2 超对称 SYK 模型中，每个 BPS 态都是偶然的：在固定电荷下，它只在一个有限的 N 范围内存在。让电荷增加，我们证明 BPS 类可以沿着偶然性窗口内的格点行走被提升，可能达到任意大的 N。然而不存在规范的提升。因此我们引入解码器 D，其谱量化精确提升及其度规代价。我们把提升调和代表的失败或代价增加称为度规脆弱性。Chen 的单矩阵模型和双味 SYK 模型的受保护塔分别实现完美提升的裸机制和真正着衣的机制。在一般单味模型中，精确提升最终失败。Lin-Maldacena-Rozenberg-Shan 型算子 D†D 的能级统计与高斯幺正系综一致。其本征值量化 BPS 态跨系统尺度的度规连续性，而其关联探测 BPS 扇区内的混沌。度规脆弱性与 BPS 混沌因此被编码在同一算子的互补可观测量中，从而区分混沌 BPS 扇区与精确可解塔。

English: In the $\mathcal N=2$ supersymmetric SYK model with $N$ fermions, every BPS state is fortuitous: at fixed charge, it exists only over a finite range of $N$. Allowing the charge to increase, we show that BPS classes may instead be uplifted along lattice walks inside the fortuity window, potentially to arbitrarily large $N$. However, there is no canonical uplift. We therefore introduce a decoder $D$ whose spectrum quantifies exact uplift and its metric cost. We call the failure or increasing cost of uplifting harmonic representatives metric fragility. Chen's single-matrix model and the protected tower of the two-flavor SYK model realize bare and genuinely dressed mechanisms of perfect uplift, respectively. In the generic one-flavor model, exact uplift eventually fails. The Lin-Maldacena-Rozenberg-Shan-type operator $D^\dagger D$ exhibits level statistics consistent with the Gaussian unitary ensemble. Its eigenvalues quantify the metric continuity of BPS states across system size, while their correlations probe chaos within the BPS sector. Metric fragility and BPS chaos are thus encoded in complementary observables of the same operator, distinguishing chaotic BPS sectors from exactly solvable towers.

一句话导读：该文研究 N=2 超对称 SYK 中 BPS 态的偶然存在、跨 N 提升的度规脆弱性，以及 BPS 扇区混沌与可解塔的算子谱判据。

English: We introduce combinatorial holographic quantum secret sharing (CHQSS) for a bulk subregion in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ to study how logical information of the bulk subregion is encoded in the boundary and protected from erasures of boundary subregions. We introduce a distance, a reconstruction threshold, and a secret threshold to characterize CHQSS schemes. A UV-Finite Refinement of the Ryu-Takayanagi Relation in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$

Philipp Dorau, Albert Much, Leonardo Sangaletti, Rainer Verch · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们在 AdS3/CFT2 中建立了一个精化的 Ryu–Takayanagi（RT）关系，以相对熵而非紫外发散的 von Neumann 纠缠熵为核心对象。将 Hollands 关于手征相对熵的精确结果适配到 diamond 区域，我们把真空与相干态之间的边界相对熵表示为 Schwarzian 泛函；Fefferman–Graham 字典将其等同于 Bañados 几何的渐近数据，而三维引力的刚性把这一边界识别提升到体。到度规微扰的线性阶，相对熵等于 RT 测地线长度变分除以 4G_N。该构造仅依赖 Bisognano–Wichmann/Borchers 定理与全息字典，给出 RT 关系的一个紫外有限、算子代数对应。

English: We establish a refined Ryu--Takayanagi (RT) relation in AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ using \emph{relative entropy} as the central object, in place of the ultraviolet-divergent von Neumann entanglement entropy. Adapting Hollands' exact result for the chiral relative entropy to a diamond region, we express the boundary relative entropy between the vacuum and a coherent state as a Schwarzian functional, which the Fefferman--Graham dictionary identifies with the asymptotic data of a Ba\~nados geometry; the rigidity of three-dimensional gravity promotes this boundary identification to the bulk. To linear order in the metric perturbation, the relative entropy then equals the variation of the RT geodesic length divided by $4G_N$. The construction rests only on the Bisognano--Wichmann/Borchers theorem and the holographic dictionary, giving a UV-finite, operator-algebraic counterpart to the RT relation.

中文摘要：我们基于具有格点边上和乐变量的 BF 型规范结构，构造了二维 Carroll 膨胀子引力的离散实现。体理论保持拓扑性，而物理动力学编码在边界自由度中。施加容许边界条件，我们直接在格点层面导出渐近对称性结构。最宽松条件给出 Carroll 代数的仿射扩展，额外约束将对称性约化为由离散 Virasoro 型代数支配的共形部分。在连续极限下，格点对称性结构重现预期的仿射 Carroll 代数及其共形约化。该构造因此给出离散 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力的超相对论对应。

English: We construct a discrete realization of two-dimensional Carroll dilaton gravity based on a BF-type gauge structure with holonomy variables on lattice links. The bulk theory remains topological, while the physical dynamics is encoded in boundary degrees of freedom. Imposing admissible boundary conditions, we derive the asymptotic symmetry structure directly at the lattice level. The least restrictive conditions yield an affine extension of the Carroll algebra, while additional constraints reduce the symmetry to a conformal sector governed by a discrete Virasoro-type algebra. In the continuum limit, the lattice symmetry structure reproduces the expected affine Carroll algebra together with its conformal reduction. The construction therefore provides the ultra-relativistic counterpart of discrete Jackiw-Teitelboim(JT) gravity.

Kerr/CFT Traversable Wormhole with Fermionic Double-Trace Deformation

M. Zhahir Djogama, Fitria Khairunnisa, Hadyan Luthfan Prihadi, Freddy Permana Zen · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文在Kerr/CFT框架下研究利用费米子场双迹形变构造可穿越虫洞。作者考虑近视界、近极端Kerr几何及其对偶共形场论，指出费米子不存在超辐射，因此可在包括玻色场因超辐射而不稳定的离轴区域在内的各个区域描述虫洞。通过选择左右边界的特定耦合，两点函数被修正，其一阶修正贡献负能量并打开虫洞。扰动在早期开启时虫洞最可穿越，其打开程度依赖模式频率、黑洞温度和费米子质量；晚期平均零能量呈阻尼振荡并最终趋于零。温度较低时可穿越性较弱，极端极限下虫洞完全闭合。eikonal方法可重现相同可穿越性。旋转和参与形变的场数可将信息传输上界提高至熵量级。此外，由虫洞连接的对称有效势垒可产生可观测回声，且回声时间延迟不超过黑洞的 scrambling time。

English: The construction of a traversable wormhole with double-trace deformation has been achieved so far by using boson fields as the perturbation. In this work, we study double-trace deformation with fermion fields in the two-sided Kerr background to open a traversable wormhole. We construct the fermionic double-trace deformation within the Kerr/CFT framework. We consider the near-horizon, near-extremal Kerr geometry, which is dual to a conformal field theory. The lack of fermionic superradiance let us describe the wormhole at every region, even at the off-axis region where bosonic field experiences instability due to superradiance. By choosing a certain coupling between the left and right boundaries, the two-point function is modified, and its first order correction contributes the negative energy to open the wormhole. The wormhole is most traversable when the perturbation is turned on at early times, with opening that depends on the mode's frequency, the black hole temperature, and the fermion mass. At late times, the average null energy has damped oscillation behavior until eventually reaches zero. Wormhole with lower temperature have less traversability and it is completely closed at extreme limit. The same traversability can also be reproduced by using eikonal method. On the other hand, rotation and the number of fields involved in the deformation can increases the upper bound on information transfer up to the order of the entropy. Additionally, symmetrical effective potential bumps connected by the wormhole can produce observable echoes. We find that the echo time delay cannot exceed the scrambling time of the black hole.

一句话导读：在Kerr/CFT框架下用费米子双迹形变构造可穿越虫洞，并分析其可穿越性、信息传输上界与回声信号。

D-instanton Effects on the Holographic Weyl Semimetals

Hwajin Eom, Yunseok Seo · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们在自顶向下方法中研究D-瞬子对全息外尔半金属的影响。发现D-瞬子的存在会诱导从外尔半金属到有能隙相的新相变，为强耦合系统中的能隙形成提供新机制。通过分析探针D7膜嵌入的自由能，我们以Weyl参数为单位，构建了关于费米子质量、瞬子密度和温度的相图。我们表明，除了与能带反转相关的常规质量驱动相变外，瞬子密度还导致一种定性不同的相变，其机制不能在标准Dirac图像中理解。我们从黑洞视界处的正则性条件计算非线性电导率，并证明两类相变表现出不同的输运行为；特别地，瞬子诱导的相变导致的有能隙相性质不同于常规绝缘相。我们还讨论了该相在边界理论中的可能解释，并评论其与强相互作用系统中非微扰效应的关系。

English: We investigate the effects of D-instantons on a holographic Weyl semimetal in a top-down approach. We find that the presence of D-instantons induces a novel phase transition from a Weyl semimetal to a gapped phase, providing a new mechanism for gap formation in strongly coupled systems. By analyzing the free energy of probe D7-brane embeddings, we construct the phase diagram in terms of the fermion mass, instanton density, and temperature, measured in units of the Weyl parameter. We show that, in addition to the conventional mass-driven transition associated with band inversion, the instanton density gives rise to a qualitatively different transition whose mechanism cannot be understood within the standard Dirac picture. We compute nonlinear electric conductivities from the regularity condition at the black hole horizon and demonstrate that the two types of transitions exhibit distinct transport behavior. In particular, the instanton-induced transition leads to a gapped phase with properties that differ from the conventional insulating phase. We also discuss possible interpretations of this phase in the boundary theory and comment on its relation to nonperturbative effects in strongly interacting systems.

一句话导读：D-瞬子在D3-D7自顶向下全息模型中诱导外尔半金属到有能隙相的新相变，并改变非线性电导输运。

Jonathan Whittle · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文利用 Ryu-Takayanagi 方案研究板状和球状纠缠区域的全息类空与类时纠缠熵。工作于无限族 10 维 IIB 型超引力解，这些解是全息对偶于无限族线性 quiver 理论的引力背景，背景由膜位形的静电势形式定义。对偶理论低能为 4 维禁闭理论，但在 UV 解紧致并流向 5 维 SCFT。发现纠缠熵表现出相变行为，并用结果研究由纠缠熵构造的 c-函数；与 flow central charge 比较，二者行为良好并反映对偶理论的 UV 和 IR 特征。

English: In this work we investigate holographic spacelike and timelike entanglement entropy using the Ryu-Takayanagi prescription, for slab-shaped and ball-shaped entangling regions. We work with an infinite family of 10-dimensional Type IIB supergravity solutions, which are gravity duals to an infinite set of linear quiver theories, with the backgrounds defined using the electrostatic potential formalism for brane configurations. The dual theories are 4-dimensional confining theories at low energy, but decompactify and flow to 5-dimensional SCFTs in the UV. We find that the entanglement entropy exhibits phase transition behaviour, and we use our results to investigate proposed c-functions constructed from the entanglement entropy. Comparing with the flow central charge, another proposed c-function, we find that each displays good behaviour, and reflects both UV and IR features of the dual theory.

环境诱导的黑洞热力学拓扑重构

Environment-induced topological reconstruction of black-hole thermodynamics

Xinyu Zhou, Chen Lan, Zhen-Ming Xu · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：热力学拓扑将黑洞平衡态描述为由离壳自由能构造的向量场的零点或缺陷。以往考虑周围物质的研究发现拓扑类不变，但未说明物质的空间分布如何影响单个平衡态。本文追问局域环境的位置能否在总拓扑数固定的情况下重组这些平衡态。作者将环境建模为峰值位于 a_m 的径向局域能量凸起，并把其外部能量加入广义离壳自由能。随着 a_m 变化，缺陷迁移并成对产生或湮灭相反电荷的缺陷，这一过程被称为拓扑重构。它会改变平衡分支的数量和稳定性，但只要没有零点穿过物理区域边界，总拓扑数保持不变。作者在 Schwarzschild、Schwarzschild-AdS、Reissner-Nordström 和 Reissner-Nordström-AdS 黑洞中发现了这一现象，临界位置和所需强度依赖于背景。在所给例子中，所需环境能量从低于黑洞质量的 1% 到与黑洞质量相当。该模型是无可反作用的有效固定背景描述；在此框架内，总拓扑数无法刻画环境响应，必须追踪局域缺陷。

English: Thermodynamic topology describes black-hole (BH) equilibria as zeros, or defects, of a vector field built from the off-shell free energy. Studies with surrounding matter find that the topological class is unchanged, but not how the matter's spatial distribution affects individual equilibria. We ask whether the position of a localized environment can reorganize these equilibria at fixed total topological number. We model the environment as a radially localized energy bump peaked at $a_m$ and add its exterior energy to the generalized off-shell free energy. As $a_m$ varies, defects migrate and are created or annihilated in opposite-charge pairs, a process we call topological reconstruction. It changes the number and stability of equilibrium branches but preserves the total topological number, provided no zero crosses the boundary of the physical domain. We find this in Schwarzschild, Schwarzschild-AdS, Reissner-Nordstr\"om, and Reissner-Nordstr\"om-AdS BHs, with critical positions and required strength that depend on the background. In our examples, the required environmental energy ranges from below $1\%$ of the BH mass to a value comparable to it. The model is an effective fixed-background description without backreaction. Within it, the total topological number cannot capture the environmental response; local defects must be tracked.

一句话导读：在固定背景有效模型中，局域环境能量凸起可改变黑洞热力学平衡缺陷的数量和稳定性，但总拓扑数保持不变。

4+1 维真空临界坍缩中的角动量

Angular Momenta in $4+1$ Vacuum Critical Collapse

Oscar J. C. Dias, Carsten Gundlach, Jorge E. Santos, Benson Way · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们在五维真空 Einstein 引力下，采用 SU(2)×Z4 对称性拟设，数值演化多族初态，研究携带角动量的引力波临界坍缩。近临界数据趋近于离散自相似的 Bizón-Chmaj-Schmidt 解，该解无旋。我们发现近阈值质量标度具有普适临界指数，但角动量标度依赖初态族而呈现两种临界指数之一，因此在该对称性拟设下角动量临界指数不普适。结果与关于临界解的微扰论预言一致。

English: We investigate the critical collapse of gravitational waves that carry angular momenta. Working in five-dimensional vacuum Einstein gravity under an SU$(2)\times\mathbb Z_4$ symmetry ansatz, we numerically evolve several families of initial data near the threshold of black-hole formation. Near-critical data approaches the discretely self-similar Bizo\'n-Chmaj-Schmidt solution, which is irrotational. We find that the near-threshold mass scaling has a universal critical exponent, but the angular-momentum scaling has one of two critical exponents, depending on the family of initial data. The angular-momentum critical exponents are therefore not universal under this symmetry ansatz. Our results agree with predictions from perturbation theory about the critical solution.

因果钻石的动力学熵与热力学

Dynamical entropy and thermodynamics of causal diamonds

Avik Chakraborty, Pratik K. Das, Manavendra Mahato · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文利用零边界上的 Wald-Zoupas 荷与通量研究因果钻石的动力学熵。对选定的边界辛势，boost 荷定义的熵由面积项加膨胀修正组成，并在钻石边缘约化为面积的四分之一。在 Einstein 引力中，作者得到联系零边界任意两个截面熵与带符号通量的精确平衡律，因此熵仅在该通量非负时减小。文中还在不假设背景 Killing 对称性的情况下，分别在有、无外部物质时得到线性化物理过程第一定律，并基于改进的量子零能条件推广到半经典引力；最后考察最大对称时空和 Einstein-标量引力中的因果钻石。

English: We study the dynamical entropy of causal diamonds using Wald-Zoupas charges and fluxes on their null boundaries. For a chosen boundary symplectic potential, the boost charge defines an entropy made of an area term plus an expansion correction, which reduces to one quarter of the area at the edge on the diamond. In Einstein gravity, we find an exact balance law relating the entropy on any two cuts of the null boundary to a signed flux, so the entropy decreases only when this flux is non-negative. We obtain a linearised physical process first law without assuming a background Killing symmetry, both in the presence and absence of external matter; and extend it for semiclassical gravity based on the improved quantum null energy condition. We also examine causal diamonds in maximally symmetric spacetimes and in Einstein-scalar gravity.

一句话导读：用 Wald-Zoupas 荷与通量建立因果钻石动力学熵的平衡律和线性化第一定律，并推广到半经典情形。

三线表述的广义相对论

General Relativity in Three Lines

Pawel Nurowski · math-ph, gr-qc, hep-th, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文表明，复广义相对论可以直接用赋予每个时空点的三条仿射线来表述。这些线由Plücker双矢表示，而对相关二形式应用Urbantke构造可重建共形时空度规。从手征Plebański作用量出发，简单性约束将三个二形式变为简单双矢的零内基，从而变为三条射影线。随后3+1分解给出一个一阶正则理论，其位形变量是加权三线，共轭变量是线动量。所得约束系统包括三个内禀Gauss约束、三个矢量约束和一个Hamiltonian约束。线表述的一个显著特征是，在对空间部分分部积分后，对线动量变分得到的方程是逐点代数的。因此，在相应Legendre映射可逆之处可显式消去动量，得到一个二阶作用量，其唯一动力学位形变量是加权三线。线曲率自然分解为宇宙学迹和所选手征扇区的Weyl矩阵。Legendre映射在一个特殊的零演化轨迹上变为奇异，而该处时空度规仍非退化；其秩从九降到六，给出三个代数相容性条件。作者构造了一个有限不变的部分Legendre变换以及穿过该轨迹的光滑约束二阶延拓。该分析为演化方向变为零的情形提供了正则框架，并可能有助于近视界几何及相关引力现象的研究。

English: We show that complex general relativity can be formulated directly in terms of three affine lines assigned to each spacetime point. The lines are represented by Pl\"ucker bivectors, and Urbantke's construction applied to the associated two-forms reconstructs the conformal spacetime metric. Starting from the chiral Pleba\'nski action, the simplicity constraints turn the three two-forms into a null internal basis of simple bivectors and thereby into three projective lines. A $3+1$ decomposition then yields a first-order canonical theory whose configuration variable is the weighted triple of lines and whose conjugate variable is a line momentum. The resulting constraint system consists of three internal Gauss constraints, three vector constraints, and one Hamiltonian constraint. A notable feature of the line formulation is that the equation obtained by varying the line momentum is pointwise algebraic after the spatial integrations by parts. Consequently the momentum can be eliminated explicitly wherever the corresponding Legendre map is invertible, giving a second-order action whose only dynamical configuration variable is the weighted triple of lines. The line curvature separates naturally into a cosmological trace and the Weyl matrix of the selected chiral sector. The Legendre map becomes singular on a distinguished null-evolution locus where the spacetime metric remains nondegenerate. There its rank drops from nine to six, giving three algebraic compatibility conditions. We construct a finite invariant partial Legendre transform and a smooth constrained second-order continuation through this locus. This analysis provides a regular framework for regimes in which the evolution direction becomes null and may be useful in the study of near-horizon geometries and related gravitational phenomena.

一句话导读：用三条仿射线/Plücker双矢和Plebański作用量给出复广义相对论的正则表述，并分析Legendre映射在零演化轨迹上的奇异与延拓。

跨越PT对称破缺转变的全息两点函数

Holographic two-point functions across a PT symmetry-breaking transition

Zuo Wang, Liang He · hep-th, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：在宇称-时间（PT）对称的非厄米系统中，本征值和本征矢合并的例外点通常将实谱与复共轭本征值分开。在对数共形场论（LCFT）中，这样的例外点出现在标度维谱中。LCFT的全息模型（如偶极模型）正是建立在该点。这里，我们形变全息偶极模型，使其两个合并的标度维分裂为两个实标度维或一对复共轭标度维。我们以闭合形式得到重整化两点函数；它们从两个幂律的线性组合，经过例外点处LCFT的对数形式，连续变为对数周期振荡。对于在膨胀下具有实混合的任意标量主算子对，共形Ward恒等式将该形式固定到两个归一化常数，而全息字典确定这些常数。在具有此类膨胀算子的PT对称理论中，实与复共轭标度维对应PT未破缺相与PT破缺相。在有限温度BTZ黑洞中，与两个标度维相关的准正频率之差在实到复谱转变前后从纯虚变为纯实。相应地，线性响应从过阻尼变为欠阻尼，并在例外点处临界阻尼。

English: In parity-time (PT)-symmetric non-Hermitian systems, an exceptional point, where eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, typically separates a real spectrum from complex-conjugate eigenvalues. In logarithmic conformal field theories (LCFTs), such an exceptional point appears in the spectrum of scaling dimensions. Holographic models of LCFTs, such as the dipole model, are built exactly at this point. Here, we deform the holographic dipole model so that its two coalescing scaling dimensions split into either two real ones or a complex-conjugate pair. We obtain the renormalized two-point functions in closed form. They change continuously from a linear combination of two power laws, through the logarithmic form of the LCFT at the exceptional point, to log-periodic oscillations. For any pair of scalar primary operators with real mixing under dilatations, the conformal Ward identities fix this form up to two normalization constants, which the holographic dictionary determines. In PT-symmetric theories with such a dilatation operator, real and complex-conjugate scaling dimensions correspond to the PT-unbroken and PT-broken phases. In the BTZ black hole at finite temperature, the difference between the quasinormal frequencies associated with the two scaling dimensions changes from purely imaginary to purely real across the real-to-complex spectral transition. Correspondingly, the linear response changes from overdamped to underdamped, with critical damping at the exceptional point.

一句话导读：通过形变全息偶极模型，给出跨PT/LCFT例外点的闭合形式两点函数，并联系BTZ黑洞QNM与过阻尼-欠阻尼响应。

复化几何中的带引力反常时间向纠缠熵

Timelike entanglement entropy with gravitational anomaly from complexified geometry

Minwoo Lim, Himanshu Parihar, Junggi Yoon · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文研究二维共形场论中带引力反常（c_L≠c_R）的时间向纠缠熵（TEE），其对偶为 AdS3 中的拓扑大质量引力。全息上，TEE 由锚定在时间向区间端点的单条复测地线上大质量自旋粒子的 on-shell 作用量决定；该作用量包含复测地线长度和平行移动法标架的 twist。作者在 Poincaré AdS3、非极端与极端旋转 BTZ 背景中计算，并给出等价的 Chern-Simons 推导：体连接保持实，而 Wilson 线探针的鞍点变为复。各情形下全息结果与对偶场论 TEE 匹配。TEE 的实部唯一确定，虚部依赖边界 iε 规定和区间取向；在体中，取向依赖反映标架选择的不确定性。沿复测地线，剩余标架群为 SO(2,C)≃C*，因此端点条件只将标架 twist 确定到 2πi 的整数倍。两种取向之差 (c_L-c_R)/6 iπ 完全由引力反常固定，并在 Rényi pseudo-entropies 中持续存在。

English: We investigate the timelike entanglement entropy (TEE) in a two-dimensional conformal field theory with a gravitational anomaly, $c_L\neq c_R$, dual to topologically massive gravity in AdS$_3$. Holographically, the TEE is determined by the on-shell action of a massive spinning particle on a single complex geodesic anchored at the endpoints of the timelike interval. This action consists of the complex geodesic length and the twist of a parallel-transported normal frame. We carry out the computation in Poincar\'e AdS$_3$, non-extremal and extremal rotating BTZ backgrounds, and provide an equivalent Chern-Simons derivation in which the bulk connection stays real while only the saddle of the Wilson-line probe becomes complex. In each case, the holographic result matches the corresponding TEE in dual field theory. The real part of the TEE is fixed unambiguously whereas its imaginary part depends on the boundary $i\epsilon$ prescription and the orientation of the interval. In the bulk, the dependence on orientation reflects an ambiguity in the choice of framing. Along the complex geodesic, the residual frame group becomes $SO(2,\mathbb C)\simeq\mathbb C^*$, so the endpoint conditions determine the frame twist only up to integer multiples of $2\pi i$. The difference between the two orientations, $\frac{c_L-c_R}{6}\,i\pi$, is fixed entirely by the gravitational anomaly and persists for the R\'enyi pseudo-entropies.

一句话导读：在 AdS3/CFT2 中通过复测地线与 Chern-Simons 表述计算带引力反常的时间向纠缠熵，并指出其虚部取向差由反常固定。
