Spinors, Doppelg\"angers and the Non-Perturbative Classical Double Copy

Kymani Armstrong-Williams · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文为复化 SU(2) Yang--Mills 理论中 Corrigan--Fairlie--'t Hooft--Wilczek 扇区与四维共形平坦引力之间的非微扰经典双拷贝建立几何与旋量表述。作者将规范势等同于共形平坦度规的正手征自旋联络，并给出 Yang--Mills 场强与 Riemann 张量手征投影之间的精确关系，从而在四维实现“doppelgänger”观点。该扇区中无源 Yang--Mills 方程要求常标量曲率，解释了共享的非线性标量方程，并将引力对应推广到具有常能量动量迹的物质。通过把伴随色指标表示为旋量指标的对称对，作者导出规范场强旋量到标量曲率与无迹 Ricci 分量的精确映射；即使 Weyl 张量为零，这些关系仍保留非平凡曲率信息。文中用 AdS、dS 以及由标量场支撑的 AdS3×R 时空说明该构造。

English: We develop a geometric and spinorial formulation of the non-perturbative classical double copy between the Corrigan--Fairlie--'t Hooft--Wilczek sector of complexified SU(2) Yang--Mills theory and four-dimensional conformally flat gravity. We identify the gauge potential with the positive-chiral spin connection of the conformally flat metric, establishing an exact relation between the Yang--Mills field strength and the chiral projection of the Riemann tensor. This provides a four-dimensional realisation of the doppelg\"anger viewpoint, in which gauge and gravitational fields arise from different interpretations of common connection data. Within this sector, the sourceless Yang--Mills equations require constant scalar curvature, explaining the shared nonlinear scalar equation and extending the gravitational correspondence from traceless matter to matter with constant energy--momentum trace. These relations retain nontrivial curvature information despite the vanishing Weyl tensor. We illustrate the construction using anti-de Sitter and de Sitter spacetimes, together with $\mathrm{AdS}_{3}\times\mathbb{R}$ supported by a scalar field, demonstrating the extension to matter with nonzero constant trace

English: Based on a holographic model exhibiting Mott-like insulating behavior on an ionic lattice, we construct a holographic striped superconductor (SSC), which is characterized by the interplay between the charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity (SC). We present the phase diagram on the $e$-$T$ plane, where the SSC phase emerges within an intermediate window of $e$, revealing both cooperative and competitive relations between the CDW order and SC order. For small charge $e$, the system undergoes the phase transition from metallic phase to CDW phase, and then to SSC phase upon cooling; while for large $e$, it transitions from metallic phase to SC phase directly, and then to SSC phase. We compute the optical conductivity of the system for these two cases and demonstrate its distinct behavior. It turns out that the imaginary part of the conductivity exhibits a divergent behavior below the critical temperature $T_{\mathrm{SSC}}$ along both pathways, so that the superconductivity of SSC phase is justified for the first time in the holographic framework. Along the CDW-to-SSC pathway the pseudogap and the pinning effect are inherited from the CDW phase, whereas along the SC-to-SSC pathway the spontaneous stripe strongly suppresses the coherent normal-fluid channel while the superfluid pole is enhanced. In addition, we demonstrate the commensurate lock-in behavior of the striped superconductor in the $p$-$T$ diagram.

中文摘要：在 AdS/CFT 关联函数中，当 AdS 边界上两个类时分离的点可通过体中的零测地线相连时，会出现体锥奇点。我们考虑该零测地线反作用对关联函数带来的、偏离 G_N→0 极限的修正。该测地线的一个特殊性质是它不是即时的，即其上存在类时分离的点，这意味着它可能对自身产生引力影响。我们证明这会导致沿该测地线经历的时间出现能量依赖的延迟；结合引力辐射可能带来的非弹性效应，这些是消解该奇点的主要机制。被消解的奇点伴随振荡，从而在关联函数实部和虚部中产生零点。我们讨论了额外非弹性效应在阻尼这些振荡中的作用。最后，我们给出一个 2+1 维的具体例子，通过研究边界引力子模式显式计算能量依赖的时间延迟效应。

English: In AdS/CFT correlators, bulk cone singularities arise when two points that are timelike separated on the AdS boundary may be connected by a null geodesic through the bulk. We consider corrections to these correlators away from the $G_N\to 0$ limit arising from the backreaction of this null geodesic. A peculiar property of this geodesic is that it is not prompt, meaning that there exist points on it that are timelike separated. This implies that it may gravitationally affect itself. We show that this leads to an energy-dependent delay in the time elapsed along this geodesic. This coupled with possible inelastic effects due to gravitational radiation are the leading mechanisms that resolve the singularity. The resolved singularity is accompanied by oscillations and hence zeroes in the real and imaginary parts of the correlator. We comment on the role that additional inelastic effects play in damping these oscillations. Finally, we provide a concrete example in $2+1$D where we can compute the energy-dependent time delay effect explicitly by studying the boundary graviton mode.

中文摘要：我们研究长寿命准正规模的并合是否会增强旋转 BTZ 黑洞的边界响应。利用混合 Robin 边界条件下的精确标量解和推迟边界关联函数，我们在固定源与算符归一化下比较频域共振和时域信号。在适当选取的固定理论中，仅改变自旋即可穿过一个例外点（EP）。沿一条不同的近极端路径，通过调节标量质量和边界耦合来追踪共转 EP 面时，一个更高更窄的共振与一个较弱但持续时间更长的双极点脉冲响应共存。频域增强在远离 EP 处仍然存在，因此并非模式并合所独有。因此，EP 决定了双极点结构和 Jordan 弛豫，但本身并不决定响应强度；响应强度还依赖于物理路径和激发协议。

English: We investigate whether the coalescence of long-lived quasinormal modes enhances the boundary response of rotating BTZ black holes. Using exact scalar solutions with mixed Robin boundary conditions and the retarded boundary correlator, we compare frequency-domain resonances and time-domain signals at fixed source and operator normalizations. Along a distinct near-extremal path that tracks the co-rotating EP surface by tuning the scalar mass and boundary coupling, a taller, narrower resonance coexists with a weaker but longer-lasting double-pole impulse response. The frequency-domain enhancement persists away from the EP and is therefore not unique to mode coalescence. Thus, the EP determines the double-pole structure and Jordan relaxation, but does not by itself determine the response strength, which also depends on the physical path and excitation protocol.

The resulting strong-field fluxes and conservative dynamics produce an accumulated inspiral dephasing that grows toward merger. Embedding this test-mass information into an effective-one-body model, we construct inspiral-merger-ringdown waveforms for comparable-mass binaries and find coupling-dependent dephasing and waveform-peak shifts. English: We revisit Vishveshwara's linear scattering on a Schwarzschild black hole to study the evolution of quasinormal mode activation along the full time-domain waveform. The first peak is completely controlled, for even (Zerilli) perturbations, by the algebraically special mode and the nearby branch cut. This phenomenon is absent for odd (Regge-Wheeler) perturbations. These qualitative features are robust under change of initial data, extending to Reissner-Nordstr\"om and Kerr black holes but being absent when departing from asymptotic flatness to spacetime asymptotics without a branch cut. Classical and Loop Quantum Cosmology of Interacting Dark Energy: A Dynamical System Analysis with Superfluid Dark Matter and Dust Matter

Koblandy Yerzhanov, Mohd Shahalam, Gulnur Bauyrzhan, Praveen Kumar Dhankar · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们在经典爱因斯坦引力与圈量子宇宙学中研究相互作用暗能量和暗物质的宇宙学动力学。考虑两种暗物质情形：由广义立方状态方程描述的超流暗物质，以及标准无压流体。暗能量组分分别用广义非线性状态方程和常数状态方程建模。我们考察两个现象学相互作用项 Q=αρ̇_m 和 Q=βρ̇_d，它们控制暗部门之间的能量转移。在经典引力中，无压物质模型具有稳定的晚期吸引子，而超流暗物质模型仅有鞍点和非双曲临界点。将分析推广到圈量子宇宙学后，量子几何修正以大爆炸前非奇异量子反弹取代奇点，并显著改变相空间动力学。因此，经典无压物质模型的稳定吸引子消失，所有相互作用模型仅具有鞍点和非双曲临界点。这些结果凸显暗物质性质与量子引力效应对相互作用暗部门渐近演化的显著影响。

English: We study the cosmological dynamics of interacting dark energy and dark matter in Classical Einstein Gravity and Loop Quantum Cosmology. Two dark matter scenarios are considered: superfluid dark matter described by a generalized cubic equation of state and the standard pressureless fluid. The dark energy component is modeled using both a generalized nonlinear equation of state and a constant equation of state. We examine two phenomenological interaction terms, $Q=\alpha\dot{\rho}_m$ and $Q=\beta\dot{\rho}_d$, which govern the energy transfer between the dark sectors. In classical gravity, the pressureless matter model exhibits stable late-time attractors, whereas the superfluid dark matter model admits only saddle and non-hyperbolic critical points. Extending the analysis to Loop Quantum Cosmology, quantum geometric corrections replace the Big Bang singularity with a nonsingular quantum bounce, and significantly modify the phase-space dynamics. As a result, the stable attractors of the classical pressureless matter model disappear, and all interacting models possess only saddle and non-hyperbolic critical points. These findings highlight the significant influence of both dark matter properties and quantum gravitational effects on the asymptotic evolution of interacting dark-sectors.

中文摘要：本文研究一个模型问题：点粒子旋入高导数引力理论中的非旋转黑洞。在这类理论中，背景时空以及引力波的产生和传播都不同于广义相对论。作者发展了修正的Teukolsky形式来描述点粒子源发出的引力波，并以立方引力理论为例计算了到达黑洞视界和零无穷远的通量。该形式可直接推广到旋转黑洞，为在修改引力理论中构建极端质量比旋近波形奠定基础，并可能通过重标度近似同等质量双黑洞波形。

English: In this work, we study a model problem involving a point particle spiraling into a non-rotating black hole in higher-derivative theories of gravity. In such theories, both the background spacetime and the generation and propagation of gravitational waves differ from those in General Relativity. We develop a modified Teukolsky formalism to describe gravitational waves sourced by the point particle and, as an illustrative example, compute the resulting fluxes to the black hole horizon and null infinity for a cubic gravity theory. The formalism is constructed in a way that can be naturally extended to rotating black holes. These results represent essential steps to build extreme mass-ratio-inspiral waveforms in modified gravity theories, which may also be rescaled to approximate waveforms from comparable-mass binary black hole systems, analogous to existing approaches in General Relativity.

Families of regular spacetimes and energy conditions

Zi-Liang Wang, Emmanuele Battista · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们提出一种在广义相对论中系统构造Kerr-Schild型静态球对称规则时空的方法，这些时空满足弱能量条件。该方法基于对物质能量密度的物理合理假设以及Kretschmann标量的有界性；后者保证所有曲率不变量有限，并且对所考虑位形等价于因果测地线完备。通过按复杂度对允许的密度分布分类，我们重新得到Bardeen、Hayward和Dymnikova等已知规则黑洞解，将其自然纳入统一框架。在此框架内，我们还给出若干新规则几何族的闭式表达式，涉及超几何函数或不完全Gamma函数，许多情形可化为代数、对数、反正切和指数等初等函数。还研究了视界和光子球的出现及其观测意义。最后，将分析推广到由Newman-Janis算法生成的旋转度规。

English: We present a systematic method for constructing static, spherically symmetric regular spacetimes of Kerr-Schild type in general relativity that satisfy the weak energy condition. Our approach relies on physically reasonable assumptions on the matter energy density, together with the boundedness of the Kretschmann scalar. The latter property ensures the finiteness of all curvature invariants and, for the configurations considered, is equivalent to the completeness of causal geodesics. By classifying admissible density profiles according to their complexity, we recover well-known regular black hole solutions such as the Bardeen, Hayward, and Dymnikova models, which are thus naturally embedded in a unified and broader framework. Within this setting, we also derive closed-form expressions for several new families of regular geometries involving hypergeometric or incomplete Gamma functions, which in many cases reduce to elementary functions including algebraic, logarithmic, arctangent, and exponential forms. The emergence of horizons and photon spheres, as well as their observational implications, is also investigated. Finally, we extend the analysis to rotating metrics generated through the Newman-Janis algorithm.

Cracking Gravitational Wave Multiple Ringdown Modes in Space

Ziming Wang, Han Wang, Yuxin Yang, Yiming Dong, Hai-Tian Wang, Yi-Ming Hu, Lijing Shao · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：受扰黑洞的铃宕信号为研究黑洞时空、强场引力与基础物理提供了干净窗口。目前，恒星级黑洞铃宕的准正规模已在地基引力波观测中成功提取。未来空间引力波天文台将更响亮地听到大质量黑洞双星并合的铃宕，并以空前精度分辨多个模式，这要求有效缓解急剧增加的计算负担。我们为空间探测器开发了一套实用的铃宕分析流程，采用已在地基探测器中验证过的新型加速算法 FIREFLY，并首次证明其与时间延迟干涉（TDI）观测量的兼容性和有效性。对于包含六个模式的模拟铃宕信号，我们以高保真度实现了超过两个数量级的加速，为空间语境下的多模式铃宕分析提供了可行且可扩展的途径。该新方法具有可靠的统计解释，并可推广到频段内的其他引力波源。

English: Ringdown signals from perturbed black holes (BHs) offer a clean window into BH spacetime, strong-field gravity, and fundamental physics. Presently the quasi-normal modes of stellar-mass BH ringdowns have been successfully extracted in the ground-based gravitational wave (GW) observations. Looking ahead, the future space-borne observatories will listen to the ringdowns from massive BH binary coalescences more loudly and resolve multiple modes to unprecedented precision, which calls for efficient approaches to mitigate the sharply increasing computational burden. We develop a practical ringdown analysis pipeline for space-borne detectors by implementing FIREFLY, a novel acceleration algorithm validated in ground-based detectors, and for the first time demonstrate its compatibility and effectiveness with the time-delay interferometry (TDI) observables. With high fidelity, we achieve an over two-order-of-magnitude speedup for a simulated ringdown signal including six modes, providing a viable and scalable route for multi-mode ringdown analysis in the space context. This new approach has sound statistical interpretation and is extensible to other GW sources in band.

Schwarzschild时空中粒子轨道（类时测地线）的隐藏对称群

Hidden symmetry group for particle orbits (timelike geodesics) in Schwarzschild spacetime

Stephen C. Anco, Mahdieh Gol Bashmani Moghadam · gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v3 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：最近在Schwarzschild时空的类时测地线方程中发现了三个隐藏守恒量，它们类似于牛顿引力中与Laplace-Runge-Lenz（LRL）矢量相关的动力学量：LRL角、LRL Killing矢量时间和LRL固有时，均为所有类时测地线的（分段）守恒量。本文通过对测地线拉格朗日量反向应用Noether定理，为这三个量提供自然的对称性解释，得到三个新的隐藏LRL对称变换。与Killing对称不同——后者是测地线构型变量上的点变换，且无需使用测地线方程即可闭合——这些新对称是动力学变换，本质上涉及测地线动量变量，并且仅在测地线方程的解上闭合。文章表明LRL对称的对易子结构取决于测地线是否有界以及是否穿越视界，其物理意义与它们对测地线能量和角动量的作用相关。它们与Killing对称及测地线拉格朗日量的重参数化对称一起，生成类时测地线方程的完整Noether对称群。

English: For the timelike geodesic equations in Schwarzschild spacetime, three hidden conserved quantities were found recently, which are analogues of dynamical quantities related to the well-known Laplace--Runge--Lenz (LRL) vector in Newtonian gravity. In particular, the geodesic equations possess an LRL angle, an LRL Killing-vector time and an LRL proper time, each of which is a (piecewise) conserved quantity for all timelike geodesics. The present work provides a natural symmetry interpretation for these three quantities by applying Noether's theorem in reverse to the geodesic Lagrangian. This yields three new (hidden) LRL symmetry transformations. Unlike the Killing symmetries, which constitute point transformations on the geodesic configuration variables and close without the use of the geodesic equations, the new symmetries are dynamical transformations which essentially involve the geodesic momenta variables and close only on solutions of the geodesic equations. The commutator structure of the LRL symmetries is shown to depend on whether a geodesic is bounded or not, and horizon-crossing or not, while their physical meaning is connected to their action on the geodesic energy and angular momentum. Together with the Killing symmetries and re-parameterization symmetries of the geodesics Lagrangian, they generate the complete Noether symmetry group of the timelike geodesic equations.

一句话导读：用Noether定理反向构造Schwarzschild类时测地线的三个隐藏LRL对称变换，并给出其完整Noether对称群。

Strong Lensing and Quasinormal modes of a Black Hole with a Global Monopole

Irengbam Roshila Devi, Ningthoujam Media, Yenshembam Priyobarta Singh, Telem Ibungochouba Singh · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本文研究静态球对称带整体单极子黑洞的强场偏折角、透镜观测量与黑洞阴影，发现单极子参数η和λ增大使偏折角与阴影半径增大；分析类时测地线、圆轨道与ISCO，指出ISCO半径随η单调增大，并用Lyapunov指数讨论稳定性；计算电磁扰动下的QNM，发现η增大使振荡衰减更慢，并通过时域演化验证准正规模振铃与晚期幂律尾；最后用EHT对M87*和Sgr A*的观测限制η与λ组合并讨论强透镜观测量前景。

English: In this paper, we investigate various key aspects of a static and spherically symmetric black hole with a global monopole. Firstly, we analyze the deflection angle in the strong field limit of a spacetime with a global monopole. It shows that the angle of deflection increases when the two characteristic parameters for the monopole configuration, $\eta$ and $\lambda$, increase. The influence of the global monopole parameter on the lensing observables and the black hole shadow is studied. This shows that a larger monopole parameter corresponds to larger shadow radii. The dynamics of timelike geodesics is also investigated in the spacetime. General circular orbits and the innermost stable circular orbits (ISCO) of timelike particles are discussed, highlighting that the monopole parameter significantly affects the circular orbits and the ISCO. In particular, it is observed that the radius of ISCO rises monotonically with $\eta$. In addition, the Lyapunov exponent is used to analyze the stability of timelike geodesics. We also determine the quasinormal modes under electromagnetic perturbations for different values of $\eta$. Our findings indicate that increasing the monopole parameter gives rise to electromagnetic perturbations with more slowly damped oscillations. To further validate the derived quasinormal mode spectrum, we discuss the time-domain evolution of the perturbation, confirming the presence of the characteristic quasinormal ringing followed by late-time power-law tails. Finally, comparison with the EHT observations of M87* and Sgr A* determines the parameter combinations of $\eta$ and $\lambda$ compatible with current observations, and the observational prospects of the strong-lensing observables are discussed.

M. Ball, D. Keitel · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：脉冲星自转突变（glitch）中自转频率的突然变化可能由内部机制驱动，并在多个时间尺度上发射引力波。随着探测器灵敏度提高，探测“类连续波”和“类爆发”两种发射的潜力也随之增强。本文旨在考察未来探测器进行这种联合测量的能力。通过分析ATNF星表中的历史glitch事件，我们量化了当前和下一代引力波探测器网络的双探测前景，并以2024年Vela脉冲星glitch的外推作为示例，探讨在双非探测情况下可给出的天体物理限制。我们发现，包含至少一个下一代探测器的网络会显著提高许多已知glitch脉冲星的双探测概率，并将glitch能量探测阈值相对现有LIGO探测器改善近两个数量级。此外，包含至少一个下一代探测器的网络在双非探测时，可对脉冲星性质给出显著改进的限制。

English: The internal mechanisms that drive the sudden change in rotation frequency in pulsar glitches could emit gravitational waves (GWs) at multiple time scales. The potential for GW analyses to detect both long and short forms of emission ("tCW-like" and "burst-like") improves as the detectors increase in sensitivity. We aim to examine how future detectors fare in making this joint measurement. By examining past glitches from the ATNF catalog, we quantify the double-detectability prospects of current- and next-generation GW detector networks. We further explore what astrophysical constraints could be placed following a double non-detection using extrapolations from the 2024 Vela pulsar glitch as a stand-in example. We find that a network with at least one next-generation detector greatly increases the probability of double-detection for many known glitching pulsars and improves the detection threshold in glitch energy by nearly two orders of magnitude over existing LIGO detectors. Additionally, double non-detections with networks with at least one next-generation detector could place dramatically improved limits on properties of the pulsar.

Horndeski理论中暗物质晕的解析与数值研究

Analytic and numerical study of dark matter halos in the Horndeski theory

Kohei Onoda, Shun Arai, Daisuke Yamauchi, Shuichiro Yokoyama, Shogo Masaki, Kenji Hasegawa · astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：能够解释宇宙晚期加速膨胀的修改引力模型必须通过局部引力实验，并引入屏蔽机制以在恒星尺度压制额外的第五力。暗物质晕由于尺度延展，可能在小尺度上出现屏蔽转变，从而成为检验修改引力和晚期加速起源的探针。本文对Horndeski理论中具有Vainshtein屏蔽的暗物质晕进行综合研究。在冷暗物质和球对称暗晕假设下，我们解析澄清了Vainshtein屏蔽有效发挥作用的暗晕轮廓条件。我们发现，当暗晕中心附近的轮廓趋近于核状结构时，即使在Vainshtein半径内，Vainshtein屏蔽也较不有效；这促使我们推测，由第五力导致的一些特征可能在暗晕动力学演化中存活。我们通过对孤立暗晕的N体模拟数值检验该推测，假设牛顿两体相互作用并加上球对称外部第五力。我们使用流体静力学、Jeans方程和引力透镜三种质量代理；在作为广义相对论弱场近似的牛顿引力情形下，它们必须完全相同。我们发现，在（准）平衡时这些代理彼此之间可以存在偏置，定量表明基准引力模型不是牛顿引力。我们的结果肯定地表明，来自观测的多个质量代理能够在暗晕尺度上检验引力。

English: The models of modified gravity that can explain the late-time accelerated expansion of the Universe must pass the local tests of gravity, introducing a screening mechanism so that any additional fifth force in gravity is suppressed at stellar scales. Dark matter halos, in contrast, by their extendedness in scale, may exhibit a transition of screening to small scales, providing a probe of modified gravity and the origin of the late-time acceleration. We perform comprehensive studies of dark matter halos with Vainshtein screening in the Horndeski theory. Given that dark matter is cold and a dark matter halo is spherically symmetric, we analytically clarify the conditions for the halo profile under which the Vainshtein screening works effectively. We find that the Vainshtein screening is less effective even within the Vainshtein radius as the profile approaches a core-like structure around the center of a halo, which motivates us to postulate that some features owing to the fifth force can survive during the dynamical evolution of a halo. We numerically examine our postulate by a $N$-body simulation for an isolated halo with the assumption of Newtonian two-body interactions with the spherical external fifth force. We make use of three proxies of the mass through hydrostatic dynamics, the Jeans equation, and gravitational lensing, all of which must be identical in the case of Newtonian gravity as a weak-field approximation to General Relativity. We find that these proxies can be biased relative to each other at a (quasi) equilibrium, quantitatively indicating that the fiducial model of gravity is not Newtonian. Our result affirmatively suggests that multiple mass proxies from observations are capable of testing gravity on halo scales.

中文摘要：本文对旋转黑洞的引力透镜效应进行建模，并在强场区域数值积分零测地线方程。通过比较不同自旋参数 a 下扩展源的像位置和形状，识别黑洞自旋参数的观测特征。对于银河系中心黑洞，区分真实源位置与引力透镜像位置需要约数百微角秒的角分辨率；而利用引力透镜确定该黑洞自旋参数则需要低于一微角秒的角分辨率。

English: Gravitational lensing by rotating black holes is modeled, and the null geodesic equations in the strong field regime are integrated numerically. Observational signatures of the black hole spin parameter are identified by comparing image locations and shapes of extended sources at different a values. For the black hole at the center of our galaxy, angular resolutions of the order of hundreds of micro arc seconds are needed to distinguish between the true source position and gravitationally lensed image position. Angular resolution below one micro arc second is needed to determine the spin parameter of the galactic black hole using gravitational lensing.

Simulating dust collapse: the impact of gauge choices on primordial black hole formation

Robyn L. Munoz, Christian T. Byrnes, Marco Bruni, Ian Hawke · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：我们研究物质主导时期尘埃坍缩的数值相对论模拟为何常在原初黑洞形成前因数值限制和不恰当规范选择而失败。利用三维全非线性尘埃流体模拟，我们详述先进数值方法的优势以及 lapse 和 shift 演化方程的影响。挑战有两方面：1）传统 lapse 切片演化方程在典型黑洞模拟中非常有效，但在宇宙学语境中必须调整；我们展示不同提议的 lapse 演化方程的表现，从而进行公平比较，并提出我们自己的方案。2）shift 演化方程的作用是分散数值网格观测者以稳定模拟，但 Gamma-driver 演化在尘埃流体壳层聚焦时失败。我们表明 shift damping 选择依赖于壳层聚焦区域的分辨率，提示未来工作应采用空间变化的 damping。改进的规范选择使模拟能显著推进更远，并有可能达到黑洞形成；表现最好的模拟接近黑洞，但还需进一步研究规范选择才能稳定。

English: We investigate why numerical relativity simulations of dust collapse in a matter-dominated era frequently fail before primordial black hole formation due to numerical limitations and inappropriate gauge choices. Using 3-dimensional fully non-linear simulations of a dust fluid, we detail the advantages of advanced numerical methods and the impact of the lapse and shift evolution equations. The challenge is twofold: 1) conventional lapse slicing evolution equations, highly effective in typical black hole simulations, must be adapted in a cosmological context. We demonstrate how different proposed lapse evolution equations perform, enabling fair comparison, and propose our own. 2) The shift evolution equation's role is to spread out the numerical grid observers for a stable simulation. However, the Gamma-driver evolution fails when confronted with shell-focussing of the dust fluid. We show how the shift damping choice depends on the resolution of the shell-focusing region, suggesting that future work should have spatially varying damping. Our improved gauge choices allow simulations to evolve significantly further and potentially reach black hole formation. The best-performing simulations reach close proximity to a black hole; however, further work on the gauge choice is required for this to be stable.

一句话导读：三维数值相对论表明，改进 lapse/shift 规范可让尘埃坍缩模拟更接近原初黑洞形成，但壳层聚焦处仍需空间变化阻尼。

Uniqueness of Static Black Holes in Lovelock Gravity

Chanchal Sharma, Sudipta Sarkar · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：黑洞唯一性是广义相对论的基本预言之一：球对称 Schwarzschild–Tangherlini 时空是 Einstein 方程唯一规则、渐近平直、静态真空黑洞解。本文证明 Lovelock 引力中微扰意义下有类似结果。在适当的正质量刚性假设下，任何位于允许关于广义相对论做规则 Taylor 展开的 generic 分支上的规则、渐近平直、静态真空 Lovelock 黑洞解，在固定 ADM 质量下，由相应的球对称 Lovelock 黑洞解唯一确定。特别地，Einstein–Gauss–Bonnet 引力不存在与 Schwarzschild–Tangherlini 微扰连接的非球对称静态分支，唯一解为 Boulware–Deser。同样的递归机制可推广到完整 Lovelock 类。结果表明静态黑洞唯一性可超越广义相对论，并非 Einstein 方程特有。

English: Black hole uniqueness is one of the fundamental predictions of general relativity: the spherically symmetric Schwarzschild--Tangherlini spacetime is the unique regular, asymptotically flat, static vacuum black hole solution of Einstein's equations. We show that an analogous result holds perturbatively in Lovelock gravity. Assuming the appropriate positive-mass rigidity statement, any regular, asymptotically flat, static vacuum black hole solution of Lovelock gravity on a generic branch admitting a regular Taylor expansion about general relativity is uniquely determined, at fixed ADM mass, by the corresponding spherically symmetric Lovelock black hole solution. In particular, Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity admits no distinct nonspherical static branch perturbatively connected to Schwarzschild--Tangherlini, and the unique solution is Boulware--Deser. The same recursive mechanism extends to the full Lovelock class. Our result shows that static black hole uniqueness can extend beyond general relativity and is not a property peculiar to the Einstein equations.

一句话导读：证明在 Lovelock 引力微扰框架下，静态渐近平直真空黑洞在固定 ADM 质量下由球对称 Lovelock 解唯一确定。

在天体物理与暗物质环境中建模极端质量比旋近

Modeling extreme mass-ratio inspirals in astrophysical and dark-matter environments

Dongjun Li, Hao-Jui Kuan, Colin Weller, Chaoyi Yang, Kelvin Ka-Ho Lam, Patrick Bourg, Adrian Ka-Wai Chung, Yanbei Chen, Nicol\'as Yunes, Huan Yang · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：极端质量比旋近是探测大质量黑洞及其环境的强有力工具，但解读其信号需要准确的轨道动力学与辐射模型。本文汇集黑洞微扰论进展，建立统一相对论框架，用于微扰天体物理环境中的绝热旋近。该框架基于修改的Teukolsky形式，不需要后牛顿近似或慢转近似。作为首个应用，我们计算了围绕被同步超轻标量云包围的旋转黑洞、沿圆轨道赤道面旋近时的领头云致引力波通量修正与保守轨道动力学修正，并将这些修正与先前计算的标量响应结合。在基准系统中，包含黑洞质量10^{-4}的云在两年内产生约-57.3弧度的轨道退相位。引力波通量修正与背景致轨道移动的相位贡献在幅度上各自超过标量贡献，并部分抵消，凸显了耦合物质-引力建模的必要性。该框架可推广到其他环境和修改引力理论，为评估探测损失与参数偏差、以及利用未来空间引力波观测探测黑洞环境本质提供所需的相对论输入。

English: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals offer a powerful probe of massive black holes and their environments, but interpreting their signals requires accurate models of orbital dynamics and radiation. Here we bring together advances in black-hole perturbation theory to establish a unified relativistic framework for adiabatic inspirals in perturbative astrophysical environments. Built on the modified Teukolsky formalism, the framework requires neither post-Newtonian nor slow-rotation approximations. As a first application, we calculate the leading cloud-induced corrections to gravitational-wave fluxes and conservative orbital dynamics for circular, equatorial inspirals around a rotating black hole surrounded by a synchronized ultralight scalar cloud, combining these corrections with the previously calculated scalar response. In our fiducial system, a cloud containing $10^{-4}$ of the black-hole mass produces about $-57.3$ radians of orbital dephasing over two years. The phase contributions from gravitational-wave flux corrections and background-induced orbital shifts each exceed the scalar contribution in magnitude and partially cancel, highlighting the need for coupled matter-gravity modeling. Extensible to other environments and modified gravity theories, our framework provides the relativistic inputs needed to assess detection losses and parameter biases, and to probe the nature of black-hole environments with future space-based gravitational-wave observations.

一句话导读：建立无需后牛顿或慢转近似的修改Teukolsky框架，计算暗物质标量云环境下EMRI轨道与引力波通量修正。

Geodesics in Black-Hole Spacetimes: A Qualitative Classification Using Vieta's Formulae

Oliver F. Piattella · gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：本专著在不求解转折点的情况下，对 Schwarzschild、Kerr 和 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞的测地线进行分类。三种时空中径向与极角运动由多项式控制，其系数只依赖运动常数，测地线的定性行为由根的模式决定。作者利用韦达公式、判别式、笛卡尔符号法则以及多项式在视界和无穷远处的取值，直接从系数读出根的模式。文中给出 Schwarzschild 时空中非径向测地线径向根倒数之和为 1/(2M)、束缚轨道第三根的闭式以及分界线 p=6+2e；在 Kerr 时空中讨论径向束缚轨道的条件、涡旋测地线无径向转折点、球轨道稳定性、赤道 ISCO、光环和光子壳；在 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 时空中讨论五次径向多项式、束缚分支条件以及边际稳定圆轨道位于 6M 之外。作者指出多数结果已知，目的是展示一条初等代数路径可统一得到这些结果，面向修过广义相对论入门课程的研究生，每章附有例题。

English: This monograph classifies the geodesics of the Schwarzschild, Kerr and Schwarzschild-de Sitter black holes without solving for their turning points. In all three spacetimes, the radial and polar motions are governed by polynomials whose coefficients depend only on the constants of motion, and the qualitative behavior of a geodesic is fixed by the pattern of their roots. We read this pattern directly off the coefficients, using Vieta's formulae together with the discriminant, Descartes' rule of signs, and the values of the polynomials at the horizons and at infinity. In Schwarzschild spacetime, the reciprocals of the radial roots of every non-radial geodesic add up to $1/(2M)$, which gives the third root of a bound orbit in closed form and the separatrix $p=6+2e$. In Kerr spacetime, the signs of the coefficients show that no radially bound orbit has $\varepsilon^2\geq1$ and that vortical geodesics, timelike or null, have no radial turning point; a positive discriminant is necessary but not sufficient for bound motion, and Descartes' rule applied at the event horizon gives the exact criterion. Spherical orbits and their stability, the equatorial ISCO and light rings, and the photon shell follow from the same relations. In Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetime, the timelike radial polynomial is a quintic with exactly one negative root, a bound branch requires $\varepsilon^2+\Lambda L^2/3<1$, and both marginally stable circular orbits lie beyond $6M$. Most of these results are known; the aim is to show that a single, elementary algebraic route leads to all of them. The text is meant for graduate students who have taken a first course in general relativity, and each chapter ends with worked examples.

一句话导读：用韦达公式、判别式和符号法则对 Schwarzschild、Kerr 与 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 黑洞测地线作统一的定性代数分类。

引力波作为多流体宇宙学的探针：一般形式与宇宙学停滞情形

Gravitational Waves as a Probe of Multi-Fluid Cosmologies: General Formalism and the Case of Cosmological Stasis

Keith R. Dienes, Fazlollah Hajkarim, Lucien Heurtier, Fei Huang, Kuver Sinha, Brooks Thomas, Tao Xu · astro-ph.CO, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-19

中文摘要：标量诱导引力波可用于探测大爆炸之前宇宙的膨胀历史，其产生依赖早期宇宙一阶标量扰动的演化，传播则依赖背景状态方程。本文将相关讨论推广到包含多种流体的宇宙学，指出多流体宇宙学中的引力波信号会受到两类修正：一是存在单流体情形没有的新速度效应，二是进入视界早于多流体时代结束的模式在后续红移中发生显著改变。因此，标量诱导引力波不仅能探测整体膨胀速率，也能探测多流体组成。作为示例，文章考虑宇宙学停滞时期产生的引力波；该时期不同状态方程能量组分的丰度保持恒定，从而给出恒定的有效状态方程，但宇宙仍是多流体。作者发现，尽管状态方程恒定，这类停滞宇宙学仍产生张量功率谱和今日引力波丰度，且与标准辐射主导宇宙的预期显著不同。

English: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) provide a powerful probe of the expansion history of the universe prior to the Big Bang. Indeed, the production of such gravity waves depends on the evolution of first-order scalar perturbations within the early universe, while their subsequent propagation depends on the background equation of state. In this paper we extend previous discussions by studying SIGWs in cosmologies containing multiple fluids. As we shall demonstrate, the gravitational-wave signal within such multi-fluid cosmologies is modified in two distinct ways: not only are there new velocity effects which have no single-fluid analogues, but there are also significant alterations to the subsequent redshifting of modes that enter the horizon before the multi-fluid era ends. Thus SIGWs provide a probe of not only the overall expansion rate within such cosmologies, but also their internal multi-fluid composition. As an example, we then consider the case of gravitational waves arising during an epoch of cosmological stasis. During such an epoch, the abundances of energy components with different equations of state remain constant, thereby giving rise to a universe with a constant effective equation of state which nevertheless remains genuinely multi-fluid despite cosmological expansion. Despite their constant equations of state, we find that such stasis cosmologies also give rise to tensor power spectra and present-day gravitational-wave abundances which are significantly different from those expected within a standard radiation-dominated universe.

一句话导读：研究多流体宇宙学中标量诱导引力波的产生与红移，并以宇宙学停滞期为例表明其张量谱和今日丰度显著偏离辐射主导情形。

中文摘要：我们提出了一个低使用门槛的数值代码 LazyTB，它在 ADM 表述下求解 Einstein 方程，用于处理具有任意数量流体的广义球对称问题；这些流体具有用户定义的状态方程，并可选地通过 drag-vector 介导相互作用。我们以精心选择的无量纲变量给出 ADM 方程，通过解析消去潜在发散项来避免一些数值不稳定性。我们通过若干示例展示该代码，包括标准 LTB 模型、包含辐射和暗物质的模型、具有非零声速的多方暗能量模型，以及耦合相互作用的暗物质和暗能量模型。我们还实现了一套诊断工具，包括光线追踪算法，使得能够从模拟中提取物理可观测量，例如任意位置观测者对应的光度距离。该代码被设计为易于扩展，也可用于本文示例之外的晚宇宙应用。LazyTB 可在 https://github.com/ollijvaisanen/LazyTB 获取。

English: We present a low entry barrier numerical code LazyTB that solves the Einstein equations in the ADM-formulation for a general spherically symmetric problem with an arbitrary number of fluids with user defined equations of state and optional interactions between the fluids mediated by drag-vectors. We present the ADM equations in terms of carefully chosen dimensionless variables that avoid some numerical instabilities by analytic cancellation of potentially diverging terms. We demonstrate the code by applying it to a number of examples including the standard LTB model, a model with radiation and dark matter, a polytropic dark energy model with a non-vanishing sound speed and a model with coupled interacting dark matter and dark energy. We also implement a suite of diagnostic tools, including ray-tracing algorithms, that allow extracting physical observables such as luminosity distances for observers at arbitrary locations from the simulations. The code is built to be easy to extend also beyond the late-universe applications considered in the examples of this paper. LazyTB is available at https://github.com/ollijvaisanen/LazyTB.

中文摘要：宇宙中绝大多数大质量双星系统显然不适合产生并合双黑洞。然而，最近已经识别出若干条通向此目标的孤立大质量双星窄演化路径。由于先前对这些路径的建模高度简化并采用假设，结论迄今仍不明确。对于其中一条路径——稳定质量转移通道——我们现在构建了详细的双星演化模型，包括内部较差自转以及恒星之间的质量和角动量转移，从零龄主序一直到黑洞形成，仅跳过快速晚期燃烧阶段。这使我们能够追踪吸积质量组分的质量和化学结构演化；结果表明，该组分对反向质量转移阶段有关键影响，使得所得到的黑洞自旋和质量比自然落入在 10--25M⊙ 主黑洞质量范围内观测到的引力波源区域。对于这一通道，也已知大量祖先双星，因此我们得出结论：它可能对观测到的引力波源族群有贡献。

English: The vast majority of massive binary systems in the universe is evidently unsuited to produce merging binary black holes. However, several narrow evolutionary paths of isolated massive binaries towards this goal have recently been identified. Due to the high degree of simplification and assumptions applied in previous modelling of these paths, conclusions remained vague so far. For one of these paths, the stable mass transfer channel, we now construct detailed binary evolution models which include internal differential rotation as well as mass and angular momentum transfer between the stars, all the way from the zero-age main sequence to the formation of the black holes, only skipping the rapid late burning stages. This allows us to follow the mass and chemical structure evolution of the mass accreting component, which turns out to have a key influence on the phase of reverse mass transfer, that allows the obtained black hole spins and mass ratios to naturally fall into the regime observed for the gravitational-wave source in the 10--25$M_\odot$ primary black hole mass range. As for this channel, also a large number of progenitor binaries are known, we conclude that it likely contributes to the observed population of gravitational wave sources.

Electrically charged regular black holes in higher dimensions: Maxwellian limit, branch point of the Lagrangian, and thermodynamics

Bobir Toshmatov, Bobomurat Ahmedov, Nozima Isamadinova, Ozodbek Rahimov, Chengxun Yuan · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：在广义相对论与非线性电动力学耦合中，带电正则黑洞已知需要双值拉格朗日密度 L(F)，其支点位于电磁不变量取极值的半径处。我们将此类黑洞构造推广到任意时空维度 D≥4，得到用单个非线性参数 γ 统一 Bardeen 与 Hayward 黑洞的新解析解族。证明当且仅当 γ=D-3 时恢复弱场麦克斯韦极限，因此四维中不具备该极限的 Bardeen/Hayward 黑洞，分别在五维和六维中变为麦克斯韦型。物质部分用对偶 P 框架写成仅含固定耦合常数的哈密顿密度 H(P)，黑洞质量和电荷成为固定理论的积分常数；正则解构成质量与电荷相联系的单参数子族。我们以闭式定位 L(F) 的支点，发现四维中支点总隐藏在事件视界内，而 D≥5 时对于近极端电荷支点可从视界露出并被远处观测者看到。零能量条件与弱能量条件处处满足，强能量条件仅在视界内被破坏，主能量条件仅在 γ>D-3 时于大距离处被破坏。最后，由于理论固定，黑洞热力学第一定律保持标准形式；我们给出闭式的视界势、以耦合为热力学变量的扩展第一定律及相应的 Smarr 公式。

English: Electrically charged regular black holes in general relativity coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics are known to require a double-valued Lagrangian density $L(F)$, with a branch point at the radius where the electromagnetic invariant attains its extremum. We extend the construction of such black holes to an arbitrary number of spacetime dimensions $D\geq4$ and obtain a new family of solutions that unifies the Bardeen and Hayward black holes in a single analytic form, with a single nonlinearity parameter $\gamma$. We show that the Maxwellian weak-field limit is recovered if and only if $\gamma=D-3$, so that the Bardeen and Hayward black holes, which lack this limit in four dimensions, become Maxwellian in five and six dimensions, respectively. The matter sector is written in the dual $P$ framework as a Hamiltonian density $H(P)$ that contains only fixed coupling constants, so that the mass and the charge of the black hole appear as integration constants of a fixed theory; the regular solutions form a one-parameter subfamily in which the mass is tied to the charge. We locate the branch point of $\L(F)$ in closed form and find that it is always hidden inside the event horizon in four dimensions, whereas for $D\geq5$ it emerges from the horizon for near-extremal charges and becomes visible to a distant observer. The null and weak energy conditions are satisfied everywhere, the strong energy condition is violated only inside the horizon, and the dominant energy condition is violated at large distances only for $\gamma>D-3$. Finally, since the theory is fixed, the first law of black hole thermodynamics holds in its standard form; we derive the horizon potential in closed form, the extended first law with the couplings as thermodynamic variables, and the corresponding Smarr formula.

一句话导读：将带电正则黑洞推广到高维，用单一参数统一 Bardeen/Hayward 解并分析麦克斯韦极限、拉格朗日支点与热力学。

Quadrupole and quadratic-in-spin effects in quasicircular, spinning, asymmetric binaries

Mostafizur Rahman, Misbah Shahzadi, Adam Pound, Josh Mathews · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：下一代引力波探测器将要求对当前理论波形模型作出显著改进，尤其是在非对称质量双星情形。为此，我们通过计算小质量比下的完全相对论有限尺寸效应——主要是能量通量——提供了一项此类改进，其中包括次天体自旋二次项、自旋诱导四极矩项和潮汐诱导四极矩项，针对一个小伴星沿准圆轨道旋入 Kerr 黑洞的情形。我们在自引力理论的多尺度波形生成框架内进行这些计算；结合我们推导的能量平衡定律，该框架可用于为涉及恒星绕黑洞运动的非对称双星构建自洽的波形模型。我们的结果还可用于改进所有质量比下的其他类型波形模型。我们以 Chebyshev 网格上的完整数值数据集，以及解析后牛顿展开（相对于通量中每一项的领头项到六阶后牛顿阶）的形式给出结果。

English: Next-generation gravitational-wave detectors will require significant improvements in current theoretical waveform models, particularly in the case of asymmetric-mass binaries. Here we provide one such improvement by calculating fully relativistic finite-size effects for small mass ratios -- primarily, fluxes of energy -- including quadratic-in-secondary-spin terms, spin-induced quadrupole terms, and tidally induced quadrupole terms, for quasicircular inspirals of a small companion into a Kerr black hole. We formulate these calculations within a multiscale waveform-generation framework in self-force theory, which could be used, with an energy-balance law we derive, to develop self-contained waveform models for asymmetric binaries involving stars orbiting black holes. Our results could additionally be used to improve other families of waveform models across all mass ratios. We present results both as complete numerical data sets on a Chebyshev grid and as analytical post-Newtonian expansions (to sixth PN order relative to the leading term in each contribution to the flux).

Extended parameterized spin expansion formalism for ringdown analysis with GW250114

Jia-Ning Chen, Liang-Bi Wu, Zong-Kuan Guo · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：黑洞准正规模谱的参数化描述对于利用铃宕观测检验引力至关重要。我们扩展了参数化自旋展开系数（ParSpec）形式，同时采样特征长度尺度 $\tilde{\ell}$ 和标度指数 $\tilde{p}$，而不是将 $\tilde{p}$ 固定为理论动机的整数并约束 $\tilde{\ell}$。物理上，这一扩展将来自高阶曲率算符的谱修正标度提升为可观测量。方法上，它使我们能够研究扩大的 ParSpec 参数空间，并识别由有效耦合 $\gamma$ 条件所诱导的先验几何。我们使用 220 和 220+221 铃宕模型、不同起始时间，并对 GW250114 的质量和光度采用信息先验，考察该框架的稳健性，还进一步研究了与 GW231123 的联合约束。我们指出，在所考虑的耦合规定中，$\gamma<1$ 可避免 $\tilde{p}$ 与 $\tilde{\ell}$ 之间的人为相关性，并且在 ParSpec 框架中铃宕起始时间和 QNM 模式内容的选择应与数据的信息量和分辨能力相匹配。需要更高信噪比的铃宕和更大事件样本的层级分析来打破 $\tilde{p}$-$\tilde{\ell}$ 简并，并直接探测对 GR 修正的标度结构。

English: Parameterized descriptions of black-hole quasinormal-mode spectra are essential for testing gravity with ringdown observations. We extend the Parameterized Spin Expansion Coefficients (ParSpec) formalism by simultaneously sampling the characteristic length scale $\tilde{\ell}$ and the scaling index $\tilde{p}$, rather than fixing $\tilde{p}$ to a theory-motivated integer and constraining $\tilde{\ell}$. Physically, this extension promotes the scaling of the spectral corrections coming from higher-curvature operators to an observable quantity. Methodologically, it enables us to investigate the enlarged ParSpec parameter space and identify the prior geometry induced by conditions on the effective coupling $\gamma$. We examine the robustness of the framework by using the $220$ and $220+221$ ringdown models over different start times with informative priors on mass and luminosity for GW250114, and further study a joint constraint with GW231123. We pointed out that $\gamma<1$ avoids an artificial correlation between $\tilde{p}$ and $\tilde{\ell}$ among the coupling prescriptions considered, and the choices of ringdown starting time and QNM mode content in the ParSpec framework should be matched to the information content and resolving power of the data. Higher-SNR ringdowns and hierarchical analyses of a larger event population will be required to break the $\tilde{p}$-$\tilde{\ell}$ degeneracy and directly probe the scaling structure of corrections to GR.

一句话导读：扩展 ParSpec 形式，将高阶曲率修正的标度指数与长度尺度同时作为可观测量，用于 GW250114 铃宕检验引力。

浸没在精质流体和弦云中的带电黑弦

Charged black string immersed in a quintessence fluid and string cloud

Leonardo G. Barbosa, Franciele M. da Silva · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们提出了一个描述浸没在 Kiselev 型精质流体和弦云中的带电黑弦的新静态解。对一般的精质状态参数求解了度规和场方程，并对物理上相关的 w_q = -2/3 情形给出了显式结果。我们分析了事件视界结构和 Kretschmann 标量，检验了能量条件约束，并推导了热力学性质，包括 Hawking 温度、热容和 Helmholtz 自由能。最后，我们研究了圆轨道零测地线的外部光子柱的存在性，发现在这里采用的参数假设下，外视界之外不存在这样的光子柱。该解通过同时包含精质和弦云参数，推广了已知的带电黑弦时空。

English: We present a new static solution describing a charged black string immersed in a Kiselev-type quintessence fluid and a string cloud. The metric and field equations are solved for a general quintessence state parameter, with explicit results provided for the physically relevant case $w_q = -2/3$. We analyze the event-horizon structure and the Kretschmann scalar, verify energy-condition constraints, and derive thermodynamic properties including the Hawking temperature and heat capacity and the Helmholtz free energy. Finally, we investigate the existence of an exterior photon cylinder for circular null geodesics, finding that, under the parameter assumptions adopted here, no such cylinder occurs outside the outer horizon. The solution generalizes known charged black-string spacetimes by simultaneously including quintessence and a string-cloud parameter.

一句话导读：构造含 Kiselev 精质与弦云的带电黑弦静态精确解，并分析其视界结构、Kretschmann 标量、能量条件、热力学性质与外部光子柱存在性。

Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞周围类时轨道的解析解

Analytical solutions for timelike orbits around Damour-Solodukhin wormholes

Shao-Chen Ho, Yo-Chung Ko, Tien Hsieh, Da-Shin Lee · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们研究 Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞周围的类时测地线，这类虫洞是 Schwarzschild 型几何，由形变参数 λ 刻画，该参数决定喉部半径 r_th。径向势有四个根，其中包括喉部半径本身，使得喉部可以与其他根合并，形成二重、三重和四重简并。与喉部相关的三重根构型原则上可以确定最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO），这提供了与 Schwarzschild 黑洞潜在观测区分。使用 Mino 时间参数化，我们推导了束缚和非束缚运动的粒子轨迹，以不完全椭圆积分的闭式解析解表示。我们关注喉部处二重或三重根的位置，此时当粒子接近喉部时，轨道运动的方位角和坐标时间表现出对数或幂律发散。相反，当喉部对应单根时，轨迹保持正则，允许粒子在两个渐近平坦区域之间平滑穿越。我们还推导了与喉部相关的精确同宿解，并计算了相应的 Lyapunov 指数。此外，分析了穿过喉部的旋近和落入轨迹。这些结果为粒子动力学和虫洞可能的观测特征提供了分析洞见。

English: We investigate timelike geodesics around Damour-Solodukhin wormholes, which are Schwarzschild-like geometries characterized by a deformation parameter $\lambda$ that determines the radius of the throat, $r_{\rm th}$. The radial potential admits four roots, including the throat radius itself, allowing the throat to merge with other roots and form double, triple, and quartic degeneracies. Triple-root configurations associated with the throat, in principle, can determine the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO), which provides a potential observational distinction from Schwarzschild black holes. Using the Mino-time parametrization, we derive particle trajectories with closed-form analytical solutions in terms of incomplete elliptic integrals for both bound and unbound motion. Our focus is on the location of double or triple roots at the throat, where the azimuthal angle and coordinate time of orbital motion show logarithmic or power-law divergence as the particle approaches the throat. By contrast, trajectories remain regular when the throat corresponds to a simple root, allowing particles to traverse smoothly between the two asymptotically flat regions. We also derive exact homoclinic solutions associated with the throat and compute the corresponding Lyapunov exponent. In addition, inspiral and plunge trajectories through the throat are analyzed. These results provide analytic insights into the particle dynamics and possible observational signatures of the wormholes.

一句话导读：本文给出 Damour-Solodukhin 虫洞周围类时测地线的解析解，并分析喉部简并、ISCO、同宿轨道与 Lyapunov 指数。

黏性恒星的径向振荡

Radial Oscillations of Viscous Stars

Lennox S. Keeble, Jaime Redondo-Yuste · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v3 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：中子星的振荡模式是第三代引力波探测器的关键目标，编码了其组成核物质的关键信息。在本工作中，我们研究黏性对冷、多方、球对称中子星振荡的影响。我们聚焦纯径向振荡，并在两个流体力学框架内微扰到线性阶：Eckart提出的Navier-Stokes方程的非因果协变推广，以及Bemfica、Disconzi、Noronha和Kovtun（BDNK）提出的因果推广。我们发现黏性在毫秒时标上阻尼径向模式，并引起振荡频率的分数偏移；该偏移随恒星的紧致度和黏性增加而增大，对于基本模式，当体黏性 ζ∼10^30 g/cm/s 时可达百分之一量级。对于黏性更大的恒星，振荡频率减小，当 ζ≳10^31 g/cm/s 时变为零（即过阻尼模式）。我们还研究了引力坍缩的线性阈值。与最近在零热导率极限下的解析结果一致，我们发现Eckart理论中的黏性无法稳定一个不稳定的无黏恒星。我们提供数值证据表明BDNK理论中的黏性同样无法阻止引力坍缩，但会略微修改坍缩阈值。总体而言，我们的结果推进了对黏性如何影响中子星振荡模式的理解，这是下一代引力波探测器时代黏性星震学的一个关键组成部分。

English: Oscillation modes of neutron stars, a key target for third-generation gravitational wave detectors, encode key information about their constituent nuclear matter. In this work, we study the effect of viscosity on oscillations of cold, polytropic, spherically symmetric neutron stars. We focus on purely radial oscillations and work perturbatively to linear order within two hydrodynamic frameworks: the acausal covariant generalization of the Navier-Stokes equations proposed by Eckart, and the causal generalization formulated by Bemfica, Disconzi, Noronha, and Kovtun (BDNK). We find that viscosity damps the radial modes on millisecond timescales and induces fractional shifts in the oscillation frequency which increase both with the compactness and viscosity of the star, reaching up to the percent level for the fundamental mode with bulk viscosities $\zeta\sim10^{30}\mathrm{g}/\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$. For more viscous stars, the oscillation frequency decreases, becoming zero (i.e., an overdamped mode) for $\zeta\gtrsim10^{31}\mathrm{g}/\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$. We also study the linear threshold of gravitational collapse. Consistent with recent analytic results in the zero heat conductivity limit, we find that viscosity in Eckart theory cannot stabilize an unstable inviscid star. We provide numerical evidence that viscosity in BDNK theory is similarly unable to prevent gravitational collapse, but it slightly modifies the threshold of collapse. Overall, our results advance our understanding of the impact of viscosity on the oscillation modes of neutron stars, a key component of viscous asteroseismology with next-generation gravitational wave detectors.

一句话导读：研究黏性对冷中子星径向振荡的阻尼与频率偏移，并论证Eckart和BDNK框架下黏性不能阻止引力坍缩。

使用有效单体框架建模偏心试验质量螺旋并入 Kerr 黑洞的并合-铃宕

Modeling the merger-ringdown of an eccentric test-mass inspiral into a Kerr black hole using the effective-one-body framework

Guglielmo Faggioli, Alessandra Buonanno, Maarten van de Meent, Gaurav Khanna · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们表征并唯象建模由一个小致密天体从赤道偏心旋进后俯冲并并入 Kerr 黑洞所发射引力波的并合-铃宕。波形通过时域 Teukolsky 码生成，其源轨迹由有效单体框架计算。我们扫描 Kerr 自旋 a∈[-0.9,0.9]、最后稳定轨道（LSO）处偏心率 e_LSO∈[0,0.9] 和相对论近点角 ξ_LSO∈[0,2π]。我们在参数空间中表征波形的最后一个峰值和铃宕特征，发现偏心率主要影响最后峰值特征，而对铃宕信号影响较小。相比之下，在 LSO 处测量的相对论近点角仅在参数空间的有限部分影响最后峰值的形态，且对铃宕部分没有影响。我们对通常包含在 SEOBNR 模型族中的所有自旋加权球谐模式进行了分析，即 (ℓ,m)∈{(2,2),(3,3),(4,4),(5,5),(2,1),(3,2),(4,3)}。最后，我们为 SEOB-TMLE 引入一个并合-铃宕模型；SEOB-TMLE 是一个即将提出的、用于试验质量极限下偏心自旋对齐双黑洞的旋进-并合-铃宕波形模型，其特征可推广到可比质量区域。该模型还考虑了铃宕期间的准正规模混合。它为将接近并合时的残余偏心率影响纳入自旋对齐的双黑洞有效单体并合-铃宕模型提供了第一步。

English: We characterize and phenomenologically model the merger-ringdown of gravitational waves emitted by a small compact object that plunges and merges into a Kerr black hole from equatorial-eccentric inspirals. The waveforms are generated employing a time-domain Teukolsky code sourced with trajectories computed using the effective-one-body framework. We span values of the Kerr spin $a\in[-0.9, 0.9] $, eccentricity at the last stable orbit (LSO) $ e_{\rm LSO} \in [0,0.9] $, and relativistic anomaly $ \xi_{\rm LSO} \in [0 , 2 \pi]$. We characterize the last peak of the waveform and ringdown features across the parameter space, finding that the eccentricity mainly affects the last peak features, while it has a smaller impact on the ringdown signal. In contrast, the relativistic anomaly measured at the LSO influences the morphology of the last peak in a restricted portion of the parameter space and has no impact on the ringdown part. We perform the analysis for all the spin-weighted spherical harmonic modes normally included in the $\texttt{SEOBNR}$ family of models, $(\ell,m)\in\{ (2,2), (3,3), (4,4), (5,5), (2,1), (3,2), (4,3)\}$. Finally, we introduce a merger-ringdown model for $\texttt{SEOB-TMLE}$, a forthcoming inspiral-merger-ringdown waveform model for eccentric spin-aligned binary black holes in the test-mass limit, whose features can be extended to comparable-mass regimes. The model also accounts for quasinormal mode mixing during the ringdown. It provides a first step toward incorporating the impact of residual eccentricity close to merger into spin-aligned effective-one-body merger-ringdown models for binary black holes.

Gravitational light deflection and shadows in a warm plasma

Barbora Bezd\v{e}kov\'a, Volker Perlick · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：紧凑天体（如黑洞或中子星）附近色散介质中光线偏折的解析研究，最大困难在于对介质的合适定义。最现实的模型是热磁化等离子体。然而在这种介质中，光线的解析描述非常困难。因此，解析计算通常假设各向同性色散介质。尽管可以为一般折射率写出方程（部分研究如此），文献中最受关注的是冷、非磁化电子-离子等离子体的特殊情况。虽然该模型涵盖许多天体物理相关情形，但有迹象表明在某些情况下等离子体温度高到冷等离子体近似不再成立。为此，本文考虑暖、非磁化电子-离子等离子体，其中温度不设为零，但假设足够小，使得相关方程可关于温度线性化。在讨论广义相对论时空上此类介质中光线的一般方程后，我们具体到轴对称且稳态情形，其中包含球对称且静态情形。特别地，我们计算暖等离子体对偏折角的影响。在球对称且静态情形，我们还计算暖等离子体中的阴影。我们用 Schwarzschild 和 Kerr 时空上的静态（或共转）以及落入暖等离子体来展示一般结果。

English: Analytical studies of light bending in a dispersive medium near compact objects, e.g., black holes or neutron stars, are most challenged by a suitable definition of the medium. The most realistic model would be a hot magnetized plasma. In such a medium, however, an analytical description of light rays is very difficult. Therefore, usually an isotropic dispersive medium is assumed in analytical calculations. While it is possible to formulate equations for a general refractive index, which some studies do, most attention in the literature is given to the particular case of a cold, non-magnetized electron-ion plasma. Whereas this model covers many astrophysically relevant situations, there are indications that in some cases the plasma temperature is so high that the approximation of a cold plasma is no longer valid. For this reason, we consider in this paper a warm, non-magnetized electron-ion plasma, where the temperature is not set equal to zero but assumed to be small enough, such that relevant equations can be linearized with respect to it. After discussing the general equations for light rays in such a medium on a general-relativistic spacetime, we specify to the axially symmetric and stationary case which includes the spherically symmetric and static case. In particular, we calculate the influence of a warm plasma on the bending angle. In the spherically symmetric and static case, we also calculate the shadow in a warm plasma. We illustrate the general results with a static (respectively corotating) and an infalling warm plasma on Schwarzschild and Kerr spacetimes.

利用内禀星体结构标度与降低状态方程模型依赖提取中子星中心声速

Extracting the Central Sound Speed of Neutron Stars through Intrinsic Stellar Structure Scaling with Reduced Equation-of-State Model Dependence

Jian-Hao Shi, Bao-Jun Cai, Yu-Gang Ma · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：推断中子星核心性质仍依赖于所假设的状态方程（EOS）。我们使用带广义 ω 介子自相互作用的非线性 Walecka 模型，构建六个 EOS 家族，每个包含 10^3 个样本，并施加相同的核物理与天体物理约束。尽管满足这些约束，各家族对高密度行为和核心性质的预言差异显著；更高阶 ω 相互作用也能在纯核子物质中产生内部声速峰。为降低这种模型依赖，我们利用无量纲 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程的内禀与微扰分析（IPAD-TOV），推导出与 EOS 无关的中心平方声速 s_c^2 估计量 Θ(X,Ψ)，其中 X=P_c/ε_c 是中心 EOS 参数，Ψ 刻画恒星质量对中心能量密度的响应。对典型 1.4 M⊙ 中子星，Θ 与 s_c^2 在各家族中线性相关（R^2≈0.94–0.99）。家族依赖关系收敛到共同最优：最小化离散度给出全部六个家族的 s_c^2≈0.523±0.044 和 X≈0.173^{+0.020}_{-0.018}，或排除无 ω 自相互作用家族后给出 s_c^2≈0.496±0.092 和 X≈0.167^{+0.030}_{-0.029}。相应半径分别为 11.73^{+1.08}_{-0.92} 和 11.92^{+1.76}_{-1.28} km（95% 置信区间）。对所有 EOS 样本拟合的统一标度支持这两组提取。这些结果表明，即使现有观测无法区分底层 EOS 描述，共同星体结构关系仍能以较低 EOS 模型依赖约束中子星核心性质。

English: Inferring neutron star (NS) core properties remains sensitive to the assumed equation of state (EOS). Using a nonlinear Walecka model with generalized $\omega$-meson self-interactions, we construct six EOS families, each containing $10^3$ samples subject to identical nuclear and astrophysical constraints. Despite satisfying these constraints, the families predict markedly different high-density behavior and core properties; higher-order $\omega$ interactions can also generate interior sound-speed peaks within purely nucleonic matter. To reduce this model dependence, we use the intrinsic and perturbative analysis of the dimensionless Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equations (IPAD-TOV) to derive an EOS-independent estimator $\Theta(\rm{X},\Psi)$ of the central squared sound speed $s_{\rm c}^2$, where $\rm{X}=P_{\rm c}/\varepsilon_{\rm c}$ is the central EOS-parameter and $\Psi$ characterizes the stellar-mass response to central energy density. For canonical $1.4\,M_\odot$ NSs, $\Theta$ correlates linearly with $s_{\rm c}^2$ across the families ($R^2\approx0.94$-$0.99$). The family-dependent relations converge toward a common optimum: minimizing their dispersion yields $s_{\rm c}^2\approx 0.523\pm0.044$ and $\rm{X}\approx 0.173^{+0.020}_{-0.018}$ for all six families, or $s_{\rm c}^2\approx 0.496\pm0.092$ and $\rm{X}\approx 0.167^{+0.030}_{-0.029}$ when the family without $\omega$ self-interaction is excluded. The corresponding radii are $11.73^{+1.08}_{-0.92}$ and $11.92^{+1.76}_{-1.28}\,\rm km$, respectively, with $95\%$ confidence intervals. A unified scaling fitted to all EOS samples supports both extractions. These results show how common stellar-structure relations can constrain NS core properties with reduced EOS-model dependence, even when existing observations cannot distinguish among the underlying EOS descriptions.

Einstein-Euler 系统的陷获面形成

Formation of Trapped Surfaces for the Einstein-Euler System

Xinliang An, Sifan Yu · math.AP, gr-qc, math-ph, math.DG, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们证明在 3+1 维中，超越球对称情形，Einstein--Euler 系统的陷获面形成。我们考虑短脉冲区域中的光滑特征初始数据，并带有快速流体注入。从没有陷获面的初始数据出发，我们得到两个陷获面形成的充分判据，分别对应剪切贡献和流体贡献。特别地，对于流体驱动的判据，我们不对剪切通量施加正下界。为了处理与引力波、声波和流体输运相关的多个传播速度，我们的分析结合三个要素：一个强制性流体能量流，其零通量反映不等的速度分量；适应物质项的曲率重整化；以及控制所有时空方向导数的加权几何估计。为确保仅流体注入即可导致陷获面形成，我们在一个设计的时空区域中使用粒子数守恒来控制聚焦过程，并获得所需的球面积分通量。

English: We prove the formation of trapped surfaces for the Einstein--Euler system in 3+1 dimensions beyond spherical symmetry. We consider smooth characteristic initial data in a short-pulse regime with rapid fluid injection. Starting from initial data containing no trapped surfaces, we obtain two sufficient criteria for trapped surface formation, corresponding to the shear and fluid contributions, respectively. In particular, for the fluid-driven criterion, we impose no positive lower bound on the shear flux. To handle the multiple propagation speeds associated with gravitational waves, sound waves, and fluid transport, our analysis combines three ingredients: a coercive fluid energy current whose null fluxes reflect the unequal velocity components, curvature renormalizations adapted to the matter terms, and weighted geometric estimates controlling derivatives in all spacetime directions. To ensure that fluid injection alone can lead to trapped surface formation, we use particle-number conservation in a designed spacetime region to control the focusing process and obtain the desired sphere-integrated fluxes.

一句话导读：证明超越球对称的 Einstein-Euler 系统在快速流体注入短脉冲数据下可形成陷获面，并给出剪切与流体驱动的充分判据。

因果一阶粘性中子星振荡中流体力学普适性的破坏

Breakdown of hydrodynamic universality in causal first-order viscous neutron star oscillations

Lennox S. Keeble, Alejandro C\'ardenas-Avenda\~no · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：对粘性中子星进行流体力学建模需要选择一种相对论流体力学理论。不同表述在长波极限下包含相同物理内容，这被称为“流体力学普适性”。最近研究表明，流体力学普适性会在径向中子星振荡中破坏：因果性和有限尺寸效应限制了足够粘性的星体进入长波普适流体力学区域。我们证明，这种破坏在 Bemfica–Disconzi–Noronha–Kovtun (BDNK) 理论中的广泛因果流体力学框架内都会发生。增加粘性会共同将这类因果框架推离 BDNK 的有效性区域，最终在体粘滞系数 ζ ~ 10^30–10^31 g/cm/s 时迫使所有框架都位于其外。这种普适性破坏伴随着振荡模式结构的实质性变化：非流体力学模式在可与流体力学模式相当的时间尺度上被阻尼，第一泛音可以比基模寿命更长，并且可能出现亚毫秒时间尺度的非物理不稳定性。即使在普适性已经破坏的区域，我们发现 BDNK 理论中引力坍缩的无粘阈值保持不变。这些结果提供证据表明，一阶相对论流体力学理论可能不足以模拟足够粘性的中子星。

English: Hydrodynamic modeling of viscous neutron stars requires a choice of theory of relativistic hydrodynamics. That distinct formulations contain the same physical content in the long-wavelength limit is referred to as ``hydrodynamic universality.'' It has been recently shown that hydrodynamic universality can break down in radial neutron star oscillations: causality and finite-size effects restrict access to the long-wavelength universal hydrodynamic regime in sufficiently viscous stars. We show that this breakdown occurs for a broad range of causal hydrodynamic frames in Bemfica--Disconzi--Noronha--Kovtun (BDNK) theory. Increasing viscosity collectively pushes this class of causal frames away from the BDNK regime of validity, eventually forcing all to lie outside it at bulk viscosities in the range $\zeta\sim10^{30}$--$10^{31}\mathrm{g}/\mathrm{cm}/\mathrm{s}$. This breakdown of universality is accompanied by material changes in the oscillation mode structure: non-hydrodynamic modes become damped on timescales comparable to those of hydrodynamic modes, the first overtone can become longer lived than the fundamental mode, and unphysical instabilities with sub-millisecond timescales can emerge. Even in regimes where universality has broken down, we find that the inviscid threshold of gravitational collapse remains unchanged in BDNK theory. These results provide evidence that first-order theories of relativistic hydrodynamics may be insufficient for modeling sufficiently viscous neutron stars.

一句话导读：在 BDNK 因果一阶粘性流体力学中，粘性中子星振荡会破坏流体力学普适性并显著改变模式结构，但无粘引力坍缩阈值不变。

中等偏心率的低质量黑洞-中子星并合数值模拟

Numerical simulations of low-mass black hole-neutron star mergers with moderate eccentricities

Ivan Markin, Gonzalo Morr\'as, Tim Dietrich · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：在黑洞-中子星系统的引力波信号中，若置信地探测到轨道偏心率，将强有力地指示其动力学形成起源。尽管最近已开发出偏心波形模型，但它们用于分析黑洞-中子星信号的有效性尚未通过数值相对论模拟得到检验。在我们此前对准圆黑洞-中子星并合研究的基础上，我们对其中一部分系统进行了模拟，其轨道偏心率约为GW200105_162426推断值的五倍。此外，我们还进行了含磁化物质的模拟，以评估被困g模振荡是否在强磁化吸积盘中持续存在。关于发出的引力波信号，我们发现有效单体波形模型SEOBNRv5EHM表现出合理的一致性，除非潮汐贡献变得重要；而仅旋进的后牛顿模型pyEFPE/pyEFPEHM在旋进后期表现出更大的偏差。对于等质量系统，其有效潮汐形变性最大，偏心潮汐修正对相位有虽小但可注意到的影响，约0.1 rad。我们发现偏心率对残余黑洞性质的影响几乎可以忽略，而残余盘质量差异可达两倍。吸积盘中的被困g模频率与偏心率无关，这证实它们主要取决于残余黑洞的性质。我们发现，当吸积盘被强磁化时，它们变得密度更低、结构更不明显，并且此前在未磁化情形中识别出的被困g模被有效地阻尼。

English: A confident detection of orbital eccentricity in gravitational-wave signals from black hole-neutron star systems would be a strong indicator of their dynamical formation origin. While eccentric waveform models have recently been developed, their validity for analyzing black hole--neutron star signals has yet to be tested against numerical-relativity simulations. Building upon our previous study of quasicircular black hole--neutron star mergers, we perform simulations of a subset of these systems with orbital eccentricities around five times larger than those inferred for GW200105_162426. Additionally, we perform simulations with magnetized matter to assess whether trapped $g$-mode oscillations persist in strongly magnetized disks. Regarding the emitted gravitational-wave signal, we find that the effective one-body waveform model SEOBNRv5EHM shows reasonable agreement unless tidal contributions become important, and the inspiral-only post-Newtonian models pyEFPE/pyEFPEHM show larger disagreement in the late inspiral. For the equal-mass system, which has the largest effective tidal deformability, eccentric tidal corrections have a small but noticeable impact on the phase, $\sim0.1$ rad. We find an almost negligible impact of eccentricity on the properties of the remnant black hole, and differences of up to a factor of two in the remnant disk mass. Trapped $g$ modes in the accretion disks have the same frequency regardless of the eccentricity, confirming that they depend mainly on the properties of the remnant black hole. We find that when accretion disks are strongly magnetized, they become less dense and have less pronounced structure, and that the trapped $g$ modes previously identified in the unmagnetized cases are efficiently damped.

磁荷黑洞的轴向引力准正规模式

Axial gravitational quasinormal modes of magnetically charged black holes

De-Cheng Zou, Xufen Zhang, Chao-Ming Zhang, Ming Zhang, Rui-Hong Yue · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：本文考虑磁荷弦启发Euler-Heisenberg黑洞上的轴向扰动。由于轴向度规扰动与轴向电磁扰动解耦，我们主要关注轴向引力扰动。利用WKB近似和AIM方法，通过改变引力扰动与黑洞的特征参数，详细分析引力准正规频率。发现AIM方法得到的结果与WKB方法以及时域剖面提取的结果吻合良好。用WKB方法计算灰体因子，并研究了参数 Q_m、ε 和多极数 l 对灰体因子的影响。

English: In this paper, we consider axial perturbations on the magnetically charged string-inspired Euler-Heisenberg black hole. Since axial metric perturbation decouples from axial electromagnetic perturbation, here we mainly focus on axial gravitational perturbation. By using WKB approximation and AIM methods, we make a detailed analysis of the gravitational quasinormal frequencies by varying the characteristic parameters of gravitational perturbation and black holes. It is found these results obtained through the AIM method are in good agreement with those of obtained by WKB method, including these results extracted from the time-domain profiles. The greybody factor is calculated by WKB method. The effects of these parameters $Q_m$, $\epsilon$ and multipole number $l$ on the greybody factor are also studied.

利用光子轨道角动量态量子层析的无位移噪声引力波探测器

Displacement-noise-free gravitational-wave detector using quantum tomography of photon orbital angular momentum states

Haorong Wu, Xilong Fan, Lixiang Chen · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM, physics.ins-det, physics.optics, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：引力波会在光子轨道角动量（OAM）态之间诱导量子跃迁，振幅为 α±。利用这一效应，我们提出一种无位移噪声的探测框架，从 OAM 希尔伯特空间提取引力波信息。对引力波诱导的 OAM 边带进行参数化量子态层析，使单个 V 形探测器能够分辨全部七个波参数：频率、传播方向、两个偏振振幅以及每个偏振的初相位。直接探测边带得到的信号约为 10^-15 W。因此引入更强的参考态 r|0>_P（r=0.01）以增强信号。对于臂长 L=4 m、往返次数 N=160、近轴参数 γ=0.1、入射光功率 P_BS=10 kW、波长 λ_opt=1064 nm 以及引力波振幅 A=10^-18，估计边带跃迁振幅 |α±|~10^-10，信号功率约 1 nW，并满足 P_BS α± ∝ P_BS A N L γ/λ_opt。散粒噪声极限灵敏度底为 S_n^{1/2}=1.6×10^-20 Hz^-1/2。由于该方案测量 OAM 跃迁振幅而非差分臂长，它本质上不受位移噪声影响，并提供宽带的引力波探测，尤其可衔接 0.1–10 Hz 中频间隙。

English: Gravitational waves (GWs) induce quantum transitions between photon orbital-angular-momentum (OAM) states with amplitudes $\alpha_{\pm}$. Exploiting this effect, we present a displacement-noise-free detection framework that extracts GW information from the OAM Hilbert space. Parametrized quantum state tomography of the GW-induced OAM sidebands enables a single V-shaped detector to resolve all seven wave parameters: the frequency, propagation direction, two polarization amplitudes, and initial phase of each polarization. Direct detection of the sidebands yields a weak signal of approximately $10^{-15}\,\mathrm{W}$. We therefore introduce a stronger reference state $r |0>_{\mathrm{P}}$, with $r=0.01$, to enhance the detected signal. For an arm length of $L=4\,\mathrm{m}$, $N=160$ round trips, a paraxial parameter of $\gamma=0.1$, an incident light power of $P_{\mathrm{BS}}=10\,\mathrm{kW}$, a wavelength of $\lambda_{\mathrm{opt}}=1064\,\mathrm{nm}$, and GW amplitudes of $A=10^{-18}$, we estimate sideband transition amplitudes of $|\alpha_{\pm}|\sim10^{-10}$ and signal powers of order $1\,\mathrm{nW}$, scaling as $P_{\mathrm{BS}}\alpha_{\pm}\propto P_{\mathrm{BS}}ANL\gamma/\lambda_{\mathrm{opt}}$. The shot-noise-limited sensitivity floor is $S^{1/2}_n=1.6\times10^{-20}\,\mathrm{Hz}^{-1/2}$. Because the scheme measures OAM transition amplitudes rather than differential arm lengths, it is intrinsically free from displacement noise and provides a broadband probe of GWs, specifically bridging the $0.1$--$10\,\mathrm{Hz}$ mid-frequency gap.

Optimal Strategies for Gravitational-Wave Memory Detection with Noise Marginalization in Pulsar Timing Arrays

Rand Burnette, Xavier Siemens · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：当前脉冲星计时阵列可能探测到引力波记忆，这将为广义相对论提供独特检验。为了优化脉冲星计时阵列中引力波记忆的搜索，我们将引力波记忆的最优频率派统计量集成到 enterprise 代码套件中。我们还测试了该统计量的噪声边缘化版本，并将其有效性更简单的最大后验方法进行比较。我们在包含红噪声和白噪声的模拟脉冲星计时阵列以及 NANOGrav 15 年数据集上进行这些测试。我们发现，对于模拟数据集，噪声边缘化方法和最大后验方法之间的探测统计量没有显著变化，而在 NANOGrav 15 年比较中仅有小变化。我们得出结论，对于现实的脉冲星计时阵列，噪声边缘化方法可能有助于为贝叶斯结果分配误报概率，尽管最大后验方法足以识别可能可探测的信号。

English: Current pulsar timing arrays could detect gravitational wave memory, which would provide a unique test of general relativity. In order to optimize our searches for gravitational wave memory in pulsar timing arrays, we integrate the optimal frequentist statistics for GW memory into the \texttt{enterprise} code suite. We additionally test a noise marginalized version of this statistic, and compare it's effectiveness to the simpler maximum posterior method. We perform these tests on simulated pulsar timing array with red and white noise content, as well as the NANOGrav $15$-year data set. We find no significant variations in our detection statistics between the noise-marginalized and the maximum-posterior methods for the simulated datasets, and only small variations in the NANOGrav $15$-year comparisons. We conclude that for realistic PTAs the noise-marginalization method could be useful for assigning a false alarm probability to Bayesian results, though the maximum posterior method is sufficient for identifying potentially detectable signals.

一句话导读：将引力波记忆的最优频率派统计量集成到 enterprise，并比较噪声边缘化与最大后验方法在模拟 PTA 和 NANOGrav 15 年数据中的表现。

带 NUT 荷的 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞

Ellis-Bronnikov wormholes with NUT charge

Masato Nozawa, Tomohiro Harada, Keisuke Nakashi · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们在 Einstein-phantom-scalar 系统中构造了 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞的精确 NUT 荷推广。该解是稳态的，两端渐近局部平坦，且无曲率奇点。它继承了 Taub-NUT 几何的特征，包括 Dirac-Misner 弦和闭合类时曲线，而没有 Killing 视界消除了视界导致的测地线无限缠绕，并使时空测地完备。通过允许 phantom 场具有带无限序列 AdS 真空的非平凡标量势，我们还获得了一个带 NUT 荷的精确渐近局部 AdS 虫洞，其在两端渐近区域之间插值不同真空。利用协变相空间形式，我们证明在适当的标量边界条件下，与两个渐近区域相关的哈密顿荷是有限的。通过双 Wick 旋转到欧几里得号差，我们证明所得度规的共形类具有 ambi-Kähler 结构。

English: We construct an exact NUT-charged generalization of the Ellis-Bronnikov wormhole in the Einstein-phantom-scalar system. The solution is stationary, asymptotically locally flat at both ends and free of curvature singularities. It inherits characteristic features of the Taub-NUT geometry, including the Dirac-Misner string and closed timelike curves, while the absence of Killing horizons eliminates the horizon-induced infinite winding of geodesics and renders the spacetime geodesically complete. By allowing the phantom field to have a nontrivial scalar potential with an infinite sequence of AdS vacua, we also obtain an exact asymptotically locally AdS wormhole with a NUT charge, which interpolates between different vacua at its two asymptotic ends. Using the covariant phase space formalism, we show that the Hamiltonian charges associated with the two asymptotic regions are finite under appropriate scalar boundary conditions. By performing a double Wick rotation to Euclidean signature, we demonstrate that the conformal class of the resulting metric admits an ambi-K\"ahler structure.

一句话导读：构造了带 NUT 荷的 Ellis-Bronnikov 虫洞精确解，包括渐近局部平坦和渐近局部 AdS 情形，并分析其因果/测地性质、守恒荷与欧几里得 ambi-Kähler 结构。

大 D 离散自相似坍缩中的 Polyakov 反作用

Polyakov backreaction in large D discretely self-similar collapse

Sheng-Hong Lai, Wen-Yu Wen · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们研究在大时空维度下，Einstein--Klein--Gordon 理论的一类离散自相似解析解上由反常诱导的半经典反作用。视界正则性固定了一个零坐标 Floquet 指数，并选出一个唯一的正则量子态。Polyakov 辅助场是仿射周期的而非周期的，其单值性由一个整体零模条件以及共形坐标标度独立确定。球对称约化引入的量子耦合向中心增长，因此周期一阶展开是非均匀的。我们构造由此产生的非线性内部问题，并找到一个临界伸缩子面。对该面的一般穿越是奇异的，而将其与正则零质量外部匹配则选出一个狭窄的高曲率喉。反常还使有效零能边界与经典物质流及零曲率曲线分离。这些结果表明，最小耦合 Polyakov 模型不能给出经典中心的一般光滑且精确自相似的补全。

English: We study anomaly-induced semiclassical backreaction on an analytic family of discretely self-similar solutions of Einstein--Klein--Gordon theory at large spacetime dimension. Horizon regularity fixes a null-coordinate Floquet exponent and selects a unique regular quantum state. The Polyakov auxiliary field is affine-periodic rather than periodic, with a monodromy that is determined independently by a global zero-mode condition and by the conformal-coordinate scaling. Spherical reduction introduces a quantum coupling that grows toward the center, so the periodic first-order expansion is nonuniform. We construct the resulting nonlinear inner problem and find a critical dilaton surface. Generic crossings of this surface are singular, whereas matching to the regular zero-mass exterior selects a narrow, high-curvature throat. The anomaly also separates the effective null-energy boundaries from the classical matter flux and zero-curvature curves. These results show that the minimally coupled Polyakov model does not yield a generic smooth, exactly self-similar completion of the classical center.

一句话导读：在大 D 下，最小耦合 Polyakov 反作用无法为离散自相似坍缩的经典中心提供一般光滑的精确自相似补全。

四阶后牛顿阶椭圆轨道的运动常数与基本频率：对齐自旋贡献

Constants of motion and fundamental frequencies for elliptic orbits at fourth post-Newtonian order: aligned-spin contributions

David Trestini, Jan Steinhoff · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：对于具有对齐自旋的偏心系统，我们计算了运动常数（能量和角动量）与基本（径向和方位角）频率之间规范不变的保守映射在四阶后牛顿阶的所有自旋贡献。这将 [arXiv:2511.10735] 中得到的无自旋映射扩展为包含自旋线性、二次、三次和四次项，以及相关的自旋形变参数。我们还得到了红移和陀螺不变量等派生量，以及圆轨道关系。我们注意到，决定最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）无量纲频率的 Blanchet-Iyer-Favata 后牛顿稳定性判据实际上与圆轨道的近星点进动密切相关。最后，对于非束缚轨道，我们用所有自旋贡献补全了 4PN 散射角。

English: For eccentric systems with aligned spins, we compute all spin contributions to the gauge-invariant conservative map between the constants of motion (energy and angular momentum) and the fundamental (radial and azimuthal) frequencies at the fourth post-Newtonian order. This extends the nonspinning map derived in [arXiv:2511.10735] to include terms that are linear, quadratic, cubic, and quartic in spin, as well as the associated spin-deformability parameters. We also obtain derived quantities such as the redshift and gyroscopic invariants, as well as circular links. We notice that the Blanchet-Iyer-Favata post-Newtonian stability criterion that determines the dimensionless frequency of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) is in fact intricately related to the periastron advance for circular orbits. Finally, in the case of unbound orbits, we complete the 4PN scattering angle with all spin contributions.

一句话导读：计算了对齐自旋偏心双星在 4PN 阶运动常数与基本频率之间的自旋修正映射，并关联 ISCO 稳定性与近星点进动，补全 4PN 散射角。

ACT 代表尴尬的宇宙学理论

ACT stands for Awkward Cosmology Theories

Loris Del Grosso, Alfredo Urbano, Marcello Ziccolella · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：最近的阿塔卡马宇宙学望远镜（ACT）观测与普朗克数据结合，倾向于一个与 Starobinsky 暴胀相冲突的标量谱指数。为调和 Starobinsky 暴胀与这些数据，已提出两种主要策略：(i) 在引力作用量中引入高阶曲率算符；(ii) 修改暴胀后的再加热动力学。我们批判性地重新审视这两种方法。当包含高阶曲率修正时，量纲分析论证允许引入第二个质量标度来压低高维算符，从而得到一个单耦合、双标度的有效理论。我们表明，拟合 ACT 数据会将这类有效理论推向对紫外物理更敏感的区域，可能意味着对暴胀可观测量的精细调节。我们用两个具体模型——无标度超引力和度规-仿射引力——来说明这一普遍观点，表明它们提供了同一底层 f(R) 理论的不同实现。在再加热方面，要求 CMB 模式在复合之前重新进入视界，会对再加热状态方程产生严格约束，而拟合 ACT 数据倾向于一种奇异的再加热相，其 ω_reh > 1/3，这与暴胀子在标准 Starobinsky 势最小值附近的振荡不相容。最后，我们探索了由一系列衰变的大质量态驱动的宇宙停滞相，能否扮演暴胀后时期的角色。我们发现，在这种设置中容纳 ACT 偏好的 n_s 需要存在负能量密度的态塔。综上所述，我们的结果表明，将 Starobinsky 暴胀与 ACT 数据相协调所需的要素，从紫外完备理论的角度来看难以得到动机，从而削弱了原始 Starobinsky 模型的最小性。

English: Recent Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) observations, combined with Planck, favor a scalar spectral index in tension with Starobinsky inflation. Two main strategies have been proposed to reconcile Starobinsky inflation with these data: (i) including higher-curvature operators in the gravitational action, and (ii) modifying the post-inflationary reheating dynamics. We critically re-examine both approaches. When higher-curvature corrections are included, dimensional-analysis arguments allow introducing a second mass scale suppressing higher-dimensional operators, resulting in a one-coupling, two-scale effective theory. We show that fitting the ACT data drives this class of effective theories toward a regime of stronger sensitivity to UV physics, potentially implying fine-tuning of the inflationary observables. We illustrate our general point with two concrete models, namely no-scale supergravity and metric-affine gravity, showing that they provide different realizations of the same underlying $f(R)$ theory. On the reheating side, requiring the CMB modes to re-enter the horizon before recombination leads to stringent constraints on the reheating equation of state, and fitting the ACT data favors an exotic reheating phase with $\omega_{\rm reh} > 1/3$, incompatible with inflaton oscillations about the minimum of the standard Starobinsky potential. Finally, we explore the possibility that a phase of cosmological stasis, driven by a tower of decaying massive states, could play the role of the post-inflationary epoch. We find that accommodating ACT-preferred $n_s$ in this setup requires a tower of states with negative energy density. Taken together, our results suggest that reconciling Starobinsky inflation with the ACT data demands ingredients that are challenging to motivate from the perspective of UV-complete theories, undermining the minimality of the original Starobinsky model.

一句话导读：批判性审视调和 Starobinsky 暴胀与 ACT 数据的方案，指出高阶曲率修正和再加热修改均需引入难以从紫外完备理论中激发的要素。

来自宇宙弦尖点的新无质量谱

New Massless Spectra from Cosmic String Cusps

Amelia Drew, Ivan Rybak · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：在宇宙弦的标准图像中，尖点是 Nambu-Goto 环的普遍特征，此时弦瞬时达到光速。它们具有特征性的尖锐轮廓，在 (x,y) 平面中遵循 y ∼ x^{2/3}，并产生强引力波暴，波形为 κ̃(ω) ∝ ω^{-4/3}，使其成为引力波搜寻的关键目标。然而，在某些条件下，这一普遍图像会有所不同。我们识别出具有不同形状（包括光滑形状）的新尖点解，并计算其无质量引力波和轴子谱。我们推导出所有可能的 Nambu-Goto 尖点谱的通用表达式，其渐近形式为 κ̃(ω) ∝ ω^{-n/(2n-1)} ω^{-m/(2m-1)}，其中 n,m≥2。我们计算了 Nambu-Goto 描述的现实修正（例如反作用和有限弦宽带来的修正）对波形的影响，这些修正引入高频截断。

English: In the standard picture of cosmic strings, cusps are generic features of Nambu-Goto loops where the string momentarily reaches the speed of light. They have a characteristic sharp profile, following $y \sim x^{2/3}$ in the $(x,y)$ plane, and produce strong gravitational-wave (GW) bursts with waveform $\tilde\kappa(\omega) \propto \omega^{-4/3}$, making them key targets for GW searches. However, under certain conditions, this generic picture can differ. We identify novel cusp solutions with different, including smooth, shapes, and compute their massless GW and axion spectra. We derive a general expression for all possible Nambu-Goto cusp spectra with the asymptotic form $\tilde\kappa(\omega) \propto \omega^{-n/(2n-1)} \omega^{-m/(2m-1)}$ where $n, m\geq 2$. We calculate the effect on the waveform of realistic corrections to the Nambu-Goto description, such as those from backreaction and finite string width, which introduce a high frequency cutoff.

一句话导读：识别出非标准宇宙弦尖点解，并给出其引力波/轴子谱及高频截断效应。

从分次泊松几何看 Einstein-Cartan 和 Palatini-Cartan 引力

Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan Gravity from Graded Poisson Geometry

Johannes Moerland, Peter Schupp · hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：使用分次泊松几何中的概念，我们发展了一个框架，能够简洁地表述 Einstein-Cartan 和 Palatini-Cartan 引力等场论。我们证明 Einstein-Cartan 引力等价于 Palatini-Cartan 引力的一种变体，其中 vielbein 场被约束满足适当的对称关系，我们称之为约束 vielbein 引力。为此，我们通过分次流形的微分同胚将这些理论联系起来。然后，我们展示如何通过移除对称约束得到完整的 Palatini-Cartan 理论。最后，我们展示我们的分次几何框架如何直接纳入分次约束 vielbein 和 Palatini-Cartan 理论的最小 BV 扩展。

English: Using notions from graded Poisson geometry, we develop a framework that allows for concise formulations of field theories such as Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan gravity. We show that Einstein-Cartan gravity is equivalent to a variant of Palatini-Cartan gravity in which the vielbein fields are constrained to satisfy appropriate symmetry relations, which we refer to as constrained vielbein gravity. To that end, we relate these theories via a diffeomorphism of graded manifolds. We then show how to obtain the full Palatini-Cartan theory by removing the symmetry constraint. Finally, we show how our graded geometric framework allows for a direct incorporation of the minimal BV extension of the graded constrained vielbein and Palatini-Cartan theories.

一句话导读：借助分次泊松几何，Einstein-Cartan 引力可视为受对称约束的 Palatini-Cartan 理论，并可自然地纳入最小 BV 扩展。

三维中的广义纠缠楔

Generalised entanglement wedges in three dimensions

Abhisek Sahu · hep-th, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：由 Bousso 和 Penington 提出的广义纠缠楔（GWs）用于一般时空中的引力区域，具有普通纠缠楔的许多性质，包括嵌套、单调性以及其广义熵的强次可加性。在 AdS/CFT 中，纠缠楔的相应性质是对偶 CFT 结构的结果。本文追问 GWs 的性质是否也有类似起源，并在真空 AdS3 中于 G 领头阶展开探讨。我们首先证明，静态切片上的每个 GW 都是测地凸区域的并集；每个这样的区域是普通纠缠楔的交集，因此每个 GW 都由纠缠楔的并与交构成。随后利用积分几何的 Crofton 公式，将凸区域的周长写成与其相交的测地线集合的测度。在 AdS3 中，每条测地线都是某个边界区间的 Ryu-Takayanagi 面，因此该测度可用 CFT 区间的 von Neumann 熵表示。CFT 熵的强次可加性保证该测度为正，而 GWs 的单调性和强次可加性则可由测地线集合之间的简单不等式推出。因此，GWs 的强次可加性是边界强次可加性的直接结果。结果进一步表明，GWs 对应于比边界子区域更一般的 CFT 子系统。

English: Generalized entanglement wedges (GWs), proposed by Bousso and Penington for gravitating regions in general spacetimes, share many properties of ordinary entanglement wedges, including nesting, monotonicity and strong subadditivity of their generalized entropies. In AdS/CFT, the corresponding properties of entanglement wedges are consequences of the structure of the dual CFT. In this paper we ask whether the properties of GWs have a similar origin. We explore this question in vacuum AdS$_3$ at leading order in $G$. We first show that every GW on a static slice is a union of geodesically convex regions. Each such region is an intersection of ordinary entanglement wedges, so every GW is built from unions and intersections of entanglement wedges. We then use the Crofton formula of integral geometry to write the perimeter of a convex region as the measure of the set of geodesics that intersect it. In AdS$_3$ every geodesic is the Ryu--Takayanagi surface of a boundary interval, so this measure can be written in terms of the von Neumann entropies of CFT intervals. Strong subadditivity of the CFT entropy guarantees that the measure is positive. Monotonicity and strong subadditivity of GWs then follow from simple inequalities between sets of geodesics. The strong subadditivity of GWs is therefore a direct consequence of strong subadditivity on the boundary. Our results further suggest that GWs correspond to subsystems of the CFT that are more general than boundary subregions.

一句话导读：在真空 AdS3 中用积分几何与 CFT 强次可加性证明，广义纠缠楔的单调性和强次可加性源于边界 CFT 的熵性质。
