全息紧致天体的有效场论

Effective Field Theory for Holographic Compact Objects

Miguel Correia, Vasco Gon\c{c}alves, Filipe Serrano · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们研究全息 CFT 中的重-重-轻-轻关联函数，其中重算符对偶于一个局域在远小于 AdS 半径尺度上的紧致天体。在长波区域，重态的内部结构由世界线有效场论描述，其局域算符编码了诸如潮汐 Love 数这样的有限尺寸响应系数。针对弱自引力天体，我们表明由局域重-轻相互作用生成的 Witten 图会重组为轻体场有效波动方程的 Born 级数。我们通过求解带有局域相互作用的该波动方程复现同一关联函数，并确定世界线 Wilson 系数如何编码在 CFT 数据中。我们的结果为 AdS 中紧致天体的有限尺寸响应与对偶 CFT 中重-轻和轻-轻复合算符的维度及 OPE 系数之间提供了直接联系。

English: We study heavy-heavy-light-light correlators in holographic CFTs when the heavy operator is dual to a compact object localized on scales much smaller than the AdS radius. In the long-wavelength regime, the internal structure of the heavy state is described by a worldline effective field theory, whose local operators encode finite-size response coefficients such as tidal Love numbers. Focusing on weakly self-gravitating objects, we show that the Witten diagrams generated by local heavy-light interactions reorganize into the Born series of an effective wave equation for the light bulk field. We reproduce the same correlator by solving this wave equation with localized interactions and identify how the worldline Wilson coefficients are encoded in the CFT data. Our results provide a direct relation between the finite-size response of compact objects in AdS and the dimensions and OPE coefficients of heavy-light and light-light composite operators in the dual CFT.

English: We develop the Gram/Wishart/Stiefel formulation of the \(N=2\), large--\(d\) planar endpoint theory of lattice BFSS/BMN matrix quantum mechanics on the lattice. The resulting continuum behavior reproduces the universal \(-2d\) contribution of the \(D_\Lambda\)-channel, while the genuinely anisotropic \(\beta_\Lambda\)-channel lies outside the scope of a pure transverse \(B\)-type description. 中文摘要：Bekenstein-Hawking 熵公式 $\rho = e^{A/4G}$ 对近极端带电黑洞会收到显著修正。利用 JT 引力中的标准结果，该修正项可在半经典意义下表示为内视界面积指数的负值，即 $-e^{A_{\text{inner}}/4G}$，而这两个指数项之间的抵消使得当两个视界碰撞时，趋近极端极限的态密度趋于零。基于 arXiv:2402.10162，我们认为该修正项对应于体引力路径积分中的一个复鞍点几何。所提出的几何具有负的边界长度，并在内视界处封顶；我们称之为内视界鞍点。我们讨论该鞍点及其伴随的负号如何通过逆 Laplace 围道的 Picard-Lefschetz 分析，连同该鞍点的稳定性分析，对态密度作出贡献。我们还讨论内视界鞍点对 Kontsevich-Segal-Witten (KSW) 复度规可允许性判据的违反。尽管这种违反被认为会导致路径积分计算中的非物理发散，但通过仔细处理错误符号模式，可以描述内视界鞍点上的一圈效应。受此观察启发，我们提出 KSW 判据的一个较弱版本，称为谱 KSW 判据。其目的是刻画复引力鞍点周围的一圈修正何时是良定义的。

English: The Bekenstein-Hawking entropy formula $\rho = e^{A/4G}$ receives significant corrections for charged black holes near extremality. Using standard results in JT gravity, the correction term can semiclassically be expressed as minus the exponential of the inner horizon area, $e^{A_{\text{inner}}/4G}$, and the cancellation between these two exponentials enforces a vanishing density of states towards extremality, when the two horizons collide. Building on arXiv:2402.10162, we argue that the correction term corresponds to a complex saddle geometry of the bulk gravitational path integral. The proposed geometry has a negative boundary length and caps off at the inner horizon; we refer to it as the inner horizon saddle. We discuss how the saddle, and its accompanying minus sign, contribute to the density of states through a Picard-Lefschetz analysis of the inverse Laplace contour, together with a stability analysis of the saddle. We also address the inner horizon saddle's violation of the Kontsevich-Segal-Witten (KSW) allowability criterion for the inclusion of complex metrics. Despite this violation, which is believed to cause unphysical divergences in path integral computations, one can describe one-loop effects on the inner horizon saddle by carefully treating wrong-sign modes. Motivated by this observation, we propose a weaker version of the KSW criterion, which we call the spectral KSW criterion. Its purpose is to characterize when one-loop corrections around complex gravitational saddles are well defined.

中文摘要：我们在度规 bumblebee 引力中构造了一个精确的 Simpson-Visser 解，它由幻影标量、磁非线性电动力学以及固定范数的类空位形支撑。独立的矢量方程确定了局域拉格朗日乘子和一个时间分量，使得度规视界上存在正则的向内延拓。重构物质函数后，在同一作用量内识别出虫洞、零最小几何和黑洞反弹的连续族。在黑洞情形，面积光子球和临界类时轨道半径保持 Schwarzschild 值，而角度偏折、近星点进动和光子轨道不稳定性依赖于反弹和 bumblebee 参数。在固定 lapse 质量和面积观测者位置下，度规阴影与 Schwarzschild 预言一致；此外，所采用的 Sgr A* 阴影直径和 M87* 角质量比较不能分别确定这些参数。耦合的轴向方程给出不同的张量、度规和横向 bumblebee 特征。我们用 Chebyshev 谱配置法计算基本辅助无质量标量和普通 Maxwell 探针共振，并在领头几何光学阶估计张量和 bumblebee 共振尺度。非负探针势排除了指数增长的探针模式。然而，对于负非最小耦合和非零时间分量的情形，支撑电磁场在其非常偏振中产生角梯度不稳定性。该不稳定特征在耦合主符号中持续存在，而变分构造在固定几何上建立了增长模式及其增长率下界。

English: We construct an exact Simpson-Visser solution in metric bumblebee gravity, supported by a phantom scalar, magnetic nonlinear electrodynamics, and a spacelike configuration of fixed norm. The independent vector equation determines a local Lagrange multiplier and a temporal component that permits a regular ingoing extension across metric horizons. Reconstruction of the matter functions identifies a continuous family of wormholes, null minimum geometries, and black-bounces within one action. In the black hole case, the areal photon sphere and critical timelike orbit radii retain their Schwarzschild values, whereas angular deflection, periapsis advance, and photon orbit instability depend on the bounce and bumblebee parameters. The metric shadow coincides with the Schwarzschild prediction at fixed lapse mass and areal observer position; in addition, the adopted Sgr A* shadow diameter and M87* angular mass comparisons do not determine these parameters separately. The coupled axial equations yield distinct tensor, metric, and transverse bumblebee characteristics. We compute fundamental auxiliary massless scalar and ordinary Maxwell probe resonances by Chebyshev spectral collocation and estimate the tensor and bumblebee resonance scales at leading geometric optics order. Nonnegative probe potentials exclude exponentially growing probe modes. For negative nonminimal coupling and a nonzero temporal case, however, the supporting electromagnetic field develops an angular gradient instability in its extraordinary polarization. The unstable characteristic persists in the coupled principal symbol, while a variational construction establishes growing modes on the fixed geometry and lower bounds on their growth rates.

通过类比引力研究量子修正黑洞与毛发黑洞

Quantum-Corrected and Hairy Black Holes via Analogue Gravity

Christian Noberto de Souza · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：这篇论文将两种奇异黑洞几何映射到 de Laval 喷嘴的跨声速流，并用空气动力学变量读取其微扰响应。第一种是由主导能量条件与视界存在性约束的引力退耦毛发黑洞。第二种是 Calmet-Kuipers 度规，其短程性由两圈 Goroff-Sagnotti 发散所确定的六维算符的单个 Wilson 系数控制。自旋 0、1/2、1 和 2 的扰动约化为薛定谔型波动方程，Mashhoon 方法以闭式给出整个泛音塔，每个频率均为阻尼。两种修正的区别在于哪个通道响应以及所有通道响应的强度：量子耦合在标量与狄拉克通道中使品质因子最多移动 37%，在另外两个通道中约 10%，而毛发对所有通道作用相同。识别两个乌龟坐标后，势的相等性转化为 Sturm-Liouville 问题，于是规定的势垒确定壁面轮廓，并由此确定流动变量与推力系数。毛发在整个扩张段都能被感受到，而量子修正只在喉部附近显现，并随质量的负四次方增长，这将其限制在原初黑洞。该类比是运动学的，因此管道复现了微扰在这些几何上的散射，但没有复现其背后的场方程。

English: This thesis maps two exotic black-hole geometries onto the transonic flow of a de Laval nozzle and reads their perturbative response in aerodynamic variables. The first is the hairy black hole of gravitational decoupling, constrained by the dominant energy condition and by the existence of a horizon. The second is the Calmet-Kuipers metric, short-ranged and governed by the single Wilson coefficient of the dimension-six operator that the two-loop Goroff-Sagnotti divergence identifies. Perturbations of spin 0, 1/2, 1 and 2 reduce to a Schr\"odinger-type wave equation, whose spectrum the Mashhoon method returns as a whole overtone tower in closed form, every frequency damped. The two corrections are distinguished by which channel responds and by how strongly all of them do, the quantum coupling moving the quality factor by up to 37% in the scalar and Dirac channels and by about 10% in the other two, while the hair acts on every channel alike. Identifying the two tortoise coordinates turns the equality of the potentials into a Sturm-Liouville problem, so that the prescribed barrier fixes the wall profile and with it the flow variables and the thrust coefficient. The hair is felt across the whole divergent section, whereas the quantum correction registers only near the throat and grows as the inverse fourth power of the mass, which confines it to primordial black holes. The analogy is kinematical, so the duct reproduces the scattering of perturbations off these geometries without reproducing the field equations behind them.

一句话导读：该论文用 de Laval 喷嘴类比研究量子修正黑洞与毛发黑洞的微扰，并以闭式给出准正规模塔及空气动力学对应。

迈向光环附近的超相对论散射：引力波通量的渐近发散

Towards ultrarelativistic scattering near the light ring: asymptotic divergence of gravitational-wave fluxes

David Trestini, Riccardo Gonzo, Benjamin Leather · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：在 Schwarzschild 黑洞的散射与捕获阈值附近，粒子会在不稳定圆轨道附近停留很长时间，而在超相对论极限下该轨道趋近光环。本文研究这种超相对论粒子在质量比一阶所发射的引力波通量行为。辐射到无穷远和被视界吸收的通量以距光环距离的倒数乘以其对数的方式发散。通过使用 WKB 近似求解 Regge-Wheeler 方程并解析处理无限谐波求和，作者推导了这个对数增强系数的精确表达式，并表明两种通量具有相同系数。随后结合低多极的数值计算与大 l 的精确渐近，估计了次主导极点贡献的系数。文章进一步猜想将其推广到 Kerr 赤道圆轨道。结果表明，这些结果也有助于理解光环附近超相对论散射轨道的能量与角动量损失的解析结构。更广泛地说，本文说明 WKB 方法可在数值模求和日益困难的情形下给出自力可观测量的渐近行为。

English: Near the threshold between scattering and capture by a Schwarzschild black hole, a particle spends a long time close to an unstable circular orbit, which in the ultrarelativistic limit approaches the light ring. Here we study the behavior of the gravitational wave fluxes emitted by such an ultrarelativistic particle at first order in the mass ratio. The fluxes radiated to infinity and absorbed by the horizon diverge as the inverse distance from the light ring multiplied by its logarithm. Using the Wentzel, Kramers, and Brillouin (WKB) approximation to solve the Regge-Wheeler equation and treating the infinite harmonic sum analytically, we derive an exact expression for the coefficient of this logarithmic enhancement and show that it is identical for both fluxes. We then estimate the coefficients of the subleading pole contributions by combining numerical calculations at low multipoles with the exact asymptotics at large multipoles. We further conjecture an extension to equatorial circular orbits in Kerr. Interestingly, our results also inform the analytical structure of the energy and angular momentum losses of ultrarelativistic scattering orbits near the light ring. More broadly, our work illustrates how WKB methods can provide the asymptotic behavior of self-force observables in regimes where numerical mode sums become increasingly challenging.

一句话导读：用 WKB 方法解析研究超相对论粒子在 Schwarzschild 黑洞光环附近散射时引力波通量的对数发散及其系数。

大 D 极限下的量子临界坍缩

Quantum critical collapse in the large $D$ limit

Chih-Hung Wu · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：在可解析处理的 Einstein-标量临界坍缩模型中，已表明主导 s 波扇区中坍缩物质的量子自能会以 Lyapunov 指数 D-2 增长，最终与支配黑洞形成的经典不稳定性竞争。这种竞争移动了裸奇点阈值，并在半经典控制范围内产生有限质量隙，然而当时空维度 D→∞ 时，这种控制可能看似受到威胁。我们研究大 D 下连续（CSS）和离散（DSS）自相似临界时空中的这种量子增长模式，并确立普适 Lyapunov 指数在两种自相似形式下都存活。在 CSS 中，向裸奇点的经典趋近被陷阱面的出现打断。在大 D 下，视界追踪约化为 Bessel 问题，产生一个量子墙，其半径满足 r_h∝(D-2)^{-2}。该半径在有限 D 下可保持在普朗克尺度以上，尽管随着 D 增大，维持这种层级变得越来越苛刻。在 DSS 中，同样的增长受到回响调制，并可保留先前回响的记忆。最简单的反常诱导作用量表现出累积记忆，但在球心处奇异。我们构造了一个协变单圈作用量，其应力张量在整个 DSS 域中保持光滑，并将其组织为无记忆的回响周期结构。这表明，真实四维 DSS Choptuik 时空的光滑真空极化可能同样由其精确回响对称性支配。

English: In analytically tractable models of Einstein-scalar critical collapse, it has been shown that the quantum self-energy of the collapsing matter in the dominant $s$-wave sector grows with Lyapunov exponent $D-2$, eventually competing with the classical instability that controls black hole formation. This competition shifts the naked singularity threshold and produces a finite mass gap within semiclassical control, yet that control may appear threatened as the spacetime dimension $D\to\infty$. We study this quantum growing mode in both continuously (CSS) and discretely (DSS) self-similar critical spacetimes at large $D$ and establish that the universal Lyapunov exponent survives both forms of self-similarity. In CSS, the classical approach to a naked singularity is interrupted by the appearance of trapped surfaces. At large $D$, the horizon tracing reduces to a Bessel problem, yielding a quantum wall whose radius obeys $r_h\propto(D-2)^{-2}$. This radius can remain above the Planck scale at finite $D$, although maintaining this hierarchy becomes increasingly demanding as $D$ grows. In DSS, the same growth is modulated by echoing and can retain memory of previous echoes. The simplest anomaly-induced action exhibits accumulating memory but is singular at the spherical center. We construct a covariant one-loop action whose stress tensor remains smooth throughout the DSS domain and organize it into an echo-periodic structure without memory. This suggests that the smooth vacuum polarization of the genuine four-dimensional DSS Choptuik spacetime may similarly be governed by its exact echoing symmetry.

一句话导读：在大 D 下研究 Einstein-标量临界坍缩的量子增长模式，揭示 CSS/DSS 自相似性、裸奇点阈值移动与量子墙，并构造 DSS 中光滑的回响周期单圈作用量。

含暗物质-重子散射的自引力系统的高效数值演化

Efficient numerical evolution of self-gravitating systems with dark-matter-baryon scattering

Marc Kamionkowski, Vera Gluscevic, Kris Sigurdson · astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, hep-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们提出一种快速算法，用于数值演化由暗物质和气体组成的球对称系统，并包含暗物质-重子散射。该方法在球对称 N 体代码 NSphere 基础上加入对气体的一维拉格朗日处理；暗物质-重子散射通过暗物质数值粒子与气体壳层之间的 Monte-Carlo 过程实现。我们还实现了在弱冷却下有效的辐射气体冷却算法。气体、暗物质-重子散射和冷却仅略微增加运行时间，使系统可在笔记本电脑上演化，所需计算资源远少于完整三维 N 体/流体模拟。作为示例，我们展示了一个约 10^13 M_sun 的晕在暗物质-重子散射截面 sigma_tot/m_chi=0.1 cm^2/g 且无气体冷却时的演化；随后展示有辐射冷却且冷却因与暗物质粒子相互作用而改变的示例。所得代码 NSphere-IDM 可快速在大范围暗物质参数空间探索暗物质相互作用对星系演化的影响，也易纳入其他新物理（如暗物质自相互作用或分布函数各向异性），并能为完整三维 N 体或流体模拟提供校准和基准。

English: We present a fast algorithm to numerically evolve a spherically symmetric system consisting of dark matter and gas, including dark-matter-baryon scattering. The method augments the spherical N-body code NSphere, which collapses the six-dimensional phase space of a spherical collisionless system to three dimensions, with a one-dimensional Lagrangian treatment of gas. Dark-matter-baryon scattering is implemented as a Monte-Carlo process between the dark-matter numerical particles and the gas shells. We also implement an algorithm for radiative gas cooling that is valid for weak cooling. The gas, as well as dark-matter-baryon scattering and cooling, adds only incrementally to the run time of the code, allowing systems to be evolved on a laptop computer, a tiny fraction of the computational resources required for a full 3D N-body/hydro simulation. To illustrate, we show the evolution of a $\sim 10^{13}\,M_\odot$ halo with a dark-matter-baryon scattering cross section $\sigma_{\rm tot}/m_\chi=0.1\,{\rm cm}^2\,{\rm g}^{-1}$ but no gas cooling. We then show examples with radiative gas cooling where the cooling is altered through interaction with dark-matter particles. The resulting code, NSphere-IDM, allows the implications of dark-matter interactions for galaxy evolution to be explored quickly over large volumes of the dark-matter parameter space, and other new physics (e.g., dark-matter self-interactions or anisotropy in the distribution function) is easily incorporated. The code can also provide useful calibrations and benchmarks for fully 3D N-body or hydrodynamical simulations.

一句话导读：提出 NSphere-IDM，一种在球对称 N 体框架中高效模拟暗物质-重子散射与气体冷却的算法，用于快速探索星系演化中的暗物质物理。

非库仑 Q-上同调与量子提升

Non-Coulomb $Q$-Cohomology and Quantum Lifting

Tanay Kibe, Sam van Leuven, Kayleigh Mathieson · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们研究了四维 $\mathcal N=4$ 超杨-米尔斯理论中经典 BPS 上同调类的量子提升。在正交规范理论中，规范微子双线性 $\mathcal S=\text{Tr}(\lambda_+\lambda_-)$ 的某些幂给出非库仑单调量：即限制到 Cartan 子代数时消失的多引力子类。对于 $SO(7)$，我们辨认出 $\mathcal S^4$ 是某个已知的已提升单调类的超共形后代，从而解释了后者的非库仑特征，并显式构造了 $\mathcal S^4$ 的一个偶然提升伙伴。该构造为寻找更高秩下更高次幂的类似伙伴提供了策略。我们的主要结果给出了对一般规范群经典 BPS 上同调的量子提升的限制。我们证明，超荷的单圈修正 $Q_1$ 湮灭经典上同调中的每一个单调类，而每一个非零的 $Q_1$ 像都是非库仑型的。因此，每一个非零单圈配对都有一个偶然源和一个非库仑靶，使得库仑单调量在有限秩下在这一阶存活。在 BMN 扇区，我们的结果意味着非库仑单调量在单圈阶也存活。论证中的一个关键步骤表明，每一个非库仑类，无论偶然还是单调，都在经典上同调中被标量判别式的足够高次幂湮灭，我们将其解释为一种部分无毛性质。

English: We study quantum lifting of classical BPS cohomology classes in four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ super-Yang-Mills theory. Certain powers of the gaugino bilinear $\mathcal S=\text{Tr}(\lambda_+\lambda_-)$ in orthogonal theories provide non-Coulomb monotones: multi-graviton classes that vanish upon Cartan restriction. For $SO(7)$, we identify $\mathcal S^4$ as a superconformal descendant of a known lifted monotone class, explaining the latter's non-Coulomb character, and explicitly construct a fortuitous lifting partner for $\mathcal S^4$. This construction provides a strategy for finding analogous partners for higher powers at higher ranks. Our main result establishes restrictions on the quantum lifting of classical BPS cohomologies for general gauge groups. We show that the one-loop correction $Q_1$ to the supercharge annihilates every monotone class in classical cohomology, while every non-zero $Q_1$ image is of non-Coulomb type. Thus every non-zero one-loop pairing has a fortuitous source and a non-Coulomb target, so that Coulomb monotones survive at this order at finite rank. In the BMN sector, our results imply that non-Coulomb monotones survive at one loop order as well. A crucial step in the argument shows that every non-Coulomb class, fortuitous or monotone, is annihilated in classical cohomology by a sufficiently high power of a scalar discriminant, which we interpret as a partial no-hair property.

一句话导读：在四维 N=4 超杨-米尔斯中研究经典 BPS 上同调类的量子提升，证明单圈超荷修正湮灭所有单调类且其像均为非库仑型，并讨论 BMN 扇区中的存活。

中文摘要：继 Yadav:2024ray 之后，我们进一步研究 de Sitter（dS）空间中的余维二全息。d 维体 dS 空间被两个世界末端（end of the world）(d-1) 维膜切片，这些膜分别带有 Lorentzian dS 或 Euclidean AdS 度规，并在一个共同的 (d-2) 维空间相交，对偶 CFT 生活在该空间。通过在体 dS 空间的两种切片中显式计算全息纠缠熵、配分函数和 Renyi 熵，并强调它们的相似性与差异，我们为该对偶提供了进一步证据。我们还评论了余维二全息的进一步推广。

We also make comments on further generalization of the codimension two holography.

中文摘要：有限 N 的迹关系可以产生没有稳定大 N 祖先的 Q-上同调类。SU(3) 的膜融合构造表明，这类态可以保留一个带标量毛的 SU(2) 非阿贝尔核心。我们把这个想法发展为适用于每个 SU(N)、N≥3 的一般构造。从 SU(2) 阈值算子 O_{24} 出发，我们选择一个标量的两两特征值，并构造修正的双色字母，其 Q-变换精确遵守 SU(2) 规则。代入 O_{24} 后，对每一对给出一个闭的有理算子。乘以特征值分离因子去掉分母，并对所有对求和，产生一个规范不变多项式。一个精确的块限制恒等式恢复 O_{24} 的非零倍数。该限制把每个稳定类映射到一个稳定的 SU(2) 类，证明所得算子非恰当且偶然，即使包含非库仑稳定类时也如此。这证明了在每个 N≥3 处都存在偶然 BMN 上同调。该构造是非阿贝尔核心带标量修饰的精确代数实现。

English: Finite-$N$ trace relations can produce $Q$-cohomology classes with no stable large-$N$ ancestor. The brane-fused construction at $SU(3)$ suggests that such states can retain an $SU(2)$ nonabelian core accompanied by scalar hair. We develop this idea into a general construction for every $SU(N)$, $N\geq3$. Starting from the $SU(2)$ threshold operator $O_{24}$, we select pairs of eigenvalues of one scalar and construct corrected two-colour letters whose $Q$-transformations obey the $SU(2)$ rules exactly. Substitution into $O_{24}$ gives a closed rational operator for each pair. Multiplying by eigenvalue-separation factors removes the denominators, and summing over all pairs produces a gauge-invariant polynomial. An exact block-restriction identity recovers a nonzero multiple of $O_{24}$. The restriction maps every stable class to a stable $SU(2)$ class, proving that the resulting operator is non-exact and fortuitous, even when non-Coulombic stable classes are included. This proves the existence of fortuitous BMN cohomology at every $N\geq3$. The construction is an exact algebraic realization of a nonabelian core with scalar dressing.

一句话导读：该文将 SU(3) 的膜融合构造推广到所有 SU(N)，证明每个 N≥3 都存在无稳定大 N 祖先的偶然 BMN 上同调类，其非阿贝尔 SU(2) 核心带标量修饰。

超越多项式拟设：M理论的正则 AdS3×M8 解

Beyond the polynomial ansatz: regular $AdS_3\times M_8$ solutions of M-theory

Carolina Matt\'e Gregory · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们研究了 Gauntlett、Mac Conamhna、Mateos 和 Waldram 的 cohomogeneity-one AdS3×M8 系统的正则紧致解，其中 M8 是三个常曲率 Riemann 面上的 S2 丛。我们发现端点论证排除了每一个没有正曲率因子的非平坦曲率符号扇区，而解析形变在所有剩余扇区中给出具有四个径向形状参数的正则族，同时保持底几何固定。已知多项式解在这些族中构成一个真解析轨迹。因此非多项式性在参数空间中是一般性的，尽管与端点匹配多项式的偏离可以非常小。除完全平坦例外外，曲率符号判据在该拟设内是充分必要的。四个磁通比给出参考解及其小曲率形变附近的局部坐标，而有理逆可直接从有限磁通比重构候选端点数据。在完全正曲率扇区，我们证明一个显式的四维有限比邻域位于物理磁通像内。磁周期和领头全息中心电荷约化为端点数据，并且一旦固定共同的 Brown-Henneaux 归一化，等变局域化公式的非平凡磁通依赖与端点结果作为精确代数恒等式一致。我们还量化了非多项式修正，并在显式收敛假设下分析了有限退化。

English: We study regular compact solutions of the cohomogeneity-one $AdS_3\times M_8$ system of Gauntlett, Mac Conamhna, Mateos and Waldram, where $M_8$ is an $S^2$ bundle over three constant-curvature Riemann surfaces. We find that an endpoint argument rules out every non-flat curvature-sign sector without a positive-curvature factor, while an analytic deformation gives regular families with four radial shape parameters in all remaining sectors, with the base geometry held fixed. The known polynomial solutions form a proper analytic locus in these families. Non-polynomiality is therefore generic in parameter space, although the deviation from an endpoint-matching polynomial can be very small. Apart from the completely flat exception, the curvature-sign criterion is necessary and sufficient within this ansatz. Four magnetic flux ratios give local coordinates near the reference solution and its small-curvature deformations, and a rational inverse reconstructs candidate endpoint data directly from finite flux ratios. In the fully positive sector we prove that one explicit four-dimensional finite-ratio neighbourhood lies inside the physical flux image. The magnetic periods and leading holographic central charge reduce to endpoint data, and, once the common Brown--Henneaux normalization is fixed, the nontrivial flux dependence of the equivariant localization formula agrees with the endpoint result as an exact algebraic identity. We also quantify the non-polynomial corrections and analyse finite degenerations under explicit convergence hypotheses.

一句话导读：在 AdS3×M8 超引力拟设中构造出超越已知多项式解的正则非多项式族，并联系磁通数据、全息中心电荷与 Brown-Henneaux/局域化结果。

相关度：medium — 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与经典超引力解研究，并明确涉及全息中心电荷和 Brown-Henneaux 归一化，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但它不涉及全息凝聚态、p波/多分量序参量、QNM、multi-trace 等用户更具体的支线，因此相关度为中等。

超越成对相互作用的多引力中的精确 AdS 波与 pp 波

Exact AdS and pp-waves in multi-gravity beyond pairwise interactions

Joakim Flinckman · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们为任意数量 N 的 vielbeins、任意时空维度 D≥3，在超越成对相互作用的无鬼多引力中构造了精确的反德西特（AdS）波和 pp 波。沿共同零方向对成比例的 AdS 和 Minkowski 解作形变，将完整非线性场方程约化为波剖面的耦合线性微分方程，且不限制其振幅。该系统在与微扰 Fierz-Pauli 质量矩阵相同的本征基下对角化，将解分为一个无质量本征剖面和 N-1 个有质量本征剖面。我们得到显式的径向和横向解，并施加 AdS 边界衰减。该衰减允许每个非负质量平方模式的适当径向支，并排除负质量平方的剖面，包括在 Breitenlohner-Freedman 阈值处的对数解。我们还通过局部平坦极限将 AdS 波与 pp 波联系起来。显式例子展示了无法由无鬼成对理论重现的波构型，表明真正的多场相互作用支持新的精确引力波解。

English: We construct exact anti-de Sitter (AdS) waves and pp-waves in ghost-free multi-gravity beyond pairwise interactions for an arbitrary number $\mathcal{N}$ of vielbeins, in any spacetime dimension $D\geq3$. Deforming proportional AdS and Minkowski solutions along a common null direction reduces the full nonlinear field equations to coupled linear differential equations for the wave profiles, without restricting their amplitudes. The system is diagonalised in the same eigenbasis as the perturbative Fierz-Pauli mass matrix, separating the solutions into one massless and $\mathcal{N}-1$ massive eigenprofiles. We obtain explicit radial and transverse solutions and impose an AdS boundary falloff. This falloff admits the appropriate radial branch of every mode with non-negative squared mass and excludes profiles with negative squared masses, including logarithmic solutions at the Breitenlohner-Freedman threshold. We also relate the AdS waves to pp-waves through a local flat limit. Explicit examples exhibit wave configurations that cannot be reproduced by ghost-free pairwise theories, demonstrating that genuine multi-field interactions support new exact gravitational-wave solutions.

一句话导读：在无鬼多引力中构造精确 AdS 波和 pp 波，按 Fierz-Pauli 质量矩阵本征基分解并施加 AdS 边界衰减。

相关度：high — 论文主要研究多引力中的精确 AdS 波与 pp 波及其经典场方程解，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；未涉及全息对偶或量子信息。

次领头后牛顿展开的全阶引力波尾

All Order Gravitational Wave Tails for Subleading Post-Newtonian Expansion

Debanjan Karan, Babli Khatun · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：经典散射过程中发射的低频引力波形包含形式为 $u^{-r}(\ln|u|)^{r-1}$、$r\geq 1$ 的无穷多个晚时和早时尾项。在牛顿极限下，最近已有工作表明整个这一尾项塔的系数是普适的，即仅由散射物体的渐近数据确定。在速度展开所保留的阶，这些领头对数尾项被确定到牛顿常数 $G$ 的所有阶。我们将其结果推广到渐近态后牛顿展开的第一个次领头阶。我们考虑任意数目的入射和出射非相对论物体，它们仅通过长程引力相互作用，并推导出该阶完整的尾项塔。该修正来自推迟展开中的第一个次领头项，并由大质量粒子的渐近牛顿轨迹决定。其系数同样完全由渐近轨迹决定，且与相互作用细节无关。对于 $2\to2$ 散射，领头对数级数可以闭式求和。我们的结果与早期工作 arXiv:2610.07134 中提出的相对论猜想一致。

English: The low-frequency gravitational waveform emitted in a classical scattering process contains an infinite tower of late- and early-time tail terms of the form $u^{-r}(\ln|u|)^{r-1}$, $r \geq 1$. In the Newtonian limit, the coefficients of this entire tower have recently been shown to be universal, i.e. fixed by the asymptotic data of the scattering objects alone. At the retained order in the velocity expansion, these leading-logarithmic tails are determined to all orders in Newton's constant $G$. We extend this result to the first subleading order in the post-Newtonian expansion of the asymptotic states. We consider scattering of an arbitrary number of incoming and outgoing nonrelativistic objects interacting only through gravity at long range, and we derive the complete tower of tail terms at this order. The correction arises from the first subleading term in the retardation expansion and is determined by the asymptotic Newtonian trajectories of the massive particles. Its coefficients are again determined entirely by the asymptotic trajectories and are independent of the details of the interaction. For $2\to2$ scattering, the leading-logarithmic series can be summed in closed form. Our results agree with a relativistic conjecture proposed in earlier work arXiv:2610.07134.

一句话导读：将牛顿极限中由渐近数据普适决定的引力波尾项塔推广到后牛顿展开的次领头阶，并验证了先前提出的相对论猜想。

双标度 SYK 的有限截断几何

Finite-cutoff geometry from double-scaled SYK

Sergio E. Aguilar-Gutierrez · hep-th, gr-qc, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们为双标度 SYK（DSSYK）模型发展了一种有限截断全息描述。我们构造了 Kourkoulou-Maldacena 和热场双态 SYK 态的微观形变，其双标度极限分别再现了 TTbar 与 TTbar+Lambda2 形变的低维类似物，我们分别记作 T^2 和 T^2+Lambda1。集合平均后的理论描述了有限截断正弦膨胀子引力中的虫洞态，并在低能和高能区域分别描述了有限截断反 de Sitter 与 de Sitter 几何。分析包括能谱流方程的微扰与非微扰解，以及各自视界之后和之外区域。只有微扰分支允许物理量子态。我们研究如何在有限截断全息字典中纳入世界端点（ETW）膜。ETW 膜导致额外的边界理论形变，这取决于是否存在可归一化束缚态，从而给出黑洞或永恒可穿越虫洞几何。我们将有限截断长度计算推广到常平均曲率（CMC）切片，并将其解释为边界理论中的复杂度。我们讨论与物质耦合的可能推广。我们的结果为 DSSYK 全息字典中研究有限截断边界、CMC 切片和膜提供了微观框架。

English: We develop a finite-cutoff holographic description of the double-scaled SYK (DSSYK) model. We construct microscopic deformations of Kourkoulou-Maldacena and thermofield-double SYK states whose double-scaling limits reproduce a lower-dimensional analogue of $\text{T}\overline{\text{T}}$ and $\text{T}\overline{\text{T}}+\Lambda_2$ deformations, which we denote $T^2$ and $T^2+\Lambda_1$, respectively. The ensemble-averaged theory describes wormhole states in finite-cutoff sine dilaton gravity, and finite-cutoff anti-de Sitter and de Sitter geometries in the low- and high-energy regimes, respectively. The analysis includes both perturbative and non-perturbative solutions to the energy spectrum flow equation, and the regions behind and beyond the respective horizons. Only the perturbative branch admits physical quantum states. We study how to incorporate end-of-the-world (ETW) branes in the finite cutoff holographic dictionary. The ETW brane leads to an additional boundary theory deformation, which leads to black hole or eternal traversable wormhole geometries depending on the existence of normalizable bound states. We extend the finite cutoff length evaluations for constant mean curvature (CMC) slices, and interpret them as complexity in the boundary theory. We discuss possible extensions with matter. Our results provide a microscopic framework for studying the finite-cutoff boundaries, CMC slices and branes in the holographic dictionary of DSSYK.

一句话导读：在双标度 SYK 中构造有限截断全息对偶，联系 TTbar 式形变、正弦膨胀子引力、ETW 膜与 CMC 复杂度。

显微镜下的 SYK 虫洞

An SYK wormhole under the microscope

Val\'erie Bettaque, Martin Sasieta, Brian Swingle, Alejandro Vilar L\'opez · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：我们推导了 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) 模型中重算子热单点函数在微观耦合实现上的方差的大 N 虫洞鞍点。我们提出该鞍点描述一个双喇叭几何。在双标度极限下，我们将虫洞表示为连接两个边界的新兴体 Hilbert 空间中弦的跃迁振幅。在 Schwarzian 极限下，弦大量增殖，虫洞定义了 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力开宇宙 Hilbert 空间中的量子跃迁振幅。将 SYK 虫洞振幅与 JT 引力耦合物质中的对应振幅比较，可直接检验 SYK 中的重算子随机性假设。微观 SYK 耦合指定虫洞的 α 参数。对于固定的耦合实现，我们计算相应 α 态中的观测量。我们给出关联半虫洞的体波函数，其在长度基中表现出不会自平均的无序关联。我们将体描述扩展到闭合宇宙的 Hilbert 空间。我们指出，虫洞几何从中涌现的关联弦在结构上类似于局部观测者世界线。

English: We derive a large-N wormhole saddle in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model for the variance of the thermal one-point function of a heavy operator across realizations of the microscopic couplings. We propose that this saddle describes a double trumpet geometry. In the double-scaling limit, we express the wormhole as a transition amplitude in an emergent bulk Hilbert space of chords connecting the two boundaries. In the Schwarzian limit, the chords proliferate and the wormhole defines a quantum transition amplitude in the open-universe Hilbert space of Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity. Comparing the SYK wormhole amplitude with its counterpart in JT gravity coupled to matter provides a direct test of the heavy-operator randomness hypothesis in SYK. The microscopic SYK couplings specify the {\alpha}-parameters of the wormhole. For a fixed realization of the couplings, we compute the observable in the corresponding {\alpha}-state. We provide the bulk wavefunction of the associated half-wormhole, which exhibits erratic correlations in the length basis that do not self-average. We extend the bulk description to the Hilbert space of a closed universe. We point out that the correlation chords from which the wormhole geometry emerges structurally resemble local observer worldlines.

一句话导读：用双标度/Schwarzian 极限和半虫洞波函数刻画 SYK 虫洞，并与 JT 引力耦合物质比较以检验重算子随机性。

AdS₃ × S³ × K3 上的世界面弦理论

Worldsheet string theory on $\mathrm{AdS}_3 \times \mathbf{S}^3 \times \mathrm{K3}$

Lorenz Eberhardt, Matthias R. Gaberdiel, Sameer Murthy, Mukund Rangamani · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-16

中文摘要：描述 AdS₃ × S³ × K3 上由纯 NS-NS 通量支撑的弦理论的 RNS 形式原则上可以直接写出。通过分析 BRST 上同调，可以直接检验世界面理论是否再现超引力所预期的正确手征谱。然而，当试图按照 RNS 形式的标准规则构造世界面配分函数，并通过对自旋结构适当求和来保证世界面模不变性时，所得结果与时空超对称存在矛盾。我们解释其原因，更重要的是提出一种解决方案。具体来说，我们通过要求时空超对称，唯一地固定配分函数的物理态投影。也许令人意外的是，投影后的世界面配分函数并不分解为玻色部分和费米部分，并且涉及非模协变的函数。作为一致性检验，我们证明该世界面配分函数方案能够同时再现 Type IIB 和 IIA 理论的超引力谱。此外，我们从世界面计算对偶 CFT 的椭圆亏格，其中既有全纯的短弦贡献，也有非全纯的长弦贡献。后者显示出 mock 模函数的特征，但存在一些关键差异；前者则具有对称 orbifold 的诱人结构。我们还指出了一种非超对称理论的世界面构造，其谱中没有快子。

English: The RNS formalism describing string theory on $\mathrm{AdS}_3 \times \mathbf{S}^3 \times \mathrm{K3}$ supported by pure NS-NS flux is in principle straightforward to write down. One can directly check that the worldsheet theory reproduces the correct chiral spectrum expected from supergravity by analyzing the BRST cohomology. However, when one attempts to construct the worldsheet partition function using the standard rules of the RNS formalism by appropriately summing over spin structures to ensure worldsheet modular invariance, one finds a result in tension with spacetime supersymmetry. We explain why this is the case and, more importantly, propose a resolution. Specifically, we fix the physical state projection for the partition function uniquely by requiring spacetime supersymmetry. Perhaps surprisingly, the projected worldsheet partition function does not factorize into a bosonic and a fermionic part and involves functions that are not modular covariant. As a consistency check, we show that our prescription for the worldsheet partition function reproduces the supergravity spectrum for both Type IIB and IIA theories. Furthermore, we compute the elliptic genus of the dual CFT from the worldsheet, which has both a holomorphic short string and a non-holomorphic long string contribution. The latter displays characteristics of a mock modular function, albeit with some key differences, while the former has the tantalizing structure of a symmetric orbifold. We also point out the worldsheet construction of a non-supersymmetric theory, whose spectrum is free of tachyons.

一句话导读：通过要求时空超对称来固定 AdS₃ × S³ × K3 上纯 NS-NS 世界面配分函数的物理态投影，解决其与超引力谱的矛盾，并计算对偶 CFT 椭圆亏格。

CHRONOS 科学计划

CHRONOS Science Program

Yuki Inoue (on behalf of CHRONOS collaboration), Masashi Hazumi (on behalf of CHRONOS collaboration), Hsiang-Yu Huang (on behalf of CHRONOS collaboration), Vivek Kumar (on behalf of CHRONOS collaboration), Ippei Obata (on behalf of CHRONOS collaboration), Mario Juvenal S Onglao III (on behalf of CHRONOS collaboration), Daiki Tanabe (on behalf of CHRONOS collaboration), Ta-Chun Yu (on behalf of CHRONOS collaboration) · astro-ph.IM, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：带量子非破坏速度计的低温亚赫兹交叉扭秤探测器（CHRONOS）是一个提议中的低温扭秤干涉仪，用于 0.1–10 Hz 波段的精密测量。Sagnac 速度计读出、功率和信号回收以及平衡零拍探测提供了对光学响应和量子测量关联的控制。本白皮书描述了科学计划、探测器设计、校准和分阶段实验发展。参考灵敏度使用多输入量子模型，包括后镜真空场和测量-反作用关联，并结合经典噪声。两个工作点针对互补的幂律积分灵敏度目标进行优化。引力波预测使用这一共同噪声预算，并说明其源和观测假设。该计划包括中等质量黑洞双星、随机背景、量子测量和地面引力扰动。暗物质应用作为响应和可行性研究进行讨论。差分引力校准器提供了一个提议的汤川引力检验，其系统本底通过减去辅助谐波而得到改善。这些都是条件性预测：实验能力需要验证本文描述的噪声、传递函数、环境本底和系统不确定性。

English: Cryogenic sub-Hz cROss torsion-bar detector with quantum NOn-demolition Speed meter (CHRONOS) is a proposed cryogenic torsion-bar interferometer for precision measurements in the 0.1-10 Hz band. A Sagnac speed-meter readout, power and signal recycling, and balanced homodyne detection provide control of the optical response and quantum measurement correlations. This White Paper describes the science program, detector design, calibration, and staged experimental development. The reference sensitivity uses a multi-input quantum model, including rear-mirror vacuum fields and measurement-back-action correlations, combined with classical noise. Two operating points are optimized for complementary power-law-integrated sensitivity objectives. Gravitational-wave forecasts use this common noise budget and state their source and observing assumptions. The program includes intermediate-mass black-hole binaries, stochastic backgrounds, quantum measurement, and terrestrial gravity perturbations. Dark-matter applications are discussed as response and feasibility studies. A differential gravitational calibrator provides a proposed Yukawa-gravity test whose systematic floor is improved by subtracting auxiliary harmonics. These are conditional projections: experimental reach requires validation of the noise, transfer functions, environmental backgrounds, and systematic uncertainties described here.

一句话导读：CHRONOS 白皮书提出低温扭秤干涉仪与量子非破坏速度计读出，用于 0.1–10 Hz 引力波探测、量子测量与引力/暗物质检验。

引力透镜中的伪谱方法：圈量子黑洞时空中的自旋进动

Pseudo-spectral methods in gravitational lensing: Spin precession in loop quantum black hole spacetimes

Xiankai Pang, Xiao-Kan Guo · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：引力透镜通常被当作初值问题处理：对于无束缚轨道的给定碰撞参数，计算相应的偏转角。本文提倡反向视角。对于规定的偏转角，轨道由空间无穷远处的两个边界条件选出，因此透镜问题成为一个适定的两点边值问题，碰撞参数扮演非线性本征值的角色。我们表明，基于 Chebyshev 配点的伪谱方法能以适中的计算成本准确求解该边值问题，并且控制粒子自旋进动的平行输运方程在同一网格上约化为一个线性系统。作为具体应用，我们计算大质量粒子在来自圈量子引力的两个黑洞时空中的后向散射自旋进动：协变有效度规和自对偶圈量子黑洞。所有方程都写为含三个自由函数的一般静态球对称线元，因此两个时空以相同方式处理。我们发现，量子修正对缓慢运动的粒子最为显著，而在超相对论极限下总能恢复普遍的自旋翻转。翻转本身是普遍的，但趋近它的速率不是：cosξ 对粒子速度在 v=1 处的导数是每个后向通道中的强场量，并明显依赖于两个时空的量子参数。该框架不限于本文研究的模型，适用于任何静态球对称时空。

English: Gravitational lensing is usually treated as an initial value problem: for a given impact parameter of an unbound orbit, one computes the resulting deflection angle. In this paper we advocate the inverse point of view. For a prescribed deflection angle, the orbit is selected by two boundary conditions at spatial infinity, so that the lensing problem becomes a well-defined two-point boundary value problem, with the impact parameter playing the role of a nonlinear eigenvalue. We show that pseudo-spectral methods based on Chebyshev collocation solve this boundary value problem accurately at modest computational cost, and that the parallel transport equations governing the spin precession of the particle reduce to a single linear system on the same grid. As a concrete application, we compute the spin precession of massive particles in backward scattering off two black hole spacetimes from loop quantum gravity: the covariant effective metric and the self-dual loop quantum black hole. All equations are written for a general static, spherically symmetric line element with three free functions, so that both spacetimes are handled on the same footing. We find that the quantum corrections are most pronounced for slowly moving particles, while in the ultra-relativistic limit the universal spin flip is always recovered. The flip itself is universal, but the rate at which it is approached is not: the derivative of $\cos\xi$ with respect to the particle speed at $v=1$ is a strong-field quantity in every backward channel and depends clearly on the quantum parameters of both spacetimes. The framework is not restricted to the models studied here and applies to any static, spherically symmetric spacetime.

Impact of the Einstein Telescope's duty cycle on the estimation of binary black holes parameters

Luca Negri, Thomas C. K. Ng, Thibeau Wouters, Tim J. Kuhlbusch, Harsh Narola, Robin Chan, Kailib Ryan Doney, Francesco Cireddu, Isaac C. F. Wong, Fabian Gittins, Peter T. H. Pang, Anuradha Samajdar, Achim Stahl, Justin Janquart, Chris Van Den Broeck, Tjonnie G. F. Li · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：爱因斯坦望远镜（拟议的下一代欧洲引力波天文台）的几何结构尚未最终确定。目前考虑两种竞争设计方案：嵌套三角形构型（ET-Δ）和两个分离的 L 形探测器（ET-2L）。此前对 ET 设计的广泛比较利用 Fisher 信息矩阵形式确立了科学前景，并指出占空比导致的单探测器运行正是该近似变得不太可靠的区间，凸显了对占空比进行更精细、有原则处理的必要性。在本手稿中，我们在此基础上，用对双黑洞并合引力波信号的完整贝叶斯参数估计重新审视这一比较，并将其投影到纳入经连续时间马尔可夫链建模的精细占空比、且测试不同探测器维护策略的模拟爱因斯坦望远镜上。我们发现，ET-Δ 设计固有的冗余使其在大部分观测时间内能保持至少两个探测器运行，而 ET-2L 构型则常常局限于单探测器。关键的是，我们表明在部分网络运行期间，ET-Δ 往往优于 ET-2L，并且多探测器运行时间的增加会转化为对光度距离和源架系分量质量的更紧约束。值得注意的是，即使引力波事件在 ET-Δ 中的信噪比低于在 ET-2L 中，这一点仍然成立。

English: The geometry of the Einstein Telescope, the proposed next-generation European gravitational-wave observatory, is yet to be finalized. Two competing designs are under consideration: a nested triangular configuration (ET-{\Delta}) and two separated L-shaped detectors (ET-2L). Extensive prior comparisons of ET designs established the scientific landscape using the Fisher-information-matrix formalism and identified that duty-cycle-induced single-detector operation is precisely the regime where this approximation becomes less reliable, underscoring the need for a refined, principled treatment of the duty cycle. In this manuscript, we build on that foundation by revisiting the comparison with full Bayesian parameter estimation of gravitational-wave signals from binary black-hole mergers, projected onto a simulated Einstein Telescope that incorporates a refined duty cycle modelled via continuous-time Markov chains and testing different detector maintenance strategies. We find that the redundancy inherent in the ET-{\Delta} design enables it to maintain at least two operational detectors for the majority of the observing time, whereas the ET-2L configuration is often limited to a single detector. Crucially, we show that, during partial network operation, ET-{\Delta} often outperforms ET-2L, and that the increased multi-detector uptime translates into tighter constraints on the luminosity distance and source-frame component masses. Notably, this remains true even when gravitational-wave events have a lower signal-to-noise ratio in ET-{\Delta} than in ET-2L.

Z. Stuchl\'ik, A. Zhidenko · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：我们重新审视 Reissner-Nordström-de Sitter 黑洞的准正规模式，这是 Einstein-Maxwell 理论中带正宇宙学常数的一个经典且看似已被充分理解的解。以往研究几乎只关注振荡的光子球分支，而我们表明，另外两个非振荡、纯虚模式分支——分别与 de Sitter 视界和近极端电荷区（零阻尼）相关——对于完整描述谱必不可少。尽管它们与晚期动力学和稳定性有关，这些模式在引力扰动中迄今大多未被探索。特别地，我们在慢阻尼区推导了纯虚准正规频率的精确解析表达式，从而完整描述该谱扇区。

English: We revisit quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordstr\"om-de Sitter black holes, a classical and seemingly well-understood solution of Einstein-Maxwell theory with a positive cosmological constant. While previous studies have focused almost exclusively on the oscillatory photon-sphere branch, we show that two additional branches of nonoscillatory, purely imaginary modes - associated with the de Sitter horizon and with the regime of near-extremal charge (zero-damped) - are essential for a complete description of the spectrum. These modes have so far remained largely unexplored for gravitational perturbations despite their relevance for late-time dynamics and stability. In particular, we derive accurate analytic expressions for the purely imaginary quasinormal frequencies in the slow-damping regime, providing a complete description of this sector of the spectrum.

Hanxi Wang, Bence Kocsis, Miguel Zumalac\'arregui · astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）预期存在于星系中心，由星系并合产生。SMBHB 的动力学与演化有助于理解星系的演化与形成、引力波背景以及引力的本质。已有许多方法被提出，用于通过探测引力波或周围气体环境辐射的调制来识别亚秒差距尺度的 SMBHB。在此前研究中，我们提出了一种通过引力透镜在非活动星系核中识别 SMBHB 的新方法。焦散，即放大率发散的源位置，呈现出复杂的延展几何结构，并随双星周期旋转。每次穿越焦散会产生高达 10^6 倍的极端放大。在本工作中，我们推广此前研究，描述双透镜对星光放大（BLAST）的丰富现象学。我们探索了在考虑源（单星或双星）相对自行、SMBHB 偏心率与进动以及相对倾角时产生的电磁暂现。恒星快速漂移穿过焦散的系统会产生单峰或双峰耀发。相反极限下，无相对自行的恒星会产生准周期透镜星光（QPLS），即重复峰值，追踪系统的轨道演化。我们确定了不同情形下的预期放大率和峰值持续时间，并计算了放大率曲线及其傅里叶变换。本研究可能有助于构建搜索流程，以在电磁时域巡天中识别 SMBHB。

English: Supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHB) are expected at the center of galaxies as a result of galaxy mergers. The dynamics and evolution of SMBHBs shed light on the evolution and formation of galaxies, the gravitational wave background and the nature of gravity. Many methods have been proposed to identify sub-parsec SMBHBs via the detection of gravitational waves or the modulation of the emission from the surrounding gaseous environment. In a previous study, we proposed a new method of identifying SMBHBs in non-active galactic nuclei via gravitational lensing. The caustics, i.e. the source positions with a divergent magnification, exhibit a complex extended geometry which rotates with the binary period. Each caustic-crossing produces an extreme magnification by up to a factor of $10^{6}$. In this work, we generalize the previous study and describe the rich phenomenology of binary-lens amplification of starlight (BLAST). We explore the electromagnetic transients produced when accounting for the relative proper motion of the source, either a single or a binary star, the eccentricity and precession of the SMBHB, and the relative inclination. Systems where a star rapidly drifts across the caustic produce a single- or double-peaked flare. In the opposite limit, a star with no relative proper motion produces quasi-periodic lensed starlight (QPLS), i.e., repeated peaks that track the system's orbital evolution. We determine the expected magnification and peak duration in different circumstances, and calculate the magnification curves and their Fourier transforms. This study may help construct search pipelines to identify SMBHBs in electromagnetic time-domain surveys.

嵌入标准模型的温暴涨中流体力学引力波尾的超视界增强

Superhorizon enhancement of the hydrodynamic GW tail in Standard Model embedded warm inflation

Simone Biondini, M. Laine · hep-ph, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：原初等离子体中的流体力学涨落会生成一个引力波（GW）背景，其随当前频率按 $f^3_0$ 增长。然而，在即将运行干涉仪的 $(10^{-4} ... 10^4)$ Hz 频段内，这些模式很可能在流体力学噪声不再处于最大值时重新进入哈勃视界。为处理这种情况，我们定义了一个模型无关的传递函数，适用于由任意时刻的流体力学（或其他白噪声）涨落生成的 GW。通过采用合适变量，我们展示了对于一般膨胀历史，如何数值确定该传递函数以及更简单的真空传递函数。结果在嵌入标准模型的温暴涨情形中得到展示，包括真空和流体力学部分。沿袭先前估计，我们发现出视界前生成的流体力学尾在 $(10^5 ... 10^7)$ Hz 以下变得近乎平坦。其小 $f_0$ 截距保持有限，因此可通过张量标量比 ($r$) 适度影响观测约束。

English: Hydrodynamic fluctuations in the primordial plasma generate a gravitational-wave (GW) background that grows like $f^3_\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle 0}$ in terms of the current frequency. However, within the ($10^{-4}_{ } ... 10^4_{ })\,$Hz band of upcoming interferometers, the modes likely re-entered the Hubble horizon when the hydrodynamic noise was no longer at its maximal value. To address this situation, we define a model-independent transfer function for GWs generated by hydrodynamic (or other white-noise) fluctuations at any time. Employing appropriate variables, we show how this transfer function, together with the simpler vacuum one, can be determined numerically for a general expansion history. The results are illustrated for Standard Model embedded warm inflation scenarios, including both the vacuum and hydrodynamic parts. Following previous estimates, we find that a pre-exit-generated hydrodynamic tail becomes almost flat below $(10^5_{ } ... 10^7_{ })\;$Hz. Its small-$f^{ }_\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle 0}$ intercept remains finite, and can then moderately influence observational constraints through the tensor-to-scalar ratio ($r$).

中文摘要：对亚太阳质量中子星和黑洞的观测将标志着一类新的天体物理对象，因为这些系统预计无法通过标准恒星演化形成。我们给出了首个针对由中子星或黑洞组成的双星的亚太阳质量搜寻，使用了Advanced LIGO第四次观测运行第二部分（O4b）和第一部分（O4a）的数据。搜寻覆盖主星质量0.1至2 M⊙和伴星质量0.1至1 M⊙。对极低质量中子星的潮汐效应最高达7×10^5进行了考虑。未发现统计显著的候选者。我们对亚太阳质量黑洞和中子星的并合率给出90%置信度上限 R90 < 5.2×10^2 Gpc^-3 yr^-1（在啁啾质量0.5 M⊙处），比此前O1-O4a搜寻低2.2倍。我们将有效局域暗物质分数约束为 ilde{f}_PBH < 0.6%（对于 M_PBH=0.8 M⊙），比此前O1-O4a约束改进约1.5倍。在我们的模型假设下，对于 M_PBH ≥ 0.6 M⊙，我们的局域暗物质分数约束比OGLE微引力透镜巡天低2-7倍。

English: The observation of sub-solar mass neutron stars and black holes would signify a new class of astrophysical objects since these systems are not expected to form via standard stellar evolution. We present the first sub-solar mass search for binaries consisting of neutron star or black holes that uses the data from both the second part (O4b) and first part (O4a) of the fourth observing run of the Advanced LIGO detectors. The search covers primary masses 0.1 to 2 $M_\odot$ and secondary masses 0.1 to 1 $M_\odot$. Tidal effects up to $7\times10^5$ are accounted for in extremely low-mass neutron stars. No statistically significant candidates are identified. We place a $90\%$ confidence upper limit on the merger rate $\mathcal{R}_{90}$ for sub-solar mass black holes and neutron stars to be $< 5.2\times10^{2}\,\textrm{Gpc}^{-3}\,\textrm{yr}^{-1}$ for a chirp mass of 0.5 $M_\odot$, a factor $2.2 \times$ lower compared to previous O1-O4a searches. We constrain the effective local dark matter fraction to be $\tilde{f}_\textrm{PBH}<0.6\%$ for $M_{\textrm{PBH}}=0.8 \,M_\odot$, approximately $1.5$ factor improvement to previous O1-O4a constraints. Given our model assumptions, our local dark matter fraction constraints are $2-7$ times lower than the OGLE microlensing survey for $M_{\textrm{PBH}}\ge{0.6}~M_\odot$.

Kerr 时空中的 EMRI：倾角扩散的作用

EMRIs in Kerr Spacetime: The Role of Inclination Diffusion

Yael Alush, Nicholas C. Stone, Scott A. Hughes · astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：极端质量比旋进（EMRIs）预计是未来激光干涉空间天线（LISA）的主要引力波源。EMRI 发生在一个致密天体在引力辐射驱动下缓慢旋进一个庞大黑洞（MBH）时。经典形成通道涉及致密核星团内反复的两体相互作用。然而，EMRI 事件率和其轨道参数的预期分布仍高度不确定。这种不确定性的一个主要来源是逐渐旋进的 EMRI 与不产生可探测引力波的直接坠入之间比例约束不足。虽然大多数天体物理 EMRI 产生研究聚焦于 Schwarzschild 极限，但先前检查 Kerr 度规的工作发现中心 MBH 的自旋可显著影响 EMRI 与直接坠入之比。这种增强敏感依赖于轨道倾角，然而早期研究将倾角固定。在这项工作中，我们发展了描述沿 Kerr 测地线演化的两体遭遇所驱动的倾角演化的数学框架。通过将 3D 扩散实现到 Monte Carlo 模拟中，我们表明初始顺行轨道可能演化为逆行状态，从而将潜在 EMRI 转化为直接坠入，或反之。我们估计 EMRI 与直接坠入之比，发现显著的 MBH 自旋将 EMRI 率提高约 2.5 倍。此外，即使对于非自旋 MBH，将轨道建模为相对论测地线而非牛顿轨迹也会将 EMRI 数量增加约 2.5 倍。Kerr EMRI 倾角分布具有显著的顺行偏置，这可能有助于在未来大型 EMRI 样本中识别损失锥 EMRI 子集。

English: Extreme mass ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are expected to be a major source of gravitational waves (GWs) for the future {\it Laser Interferometer Space Antenna} ({\it LISA}). An EMRI occurs when a compact object, driven by the emission of gravitational radiation, slowly inspirals into a massive black hole (MBH). The classical formation channel involves repeated two-body interactions within dense nuclear star clusters. However, both EMRI event rates and the expected distribution of their orbital parameters remain highly uncertain. A major source of this uncertainty is the poorly constrained ratio between gradually inspiraling EMRIs and direct plunges, which do not produce detectable GWs. While most studies of astrophysical EMRI production focus on the Schwarzschild limit, previous work examining the Kerr metric found that the spin of the central MBH can significantly affect the EMRI-to-plunge ratio. This enhancement depends sensitively on orbital inclination, yet earlier studies held inclination fixed. In this work, we develop the mathematical framework describing inclination evolution driven by two-body encounters evolving along Kerr geodesics. By implementing 3D diffusion into Monte Carlo simulations, we show that initially prograde orbits may evolve into retrograde states, thereby converting potential EMRIs into plunges or vice versa. We estimate the EMRI-to-plunge ratio and find that substantial MBH spin enhances the EMRI rate by a factor of $\sim 2.5$. Additionally, even for a non-spinning MBH, modeling the orbits as relativistic geodesics rather than Newtonian trajectories increases the number of EMRIs by a similar factor of $\sim 2.5$. The distribution of Kerr EMRI inclinations has a substantial prograde bias that may aid in identifying the subset of loss cone EMRIs within large future EMRI samples.

一句话导读：在 Kerr 时空中纳入两体遭遇驱动的倾角扩散，发现黑洞自旋与相对论测地线处理均可将 EMRI 率提高约 2.5 倍，并给出顺行偏置的倾角分布。

身份危机：从引力波族群中厘清质量排序假象与致密天体配对

Identity Crisis: Untangling Mass-Ordering Artifacts from Compact-Object Pairing in Gravitational-Wave Populations

Soumendra Kishore Roy, Asad Hussain, L. A. C. van Son, Maya Fishbach, Carl L. Rodriguez, Will M. Farr · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：从引力波观测推断的双黑洞并合质量分布，为双星如何形成提供了线索。这些分布按惯例将较重的组成部分标为主星，质量记为 m1，较轻的标为次星，质量记为 m2，使得 m1 ≥ m2。这种排序把物理标记的质量分布沿等质量线折叠，可能重塑其背后的族群结构。在本快报中，我们确定哪些族群特征可能来自质量排序，哪些需要真实的物理天体结构。我们表明，仅排序本身就能产生：(1) 一个比 m1 分布下降更快的 m2 分布，而物理标记的两个组成部分之间并没有内禀差异；(2) 沿等质量线看似集中的现象，而并不存在偏好将等质量黑洞配对的关联。此外，不同的物理标记族群也可以产生相同的排序质量分布。然而关键的是，一个随 m1 增大而保持恒定的偏好伴星质量，要求物理标记族群中已经存在特征质量尺度。将模型应用于第五次引力波瞬变星表中的双黑洞并合，我们的模型在 m2 约 50 M_sun 附近恢复出这样一个尺度。在该尺度附近，并合率密度朝更高 m2 下降得比朝更低 m2 快得多，以 99.45% 的可信度排除了高 m2 端下降相同或更弱的可能。因此，这种结构要求至少在一个物理标记的组成部分中存在特征质量尺度，但仅靠质量无法确定哪个组成部分携带该尺度。任何能够重现观测到的高质量双黑洞并合族群的形成模型都必须包含这样一个尺度。

English: Mass distributions of binary black hole mergers inferred from gravitational-wave observations offer clues to how binaries form. These distributions conventionally label the heavier component as the primary, with mass $m_1$, and the lighter as the secondary, with mass $m_2$, such that $m_1 \geq m_2$. This ordering folds the physically labeled mass distribution along the equal-mass line, potentially reshaping the underlying population structure. In this Letter, we determine which population features can arise from mass ordering and which require genuine astrophysical structure. We show that ordering alone can produce (1) an $m_2$ distribution that declines more rapidly than the $m_1$ distribution, without intrinsic differences between the physically labeled components, and (2) an apparent concentration along equal masses, without correlations that preferentially pair black holes of equal mass. Moreover, different physically labeled populations can produce the same ordered mass distribution. Crucially, however, a preferred companion mass that remains constant as $m_1$ increases requires a characteristic mass scale already present in the physically labeled population. Applied to binary black hole mergers in the fifth Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalog, our model recovers such a scale near $m_2 \simeq 50\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$. Around this scale, the merger-rate density declines much more rapidly toward higher $m_2$ than toward lower $m_2$, ruling out an equal or weaker high-$m_2$ decline at 99.45% credibility. This structure therefore requires a characteristic mass scale in at least one physically labeled component, but masses alone cannot determine which component carries it. Any formation model reproducing the observed high-mass binary black hole merger population must contain such a scale.

一句话导读：引力波族群中按质量排序会制造 m2 下降更快和等质量聚集等假象，但 m2 约 50 M_sun 的偏好伴星质量仍需至少一个物理标记成分中的特征质量尺度。

相关度：medium — 属于引力波/双黑洞族群的经典引力与天体物理方向，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息。

限制层级三体系统中顺序黑洞并合的祖先轨道：基于 Peters 方程的估计

Constraining the Progenitor Orbits of Sequential Black-Hole Mergers in Hierarchical Triples: Peters-Based Estimates

Felix M. Heinze, Zhoujian Cao · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：两个黑洞并合事件若空间定位重叠，且第一次并合的残余质量与第二次并合的一个组分质量相容，则可能起源于预先存在的层级黑洞三体中的顺序并合。在此情景下，内双星先并合，留下的残余仍与第三体束缚，随后发生第二次并合。我们提出一种方法，利用 Peters 方程建模残余-第三体双星的引力波驱动演化，从而限制祖先三体的外轨道。在给定第一次并合反冲速度上限的情况下，该方法只需黑洞质量、两次并合之间的时间延迟以及参考频率处的偏心率——这些量可由并合事件本身推断。我们通过构建覆盖系统属性范围的约束图集来研究潜在约束能力，并确定该方法能对祖先三体外轨道参数给出紧致可靠限制的条件。通过对探测频段偏心率施加上限，我们还对文献中提出的候选层级并合（包括 GW190514-GW190521）获得了有意义的限制。我们提供数值工具，用于将方法应用于用户指定系统并评估所得 Peters 限制的可靠性。该框架为重建层级并合祖先提供了计算成本低的第一步，并为纳入更复杂相对论处理的扩展奠定了基础。

English: Two black-hole merger events may originate from sequential mergers in a pre-existing hierarchical black-hole triple if their spatial localizations overlap and the remnant mass of the first merger is compatible with a component mass of the second. In this scenario, the inner binary merges first, leaving a remnant that remains bound to the tertiary and subsequently undergoes a second merger. We present a method to constrain the progenitor triple's outer orbit by modeling the gravitational-wave-driven evolution of the remnant-tertiary binary using Peters' equations. Given an assumed upper bound on the recoil velocity of the first merger, the method requires only the black-hole masses, the time delay between the mergers, and the eccentricity at a reference frequency - quantities that can be inferred from the merger events themselves. We investigate the potential constraining power by constructing a constraint atlas spanning a range of system properties and identify the conditions under which the method places tight and reliable bounds on the progenitor triple's outer orbital parameters. By imposing an upper bound on the detector-band eccentricity, we also obtain meaningful constraints for candidate hierarchical mergers proposed in the literature, including GW190514-GW190521. We provide numerical tools for applying the method to user-specified systems and evaluating the reliability of the resulting Peters-based constraints. This framework offers a computationally inexpensive first step toward reconstructing hierarchical-merger progenitors and provides a foundation for extensions incorporating more sophisticated relativistic treatments.

一句话导读：利用 Peters 方程与并合事件可观测量，限制层级三体中顺序黑洞并合祖先三体的外轨道参数。

相关度：medium — 属于经典引力/广义相对论与黑洞并合动力学，匹配用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；但不涉及全息对偶或其他全息研究支线。

黑洞铃宕中的三次准正模

Cubic Quasinormal Modes in the Black-Hole Ringdown

Neev Khera, Huan Yang · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：我们构建并数值求解至三阶的非线性 Teukolsky 方程，从第一性原理计算 Kerr 黑洞的立方准正模振幅。我们的方法结合了 split light-cone 规范下的低阶度规重构，以及复径向围道上的双曲型紧致化表述。自旋相关的复耦合系数由线性母振幅的乘积确定立方振幅。我们将这些预言应用于一个无进动数值相对论波形，包括 (2,2) 基模、其第一泛音及其复共轭的三次乘积。预言的立方项在选定的早期铃宕拟合窗口内改善吻合，并在不增加拟合参数的情况下移动推断出的线性泛音振幅。在 |h22| 峰值后 3M 处，求和后的立方贡献约达到总 h22 信号的 38%；M 为初始总质量。这些结果表明早期铃宕中存在可观的立方响应。

English: We formulate and numerically solve the nonlinear Teukolsky equations through third order, obtaining a first-principles calculation of cubic quasinormal-mode amplitudes for Kerr black holes. Our approach combines lower-order metric reconstruction in split light-cone gauges with a hyperboloidal, compactified formulation solved on complex radial contours. Spin-dependent complex coupling coefficients fix the cubic amplitudes from products of their linear parent amplitudes. We apply these predictions to a nonprecessing numerical-relativity waveform, including cubic products of the $(2,2)$ fundamental mode, its first overtone, and their conjugates. The predicted cubic terms improve agreement over selected early-ringdown fitting windows and shift inferred linear-overtone amplitudes without adding fitting parameters. $3M$ after the peak of $|h_{22}|$, the summed cubic contribution reaches approximately $38\%$ of the total $h_{22}$ signal; $M$ is the initial total mass. These results identify an appreciable cubic response in early ringdown.

一句话导读：从第一性原理计算 Kerr 黑洞三阶非线性准正模振幅，并在数值相对论波形中发现早期铃宕约 38% 的立方响应。

相关度：high — 直接对应重点标签“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；研究 Kerr 黑洞非线性铃宕中的三次准正模。

中文摘要：我们报告了一项引力波搜寻，目标是次级质量在0.2 M⊙至1 M⊙之间、主质量在0.2 M⊙至10 M⊙之间，且组分质量比限制在0.1至1之间的致密双星并合。分析使用了LIGO与Virgo探测器在2024年4月10日15:00:00至2025年1月28日17:00:00期间收集的数据，即LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA合作组第四次观测运行的第二阶段。三条搜寻流程中有两条给出异常候选体，但显著性不足以提供探测证据。我们报告了当前搜寻对目标亚太阳质量黑洞族群，以及对含一个或多个亚太阳质量组分的中子星双星，在观测运行第一和第二阶段合并后的灵敏度。我们对亚太阳质量黑洞并合率给出上限，不同组分质量组合下为50 Gpc^-3 yr^-1至5000 Gpc^-3 yr^-1（90%置信度）。我们利用并合率上限约束两种可形成亚太阳质量致密天体的示意性暗物质情景：原初黑洞，以及耗散暗物质模型中形成的暗黑洞。对于原初黑洞，假设单色质量分布，早期形成双星情景下暗物质占比被限制为≤(0.018-0.032)（在1 M⊙处）和≤(0.10-0.18)（在0.35 M⊙处）；晚期形成双星情景下，在高于(0.62-0.74) M⊙的质量处占比小于1。对于耗散模型，我们将最小暗黑洞质量低于1 M⊙的范围内暗物质占比限制到低至(1.0-1.1)×10^-5；若暗黑洞构成全部暗物质，还排除了高于(0.62-0.74) M⊙的最小质量。对于包含亚太阳质量组分的双中子星，假设简单的固定族群模型，我们得到并合率上限为249 Gpc^-3 yr^-1。

English: We report on a gravitational wave search for compact binary coalescences with secondary mass between 0.2 M and 1 M and primary mass between 0.2 M and 10 M, restricting the component mass ratio to lie between 0.1 and 1. The analysis uses data collected by the LIGO and Virgo detectors between 2024 April 10 15:00:00 and 2025 January 28 17:00:00, the second part of the fourth observing run of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA Collaboration. Results from two out of three search pipelines show outlier candidates, but not at a sufficient level of significance to provide evidence for detection. We report the combined sensitivity of the current searches over the first and second parts of the observing run to the target sub-solar mass (SSM) black hole (BH) population, as well as to neutron star (NS) binaries with one or more sub-solar component. We place upper limits on the merger rate of SSM BHs, ranging from $50 {\rm Gpc}^{-3} {\rm yr}^{-1}$ to~$5000 {\rm Gpc}^{-3} {\rm yr}^{-1}$ (90% confidence) for different component mass combinations. We use the merger rate limits to constrain two illustrative dark matter (DM) scenarios that can form SSM compact objects: primordial BHs, and dark BHs forming in a dissipative DM model. Our search limits the fraction of DM in primordial BHs, assuming a monochromatic mass distribution, to be $\leq$ (0.018-0.032) at 1 M, and $\leq$ (0.10-0.18) at 0.35 M for early-forming binaries; or to be less than 1 at masses above (0.62-0.74) M for late-forming binaries. For the dissipative model, we constrain the fraction of DM for a range of minimum dark black hole masses below $1\,M$ to be as low as (1.0-1.1) x $10^{-5}$; we also exclude minimum masses above (0.62-0.74) M, if dark BHs constitute all of the DM. For binary NSs that include sub-solar mass components, assuming a simple, fixed population model we find a merger rate upper limit of $249 {\rm Gpc}^{-3} {\rm yr}^{-1}$.

引力波微引力透镜对广义相对论铃宕检验的偏差

Biases in Ringdown Tests of General Relativity from Gravitational-Wave Microlensing

Sreelakshmi Mundakkal Dasan, Anuj Mishra, Apratim Ganguly · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：引力波（GW）铃宕（ringdown）信号通过黑洞光谱学和 Kerr 假设检验，为强场广义相对论（GR）提供了有力探针。然而，未建模的传播效应可能偏差对残余天体性质的推断以及对铃宕特征的解读。我们使用类似 GW150914 的模拟信号，覆盖长波长、波光学和几何光学区域，研究引力透镜对铃宕推断和 GR 检验的影响。我们使用未透镜波形模型进行互补的时域后合并和频域全 inspiral-merger-ringdown 分析。我们发现，波光学区域的透镜效应可对推断的残余质量和自旋产生显著偏差，并能强烈影响推断的铃宕模态内容。特别地，它可以虚假地偏好第一个 overtone 的存在，log10 B^{221}_{220} ~ 40，即便注入信号并无支持。参数化铃宕检验同样可以对偏离 Kerr 准正规模（QNM）谱给出强的表观支持，log10 B^{modGR}_{GR} ~ 8。相反，对于这里考虑的模拟信号，高阶模的证据基本不变。使用整个信号的参数化分析进一步表明，微引力透镜可偏差推断的主导 (2,2,0) QNM 频率。这些结果表明，未建模的微引力透镜可在铃宕分析中产生系统偏差和虚假特征，可能影响 Kerr 假设的精确检验。

English: Gravitational-wave (GW) ringdown signals provide a powerful probe of the strong-field regime of general relativity (GR) through black hole spectroscopy and tests of the Kerr hypothesis. However, unmodeled propagation effects can bias the inference of remnant properties and the interpretation of ringdown features. We investigate the impact of gravitational lensing on ringdown inference and tests of GR using GW150914-like simulated signals spanning the long-wavelength, wave-optics, and geometric-optics regimes. We perform complementary time-domain post-merger and frequency-domain full inspiral--merger--ringdown analyses using unlensed waveform models. We find that lensing in the wave-optics regime can produce substantial biases in the inferred remnant mass and spin and can strongly affect the inferred modal content of the ringdown. In particular, it can spuriously favor the presence of the first overtone, with $\log_{10}\mathcal{B}^{221}_{220}\sim40$, even though the injected signal has no support for it. Parameterized ringdown tests can likewise yield strong apparent support for deviations from the Kerr quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum, with $\log_{10}\mathcal{B}^{\rm modGR}_{\rm GR}\sim8$. In contrast, the evidence for higher-order modes remains largely unchanged for the simulated signals considered here. The parameterized analysis using the entire signal further shows that microlensing can bias the inferred frequency of the dominant $(2,2,0)$ QNM. These results demonstrate that unmodeled microlensing can produce systematic biases and spurious signatures in ringdown analyses, potentially affecting precision tests of the Kerr hypothesis.

通过引力透镜检验嵌入各向异性物质并被等离子体包围的带电黑洞：来自斯隆透镜ACS巡天的限制

Testing Charged Black Holes Embedded in Anisotropic Matter and Surrounded by Plasma through Gravitational Lensing: Bounds from the Sloan Lens ACS Survey

Ritesh Pandey, Shubham Kala, Amare Abebe, Hemwati Nandan, G. G. L. Nashed · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：我们研究了由被各向异性物质包围的带电黑洞引起的弱引力透镜效应，该黑洞由双分量Kiselev度规描述，并浸没在均匀等离子体中。我们首先考察黑洞几何与视界结构，然后从等离子体中光传播的哈密顿描述推导弱偏折角，使用固定转向点的展开，并用直接数值积分进行验证。利用引力透镜方程，我们得到爱因斯坦环角、像位置、总放大率以及主像和次像的分式放大率。随后我们将模型与斯隆透镜ACS巡天中两个星系尺度透镜J0008−0004和J0029−0055的爱因斯坦半径进行对照。由于爱因斯坦角不能小于约化亏损偏折，观测到的半径给出与质量无关的限制K<6.5×10^-6和K<4.2×10^-6。爱因斯坦半径的电荷修正被r_s/R_E≈5×10^-6压低，不可观测；而在SLACS成像的光学波段，等离子体参数为10^-22量级，无法被限制。结果表明，星系尺度强透镜数据对透镜周围各向异性物质给出严格限制，而等离子体效应只能在低频射电波段探测。

English: We investigate weak gravitational lensing by a charged black hole surrounded by anisotropic matter, described by the two-component Kiselev metric, and immersed in a homogeneous plasma. We first examine the black hole geometry and horizon structure and then derive the weak-deflection angle from the Hamiltonian description of light propagation in plasma, using an expansion with a fixed turning point that we verify against direct numerical integration. Using the gravitational lens equation, we obtain the Einstein-ring angle, the image positions, the total magnification and the fractional magnifications of the primary and secondary images. We then confront the model with the Einstein radii of two galaxy-scale lenses of the Sloan Lens ACS Survey, J0008$-$0004 and J0029$-$0055. Because the Einstein angle cannot be smaller than the reduced deficit deflection, the observed radii give the mass-independent bounds $K<6.5\times10^{-6}$ and $K<4.2\times10^{-6}$, respectively. The charge correction to the Einstein radius is suppressed by $r_s/R_E\approx 5\times10^{-6}$ and is unobservable, while the plasma parameter at the optical wavelengths of the SLACS imaging is of order $10^{-22}$ and cannot be constrained. Our results show that galaxy-scale strong lensing data place stringent limits on anisotropic matter surrounding the lens, whereas plasma effects can be probed only at low radio frequencies.

扭转棒 Sagnac 速度计中的量子噪声与力矩关联

Quantum noise and torque correlations in a torsion-bar Sagnac speed meter

Yuki Inoue, Mario Onglao, Daiki Tanabe, Masashi Hazumi, Vivek Kumar, Apimook Watcharangkool · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：通过弱透射镜进入的量子涨落可以限制用于低频引力波探测的扭转棒 Sagnac 速度计，即使其光学布局抑制了辐射压反作用。我们表明，在 CHRONOS（Cryogenic sub-Hz cROss torsion bar detector with quantum NOn-demolition Speed meter）中，从端部与中间测试质量背后进入的真空场可以主导低频量子噪声，尽管每根棒两端力矩相互抵消。对于镜面功率透射率仅为 10^{-7} 的参考配置，这些场在 0.1 Hz 处贡献了总量子噪声功率谱密度的 89.7%。若忽略它们，会将幅度谱密度低估 3.11 倍。我们的输入-输出模型将连续光学相互作用产生的关联与每根棒所受的力以及测量信号联系起来。这一联系表明，强力矩抵消本身并不能保证探测器灵敏度相应改善。在固定反射率下用吸收替代镜面透射，对于所研究的两个工作点，过量量子噪声基本不变。随着循环失谐和零差角变化，预测的信号响应与量子噪声与独立的 FINESSE 3 计算一致。这些结果确立了后向真空场是该扭转棒速度计中的限制性噪声源，并为其镜面和读出设计提供了定量要求。

English: Quantum fluctuations entering through weakly transmitting mirrors can limit a torsion-bar Sagnac speed meter for low-frequency gravitational-wave detection, even when its optical layout suppresses radiation-pressure back action. We show that, in the Cryogenic sub-Hz cROss torsion bar detector with quantum NOn-demolition Speed meter (CHRONOS), vacuum fields entering from behind the end and middle test masses can dominate the low-frequency quantum noise despite cancellation of the torques on opposite ends of each bar. For a reference configuration with mirror power transmissions of only $10^{-7}$, these fields contribute $89.7\%$ of the total quantum-noise power spectral density at 0.1 Hz. Omitting them would underestimate the amplitude spectral density by a factor of 3.11. Our input-output model connects the correlations produced by successive optical interactions to the forces on each bar and the measured signal. This connection shows why strong torque cancellation does not, by itself, ensure a corresponding improvement in detector sensitivity. Replacing mirror transmission with absorption at fixed reflectivity leaves the excess quantum noise essentially unchanged for the two operating points studied. The predicted signal response and quantum noise agree with independent FINESSE 3 calculations as recycling detuning and homodyne angle are varied. These results establish rear vacuum fields as a limiting noise source in this torsion-bar speed meter and provide quantitative requirements for its mirror and readout design.

ICTS-TIFR 的长、偏心且进动双黑洞模拟目录

A catalog of long, eccentric and precessing binary black hole simulations from ICTS-TIFR

Vaishak Prasad, Prayush Kumar, Michael Boyle, Lawrence E. Kidder, Harald P. Pfeiffer, Mark A. Scheel · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：我们展示了使用 Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC) 在 ICTS-TIFR, Bengaluru 的 Sonic 集群上，于 2023 年 8 月至 2024 年 12 月期间进行的 31 个双黑洞模拟目录，针对参数空间中轨道偏心率和自旋-轨道进动同时存在的稀疏覆盖角落：17 个构型既偏心又进动，质量比范围 1 ≤ q ≤ 11，初始偏心率最高达 ê0 = 0.40。最长的 EccPrecDiff002 螺旋下降 80 圈（159 个引力波周期），据我们所知是迄今最长的同时偏心且进动的双黑洞演化。针对 AMD Zen-2 架构对 SpEC 及其第三方库栈的编译时优化使初始数据求解器加速 90%，演化加速 40%，其中约一半可追溯到 pre-2.34 glibc 在 AMD 处理器上报告缓存拓扑的一个缺陷。该活动消耗了 1.18×10^6 CPU 小时。我们记录了后处理流程并验证了框架变换和波形。偏心率从波形中测量，并与初始数据进行比较。双黑洞力学第一定律（近似螺旋对称的检验）对于每个 eω < 0.2 的构型满足优于 0.54%，并且我们表明，即使在进动系统中，在共进动框架中也可视为具有近似螺旋对称。使用对齐自旋模拟校准数值地板，共进动近似的镜面对称违反比该地板高出三到四个数量级，并随开角从 0.7% 增加到 5.3%。EccPrecDiff002 在 M ≤ 62 M⊙ 时无需混合即可跨越 5 Hz 以上的频带，在 Cosmic Explorer 中在 1 Gpc 处给出单干涉仪信噪比 961。

English: We present a catalogue of 31 binary black hole simulations performed with the Spectral Einstein Code (SpEC) on the Sonic cluster at ICTS-TIFR, Bengaluru between August 2023 and December 2024, targeting the sparsely covered corner of parameter space in which orbital eccentricity and spin-orbit precession are present simultaneously: 17 configurations are both eccentric and precessing, spanning mass ratios $1 \le q \le 11$ and initial eccentricities up to $\hat{e}_0 = 0.40$. The longest, EccPrecDiff002, inspirals for 80 orbits (159 gravitational-wave cycles), to our knowledge the longest simultaneously eccentric and precessing binary black hole evolution to date. Compile-time optimisation of SpEC and its third-party library stack for the AMD Zen-2 architecture delivered a 90% speedup of the initial-data solver and a 40% speedup of the evolution, roughly half of the latter traceable to a single defect in how pre-2.34 glibc reported cache topology on AMD processors. The campaign consumed $1.18 \times 10^{6}$ CPU-hours. We document the post-processing pipeline and validate the frame transformation and waveforms. Eccentricity is measured from the waveforms and compared against the initial data. The first law of binary black hole mechanics, a test of approximate helical symmetry, is satisfied to better than 0.54% for every configuration with $e_{\omega} < 0.2$, and we show that even precessing systems can be regarded as possessing approximate helical symmetry in the co-precessing frame. Using the aligned-spin simulations to calibrate the numerical floor, the co-precessing approximation's mirror-symmetry violation lies three to four ordersof magnitude above it, growing from 0.7% to 5.3%with opening angle. EccPrecDiff002 spans the band above 5 Hz without hybridisationfor $M \le 62\,M_\odot$, giving a single-interferometer signal-to-noise ratio of 961 in Cosmic Explorer at 1 Gpc.

使用深度学习对极端质量比旋近内禀参数进行分层参数估计

Hierarchical Parameter Estimation for Intrinsic Parameters of Extreme-mass-ratio Inspirals Using Deep Learning

Ping Shen, Wen-Biao Han, Minghui Du · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：极端质量比旋近（EMRIs）是未来空间引力波探测器的首要目标，但其精确参数估计受到波形复杂性和高维参数空间的严重制约。本工作提出一个深度学习框架，能够在不依赖外禀参数详细先验的情况下恢复七个EMRI内禀参数。该方法首先使用U-Net从含噪时频数据中提取稳健信号特征。这些特征随后输入配备双重注意力机制的多通道卷积神经网络（CNN），该机制解耦时间和频率维度，以联合建模长程时间演化和持续频谱结构，从而增强对含噪数据中EMRI时频脊的敏感性。值得注意的是，该方法将参数 {log M, a, μ, e0, p0} 和 {t_p, x_I0} 的搜索范围分别缩小约 10^2 和 10^1 倍，有效将七维参数空间总体积缩小约 10^8 倍。如此显著的缩减使得能够快速预筛选内禀参数空间，大幅节省后续全参数估计的计算成本。尽管该框架按太极任务规格开发，该方法也适用于其他空间引力波探测器的数据。

English: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) stand as prime targets for future space-borne gravitational wave (GW) detectors, yet their precise parameter estimation is severely hindered by waveform complexity and high-dimensional parameter spaces. In this work, we propose a deep learning framework capable of recovering the seven intrinsic EMRI parameters without relying on detailed priors for extrinsic parameters. Our approach first employs a U-Net to extract robust signal features from noisy time-frequency data. These features are then fed into a multi-channel convolutional neural network (CNN) equipped with a dual attention mechanism, which decouples the time and frequency dimensions to jointly model long-range temporal evolution and persistent spectral structures, thereby enhancing sensitivity to EMRI time-frequency ridges in noisy data. Remarkably, this method reduces the search ranges for the parameters $\{\log M, a, \mu, e_0, p_0 \}$ and $\{t_p, {x_I}_0 \}$ by factors of $\sim 10^{2}$ and $\sim 10^{1}$, respectively, effectively shrinking the total volume of the seven-dimensional parameter space by $\sim 10^{8}$. Such a dramatic reduction enables a rapid pre-screening of the intrinsic parameter space, substantially saving computational cost for subsequent full parameter estimation. Although our framework is developed with Taiji mission specifications in mind, the methodology is applicable to data from other space-borne GW detectors.

Bardeen黑洞周围周期轨道上极端质量比旋近的引力波可探测性

Detectability of Gravitational Waves from Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals on Periodic Orbits around Bardeen Black Holes

Li Huang, Xing He · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：我们研究Bardeen黑洞周围极端质量比旋近（EMRI）的引力波（GW）特征，将小天体建模为测试粒子，并提供一个探测强场时空几何的框架。我们首先给出Bardeen黑洞周围测试粒子的运动方程，并在能量和角动量参数空间中刻画圆轨道。利用Levin分类法，我们采用扩展分类方案对Bardeen黑洞周围的周期轨道进行分类。然后，我们计算这些周期轨道在时域和频域中的GW波形以及相应的特征应变，并将其与激光干涉空间天线（LISA）、演化LISA（eLISA）、天琴计划、大爆炸观测者（BBO）和分赫兹干涉仪引力波天文台（DECIGO）的灵敏度曲线进行比较。我们发现可探测性主要由光度距离控制。在200 Mpc的光度距离处，信号可以超过BBO和DECIGO的灵敏度曲线，并与LISA灵敏度曲线相当；而在2 Gpc处，它们仍低于所有考虑探测器的灵敏度曲线。这些结果表明，Bardeen黑洞周围周期轨道上的EMRI为探测强场引力和Bardeen黑洞性质提供了一个有前景的途径。

English: We investigate gravitational wave (GW) signatures from extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) around a Bardeen black hole, modeling the small object as a test particle, and provide a framework for probing strong-field spacetime geometry. We first present the equations of motion for test particles around a Bardeen black hole and characterize circular orbits in the parameter space of energy and angular momentum. Using Levin's classification, we adopt the extended classification scheme to classify periodic orbits around a Bardeen black hole. We then compute GW waveforms in both the time and frequency domains, as well as the corresponding characteristic strains, for these periodic orbits and compare them with the sensitivity curves of the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA), the evolved Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (eLISA), the TianQin mission, the Big Bang Observer (BBO), and the Decihertz Interferometer Gravitational wave Observatory (DECIGO). We find that detectability is controlled primarily by the luminosity distance. At a luminosity distance of 200 Mpc, the signals can exceed the sensitivity curves of BBO and DECIGO and are comparable to the LISA sensitivity curve, whereas at 2 Gpc, they remain below the sensitivity curves of all detectors considered. These results suggest that EMRIs on periodic orbits around Bardeen black holes offer a promising avenue to probe strong-field gravity and the properties of Bardeen black holes.

The WDM time-frequency transform in gravitational-wave data analysis II: Evolutionary spectrum and noise covariance

Aaron D. Johnson, Katerina Chatziioannou, Robert Rosati · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：对于未来引力波探测器所需的时标，噪声不能视为平稳：地面探测器为分钟量级，空间探测器为月量级。非平稳性导致频域噪声协方差矩阵非对角，因此促使转向时频域。我们引入演化功率谱，用于在 Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer 时频基下描述非平稳噪声。在振荡过程框架下，我们证明，在 Meyer 滤波器与非平稳时标之比的首阶近似下，演化谱是一个功率-频率分布，可由单次噪声实现中估计。我们推导相应的噪声协方差矩阵，并表明它与平稳情形类似，是带状三对角的。所有阶的精确协方差按构造为半正定，并依噪声而稠密。我们进一步推导时频平面的最优铺砌，使对角协方差近似的误差最小，并表明对平面粗粒化会以二次方式抑制关联。使用含 LISA 银河系前景和漂移幂律谱的模拟数据，我们表明平稳性近似会导致信噪比损失并严重偏置推断。对于真实 LISA 数据，在 Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer 域中将协方差近似为对角，对于单个已分辨银河双星的窄带分析是准确的，但对于宽带分析则不足。最后，我们给出缓解策略，用于处理当数据开始与结束处谱不同时，在数据时间边缘跨边引起的回绕关联。

English: Noise cannot be treated as stationary over the timescales required for upcoming gravitational-wave detectors, minutes for ground-based and months for space-based detectors. Nonstationarity leads to a non-diagonal frequency-domain noise covariance matrix, thus motivating a shift to the time-frequency domain. We introduce \emph{evolutionary power spectra} for describing nonstationary noise in the Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer time-frequency basis. Under the framework of oscillatory processes, we show that, to leading order in the ratio of the Meyer filter and the nonstationarity timescales, the evolutionary spectrum is a power-frequency distribution that can be estimated from a single noise realization. We derive the corresponding noise covariance matrix and show that it is band tri-diagonal, like its stationary counterpart. The exact covariance to all orders is positive semi-definite by construction and dense depending on the noise. We further derive the optimal tiling of the time-frequency plane that minimizes the error of a diagonal covariance approximation and show that coarse-graining the plane suppresses correlations quadratically. Using simulated data with a LISA Galactic foreground and a drifting powerlaw spectrum, we show that the stationarity approximation leads to signal-to-noise ratio loss and severely biases inference. For realistic LISA data, approximating the covariance as diagonal in the Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer domain is accurate for the narrow-band analysis of a single resolved Galactic binary, but insufficient for a broad-band analysis. Finally, we provide mitigation strategies for the wraparound correlations induced across the data time edges whenever the spectrum differs between the start and the end of the data.

一句话导读：本文在 WDM 时频基下引入演化功率谱和噪声协方差矩阵，分析非平稳噪声对引力波（尤其 LISA）数据分析的影响，并给出对角近似与边缘关联缓解策略。

相关度：medium — 属于引力波数据分析与噪声协方差方法，与经典引力/引力波观测支线相关；但不属于全息、量子引力或所列全息重点方向。

黑洞精细结构

Black Hole Fine Structure

Adrian Ka-Wai Chung, Richard Dyer, Tomasz Kinowski, Christopher J. Moore · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：在广义相对论中，轴向和极向黑洞扰动具有相同的准正规模谱，这一性质称为等谱性。新物理可以打破这种简并，产生类似于原子精细结构的光谱分裂。我们对引力波观测进行理论不可知搜索以寻找这种分裂。我们没有发现等谱性破缺的证据，并对相对频率分裂给出联合 90% 上限 <28.5%。我们将这些约束映射到若干修改引力理论，将耦合长度限制为 ≲28 km。

English: In General Relativity, axial and polar black-hole perturbations share identical quasinormal-mode spectra, a property known as isospectrality. New physics can break this degeneracy, producing a spectral splitting analogous to atomic fine structure. We perform a theory-agnostic search for such splitting in gravitational-wave observations. We find no evidence for isospectrality breaking and place a combined $90\%$ upper limit of $<28.5\%$ on the relative frequency splitting. We map these constraints onto several modified-gravity theories, constraining the coupling-lengths to be $\lesssim 28\,\mathrm{km}$.

一句话导读：利用引力波观测搜索黑洞准正规模等谱性破缺，未发现证据并给出修改引力耦合长度约束。

基于射线追踪到达时间面的强场引力波透镜

Strong-Field Gravitational-Wave Lensing from Ray-Traced Arrival-Time Surfaces

Luka Vujeva, Jo\~ao S. Santos, Brian C. Seymour · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-15

中文摘要：衍射积分形式在描述引力波透镜效应方面取得了很大成功，适用于信号波长与透镜特征长度尺度相当的情形，即波动光学区。然而，当源接近黑洞透镜的强引力区域时，构造其被积函数所需的假设会失效。我们特别关注双星（源）靠近大质量黑洞（透镜）时被透镜化的信号。我们提出一种新形式，利用零测地线满足 Hamilton--Jacobi 方程这一事实，来获得引力强场区被透镜化源的低频修正。由此，我们能够不依赖薄透镜近似地构造时间延迟面，并直接求解对应于该面的衍射积分。对于位于 10M、深处强场区的静止源，将结果与相对论波散射模型比较，我们在峰值放大率和第一衍射条纹上分别发现 6.5% 和 0.3% 的一致性。此外，对于弱场中位于 10^4 M 的源，我们发现与点质量透镜振幅有 <1% 的一致性，但在更高频率下放大函数峰值之间存在明显退相位。这项工作使得在原本分离的区域之间进行干净插值成为可能，适用于从 ~6M 到无穷远的源。它为计算强场区超越几何光学的透镜效应提供了一个透明且具有物理动机的框架。

English: The diffraction integral formalism has been greatly successful in describing gravitational wave lensing effects in scenarios where the wavelength of the signal is comparable to the characteristic length scale of the lens, known as the wave optics regime. However, the assumptions required to construct its integrand break down as the source approaches the strong gravity region of a black hole lens. In particular, we are interested in the lensed signal from a binary (the source) near a massive black hole (the lens). We present a new formalism for obtaining low frequency corrections to sources being lensed in the strong field regime of gravity by leveraging the fact that null geodesics obey the Hamilton--Jacobi equations. In doing so, we are able to construct a time delay surface without relying on the thin lens approximation, and solve the diffraction integral for the resulting surface directly. For a stationary source at $10M$, deep in the strong field regime, when comparing the results with a relativistic wave scattering model, we find $6.5\%$ and $0.3\%$ agreement in the peak amplification and first diffractive fringe, respectively. Furthermore, we find a $< 1\%$ agreement with the amplitude of the point mass lens with a source at $10^4 M$ in the weak field, but noticeable dephasing between the peaks of the amplification function at higher frequencies. This work allows for clean interpolation between otherwise separate regimes, valid for sources from $\sim 6M \to \infty$. It provides a transparent, physically motivated framework for computing beyond-geometric optics lensing effects in the strong field regime.

一句话导读：提出不依赖薄透镜近似的射线追踪到达时间面方法，用于计算黑洞强场区引力波透镜的低频衍射修正，并可在强场到弱场之间插值。

相关度：high — 该文直接属于“经典引力/广义相对论”重点支线，研究强场引力波透镜、黑洞透镜与波动光学修正。
