含物质的准拓扑引力：修正双拷贝方法

Quasitopological Gravity with Matter: Modified Double-Copy Approach

Valeri P. Frolov · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们将最近提出的修正双拷贝形式推广到与物质耦合的准拓扑引力（QTG）。对于球对称位形，带有一大类物质源的 D 维弯曲时空中 QTG 场方程被映射为平坦 (D+1) 维时空中辅助非线性规范场的方程。支配该辅助场的非线性电动力学完全由指定 QTG 模型的生成函数 h(p) 决定，而相应的流由物质应力-能量张量决定。将辅助解限制到 D 维超平面并应用修正双拷贝规定，可得到求解 QTG 方程的 Kerr-Schild 度规。我们表明，麦克斯韦和非线性电动力学，以及一大类球对称 Yang-Mills 场，提供了与该构造相容的物理物质源。在不存在类光物质通量时，相应解拥有额外的 Killing 矢量。这意味着它们满足广义 Birkhoff 定理，而类光带电电流自然产生 Vaidya 型解。在 Einstein 极限 h(p)=p 下，辅助非线性电动力学约化为麦克斯韦理论。

English: We extend the recently proposed modified double-copy formalism to quasitopological gravity (QTG) coupled to matter. For spherically symmetric configurations, the QTG field equations in $D-$dimensional curved spacetime with a broad class of matter sources are mapped to equations for an auxiliary nonlinear gauge field in a flat $(D+1)$-dimensional spacetime. The nonlinear electrodynamics governing this auxiliary field is determined entirely by the generating function $h(p)$ that specifies the QTG model, while the corresponding current is determined by the matter stress-energy tensor. Restricting the auxiliary solution to a $D$-dimensional hyperplane and applying the modified double-copy prescription yields the Kerr--Schild metric solving the QTG equations. We show that Maxwell and nonlinear electrodynamics, as well as a broad class of spherically symmetric Yang--Mills fields, provide physical matter sources compatible with this construction. In the absence of null-matter fluxes, the corresponding solutions possess an additional Killing vector. This means that they satisfy a generalized Birkhoff theorem, whereas null charged currents naturally generate Vaidya-type solutions. In the Einstein limit, $h(p)=p$, the auxiliary nonlinear electrodynamics reduces to Maxwell theory.

一句话导读：该工作将修正双拷贝形式推广到含物质的准拓扑引力，并给出 Kerr-Schild、广义 Birkhoff 及 Vaidya 型解。

English: This note addresses a number of subtle issues pertaining to the long-standing problem of strong phonon-like fermion-boson coupling. Among the central topics are the customary Migdal-Eliashberg approximation in the pertinent Schwinger-Dyson gap equation and its solutions. The previously gained insight is assessed by contrasting it against the various (non-)supersymmetric variants of the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model. Also, some previously discussed (pseudo-)holographic aspects of fermion pairing in such models are commented upon.

从 Bertotti--Robinson 到真空：通过 Harrison 与反演对称性获得的广义相对论新精确解

From Bertotti--Robinson to Vacuum: New Exact Solutions in General Relativity via Harrison and Inversion Symmetries

Jos\'e Barrientos, Adolfo Cisterna, Amaro D\'iaz, Keanu M\"uller · gr-qc, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们构造了 Einstein 方程的新真空解，这些解由嵌入外部电磁背景的电真空构型生成。起点是加速 Bertotti--Robinson 黑洞，我们利用电真空的两个独立对称性：Melvin--Bonnor 型磁化与磁反演。在两种构造中，外部电磁场可以被移除，同时在度规中留下非平凡的引力反作用，从而得到新的 Petrov I 型加速真空时空。在静态、非加速极限下，磁化 Bertotti--Robinson--Schwarzschild 情形复现已知结果，而反演对称性给出一个真正新的真空构型，即 Schwarzschild--Levi--Civita 几何的双参数推广。这些构造为生成代数一般真空几何提供了系统方法，并说明电磁嵌入如何在广义相对论中诱导非平凡真空度规。我们分析了这些时空的主要几何性质。此外，我们还给出两个进一步结果：这些真空几何的稳态推广，以及将同样对称性应用于 Alekseev--García 黑洞种子得到的两类新静态真空构型。

English: We construct new vacuum solutions of the Einstein equations generated from electrovacuum configurations embedded in external electromagnetic backgrounds. Starting from accelerating Bertotti--Robinson black holes, we exploit two independent symmetries of the electrovacuum: a Melvin--Bonnor-type magnetization and a magnetic Inversion. In both constructions, the external electromagnetic field can be removed while still leaving a non-trivial gravitational backreaction in the metric, yielding new accelerating vacuum spacetimes of Petrov type I. In the static, non-accelerating limit, the magnetized Bertotti--Robinson--Schwarzschild case reproduces known results, while the Inversion symmetry produces a genuinely new vacuum configuration, a two-parameter extension of the Schwarzschild--Levi-Civita geometry. These constructions provide a systematic method for generating algebraically general vacuum geometries and illustrate how electromagnetic embeddings can induce non-trivial vacuum metrics in General Relativity. The main geometrical properties of these spacetimes are analyzed. Additionally, we present two further results: a stationary generalization of these vacuum geometries and two new static vacuum configurations obtained by applying the same symmetries to the Alekseev--Garc\'ia black hole seed.

一句话导读：利用电真空的磁化与磁反演对称性，从加速 Bertotti--Robinson 黑洞生成新的 Petrov I 型加速真空精确解，并给出稳态与静态推广。

超轻暗物质对致密双星并合的影响

Effect of ultralight dark matter on compact binary mergers

Kabir Chakravarti, Soham Acharya, Sumanta Chakraborty, Sudipta Sarkar · gr-qc, astro-ph.GA, hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：不断增长的引力波事件目录使得对致密双星并合进行统计分析成为可能，通常用双星并合率密度来量化。该量可能受环境因素影响；因此，本文研究了暗物质环境对并合统计的影响。我们构建了一个包含偏心与近圆致密双星并合的基线天体物理模型，并通过引入超轻暗物质模型对其进行扩展：该暗物质通过吸积和动力学摩擦影响双星轨道演化。对双星前身星并合群体的分析表明，与基线模型相比，超轻暗物质能够在环境密度约 ≲10^4 GeV/cm^3 与偏心率约 0.5 的最优组合附近改变并合统计。与 GWTC-3 目录的引力波数据比较，为超轻暗物质在并合事件中的潜在观测特征提供了重要线索，并可能对星系中暗物质分布的存在性与密度给出限制。

English: The growing catalogue of gravitational wave events enables a statistical analysis of compact binary mergers, typically quantified by the binary merger rate density. This quantity can be influenced by ambient factors, following which, in this work we have investigated the impact of dark matter environment on the merger statistics. We construct a baseline astrophysical model of eccentric and quasi-circular compact binary mergers and extend it by incorporating a model of ultra light dark matter, which affects the orbital evolution of binaries through accretion and dynamical friction. Our analysis of the merged population of binary progenitors demonstrates that, compared to the baseline model, ULDM can potentially alter the merger statistics around an optimal combination of ambient density $\lesssim10^4 \textrm{GeV}/\textrm{cm}^{3}$ and eccentricity $\sim 0.5$. A comparison with the gravitational wave data from the GWTC-3 catalogue provides crucial insight into potential observational signatures of the ULDM in merger events, leading to possible constraints on the existence and density of dark matter distribution in galaxies.

一句话导读：超轻暗物质可通过吸积和动力学摩擦改变致密双星并合统计，并有望用 GWTC-3 数据限制星系暗物质分布。

Complexity study of the Hartle-Hawking state in JT gravity

Ritam Basu · hep-th, gr-qc, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：Wigner 函数一般会取负值，其负性大小给出了在经典计算机上模拟量子态复杂度的一种操作上有意义的度量。本文研究 Jackiw-Teitelboim 引力中 Hartle-Hawking 态的 Wigner 负性在时间演化下的增长。我们在引力长度基下、亏格为零、高温 β≪1 的条件下工作。主要解析结果很简单：在 β 领头阶，该态是一个最小不确定性的高斯波包，静止在 Liouville 墙的转折点；因此其 Wigner 函数为正，负性为 1+δ(β,t)，其中修正 δ 小于 β 的任意幂。我们证明 δ 是时间的偶函数，故在 t=0 无线性增长；并且波包从墙上反射后，其领头阶演化是一个 Clifford 剪切，不能改变负性。我们还数值研究了 Wigner 函数及其负性的时间演化。我们观察到，δ 在 t=0 以及整个反射过程中保持在 10^{-11} 以下，随后在几十个 β/π 的时间尺度内缓慢上升，并趋近一个与 δ∞(β)≃0.08 e^{-4.4/β}（0.25≤β≤1）一致的晚期值：温度越低，晚期负性越大。精确的存活振幅 Z(β+it)/Z(β) 将 spread complexity 确定到 t^4 阶，也确定了我们此前工作 (arXiv:2607.04065, arXiv:2607.17346) 中的种子归一化 Wigner 诊断量。我们认为这表明长度基非常适合描述亏格为零动力学的对偶半经典描述。对于高于零的亏格，长度基是过完备的，我们不对有限 e^{S_0} 作任何陈述。

English: The Wigner function, in general, takes on negative values, and the amount of negativity in the Wigner function gives an operationally meaningful measure of the complexity of simulating the quantum state on a classical computer. In this paper, we study the growth of Wigner negativity of the Hartle-Hawking state of Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity under time evolution. We work in the gravitational length basis, at genus zero, and at high temperature, $\beta \ll 1$. Our main analytic result is simple: to leading order in $\beta$ the state is a Gaussian wavepacket of minimum uncertainty, sitting at rest at the turning point of the Liouville wall. Its Wigner function is therefore positive, and the negativity is $1+\delta(\beta,t)$, where the correction $\delta$ is smaller than any power of $\beta$. We show that $\delta$ is an even function of time, so there is no linear growth at $t=0$, and that once the packet has reflected off the wall its leading-order evolution is a Clifford shear, which cannot change the negativity. We also numerically study the time evolution of the Wigner function and its negativity. We observe that $\delta$ stays below $10^{-11}$ at $t=0$ and through the reflection, then rises slowly over a few tens of $\beta/\pi$, and then approaches a late-time value consistent with $\delta_\infty(\beta) \simeq 0.08\, e^{-4.4/\beta}$ for $0.25 \le \beta \le 1$: the lower the temperature, the larger the late-time negativity. The exact survival amplitude $Z(\beta+it)/Z(\beta)$ fixes the spread complexity to order $t^4$, and it also fixes the seed-normalised Wigner diagnostic of our earlier work (arXiv:2607.04065, arXiv:2607.17346). We take this as evidence that the length basis is ideally suited for a dual, semi-classical description of the dynamics at genus zero. Beyond genus zero the length basis is overcomplete, and we make no statement about finite $e^{S_0}$.

一句话导读：在 JT 引力中，用 Wigner 负性研究 Hartle-Hawking 态的复杂度演化，发现高温下主要为最小不确定度高斯波包，负性修正极小且晚期随温度降低而增大。

AdS/CFT 平直极限中的希尔伯特空间. I. 有质量粒子

Hilbert space in the flat limit of AdS/CFT. I. Massive particles

Kevin Nguyen · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：AdS$_4$ 时空的平直极限在对称代数层面相应于 Inönü–Wigner 收缩 $\mathfrak{so}(2,3)\to\mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$。我们描述了任意整数自旋 $s$ 的有质量散射态希尔伯特空间如何从共形群的一元最低权表示 $\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ 中涌现，所用的基是 Fronsdal 首先引入的‘赝动量’态。在 AdS 曲率半径 $\ell\to\infty$、固定 $m=\Delta/\ell$ 的极限下，这些态很好地约化为 Wigner 的动量本征态。一个简单的共形映射将该描述与径向量子化中熟悉的 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 共形场联系起来，其中单位球的内部和外部各自对应出射和入射动量。在收缩下并经过适当重标度，$\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ 上的内积收敛到 Wigner 有质量粒子的标准洛伦兹不变内积，因此整个过程中幺正性保持。向无质量粒子的收缩在此简要讨论，并将在后续文章中详细处理。

English: The flat limit of AdS$_4$ spacetime corresponds, at the level of the symmetry algebra, to the In\"on\"u--Wigner contraction $\mathfrak{so}(2,3) \to \mathfrak{iso}(1,3)$. We describe the emergence of the Hilbert space of massive scattering states of arbitrary integer spin $s$ from unitary lowest-weight representations $\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ of the conformal group, using a basis of `pseudo-momentum' states first introduced by Fronsdal. These states nicely reduce to Wigner's momentum eigenstates in the limit of infinite AdS curvature radius $\ell \to \infty$, at fixed $m=\Delta/\ell$. A simple conformal map relates this description to conformal fields in $\mathbb{R}^3$ familiar from radial quantization, with the interior and exterior of the unit ball respectively corresponding to outgoing and ingoing momenta. Under the contraction, and upon appropriate rescaling, the inner product on $\mathcal{D}(\Delta,s)$ converges to the standard Lorentz-invariant inner product of Wigner's massive particles, so that unitarity is preserved throughout. The contraction to massless particles is briefly discussed here, and will be treated in detail in a forthcoming paper.

一句话导读：从 AdS4 共形群最低权表示出发，在 Inönü–Wigner 平直极限下构造 Wigner 有质量粒子希尔伯特空间，并证明内积收敛与幺正性保持。

AdS4-Einstein-标量引力中平面黑洞上的微扰双标量毛发

Perturbative Double-Scalar Hair on Planar Black Holes in AdS$_{4}$-Einstein-Scalar Gravity

Sangheon Yun · hep-th, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们在四维Einstein引力中构造了耦合两个标量的双标量毛发平面黑洞，其势来自十一维超引力的ABJM一致截断。从已知单标量毛发黑膜出发，我们在无量纲毛发参数ε中微扰地打开第二个标量φ_m（固定源时正比于λ_-T），并求解耦合Einstein-标量系统至ε^2阶。线性化φ_m剖面是精确超几何函数，不依赖于φ_p毛发；其视界正则分支总带有源，因此没有自发φ_m毛发。由于对偶算符为无关算符（Δ_-=4），二阶响应出现共振对数：凝聚随闭式系数跑动，该系数由三阶顶点固定。度规和φ_p反作用以闭式给出；对任意毛发，它对角化为两个Pöschl-Teller问题，并将φ_p修正与横向度规修正锁定，比例为6/√7。在AdS-Schwarzschild上，第一定律与全息重整化一致，给出解析状态方程：固定熵时 T/T0 -1 = -(5√3/8π)ε^2，c_s^2 = 1/2 - (5√3/8π)ε^2，且 η/s = 1/4π，ζ/η = 1/4 ε^2。然后加入截断中Z2奇的第三标量χ，其对偶维Δχ=5。在毛发背景上其线性方程是带表观奇点的Heun方程，由Clausen函数求解。二阶时χ必然源φ_m，但两种交叉耦合都不使任一凝聚跑动，这种相互非重整化来自单步共振恒等式和关系 2Δχ - Δ_- = 2d。

English: We construct a two-scalar hairy planar black hole in four-dimensional Einstein gravity coupled to two scalars whose potential descends from the ABJM consistent truncation of eleven-dimensional supergravity. Starting from the known single-scalar hairy black brane, we switch on the second scalar $\phim$ perturbatively in its dimensionless hair parameter $\eps$, which at fixed source is proportional to $\lambda_{-}T$, and solve the coupled Einstein-scalar system to order $\eps^{2}$. The linearized $\phim$ profile is an exact hypergeometric function, independent of the $\pp$ hair, whose horizon-regular branch always carries a source, so there is no spontaneous $\phim$ hair. Because the dual operator is irrelevant ($\Delta_{-}=4$), the second-order response develops a resonant logarithm: the condensate runs with a closed-form coefficient fixed by the cubic vertex. The metric and $\pp$ back-reaction is obtained in closed form; for arbitrary hair it diagonalizes into two P\"oschl-Teller problems and locks the $\pp$ correction to the transverse metric correction with ratio $6/\sqrt7$. On AdS-Schwarzschild the first law and holographic renormalization agree and give an analytic equation of state, $T/T_{0}-1=-\tfrac{5\sqrt3}{8\pi}\eps^{2}$ at fixed entropy and $c_{s}^{2}=\tfrac12-\tfrac{5\sqrt3}{8\pi}\eps^{2}$, with $\eta/s=1/4\pi$ and $\zeta/\eta=\tfrac14\eps^{2}$. We then add the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$-odd third scalar $\chi$ of the truncation, dual to $\Delta_{\chi}=5$. On the hairy background its linear equation is a Heun equation with an apparent singularity, solved by a Clausen function. At second order $\chi$ necessarily sources $\phim$, yet neither cross-coupling makes either condensate run, a mutual non-renormalization that follows from a one-step resonance identity and the relation $2\Delta_{\chi}-\Delta_{-}=2d$.

一句话导读：在AdS4 Einstein-标量引力中微扰构造双标量毛发平面黑洞，并给出全息重整化、状态方程、输运系数及多标量相互非重整化结果。

Alexandre Belin, Suzanne Bintanja, Alessandra Gnecchi, Damian R. Musk, Kyriakos Papadodimas · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：D1D5 CFT 的 BPS 态表现出电荷集中难题，与 N=4 SYM 的情形类似但更简单。我们考虑 D1D5 CFT 中由超荷上同调产生的 1/4-BPS 算符的手征代数，以及由此得到的有理关联函数。利用交叉对称性和该手征代数，我们对一般耦合和有限中心荷下、远离电荷集中轨迹的一族 1/4-BPS 态的存在性给出了非微扰证明。我们进一步讨论这对 D1D5 CFT 中 BPS 混沌的可能含义，并在 orbifold 点计算了一个晚期 BPS 平台。

English: The D1D5 CFT exhibits a charge concentration puzzle for BPS states, similar to, but simpler than, that of $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM. We consider the chiral algebra of 1/4-BPS operators in the D1D5 CFT arising from a supercharge cohomology, and the resulting rational correlators. Using crossing symmetry and this chiral algebra, we establish a non-perturbative proof of the existence of a family of 1/4-BPS states away from the charge concentration locus for general coupling and finite central charge. We further discuss possible implications for BPS chaos in the D1D5 CFT and compute a late-time BPS plateau at the orbifold point.

一句话导读：利用 D1D5 CFT 的 1/4-BPS 手征代数非微扰证明远离电荷集中轨迹的 BPS 态，并探讨 BPS 混沌与晚期平台。

Linking defects via AdS/CFT holography

Varun Gupta · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：在本文中，我们讨论嵌入在一个 IIB 型超引力背景解中的一些超对称探针 D5 膜解，该背景解通过形变整体 AdS5×S5 时空得到。所关注的 D5 膜解具有非紧致世界体；当它与一个重叠的反 D5 膜解放在一起时，其组合对偶于边界 SYM 理论的一个余维一缺陷。如果我们把探针 D5 的轮廓更多地移向体时空边界，使其形成从边界悬挂下来的 U 形轮廓，则对偶缺陷变成一个 U(1) 0-形式整体对称性的拓扑对称缺陷。我们展示如何利用悬挂 D5 膜，通过让 SYM 理论中的重行列式算符穿过体时空中的对偶巨引力子 D3 膜，来全息测量这些算符的 U(1) 整体对称性荷。

English: In this article, we discuss some supersymmetric probe D5 brane solutions embedded in a type 2b supergravity background solution obtained by deforming the global $AdS_5 \times S^5$ spacetime. The D5 brane solution of interest has a non-compact worldvolume, and when it is placed alongside overlapping with an anti-$\overline{\text{D5}}$ solution, the combination is dual to a codimension-1 defect of the boundary $SYM$ theory. The dual defect becomes a topological symmetry defect of a $U(1)$ $0$-form global symmetry if we move the profile of the probe D5 more towards the boundary of the bulk spacetime, resulting in a U-shaped profile hanging from the boundary. We show how the hanging D5 brane can be used holographically to measure the $U(1)$ global symmetry charge of the heavy determinant operators in the SYM theory by moving them across dual giant graviton D3 branes in the bulk spacetime.

一句话导读：利用形变 AdS5×S5 中的探针 D5/反 D5 膜构造边界 SYM 的余维一缺陷，并借助悬挂 D5 膜与巨引力子 D3 膜测量重行列式算符的 U(1) 荷。

相关度：medium — 论文核心是 AdS/CFT 中探针 D5/反 D5 膜与缺陷构造，并涉及巨引力子，命中 D3-D5 探针膜标签；但不涉及 Floquet 驱动、超流超导或多分量序参量等其它重点支线。

在 AdS$_3$ 中闭合 $\Phi^4$ 的圈图

Dean Carmi, Riccardo Ciccone, Shimon Sukholuski · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们计算了 AdS$_3$ 中 $\Phi^4$ 理论所有双迹算符 $[\phi\phi]_{n,\ell}$ 的 CFT 数据的单圈修正，适用于任意 $n$、$\ell$ 以及标度维度 $\Delta_\phi>1$。在谱表示下，$t$ 道单圈气泡图被约化为由共形 $6j$ 符号修饰的谱积分乘积。谱积分以及随后的留数求和均解析完成，用高阶超几何函数给出了反常维度的有限闭式表达式。我们讨论结果的结构，包括其大自旋和高能行为，并表明反常维度对自旋完全单调。

English: We compute the one-loop correction to the CFT data of all double-trace operators $[\phi\phi]_{n,\ell}$ for a $\Phi^4$ theory in AdS$_3$, for arbitrary values of $n$, $\ell$, and of the scaling dimension $\Delta_\phi>1$. Working in the spectral representation, the $t$-channel one-loop bubble diagram is reduced to a product of spectral integrals dressed by the conformal $6j$ symbol. Both the spectral integrals and the subsequent sums over residues are performed analytically, yielding finite closed-form expressions for the anomalous dimensions in terms of higher hypergeometric functions. We discuss the structure of the results, including their large-spin and high-energy behaviors, and show that the anomalous dimensions are completely monotonic in spin.

一句话导读：计算 AdS$_3$ 中 $\Phi^4$ 理论所有双迹算符 CFT 数据的单圈修正，并解析给出反常维度的闭式表达式。

中文摘要：我们提出了四维线性化引力的首个显式洛伦兹协变且民主的表述，即平等对待由电磁对偶相联系的两个框架。众所周知，四维线性化引力属于四维共形代数 so(2,4) 的一类 singleton 表示。我们的关键洞察是将该代数视为 AdS5 的等距代数，并将无质量自旋-2 场实现为取值于 so(2,4) 的特定有限维表示的五维拓扑场的边缘模式。所需的四维作用量随后通过协变边界约化程序得到。

Our key insight is viewing this algebra as the isometry of $\text{AdS}_5$ and realising the massless spin-2 field as edge modes of a five-dimensional topological field taking values in a specific finite-dimensional representation of $\mathfrak{so}(2,4)$. English: We study how entanglement entropy can be used to reconstruct a dual gravity description. For a two-dimensional thermal system, equal-time entanglement entropy determines the spatial part of a three-dimensional black-hole geometry within a given metric ansatz. For an undeformed conformal field theory, the same inverse problem can be solved analytically by the Abel transformation. For a relevant deformation, we work in three-dimensional Einstein gravity with one canonical scalar field whose profile is monotonic. The geometry reconstructed from the given entanglement entropy then allows us to determine the scalar profile and the part of the scalar potential sampled by the RG flow. It also determines the holographic $\beta$-function and $c$-function.

中文摘要：我们提出了一套形式化方法，用于计算在时间对称时刻下，引力时空中任意空间区域的纠缠熵。关键要素是对该区域嵌入整体时空的路径积分，可解释为与该区域相关的边缘模式的求和。我们认为，在牛顿常数领头阶下，这种纠缠熵可以解释为所有包围它的区域中的最小广义熵。这暗示了一种“陆地全息”的概念：空间中的区域可以编码更大的区域，这与标准全息不同，标准全息中宇宙边界天球上的自由度编码内部。

English: We develop a formalism for calculating the entanglement entropy of an arbitrary spatial region of a gravitating spacetime at a moment of time symmetry. This suggests a notion of ``terrestrial holography'' where regions of space can encode larger ones, in contrast to the standard form of holography, in which degrees of freedom on the celestial sphere at the boundary of the universe encode the interior.

高维中的涡旋时空：真空背景与黑洞

Swirling spacetimes in higher dimensions: Vacuum backgrounds and black holes

Jos\'e Barrientos, Adolfo Cisterna, Carlos Herdeiro, Konstantinos Pallikaris · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们利用降维理论中的隐藏对称性，在真空广义相对论中构造高维涡旋时空。直接采用陪集空间表述，我们在五维中沿两个独立轴向 Killing 矢量进行约化，得到一个 SL(3,R)/SO(3) sigma 模型，以及一个具有两个独立涡旋参数的真正五维背景。同一变换也生成双涡旋的 Schwarzschild-Tangherlini 和 Myers-Perry 几何。新背景的一个显著特征是其多方向渐近结构。关联的径向-角度极限揭示了方向性曲率奇点，这些奇点在通常固定角的大半径极限中不可见。我们进一步展示能够以有限仿射参数到达此类奇异渐近端点的因果测地线。最后，我们描述这种构造到高维的最大轴向延拓：对于完全轴向约化到三维，五维是最大的；而六维允许一个额外的非平凡平移形变，更高维只贡献平坦旁观方向。

English: We construct higher-dimensional swirling spacetimes in vacuum General Relativity using the hidden symmetries of the dimensionally reduced theory. Working directly with the coset-space formulation, we perform in five dimensions a reduction along the two independent axial Killing vectors, obtaining an $SL(3,\mathbb{R})/SO(3)$ sigma model and a genuinely five-dimensional background with two independent swirling parameters. The same transformation yields doubly swirling Schwarzschild--Tangherlini and Myers--Perry geometries. A distinctive feature of the new background is its multidirectional asymptotic structure. Correlated radial-angular limits reveal directional curvature singularities that are invisible in the usual large-radius limit at fixed angle. We further exhibit causal geodesics that reach such singular asymptotic ends in finite affine parameter. Finally, we describe the maximally axial extension of this construction to higher dimensions: five dimensions are maximal for an entirely axial reduction to three dimensions, while six dimensions admit an additional nontrivial translational deformation, with further dimensions contributing only flat spectator directions.

一句话导读：利用降维隐藏对称性构造高维真空涡旋时空，给出双涡旋黑洞几何并揭示方向性渐近奇点与测地线性质。

相关度：high — 论文直接研究高维真空 Einstein 方程、隐藏对称性约化、经典黑洞解以及奇点和测地线，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

超越 Horndeski 引力中具有初级毛发的非互易黑洞：精确解与稳定性

Nonreciprocal black holes with primary hair in beyond Horndeski gravity: Exact solutions and stability

Sebastian Bahamonde, Theodoros Nakas, Simon Iteanu · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们提出一种新的系统方法，用于在位移对称和 Z2 对称的超越 Horndeski 理论中构造精确、静态且渐近平直的黑洞解。与以往研究不同，我们的方法不依赖于限制性的互易条件 g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1，从而允许由两个独立度规函数描述的更一般几何。所得解空间包含两类定性不同的毛发，分别源自理论的不同分支。一个分支以 khronometric 毛发为特征，另一个分支则以真正的标量毛发为特征。在两者中，标量剖面都定义了一个非平庸的优选叶层化，但前者位移对称诺特流及相应传播自由度是平凡的，后者则是非零的。我们主要关注第二个分支，推导出若干不同的精确黑洞解族。一般来说，这些解是奇异的，并具有与独立标量荷相关的初级标量毛发。尽管如此，我们证明它们可以被正则化，从而得到规则黑洞或孤子组态，此时标量毛发变为次级。我们进一步通过分析轴向扇区和偶宇称扇区的单极（ℓ=0）模，在线性微扰下研究这些解的稳定性。对于具有标量毛发的代表性解，微扰分析给出了在所考虑模式下线稳定性的证据。

English: We develop a novel systematic method for constructing exact, static, and asymptotically flat black-hole solutions in shift-symmetric and $Z_2$-symmetric beyond Horndeski theories. In contrast to previous studies, our approach does not rely on the restrictive reciprocal condition $g_{tt}g_{rr}=-1$, allowing for more general geometries characterized by two independent metric functions. The resulting solution space contains two qualitatively distinct types of hair originating from different branches of the theory. One branch is characterized by khronometric hair, while the other by genuine scalar hair. In both, the scalar profile defines a nontrivial preferred foliation, but the shift-symmetry Noether current and the associated propagating degree of freedom are trivial for the former and nonvanishing for the latter. Focusing mainly on the second branch, we derive several distinct families of exact black-hole solutions. In general, these solutions are singular and exhibit primary scalar hair associated with an independent scalar charge. Nevertheless, we demonstrate that they can be regularized to yield regular black-hole or solitonic configurations, for which the scalar hair becomes secondary. We further investigate the stability properties of these solutions under linear perturbations by analyzing the axial sector and the monopole $(\ell=0)$ mode of the even-parity sector. For representative solutions with scalar hair, the perturbative analysis provides evidence for linear stability under the modes considered.

一句话导读：在超越 Horndeski 引力中不依赖互易条件构造出带初级标量毛发的精确渐近平直黑洞解，并分析其线性稳定性。

N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论大荷极限下的能量-能量关联函数

Energy-energy correlators in the large-charge limit of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory

Alessandro Georgoudis, Max Jackson, Congkao Wen · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们研究四维 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论重态中的能量-能量关联函数（EEC），所处的大荷 't Hooft 极限为：重算符的维度 Δ（等价地，其 R-荷）趋于无穷，同时保持有效耦合 λ_Q ∝ g_YM^2 Δ 固定。在此极限下，相关的重-重-轻-轻四点关联函数已知到 λ_Q 的任意阶。对于某些类型的算符，微扰级数可以重求和，从而得到精确的有限耦合表达式。我们利用这些结果确定相应的 EEC，其动力学部分可由四点关联函数的双重不连续性提取。我们给出了有限有效耦合下的 EEC，并研究其作为 λ_Q 以及探测器之间角分离的函数在一般角度、共线极限和背对背极限下的物理行为。

English: We study the energy-energy correlator (EEC) in heavy states of four-dimensional $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory in the large-charge 't Hooft limit, in which the dimension $\Delta$ of the heavy operator (or, equivalently, its $R$-charge) is taken to infinity with the effective coupling $\lambda_Q \propto g_{\mathrm{YM}}^2\Delta$ held fixed. The relevant heavy-heavy-light-light four-point correlators are known to all orders in $\lambda_Q$ in this limit. For certain classes of operators, the perturbative series can be resummed to obtain exact finite-coupling expressions. We use these results to determine the corresponding EEC, whose dynamical part can be extracted from a double discontinuity of the four-point correlator. We determine the EEC at finite effective coupling and study its physical behavior as a function of $\lambda_Q$ and the angular separation between the detectors, both at generic angles and in the collinear and back-to-back limits.

一句话导读：在大荷 't Hooft 极限下研究 N=4 SYM 重态的能量-能量关联函数，并从重-重-轻-轻四点关联函数提取有限有效耦合下的 EEC 行为。

相关度：low — 该文属于 N=4 SYM/共形场论关联函数研究，但摘要未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM、冷原子实验启发或探针膜等具体支线。

弹跳奇点的弦论消解

Stringy resolution of bouncing singularities

Ilija Buri\'c, Ivan Gusev, Andrei Parnachev · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们研究了近极端 NS5 膜的近视界几何，它允许用 SL(2,R)_k/U(1) coset 给出精确的世界面描述。在超引力极限下，解析延拓到时间域的反射振幅表现出与从黑洞奇点反弹的零测地线相关的奇点，类似于渐近 AdS 时空中边界关联子的反弹奇点。我们证明有限弦长效应使该振幅成为复时间的整函数，从而完全消解了反弹奇点。这种消解在 coset 能级的倒数展开中是非微扰的：该奇点在展开的每个有限阶都持续存在。

English: We study the near-horizon geometry of near-extremal NS5 branes, which admits an exact worldsheet description in terms of the $SL(2,\mathbb{R})_k/U(1)$ coset. In the supergravity limit, the analytically continued time-domain reflection amplitude exhibits a singularity associated with a null geodesic bouncing off the black-hole singularity, analogous to the bouncing singularities of boundary correlators in asymptotically AdS spacetimes. We show that finite-string-length effects render this amplitude an entire function of complex time, completely resolving the bouncing singularity. This resolution is nonperturbative in the inverse coset level: the singularity persists at every finite order in the expansion.

一句话导读：近极端 NS5 膜通过 SL(2,R)/U(1) coset 的世界面精确描述表明，有限弦长效应非微扰地消解了黑洞反弹奇点。

精确流体力学作用量的视界对称性

Horizon symmetries of exact hydrodynamic actions

Mike Blake, Arpit Das, Richard A. Davison · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们展示 AdS 黑洞的视界对称性如何在对偶能动张量动力学的流体力学作用量中实现。最近一种获得此类作用量的方法涉及选取视界边界条件，我们证明保持这些边界条件的微分同胚给出了相应流体力学作用量的对称性。利用该方法，我们获得了 JT 引力和 AdS3 引力中黑洞小振幅扰动的显式流体力学作用量，并显式证明了这些对称性的存在。对于一种自然的边界条件选择，所得作用量明显地实现了此前为最大混沌有效理论提出的规范对称性。

English: We demonstrate how horizon symmetries of AdS black holes are realised in the hydrodynamic actions for the dynamics of the dual stress tensor. A recent approach for obtaining such actions involves a choice of horizon boundary conditions, and we show that diffeomorphisms that preserve these give rise to symmetries of the corresponding hydrodynamic action. We obtain explicit hydrodynamic actions for small amplitude perturbations of black holes in JT and AdS$_3$ gravity using this approach and demonstrate explicitly the existence of these symmetries. For a natural choice of boundary conditions, the resulting actions manifestly realise gauge symmetries previously proposed for effective theories of maximal chaos.

一句话导读：从 AdS 黑洞视界边界条件与保持微分同胚导出精确流体力学作用量，并在 JT/AdS3 中实现最大混沌有效理论的规范对称性。

相关度：high — 与全息对偶、AdS 黑洞视界、流体力学作用量及最大混沌有效理论直接相关；涉及 JT/AdS3 和边界条件/微分同胚，贴合全息非平衡与混沌方向。

de Sitter JT 引力的概率测度

Probability measures for de Sitter JT gravity

Wilfried Buchmuller, Alexander Westphal · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：具有正宇宙学常数的 Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) 引力是研究从量子态中涌现出膨胀 de Sitter 宇宙的玩具模型。其密度矩阵是双喇叭振幅的叠加，而这些振幅是 Wheeler-DeWitt 方程的解。我们比较了此类混合态对经典膨胀宇宙的预言与无边界波函数的相应预言。与全息一致的、其半经典极限与 Schwarzian 边界涨落结果相符的双喇叭振幅，给出宇宙大小的平坦概率分布，与暴胀模型一致。这与无边界波函数所预言的对大宇宙的压低形成对比。

English: Jackiw-Teitelboim (JT) gravity with positive cosmological constant is a toy model to study the emergence of expanding de Sitter universes from a quantum state. Its density matrix is a superposition of double-trumpet amplitudes which are solutions of a Wheeler-DeWitt equation. We compare predictions of such mixed states for classical expanding universes with the corresponding predictions of no-boundary wavefunctions. Double-trumpet amplitudes consistent with holography, whose semiclassical limit matches the result from Schwarzian boundary fluctuations, lead to a flat probability distribution for the size of the universe, consistent with models of inflation. This is in contrast to the suppression of large universes predicted by no-boundary wave functions.

一句话导读：在 de Sitter JT 引力中，比较双喇叭混合态与无边界波函数给出的宇宙大小概率分布，发现全息一致的双喇叭预言平坦分布而非大宇宙压低。

AdS/BCFT 中的多分纠缠几何

Multipartite Entanglement Geometry in AdS/BCFT

Debarshi Basu, Qiang Wen, Mingshuai Xu · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：多分纠缠度量探测量子关联的组织方式如何超出成对熵所能推断的内容。我们研究在全息 BCFT 中物理边界如何重塑这种结构。世界末端膜为多分纠缠打开新的相对同调通道，使得连通的体 web 可以在不必与普通 Ryu--Takayanagi 转变重合的尺度上重组和因子化。在静态 AdS3/BCFT2 中，这产生特征性的多分相层级以及真正多熵对边界的非平凡依赖。在热场双态中，真正连通的 web 反而可以通过爱因斯坦--罗森桥支撑，导致不同于通常 Hartman--Maldacena 转变的增长、重连和饱和尺度。这些结果表明，多分纠缠不仅对极端曲面面积敏感，而且对存在边界时体纠缠结构被允许如何连接、分裂和终止敏感。

English: Multipartite entanglement measures probe how quantum correlations are organized beyond what can be inferred from pairwise entropies. We study how this structure is reshaped by a physical boundary in a holographic BCFT. The end-of-the-world brane opens new relative-homology channels for multipartite entanglement, allowing connected bulk webs to reorganize and factorize at scales that need not coincide with any ordinary Ryu--Takayanagi transition. In static AdS$_3$/BCFT$_2$, this produces a characteristic hierarchy of multipartite phases and a nontrivial dependence of genuine multi-entropy on the boundary. In the thermofield-double state, genuinely connected webs can instead be supported through the Einstein--Rosen bridge, leading to growth, reconnection and saturation scales distinct from the usual Hartman--Maldacena transitions. These results show that multipartite entanglement is sensitive not only to extremal-surface areas but also to how bulk entanglement structures are allowed to join, split and terminate in the presence of a boundary.

一句话导读：在 AdS/BCFT 中，边界膜改变多分纠缠的体同调通道，产生独立于普通 RT 转变的多分相层级和 TFD 中的新饱和尺度。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

从分级泊松几何看 Einstein-Cartan 与 Palatini-Cartan 引力

Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan Gravity from Graded Poisson Geometry

Johannes Moerland, Peter Schupp · hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：利用分级泊松几何中的概念，我们建立了一个框架，可简洁地表述 Einstein-Cartan 与 Palatini-Cartan 引力等场论。我们证明 Einstein-Cartan 引力等价于一类 Palatini-Cartan 引力的变体，其中 vielbein 场被约束满足适当的对称关系，我们称之为受约束 vielbein 引力。为此，我们通过分级流形之间的微分同胚联系这些理论。随后我们展示如何通过去除对称性约束来得到完整的 Palatini-Cartan 理论。最后，我们说明该分级几何框架如何直接纳入受约束 vielbein 与 Palatini-Cartan 理论的最小 BV 扩张。

English: Using notions from graded Poisson geometry, we develop a framework that allows for concise formulations of field theories such as Einstein-Cartan and Palatini-Cartan gravity. We show that Einstein-Cartan gravity is equivalent to a variant of Palatini-Cartan gravity in which the vielbein fields are constrained to satisfy appropriate symmetry relations, which we refer to as constrained vielbein gravity. To that end, we relate these theories via a diffeomorphism of graded manifolds. We then show how to obtain the full Palatini-Cartan theory by removing the symmetry constraint. Finally, we show how our graded geometric framework allows for a direct incorporation of the minimal BV extension of the graded constrained vielbein and Palatini-Cartan theories.

一句话导读：用分级泊松几何统一表述 Einstein-Cartan 与 Palatini-Cartan 引力，并构造最小 BV 扩张。

极端黑洞模仿者：几何、稳定性与长延迟信号列

Extremal black hole mimickers: geometry, stability, and long-delay signal trains

Sergey N. Solodukhin · hep-th, gr-qc, math-ph, math.MP · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：我们提出一个作为极端黑洞无视界模仿者的时空。与先前研究的非退化视界黑洞模仿者不同——其几何为虫洞型，由两个渐近平坦区域通过极长喉部连接——极端黑洞的模仿者在一端具有单个渐近平坦区域，另一端为无限长喉部。在喉部区域，时空趋近直积几何 M_{1,1} × S^2，其中 M_{1,1} 为二维闵可夫斯基时空，S^2 为二维球面。我们研究标量场动力学以及 Aretakis 不稳定性的命运。尽管在喉部的局部分析中出现 Aretakis 型模式，它们并不会导致模仿者的物理不稳定性。一个最初局域于喉部的标量扰动在晚期会产生具有特征间隔 t_delay ∼ 1/λ 的信号序列，其中 λ≪1 是形变参数。该时标在参数上大于非极端黑洞模仿者所特有的回声时间 t_echo ∼ ln(1/λ)。我们将此序列称为长延迟信号列。几何上，长延迟信号的周期性对应于 S^2 上的周期测地线。然后我们将构造推广到极端 Kerr。在此情形，喉部区域趋近于涉及 M_{1,1} 和二维曲面 Σ_2 的广义直积几何。相应信号预期形成准周期信号列，反映 Σ_2 上的准周期测地运动。我们还评论了对非极端黑洞虫洞型模仿者的推广，以及这些结果在 AdS/CFT 对应下对幺正性的意义。

English: We present a spacetime that serves as a horizonless mimicker of extremal black holes. Unlike previously studied mimickers of black holes with non-degenerate horizons, whose geometries are of the wormhole type and consist of two asymptotically flat regions connected by a very long throat, the mimicker of an extremal black hole possesses a single asymptotically flat region at one end and an infinitely long throat at the other. In the throat region, the spacetime approaches the direct-product geometry $M_{1,1} \times S^2$, where $M_{1,1}$ is two-dimensional Minkowski spacetime and $S^2$ is the two-sphere. We investigate scalar-field dynamics and the fate of the Aretakis instability. Although Aretakis-like modes arise in a local analysis of the throat, they do not lead to a physical instability of the mimicker. A scalar perturbation initially localized in the throat gives rise, at late times, to a sequence of signals with a characteristic separation $t_{\rm delay}\sim 1/\lambda$, where $\lambda\ll 1$ is a deformation parameter. This timescale is parametrically larger than the echo time $t_{\rm echo}\sim \ln(1/\lambda)$ characteristic of non-extremal black-hole mimickers. We refer to this sequence as a {\it long-delay signal train}. Geometrically, the periodicity of the long-delay signals is associated with periodic geodesics on $S^2$. We then extend the construction to extremal Kerr. In this case, the throat region approaches a generalized product geometry involving $M_{1,1}$ and a two-dimensional surface $\Sigma_2$. The corresponding signals are expected to form a quasi-periodic signal train, reflecting the quasi-periodic geodesic motion on $\Sigma_2$. 中文摘要：我们研究度为 L 的规范不变双矩阵多项式，它们对应于规范群为 U(N) 或 SU(N)、有限 N 下的 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论 su(2) 扇区中的态。对于 U(N) 理论，态空间具有代数 A_N(L) 的结构，该代数是置换中心化子代数的直和，即 S_L 的群代数 C[S_L] 的子代数。当 N >= L 时，A_N(L)=A(L) 与 N 无关，一圈膨胀算符作用在 A(L) 上，其中 N 作为参数。当 N < L 时，A_N(L) 是 A(L) 的一个子空间，由对具有 L 个方格的杨图施加有限 N 截断来定义。我们建立关于一圈膨胀算符本征空间的两个结果。第一个主要结果是：一圈膨胀算符在 A_N(L) 上的特征多项式整除从 A(L) 延续到 N < L 的特征多项式。第二个结果是：SU(N) 理论中一圈膨胀算符的每个本征态，通过乘上单字母迹，会在 U(N) 理论中生成一个无穷本征态塔。这些塔定义了 U(N) 理论按此类迹的数目标记的本征空间因子化。进一步，我们猜想：有限 N 下两个无迹矩阵的 SU(N) 不变多项式空间，同构于 A_N(L) 与 C[S_L] 中由错排张成的子空间的交集。该交集猜想得到维数计数的支持。最后，我们在该交集上提出一个一圈膨胀算符，从而为有限 N 下 SU(N) 谱问题提供一个直接的置换框架。基于该提议计算出的谱与 U(N) 理论中本征空间因子化的预言一致。

English: We study gauge-invariant two-matrix polynomials of degree $L$, corresponding to the states in the $su(2)$ sector of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory with gauge group $U(N)$ or $SU(N)$ at finite $N$. For the $U(N)$ theory, the state space has the structure of an algebra $\mathcal{A}_N(L)$, which is a direct sum of permutation centraliser algebras, i.e. sub-algebras of the group algebra $\mathbb{C}[S_L]$ of $S_L$. For $N \ge L$, $\mathcal{A}_N (L) = \mathcal{A} (L)$ is independent of $N$, and the one-loop dilatation operator acts on $\mathcal{A}(L)$ with $N$ as a parameter. For $N < L$, $\mathcal{A}_N (L)$ is a subspace of $\mathcal{A}(L)$ defined using a finite-$N$ cutoff on Young diagrams with $L$ boxes. We establish two results on the eigenspaces of the one-loop dilatation operator. Our first main result is that the characteristic polynomial of the one-loop dilatation operator on $\mathcal{A}_N(L)$ divides the characteristic polynomial from $\mathcal{A}(L)$, continued to $N < L$. Our second result is that each eigenstate of the one-loop dilatation operator in the $SU(N)$ theory generates an infinite tower of eigenstates in the $U(N)$ theory, through the multiplication of single-letter traces. These towers define an eigenspace factorisation of the $U(N)$ theory labelled by the number of such traces. Further, we conjecture that the space of $SU(N)$-invariant polynomials in two traceless matrices at finite $N$ is isomorphic to the intersection of $\mathcal{A}_N(L)$ with the subspace of $\mathbb{C}[S_L]$ spanned by derangements. This intersection conjecture is supported by dimension counting. Finally, we propose a one-loop dilatation operator on the intersection, thus providing a direct permutation framework for the $SU(N)$ spectral problem at finite $N$. The computed spectra based on the proposal agree with the prediction from the eigenspace factorisation in the $U(N)$ theory.

中文摘要：我们研究了在存在半BPS表面缺陷时，N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中手征主算符的两点函数。此类缺陷仅保持横向转动与整体 U(1) R-对称性的对角组合，因此关联函数依赖于一个额外的交比，并分裂为具有确定角荷的扇区。我们求解了超共形 Ward 恒等式，并构造了所有扇区中的体块与缺陷超共形块，包括带电扇区；这些带电扇区在保持横向转动的缺陷中没有类似物。解中包含一个全纯扇区，我们通过将其映射到手征代数关联函数来非微扰地固定。我们将此映射推广到破坏横向转动的缺陷，此时它要求重新定义二维流代数的模式，并利用它来固定带电扇区。随后，我们利用缺陷色散关系，在大 N 与强耦合领头阶重构了维度二手征主算符的完整关联函数。在带电扇区中长多重态不存在，且该结果被猜测在 N 和耦合常数上都精确；将其在弱耦合展开，我们发现与已知结果完全一致。从这些关联函数中，我们提取出无穷多个新的缺陷 CFT 数据。最后，我们通过在转动不变轨迹上的独立 Witten 图自举再现了强耦合答案。

English: We study two-point functions of chiral primary operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills in the presence of a half-BPS surface defect. Such a defect preserves only the diagonal combination of transverse rotations and of a global U(1) R-symmetry, so that the correlator depends on one additional cross-ratio and splits into sectors of definite angular charge. We solve the superconformal Ward identities and construct the bulk and defect superconformal blocks in all sectors, including the charged ones, which have no analogue for defects preserving transverse rotations. The solution contains a holomorphic sector, which we fix non-perturbatively by mapping it to a chiral algebra correlator. We extend this map to defects breaking transverse rotations, where it requires a redefinition of the modes of the two-dimensional current algebra, and use it to fix the charged sectors as well. We then use the defect dispersion relation to reconstruct the full correlator of the dimension-two chiral primary at leading order at large N and strong coupling. In the charged sectors long multiplets are absent and the answer is conjecturally exact in both N and the coupling; expanding it at weak coupling, we find perfect agreement with known results. From these correlators we extract infinitely many new pieces of defect CFT data. Finally, we reproduce the strong-coupling answer by an independent Witten diagram bootstrap on the rotation-invariant locus.

中文摘要：我们研究了 AdS_D 的 Poincaré 片中的 Carroll-Weyl 规范零弦及其 BRST 量子化。在 Poincaré 坐标 X^A=(z,x^i) 中，径向共形 Killing 矢量 K=∂_z 在合适的共形相关标架下成为位似矢量。对位似哈密顿约束作场依赖重标度后，得到径向适配基 M=1/2(P_z^2+P_iP^i)、L=-P_A X'^A、S=P_z，其中 M 沿 Carroll-Weyl 径向流不变。它们的模式构成由 Abel 权重一电流扩展的 BMS_3 代数。我们分类该剩余代数允许的中心扩张，并在 LL、LM、LS、SS 通道发现四个独立上同调类。随后构造相应的 BRST 复形，包括径向 Carroll-Weyl 约束的鬼对。在正则最高权一阶表示中，只有 Virasoro 型中心扩张可实现：(c_LL,c_LM,c_LS,c_SS)=(2D-54,0,0,0)。因此相应非平凡 BRST 余圈消去给出该表示中 D=27。其结构与最小平坦 Carroll-Weyl 理论不同，后者由 dilation 约束 X·P 给出额外反常通道。

English: We study the Carroll-Weyl gauged null string in the Poincar\'e patch of $\mathrm{AdS}_D$ and its BRST quantization. In Poincar\'e coordinates $X^A=(z,x^i)$, the radial conformal Killing vector $K=\partial_z$ becomes homothetic in a suitable conformally related frame. A field-dependent rescaling of the homothetic Hamiltonian constraint then leads to the radial-adapted basis $\mathcal{M}=\frac{1}{2}(P_z^2+P_iP^i)$, $\mathcal{L}=-P_AX'^A$, and $\mathcal{S}=P_z$, with $\mathcal{M}$ invariant along the Carroll-Weyl radial flow. Their modes form a $\mathrm{BMS}_3$ algebra extended by an abelian weight-one current. We classify the central extensions allowed by this residual algebra and find four independent cohomology classes in the $LL$, $LM$, $LS$, and $SS$ channels. We then construct the associated BRST complex, including the ghost pair for the radial Carroll-Weyl constraint. In the canonical highest-weight first-order representation, only the Virasoro-type central extension is realized: $(c_{LL},c_{LM},c_{LS},c_{SS})=(2D-54,0,0,0)$. Cancellation of the corresponding nontrivial BRST cocycle therefore gives $D=27$ in this representation. This differs structurally from the minimal flat Carroll-Weyl theory, where the dilation constraint $X\cdot P$ gives extra anomaly channels.

Closed Universe, Quantum Entanglement and Observers

Hao Geng · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：有观点认为，在量子引力中，任何闭合宇宙对应的希尔伯特空间都是平凡的一维空间。为将此论点与我们宇宙的丰富性相协调，有人提出一旦纳入“观察者”，非平凡希尔伯特空间就会出现。此类“观察者”已被以不同方式建模。存在三类具体模型：1）“观察者”由系统完整哈密顿量中一个关于相空间变量线性的项来建模；2）在全息量子线路模型中，“观察者”被建模为闭合宇宙中与外部非引力系统纠缠的子系统；3）当微分同胚被自发破缺时，“观察者”被认为由出现的 Goldstone 玻色子描述。事实上，第三类是在试图物理实现第一类时被发现的。本文表明第二类也可统一到第三类中。我们的结果表明，“观察者”的出现是 Massive Islands 范式的表现。它表明引力子质量是量子态的一个特征。人们应把 islands 视为闭合宇宙，而把与引力子质量相关的 Goldstone 玻色子视为“观察者”，这正是在蒸发黑洞晚期的情形。这项工作的一项含义是，“观察者”可以“观察”量子引力中的整体对称性。

English: It has been argued that in quantum gravity the Hilbert space associated with any closed universe is trivially one-dimensional. To reconcile this argument with the richness of our own universe, it was suggested that a nontrivial Hilbert space will emerge once an ``observer" is included. Such an ``observer" has been modeled in different ways. There are three concrete classes of models: $\textbf{1)}$ The ``observer" is modeled by a term in the full Hamiltonian of the system which is linear in a phase space variable; $\textbf{2)}$ The ``observer" is modeled in the quantum circuit model of holography as a subsystem in the closed universe which is entangled with an external non-gravitational system; $\textbf{3)}$ The ``observer" is argued to be described by the emergent Goldstone bosons when the diffeomorphisms are spontaneously broken. In fact, the third class was discovered by an attempt to physically realize the first class. In this paper, we will show that the second class can also be unified into the third class. Our result indicates that the emergence of the ``observer" is a manifestation of the $\textit{Massive Islands}$ paradigm. It demonstrates that the graviton mass is a feature of the quantum state. One should think of the islands as closed universes and the Goldstone boson associated with the graviton mass as the ``observer", which is exactly the case at late-times for evaporating black holes. An implication of this work is that the ``observer" can ``observe" global symmetries in quantum gravity.

一句话导读：本文表明全息量子线路模型中的观察者可统一为微分同胚自发破缺产生的 Goldstone 玻色子，观察者出现是 Massive Islands 范式的体现。

从 QCD 有效电荷洞察色禁闭

Insight on confinement from the QCD effective charge

A. Deur · hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：如同 QED 的 Gell-Mann–Low 耦合 α，有效电荷 α_{g1} 是一个物理的、由可观测量定义的跑动耦合，可作为 QCD 耦合 α_s。它可以由一个解析形式表示，该形式与重整化群演化、全息光前 QCD（HLFQCD）以及关于 α_s 的世界数据一致。作为一个可观测量，α_{g1} 具有物理相关的解析结构，反映了底层的部分子动力学。在长距离区域，它在 Q^2 = ± i Λ_s^2 处显示出两个共轭虚奇点，其中 Λ_s 是 QCD 标度。为将此结构与禁闭联系起来，我们将 α_{g1} 与部分子穿衣传播子和顶点之间的已知一般关系，与最近 HLFQCD 中 α_{g1} 的唯象表示相结合。由于与顶点不同，传播子表征分离位置之间的场变化，两个奇点被赋予传播子。这导致部分子传播子在长距离表现出 e^{-Λ_s |x|/√2} |x|^{-5/2 + d_a} 的行为，传播在超过 1/Λ_s 量级的距离上被抑制，正如禁闭所预期。这提供了对禁闭的直观解释：QCD 格林函数在长距离被抑制。

English: Like the Gell-Mann--Low coupling $\alpha$ of QED, the effective charge $\alpha_{g_1}$ is a physical, observable-defined running coupling that can serve as the QCD coupling $\alpha_s$. It can be represented by an analytic form consistent with renormalization-group evolution, holographic light-front QCD (HLFQCD), and the world data on $\alpha_s$. As an observable, $\alpha_{g_1}$ has a physically relevant analytic structure that reflects the underlying partonic dynamics. It displays, in the long-distance regime, two imaginary conjugate singularities at $Q^2 = \pm i\Lambda_s^2$, with $\Lambda_s$ the QCD scale. To connect this structure to confinement, we combine known general relations between $\alpha_{g_1}$ and the parton dressed propagators and vertices with a recent phenomenological representation of $\alpha_{g_1}$ within HLFQCD. Since, unlike vertices, propagators characterize a field variation between separate locations, the two singularities are assigned to the propagators. This results in the parton propagators displaying a long-distance behavior $e^{-\Lambda_s |x|/\sqrt{2}} |x|^{-5/2 + d_a}$ where propagation is suppressed beyond distances of order $1/\Lambda_s$, as expected from confinement. This offers an intuitive interpretation of confinement as the suppression of QCD Green's functions at long distance.

一句话导读：用全息光前 QCD 的有效电荷解析结构说明 QCD 传播子长程指数压制，从而为色禁闭提供直观解释。

通过后BBN时期物质主导与kination主导下的宇宙弦解释纳赫兹引力波

Interpretation of Nanohertz Gravitational Waves via Cosmic Strings in Post-BBN Matter and Kination Domination

Raymond T. Co, Siu Cheung Lam, Taegyu Lee · astro-ph.CO, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：近期脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）观测报告了与随机引力波背景一致的共同低频信号证据。本文在宇宙弦解释框架下研究该信号，考虑大爆炸核合成与复合之间一段非标准宇宙历史：早期物质主导阶段之后跟随kination阶段。已有研究表明，kination可以显著改变宇宙弦诱导的引力波谱，在纳赫兹频段产生特征，并形成与当前PTA数据一致的形状。在此基础上，我们分别对NANOGrav 15年和EPTA DR2 New+数据集进行贝叶斯分析，量化数据对这种宇宙历史的偏好程度。我们发现，在宇宙弦解释引力波信号的前提下，相对于标准宇宙历史，存在对短暂物质主导和kination主导阶段的实质性证据：NANOGrav 15年数据给出的Bayes因子为3.63^{+0.22}_{-0.21}，同时推断的宇宙弦张力几乎不变。若超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHB）贡献较小（如天体物理族群模拟所暗示），这一宇宙弦主导情景尤其相关。与纯SMBHB产生引力波的场景相比，在两种膨胀历史和两个数据集中，含或不含SMBHB额外贡献的宇宙弦解释均未显示出显著偏好。

English: Recent pulsar timing array (PTA) observations have reported evidence for a common low frequency signal consistent with a stochastic gravitational wave background. In this work, we investigate the cosmic string interpretation of this signal in a non-standard cosmological history between big bang nucleosynthesis and recombination, featuring an early matter-dominated era followed by a kination phase. Previous studies have shown that kination can significantly modify the cosmic-string-induced gravitational wave spectrum, generating characteristic features in the nanohertz range and producing a shape consistent with current PTA data. Building on this, we perform separate Bayesian analyses of the NANOGrav 15-year and EPTA DR2 New+ datasets to quantify the extent to which such a cosmological history is favored by the data. We find substantial evidence for a transient period of matter and kination domination over the standard cosmological history within a cosmic-string interpretation of the gravitational-wave signal, with a Bayes factor $3.63^{+0.22}_{-0.21}$ from the NANOGrav 15-year dataset, while leaving the inferred cosmic-string tension nearly unchanged. This cosmic-string-dominated scenario is particularly relevant if the contribution from supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) is small, as hinted at by astrophysical population simulations. Compared with a scenario where gravitational waves are produced purely by SMBHBs, cosmic-string interpretations with and without an additional contribution from SMBHBs, across both expansion histories and datasets, reveal no significant preference.

一句话导读：对NANOGrav 15年与EPTA DR2的贝叶斯分析表明，在宇宙弦解释PTA信号时，数据对BBN后早期物质主导加kination阶段给出实质性证据，但未显著优于SMBHB场景。

超辐射对超轻玻色子限制中的系统不确定性

Systematic Uncertainties in Ultralight Boson Constraints from Superradiance

P. S. Aswathi, Ling Sun · hep-ph, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-10-09

中文摘要：超轻玻色子是标准模型之外物理的合理候选者，并可能构成暗物质的全部或一部分。黑洞超辐射提供了一种通过其与旋转黑洞的引力相互作用来探测这些粒子的有力手段。该机制推动了一系列来自黑洞自旋电磁测量以及近期引力波观测的不断增长的约束。引力波探测利用若干不同特征：并合双黑洞的自旋、玻色子云发出的引力辐射，以及云诱导的双星动力学变化可能留下的印记。这些探测的解释取决于方法特定的天体物理和理论假设，包括黑洞形成、初始自旋、年龄、吸积历史、族群先验和玻色子自相互作用。本文综述由黑洞超辐射得到的主要电磁和引力波约束，特别强调其背后假设和系统不确定性。这些方法的不同观测特征和系统不确定性为超轻玻色子模型的可存活提供互补视角。特别是，它们在玻色子质量 $10^{-13}$-$10^{-12}$ eV 附近的重叠覆盖使该区域对于比较约束尤其有信息量，同时需关注每个结果背后的假设。

English: Ultralight bosons are well-motivated candidates for physics beyond the Standard Model and may constitute part or all of the dark matter. Black-hole superradiance provides a powerful means of probing these particles through their gravitational interaction with rotating black holes. This mechanism has motivated a growing body of constraints from electromagnetic measurements of black-hole spins and, more recently, gravitational-wave observations. Gravitational-wave probes draw on several distinct signatures: the spins of merging binary black holes, gravitational radiation emitted by boson clouds, and potential imprints of cloud-induced changes to binary dynamics. The interpretation of these probes depends on method-specific astrophysical and theoretical assumptions, including black hole formation, natal spin, age, accretion history, population priors, and boson self-interactions. In this paper, we review the principal electromagnetic and gravitational-wave constraints derived from black-hole superradiance, with particular emphasis on their underlying assumptions and systematic uncertainties. The distinct observational signatures and systematic uncertainties of these approaches offer complementary perspectives on the viability of ultralight-boson models. In particular, their overlapping coverage around boson masses of $10^{-13}$-$10^{-12}$ eV makes this region particularly informative for comparing constraints, with attention to the assumptions underlying each result.

一句话导读：综述黑洞超辐射对超轻玻色子给出的电磁与引力波限制及系统不确定性。

Q. -L. Zhao, P. -M. Zhang, M. Elbistan, J. Balog, P. A. Horvathy · gr-qc, hep-th, math-ph, math.MP · v2 · 更新 2026-10-08

English: The large-distance behaviour of a sandwich gravitational wave can be approximated by a continuous but not necessarily smooth profile, providing us with a simplified description of particle motion. Our approximate model is consistent with the Carroll symmetry. Our strategy is illustrated by the Poschl-Teller profile. The limits of the sandwich approximation are discussed.

含宇宙学常数的广义 type-D Einstein-Maxwell 解在零无穷处的引力辐射研究

Study of gravitational radiation at $\mathscr{J}$ for the general type-D Einstein-Maxwell solution with cosmological constant

Francisco Fern\'andez-\'Alvarez, Jos\'e M. M. Senovilla · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：我们刻画了含任意符号宇宙学常数 Λ 的一般 Plebański-Demiański type D 解中的引力辐射。我们证明，辐射逃逸到无穷远当且仅当加速度参数非零。我们计算了负 Λ 情形下的 Cotton-York 张量和无穷远处的边界应力-能量张量，以及正 Λ 情形下在零无穷处补充初始或最终数据的 D 张量。此外，我们通过一个简单的相似变换，将该度规族最近的一种参数化改写为新形式，正确识别出 Λ，并研究可能的对称轴的存在性与正则性，寻找亏损角与辐射之间的关系。我们还识别出在零无穷处具有非零 Cotton-York 张量的一般非辐射解分支。

English: We characterize the gravitational radiation present in the general Pleba\'nski-Demia\'nski type~D solution with cosmological constant $\Lambda$ of any sign. We show that radiation escapes towards infinity if and only if the acceleration parameter is non-zero. We calculate the Cotton-York tensor and the boundary stress-energy tensor at infinity for negative $\Lambda$, and for positive $\Lambda$ the $D$ tensor that complements initial or final data at $\mathscr{J}$. In addition, we recast a recent parametrization of this family of metrics into a new form by a simple homothety, correctly identifying $\Lambda$, and study the existence and regularity of the possible axes of symmetry, searching for a relation between deficit angles and radiation. We also identify the branch of general non-radiating solutions with non-vanishing Cotton-York tensor at $ \mathscr{J} $.

一句话导读：研究含任意符号 Λ 的一般 Plebański-Demiański type-D Einstein-Maxwell 解在零无穷处的引力辐射，发现仅当加速度参数非零时辐射逃逸，并分析边界张量、对称轴与亏损角。

de Sitter 标量离散系列：Gupta-Bleuler 结构与全息

de Sitter Scalar Discrete Series: Gupta-Bleuler Structure and Holography

Maryam Bajalan, Jean-Pierre Gazeau, Hamed Pejhan · math-ph, hep-th, math.MP, math.RT · v3 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：我们证明，de Sitter（dS）群 SO_0(1,4) 的标量离散系列酉不可约表示（UIRs）Π_{p,0}（p=1,2,⋯）在 dS 双曲面上承认一个 dS 协变的 Krein 实现，并带有 dS 不变的非退化 Klein-Gordon（KG）半双线性形式；其中群作用不可分解，并自然组织成 Gupta-Bleuler 三重态。正范数和负范数扇区已存在于底层 Krein 空间中，而零扇区仅在中间阶段出现；在中间阶段，诱导的 KG 形式退化，其根空间典范地导向携带 UIR Π_{p,0} 的物理商。我们进一步证明，体理论在“未来”和“过去”共形边界 I^± 的适当极限给出 dS 不变的边界实现，并带有诱导的核内积。虽然体负范数扇区没有独立的边界对应物，但边界实现保留了从体继承的物理与规范结构。所得边界模仍不可分解，其物理商携带离散系列表示 Π_{p,0}。对跖对称性在 I^+ 与 I^- 上的实现之间提供自然关系，确保边界构造及其几何解释的一致性。分析的核心是一个 Fourier 型体-边界变换，它给出体与边界物理扇区的 dS 协变识别，在保持反射正性的同时，在 Π_{p,0} 的体实现与边界实现之间建立一一对应的 intertwining 对应。

English: We show that scalar discrete-series unitary irreducible representations (UIRs) $\Pi_{p,0}$ ($p=1,2,\cdots$) of the de Sitter (dS) group $\mathrm{SO}_0(1,4)$ admit a dS-covariant Krein realization on the dS hyperboloid, endowed with a dS-invariant non-degenerate Klein-Gordon (KG) sesquilinear form, in which the group action is indecomposable and organizes naturally into a Gupta-Bleuler triplet. The positive- and negative-norm sectors are already present in the underlying Krein space, whereas a null sector emerges only at an intermediate stage, where the induced KG form becomes degenerate and its radical leads canonically to the physical quotient carrying the UIR $\Pi_{p,0}$. We further show that suitable limits of the bulk theory at the ``future'' and ``past'' conformal boundaries ${\mathcal{I}}^\pm$ give rise to dS-invariant boundary realizations endowed with induced kernel inner products. While the bulk negative-norm sector admits no independent boundary counterpart, the boundary realization retains the physical and gauge structures inherited from the bulk. The resulting boundary module nevertheless remains indecomposable, with its physical quotient carrying the discrete-series representation $\Pi_{p,0}$. The antipodal symmetry provides a natural relation between the realizations on ${\mathcal{I}}^+$ and ${\mathcal{I}}^-$, ensuring the consistency of the boundary construction and its geometric interpretation. At the heart of the analysis lies a Fourier-type bulk-boundary transform that provides a dS-covariant identification of the bulk and boundary physical sectors, establishing a one-to-one intertwining correspondence between the bulk and boundary realizations of $\Pi_{p,0}$ while preserving reflection positivity.

一句话导读：在 dS 双曲面上构造标量离散系列 UIR 的 Gupta-Bleuler/Krein 实现，并导出保持反射正性的体-边界全息对应。

具有 NNLO 微扰 QCD 重整化群改进的夸克星与混合星

Quark and hybrid stars with renormalization group improvement of NNLO perturbative QCD

Lo\"ic Fernandez, Jean-Lo\"ic Kneur, Marcus Benghi Pinto, Constan\c{c}a Provid\^encia, Claudia Ratti, Tulio E. Restrepo · nucl-th, astro-ph.HE, hep-ph, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：最近，冷且致密对称物质的 NNLO 微扰 QCD 压强（任意夸克质量）已在重整化群优化微扰论（RGOPT）框架下被重求和。由于获得了重整化群性质，所得压强对重整化标度（Λ≡X μ_B/3）变化的敏感度低于 NNLO 微扰 QCD 压强。这里我们通过考虑 β 平衡和电荷中性来扩展这一点，以计算相应的状态方程（EoS）。我们为 N_f=2+1 有质量夸克在不同重整化标度参数 X 下的 EoS 提供了一个紧凑的“口袋”拟合公式。我们描述了纯夸克星以及带有夸克核的混合星。与天体物理观测兼容的纯夸克星在 X=2.71-3.30 时获得，而如果 GW190814 的次分量代表中子星，则需要更大的值（3.84）。混合星是在基于相对论平均场描述的三种代表性强子模型下构建的，并选择产生软和硬的 EoS。我们得到了质量与巨大脉冲星 PSR J0740+6620 兼容的稳定混合星，所考虑的 X 约为 2 到 2.71；最大标度导致具有半径 2 到 8 km 的大夸克核的混合星，而最小标度则导致星中心处的小夸克核。

English: Recently, the NNLO perturbative QCD pressure of cold and dense symmetric matter, with arbitrary quark masses, has been resummed within the renormalization-group-optimized perturbation theory (RGOPT) framework. By being imbued with renormalization group properties, the resulting pressure is less sensitive to renormalization scale ($\Lambda\equiv X \mu_B/3$) variations than the NNLO perturbative QCD pressure. Here, we extend this by considering $\beta$-equilibrium and charge neutrality to evaluate the corresponding equation of state (EoS). We provide a compact ``pocket" fitting formula for the EoS for $N_f=2+1$ massive quarks at different renormalization scale parameter ($X$) values. We describe pure quark stars as well as hybrid stars with quark-cores. Pure quark stars compatible with astrophysical observations were obtained with $X=2.71-3.30$, whereas a larger value (3.84) is needed if the secondary component of the observation GW190814 represents a neutron star. Hybrid stars were built considering three representative hadron models based on a relativistic mean-field description, and chosen to produce soft and stiff EoSs. Stable hybrid stars with masses compatible with the massive pulsar PSR J0740+6620 were obtained considering $X$ of the order of 2 to $2.71$, the largest scale giving rise to hybrid stars with a large quark core with a radius of 2 to 8 km , and the smallest to a small quark core at the center of the star.

偏心区域中的大质量标量场：来自极端质量比旋近 LISA 观测的可探测性与限制

Massive scalar fields in eccentric regime: Detectability and constraints from LISA observations of extreme mass-ratio inspirals

Tieguang Zi, Shailesh Kumar, Genliang Li, Jun-Kun Zhao, Bao-Min Gu, Fu-Wen Shu · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：极端质量比旋近（EMRI）是未来空间引力波天文台最有希望的源之一，并为强引力区中额外基本场提供了灵敏探针。本工作研究在存在大质量标量场时，围绕 Kerr 黑洞的偏心赤道 EMRI。我们假设旋近天体携带标量荷，因此除引力波外还发出标量辐射。通过在频率域求解大质量标量微扰方程，我们计算事件视界处和无穷远处的相对论标量能流，并将其纳入绝热旋近模型。通过分析相对于广义相对论（GR）和无质量标量极限的累积相位差与波形失配，我们研究标量荷和标量场质量对轨道演化和引力波形的影响。结果表明，大质量标量辐射可产生显著的引力波退相位，且效应在轨道越偏心时越明显。此外，标量场质量越大，标量通量被抑制，因为满足无穷远处传播条件的标量谐波更少。最后，利用 Fisher 信息矩阵预测和贝叶斯参数估计，我们评估 LISA 约束标量荷和标量场质量的能力。两种推断方法给出自洽的约束，表明偏心 EMRI 为在强场区探测大质量标量场和标量-张量引力扩展提供了有希望的途径。

English: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) are among the most promising sources for future space-based gravitational wave (GW) observatories and provide sensitive probes of additional fundamental fields in the strong-gravity regime. In the present work, we investigate eccentric equatorial EMRIs around Kerr black holes in the presence of a massive scalar field. We assume that the inspiralling object carries a scalar charge, therefore, emits scalar radiation in addition to GWs. By solving the massive scalar perturbation equation in the frequency domain, we compute the relativistic scalar energy fluxes at the event horizon and at infinity and incorporate them into an adiabatic inspiral model. We investigate the impact of the scalar charge and scalar field mass on the orbital evolution and gravitational waveforms by analysing the accumulated phase differences and waveform mismatches relative to both general relativity (GR) and the massless scalar limit. Our results show that the massive scalar radiation can produce significant GW dephasing, with the effect becoming increasingly pronounced for more eccentric orbits. In addition, the scalar flux is suppressed for larger scalar field masses as fewer scalar harmonics satisfy the propagation condition at infinity. Finally, using both Fisher-information-matrix forecasts and Bayesian parameter estimation, we assess the capability of the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna to constrain the scalar charge and scalar field mass. The two inference approaches gives consistent constraints, demonstrating that eccentric EMRIs provide a promising avenue for probing massive scalar fields and scalar-tensor extensions of gravity in the strong-field regime.

高阶曲率引力中的光子面：对准正规模与引力透镜的影响

Photon Surfaces in Higher-Curvature Gravity: Implications for Quasinormal Modes and Gravitational Lensing

Takamasa Kanai · gr-qc, hep-th · v4 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：有效场论（EFT）提供了一个系统框架，通过引力作用量的高阶曲率修正来描述对广义相对论的偏离。在本工作中，我们研究具有高阶曲率修正的静态球对称时空中的测试场准正规模（QNMs）以及弱、强引力透镜，重点关注光子球附近的类光测地线。利用 Bozza 发展的强偏折极限形式，我们推导出偏折角的对数发散，并分离发散与正则贡献。我们通过视界半径 r_s=2M 的适当幂次对量纲性 EFT 耦合进行归一化，并在所得的无量纲参数中作微扰处理。我们分析高阶曲率修正如何改变光子球半径、临界碰撞参数以及控制强偏折展开的系数。我们进一步考察 eikonal 区域中对测试场 QNMs 的相应效应。我们的结果系统刻画了高阶曲率 EFT 修正如何修改类光测地线、强引力透镜与测试场 QNMs，并阐明了 EFT 耦合与周围时空几何特征性质之间的关系。

English: Effective field theory (EFT) provides a systematic framework to describe deviations from general relativity through higher-curvature corrections to the gravitational action. In this work, we investigate test-field quasinormal modes (QNMs) and weak and strong gravitational lensing in static, spherically symmetric spacetimes with higher-curvature corrections, focusing on null geodesics near the photon sphere. Using the strong deflection limit formalism developed by Bozza, we derive the logarithmic divergence of the deflection angle and separate the divergent and regular contributions. We normalize the dimensionful EFT couplings by appropriate powers of the horizon radius $r_s=2M$ and work perturbatively in the resulting dimensionless parameters. We analyze how higher-curvature corrections modify the photon sphere radius, the critical impact parameter, and the coefficients governing the strong deflection expansion. We further examine the corresponding effects on test-field QNMs in the eikonal regime. Our results provide a systematic characterization of how higher-curvature EFT corrections modify null geodesics, strong gravitational lensing, and test-field QNMs, and clarify the relation between EFT couplings and characteristic properties of the surrounding spacetime geometry.

通过四点关联器在脉冲星计时阵列中寻找非高斯性

Looking for non-gaussianity in Pulsar Timing Arrays through the four point correlator

Adrien Kuntz, Clemente Smarra, Massimo Vaglio · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列最近报告了随机引力波背景的强证据。在标准分析中，它通过脉冲星依赖的傅里叶系数建模，并假定服从高斯统计，因此信号完全由两点函数表征。然而，如果背景来自有限数量的旋进超大质量黑洞双星，可能出现非高斯特征，使得确定高阶关联器变得必要。在这项工作中，我们计算了四个任意脉冲星位置的随机引力波背景傅里叶系数的完整四点关联器，并将其确定为非高斯性的主要探针。结果分为高斯贡献，正比于两点函数的平方，以及真正非高斯的连通分量，其非平凡角依赖将 Hellings 和 Downs 关联推广到四颗脉冲星。这种角结构仅依赖于天线方向图函数乘积的平均值，因此预期独立于背景的具体物理起源。我们进一步提出通过推导一个微扰地考虑非高斯效应的边缘化似然，将四点关联器纳入参数估计流程。我们的结果为在脉冲星计时阵列数据中寻找非高斯特征提供了理论框架，为更完整地表征引力波背景开辟了道路。

English: Pulsar Timing Arrays have recently reported strong evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave background. In standard analyses, it is modeled through pulsar-dependent Fourier coefficients assumed to follow gaussian statistics, so that the signal is fully characterized by its two-point function. However, if the background arises from a finite population of inspiralling supermassive black hole binaries, non-gaussian features may emerge, making the determination of higher-order correlators essential. In this work, we compute the complete four-point correlator of the stochastic gravitational wave background Fourier coefficients for four arbitrary pulsar positions, identifying it as the leading probe of non-gaussianity. The result separates into a gaussian contribution, proportional to the square of the two-point function, and a genuinely non-gaussian connected component, whose non-trivial angular dependence generalizes the Hellings and Downs correlation to four pulsars. This angular structure depends only on averages of products of antenna pattern functions, and is therefore expected to be independent of the specific physical origin of the background. We further propose to incorporate the four-point correlator into the parameter-estimation pipeline by deriving a marginalized likelihood that perturbatively accounts for non-gaussian effects. Our results provide the theoretical framework to search for non-gaussian features in pulsar timing array data, opening the way to a more complete characterization of gravitational-wave backgrounds.

Palatini 与度量-仿射 f(R) 引力中宇宙学膜世界的全局一致性

Global Consistency of Cosmological Braneworlds in Palatini and Metric-Affine f(R) Gravity

Paulo Michel L. T da Silva · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：我们研究了 Palatini 和度量-仿射引力中五维翘曲膜世界的全局一致性条件。从广义 Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde 框架出发，我们为宇宙学翘曲几何推导积分求和规则，并考察独立联络自由度如何修改标准 Einstein 引力中对光滑紧致膜世界的阻碍。该分析将几何、物质和非黎曼贡献分开，并澄清通常 no-go 结果可被修改的条件。我们表明，广义一致性关系给出了可容许构型的必要全局约束，并识别出可能导致偏离黎曼情形的项。结果为在具有独立仿射结构的引力理论中检验光滑五维膜世界的全局一致性建立了系统框架。

English: We investigate global consistency conditions for five-dimensional warped braneworlds in Palatini and metric-affine gravity. Starting from the generalized Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde framework, we derive integrated sum rules for cosmological warped geometries and examine how independent connection degrees of freedom modify the standard Einstein-gravity obstruction to smooth compact braneworlds. The analysis separates geometric, matter, and non-Riemannian contributions and clarifies the conditions under which the usual no-go result can be modified. We show that the generalized consistency relations provide necessary global constraints on admissible configurations and identify the terms responsible for possible departures from the Riemannian case. The results establish a systematic framework for testing the global consistency of smooth five-dimensional braneworlds in gravitational theories with independent affine structure.

AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数：2-loop 修正

M2 brane $S^3/\mathbb Z_k$ instanton partition function in ${\rm AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction

Arkady A. Tseytlin · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：如 arXiv:2609.14497 所示，对包裹 AdS_2×S^1 并位于 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 内的 M2 膜配分函数的 2-loop T^{-1}_2 修正为零。这与 ABJM 理论中 1/2-BPS 圆形 Wilson loop 的 localization 预言一致；按照 arXiv:2505.21633 的猜想，该预言在 grand-canonical ensemble 中解释。这里我们研究包裹 S^3/Z_k ⊂ S^7/Z_k、对偶于 ABJM 在 3-sphere 上自由能的大 N 领头非微扰贡献的 M2 膜瞬子的 T^{-1}_2 修正。arXiv:2307.14112 表明 1-loop 瞬子 M2 膜配分函数与 localization 预言匹配。2-loop 计算因存在玻色子和费米子零模而复杂，需要对集体坐标积分。集体坐标 Jacobian 在 M2 膜作用量的四次相互作用顶点贡献之外，提供非平凡的 T^{-1}_2 贡献。我们发现对于 k>2，在将费米子零模与量子场分离、使其形成独立超多重态的选取下，四次顶点贡献被 Jacobian 贡献抵消。假设配对零模采用超对称规定，我们证明在集体坐标积分后抵消仍然存在。因此 T^{-1}_2 修正为零，与 grand-canonical ensemble 预言一致。对于 k=1，四次顶点贡献约化为运动方程项，如同 arXiv:2511.22306 中 AdS_3 ⊂ AdS_7×S^4 的情形；后者通过形式解析延拓与 S^3 ⊂ AdS_4×S^7 情形相关。

English: As was shown in arXiv:2609.14497, the 2-loop $ {\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction to the partition function of M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$ vanishes. This is in agreement with the localization prediction for $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory interpreted in the grand-canonical ensemble according to the conjecture of arXiv:2505.21633. Here we study the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction for the M2 brane instanton wrapping $S^3/\mathbb Z_k\subset S^7/\mathbb Z_k$ dual to the leading non-perturbative large $N$ contribution to the ABJM free energy on 3-sphere. The 1-loop instanton M2 brane partition function was shown in arXiv:2307.14112 to match the localization prediction. The 2-loop computation is complicated by the presence of bosonic and fermionic zero modes, which requires to integrate over the collective coordinates. The collective-coordinate Jacobian provides a non-trivial ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ contribution in addition to the one of the quartic interaction vertex in the M2 brane action. We find that for $k>2$ the the quartic vertex contribution is cancelled by the Jacobian contribution for the choice of the separation of the fermionic zero modes from the quantum fields under which these form separate supermultiplets. Assuming the supersymmetric prescription for the paired zero modes we show that the cancellation persists after integration over the collective coordinates. Thus the ${\rm T}^{-1}_2$ correction vanishes, in agreement with the grand-canonical ensemble prediction. For $k=1$ the quartic vertex contribution reduces to equation-of-motion terms as in the case of ${\rm AdS}_3 \subset { \rm AdS}_7 \times S^4$ in arXiv:2511.22306 which is related to $S^3 \subset {\rm AdS}_4 \times S^7$ case by a formal analytic continuation.

一句话导读：计算 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中 M2 膜 S^3/Z_k 瞬子配分函数的 2-loop T^{-1}_2 修正，发现 k>2 时抵消为零，支持 grand-canonical ensemble 预言；k=1 约化为运动方程项。

局域化 M 理论路径积分

Localizing the M-Theory Path Integral

Pietro Benetti Genolini, Florian Gaar, Jerome P. Gauntlett, Jaeha Park, James Sparks · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：我们提出一个超对称局域化公式，用于 M 理论路径积分的局部微扰贡献，将其约化为对等变通量数据的积分。十一维 Chern--Simons 耦合的相对等变扩张决定局域化作用量，而对于 M2 膜背景，一个切丛-余切丛特征标计算单圈行列式。这给出了一般 squashing 和化学势下完整微扰 ABJM 配分函数的首个闭式表达式，以及描述黑洞的 ABJM 拓扑扭曲指标的新解析结果。应用于非环面 V^{5,2} 理论，同一方案给出了此前仅以数值已知的闭式解析 Airy 常数。我们的公式重现了所有可获得的独立场论结果，并在当前尚不知场论答案的一般参数下给出解析预言。我们推导出 Type IIA 展开的全亏格结果，它是通常拓扑弦常数映射结果的等变形式，并提取了积分关联函数。

English: We propose a supersymmetric localization formula for the local perturbative contribution to the M-theory path integral, reducing it to an integral over equivariant flux data. Relative equivariant extensions of the eleven-dimensional Chern--Simons couplings determine the localized action, while for M2-brane backgrounds a tangent-cotangent character computes the one-loop determinant. This gives the first closed form expression for the complete perturbative ABJM partition function at general squashing and chemical potentials, and new analytic results for the ABJM topologically twisted index describing black holes. Applied to the non-toric $V^{5,2}$ theory, the same prescription yields a closed analytic Airy constant previously known only numerically. Our formulas reproduce all available independent field theory results, and provide analytic predictions at general parameters where no field theory answer is currently known. We derive an all-genus result for the Type IIA expansion which is an equivariant form of the usual topological string constant map result, and also extract integrated correlators.

一句话导读：该文提出 M 理论路径积分的超对称局域化公式，并应用于 ABJM 配分函数、黑洞拓扑扭曲指标、非环面 V^{5,2} 理论和 Type IIA 展开。

平面极限下全息理论的 Bootstrap

Bootstrapping Holographic Theories in the Planar Limit

Shai M. Chester, Daniele R. Pavarini, Alessandro Piazza · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：我们将数值共形 bootstrap 与超对称局域化结合起来，以在平面大 N 极限、有限 't Hooft 耦合 λ 下约束全息超共形场论的谱。我们考虑 N=4 SU(N) 超杨-米尔斯（SYM）中的应力张量多重态四点函数，其全息对偶为闭弦散射；以及某个具有 SO(8) 味对称性的 4d N=2 USp(2N) 规范理论中的味多重态关联函数，其对偶为开弦散射。在这两种情况下，我们结合色散求和规则与来自超对称局域化的积分约束，计算对所有 λ 的最低标量单迹算符标度维数的上界。对于 N=4 SYM，我们发现我们的界在所有 λ 下都接近已知可积性结果。对于 N=2 理论，目前尚无可用可积性，我们发现我们的界在相关区域接近弱耦合和强耦合预测。

English: We combine the numerical conformal bootstrap with supersymmetric localization to constrain the spectrum of holographic superconformal field theories in the planar large $N$ limit for finite 't Hooft coupling $\lambda$. We consider the stress tensor multiplet four-point function in $\mathcal{N}=4$ $SU(N)$ super-Yang-Mills (SYM), which is holographically dual to closed string scattering, as well as the flavor multiplet correlator in a certain $ 4d $ $\mathcal{N}=2$ $U\!Sp(2N)$ gauge theory with $SO(8)$ flavor symmetry, which is dual to open string scattering. In both cases, we combine dispersive sum rules with integrated constraints from supersymmetric localization to compute an upper bound on the scaling dimension of the lowest scalar single-trace operator for all $\lambda$. For $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM, we find that our bounds are close to the known integrability result for all $\lambda$. For the $\mathcal{N}=2$ theory, where integrability is not yet available, we find that our bounds are close to weak and strong coupling predictions in the relevant regimes.

M2 brane in AdS$_4\times S^7/\mathbb Z_k$: 2-loop correction to $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS Wilson loop vs localization in ABJM theory

M. Beccaria, S. A. Kurlyand, A. A. Tseytlin, J. van Muiden · hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：我们研究在 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 内包裹 AdS_2×S^1 的 M2 膜的量子化，其与 ABJM 理论中的 1/2-BPS 圆形 Wilson 圈对偶。经典作用量和单圈贡献此前已被证明可重现规范理论局域化结果。这里我们将分析推广到双圈阶。在适配静态规范与 κ-对称规范下，世界体积作用量不含三次相互作用顶点，因此双圈修正完全由四次相互作用决定，并且显式地无对数紫外发散。我们发现玻色与费米贡献组合成完全平方 X^2，其中 X 是三维玻色与费米 Green 函数及其导数的线性组合。计算 X 需要固定无质量费米模式的 AdS_2 边界量子化。在由保持超对称所选定的边界条件下，X 为零，因此完整双圈修正为零。这一结果将不能与把 M2 膜圈展开直接等同于固定 (N,k) 局域化预言的大 N 展开相一致。相反，它精确符合最近提出的建议：半经典 M2 膜配分函数应与规范理论巨正则系综匹配，在该系综中 Wilson 圈期望值微扰地单圈精确。因此双圈修正的消失为这一巨正则识别提供了非平凡检验。

English: We study the quantization of an M2 brane wrapping $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ inside $\mathrm{AdS}_4\times S^7/\mathbb{Z}_k$, dual to the $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS circular Wilson loop in ABJM theory. The classical action and the one-loop contribution were previously shown to reproduce the gauge-theory localization result. Here we extend the analysis to the two-loop order. In an adapted static and $\kappa$-symmetry gauge the world-volume action contains no cubic interaction vertices, so that the two-loop correction is determined entirely by quartic interactions and is manifestly free of logarithmic UV divergences. We find that the bosonic and fermionic contributions combine into a perfect square $ {\mathscr X}^2$ where ${\mathscr X}$ is a linear combination of the bosonic and fermionic 3d Green's functions and their derivatives. The evaluation of $\mathscr X$ requires fixing the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ boundary quantization of the massless fermionic modes. With the boundary conditions selected by the preserved supersymmetry, $\mathscr X$ vanishes and hence the complete two-loop correction is found to be zero. This result would not be consistent with identifying the M2-brane loop expansion directly with the large-$N$ expansion of the canonical, fixed-$(N,k)$ localization prediction. Instead, it agrees precisely with the recent proposal that the semiclassical M2-brane partition function should be matched to the gauge-theory grand-canonical ensemble, in which the Wilson loop expectation value is perturbatively one-loop exact. The vanishing of the two-loop correction thus provides a non-trivial test of this grand-canonical identification.

一句话导读：在 AdS_4×S^7/Z_k 中计算 M2 膜对 1/2-BPS Wilson 圈的双圈修正并发现其为零，支持半经典 M2 膜配分函数对应巨正则系综而非固定 (N,k) 局域化展开。

相关度：low — 论文属于 AdS/CFT 精确检验与 M2 膜量子化，与用户重点标签（全息超流、p 波、畴壁、multi-trace、相变气泡、QNM、冷原子、探针膜/Floquet、经典引力）均不直接相关。

会记忆的结：两个耦合 SYK Majorana 系统的红外响应

The Junction That Remembers: Infrared Response of Two Coupled SYK Majorana Systems

Ali Vahedi · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el · v3 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：两个 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 型强相互作用 Majorana 系统，各自具有独立无序，通过一个随时间开启的连接耦合。我们询问连接的红外结构如何印记在响应上，以及系统是否记得它是如何被打开的。在大 N 下，两个系统之间的主导互关联精确地是两个平衡传播子与开关剖面的乘积；由于无序独立，没有梯形图修正它。连接算符的标度维数为 1/2，这使其感受率具有普适对数，我们确定其系数和相位并数值验证；耦合平衡问题的能隙增长比朴素交叉估计更慢。每侧最多十二个 Majorana 的精确动力学显示出强宇称转移和数倍于自由费米子上限的纠缠。开关所做的功有一阶部分不依赖于开关时间，二阶部分随开关时间增长而增大。一旦功固定，纠缠、连接期望值和一个 scrambling 诊断对协议的依赖性几乎消失，且小的残差不依赖于协议差异是在低频还是高频。这些小型系统没有红外窗口，因此它们既不能确认也不能排除大 N 下的记忆。

English: Two strongly interacting Majorana systems of the Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev type, each with its own independent disorder, are joined by a link that is switched on in time. We ask how the infrared structure of the link is imprinted on the response and whether the system remembers how it was opened. At large $N$ the leading cross-correlation between the two systems is an exact product of two equilibrium propagators and the switching profile; because the disorder is independent, no ladder dresses it. The link operator has scaling dimension one half, which gives its susceptibility a universal logarithm whose coefficient and phase we fix and verify numerically, while the gap of the coupled equilibrium problem grows more slowly than the naive crossover estimate. Exact dynamics for up to twelve Majoranas per side show strong parity transfer and entanglement several times the free-fermion ceiling. The work done by the switch has a first-order part that does not depend on the switching time and a second-order part that grows in magnitude with it. Once the work is held fixed, the protocol dependence of the entanglement, the link expectation value and a scrambling diagnostic nearly vanishes, and the small residuals do not depend on whether the protocols differ at low or at high frequency. These small systems have no infrared window, so they neither confirm nor exclude memory at large $N$.

一句话导读：在大 N 下分析两个耦合 SYK Majorana 系统通过时变连接开启后的红外响应、纠缠与功，发现小系统无法判定大 N 记忆。

相关度：low — 论文属于 JT/SYK/AdS2 理论全息方向，研究耦合 SYK、时变连接与 scrambling；但未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、D3-D7探针膜或经典引力等支线，故相关性偏低。

U(N) 矩阵模型在规范不变单态扇区中的精确算法

An exact algorithm for U(N) matrix models in the gauge-invariant singlet sector

Enrico M. Brehm, Jean Cazalis · hep-th, math-ph, math.MP, quant-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：矩阵模型作为 M 理论和 D-brane 动力学的基本描述出现；通过规范/引力对偶，其规范不变（或单态）扇区描述了全息对偶中纯引力的自由度。我们提出一种新的精确算法，用于计算规范不变单态扇区中玻色型 U(N) 矩阵模型的可观测量。该扇区由 Schur 多项式（单矩阵情形）和限制 Schur 多项式（多矩阵情形）的正交基张成；这组基使自由哈密顿量对角化，并给出按激发数对希尔伯特空间的自然截断。相互作用哈密顿量或任何规范不变可观测量的矩阵元，通过群论约化到对称群适当子群的陪集与双陪集，并结合对称群上的特征标求和来计算。所得矩阵元是规范群秩 N 的闭式多项式，由只需预计算一次、并可对任意 N 和任意耦合常数重复使用的群论数据组装而成。我们通过单矩阵实现与 N 个非相互作用费米子的精确映射进行验证，表明低能谱随截断快速收敛。多矩阵推广已作概述；其主要瓶颈是对称群限制特征标的计算，目前尚不知道有可与 Murnaghan--Nakayama 规则相比的算法。该框架可直接获得规范不变态的有限 N、有限耦合动力学，并为全息矩阵模型的非平面区域打开新的计算窗口。

English: Matrix models appear as fundamental descriptions of M-theory and D-brane dynamics, and via the gauge/gravity duality their gauge-invariant, or singlet, sector describes the purely gravitational degrees of freedom in the holographic dual. We present a new exact algorithm for computing observables of bosonic U(N) matrix models in the gauge-invariant singlet sector. This sector is spanned by an orthogonal basis of Schur polynomials (for a single matrix) and restricted Schur polynomials (for multiple matrices), which diagonalizes the free Hamiltonian and provides a natural truncation of the Hilbert space by excitation number. Matrix elements of the interaction Hamiltonian, or any gauge-invariant observable, are evaluated through a group-theoretic reduction to cosets and double cosets of suitable subgroups of the symmetric group, together with character sums on the symmetric group. The resulting entries are closed-form polynomials in the gauge-group rank N, assembled from group-theoretic data that are precomputed once and can be reused for any N and any coupling constants. We validate the one-matrix implementation against the exact mapping to N non-interacting fermions, demonstrating rapid convergence of the low-lying spectrum with the cutoff. The multi-matrix extension is outlined; its main bottleneck is the computation of restricted characters of the symmetric group, for which no algorithm comparable to the Murnaghan--Nakayama rule is currently known. The framework gives direct access to finite-N, finite-coupling dynamics of gauge-invariant states and opens a new computational window on the non-planar regime of holographic matrix models.

一句话导读：提出一种在规范不变单态扇区精确计算 U(N) 矩阵模型可观测量的群论算法，可访问有限 N、非平面全息动力学。

相关度：medium — 属于全息矩阵模型/非平面计算方向，但与用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、QNM、D3-D7/Floquet 等具体支线无直接重合。

全息界面中连接边界熵与有效中心荷

Connecting boundary entropy and effective central charge at holographic interfaces

Evangelos Afxonidis, Ignacio Carre\~no Bolla, Carlos Hoyos, Andreas Karch · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el · v3 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：与没有界面的CFT相比，1+1维界面CFT中区间的纠缠熵有两处修正：存在有限的边界熵贡献；并且对于一端位于界面的区间，通常正比于CFT中心荷的对数发散项的系数被修改为有效中心荷。我们证明，利用界面CFT的全息对偶，后一修改可理解为前一修改的极限。此外，我们表明，在不穿过界面的区间中也会出现有限贡献，并且为了确保纠缠熵的强次可加性，这一贡献是必要的。

English: The entanglement entropy of intervals in $1+1$ interface CFTs is modified in two ways compared to a CFT without interface: there is a finite boundary entropy contribution, and, for an interval with an endpoint at the interface, the coefficient of the logarithmically divergent contribution -- which is usually proportional to the central charge of the CFT -- is modified to an effective central charge. We show that the latter modification can be understood as a limit of the former using holographic duals of interface CFTs. Furthermore, we show that a finite contribution also appears in intervals that do not cross the interface and it is needed to ensure strong subbaditivity of the entanglement entropy.

一句话导读：在全息界面CFT中，区间纠缠熵的有效中心荷修正可由边界熵取极限得到，非穿越界面的有限项则保证强次可加性。

相关度：medium — 属于全息纠缠熵/界面CFT的形式研究，与AdS/CFT基础相关；但不直接匹配列出的重点支线（全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7、经典引力等）。

Kerr-Newman 扰动的电荷正则形式与辐射振幅

Charge-regular formulation and radiative amplitudes of Kerr-Newman perturbations

Hayato Motohashi · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-08

中文摘要：我们建立了分离的 Kerr–Newman 扰动的电荷正则表述，并给出从主方程解到物理辐射场的显式映射。我们推导了正则的角向和径向一阶系统及其二阶约化，其中包含自旋 ±1 与 ±2 Teukolsky 方程的有限电荷形变。场与边界归一化在复现标准 Kerr 约定的同时，也处理了无穷远处非均匀的零电荷极限。对于具有通常 peeling 行为的物理 Einstein–Maxwell 扰动，我们得到了非零实频率下显式的出射引力与电磁振幅以及能流。所得的有限电荷辐射组成比仅依赖于正则角向函数，与径向激发无关。

English: We establish a charge-regular formulation of separated Kerr--Newman perturbations and an explicit map from master solutions to physical radiative fields. We derive regular angular and radial first-order systems and their second-order reductions, with finite-charge deformations of the spin $\pm1$ and $\pm2$ Teukolsky equations. The field and boundary normalizations recover the standard Kerr conventions while accounting for the nonuniform zero-charge limit at infinity. For physical Einstein--Maxwell perturbations with the usual peeling behavior, we obtain explicit outgoing gravitational and electromagnetic amplitudes and energy fluxes at nonzero real frequency. The resulting finite-charge radiation-composition ratios depend only on the regular angular functions, independently of the radial excitation.

一句话导读：建立 Kerr-Newman 扰动的电荷正则表述并给出引力/电磁辐射振幅与能流。
