Improvement therefore requires a gate outside that class, and the exact factorisation of $V$ into a sum of squared commutator entries supplies one in each era. For NISQ, Hadamard: each squared entry is added into a Fourier register and squared there, $\Theta(d^2N^3Q^3)$ two-qubit gates. For fault tolerance, $T$: reversible arithmetic with one phase-gradient injection per squared entry, $\Theta(d^2N^3Q^2)$ T gates and no arbitrary-angle rotation. Both are built and verified. With a native $R_{ZZ}$ the NISQ circuit uses fewer two-qubit gates than every parity network from $Q=6$ at SU(2) and $Q=2$ at SU(5); the oracle beats a precision-matched Hamming-weight-phasing incumbent at every point built except the smallest, by up to $11.9\times$ in T count and, at equal width, $25.5\times$ in surface-code spacetime. An ablation with the same arithmetic but no factorisation costs up to $21\times$ more and loses to that incumbent at $15$ of $17$ points, so the factorisation, not the arithmetic, produces the win. Both constructions survive the supersymmetric deformation to mini-BMN with fermions, and complete Trotter evolutions on a statevector simulator reproduce the exact product formula to $2\times10^{-12}$.

This factorization imposes rank constraints across output channels and choices of second-order initial data, providing consistency tests of the intermediate-mode description. Second, the intermediate pole residue can be reconstructed from its horizon and infinity radiation. With the first-order field and third-order data held fixed, this reconstruction extends to the full cubic waveform difference generated by changing the second-order initial data. QCS thus connects lower-order radiation to higher-order observables and provides a framework for probing the interaction structure of nonlinear ringdown.

English: We study leading parity-even four-derivative corrections to the linear Christodoulou regularity criterion for a neutral, massless, minimally coupled spectator scalar in four-dimensional charged de Sitter black holes. We find that the dominant nonstationary spherically symmetric mode retains its cold-limit regularity ratio through first order, while higher angular sectors respond to the deformation of the relative throat radii. The finite-distance neutral-scalar Christodoulou boundary nevertheless shifts because the relevant exterior scalar spectrum and the unequal horizon surface gravities enter the regularity ratio. At smaller and intermediate cosmological scales, positive effective coefficients move the Christodoulou threshold to larger normalized separation of the Cauchy and event horizons. Toward the larger cosmological-scale part of the cold branch, the same coefficient directions move that threshold back toward the cold endpoint. The reversal accompanies a transition in the quasinormal family that supplies the spectral gap. We further show that the coefficient combination governing the fixed-charge extremal mass parameter differs generically from those governing the cold throat and the finite-distance neutral-scalar boundary. Extremality therefore does not determine a universal direction for the neutral-scalar Christodoulou-threshold correction. Our results identify cosmological scale and spectral-family competition as essential elements in relating effective gravity, black-hole extremality, and Cauchy-horizon regularity in this spectator sector.

中文摘要：我们研究标量–Gauss–Bonnet 引力中静态球对称黑洞的自发标量化，其中 Ricci 耦合为 F=1+βφ²/4+γβ²φ⁴+O(φ⁶)，对二次项作了非线性完备化。对于任意耦合和势，我们以闭式导出了近视界正则条件和视界曲率不变量；标量化分支在该条件退化处、于有限视界曲率处终止。弱非线性展开精确固定了分岔方向：对于无质量标量，其控制系数是 β 的二次函数，在 β=1.1156 处变号，并线性依赖于四次自相互作用。在标量取相同视界值时，不同完备化在领头阶的质量差与 γ 成正比。任意耦合下的径向微扰主方程证实了在分岔点和转折点处稳定性的交换。因此，在所研究范围内，径向稳定黑洞的参数区域随 γ 增大而缩小；指数型完备化下的区域比二次截断更小。

English: We study spontaneous scalarization of static, spherically symmetric black holes in scalar--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with a Ricci coupling $F=1 \beta\phi^{2}/4+\gamma\beta^{2}\phi^{4}+O(\phi^{6})$ that nonlinearly completes the quadratic one. For arbitrary couplings and potential, we derive the near-horizon regularity condition and horizon curvature invariants in closed form; scalarized branches terminate where this condition degenerates, at finite horizon curvature. A weakly nonlinear expansion fixes the bifurcation direction exactly: for a massless scalar, its governing coefficient is quadratic in $\beta$, changes sign at $\beta=1.1156$, and depends linearly on a quartic self-interaction. At equal horizon values of the scalar, completions differ in mass, to leading order, in proportion to $\gamma$. A radial-perturbation master equation for arbitrary couplings confirms the exchange of stability at the bifurcation and turning points. Consequently, the domain of radially stable black holes shrinks as $\gamma$ increases over the range studied; it is smaller for the exponential completion than for the quadratic truncation.

一句话导读：该文在标量–Gauss–Bonnet 引力中为 Ricci 耦合加入非线性项，分析黑洞标量化分支、分岔方向、稳定性交换及质量修正。

量子退相干对黑洞阴影可见性与时域回声的影响

Influence of quantum decoherence on black hole shadow visibility and time domain echoes

Sen Guo, Xin Li, Yu Liang, Kai Lin, Li-Fang Li · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：黑洞的几何阴影在观测上无法区分无视界奇异致密天体。我们通过将视界的基本量子退相干（Danielson-Satishchandran-Wald 机制）映射为宏观有效反射率 \mathcal{R} 来打破这种简并。利用 Kerr 光线追踪，我们表明部分反射边界（\mathcal{R}>0）在镜面反射和漫反射（Lambertian）条件下都会产生延迟的电磁回声。在空间域中，这些回声照亮内部阴影并改变低频可见度，同时保持由度规控制的光子子环不变。信号强度随膜紧致度 \epsilon 按 \epsilon^\Gamma 标度，其中镜面反射时 \Gamma=0，而由于逃逸锥塌缩，漫反射再发射时 \Gamma\to1。这使镜面反射率降至 \mathcal{R}\simeq0.12（ngEHT）和 0.04（BHEX），处于静态成像可及范围内。对于人马座 A*，我们将这些回声转化为稳健的时域特征。使用自相关函数（ACF）流程，我们证明单耀发回声可以从严重的吸积红噪声中干净地提取，在连续监测 15 至 33 小时内对振幅 \mathcal{A}\gtrsim0.3 实现 3σ 探测。该框架为检验黑洞幺正性提供了一条可直接部署的途径。

English: The geometric shadow of a black hole cannot observationally distinguish horizonless exotic compact objects. We break this degeneracy by mapping the fundamental quantum decoherence of the horizon (the Danielson-Satishchandran-Wald mechanism) into a macroscopic effective reflectivity $\mathcal{R}$. Utilizing Kerr ray tracing, we show that a partially reflective boundary ($\mathcal{R}>0$) generates delayed electromagnetic echoes under both specular and diffuse (Lambertian) conditions. In the spatial domain, these echoes illuminate the inner shadow and alter low-frequency visibilities, while leaving metric-governed photon subrings unchanged. The signal strength scales with the membrane compactness $\epsilon$ as $\epsilon^{\Gamma}$, where $\Gamma=0$ for specular reflection and $\Gamma\to1$ for diffuse re-emission due to escape-cone collapse. This brings specular reflectivities down to $\mathcal{R}\simeq0.12$ (ngEHT) and $0.04$ (BHEX) within reach of static imaging. For Sagittarius A$^\ast$, we translate these echoes into a robust time-domain signature. Using an Autocorrelation Function (ACF) pipeline, we demonstrate that single-flare echoes can be cleanly extracted from severe accretion red noise, achieving a $3\sigma$ detection for amplitudes $\mathcal{A}\gtrsim0.3$ within 15 to 33 hours of continuous monitoring. This framework provides a directly deployable pathway to test black hole unitarity.

一句话导读：将视界量子退相干映射为有效反射率，并用 Kerr 光线追踪与 ACF 时域分析预测黑洞阴影低频可见度变化和可观测回声，以检验黑洞幺正性。

On-shell Homogeneous Curvature Modes in Quadratic $F(R,\mathcal G)$ Cosmology

Francisco Tello-Ortiz, B. Mishra, Y. G\'omez-Leyton, Jean B\'aez Cuevas · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究二次模型 F(R,𝒢)=R+αR^2+β𝒢^2 中的均匀宇宙学扰动。修改后的 Friedmann 方程线性化并结合尘埃守恒，给出均匀 Hubble 扰动的二阶方程，或等价地给出物质对比度的三阶方程。随后，我们将渐近分析限制在满足同一二次理论零阶方程的背景上。除低曲率尘埃支（趋近 H=2/(3t)）外，该模型还允许一个非平凡真空 de Sitter 解，满足 β H_dS^6=1/96。仅当 α<-1/(6H_dS^2) 时，其均匀曲率模式才是稳定的。在高曲率下，背景方程还允许一个真空 big rip 渐近支，起始为 H=7/(t_s-t)；首批修正由二次耦合确定。相应的 𝒢^2 主导扰动有一个发散的均匀模式。同时取 Einstein 极限仅作为一致性检验，并恢复标准尘埃行为。

English: 5We study homogeneous cosmological perturbations in the quadratic model $F(R,\mathcal G)=R+\alpha R^2+\beta\mathcal G^2$. Linearization of the modified Friedmann equation together with dust conservation yields a second-order equation for the homogeneous Hubble perturbation, or equivalently a third-order equation for the matter contrast. We then restrict the asymptotic analysis to backgrounds that satisfy the zeroth-order equations of the same quadratic theory. Besides the low-curvature dust branch, which approaches $H=2/(3t)$, the model admits a nontrivial vacuum de Sitter solution with $\beta H_{\rm dS}^6=1/96$. Its homogeneous curvature modes are stable only when $\alpha<-1/(6H_{\rm dS}^2)$. At high curvature the background equation also admits a vacuum big-rip asymptotic branch beginning with $H=7/(t_s-t)$; the first corrections are fixed by the quadratic couplings. The corresponding $\mathcal G^2$-dominated perturbation has one divergent homogeneous mode. The simultaneous Einstein limit is taken only as a consistency check and recovers the standard dust behavior.

一句话导读：在二次 F(R,𝒢) 宇宙学中分析均匀 Hubble 扰动与物质对比度的渐近演化，并考察低曲率尘埃支、真空 de Sitter 支及高曲率 big rip 支的稳定性。

带电大 D 膜范式中黑洞动力学的局部第二定律

A local second law for black hole dynamics in the charged large-$D$ membrane paradigm

Supratim Halder, Mangesh Mandlik · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：大 D 膜范式为黑洞动力学提供了一种微扰的非引力描述。虽然中性膜的局部热力学第二定律已经建立，但在带电大 D 膜框架中显式确定局部熵产生方程仍未解决。本文计算了平直背景下带电黑洞膜速度散度的次领头阶修正。我们通过非仿射零 Raychaudhuri 方程，在物理事件视界上计算相应的标量 Einstein-Maxwell 约束方程，并将物理视界表达式与辅助膜运动学联系起来，证明膜速度在膜世界体积的第一个非零阶产生非负散度，该散度由两个二次形式驱动：膜剪切以及纯 Maxwell 场产生的新贡献。利用这一结果，我们构造了膜熵流，并证明其散度到该阶非负，从而建立了带电大 D 膜范式的局部第二定律。

English: The large-$D$ membrane paradigm provides a perturbative, non-gravitational description of black hole dynamics. While the local second law of thermodynamics has been established for neutral membranes, the explicit determination of the local entropy production equation within the charged large-$D$ membrane framework remains unsolved. In this paper, we compute the subleading-order correction to the divergence of the membrane velocity for a charged black hole in a flat background. We evaluate the corresponding scalar Einstein-Maxwell constraint equation at the physical event horizon via the non-affine null Raychaudhuri equation, and relate the physical horizon expressions to the auxiliary membrane kinematics, demonstrating that the membrane velocity produces a non-negative divergence at the first non-vanishing order in the membrane worldvolume, which is driven by two quadratic forms: the membrane shear and a novel contribution generated purely by the Maxwell field. Using this result, we construct the membrane entropy current and prove that its divergence is non-negative through this order, thereby establishing the local second law for the charged large-$D$ membrane paradigm.

一句话导读：在带电大 D 膜范式中计算膜速度散度的次领头阶修正，并构造具有非负散度的熵流，证明局部第二定律。

Black Hole Entropy and Holographic Entanglement Entropy in DGP Brane Gravity

Takamasa Kanai · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究引力熵与全息纠缠熵在膜世界引力中的关系，其中引力动力学定域在膜上。首先考虑DGP膜模型，即在膜作用量中包含Einstein-Hilbert项，推导膜世界黑洞的引力熵与全息纠缠熵一致所需的条件。我们表明，当涉及膜外曲率的一个特定条件满足时，两种熵相等；特别地，该条件对静态构型自动满足。随后将膜局域Einstein-Hilbert项推广到高阶曲率引力理论。对于膜上的Lovelock引力和$f(R)$引力，我们推导引力熵与全息纠缠熵相等对应的条件，并表明它们与Einstein引力所得形式相同。尽管对一般稳态构型等式并不保证成立，但所需条件对静态膜世界黑洞满足，从而使两种熵一致。这些结果阐明了膜世界引力中引力熵与全息纠缠熵的关系，并有助于更深入理解膜世界设定中的全息。

English: We investigate the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity with gravitational dynamics localized on the brane. We first consider the DGP brane model, in which an Einstein-Hilbert term is included in the brane action, and derive the condition under which the gravitational entropy of a braneworld black hole agrees with the holographic entanglement entropy. We show that the two entropies coincide when a specific condition involving the extrinsic curvature of the brane is satisfied. In particular, this condition is automatically satisfied for static configurations. We then generalize the brane-localized Einstein-Hilbert term to higher-curvature gravitational theories. For Lovelock gravity and $f(R)$ gravity on the brane, we derive the corresponding conditions for the equality between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy and show that they take the same form as that obtained for Einstein gravity. Although the equality is not guaranteed for general stationary configurations, the required condition is satisfied for static braneworld black holes, leading to an agreement between the two entropies. These results clarify the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity and contribute to a deeper understanding of holography in braneworld settings.

一句话导读：在DGP等膜世界引力中，黑洞的引力熵与全息纠缠熵在静态膜世界黑洞构型下满足特定外曲率条件时相等。

Global Consistency of Cosmological Braneworlds in Palatini and Metric-Affine f(R) Gravity

Paulo Michel L. T da Silva · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究 Palatini 与度量仿射引力中五维弯曲膜世界的全局一致性条件。从广义 Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde 框架出发，我们推导了宇宙学弯曲几何的积分求和规则，并考察独立联络自由度如何改变标准 Einstein 引力对光滑紧致膜世界的障碍。分析将几何、物质和非黎曼贡献分开，并澄清了通常 no-go 结果可被修改的条件。我们证明广义一致性关系为允许构型提供了必要的全局约束，并确定了导致偏离黎曼情形可能的项。结果建立了一个系统性框架，用于检验具有独立仿射结构的引力理论中光滑五维膜世界的全局一致性。

English: We investigate global consistency conditions for five-dimensional warped braneworlds in Palatini and metric-affine gravity. Starting from the generalized Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde framework, we derive integrated sum rules for cosmological warped geometries and examine how independent connection degrees of freedom modify the standard Einstein-gravity obstruction to smooth compact braneworlds. The analysis separates geometric, matter, and non-Riemannian contributions and clarifies the conditions under which the usual no-go result can be modified. We show that the generalized consistency relations provide necessary global constraints on admissible configurations and identify the terms responsible for possible departures from the Riemannian case. The results establish a systematic framework for testing the global consistency of smooth five-dimensional braneworlds in gravitational theories with independent affine structure.

Einstein-Maxwell 求和规则与光滑膜禁戒定理的持续

Einstein--Maxwell Sum Rules and the Persistence of the Smooth-Brane No-Go Theorem

Paulo Michel Longo Tavares da Silva · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究最小耦合阿贝尔 Maxwell 部门是否能够缓解 Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde (GKL) 对五维光滑翘曲膜世界的阻碍。对于与体 Maxwell 场耦合的正则标量场，我们在将切向 F_{\mu\nu} 和混合 F_{\mu5} 部门分开的情况下，推导了单参数族整体一致性条件。这种分解至关重要，因为 Maxwell 应力张量在五维中并非无迹。我们表明电磁项在形式上修正了积分 GKL 约束，但在标准假设下这种修正不能提供对禁戒定理的一致规避。精确的四维 Poincaré 不变性排除了背景中非零确定性经典 Maxwell 场，因为其场强会选出优先的四维方向。因此 Maxwell 部门在对称背景中消失，通常的光滑膜阻碍重新出现。我们还指出了哪些假设必须被放松才能得到非平庸的电磁贡献，并将此背景结果与体规范场局域化的局域一致性条件区分开。

English: We investigate whether a minimally coupled Abelian Maxwell sector can relax the Gibbons--Kallosh--Linde (GKL) obstruction to smooth five-dimensional warped braneworlds. For a canonical scalar field coupled to a bulk Maxwell field, we derive the one-parameter family of global consistency conditions while keeping the tangential F_{{\mu}{\nu}} and mixed F_{{\mu}5} sectors separate. This decomposition is essential because the Maxwell stress tensor is not traceless in five dimensions. We show that electromagnetic terms formally modify the integrated GKL constraints, but this modification does not provide a consistent evasion of the no-go theorem under the standard assumptions. Exact four-dimensional Poincar\'e invariance excludes a nonzero deterministic classical Maxwell field from the background, since its field strength would select preferred four-dimensional directions. The Maxwell sector therefore vanishes in the symmetric background and the usual smooth-brane obstruction is recovered. We also identify which assumptions must be relaxed for a nontrivial electromagnetic contribution and distinguish this background result from local consistency conditions for bulk gauge-field localization.

一句话导读：在标准假设下，阿贝尔 Maxwell 场不能规避五维光滑翘曲膜世界的 GKL 禁戒定理。

More on the Celestial Soft Symmetry Algebra in the ${\cal N}=8$ Supergravity

Changhyun Ahn · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们构造了 ${\cal N}=8$ 超引力中（由反全纯光变换得到的）${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ 流与物质场的算子乘积展开（OPEs）。利用上述 OPE，通过双重围道积分得到相应的（反）对易子。通过计算由流-流-物质组成的三重（反）对易子（即固定最后一个元素的 Jacobi 恒等式），复现了先前已知的、这些流之间（在反全纯部分）的 ${\cal N}=8$ 天球软对称代数。我们对全纯光变换以及 ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$ 流与物质场的 OPE 重复上述过程，得到相应的（反）对易子。我们还得到这些流之间（在全纯部分）的另一类 ${\cal N}=8$ 天球软对称代数。作为反全纯与全纯部分中的子代数，存在 ${\cal N}=8$ 扩展 BMS（Bondi、van der Burg、Metzner 和 Sachs，1962）代数。我们从反全纯（或全纯）部分中的 ${\cal N}=8$ 共形{\it 软} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$（或 ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$）流来分析上述结果。描述了引力子、引力微子和引力光子的非平凡软定理。最后，利用 shadow 变换（全纯与反全纯光变换的连续复合），我们得到 ${\cal N}=8$ {\it shadow} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$（或 ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$）流与物质场的 OPE，其中识别出 ${\cal N}=8$ 扩展 BMS 代数的应力-能量张量、超流（supercurrents）和超平移生成元。

English: We construct the operator product expansions (OPEs) of the ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ currents (obtained from the antiholomorphic light transform) with the matter fields in the ${\cal N}=8$ supergravity. The corresponding (anti)commutators are obtained from the double contour integrals using the above OPEs. By computing the triple (anti)commutators consisting of current-current-matter (i.e., the Jacobi identity for fixed last element), the previously known ${\cal N}=8$ celestial soft symmetry algebra between these currents (in the antiholomorphic sector) is reproduced. We repeat the above procedure by taking the holomorphic light transform and the OPEs of the ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$ currents with the matter fields and the corresponding (anti)commutators are obtained. We also obtain another type of ${\cal N}=8$ celestial soft symmetry algebra between these currents (in the holomorphic sector). As a subalgebra in the antiholomorphic and holomorphic sectors, there exists the ${\cal N}=8$ extended BMS (Bondi, van der Burg, Metzner, and Sachs in 1962) algebra. We analyze the above results from the ${\cal N}=8$ conformally {\it soft} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ (or ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$) currents in the antiholomorphic (or holomorphic) sector. The nontrivial soft theorems for the graviton, the gravitinos and the graviphotons are described. Finally, using the shadow transform (the consecutive composition of holomorphic and antiholomorphic light transforms), we obtain the OPEs of the ${\cal N}=8$ {\it shadow} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ (or ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$) currents with the matter fields where the stress-energy tensor, the supercurrents and the supertranslation generator of the ${\cal N}=8$ extended BMS algebra are identified.

Extremal black hole throats from non extremal near horizon expansions

Anirudhda Shinde, Mangesh Mandlik · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们展示了，对于具有光滑极端极限的光滑稳态黑洞族，如何从非极端近地平展开恢复极端近地平几何。在族共有的 Gaussian null 坐标中，我们对表面引力作近极端缩放，并结合径向缩放和 Killing 时间重标度。尽管物理表面引力消失，缩放后的地平可以保留有限表面引力。当这一缩放表面引力趋于零时，就得到极端近地平几何。在近极端缩放和时间重标度下，时间度规分量中的二次径向项可以存活，而更高径向阶消失。因此，展开到二阶既充分，又在所选图中二次项具有非零极限系数时必要。我们推导了用于提取近地平系数的统一拉回方案，并恢复了 Reissner-Nordström、Kerr、Kerr-Newman 以及带电旋转 Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) 黑洞的已知喉部。中性旋转 BTZ 提供了一个弦 Carroll 展开已经足够的例子。

English: We show how extremal near horizon geometries can be recovered from the non extremal near horizon expansion for smooth stationary black hole families admitting a smooth extremal limit. In Gaussian null coordinates common to the family, we apply the near extremal scaling of the surface gravity together with a radial scaling and a rescaling of Killing time. Although the physical surface gravity vanishes, the scaled horizon can retain a finite surface gravity. The extremal near horizon geometry is obtained when this scaled surface gravity is taken to zero. Under the near extremal scaling and the time rescaling, the quadratic radial term in the temporal metric component can survive, while higher radial orders vanish. Expansion through second order is therefore sufficient and is necessary whenever the quadratic term has a nonzero limiting coefficient in the chosen chart. We derive a common pullback prescription for extracting the near horizon coefficients and recover the known throats of Reissner-Nordstr\"om, Kerr, Kerr-Newman, and charged rotating Ba\~nados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) black holes. Neutral rotating BTZ provides a case in which the string Carroll expansion already suffices.

一句话导读：该文建立坐标缩放与拉回方法，从非极端近地平展开恢复极端黑洞近地平喉部几何。

从临界零模到全息超导体的内部动力学

From Critical Zero Modes to Interior Dynamics in Holographic Superconductors

Yan Liu, Hong-Da Lyu · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究全息超导体的临界行为如何控制带电黑洞的内部几何。尽管外部凝聚在临界点消失，临界零模在Reissner-Nordström Cauchy视界附近产生对数振荡，使得内部临界极限非一致。我们表明，透射的临界模振幅与局部Cauchy视界量共同决定了主导的Einstein-Rosen坍缩宽度Δz_ER以及后续Josephson区域中的相位Θ_J。若凝聚满足 t≡1-T/T_c∝ε^{2r}，则 Δz_ER∝t^{1/r}，Θ_J∝t^{-1/r}。该Josephson相位被转移到第一个Kasner epoch，产生振荡的Kasner指数以及标量速度相继零点的累积律 t_n∼n^{-r}。临界零模确定了主导坍缩和相位系数，并在普通和三临界情形下由完全非线性解定量证实。在低温下，内部则依赖于零温几何的红外完成。因此，近临界标度由临界模透射控制，而低温行为由红外端点控制。

English: We study how the critical behavior of holographic superconductors controls the interior geometry of charged black holes. Although the exterior condensate vanishes at criticality, the critical zero mode develops logarithmic oscillations near the Reissner--Nordstr\"om Cauchy horizon, rendering the interior critical limit nonuniform. We show that the transmitted critical-mode amplitude, together with local Cauchy-horizon quantities, fixes both the leading Einstein--Rosen collapse $\Delta z_{\rm ER}$ width and the phase $\Theta_J$ in the subsequent Josephson regime. If the condensate obeys $t\equiv1-T/T_c\propto\epsilon^{2r}$, then $\Delta z_{\rm ER}\propto t^{1/r}$ and $\Theta_J\propto t^{-1/r}$. This Josephson phase is transferred to the first Kasner epoch, producing oscillatory Kasner exponents and an accumulation law $t_n\sim n^{-r}$ for successive zeros of the scalar velocity. The critical zero mode fixes the leading collapse and phase coefficients, which are quantitatively confirmed by fully nonlinear solutions in both the ordinary and tricritical cases. At low temperature, the interior instead depends on the infrared completion of the zero-temperature geometry. Thus near-critical scaling is governed by critical-mode transmission, whereas the low-temperature behavior is controlled by the infrared endpoint.

一句话导读：全息超导临界零模通过透射控制带电黑洞内部ER坍缩与Josephson/Kasner动力学，低温行为则由红外端点决定。

2+1维引力中的Wald熵与Wen-Zee型规范-曲率耦合

Wald entropy and Wen-Zee type gauge-curvature coupling in 2+1-dimensional gravity

Aryan Bhatia, Giandomenico Palumbo, Suraj S. Hegde · hep-th, cond-mat.mes-hall, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：Wen-Zee项是量子霍尔流体的拓扑Chern-Simons描述中的一种混合规范-曲率耦合，编码了束缚于空间曲率的电荷。我们研究该耦合的洛伦兹协变化推广，将其范围扩展至黑洞时空，并确定其对视界熵的贡献。此类耦合自然出现在基于Maxwell代数的三维Chern-Simons引力中。我们证明其Wald熵贡献是一个视界助推荷，由附加规范场沿分叉圆切向投影的环路积分给出。即使混合项在壳消失，该贡献也可以非零。当投影方向协变常时，该积分具有Abelian holonomy解释。我们在平直宇宙学解上计算该荷，并利用光滑视界场和指定热系综在AdS-Lorentz黑洞上计算该荷。这些结果将量子霍尔物理中熟悉的几何响应与引力视界热力学联系起来。

English: The Wen-Zee term is a mixed gauge-curvature coupling in the topological Chern-Simons description of a quantum Hall fluid, encoding the electric charge bound to spatial curvature. We investigate a Lorentz-covariant generalisation of this coupling, expanding its scope to black-hole spacetimes and determine its contribution to horizon entropy. Such a coupling arises naturally in three-dimensional Chern-Simons gravity based on the Maxwell algebra. We show that its Wald entropy contribution is a horizon boost charge, given by a loop integral of the additional gauge field projected along the tangent to the bifurcation circle. This contribution can be nonzero even when the mixed term vanishes on shell. We show that the integral admits an Abelian holonomy interpretation when the projection direction is covariantly constant. We evaluate the charge on a flat cosmological solution and, using smooth horizon fields and a specified thermal ensemble, on an AdS-Lorentz black hole. These results connect the geometric response familiar from quantum Hall physics to gravitational horizon thermodynamics.

一句话导读：在2+1维Chern-Simons引力中，Wen-Zee型混合规范-曲率耦合对Wald熵的贡献表现为视界助推荷，并在平直宇宙学解与AdS-Lorentz黑洞上计算。

最大对称空间中线性化引力的高形式对称性

Higher-form Symmetries of Linearized Gravity in Maximally Symmetric Spaces

Natsuya Kido · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们将最大对称时空上的引力场表述为规范理论，并通过对牛顿引力常数作级数展开来研究线性化引力场的高形式对称性。为了把引力作为规范理论处理，采用了基于 Cartan 几何的 MacDowell-Mansouri 表述。我们证明了闵可夫斯基时空上线性化引力中 1-形式对称性的存在。此外，对于具有小宇宙学常数的其他最大对称时空（de Sitter 和 anti-de Sitter 时空），我们证明了相应线性化引力中存在近似的 1-形式对称性，并详细给出了其对宇宙学常数的显式依赖。

English: We formulate the gravitational field on maximally symmetric spacetimes as a gauge theory, and investigate higher-form symmetries of the linearized gravitational field via a series expansion in Newton's gravitational constant. To treat gravity as a gauge theory, the MacDowell-Mansouri formulation based on Cartan geometry is utilized. We show the existence of a 1-form symmetry in linearized gravity on Minkowski spacetime. Furthermore, for other maximally symmetric spacetimes (de Sitter and anti-de Sitter spacetimes) with a small cosmological constant, we demonstrate the existence of an approximate 1-form symmetry in the corresponding linearized gravity, detailing its explicit dependence on the cosmological constant.

M2-膜 SCFT 的 Wilson 线缺陷指标

Wilson line defect indices for M2-brane SCFTs

Hirotaka Hayashi, Tomoki Nosaka, Tadashi Okazaki · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：我们研究 3d N≥4 超对称规范理论中的线缺陷 Coulomb 和 Higgs 指标。由修饰缺陷指标与普通指标之比定义的归一化线缺陷指标给出良好定义的整数值，即在单位 R-荷逸度极限下的线缺陷 Witten 指标。我们为无 Chern-Simons 项的理论提出 Coulomb 和 Higgs 极限下这些 Witten 指标的通用公式，并证明二者都计数在分支一般点处残余规范群下不变的态，该残余规范群由真空方程读出。此外，我们在描述 M2-膜的 3d SCFT（包括 ADHM 型理论和 ABJ(M) 理论）中，发现 Wilson 线缺陷 Coulomb 指标的强有力代数递推关系。这些关系意味着更高阶线缺陷指标由低阶数据递归决定，适用于 U(N)、USp(2N)、SO(2N) 和 SO(2N+1) ADHM 型理论以及 ABJ(M) 理论。

English: We investigate line defect Coulomb and Higgs indices in 3d $\mathcal{N}\ge 4$ supersymmetric gauge theories. The normalized line defect indices defined by ratios of the decorated defect indices to the ordinary indices yield well-defined integer values, the line defect Witten indices in the unit R-charge fugacity limit. We propose general formulae for these Witten indices in both Coulomb and Higgs limits for the theories without Chern-Simons terms, and we show that both count the states invariant under the residual gauge group left unbroken at a generic point of the branch, which we read off from the vacuum equations. Furthermore, we find powerful algebraic recursion relations for Wilson line defect Coulomb indices in the 3d SCFTs describing M2-branes, including ADHM-type theories and ABJ(M) theories. These relations imply that higher rank line defect indices are recursively determined by lower rank data across $U(N)$, $USp(2N)$, $SO(2N)$ and $SO(2N+1)$ ADHM-type theories and ABJ(M) theories.

一句话导读：研究 3d N≥4 规范理论中 Wilson 线缺陷的 Coulomb/Higgs 指标，并在 M2-膜 SCFT 中发现递推关系。

量子协变比特线

Quantum covariant bit threads

Matthew Headrick, Sreeman Reddy Kasireddy, Andrew Rolph · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：纠缠熵在全息中起核心作用。量子极值面（QES）公式是在动力学与体量子修正都重要的情形（如黑洞蒸发）中的标准工具。我们推导并探索了与 QES 等价的方案——量子协变比特线——它用体的极小或极大流，而不是极值面，来表述全息纠缠熵。与经典协变比特线一样，我们的方案有两种类型：（通常）类空的 V-流和类时的 U-流。为了计入体量子修正，流线可以在体中的点开始和结束，端点的分布由体纠缠熵控制。在我们的比特线语言中，QES 是流的量子瓶颈，一些线穿过它（对应广义熵中的面积项），另一些线跳过它（对应熵项）。我们的方案为 QES 公式提供了互补视角，并为黑洞蒸发、岛和婴儿宇宙等重要现象提供了新见解。

English: Entanglement entropy plays a central role in holography. The quantum extremal surface (QES) formula is the standard tool in settings where both dynamics and bulk quantum corrections are important, such as in black hole evaporation. We derive and explore QES-equivalent prescriptions --- quantum covariant bit threads --- that formulate holographic entanglement entropy in terms of minimal or maximal bulk flows rather than extremal surfaces. Like classical covariant bit threads, our prescriptions come in two types: (typically) spacelike V-flows, and timelike U-flows. To account for bulk quantum corrections, the flow lines can start and end at points in the bulk, with the distribution of endpoints controlled by bulk entanglement entropies. In our bit thread language, the QES is a quantum bottleneck to the flow, with some threads passing through it (accounting for the area term in the generalized entropy) and others jumping across it (accounting for the entropy term). Our prescriptions provide a complementary perspective to the QES formula and offer new insights on important phenomena such as black hole evaporation, islands, and baby universes.

一句话导读：提出量子协变比特线方案，用体的极小/极大流等价表述量子极值面与全息纠缠熵，并将 QES 视为流的量子瓶颈。

中子星中的暗物质：完整广义相对论下的双流体 f-模式振荡

Dark matter in neutron stars: two-fluid $f$-mode oscillations in full general relativity

Prashant Thakur, Ishfaq Ahmad Rather, Y. Lim · astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-06

中文摘要：暗物质核心与偏软的核物质状态方程可以产生相似的质量—半径特征，这促使人们通过 f-模式谱进行互补探测。我们在完整广义相对论下计算了冷、非转动、且掺入自相互作用玻色暗物质（DM）中子星的四极 f-模式频率和引力波阻尼时间。我们的双流体扫描涵盖 21 个核物质状态方程，覆盖核子、超子、Δ 混杂以及超子—Δ 组合成分，暗物质分数 F_DM=1%–20%。主要序列对核心和晕研究分别采用 λ=π 以及 500 和 100 MeV 的玻色子质量。独立的正常物质（NM）和暗物质位移通过度规耦合，产生 NM 主导和 DM 主导的 f-模式分支，其辐射阻尼由出射波边界条件决定。在 1.4 M⊙ 处，核心 DM 主导的阻尼时间从 F_DM=1% 时的约 10^3 s 降至 20% 时的约 1 s，大致遵循经验性的 F_DM^{-2} 依赖；而 NM 主导的阻尼时间保持在 0.12–0.33 s 内。晕中 DM 主导的阻尼反而随暗物质分数增加：在相同恒星质量和 F_DM=20% 时，暗半径接近 88 km，频率降至 0.14 kHz，阻尼时间达到约 450 s。部分高质量核心序列表现出 DM 主导阻尼时间的强烈上折，而领先的质量四极诊断无法再现。代表性核心计算显示 DM 主导模式对玻色子自耦合更敏感，并且在 ℓ=3 时仍保留两个分支。在所采用的非转动、圆轨道双星近似下，没有评估的构型满足受控线性潮汐共振所需的全部几何和微扰条件。

English: A dark-matter core and a soft nuclear equation of state can produce similar mass--radius signatures, motivating a complementary probe through the $f$-mode spectrum. We compute quadrupolar $f$-mode frequencies and gravitational-wave damping times in full general relativity for cold, nonrotating neutron stars admixed with self-interacting bosonic dark matter (DM). Our two-fluid survey spans 21 nuclear equations of state covering nucleonic, hyperonic, $\Delta$-admixed, and combined hyperon--$\Delta$ compositions at $F_{\rm DM}=1$--$20\%$. The main sequences use $\lambda=\pi$ and boson masses of $500$ and $100\,\mathrm{MeV}$ for the core and halo studies, respectively. Independent normal-matter (NM) and DM displacements couple through the metric, yielding NM-led and DM-led $f$-mode branches whose radiative damping is determined by outgoing-wave boundary conditions. At $1.4\,M_\odot$, the core DM-led damping time decreases from order $10^3\,\mathrm{s}$ at $F_{\rm DM}=1\%$ to order $1\,\mathrm{s}$ at $20\%$, approximately following an empirical $F_{\rm DM}^{-2}$ dependence, while NM-led damping times remain within $0.12$--$0.33\,\mathrm{s}$. Halo DM-led damping instead increases with dark fraction: at the same stellar mass and $F_{\rm DM}=20\%$, dark radii approach $88\,\mathrm{km}$, frequencies fall to $0.14\,\mathrm{kHz}$, and damping times reach approximately $450\,\mathrm{s}$. Selected high-mass core sequences exhibit strong DM-led damping-time upturns not reproduced by the leading mass-quadrupole diagnostic. Representative core calculations show greater DM-led sensitivity to the bosonic self-coupling and retain both branches at $\ell=3$. Under the adopted nonrotating, circular-binary prescriptions, no evaluated configuration satisfies all geometric and perturbative conditions for a controlled linear tidal resonance.

一句话导读：在完整广义相对论下研究含玻色暗物质中子星的双流体 f-模式，给出核物质主导与暗物质主导两支的频率及引力波阻尼时间。

James M. Cline, Savas Stoica, Yong Xu · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们研究由宇宙学一阶相变中产生的超重暗物质（DM）衰变而来的高能中微子（HEνs）。采用过滤暗物质产生机制，我们结合从流体力学确定气泡壁速度的最新进展，重新考察了遗迹丰度计算。我们表明，质量 m_DM≈4.4×10^8 GeV 的暗物质可以再现观测到的遗迹丰度，并容纳如 KM3-230213A 这样的超高能中微子事件，而同一相变同时产生随机引力波（GW）背景。尽管在此例子中 GW 信号（峰值在 10^4 Hz）尚不可观测，但在较低 DM 质量 m_DM≲10^6 GeV 时，中微子谱移入与 IceCube 观测相关的能量范围，同时相关 GW 信号移到较低频率，并可达到 Cosmic Explorer、BBO 和 DECIGO 的预期灵敏度。这给出了 HEνs 与 GWs 之间的多信使联系，两种信号都与一阶相变中的 DM 产生相关。

English: We investigate high energy neutrinos (HE$\nu$s) from the decay of superheavy dark matter (DM) produced during a cosmological first order phase transition. Adopting the filtered DM production mechanism, we revisit the relic abundance calculation by incorporating recent progress in determining the bubble wall velocity from hydrodynamics. We show that DM with mass $m_{\text{DM}}\simeq 4.4\times10^{8}~\text{GeV}$ can reproduce the observed relic abundance and accommodate ultra high energy neutrino events such as KM3-230213A, while the same phase transition simultaneously generates a stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background. Although the GW signal (which peaks at $10^{4}\,\text{Hz}$) is not yet observable in this example, at lower DM masses $m_{\text{DM}} \lesssim10^{6}~\text{GeV}$, the neutrino spectrum shifts into the energy range relevant for IceCube observations, while the associated GW signal moves to lower frequencies and can reach the projected sensitivities of Cosmic Explorer, BBO, and DECIGO. This gives a multimessenger connection between HE$\nu$s and GWs, with both signals connected to DM production in a first order phase transition.

一句话导读：一阶宇宙相变中过滤产生的超重暗物质可同时解释超高能中微子事件并产生随机引力波信号，形成暗物质-中微子-引力波多信使联系。

Horizon, Null-Orbit, and Photon-Sphere Phase Structures in Logarithmic Nonlinear Electrodynamics

Peshwaz Abdulkareem Abdoul · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们研究了对数非线性电动力学（LNED）中静态、带电、渐近平直黑洞在 (Q, ε) 参数空间中的性质。我们区分了三种相结构：视界几何、背景圆形零轨道，以及有效光学几何的圆形光子轨道。它们都共享一个零半径边界 Q_nc(ε;M)=γ M^{2/3} ε^{1/6}，但具有不同的临界结构：极值曲线 Q_ext(ε;M) 和背景合并曲线 Q_m(ε;M) 都终止于位于 r=0 的分岔点 (Q_b, ε_b)。相反，有效光子轨道合并曲线 Q_m^{ph}(ε;M) 不经过该点。对于 ε≥ε_b，趋近 Q_nc 会使视界收缩到零半径，形成具有非零、量子修正熵的黑点。它们的霍金温度在分岔点消失，并在 ε>ε_b 时发散，除非 ηδ=1；此时分岔点的温度也发散。背景势 V_eff^{bg}(r) 在 r=0 处形成无限势垒，且没有局域极值，表现为完美排斥体。相比之下，光子势 V_eff^{ph}(r) 被正则化，并在有限半径处有一个最大值，表现为部分反射体。因此，这些黑点仍保留有限半径的光子球。远离 Q_nc 时，对于 ε<ε_b，两种几何都支持高于 Q_ext 的无视界结构；对于 ε≥ε_b，只有光学几何在 Q_nc<Q<Q_m^{ph} 区域支持无视界结构。非径向测地线被阻止到达奇点，并可形成亚稳束缚态，而径向测地线要么到达 r=0，要么逃逸到无穷远。临界碰撞参数同时编码了引力几何和光学几何效应，从而探测这些不同的相结构。

English: We investigate static, charged, asymptotically flat black holes in logarithmic nonlinear electrodynamics (LNED) within the $(Q,\epsilon)$ parameter space. We distinguish three phase structures: the horizon geometry, the background circular null orbits, and the circular photon orbits of the effective optical geometry. All share a zero-radius boundary $Q_{nc}(\epsilon;M)=\gamma M^{2/3}\epsilon^{1/6}$, but possess distinct critical structures: the extremal curve $Q_{ext}(\epsilon;M)$ and the background merger curve $Q_{m}(\epsilon;M)$ both terminate at the bifurcation point $(Q_{b},\epsilon_{b})$, located at $r=0$. In contrast, the effective photon-orbit merger curve $Q_{m}^{ph}(\epsilon;M)$ does not pass through this point. For $\epsilon\ge\epsilon_{b}$, approaching $Q_{nc}$ shrinks the horizon to zero radius, resulting in black points with non-zero, quantum-corrected entropy. Their Hawking temperature vanishes at the bifurcation point and diverges for $\epsilon>\epsilon_{b}$, except when $\eta\delta=1$, where the temperature at the bifurcation point also diverges. The background potential $V_{eff}^{bg}(r)$ develops an infinite barrier at $r=0$ without local extrema, acting as a perfect repeller. In contrast, the photon potential $V_{eff}^{ph}(r)$ is regularized with a maximum at a finite radius, acting as a partial reflector. Consequently, the black points retain photon spheres of finite radius. Away from $Q_{nc}$, for $\epsilon<\epsilon_{b}$, both geometries support horizonless structures above $Q_{ext}$; for $\epsilon\ge\epsilon_{b}$, only the optical geometry does so in the region $Q_{nc}<Q<Q_{m}^{ph}$. Non-radial geodesics are blocked from the singularity and can form metastable bound states, while radial geodesics either reach $r=0$ or escape to infinity. The critical impact parameter encodes both gravitational and optical-geometry effects, probing the distinct phase structures.

一句话导读：在LNED黑洞的(Q,ε)参数空间中，视界、背景零轨道和有效光学光子轨道具有不同临界结构；黑点可保留有限半径光子球，临界碰撞参数可区分这些相。

相关度：high — 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究黑洞时空、光子球、零轨道与测地线，不涉及全息对偶；与重点标签‘经典引力/广义相对论’直接相关。

Plebanski 引力范式中的 Lanczos 势

The Lanczos potential in the Plebanski paradigm of gravity

Daniel Esp\'in, Alejandro Jim\'enez Cano, Javier Olmedo, Ant\'onio Torres Manso · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们提出了广义相对论的一种新的 Plebanski 表述。关键区别在于，我们使用一个由 Weyl 张量的 Lanczos 势导出的规范矢量场。我们证明，在壳上该规范矢量场编码了所有非平凡的引力自由度，并且在合适的洛伦兹规范下，Bianchi 恒等式保证该规范矢量场对 Ricci 平坦时空满足无源波动方程。这一描述为理解真正的几何自由度提供了新途径，并在经典引力和量子引力中具有应用前景。

English: We present a new Plebanski formulation of General Relativity. The key difference is that we work with a gauge vector field derived from the Lanczos potential of the Weyl tensor. We show that, on shell, the gauge vector field encodes all nontrivial gravitational degrees of freedom and, in a suitable Lorentz gauge, Bianchi identities ensure that this gauge vector field satisfies a source-free wave equation for Ricci-flat spacetimes. This description suggests new ways of interpreting the true geometrical degrees of freedom with applications in both classical and quantum gravity.

一句话导读：用 Weyl 张量的 Lanczos 势构造规范矢量场，在 Plebanski 框架中重新表述广义相对论，并在 Ricci 平坦时空中导出无源波动方程。

计算若干类时奇点的能量

Computing the energy of some timelike singularities

Fernando Ruiz Ruiz · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：本文明确计算了若干渐近 AdS 空间中的类时奇点以及负质量 Schwarzschild 黑洞的引力能量。在所有考虑的情形中，能量均为有限且为正，依赖于奇点周围的几何，并抵消来自渐近边界的负能量贡献，从而使总引力能量为正。所用能量定义是 Hawking 和 Horowitz 提出的物理经典作用量的壳上哈密顿量。为处理奇点，用一个包围奇点的类时调节边界截断时空，该边界与按常时切片进行的时空叶状分层相容。结果表明，具有类时 Kasner 奇点的静态 AdS-Kasner 解的总能量等于平面 AdS 黑洞的能量，而负质量 Schwarzschild 黑洞具有与 Minkowski 空间相同的能量。

English: The gravitational energies of timelike singularities in some asymptotically AdS spaces and in the Schwarzschild black hole with negative mass are explicitly computed. In all cases considered, the energy is finite and positive, depends on the geometry around the singularity, and compensates negative energy contributions from the asymptotic boundary, rendering the total gravitational energy positive. The definition used for energy is the on-shell Hamiltonian of the physical classical action proposed by Hawking and Horowitz~\cite{Hawking-Horowitz}. To deal with the singularity, spacetime is cut off by a timelike regulating boundary surrounding the singularity that is compatible with a foliation of spacetime in constant-time slices. It is shown that the total energy of static AdS-Kasner solutions with timelike Kasner singularities is equal to the energy of the planar AdS black hole, and that the Schwarzschild black hole with negative mass has the same energy as Minkowski space.

一句话导读：用 Hawking-Horowitz 壳上哈密顿量计算渐近 AdS 与负质量 Schwarzschild 时空中类时奇点的引力能量，发现能量有限为正并可抵消边界负贡献。

纯 Lovelock 黑洞的 Hawking-Page 相变

Hawking-Page phase transition for pure Lovelock black holes

Nitesh K. Dubey, Sanved Kolekar · gr-qc, hep-th, quant-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们研究静态、球对称反德西特（AdS）黑洞的热力学性质，重点考察特征温度之间的相互关系，以及 Hawking-Page（HP）相变处 Ruppeiner 标量曲率的普适性。特别地，我们研究纯 Lovelock 引力中静态球对称 AdS 黑洞的最低温度与 HP 相变温度之间的关系。对于 Einstein 引力中的电磁中性情形，(d+1) 维的最低温度与 d 维的 HP 相变温度一致；而在更高阶纯 Lovelock 理论中，这一关系被一个依赖于维度和阶数的因子修正，并在适当极限下回到 Einstein 结果。对于带电 AdS 黑洞，在巨正则系综中，广义相对论里两个温度相差一个简单的维度依赖因子，而在更高曲率纯 Lovelock 理论中不存在持续的普适关系。我们进一步分析 HP 相变处的归一化 Ruppeiner 标量曲率，并表明对于纯 Lovelock 理论中的电磁中性黑洞，它是一个仅依赖于时空维度的普适常数。对于 Einstein 理论情形下巨正则系综中的带电静态球对称黑洞，归一化标量曲率在适当条件下也保持为常数；而在一般纯 Lovelock 理论中，它依赖于压强和静电势等热力学参数，并在大压强极限或电势与压强同时很大的极限下渐近趋于常数。

English: We investigate the thermodynamic properties of static, spherically symmetric Anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes, focusing on the interplay between characteristic temperatures, as well as on the universality of Ruppeiner scalar curvature at the Hawking-Page (HP) phase transition. In particular, we study the relation between the minimum temperature and the HP phase transition temperature for static, spherically symmetric AdS black holes in pure Lovelock gravity. For the electromagnetically neutral case in Einstein gravity, the minimum temperature in $(d+1)$ dimensions coincides with the HP transition temperature in $d$ dimensions, while in higher pure Lovelock theories this relation is modified by a dimension- and order-dependent factor, reducing to the Einstein result in appropriate limits. For charged AdS black holes, in the grand canonical ensemble, in general relativity, the two temperatures differ by a simple dimension-dependent factor, whereas no universal relation persists in higher curvature pure Lovelock theories. We further analyze the normalized Ruppeiner scalar curvature at the HP transition and show that it is a universal constant depending only on the spacetime dimension for electromagnetically neutral black holes in pure Lovelock theories. The normalized scalar curvature remains a constant, under appropriate conditions, even for the charged static spherically symmetric black holes in the grand canonical ensemble for the Einstein theory case, whereas in general pure Lovelock theories it depends on thermodynamic parameters such as pressure and electrostatic potential, asymptotically approaching a constant in the large-pressure or simultaneous large-potential and large-pressure limits.

一句话导读：在纯 Lovelock AdS 黑洞中考察最低温度、Hawking-Page 相变温度及 Ruppeiner 曲率普适性。

热且重子致密 QGP 的全息输运与能量损失的不确定性量化

Uncertainty quantification of holographic transport and energy loss for the hot and baryon-dense QGP

Musa R. Khan, Ayrton Nascimento, Yumu Yang, Joaquin Grefa, Mauricio Hippert, Jorge Noronha, Claudia Ratti, Romulo Rougemont · nucl-th, hep-ph, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们研究了具有 N_f=2+1 味的热密 QCD 的全息 Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) 模型相图中的若干输运系数。我们的结果来自该模型的一个开源 C++ 实现，该实现作为 MUSES 框架内的一个模块公开可用。该代码包含一种新的数值方法，用于从全息模型的近边界渐近行为中提取热力学量，本文首次引入该方法，与早期实现相比，它极大地提高了数值稳定性和性能。得益于这一改进技术，我们能够针对从受零化学势格点 QCD 结果约束的贝叶斯后验分布中采样得到的该全息模型的许多实现进行计算。这使我们能够将格点 QCD 误差棒传播到宽温度与重子化学势窗口内输运系数的预言，涵盖 crossover 区域、预言临界点附近以及一阶相变线。物理观测量包括重子电导率和热导率、重子扩散、剪切与体粘度、喷注淬火参数、重夸克拖曳力以及 Langevin 扩散系数。在零重子密度下，我们将结果与 JETSCAPE 合作组从重离子数据中提取的估计值进行比较，发现二者符合良好。

English: We investigate several transport coefficients across the phase diagram of a holographic Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) model of hot and dense QCD with $N_f=2+1$ flavors. Our results are obtained from an open-source implementation of this model in C++, publicly available as a module within the MUSES Framework. This code includes a new numerical method to extract thermodynamic quantities from near-boundary asymptotics in holographic models, introduced here for the first time, which greatly improves numerical stability and performance in comparison to earlier implementations. Thanks to this improved technique, we are able to compute results for many realizations of our holographic model, sampled from a Bayesian posterior distribution constrained by lattice QCD results at zero chemical potential. This allows us to propagate lattice QCD error bars to predictions of transport coefficients in a wide window of temperature and baryon chemical potential, covering the crossover region, the neighborhood of the predicted critical point, and the line of first-order phase transition. The physical observables include baryon and thermal conductivities, baryon diffusion, shear and bulk viscosities, the jet-quenching parameter, the heavy-quark drag force, and Langevin diffusion coefficients. At vanishing baryon density, we compare our results to estimates extracted by the JETSCAPE Collaboration from heavy-ion data, with which we find good agreement.

一句话导读：在 MUSES 框架内基于开源 EMD 全息模型，对热密 QCD 相图输运系数进行贝叶斯不确定性量化，并与 JETSCAPE 数据符合良好。

相关度：low — 论文属于全息 QCD/核物理中的输运系数与能量损失研究，主要面向热密 QGP 相图与贝叶斯不确定性量化；未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核（尽管涉及相变线，但非气泡成核动力学）、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力/广义相对论等支线。

携带可穿越虫洞的致密星状系统的物理性质：混沌磁场与各向异性物质的影响

Physical properties of compact star-like systems harboring traversable wormholes: Effects of chaotic magnetic fields and anisotropic matter

Muhammad Lawrence Pattersons, Freddy Permana Zen, Hadyan Luthfan Prihadi, Muhammad F. A. R. Sakti · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-th · v5 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：本文构建了一类奇异致密天体——携带可穿越虫洞的致密星状系统（CSSTW），由两个标量场支持，并允许中子流体具有混沌磁场和压强各向异性。无论是否包含中子流体各向异性或磁场，虫洞都是可穿越的。特别地，在虫洞喉附近零能量条件（NEC）仍被违反，从而保证几何的可穿越性。所有构型的Kretschmann标量表明整个时空是规则的。时间度规函数表明所有考虑情形均无事件视界。对于磁化构型，所得CSSTW可以极其巨大，ADM质量超过8 M⊙，并表现出超过约1.5的大表面红移。系统还可达到超致密区域，从而允许计算可能产生的回声时间。回声时间计算表明，它可随混沌磁场构型和流体各向异性而变化。对于非磁化构型，引力波回声时间约为10^{-2}-10^{-1} ms。对于磁化构型，其范围约为10^{-1} μs至10^{-1} ms，表明磁场拓宽了回声时间范围。此外，为研究磁场对回声时间的直接影响，我们推导了回声时间作为均匀磁场函数的显式表达式。所得关系表明，回声时间随磁场强度增加而减小。径向微扰稳定性分析表明，所有表面磁场为B_s=10^15 G的考虑构型都是稳定的。

English: In this paper, we formulate exotic compact objects in form of compact star-like systems harboring traversable wormhole (CSSTW) supported by two scalar fields, allowing for both chaotic magnetic field and pressure anisotropy of the neutron fluid. The wormhole is traversable regardless of whether anisotropy of the neutron fluid and/or magnetic fields are included. In particular, the null energy condition (NEC) remains violated in the vicinity of the wormhole throat, ensuring the traversable nature of the geometry. The Kretschmann scalars for all considered configurations show that the entire spacetime is regular. The temporal metric functions for all considered configurations show that there are no horizons in any of the considered cases. For magnetized configurations, the resulting CSSTW can become extremely massive, with ADM masses exceeding $8\,M_\odot$, and can exhibit large surface redshifts exceeding $\mathcal{Z} \simeq 1.5$. The system can also reach the ultracompact regime, which allows us to calculate echo time that might be produced the systems. Our calculations of the echo time indicate that it can vary depending on the chaotic magnetic field configuration and fluid anisotropy. For non-magnetized configurations, the gravitational-wave echo time is of the order of $10^{-2}-10^{-1}$ ms. For the magnetized configurations, however, it ranges from the order of $10^{-1}$ $\mu$s $-10^{-1}$ ms, suggesting that magnetic fields broaden the range of echo time. Moreover, to investigate the direct impact of the magnetic field on the echo time, we derive an explicit expression for the echo time as a function of uniform magnetic field. The resulting relation shows that the echo time decreases as the magnetic field strength increases. The stability analysis of radial perturbations shows that all considered configurations with a surface magnetic field of $B_s=10^{15}$~G are stable.

一句话导读：在含混沌磁场和各向异性中子流体的致密星状可穿越虫洞中，考察NEC违反、规则性、质量/红移、回声时标与径向稳定性。

双全息中的量子黑洞化学

Quantum Black Hole Chemistry from Double Holography

Naman Kumar · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：扩展黑洞热力学凸显了通常全息字典中的尖锐矛盾：在固定边界共形框架下，改变 AdS 半径会同时改变 CFT 的中心荷和空间体积，使第一定律中的色部门与体积部门简并。我们表明，在 Karch-Randall 双全息中，量子黑洞自然消除这一简并。该机制本质上是半经典的：用物理膜替代全息正则化面会诱导出与截断 CFT 耦合的引力，因此经典体黑洞变为低维量子黑洞，其几何在所有反作用阶都包含截断物质应力张量。这个反作用物质部门提供了一个不同于缺陷体积的色变量。我们对量子 BTZ 黑洞明确展示了该机制。因此，量子反作用解决了最近 Weyl 因子提议所处理的同一色-体积简并问题，但无需引入非标准的边界 Weyl 因子；缺失的热力学方向由双全息量子黑洞的物理截断物质部门提供。

English: Extended black hole thermodynamics highlights a sharp tension in the usual holographic dictionary: at fixed boundary conformal frame, changing the AdS radius changes both the central charge and the spatial volume of the CFT, so that the color and volume sectors of the first law becomes degenerate. We show that this degeneracy is naturally removed for quantum black holes in Karch--Randall double holography. The mechanism is intrinsically semiclassical. Replacing the holographic regulator surface by a physical brane induces gravity coupled to a cutoff CFT, so classical bulk black holes become lower-dimensional quantum black holes whose geometry includes the cutoff-matter stress tensor to all orders in backreaction. This backreacting matter sector supplies a color variable distinct from the defect volume. We demonstrate the mechanism explicitly for the quantum BTZ black hole. Thus quantum backreaction resolves the same color-volume degeneracy addressed by the recent Weyl-factor proposal, but without introducing a non-standard boundary Weyl factor. Instead, the missing thermodynamic direction is supplied by the physical cutoff-matter sector of the doubly holographic quantum black hole.

一句话导读：Karch-Randall 双全息中，量子反作用通过截断物质部门消除扩展黑洞热力学的色-体积简并。

相关度：medium — 属于 AdS/CFT 与黑洞热力学交叉，但未直接涉及所列全息超导、探针膜、QNM、冷原子等具体重点支线。

arXiv 摘要 · PDF

小反作用极限下 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子的一圈效应

One loop aspects of Coleman de Luccia instantons at small backreaction

Victor Ivo · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们讨论围绕 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子的欧几里得路径积分。我们在小反作用极限的领头阶计算它们的一圈贡献。在此近似水平下，它们的贡献分解为纯引力部分和纯物质部分。在推导这一结果时，我们也澄清了当导致零模贡献的对称性破缺后，路径积分中某些零模贡献会发生什么。建立这些结果后，我们提出一个用引力路径积分表示假真空衰变率的公式，并表明我们的定义在 G_N→0 时与通常量子场论结果一致。最后，我们提出一套方案来研究引力加物质路径积分的相位如何随理论参数变化。

English: We discuss the Euclidean path integral around Coleman de Luccia instantons. We compute their contribution at the one-loop level, at leading order in the small backreaction limit. At this level of approximation, their contribution factorizes into a pure gravity and a pure matter contribution. In deriving this result, we also clarify what happens to some zero mode contributions to the path integral, once the symmetry responsible for them is broken. With these results established, we propose a formula for the decay rate of the false vacuum in terms of gravitational path integrals, and we show that our definition matches the usual quantum field theory result as $G_{N}\rightarrow0$. Lastly, we propose a prescription to study how the phase of the gravity+matter path integral changes as we change the parameters of the theory.

English: In the present work, we study the magnetic response of a holographic plasma in a D3/D7 setup through the quasinormal spectrum of D7-brane embedding fluctuations. Extending the spectral analysis to nonzero spatial momentum, we show that the modes become increasingly quasiparticle-like as the kinetic momentum grows at fixed magnetic field, while increasing the field at fixed kinetic momentum suppresses this character. The possible existence of these competing effects in an actual quark-gluon plasma could account, on the one hand, for the partial success of quasiparticle-based effective descriptions due to the presence of a substantial population of modes stabilized by their high momentum, and, on the other, for the difficulty of isolating experimental signatures of such constituents because of the magnetic suppression that dominates at low momentum. 中文摘要：我们研究了将 Simpson-Visser 规定 $r\to\sqrt{r^2+a^2}$ 应用于圈量子宇宙学中的量子 Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt (qOSD) 黑洞后得到的球对称几何，其时移函数 $A=1-2M/R+\alpha M^2/R^4$ 带有修正 $\alpha$。该族在 qOSD 黑洞 ($a\to0$)、Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹 ($\alpha\to0$) 和 Schwarzschild 之间插值。对任意 $a>0$，几何是正则的；喉处的 Ricci 标量对 $\alpha$ 不敏感，而 Kretschmann 标量则不然，且零能量条件在喉处被以 $-1/(4\pi a^2)$ 破坏。$(\alpha,a)$ 平面划分为双视界正则黑洞、带隐藏反弹的单视界黑洞、无 Cauchy 视界以及可穿越虫洞；中间区域无需精细调节就移除了正则黑洞的质量膨胀通道。由于圆轨道由面积半径决定，光子球、阴影、ISCO 和方位角本轮频率仅依赖 $\alpha$，而 Lyapunov 指数和径向本轮频率带有因子 $\sqrt{1-a^2/R^2}$：阴影只限制 $\alpha$，而铃宕阻尼和双峰准周期振荡比对 $a$ 敏感。我们推导了视界热力学，其第一定律熵偏离面积律；表明反弹在每个 $\alpha$ 下都将热力学拓扑荷从 $W=-1$ 变为 $W=0$；并使用三阶 WKB、Chebyshev 谱配置法和时域积分计算了标量、电磁和 Dirac 准正规模谱，它们相互一致并与 eikonal 标度一致。灰体界限、Hawking 辐射、级联稀疏度和铃宕品质因子完成了分析；在虫洞区域，双峰势产生回声。

English: We study the spherical geometry from the Simpson-Visser prescription $r\to\sqrt{r^2+a^2}$ to the quantum Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt (qOSD) black hole of loop quantum cosmology, whose lapse function $A=1-2M/R+\alpha M^2/R^4$ carries the correction $\alpha$. This family interpolates between the qOSD black hole ($a\to0$), the Simpson-Visser black bounce ($\alpha\to0$), and Schwarzschild. The geometry is regular for every $a>0$, the Ricci scalar at the throat is blind to $\alpha$ while the Kretschmann scalar is not, and the null energy condition is violated at the throat by $-1/(4\pi a^2)$. The $(\alpha,a)$ plane splits into a two-horizon regular black hole, a single-horizon black hole with a hidden bounce, no Cauchy horizon, and a traversable wormhole; the middle region removes the mass-inflation channel of regular black holes without fine tuning. Because circular orbits are governed by the areal radius, photon sphere, shadow, ISCO and azimuthal epicyclic frequency depend on $\alpha$ only, whereas the Lyapunov exponent and radial epicyclic frequency carry the factor $\sqrt{1-a^2/R^2}$: shadow constrains only $\alpha$, while ringdown damping and the twin-peak quasiperiodic-oscillation ratio are sensitive to $a$. We derive horizon thermodynamics with a first-law entropy that departs from the area law, show that the bounce changes the thermodynamic topological charge from $W=-1$ to $W=0$ at every $\alpha$, and compute scalar, electromagnetic and Dirac quasinormal spectra using third-order WKB, Chebyshev spectral collocation and time-domain integration, which agree with one another and with eikonal scaling. Greybody bounds, Hawking emission, cascade sparsity and ringdown quality factor complete the analysis, and in the wormhole region the double-peaked potential produces echoes.

从粘合一致性看量子引力：从 AdS/CFT 到自旋泡沫

Quantum Gravity from Gluing Consistency: AdS/CFT to Spin-Foams

Chethan Krishnan · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们认为，具有 SO(d+1,1) 规范群的 BF 理论提供了一个 SymTFT“骨架”，可通过作为自举原理的粘合一致性来构造 AdS_{d+1}/CFT_d 对偶，粗略类比于紧致 Chern-Simons 理论作为 rational CFT 的 TQFT 骨架。这是一个非微扰的体量子引力框架。该自举被表述为：在一个普适的、对缺陷封闭的 BF 缝合演算中，物理振幅具有表示无关性；该演算包括 Wilson 线、余二维单值缺陷及其交汇。平坦 BF 联络编码边界的共形几何，而 Wilson 线路径积分构造候选的量子引力微观态和电荷 sector。当自举得到的谱含有应力张量时，Ward 恒等式自然地将其与 B 场联系起来，我们称此关系为广义 simplicity。在允许引力 EFT 的大 N、大 gap 区域，这促使引入有效 B 场概念。在 Einstein 极限下，这变为自旋泡沫模型中使用的“simplicity”关系。传统自旋泡沫模型通过约束 BF 理论到达引力。我们反而建议 BF 理论是柏拉图式的缝合骨架，理论应从中被自举出来。尽管骨架是拓扑的，微扰局域体场可以通过多迹 primary 的 Wilson 塔涌现，并复现其一圈行列式。我们指出 BF Fourier 核是 modular-S 结构的一个有启发性的高维类比。由于体粘合原理本身不需要边界描述，该框架在概念上比 AdS/CFT 更广。我们勾勒 de Sitter 空间如何能纳入这一图景，并赋予观察者自然角色。我们的方法将粘合一致性提升为量子引力理论背后的普适体原理。

English: We argue that BF theory with $SO(d+1,1)$ gauge group provides a SymTFT ''skeleton'' for building AdS$_{d+1}$/CFT$_d$ pairs via gluing consistency as the bootstrap principle, loosely analogous to how compact Chern-Simons theory is a TQFT skeleton for rational CFTs. This is a non-perturbative $bulk$ framework for quantum gravity. The bootstrap is formulated as presentation independence of physical amplitudes within a universal, defect-closed BF sewing calculus, which includes Wilson lines, codimension-two monodromy defects, and their junctions. The flat BF connection encodes the conformal geometry of the boundary, while Wilson-line path integrals construct candidate quantum-gravity microstates and charge sectors. When the bootstrapped spectrum has a stress tensor, Ward identities naturally connect it to the $B$-field, a relation we call generalized simplicity. In large-$N$, large-gap regimes admitting a gravitational EFT, this motivates the introduction of an effective notion of the $B$-field. In the Einstein limit, this becomes the ''simplicity'' relation used in spin-foam models. Conventional spin-foam models reach gravity by constraining BF theory. We suggest instead that BF theory is the Platonic sewing skeleton, from which theories are to be bootstrapped. Despite the topological nature of the skeleton, perturbative local bulk fields can emerge via Wilson-towers of multi-trace primaries, reproducing their one-loop determinants. We note that the BF Fourier kernel is a suggestive higher-dimensional analogue of the modular-$S$ structure. Because the bulk gluing principle in itself does not require a boundary description, the framework is conceptually broader than AdS/CFT. We sketch how de Sitter space may fit into this picture, with a natural role for observers. Our approach elevates gluing consistency to a universal bulk principle underlying theories of quantum gravity.

一句话导读：提出以 SO(d+1,1) BF 理论为 SymTFT 骨架，通过粘合一致性自举 AdS/CFT 与自旋泡沫等量子引力理论，并讨论其向 de Sitter 的推广。

中文摘要：零弦理论（NST）是 Carrollian 世界面上的二维 sigma 模型，其规范对称性包括二维微分同胚、Weyl 缩放和 Carroll-Weyl（CW）缩放；而一般靶空间上的 ILST 理论只实现前两种，不包括 CW 规范对称性。本文表明，在 Carrollian 靶空间（CTS）上，如果背景具有 homothetic kernel generator，则 NST 是良定义的，并且可由同一 CTS 上的 ILST 理论描述。为此，我们从第一性原理构造 CTS 上的最小零弦理论，并讨论超出最小理论的形变。我们研究了几类此类形变，涉及 ruled Carrollian 空间的 clock one-form 和/或 Carrollian 空间上的联络。我们讨论这对近期引入的零弦全息的意义。作为 CTS 的例子，我们简要讨论探测黑洞视界的零弦以及此背景下的零弦全息。

We show in this work that NST on the Carrollian target spaces (CTS) is well-defined if the background admits a homothetic kernel generator and that, it is described by the ILST theory on the same CTS. To this end, we formulate a minimal null string theory on CTS, starting from first principles and then discuss beyond minimal theories as deformations away from minimality. We study some classes of such deformations involving the clock one-from for ruled Carrollian spaces and/or connection on the Carrollian space. We discuss implications of this for the recently introduced null string holography. As examples CTS, we briefly discuss null strings probing black hole horizons and the null string holography in this context.

S. Maurelli, R. Noris, M. Oyarzo, A. Saha, H. Samtleben, M. Trigiante · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们研究了任意时空号差的 D 维引力理论中，与带标量势的标量场耦合的各向异性畴壁和宇宙学解。我们找到一类标量势，使得二阶运动方程允许一阶表述。相应的玻色流允许非平凡的 Ricci 平坦世界体积，而其 Killing 旋量实现进一步要求世界体积允许一个非零平行旋量。五维 N=2 规范超引力提供了该构造的具体实现，其世界体积几何由号差决定，并产生 pp-wave、hyper-Kähler 和 hypersymplectic 几何。我们进一步构造了一类依赖于单个变量的广义各向异性解，其中各向异性编码在一个常无迹矩阵中。当一部分标量场仅通过动能项贡献而不进入标量势时，会出现一个特殊分支；这些场在标量流形上沿测地线运动。作为一个显式应用，我们重新得到 Kasner-dilaton-AdS 解，并证明在适当极限下它们满足一阶流方程。

English: We investigate anisotropic domain wall and cosmological solutions in $D$-dimensional gravitational theories of arbitrary spacetime signature coupled to scalar fields with a scalar potential. We identify a class of scalar potentials for which the second-order equations of motion admit a first-order formulation. The associated bosonic flows allow non-trivial Ricci-flat worldvolumes, while their Killing-spinor realization further requires the worldvolume to admit a non-vanishing parallel spinor. Five-dimensional ${\cal N}=2$ gauged supergravity provides a concrete realization of this construction, with the worldvolume geometry determined by its signature and giving rise to pp-wave, hyper-K\"{a}hler, and hypersymplectic geometries. We further construct a general class of anisotropic solutions depending on a single variable, with the anisotropy encoded in a constant traceless matrix. A particular branch arises when a subset of scalar fields contribute through their kinetic terms but do not enter the scalar potential; these fields follow geodesics on the scalar manifold. As an explicit application, we recover the Kasner-dilaton-AdS solutions and show that, in the appropriate limit, they satisfy the first-order flow equations.

一句话导读：研究任意号差 D 维引力中带标量势的各向异性畴壁/宇宙学解，给出可一阶化的势类及 5D N=2 规范超引力实现，并恢复 Kasner-dilaton-AdS 解。

English: We extend the modularity-based approach of arXiv:2509.02226 for the holographic thermal propagator to the physically relevant case of nonzero energy $\omega$. We obtain the low-temperature expansion of the propagator and find agreement with the result of a completely different method, the near-boundary expansion of the bulk wave equation.

A Semiclassical Entanglement Wedge in Double-Scaled SYK

Xi Dong, Jiuci Xu · hep-th, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们研究双标度 SYK 中部分纠缠热态的纠缠结构，其中物质插入所携带的 flavor 自由度可处于任意混合态。在半经典极限、随后重探针极限下，我们的 replica 计算给出一个 Faulkner-Lewkowycz-Maldacena 公式：边界熵分解为一个与 flavor 态无关的“面积”项，以及相应纠缠楔内的体物质熵。改变算符插入的欧几里得位置会在边界熵中产生尖锐转变，我们将其解释为单个物质激发穿过楔的边界，因而作为存在清晰定义纠缠楔的证据。为得到该结果，我们分析一般欧几里得 2n 点函数的半经典行为，并给出其分解为两点函数乘积之和的概率证明。我们还从精确谱表示出发，利用量子 6j 符号的半经典行为给出一个互补推导。

English: We study the entanglement structure of partially entangled thermal states in double-scaled SYK , allowing flavor degrees of freedom carried by matter insertions to be in an arbitrary mixed state. Varying the Euclidean locations of the operator insertions produces sharp transitions in the boundary entropy, which we interpret as individual matter excitations crossing the boundary of the wedge and hence as evidence for a sharply defined entanglement wedge. To derive this result, we analyze the semiclassical behavior of general Euclidean $2n$-point functions and give a probabilistic proof of their factorization into sums over products of two-point functions. We also give a complementary derivation from exact spectral representations, using the semiclassical behavior of the quantum $6j$-symbol.

一句话导读：在双标度 SYK 中，半经典 FLM 公式将部分纠缠热态的边界熵分解为面积项与纠缠楔内物质熵，插入位置变化对应物质激发穿越楔边界的尖锐转变。

On the gravity side, this has been verified by explicit computations in many examples, but a general proof is lacking even at the classical level. We fill this gap by showing that in any four-dimensional supergravity theory with $\mathcal{N} \geq 2$ supersymmetry in asymptotically flat space-time, the classical contribution to the index from each supersymmetric saddle is independent of both. The argument uses only the behavior of the solution and of the Killing spinor equations near infinity. The result therefore holds in the presence of arbitrary higher-derivative corrections and for multi-centered black hole configurations. In particular, moduli independence follows without appeal to the attractor mechanism, which relies on the near-horizon geometry.

黑化的 BPS：热 BMN 分支的终点

Blackened BPS: the end of the thermal BMN branch

Jorge E. Santos · hep-th, hep-lat · v1 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们利用十一维超引力中的对偶黑洞，研究大 N 强耦合下 BMN 矩阵模型的热力学。在约化到二维 SO(9) 规范超引力的相容截断中，静态 SO(3)×SO(6) 不变黑洞满足常微分方程，我们高精度求解了这些方程。我们为该截断建立全息重整化，并用一个超对称解固定有限反项。这分别给出能量、熵以及对 BMN 质量的响应，并沿分支验证了第一定律和 Smarr 关系。热分支终止于一个临界 μ/T 值，幂律拟合将其定为 4π，估计不确定度低于 10^{-10}。此前工作中由熵重构自由能所推断的一阶相变不再成立，而一个独立的十一维计算在其覆盖范围内与我们的结果一致。相反，自由能、熵和质量响应在分支终点连续趋近于禁闭相的相应值，此时解变得奇异。如果该分支直到终点仍占主导，则相变与奇点重合。在分支终点附近，标量场遵循超对称一阶方程的解，而度规带有非平凡的变黑因子。视界发展出一个颈部，其剖面是普适的，半径随到收缩点的距离以 2/5 次幂增长。在我们分辨的范围内，几何不是支配真空黑洞并合的 Ricci 平坦双锥。

English: We study the thermodynamics of the BMN matrix model at large $N$ and strong coupling, using its dual black holes in eleven-dimensional supergravity. Within the consistent truncation to two-dimensional $SO(9)$ gauged supergravity, the static $SO(3)\times SO(6)$-invariant black holes solve ordinary differential equations, which we solve to high precision. We formulate holographic renormalisation for this truncation and fix the finite counterterms using a supersymmetric solution. This gives the energy, the entropy and the response to the BMN mass independently, and we verify the first law and the Smarr relation along the branch. The thermal branch ends at a critical value of $\mu/T$, which power-law fits place at $4\pi$ with an estimated uncertainty below $10^{-10}$. The first-order transition inferred in earlier work, where the free energy was reconstructed from the entropy, does not survive, and an independent eleven-dimensional calculation agrees with ours over the range it covers. Instead, the free energy, the entropy and the mass response approach their values in the confined phase continuously at the end of the branch, where the solutions become singular. If this branch remains the dominant one up to its end point, the transition therefore coincides with the singularity. Near the end of the branch, the scalar fields follow a solution of the supersymmetric first-order equations, while the metric carries a nontrivial blackening factor. The horizon develops a neck whose profile is universal, with radii growing as the $2/5$ power of the distance from the pinch. Within the range we resolve, the geometry is not that of the Ricci-flat double cone which governs mergers of vacuum black holes.

一句话导读：高精度求解十一维超引力中的 BMN 对偶黑洞，发现热 BMN 分支在 μ/T≈4π 处终结并与禁闭相连续，否定了先前由熵重构推断的一阶相变。

阴影中的孪生星：原中子星中的相变

Twins in the Shadow: Phase Transitions in Proto-Neutron Stars

Jannik Milthaler, Jan-Erik Christian, Pia Jakobus, Stephan Rosswog · astro-ph.HE, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：我们研究从强子物质到退禁闭夸克物质的一阶相变对原中子星演化的影响。为最大化结果的适用性，我们构建了高度可参数化的状态方程，其中用相对论平均场方法描述强子物质，用常数声速方法描述夸克物质。我们将原中子星的冷却行为近似为在固定重子质量下熵递减的序列。某些参数化会导致所谓“孪生星”，即两颗中子星具有相同（引力）质量但半径不同；探测到它们被视为相变的决定性信号。然而我们发现，原中子星演化表明，引力孪生星只有在杂化星不额外具有重子孪生星时才可能；这排除了大多数孪生星对，尤其是当相变发生在高密度时。在质量-半径图中，未被占据的杂化支看起来处于强子支的“阴影”中。

English: We study the impact of a first-order phase transition from hadronic to deconfined quark matter on the evolution of proto-neutron stars. To maximize the applicability of our results, we construct an equation of state that is highly parameterizable, where we use a relativistic mean field approach to model hadronic matter and a constant speed of sound approach to model quark matter. We approximate the cooling behavior of proto-neutron stars as a sequence of decreasing entropy at constant baryonic mass. Some parameterizations lead to so-called "twin-stars", where two neutron stars have the same (gravitational) mass but different radii. Detecting them is regarded as a smoking gun signal for phase transition. We find, however, that proto-neutron star evolution suggests that gravitational twin stars are only possible if the hybrid star does not have, in addition, a baryonic twin. This rules out most twin star pairs, especially if the phase transition occurs at large densities. In a mass-radius diagram the unpopulated hybrid branch appears to be "in the shadow" of the hadronic branch.

一句话导读：原中子星演化对一阶强子-夸克相变产生的引力孪生星施加限制，多数孪生星对因重子孪生条件而被排除。

孪生宇宙与双度规引力：从萨哈罗夫宇宙学对称性到关于负质量的现代思辨

Twin Universes and Bimetric Gravity: From Sakharov's Cosmological Symmetry to Modern Speculations on Negative Mass

Jean-Pierre Luminet · physics.gen-ph, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：本文综述孪生宇宙模型的概念与理论现状：从萨哈罗夫关于重子生成、CPT对称性和时间箭头反转的早期思想，到近期涉及成对产生纠缠宇宙的量子宇宙学情景。特别关注萨哈罗夫型宇宙学对称性、现代双度规引力理论与涉及负质量部门的思辨模型之间的区别。我们总结双度规引力面临的主要自洽性条件，包括Boulware-Deser鬼、Higuchi型界限、协变守恒律，以及正质量与负质量部门的不可能性结果。随后考察Janus宇宙学模型及相关的黑洞替代方案，强调启发式孪生宇宙叙事与完整指定的相对论场论之间的差异。我们认为，尽管孪生宇宙思想对于时间箭头、物质-反物质不对称和宇宙量子起源等问题仍是有成果的框架，但将双度规引力、负质量、暗部门现象学与Kerr黑洞替代方案结合起来的模型仍面临沉重的数学与观测证明负担。

English: We review the conceptual and theoretical status of twin-universe models, from Sakharov's early ideas on baryogenesis, CPT symmetry, and reversed arrows of time to recent quantum-cosmological scenarios involving pair-created entangled universes. Particular attention is given to the distinction between Sakharov-type cosmological symmetry, modern bimetric theories of gravity, and speculative models involving negative mass sectors. We summarize the main consistency conditions faced by bimetric gravity, including the Boulware-Deser ghost, Higuchi-type bounds, covariant conservation laws, and no-go results for positive- and negative-mass sectors. We then examine the Janus cosmological model and related black-hole replacement proposals, emphasizing the difference between heuristic twin-universe narratives and fully specified relativistic field theories. We argue that while twin-universe ideas remain a fertile framework for questions about the arrow of time, matter-antimatter asymmetry, and the quantum origin of the universe, models combining bimetric gravity, negative mass, dark-sector phenomenology, and alternatives to Kerr black holes face a substantial burden of mathematical and observational proof.

一句话导读：综述从萨哈罗夫宇宙学对称性到现代双度规引力与负质量孪生宇宙模型，并讨论其自洽性条件与黑洞替代方案。

SPHINCS_BSSN 中带表格状态方程的双中子星并合原始变量恢复方法

Primitive recovery methods for binary neutron star mergers with tabulated equations of state in SPHINCS_BSSN

Swapnil Shankar, Stephan Rosswog, Peter Diener · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：中子星并合的动力学与可观测信号由极端条件下的物理决定，尤其受高密度状态方程影响，最精细模型通常以表格形式给出。数值相对论代码通常演化性质良好的数值（守恒）变量，但代价是必须在每个计算单元和每个积分子步通过昂贵且并非总是成功的求根算法找到物理感兴趣的（原始）变量。我们最近开发了拉格朗日数值相对论代码 SPHINCS_BSSN，它在自适应网格上用经过充分测试的方法演化时空，但流体用自由运动粒子演化。由于我们的演化方程不同于传统数值相对论，若想使用表格状态方程，需要发展新的守恒到原始变量算法。本文提出三种算法：三维和二维 Newton-Raphson 方法，以及基于 Ridders 方法的一维求根算法。我们发现三维方法快速稳健，在完整中子星并合模拟（DD2 状态方程）中平均失败比例远低于1%。二维方法未发现明显优势；一维 Ridders 方法较慢但基本不会失败。因此我们选择三维 Newton-Raphson 作为默认，并以一维 Ridders 方法作为安全“降落伞”。

English: The dynamics and observable signatures of neutron star mergers are governed by physics under the most extreme conditions. They are particularly impacted by the high-density equation of state, which for the most sophisticated models is usually available in the form of tables. Numerical relativity codes usually evolve particularly well-behaved numerical ("conservative") variables, but at the price that the physically interesting ("primitive") variables need to be found at every computational element and at every integration sub-step by means of expensive (and not always successful) root-finding algorithms. We have recently developed the Lagrangian numerical relativity code SPHINCS_BSSN which evolves the spacetime on an adaptive mesh with well tested methods, but the fluid is evolved by means of freely moving particles. Since our evolution equations differ from those of conventional numerical relativity, we need to develop new conservative-to-primitive algorithms if we want to use tabulated equations of state. We present here three such algorithms: a 3D and a 2D Newton-Raphson method and a 1D root-finding algorithm based on Ridders' method. We find the 3D method to be very fast and robust with an average failure fraction in a full-blown neutron star merger simulation (with the DD2 equation of state) well below 1%. While we do not find obvious advantages for the 2D method, the 1D Ridders' method is slow, but essentially fail-safe. Therefore, we choose the 3D Newton-Raphson as default and fall back to the 1D Ridders' method as a safe "parachute".

一句话导读：SPHINCS_BSSN 针对表格状态方程开发三种守恒到原始变量恢复算法，推荐3D Newton-Raphson并备选1D Ridders。

Deep Learning Search for Gravitational Waves from Compact Binary Coalescence

Lorenzo Mobilia, Tito Dal Canton, Gianluca Maria Guidi · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：引力波搜索依赖于多种方法的组合，包括匹配滤波、相干分析以及较新的基于机器学习的流程。对于致密双星并合——其信号来源于致密天体的相对论动力学——匹配滤波仍是核心要素，但随着下一代干涉仪（如爱因斯坦望远镜）所需的数据量和参数空间覆盖度增加，其计算成本将大幅上升。因此，发展能够在保持探测性能的同时降低计算负载的互补策略至关重要。我们研究了一种将匹配滤波概念与卷积神经网络相结合的混合方法，从而无需依赖通常的 $\chi^2$ 拒绝检验即可实现高效信号搜索。使用包含高斯噪声中注入信号、瞬态噪声以及模板库未涵盖的物理效应（如偏心率、进动和高阶模式）的模拟数据集，我们表明该方法达到了与标准匹配滤波搜索相当或更好的探测效率，同时在信号中所含物理未被模板库代表或数据受毛刺影响的所有情形下，提供了更节省资源的流程。相反，该分析也揭示了在纯高斯噪声中标准 BNS/BBH 搜索时探测能力的一些损失。这些结果表明，深度学习辅助搜索可以支持未来探测器时代的可持续引力波数据分析。

English: Gravitational-wave searches rely on a combination of methods, including matched filtering, coherent analyses, and more recent machine-learning-based pipelines. For compact binary coalescences --- where signals originate from the relativistic dynamics of compact objects --- matched filtering remains a central element, but its computational cost will increase substantially with the data volumes and parameter-space coverage required by next-generation interferometers such as the Einstein Telescope. Developing complementary strategies that reduce computational load while preserving detection performance is therefore essential. We investigate a hybrid approach that combines matched-filtering concepts with Convolutional Neural Networks, enabling efficient signal searches without relying on the usual $\chi^2$ rejection test. Using simulated data sets that include injected signals in Gaussian noise, transient noise, and physical effects not represented in the template bank --- such as eccentricity, precession and higher-order modes --- we show that the method achieves a detection efficiency comparable to or better than a standard matched-filtering search while offering a more resource-efficient pipeline in all the cases where the physics included in the signals were not represented in the template bank or when glitches were affecting the data. Conversely, the analysis also reveals some loss of detection capability for standard BNS/BBH searches in pure Gaussian noise. These results indicate that deep-learning-assisted searches can support sustainable gravitational-wave data analysis in future detector eras.

一句话导读：将匹配滤波思想与卷积神经网络结合，用于致密双星并合引力波搜索，并在非模板物理与毛刺场景下展现资源效率优势。

稳态时空中光子与有质量粒子超曲面的统一框架

A unified framework for photon and massive particle hypersurfaces in stationary spacetimes

Erasmo Caponio, Anna Valeria Germinario, Antonio Masiello · gr-qc, math.DG · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：Kobialko、Bogush 和 Gal'tsov 引入的有质量粒子面（MPS）是限制具有固定 Killing 能量和荷质比的带电有质量粒子轨迹的类时超曲面，类似于 Claudel、Virbhadra 和 Ellis 的光子面。我们在统一的 Finsler 框架下研究标准稳态时空中的这两类面。对于 Killing 不变超曲面 R×S0，其中 S0 是空间切片 S 的超曲面，我们证明：光子超曲面和 MPS 恰好分别是 S0 关于 Fermat 度规和 S 上的 Jacobi–Randers 度规为全测地曲面的那些情形。对 MPS 我们还给出规范不变版本，用 Riemann 型 Jacobi 度规和约化磁场的相切条件表述。对任意类时超曲面，我们给出 MPS 部分脐性刻画的坐标无关表述；在维数至少四且满足自然能量条件下，我们刻画一个 MPS 何时按 B.-Y. Chen 意义为拟脐性的。在刚性旋转带电尘埃的 Som–Raychaudhuri 时空中，我们展示既不是光子超曲面也不是拟脐性的 MPS。最后，在 Jacobi–Randers 度规的完备性假设下，我们证明连接一点到 Killing 场流线的 Lorentz 力方程固有时参数化解的存在性和多重性结果；在紧致性假设下，证明具有周期空间投影的解的存在性，这些解可能被限制在一个 MPS 上。

English: Massive particle surfaces (MPS), introduced by Kobialko, Bogush and Gal'tsov, are timelike hypersurfaces confining the trajectories of charged massive particles with fixed Killing energy and charge-to-mass ratio, in analogy with the photon surfaces of Claudel, Virbhadra and Ellis. We study both classes in standard stationary spacetimes within a unified Finslerian framework. For Killing-invariant hypersurfaces $\mathbb{R}\times S_0$, with $S_0$ a hypersurface of a spacelike slice $S$, we prove that photon hypersurfaces and MPS are exactly those for which $S_0$ is totally geodesic with respect to the Fermat metric and to a Jacobi--Randers metric on $S$, respectively. For MPS we also give a gauge-invariant version, in terms of a Riemannian Jacobi metric and a tangency condition on the reduced magnetic field. For arbitrary timelike hypersurfaces, we give a coordinate-free formulation of the partial umbilicity characterization of MPS and, in dimension at least four and under a natural energy condition, we characterize when an MPS is quasi-umbilical in the sense of B.-Y. Chen. In the Som--Raychaudhuri spacetime of a rigidly rotating charged dust we exhibit MPS which are neither photon hypersurfaces nor quasi-umbilical. Finally, under completeness assumptions on the Jacobi--Randers metric, we prove existence and multiplicity results for proper-time parametrized solutions of the Lorentz force equation connecting a point to a flow line of the Killing field and, under compactness assumptions, existence of solutions with periodic spatial projection, possibly confined to an MPS.

一句话导读：在统一 Finsler 框架下，将稳态时空中的光子面与有质量粒子面刻画为空间切片上的全测地超曲面，并研究其脐性及 Lorentz 力方程解的存在性。

Parametrized model for gravitational waves from eccentric, precessing binary black holes: theory-agnostic tests of General Relativity with pTEOBResumS

Danilo Chiaramello, Nicol\`o Cibrario, Jacob Lange, Koustav Chandra, Rossella Gamba, Raffaella Bonino, Alessandro Nagar · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：双黑洞并合产生的引力波可在强场、高曲率区域检验广义相对论。然而，现有基于引力波的此类检验迄今假设信号源无偏心率，限制了其适用范围。本文提出 pTEOBResumS，这是一个新的参数化旋进-并合-铃宕模型，用于广义相对论零假设检验，同时纳入轨道偏心率和自旋进动，并建立在有效单体模型 TEOBResumS-Dalí 基础上。我们在旋进和并合-铃宕阶段都引入对广义相对论的参数化偏离。我们通过用模型自身或数值模拟生成的合成信号进行参数估计来验证模型，包括包含超出广义相对论物理的系统。由此确立模型的自洽性，展示其识别超出广义相对论效应的能力，并评估偏心率对偏离参数恢复的影响。随后，我们分析来自前三轮 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 观测运行的一组双黑洞事件，在偏心、自旋对齐或进动、准圆假设下，寻找残余黑洞基频准简正模的偏离。我们在任何事件中都没有发现此类偏离的统计显著证据。我们用似然相乘或分层程序合并单事件结果；与先前工作一致，我们推断出对更长准简正模阻尼时间的轻微偏好，但有限的事件样本和潜在系统误差降低了该发现的显著性。除 GW200129 外，我们在事件中未发现对轨道偏心率的支持。对于该事件，偏心描述受到强烈偏好，尽管该结果可能受数据质量问题影响。

English: Gravitational waves from binary black hole mergers allow us to test General Relativity in the strong-field, high-curvature regime. However, existing gravitational waves-based tests for this have so far assumed non-eccentric signal sources, limiting their range of applicability. In this work, we present pTEOBResumS, a new parametrized inspiral-merger-ringdown model for null tests of General Relativity incorporating both orbital eccentricity and spin precession, building on the effective-one-body model TEOBResumS-Dal\'i. We introduce parametrized deviations from General Relativity both in the inspiral and the merger-ringdown regimes. We validate the model through parameter estimation of synthetic signals generated with the model itself or from numerical simulations, including of systems featuring physics beyond General Relativity. We thus establish the model's consistency, demonstrate its capability to identify effects beyond General Relativity, and gauge the impact of eccentricity on the recovery of deviation parameters. We then analyze a set of binary black hole events from the first three LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing runs, under either the eccentric, spin-aligned or precessing, quasi-circular hypotheses, searching for deviations in the remnant black hole's fundamental quasi-normal mode. We find no statistically significant evidence for such deviations in any of the events. We combine single event results either by multiplying likelihoods, or via a hierarchical procedure;consistent with previous works, we infer a mild preference for longer quasi-normal mode damping times than expected, though the limited event sample and potential systematics reduce the significance of this finding. We find no support for orbital eccentricity among the events, save for GW200129. An eccentric description is strongly favored for this event, although this result could be influenced by data quality issues.

一句话导读：提出包含偏心与自旋进动的参数化 IMR 模型 pTEOBResumS，用于双黑洞引力波中理论无关的广义相对论检验，并在 LVK 事件中搜索 QNM 偏离与偏心率证据。

Learning Approximate Isometric Embeddings for Efficient Template Placement

Alexandra Wernersson, Jessica Irwin, Melissa Lopez, Sarah Caudill · astro-ph.IM, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：球覆盖问题在科学中有广泛应用，然而在弯曲高维流形上精确求解在计算上不可行，因为距离必须使用依赖位置的度规来评估。我们提出 isobank，一个归一化流，学习近似等距的坐标变换，使得潜在空间中的欧氏距离近似物理参数空间中度规诱导的固有距离。这允许在潜在空间中使用欧氏距离检查进行模板放置，避免放置过程中重复的度规评估。我们在引力波模板库构建背景下评估 isobank，其中球覆盖问题对应模板放置问题。在五维偏心双星参数空间上，isobank 在最大失配 μ=0.03 时达到 97% 覆盖率，使用的模板比最先进的随机放置代码 mbank 少 23%，后者达到 94% 覆盖率。覆盖率在独立注入上测量，注入在质量、自旋和偏心率上均匀抽取，使用精确波形匹配而非度规近似。训练该流约需 2.5 小时，在 32 个 CPU 核心上放置模板库不到 1 小时。isobank 已在 GitHub 公开：https://github.com/Alexandra-Wernersson/isobank

English: The sphere covering problem has broad applications in science however, exact solutions are computationally infeasible on curved, high-dimensional manifolds because distances must be evaluated using a position-dependent metric. We present $\texttt{isobank}$, a normalizing flow that learns an approximately isometric coordinate transformation, such that Euclidean distances in the latent space approximate metric-induced proper distances in the physical parameter space. This enables template placement using Euclidean distance checks in the latent space, avoiding repeated metric evaluations during placement. We evaluate $\texttt{isobank}$ in the context of gravitational wave template bank construction, where the sphere covering problem corresponds to the template placement problem. On a five-dimensional eccentric binary parameter space, $\texttt{isobank}$ reaches 97\% coverage at a maximum mismatch of $\mu=0.03$ with 23\% fewer templates than the state-of-the-art stochastic placement code $\texttt{mbank}$, which reaches 94\% coverage. Coverage is measured on independent injections drawn uniformly over the masses, spins and eccentricity, using the exact waveform match rather than the metric approximation. Training the flow takes about 2.5h and placing the bank under 1h on 32 CPU cores. $\texttt{isobank}$ is publicly available on Github https://github.com/Alexandra-Wernersson/isobank

一句话导读：提出 isobank 归一化流学习近似等距嵌入，在五维偏心双星引力波模板放置中以更少模板达到更高覆盖率。

Parity Isospectrality of the Kerr--Newman--de Sitter Black Hole

Colin Weller, Dongjun Li, Pratik Wagle, Yanbei Chen, Nicolas Yunes · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-05

中文摘要：在广义相对论中，真空 Kerr 扰动的偶宇称与奇宇称准正规模频率相同。我们对次极端 Kerr–Newman–de Sitter 黑洞的线性引力电磁扰动建立了这种宇称等谱性，且未使用慢旋转或小电荷展开。我们在辐射规范下直接从规范不变的主变量重构辐射度规与规范势扰动，无需引入中间复势。

English: Vacuum Kerr perturbations in general relativity have identical even- and odd-parity quasinormal frequencies. We establish this parity isospectrality for linear gravitoelectromagnetic perturbations of subextremal Kerr--Newman--de Sitter black holes, without a slow-rotation or small-charge expansion. We reconstruct the radiative metric and gauge-potential perturbations directly from gauge-invariant master variables in radiation gauge, without an intermediate complex potential.
