MADGRAV：应用于 LIGO 数据的引力波搜索多级异常检测流程

MADGRAV: a multilevel anomaly-detection pipeline for gravitational-wave searches applied to LIGO data

Gianluca Inguglia, Huw Haigh, Ulyana Dupletsa, Alessandro Longo · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM, cs.LG · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：我们展示了 MADGRAV 的结果，这是一个基于深度学习的高质量致密双星并合搜索，应用于 LIGO 干涉仪在第三次观测运行以及第四次观测运行第一、第二部分收集的数据。MADGRAV 流程由一系列顺序卷积神经网络组成，执行异常检测、毛刺分类、相干性检验和信号排序。我们通过 1 秒 Q 变换窗口研究 Hanford 和 Livingston LIGO 探测器的数据（分别以及相干）。在通过流程每一阶段的候选者中，48 个达到显著性阈值，我们报告了 47 个引力波探测，其虚警率低于 1 yr^-1，天体物理来源概率 p_astro>0.9。47 个探测中有 44 个与最小模型化相干 WaveBurst 搜索共享。从官方引力波瞬变目录提取的观测总源帧质量范围为 14–236 M_sun，中位数为 69 M_sun，中位信噪比为 16。我们注意到，回收的置信探测比例随质量上升：对于 LIGO 探测器网络 SNR>10，该流程回收 30 M_sun 以下置信目录事件的 8.1%，30–100 M_sun 之间的 39.8%，100 M_sun 以上的 53.3%，分别对应相干 WaveBurst 在同一区间探测事件的 33.3%、45.5% 和 53.3%。这些结果表明，异常检测流程可以作为独立探测通道，在高质量高信噪比区域补充匹配滤波。

English: We present the results of \textbf{MADGRAV}, a deep-learning-based search for high-mass compact binary coalescences, applied to the data collected by the LIGO interferometers during the third observing run and during the first and second part of the fourth observing run. The \textbf{MADGRAV} pipeline consists of a series of sequential convolutional neural networks that perform anomaly detection, glitch classification, coherence testing, and signal ranking. Data from the Hanford and Livingston LIGO detectors are studied (both individually and in coherence) by way of 1 second Q-transform windows. Of the candidates that survive every stage of the pipeline, 48 reach the significance threshold, and we report 47 gravitational wave detections characterised by a false alarm rate below $1\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$ with a probability of astrophysical origin $p_{\rm astro}>0.9$. Of the 47 detections, 44 are shared with the minimally modelled coherent WaveBurst search. The observed total source-frame masses, extracted from official gravitational wave transient catalogues, are in the $14-236 M_{\odot}$ range with a median of $69 M_{\odot}$, and a median SNR of 16. We note that the recovered fraction of confident detections rises with mass: for LIGO detectors network SNR $>10$ the pipeline recovers $8.1\%$ of confident catalog events below $30 M_{\odot}$, $39.8\%$ between $30$ and $100 M_{\odot}$, and $53.3\%$ above $100 M_{\odot}$, corresponding to $33.3\%$, $45.5\%$ and $53.3\%$ of the events detected by coherent WaveBurst in the same bins. These results suggest that anomaly detection pipelines can serve as an independent detection channel complementary to matched filtering in the high-mass high-SNR regime.

一句话导读：MADGRAV 深度学习异常检测流程在 LIGO O3/O4 数据中报告 47 个高置信引力波探测，并显示在高质量区可作为匹配滤波的补充通道。

具有完备渐近喉的黑洞

Black Holes With Complete Asymptotic Throats

Yi-Bo Liang, Hong-Rong Li · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：我们研究一个球对称黑洞能否在有限非零面积半径处具有完备内端，同时在其视界外足够远处满足标准能量条件。保留两个独立的度规函数，我们处理零类（null-type）和类空型（spacelike-type）渐近喉，并推导因果测地线完备性的一个必要且充分积分判据。在对独立曲率分量有有界性和有限极限假设下，零类型端点的极限曲率由喉半径固定，而类空类型端点允许一个额外的非负曲率参数。我们得到了在类时和零类平行传播标架中曲率有界的判据。完备的类空类型例子可以有有界标量不变量和有界类时标架曲率，但在无限仿射参数处零标架曲率无界。我们还证明，在所陈述类别中，径向零能量条件必须在每个完备内端任意近处失效。然而，具有任一种喉的显式实解析构造在足够远的外部区域处处满足零、弱、主和强能量条件。光滑构造可以在有限半径之外变成精确的 Schwarzschild。这些结果确立了完备渐近喉与外部能量条件的相容性，同时区分完备性与不同层次的曲率正则性。

English: We investigate whether a spherically symmetric black hole can have a complete inner end at finite, nonzero areal radius while satisfying the standard energy conditions sufficiently far outside its horizon. Retaining two independent metric functions, we treat both null-type and spacelike-type asymptotic throats and derive a necessary and sufficient integral criterion for causal geodesic completeness. Under boundedness and finite-limit assumptions on the independent curvature components, null-type ends have limiting curvature fixed by the throat radius, whereas spacelike-type ends admit an additional nonnegative curvature parameter. We obtain criteria for bounded curvature in timelike and null parallel-propagated frames. Complete spacelike-type examples can have bounded scalar invariants and bounded timelike-frame curvature but unbounded null-frame curvature at infinite affine parameter. We also prove that the radial null energy condition must fail arbitrarily close to every complete inner end in the stated class. Nevertheless, explicit real-analytic constructions with either type of throat satisfy the null, weak, dominant, and strong energy conditions throughout a sufficiently distant exterior region. Smooth constructions can become exactly Schwarzschild beyond a finite radius. These results establish the compatibility of complete asymptotic throats with exterior energy conditions while distinguishing completeness from different levels of curvature regularity.

一句话导读：该文证明球对称黑洞可在视界外满足标准能量条件的同时拥有完备渐近内喉，给出测地线完备性判据，并指出径向零能量条件在完备内端附近必被违反。

洛伦兹破坏暴胀中非正则动能的原初张量特征与引力波约束

Primordial Tensor Signatures and Gravitational Wave Constraints in Lorentz Violating Inflation with Non-Canonical Kinetics

Dibash Plaban Kalita, Shreya Banerjee · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-10-01

中文摘要：我们研究洛伦兹破坏暴胀框架中带非正则标量场动力学的原初张量扰动。采用含高阶动能项 K3X^2 的爱因斯坦-以太型理论，导出张量传播速度及其对有效洛伦兹破坏耦合的依赖。我们考虑一个可解析处理的无势背景，并研究两种代表性耦合 q_k=λ_T φ_k^2 和 q_k=λ_T φ_k^4。所得张量谱指数 n_T 及其跑动 α_T 满足不同的一致性关系，为原初引力波谱中的洛伦兹破坏提供潜在特征。我们导出张量倾斜和跑动对应的约束，并将其与 GW170817/GRB170817A 给出的晚期引力波速度严格限制比较。我们强调，将该限制转化为原初约束需要对张量扇区耦合从暴胀到晚期宇宙的演化作出假设。结果表明，原初张量观测量可为洛伦兹破坏及其与非正则暴胀动力学的相互作用提供互补探针。

English: We investigate primordial tensor perturbations in a Lorentz violating inflationary framework with non-canonical scalar field dynamics. Using an Einstein-\AE{}ther type with a higher order kinetic term $K_3X^2$, we derive the tensor propagation speed and its dependence on an effective Lorentz violating coupling. We consider an analytically tractable potential free background and study two representative couplings, $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^2$ and $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^4$. The resulting tensor spectral index $n_T$ and its running $\alpha_T$ satisfy distinct consistency relations, providing potential signatures of Lorentz violation in the primordial gravitational wave spectrum. We derive corresponding constraints from the tensor tilt and running and compare them with the stringent late-time bound on the gravitational wave speed from GW170817/GRB170817A. We emphasize that translating this bound into primordial constraint requires an assumption about the evolution of tensor sector coupling between inflation and the late Universe. 中文摘要：物理信息神经网络（PINNs）是一种机器学习框架，通过约束神经网络满足底层物理定律来近似偏微分方程组的解。由此得到的连续表示不需要预定义的计算网格，并可在训练域内任意点求值。在本工作中，我们研究将 PINNs 应用于广义相对论的 Einstein 方程。我们讨论用于获得精确时空解的数学表述、网络架构、损失函数和训练策略，并通过数值相对论中的一系列标准基准展示该方法。随后，我们将该方法扩展到更具天体物理背景的情形，考虑一个孤立孤子玻色星的动力学演化。我们的模拟表明，直接在三维笛卡尔坐标中运行的 PINN 可以重现高度致密玻色星的平衡结构，并恢复其标志性的径向振荡频率。这些结果确立了 PINNs 作为求解耦合物质-Einstein 方程以及探索数值相对论中替代表述的可行补充框架。

English: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a machine-learning framework for approximating solutions to systems of partial differential equations by constraining neural networks to satisfy the underlying physical laws. The resulting continuous representation does not require a predefined computational mesh and can be evaluated at arbitrary points within the training domain. In this work, we investigate the application of PINNs to Einstein's equations of General Relativity. We discuss the mathematical formulation, network architectures, loss functions, and training strategies used to obtain accurate spacetime solutions, and demonstrate the approach through a series of standard benchmarks from Numerical Relativity. We then extend the method to a more astrophysical setting by considering the dynamical evolution of an isolated solitonic boson star. Our simulations show that a PINN operating directly in three-dimensional Cartesian coordinates can reproduce the equilibrium structure of a highly compact boson star and recover its characteristic radial oscillation frequencies. These results establish PINNs as a viable complementary framework for solving coupled matter-Einstein equations and exploring alternative formulations in numerical relativity.

In particular, the resulting equation of state can approach $\omega_X \simeq -1$ and cross the phantom divide within the weak torsion regime $|\Phi/H| < 1$. The model predicts a dynamical equation of state in which cosmic acceleration gradually weakens, potentially consistent with recent DESI observations. Overall, our results support the feasibility of the model and provide a theoretical framework for preparing likelihood analyses.

English: In vacuum anti-de Sitter (AdS) space, the geometry admits a perfect tessellation by a geodesic network. This tessellation characterizes the background exactly, and a partial entanglement entropy (PEE) tensor-network toy model of AdS/CFT can be defined on it. It has so far been unclear whether this construction can be extended beyond vacuum AdS. In this paper we take the first step in this direction. We show that the exterior region of the Schwarzschild black hole and its Einstein--Rosen bridge are perfectly tessellated by a specific geodesic gas emitted from the boundary, so that Crofton reconstruction holds in these regions. We then prove that such a geodesic tessellation and the Crofton reconstruction it defines extend to more generic Riemannian manifolds. This allows us to construct a PEE tensor-network model of holographic duality on more generic geometric backgrounds. In the case of the PEE tensor-network model for the Schwarzschild background, we can concretely realize the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy, the Ryu--Takayanagi formula and the ER=EPR proposal. Our approach opens a new route towards holographic toy models beyond AdS/CFT.

为什么库珀对生活在 AdS2：Yukawa-SYK 模型的谱分析

中文摘要：我们为 Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev 模型中库珀配对的几何表述建立了谱基础。从大-$N$ 双局域有效作用量出发，我们推导了偶频自旋单态库珀通道中的高斯涨落核。按照 Maldacena 和 Stanford 的构造，我们对任意共形权重 $h$ 解析地确定了核本征值 $k(h)$，并将配对涨落分解为相应 de Sitter 空间 Laplacian 的连续谱和离散谱部分。我们表明，超导不稳定及其附近的普适低能涨落完全位于连续散射谱部分，而离散模保持非临界。将核围绕最低连续模展开，得到限制在连续谱子空间上的 ${\rm dS}_2$ 上的 Klein--Gordon 作用量。该子空间正是逆 Radon 变换到 ${\rm AdS}_2$ 定义良好的子空间。因此，投影后的双局域库珀对场可以映射到在 ${\rm AdS}_2$ 中传播的标量物质场，而无需对体理论进一步施加谱限制。我们的结果为早期全息表述中隐含的投影提供了缺失的微观依据，并阐明了局域体场如何从双局域配对理论中涌现。

English: We establish the spectral foundation of the geometric formulation of Cooper pairing in the Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. Starting from the large-$N$ bilocal effective action, we derive the Gaussian fluctuation kernel in the even-frequency spin-singlet Cooper channel. Following the construction of Maldacena and Stanford, we determine the kernel eigenvalue $k\left(h\right)$ analytically for arbitrary conformal weight $h$ and resolve the pairing fluctuations into the continuous and discrete sectors of the associated de-Sitter space Laplacian. We show that the superconducting instability and the universal low-energy fluctuations near it reside entirely in the continuous scattering sector, while the discrete modes remain non-critical. Expanding the kernel about the lowest continuum mode yields a Klein--Gordon action on ${\rm dS}_2$, restricted to the continuous spectral subspace. This is precisely the subspace on which the inverse Radon transform to ${\rm AdS}_2$ is well defined. The projected bilocal Cooper-pair field can therefore be mapped onto a scalar matter field propagating in ${\rm AdS}_2$, without requiring any further spectral restriction on the bulk theory. Our results provide the missing microscopic justification for the projection implicit in earlier holographic formulations and clarify how a local bulk field emerges from the bilocal pairing theory.

一句话导读：通过 Yukawa-SYK 的谱分析表明库珀对涨落位于连续谱扇区，并可映射为 AdS2 中的标量场，为全息库珀配对投影提供微观依据。

Emergent States and Algebras from the Double-Scaling limit of Pure States in SYK

Harshit Rajgadia, Jiuci Xu · hep-th, cond-mat.dis-nn, cond-mat.stat-mech · v3 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：近期工作强调了 AdS/CFT 中大 N 极限的一个微妙之处：微观理论中的一列纯态相对于涌现的可观测量代数未必保持纯态。我们研究 SYK 模型双标度极限下的 Kourkoulou-Maldacena (KM) 态中的这一现象，并表明其系综平均的代数描述关键依赖于哪些可观测量在该极限下存活。对于尺度为 N^{1/2} 的费米子算符，一般算符收敛到双标度 SYK 通常的 chord 算符。所得的 von Neumann 代数是标准 Type II_1 因子，且无穷温度下的 KM 纯态收敛到迹态，因此一般探针无法获取微观纯度。随后我们识别出一类适应 KM 态的算符，它们也在双标度极限下存活。由于 KM 态可视为迹态内的一个投影，这些算符成为着装 (dressed) 的 chord 产生湮灭算符。一旦纳入它们，极限代数变为 Type I_∞，极限态变为纯态。这给出了一个具体例子：向涌现代数加入足够适应状态的算符可恢复对底层态纯度的访问。我们进一步表明，着装算符的关联函数具有精确的修正 chord 图规则，推导了未交叉 2n 点函数与交叉四点函数的解析表达式，分析了它们的有限温度半经典与 Schwarzian 极限，研究了对 chord Hamiltonian 的一种形变，该形变产生束缚态并将与 JT 引力加 EOW 膜的对应推广到一般膜张力，并识别出一个涌现 U(1) 对称性及其有限 N 破坏。最后，我们讨论了与为黑洞内部和闭合宇宙提出的边界代数的类比，并给出我们的构造对二者的启示。

English: Recent work has emphasized a subtlety of large- $N$ limits in AdS/CFT: a sequence of pure states in the microscopic theory need not remain pure with respect to the emergent algebra of observables. We study this phenomenon for Kourkoulou-Maldacena (KM) states in the double-scaling limit of the SYK model, and show that their ensemble-averaged algebraic description depends crucially on which observables survive the limit. For fermionic operators of size $N^{1/2}$, generic operators converge to the usual chord operators of double-scaled SYK. The resulting von Neumann algebra is the standard Type II$_1$ factor, and the KM pure states at infinite temperature converge to the tracial state, so generic probes lose access to microscopic purity. We then identify a class of operators adapted to the KM state that also survives the double-scaling limit. Since the KM state may be viewed as a projection inside the tracial state, these become dressed chord creation and annihilation operators. Once included, the limiting algebra becomes Type I$_\infty$ and the limiting state becomes pure. This gives a concrete example in which adding a sufficiently state-adapted operator to the emergent algebra restores access to the purity of the underlying state. We further show that correlators of the dressed operators admit exact modified chord-diagram rules, derive analytic expressions for uncrossed $2n$-point and crossed four-point functions, analyze their finite-temperature semiclassical and Schwarzian limits, study a deformation of the chord Hamiltonian that produces bound states and extends the correspondence with JT gravity plus an EOW brane to general brane tension, and identify an emergent $U(1)$ symmetry together with its finite-$N$ violation. Finally, we discuss analogies with boundary algebras proposed for black hole interiors and closed universes, and suggest lessons from our construction for both.

一句话导读：该文在双标度 SYK 中展示 KM 纯态的涌现代数依赖可观测集合：加入适应态的着装 chord 算符后，代数从 Type II1 变为 Type I∞ 并恢复纯态，同时推广 JT+EOW 膜对应。

中文摘要：我们研究了极端带电 BTZ 黑洞近视界区域中带电标量场的不稳定性。极端几何包含由恒定电场支撑的 AdS2×S1 喉区，这会降低标量有效质量，并可能违反 AdS2 的 Breitenlohner--Freedman 界。这确认了极端正常态存在红外不稳定性。随后我们构造了一族邻近的有限温度、完全背反应、无源、无节点带毛黑洞解，从而建立了不稳定模式在其起始点附近的非线性延拓。标量凝聚修改了 Maxwell 场和几何，而更强的引力背反应降低临界温度并抑制凝聚振幅。在临界点附近，凝聚表现出平均场标度。我们还发展了基于电通量屏蔽的近视界有效解释。带毛分支的精确零温端点在此未确定，仍是一个开放问题。

English: We study the instability of a charged scalar field in the near-horizon region of an extremal charged BTZ black hole. The extremal geometry contains an $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times S^1$ throat supported by a constant electric field, which lowers the effective scalar mass and can violate the $\mathrm{AdS}_2$ Breitenlohner--Freedman bound. This identifies an infrared instability of the extremal normal state. We then construct a nearby finite-temperature branch of fully backreacted, source-free, node-free hairy black-hole solutions, thereby establishing the nonlinear continuation of the unstable mode near its onset. The scalar condensate modifies both the Maxwell field and the geometry, while stronger gravitational backreaction lowers the critical temperature and suppresses the condensate amplitude. Near the critical point, the condensate exhibits mean-field scaling. We also develop an effective near-horizon interpretation in terms of electric-flux screening. The exact zero-temperature endpoint of the hairy branch is not determined here and remains an open problem.

近极端带电 BTZ 黑洞的 Schwinger 不稳定性

Schwinger instability for near-extremal charged BTZ black hole

Mendrit Latifi, Kimet Jusufi · hep-th, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：我们研究近极端带电 BTZ 黑洞的近视界区域，其中出现可控的 AdS2×S1 喉道。在此背景下，我们精确求解带电标量场的 Klein-Gordon 方程，确定 BF 界阈值，并计算平均 Schwinger 对产生率；该速率在适当极限下退化为标准半经典公式。该超几何解在解耦的近视界 AdS2 黑洞片中精确成立；在真实外视界施加入射条件后，它在整个可控近极端喉道区域给出产生对平均数的闭式结果。其有限温度依赖仅通过模式频率与霍金温度之比进入，而极端极限再现已知的 AdS2 Schwinger 结果，并具有以曲率修正有效温度表示的精确类热形式。我们还通过在喉道坐标中直接进行 WKB 隧穿分析来计算带电霍金辐射，从而可以清晰比较热贡献与电贡献，并用有效 Unruh 温度确定不稳定性阈值。最后，我们讨论 Schwinger 产生所生成的应力-能量通量如何可能进入广义熵极端性条件，同时将完整背反应和量子极端面分析留待未来工作。

English: We study the near-horizon region of a near-extremal charged BTZ black hole, where a controlled AdS$_2\times S^1$ throat emerges. In this background we solve the Klein-Gordon equation for a charged scalar exactly, identify the BF-bound threshold, and compute the mean Schwinger pair-production rate, which reduces to the standard semiclassical formula in the appropriate limit. The hypergeometric solution is exact within the decoupled near-horizon AdS$_2$ black-hole patch; with ingoing conditions imposed at the true outer horizon, it yields a closed-form mean number of produced pairs throughout the controlled near-extremal throat regime. Its finite-temperature dependence enters only through the ratio of the mode frequency to the Hawking temperature, while the extremal limit reproduces the known AdS$_2$ Schwinger result and admits an exact thermal-like form in terms of curvature-corrected effective temperatures. We also compute charged Hawking emission via a WKB tunneling analysis done directly in throat coordinates, allowing a clean comparison between thermal and electric contributions and fixing the instability threshold in terms of an effective Unruh temperature. Finally, we discuss how the stress-energy flux generated by Schwinger production may enter the generalized-entropy extremality condition, while leaving a complete backreaction and quantum-extremal-surface analysis for future work.

一句话导读：在近极端带电 BTZ 黑洞的 AdS2 喉道中精确求解带电标量 Klein-Gordon 方程，得到 Schwinger 对产生率、带电霍金辐射及不稳定性阈值。

Marcin Postolak · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：本论文研究宇宙暗区的标量场描述，重点为标量-张量宇宙学、暴胀有效场论、精质以及火劫/循环暴胀替代方案。论文首先回顾标量-张量引力理论，从 Brans-Dicke 理论出发推广到一般非最小耦合标量场；特别关注标量场的解读、Jordan 与 Einstein 共形框架之间的关系，以及共形变换在宇宙学中的作用。这为将标量场视为修改物质或额外引力自由度提供了理论基础。第二部分从有效场论角度讨论宇宙暴胀，分析时间平移的自发破缺、绝热扰动的 Goldstone 描述、高维算符、辐射修正和 Planck 压低项，并联系紫外敏感性和 eta 问题。第三部分讨论作为最简单动力学暗能量模型的精质，涉及 tracking、scaling、thawing、freezing 行为，以及 Statefinder 参数、(ω_φ, ω'_φ) 平面和 Om(z) 诊断；DESI DR2 结果被用作考虑超出严格宇宙学常数的时间依赖有效暗能量的动机。最后一部分研究火劫与循环宇宙学，将火劫相视为基于超刚性标量场状态方程的平滑机制，并讨论扰动、非高斯性、张量模、反弹条件、熵产生、测地线不完备性以及按相区分的场空间距离界限。

English: This dissertation investigates scalar field descriptions of the dark sector (of the Universe), with emphasis on scalar-tensor cosmology, inflationary effective field theory, quintessence, and ekpyrotic/cyclic alternatives to inflation. The thesis first reviews scalar-tensor theories of gravity, starting from Brans-Dicke theory and extending to general non-minimally coupled scalar fields. Particular attention is paid to the interpretation of the scalar field, the relation between the Jordan and Einstein conformal frames, and the role of conformal transformations in cosmology. This provides the theoretical basis for treating scalar fields either as modified matter or as additional gravitational degrees of freedom. The second part discusses cosmological inflation from the viewpoint of effective field theory. The spontaneous breaking of time translations, the Goldstone description of adiabatic perturbations, higher-dimensional operators, radiative corrections and Planck-suppressed terms are analyzed in the context of ultraviolet sensitivity and the eta problem. The third part is devoted to quintessence as the simplest dynamical dark energy model. 'Tracking', 'scaling', 'thawing' and 'freezing' behaviors are discussed, together with observational diagnostics such as the statefinder parameters, the $(\omega_{\phi},\omega'_{\phi})$ plane and the $Om(z)$ diagnostic. The DESI DR2 results are used as motivation for considering time-dependent effective dark energy beyond a strict cosmological constant. The final part studies ekpyrotic and cyclic cosmologies. The ekpyrotic phase is analyzed as a smoothing mechanism based on an ultra-stiff scalar field equation of state. Perturbations, non-Gaussianity, tensor modes, bounce conditions, entropy production, geodesic incompleteness and phase-resolved field-space distance bounds are discussed.

一句话导读：一篇综述性学位论文，系统讨论标量-张量宇宙学中作为暗区的标量场：暴胀有效场论、精质暗能量与火劫/循环模型。

迈向 CompactHedron：从微观原理对中子星的限制

Toward the CompactHedron: Bounds on Neutron Stars from Microscopic Principles

Thomas Apostolidis, Alessandro Longo, Borna Salehian, Luca Santoni · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：我们研究因果性与正性对引力物体潮汐 Love 数的影响。我们在点粒子有效场论框架下工作，其中 Love 数对应由曲率张量及其导数构造的算符的 Wilson 系数。为简单起见，我们聚焦四极引力电扇区，它对潮汐形变率给出领头贡献。我们表明，要求潮汐响应是推迟的且在高频衰减，并结合被动性假设，会得到 Love 数的非平凡界限。这些界限在有效理论参数空间中划出允许区域，并适用于任何局域物体。特别地，我们研究它们对中子星的应用。我们计算了动力 Love 数，在频率展开中到四阶，对一组代表性多方和表格中子星状态方程，并表明在低致密 regime，这些界限转化为对恒星第一个振荡模式的约束。重要的是，这些约束在概念上独立于文献中通常施加的稳定性和热力学条件。虽然我们主要关注保守系统，我们也讨论在存在耗散时这些界限如何被修改。我们的结果为从基本原理推导致密天体界限的系统框架奠定基础。

English: We investigate the implications of causality and positivity for the tidal Love numbers of gravitating objects. We work within the framework of point-particle effective field theory, where the Love numbers correspond to the Wilson coefficients of operators constructed from the curvature tensor and its derivatives. For simplicity, we focus on the quadrupolar gravito-electric sector, which provides the leading contribution to tidal deformability. We show that requiring the tidal response to be retarded and to decay at high frequencies, together with the assumption of passivity, leads to nontrivial bounds on the Love numbers. These bounds delineate an allowed region in the parameter space of the effective theory and apply to any localized object. In particular, we study their application to neutron stars. We compute the dynamical Love numbers through fourth order in the frequency expansion for a representative set of polytropic and tabulated neutron-star equations of state and show that, in the low-compactness regime, the bounds translate into constraints on the first oscillation mode of the star. Importantly, these constraints are conceptually independent of the stability and thermodynamic conditions commonly imposed in the literature. While our focus is primarily on conservative systems, we also discuss how the bounds are modified in the presence of dissipation. Our results lay the ground for a systematic framework to derive bounds on compact objects from fundamental principles.

中文摘要：黑洞准正规模（QNMs）提供了洞察黑洞及其产生环境底层结构的窗口。QNMs 在超越广义相对论的耦合系统中具有特别丰富的动力学，其中已知会发生避免交叉、共振激发和模式重联。近期工作表明，重联的 QNM 轨迹可以在复频率平面上描绘出独特的双螺旋结构。在本工作中，我们在扰动 dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) 理论的具体模型以及一个最小玩具模型中研究这一现象学。在前者中，我们刻画了若干扰动参数取值下的例外点、避免交叉和重联，并发现双螺旋端点的极限频率与扰动强度无关。我们计算了激发因子，发现它们遵循标量与引力模式之间共振的特征标度。为确定这些现象是否依赖于 dCS 的具体特征，我们构建了一个具有方势垒的耦合自由度玩具模型，并发现可以重现避免交叉和重联，表明这些现象可以在耦合系统中更普遍地发生，并且对系统参数高度敏感。

English: Black hole quasinormal modes (QNMs) provide a window into the underlying structure of black holes and the environments in which they arise. QNMs have particularly rich dynamics in coupled systems beyond general relativity, in which they are known to undergo avoided crossings, resonant excitation, and mode reconnections. Recent work has shown that reconnecting QNM trajectories can trace out a distinctive double spiral structure in the complex frequency plane. In this work, we study this phenomenology in a concrete model of perturbed dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) theory, as well as in a minimal toy model. In the former, we characterize the exceptional points, avoided crossings and reconnections for several values of the perturbation parameters, and find that the limiting frequency of the double spiral endpoints is independent of the perturbation strength. We compute the excitation factors and find that they follow the scaling characteristic of a resonance between the scalar and gravitational modes. To determine whether these phenomena depend on the specific features of dCS, we construct a toy model of coupled degrees of freedom with square potential barriers, and find that we can reproduce the avoided crossings and reconnections, indicating that these phenomena can occur more generally in coupled systems and are highly sensitive to the system parameters.

Reza Ebadi, Surjeet Rajendran · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.IM, hep-ph, hep-th, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：利用内太阳系检验质量探测低频段（10 nHz 至 1 微赫兹）引力波，受到小行星带产生的牛顿引力梯度噪声（GGN）的严重限制。本文提出一种新的探测概念，利用引力波的相对论本性来打破信号与小行星 GGN 背景之间的简并。小行星的非相对论运动主要产生引力电场，其引力磁场分量受到速度压低。相对论性引力波产生的引力电场与引力磁场分量大小相等。我们提出利用检验质量的洛伦兹加速度来探测低频引力波的引力磁场分量。由于预期的低频引力波天体物理源的特征应变显著高于通常在高频段预期的应变，对这种洛伦兹加速度的测量在计量学上是可行的。我们表明，在三卫星星座中，这一测量允许从引力梯度噪声中无歧义地提取引力波信号。引力磁场测量仍需要一个与非引力噪声良好隔离的检验质量。我们提出使用原子干涉仪作为这样一种纯净的惯性参考。

English: The detection of gravitational waves in the low-frequency band (10 nHz to 1 micro-Hz) using inner solar system proof masses is severely limited by Newtonian gravity gradient noise (GGN) sourced by the asteroid belt. In this paper, we propose a novel detection concept that exploits the relativistic nature of gravitational waves to break the degeneracy between the signal and the asteroid GGN background. The non-relativistic motion of asteroids dominantly sources gravito-electric fields, with velocity suppressed gravito-magnetic components. Relativistic gravitational waves produce gravito-electric and gravito-magnetic components of equal magnitude. We propose detecting the gravito-magnetic component of low frequency gravitational waves using the Lorentz acceleration of test bodies. The measurement of this Lorentz acceleration is metrologically possible due to the fact that expected astrophysical sources of low frequency gravitational waves have considerably higher characteristic strains than the strains typically expected at higher frequencies. We show that this measurement allows for unambiguous extraction of the gravitational wave signal from the gravity gradient noise in a three satellite constellation. The gravito-magnetic measurement still requires a proof mass that is well isolated from non-gravitational noise. We propose the use of atom interferometers to serve as such a pristine inertial reference.

中文摘要：我们研究了f(Q,B)引力标量表示中的余维一厚膜世界，其中Q是非度量标量，B是满足R=Q-B的边界项。我们将引力部分用两个辅助标量场φ=f_Q和ψ=f_B以及通过Legendre变换从f(Q,B)函数得到的相互作用势U(φ,ψ)来表示。在重合规范下，假设具有四维Poincaré对称性的五维翘曲几何，我们推导了由正则体标量场作为源的完整膜方程。为实现目标，我们处理了两个具有局域标量剖面的光滑渐近AdS厚膜模型。此外，我们还分析了张量扰动，并证明了无质量引力子的局域化和稳定性。

English: One examines a codimension-one thick braneworld in the scalar representation of $f(Q,B)$ gravity, where $Q$ is the nonmetricity scalar, and $B$ is the boundary term satisfying $R=Q-B$. We write the gravitational sector in terms of two auxiliary scalar fields, $\varphi=f_Q$ and $\psi=f_B$, and an interaction potential $U(\varphi,\psi)$ obtained by a Legendre transformation from the $f(Q,B)$ function. Working in the coincident gauge and assuming a five-dimensional warped geometry with four-dimensional Poincar\'e symmetry, we derive the complete set of brane equations sourced by a canonical bulk scalar field. To accomplish our purpose, we address two models of smooth asymptotically AdS thick brane with localized scalar profiles. Furthermore, we also analyze tensor perturbations and demonstrate the localization and stability of the massless graviton.

Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov 虫洞的极向度规/轴向规范微扰

Polar-metric/axial-gauge perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov wormhole

Abhishake Sadhukhan · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：我们研究了 Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov (MMP) 可穿越虫洞的线性微扰。在磁荷背景上，极向度规微扰与规范场的轴向微扰耦合。我们处理该扇区，将其约化为两个 Zerilli-Moncrief 型耦合主方程。该虫洞有两个区域。在口部，几何是近乎极端的磁 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞，没有量子源。在喉部，带电费米子最低朗道能级的 Casimir 能量维持虫洞开放。我们表明，只有当费米子对微扰有响应时，喉部方程才自洽；该响应由二维共形反常精确计算，使用包含 MMP 所丢弃迹部分的完整应力张量。该响应必须伴随费米子的诱导霍尔电流。将两种效应都包括后，线性化 Bianchi 恒等式在费米子反作用 α 的一阶成立。若从费米子有效作用量推导霍尔电流，则需要一个系数为 c/48π 的 Euler 项，它成为磁通与曲率之间的耦合，类似 Wen-Zee 项。在 α=0 时，喉部是精确的 AdS2×S2，模式解耦为两个 Pöschl-Teller 问题，质量分别为 l(l-1) 和 (l+1)(l+2)，频率间隔为 1/ℓ。我们以闭合形式给出 O(α) 修正。它们混合两个模式并依赖频率，且在重叠区域与口部匹配。势的对称部分在整个虫洞中为正，排除了纯指数增长。这些修正降低正常频率，并分裂两个模式共享的能级，在一阶 α 有实位移。在此阶，该扇区对 l≥2 没有增长模式。

English: We study linear perturbations of the Maldacena-Milekhin-Popov (MMP) traversable wormhole. On a magnetically charged background, polar metric perturbations couple to axial perturbations of the gauge field. We treat this sector and reduce it to two coupled master equations of Zerilli-Moncrief type. The wormhole has two regions. In the mouths the geometry is a nearly extremal magnetic Reissner-Nordstrom black hole with no quantum source. In the throat the Casimir energy of the lowest Landau level of charged fermions holds the wormhole open. We show that the throat equations are consistent only if the fermions respond to the perturbation, computed exactly from the two-dimensional conformal anomaly with the full stress tensor including the trace part that MMP discard. This response must be accompanied by an induced Hall current of the fermions. With both effects included, the linearised Bianchi identities hold at first order in the fermionic backreaction $\alpha$. Deriving the Hall current from the fermion effective action instead requires an Euler term with coefficient $c/48\pi$, which becomes a coupling between magnetic flux and curvature similar to a Wen-Zee term. At $\alpha=0$ the throat is exact AdS$_2\times S^2$ and the modes decouple into two Poschl-Teller problems with masses $l(l-1)$ and $(l+1)(l+2)$, with levels spaced by $1/\ell$ in frequency. We give the $O(\alpha)$ corrections in closed form. They mix the two modes and depend on frequency, and match the mouths in the overlap region. The symmetric part of the potential is positive throughout the wormhole, excluding purely exponential growth. The corrections lower the normal frequencies and split the levels shared by the two modes, with real shifts at first order in $\alpha$. This sector has no growing mode for $l\ge2$ at this order.

中文摘要：我们研究了在 Sasaki-Einstein 五维流形 Y^{p,q}（尤其关注锥形底 T^{1,1}）上 IIB 型超引力一致截断中，环绕 AdS5 黑洞的各类探测 D-膜的有效势。这些探针要么是支撑在 AdS 时空维度上的对偶巨引力子，要么是包裹内部流形不可收缩闭链的 D3 探测膜，后者在 AdS 时空中表现为“点状”。T^{1,1} 和 Y^{p,q} 的不可收缩闭链从拓扑上把膜稳定在有限尺寸；我们在 Gutowski-Reall 黑洞上找到稳定的超对称包裹 D3 膜，从而在 AdS5 中有效提供了一个由黑洞及其周围重子凝聚体组成的稳定 BPS 复合系统。我们表明，黑洞背景中超辐射的开始与探测有效势中稳定极小值的出现相匹配，从而扩展了 Dual Dressed Black Holes 与 Grey Galaxies 的构造。我们还评论了该结果与近期关于经典上同调问题以及相关偶然态在对偶的 Klebanov-Witten 理论中研究的关联。

English: We study the effective potentials for various probe D-branes surrounding AdS$_5$ black holes in consistent truncations of type IIB supergravity on Sasaki-Einstein 5-manifolds $Y^{p,q}$, focusing in particular on the conifold base $T^{1,1}$. The probes are either dual Giant Gravitons having support on AdS spacetime dimensions or D3 probe branes wrapped on non-contractible cycles of the internal manifold, which then appear "point-like" in the AdS spacetime. The non-contractible cycles of $T^{1,1}$ and $Y^{p,q}$ topologically stabilize the branes at a finite size, and we find stable supersymmetric wrapped D3 branes on Gutowski-Reall black holes, effectively providing a stable BPS composite system in AdS$_5$ made by a black hole surrounded by a baryonic condensate. We show that the onset of superradiance in the black hole backgrounds matches the emergence of stable minima in the probe effective potentials, extending the constructions of Dual Dressed Black Holes and the Grey Galaxies. We comment on the relevance of this result for recent studies concerning the classical cohomology problem and the associated fortuitous states in the dual Klebanov-Witten theory.

中文摘要：我们研究全息 CFT 中的重-重-轻-轻关联函数，其中重算符对偶于局域在远小于 AdS 半径尺度上的致密天体。在长波区域，重态的内部结构由一条世界线有效场论描述，其局域算符编码潮汐 Love 数等有限尺寸响应系数。聚焦弱自引力天体，我们展示由局域重-轻相互作用产生的 Witten 图重组成轻体场有效波动方程的 Born 级数。我们通过求解带局域相互作用的波动方程复现同一关联函数，并确定世界线 Wilson 系数如何编码在 CFT 数据中。我们的结果给出 AdS 中致密天体有限尺寸响应与对偶 CFT 中重-轻和轻-轻复合算符的维度及 OPE 系数之间的直接关系。

English: We study heavy-heavy-light-light correlators in holographic CFTs when the heavy operator is dual to a compact object localized on scales much smaller than the AdS radius. In the long-wavelength regime, the internal structure of the heavy state is described by a worldline effective field theory, whose local operators encode finite-size response coefficients such as tidal Love numbers. Focusing on weakly self-gravitating objects, we show that the Witten diagrams generated by local heavy-light interactions reorganize into the Born series of an effective wave equation for the light bulk field. We reproduce the same correlator by solving this wave equation with localized interactions and identify how the worldline Wilson coefficients are encoded in the CFT data. Our results provide a direct relation between the finite-size response of compact objects in AdS and the dimensions and OPE coefficients of heavy-light and light-light composite operators in the dual CFT.

中文摘要：在一篇姊妹论文中，我们发现，在四边界 AdS3 虫洞的未扭曲点附近，只要完整双部分 Ryu-Takayanagi 熵矢量对 Fenchel-Nielsen 扭曲不敏感，全息 q=4 多熵也不敏感。这里我们表明，在有限扭曲下情况发生变化。扭曲会拉长交叉测地线，从而扩大所有双部分 RT 熵保持不变的区域。在这一扩大区域的一部分中，一个对扭曲敏感的 q=4 网络成为全局最小。因此我们找到虫洞模空间中的一个开区域，其中完整双部分 RT 熵矢量完全不变，而 q=4 多熵探测到扭曲。我们的结果提供了一个显式例子，其中 q=4 真正多熵探测到所有双部分纠缠熵不可见的体几何信息。

English: In a companion paper, we found that near the untwisted point of a four-boundary AdS$_3$ wormhole, whenever the complete bipartite Ryu-Takayanagi entropy vector is insensitive to a Fenchel-Nielsen twist, the holographic $\mathtt q=4$ multi-entropy is insensitive as well. Here we show that the situation changes at finite twist. The twist lengthens the crossing geodesics and thereby enlarges the region in which all bipartite RT entropies remain invariant. In part of this enlarged region, a twist-sensitive $\mathtt q=4$ network becomes globally minimal. We thus find an open region of wormhole moduli space in which the complete bipartite RT entropy vector is exactly unchanged while the $\mathtt q=4$ multi-entropy detects the twist. Our result provides an explicit example in which the $\mathtt q=4$ genuine multi-entropy probes bulk geometric information invisible to all bipartite entanglement entropies.

Norihiro Iizuka · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：我们追问多体纠缠能否探测双体纠缠不可见的体模量。我们在由 Fenchel-Nielsen 扭转 τ 联系的一族显式四边界 AdS₃ 虫洞中研究这个问题，询问完整的一组双体 RT 熵能否保持严格与 τ 无关，而全息 q=4 多熵对扭转敏感。在此分析的一类构型中，对于足够小的 |τ|，我们发现在对称线 ℓ=m 上不存在这样的区域：全局最小的 q=4 网络本身在整个所分析参数范围内严格与 τ 无关。这个结论并非先验显然：它来自若干允许构型之间的竞争，这些构型的相对排序随着几何变化而多次改变，并持续到双体 RT 熵自身变得对扭转敏感之处。

English: We ask whether multipartite entanglement can probe bulk moduli invisible to bipartite entanglement. We study this question in an explicit family of four-boundary AdS$_3$ wormholes related by a Fenchel-Nielsen twist $\tau$, asking whether the complete set of bipartite RT entropies can remain exactly $\tau$-independent while the holographic $\mathtt q=4$ multi-entropy is sensitive to the twist. Within the class of configurations analyzed here, for sufficiently small $|\tau|$, we find no such regime along the symmetric line $\ell=m$: the globally minimal $\mathtt q=4$ network is itself exactly $\tau$-independent throughout the parameter range analyzed. This conclusion is not a priori obvious: it emerges from a competition among several admissible configurations whose relative ordering changes multiple times as the geometry is varied, and persists up to the point where the bipartite RT entropies themselves become twist-sensitive.

English: Coleman--De Luccia tunneling can exhibit an infinite tower of rapidly oscillating negative modes, complicating the semiclassical evaluation of the path integral. Treating the bounce and the false vacuum in the same well-defined gauge and with a common regulator, we find that their high-frequency negative spectra approach one another. Assuming linear closure and normalizing the global modes to reproduce the geometric AdS isometries, covariance and the Jacobi identities uniquely determine the soft-mode bracket. The result is the wedge of $\mathcal L_\Lambda w_{1+\infty}$, where $\Lambda=-\ell^{-2}$. Global symmetries of the bulk anyons can emerge after the average, as T-dualities relating different theories in the ensemble are "folded" into symmetries of a single theory (duality origami). We discuss the relation to the Swampland program, including the emergence of global symmetries at infinite distance. Finally, we recast strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) of mixed states as an emergence of symmetries in ensemble averages; in holography, wormholes connecting the two sides of a thermofield-double construction provide its bulk realization. This motivates a new Swampland conjecture.

一句话导读：综述：理论系综平均（如全息中的 Narain CFT 系综）可涌现全局对称性，并联系 T-对偶折纸、Swampland 与混合态 SWSSB 的虫洞实现。

We construct an asymptotically flat phase space of conformal gravity in which both types of Carroll-Weyl transformations and local Carroll boosts admit finite, integrable, and generically nonvanishing canonical charges, and derive their centrally extended algebra. Finally, we show that these central extensions arise from boundary anomalies through symplectic descent, yielding a gravitational prediction for Carroll-Weyl anomalies in flat holography.

Bao-An Li, Xavier Grundler · astro-ph.HE, hep-ph, nucl-ex, nucl-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：我们研究未来高精度中子星（NS）半径测量如何编码致密物质状态方程（EOS）的微观信息，重点关注可能的一阶强子-夸克相变及其导致的质径拓扑。在贝叶斯框架下，使用含九个微观参数的元模型EOS，我们分析了对典型中子星的模拟半径测量 R_{1.4}=11.9\pm\sigma_R km，其中 \sigma_R=0.9 和 0.1 km。我们通过研究每个EOS参数的条件均值作为模型预言的典型半径 R_{1.4} 的函数，引入逆EOS-半径映射。其斜率度量EOS参数对半径的敏感度，而曲率通过Jensen展开决定其后验均值对精度的主导依赖。对称能参数 L（斜率）和 K_sym（曲率）被强烈编码在 R_{1.4} 中，且其后验均值随半径精度提高而显著移动，而更高阶强子参数表现出更强的拓扑依赖性。在相变参数中，相变密度 \rho_t 最强烈地编码在 R_{1.4} 中，而能量密度跳变和夸克物质声速与完整质径序列的拓扑更密切相关。由于不同拓扑的 R_{1.4} 分布强烈重叠，即使精确的半径测量本身也不能识别拓扑或唯一确定高密度相变性质。这些结果为评估未来高精度半径测量和高密度NS EOS互补探针的科学回报提供了参数依赖的层级。

English: We investigate how future high-precision neutron star (NS) radius measurements encode microscopic information about the dense-matter equation of state (EOS), focusing on a possible first-order hadron--quark phase transition and the resulting mass--radius topology. Within a Bayesian framework using meta-model EOSs with nine microscopic parameters, we analyze mock radius measurements $R_{1.4}=11.9\pm\sigma_R$ km with $\sigma_R=0.9$ and $0.1$ km for canonical NSs. We introduce inverse EOS--radius mappings by studying the conditional mean of each EOS parameter as a function of the model-predicted canonical radius $R_{1.4}$. Their slope measures the sensitivity of an EOS parameter to the radius, while their curvature determines the leading precision dependence of its posterior mean through the Jensen expansion. The symmetry-energy parameters $L$ (slope) and $K_{\rm sym}$ (curvature) are strongly encoded in $R_{1.4}$ and their posterior means shift appreciably with improved radius precision, whereas the higher-order hadronic parameters show stronger topology dependence. Among the transition parameters, the transition density $\rho_t$ is the most strongly encoded in $R_{1.4}$, while the energy-density jump and quark-matter sound speed are more strongly associated with the topology of the full mass--radius sequence. Since the different topologies have strongly overlapping $R_{1.4}$ distributions, even precise radius measurements cannot by themselves identify the topology or uniquely determine the high-density transition properties. These results provide a parameter-dependent hierarchy for assessing the scientific return of future high-precision radius measurements and complementary probes of high-density NS EOS.

我们从 NICER 关于中子星半径中学到了什么

M. C. Miller · astro-ph.HE, nucl-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：中子星核心所具有的密度、温度以及中子-质子不对称性的组合，无法在实验室中复制，也无法用第一性原理量子色动力学理解。因此，观测中子星对于理解这一区域是必要的。特别是，对中子星半径的精确测量，对于了解几倍核饱和密度下的冷催化物质极具信息量。NASA 的中子星内部组成探测器（NICER）的 X 射线观测已给出若干非吸积中子星的半径测量，这大大推进了我们对致密物质的理解。在这篇综述中，我们讨论 NICER 的半径测量及其启示，并表明迄今在 NICER 分析中探索的系统误差对推断出的中子星半径至多只有次要影响。

English: The cores of neutron stars have a combination of density, temperature, and neutron-proton asymmetry that cannot be replicated in laboratories or understood using first-principles quantum chromodynamics. Thus, observations of neutron stars are necessary to understand this regime. In particular, precise and accurate measurements of neutron star radii are highly informative about cold, catalyzed matter at a few times nuclear saturation density. X-ray observations with NASA's Neutron star Interior Composition Explorer (NICER) have yielded radius measurements for a few nonaccreting neutron stars, which have advanced substantially our understanding of dense matter. In this review we discuss the NICER radius measurements and their implications and demonstrate that the systematic errors thus far explored in NICER analyses have at most a minor effect on the inferred radii of neutron stars.

中文摘要：我们利用当前多信使观测研究中子星中混合有排斥性自相互作用玻色暗物质（DM）的情形。暗物质成分被建模为复标量场，仅通过引力与重子物质耦合，从而允许暗核与暗晕位形。为量化重子状态方程（EOS）不确定性，我们将对 (mχ, λ, Fχ) 的三维扫描与 27 个基于 DDME2 的协变密度泛函 EOS 相结合，这些 EOS 覆盖 L_sym=30、50、70 MeV 以及 -600≤Q_sat≤1000 MeV。在贝叶斯框架中，将这些模型与来自 Amsterdam 和 Maryland/Illinois 分析的 NICER 质量—半径测量以及 GW170817 潮汐形变约束进行对比。在对 EOS 系综进行贝叶斯证据加权后，对于两个 NICER 数据集，与 EOS 相关的暗部门标度 μχ≡mχ/λ^{1/4} 被局域在 250 MeV 附近。在 (mχ, λ) 参数化中，边缘化后的玻色子质量后验峰值位于 mχ≃300–330 MeV，而 λ 仍呈宽分布。由于玻色 EOS 仅通过 μχ 依赖于 mχ 和 λ，它们各自单独的边缘分布以所采用的独立先验为条件。推断出的暗物质分数更依赖于数据集，Maryland/Illinois 的后验众数接近 4%，Amsterdam 接近 12%。玻色暗物质还将推断出的 Q_sat 从负值移向中间值和正值，而 L_sym 的响应较弱。这表明在暗物质诱导的致密化与重子物质的高密度刚度之间存在模型相关的权衡。这些约束仍以所选 EOS 族以及所有源具有共同有效 Fχ 的假设为条件。

English: We investigate neutron stars admixed with repulsively self-interacting bosonic dark matter (DM) using current multi-messenger observations. The dark component is modeled as a complex scalar field coupled to baryonic matter only through gravity, allowing dark-core and dark-halo configurations. To quantify baryonic equation-of-state (EOS) uncertainties, we combine a three-dimensional scan over $(m_\chi,\lambda,F_\chi)$ with 27 DDME2-based covariant density-functional EOSs spanning $L_{\rm sym}=30,50,70$ MeV and $-600\le Q_{\rm sat}\le 1000$ MeV. The models are confronted in a Bayesian framework with NICER mass--radius measurements from the Amsterdam and Maryland/Illinois analyses and the GW170817 tidal-deformability constraint. After Bayesian evidence weighting over the EOS ensemble, the EOS-relevant dark-sector scale $\mu_\chi\equiv m_\chi/\lambda^{1/4}$ is localized around 250 MeV for both NICER data sets. In the $(m_\chi,\lambda)$ parameterization, the marginalized boson-mass posterior peaks at $m_\chi\simeq300$--$330$ MeV, while $\lambda$ remains broadly distributed. Since the bosonic EOS depends on $m_\chi$ and $\lambda$ only through $\mu_\chi$, their separate marginals are conditional on the adopted independent priors. The inferred DM fraction is more data-set dependent, with posterior modes near 4% for Maryland/Illinois and 12% for Amsterdam. Bosonic DM also shifts the inferred $Q_{\rm sat}$ from negative toward intermediate and positive values, whereas the response of $L_{\rm sym}$ is weaker. This indicates a model-dependent trade-off between DM-induced compactification and the high-density stiffness of baryonic matter. These constraints remain conditional on the selected EOS family and the assumption of a common effective $F_\chi$ for all sources.

超大质量黑洞双星产生的随机引力波背景的高阶统计

Hinano Hisamatsu, Koutarou Kyutoku · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：最近引力波观测的进展使脉冲星计时阵列成为探测纳赫兹频段随机引力波背景的关键工具。人们普遍认为该背景主要来自宇宙中相互旋进的超大质量黑洞双星群体。传统分析主要关注引力波背景的谱振幅和频率依赖性，而方差、偏度和超额峰度等高阶统计量可能有助于提取更多物理信息。然而，已知当红移积分延伸至 z=0 时，这些统计矩会发散。在本研究中，我们提出一种策略，通过引入物理动机的下积分下限 z_min 来解决该问题，该下限由探测单个源的灵敏度定义。由于高阶统计量主要由局部源决定，我们可以在其计算中采用关于红移的最低阶近似。在此近似下，我们证明除期望值外所有高阶统计量仅通过啁啾质量的加权平均 <M^{10/3}> 依赖于质量函数，而与红移演化模型无关。我们表明方差与期望值之比提供了关于 <M^{10/3}>/<M^{5/3}> 的信息，且不依赖于并合总数。我们还发现超额峰度与偏度平方之间的一致性关系，为检验引力波背景的双星起源假设开辟了道路。我们的发现表明高阶统计量为解释引力波背景提供了新窗口，提供了一种打破现有简并并改进对质量函数理解的方法。

English: Recent progress in gravitational wave observations has positioned pulsar timing arrays as a key tool for detecting the stochastic gravitational wave background in the nanohertz band. It is widely believed that this background is primarily attributed to the cosmic ensemble of inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries. While traditional analyses have predominantly focused on the spectral amplitude and frequency dependence of the gravitational wave background, higher-order statistics such as variance, skewness, and excess kurtosis could potentially be useful for extracting further physical information. However, these statistical moments are known to diverge when the redshift integration is extended down to z=0. In this study, we propose a strategy to resolve this issue by introducing a physically motivated lower integration limit, z_min, defined by the sensitivity for detecting individual sources. Since higher-order statistics are primarily determined by local sources, we may adopt the lowest-order approximation with respect to redshift in their computations. Under this approximation, we demonstrate that all higher-order statistics beyond the expectation value depend on the mass function only through a weighted average of the chirp mass, <\mathcal{M}^{10/3}>, irrespective of the redshift evolution model. We show that the ratio of the variance to the expectation value provides information on <\mathcal{M}^{10/3}>/<\mathcal{M}^{5/3}> independently of the total number of mergers. We also find a consistency relation between the excess kurtosis and the squared skewness, paving the way for testing the binary-origin hypothesis of the gravitational wave background. Our findings demonstrate that higher-order statistics provide a new window for interpreting the gravitational wave background, offering a methodology to break existing degeneracies and refine our understanding of the mass function.

English: Transient orbital resonances can introduce phase-dependent corrections to the evolution of extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs), potentially altering their long-term dynamics and emitted gravitational-wave signals. In this work, we quantify the resonance-induced modifications to the energy, axial angular momentum, and Carter constant fluxes and compute the corresponding resonance coefficients across a broad region of the orbital parameter space. Using the publicly available $\texttt{pybhpt}$ code, we solve the Teukolsky equation in the frequency domain to coherently combine the degenerate radial and polar harmonics that arise at resonance. We analytically derive a selection rule governing the relative radial-polar phase dependence of the resonant flux modifications. We argue that the relative strength of the resonant flux modifications reflects a balance between symmetry-induced cancellations and the degree to which the resonant orbit samples the underlying two-dimensional orbital phase space. For the dynamically important $3{:}2$ and $2{:}1$ resonances, we also characterize how the resonance coefficients vary with the primary black-hole spin, orbital eccentricity and inclination. Our results constitute the largest set of Teukolsky-based resonance coefficients calculated to date and provide essential input for future studies of transient orbital resonances in EMRIs.

中文摘要：我们刻画了幺模引力（UG）中的可穿越虫洞，并研究它们与广义相对论（GR）对应物的区别。对于一类静态球对称解，我们分析其嵌入和类时测地线，表明测地线结构完全由度规决定，因此在两种理论中相同。为识别其差异的物理起源，我们比较维持同一虫洞几何所需的源扇区。我们发现，在保持固定 UG 几何的同时施加能量-动量守恒，需要限制状态方程，而放宽该条件则引入一种有效非均匀真空贡献。我们进一步表明，即使能量-动量不守恒，奇异性的程度仍然保持，而对 GR 扇区的偏离编码在有效非均匀真空结构中，其渐近行为类似宇宙学常数。我们的结果强化了 UG 在几何上等价于 GR，而其独特特征出现在源扇区的动力学解释中。更一般地，我们的分析表明，不同引力理论可以产生相同的时空几何，但需要不同的源来维持它们。

English: We characterize traversable wormholes in Unimodular Gravity (UG) and investigate what distinguishes them from their General Relativistic (GR) counterparts. For a class of static and spherically symmetric solutions, we analyze their embedding and timelike geodesics, showing that the geodesic structure is entirely determined by the metric and is therefore identical in both theories. To identify the physical origin of their differences, we compare the source sectors required to sustain the same wormhole geometry. We find that preserving a fixed UG geometry while imposing energy-momentum conservation requires restricting the equation of state, whereas relaxing this condition introduces an effective inhomogeneous vacuum contribution. We further show that the degree of exoticity is preserved even when energy-momentum is not conserved, while departures from the GR sector are encoded in an effective inhomogeneous vacuum structure whose asymptotic behavior resembles that of a cosmological constant. Our results reinforce that UG is geometrically equivalent to GR, while its distinctive features emerge in the dynamical interpretation of the source sector. More generally, our analysis illustrates that different gravitational theories may give rise to identical spacetime geometries while requiring different sources to sustain them.

A Physical space derivation of Morawetz-Energy estimates in Kerr spacetimes with large angular momentum

Lili He, Sergiu Klainerman · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：我们重新审视 Kerr 时空 K(a,m) 外通讯域中标量波动方程的 Morawetz 能量估计推导。目标是发展稳健的物理空间方法，以便推广到 Kerr 的实际扰动。证明依赖若干要素。首先，我们推导条件 Morawetz 估计，通过利用全 r 范围内陷获零测地线的物理空间刻画，扩展 Andersson-Blue 开创、后经 GKS 适配到慢转 Kerr 扰动的物理空间技术。其次，我们使用 Stogin 在轴对称情形引入的想法处理 Morawetz 估计中的低频困难。在一般情形，低阶项的控制还要求充分利用 Morawetz 体范数中的主陷获项，并新用 Hardy 型不等式。一个关键新要素是控制 Morawetz 估计产生的边界项。我们以姊妹篇 [He-K2] 的结果为输入，该结果基于 seminal Whiting 变换的纯物理空间版本给出频率无关的通量估计。最后，连续性论证给出无条件整体时间 Morawetz 估计，同时通过构造在陷获集上为 Killing 的因果向量场得到新的能量估计。在这个新版本中，我们增加了一个更简单的新证明，覆盖整个次极值情形。这里证明的结果限于自旋 0 的标量波动方程，且 |a|/m≤0.75。我们预期这一限制是技术性的，本文发展的方法可推广到 Teukolsky 方程。

English: We revisit the derivation of Morawetz-energy estimates for scalar wave equations in the domain of outer communication of a Kerr spacetime $\KK(a,m)$. Our goal is to develop robust physical space methods which are well suited for extension to realistic perturbations of Kerr. The proof rests on several ingredients. First, we derive conditional Morawetz estimates which extend the physical space techniques initiated by Andersson and Blue \cite{AB}, and later adapted in \cite{GKS} to perturbations of slowly rotating Kerr, by exploiting a physical-space characterization of the full $r$-range of trapped null geodesics. Second, we use an idea introduced by Stogin \cite{St} in the axially symmetric case to handle the low-frequency difficulties in the Morawetz estimates. In the general case, the control of the lower order terms also requires making full use of the principal trapping term in the Morawetz bulk norm, together with a new use of Hardy-type inequalities. A crucial new ingredient is the control of the boundary terms generated by the Morawetz estimates. We use as input the results of our companion paper \cite{He-K2}, which provides a frequency independent estimate for the flux based on a purely physical space version of the seminal Whiting transform \cite{W}. Finally, a continuity argument yields an unconditional global-in-time Morawetz estimate, while a new energy estimate is obtained from the construction of a causal vectorfield which is Killing on the trapping set. In this new version we have added a new, much simpler, proof which covers the full subextremal case. The results proved here are restricted to scalar wave equations, corresponding to spin $0$, in the range $|a|/m\leq 0.75$. We expect this restriction to be technical, and the methods developed in this paper to extend to the Teukolsky equation.

一句话导读：用纯物理空间方法在 Kerr 外通讯域中证明标量波方程的条件与整体 Morawetz 能量估计，覆盖 |a|/m≤0.75 的次极值 Kerr。

无碰撞暗物质尖峰的耗竭

The Depletion of Collisionless Dark Matter Spikes

Charlie Sharpe, Yonadav Barry Ginat, Thomas F. M. Spieksma, Alexander Heger, Bence Kocsis · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.HE · v2 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：黑洞周围的高密度暗物质聚集为探测暗物质本质提供了有吸引力的机会。在经典的 Gondolo--Silk 模型中，大质量黑洞在暗物质尖峰中的绝热生长会产生陡峭的密度尖峰（ρ ∝ r^{-7/3}），并可能在中等质量比旋进（IMRIs）和极端质量比旋进（EMRIs）中引起可测量的引力波退相干。我们通过考虑嵌入真实核星团中的无碰撞暗物质尖峰来挑战这一范式。利用各向同性核星团的 Fokker--Planck 模型，我们表明多质量恒星尖峰中的质量分层会加速弛豫，相对于单质量模型，从而在 1 Gyr 内将暗物质驱动到较低密度的 r^{-3/2} Bahcall--Wolf 轮廓。在内区，Fokker--Planck 描述失效，我们用后牛顿三体模拟来建模暗物质粒子与 EMRI 之间的强三体相互作用。我们表明，EMRI 通过引力弹弓效应抛射暗物质粒子，在几 Gyr 内耗竭内区尖峰。由于 EMRI 数密度太低，不足以驱动两体弛豫，而暗物质自弛豫的补充又可忽略，这种耗竭是不可逆的。虽然 EMRI 引起的暗物质耗竭程度取决于 EMRI 速率和质量，我们发现密度降低可达几个数量级。因此，对于 z = 3（2.14 Gyr）、质量 ≲ 10^5 M⊙ 的大质量黑洞（对应低 O(10) Gyr^{-1} 的 EMRI 速率），EMRI 的暗物质诱导退相干可能低于 LISA 可探测阈值；对于更现实的 O(100-300) Gyr^{-1} 速率，这一质量上限可扩展到 ≲ 10^6 M⊙。我们的发现大幅缩小了大质量黑洞能够承载可探测无碰撞暗物质尖峰的参数空间。

English: Dense concentrations of dark matter surrounding black holes provide a compelling opportunity to probe the nature of dark matter. In the classic Gondolo--Silk model, the adiabatic growth of a massive black hole in a dark matter cusp produces a steep density spike ($\rho \propto r^{-7/3}$), potentially inducing measurable gravitational-wave dephasings in intermediate and extreme mass-ratio inspirals (IMRIs/EMRIs). We challenge this paradigm by considering a collisionless dark matter spike embedded in a realistic nuclear star cluster. Using Fokker--Planck models of isotropic nuclear clusters, we show that mass segregation in a multi-mass stellar cusp accelerates relaxation relative to single-mass models, thereby driving the dark matter to the lower density $r^{-3/2}$ Bahcall--Wolf profile within 1 Gyr. In the inner regions, where the Fokker--Planck description breaks down, we model strong triple interactions between dark matter particles and EMRIs using post-Newtonian 3-body simulations. We show that EMRIs eject dark matter particles via gravitational slingshots, depleting the inner spike over a few Gyr. Because EMRI number densities are too low to drive two-body relaxation, and replenishment by DM self-relaxation is negligible, this depletion is irreversible. While the extent of EMRI-induced DM depletion depends on the EMRI rate and mass, we find reductions in densities by several orders of magnitude. As a result, the dark-matter-induced dephasings for EMRIs may fall below the LISA detectability threshold for massive black holes at $z = 3$ (2.14 Gyr) with masses $\lesssim 10^{5}\,M_\odot$ (for a low $\mathcal{O}(10) \, \mathrm{Gyr}^{-1}$ EMRI rate), extending to $\lesssim 10^6\,M_\odot$ for more realistic rates of $\mathcal{O}(100 - 300)\,$Gyr$^{-1}$. Our findings substantially reduce the parameter space over which massive black holes can host detectable collisionless dark matter spikes.

一句话导读：多质量核星团弛豫与 EMRI 引力弹弓会不可逆地耗竭黑洞周围的无碰撞暗物质尖峰，从而大幅压低 LISA 可探测的暗物质诱导引力波退相干参数空间。

相关度：medium — 不属于 AdS/CFT 或全息理论；主要涉及经典引力/黑洞天体物理、暗物质尖峰与 EMRI 引力波退相干，因此与“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关，但与全息研究无直接关系。

DHOST 理论中的慢转黑洞

Slowly rotating Black Holes in DHOST Theories

Hugo Candan, Karim Noui, David Langlois · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：我们在退化高阶标量张量（DHOST）理论中研究慢转黑洞解。从某一 DHOST 理论的静态球对称度规解出发，采用 Hartle-Thorne 拟设来刻画慢转时空。我们证明，主导参考系拖曳函数 ω（通常假定仅依赖于径向坐标）的微分方程对任意 DHOST 理论均可积，从而使我们能够得到其显式形式。我们还考虑了 ω 对角度方向的依赖，并证明与广义相对论一样，视界处和无穷远处的正则性会排除这种依赖。作为本文所引入形式体系的例证，我们研究了近期获得的带原生毛（primary hair）黑洞解的慢转版本，考察转动对最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）以及赤道面上圆型光线轨迹的影响。

English: We study slowly rotating black hole solutions within Degenerate Higher Order Scalar Tensor (DHOST) theories. Starting from a static, spherically symmetric metric solution of a DHOST theory, we employ the Hartle-Thorne ansatz to model a slowly rotating spacetime. We show that the differential equation governing the frame-dragging function $\omega$ (which is supposed to depend on the radial coordinate only) is integrable for any DHOST theory allowing us to obtain its explicit form. We also consider angular dependence in $\omega$ and show that regularity at the horizon and at infinity forbids it, as in General Relativity. As an illustration of the formalism introduced here, we study the slowly-rotating version of black hole solutions with primary hair obtained recently, examining the influence of the rotation on the Innermost Stable Circular Orbit (ISCO) and on the circular light trajectories in the equatorial plane.

一句话导读：在 DHOST 理论中构造慢转黑洞解，证明参考系拖曳方程可积，并分析转动对 ISCO 与赤道光测地线的影响。

从恒星到波：微引力透镜引力波的随机推断

From Stars to Waves: Stochastic Inference of Microlensed Gravitational Waves

Zhaoqi Su, Xikai Shan, Zhenwei Lyu, Junyao Zhang, Yebin Liu, Shude Mao, Huan Yang · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE · v3 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：当强透镜引力波穿过透镜星系的恒星场时，视线方向上恒星和恒星遗迹的引力微透镜会给它们带来额外的相位和振幅调制。这些微透镜波形依赖于成千上万乃至更多最相关恒星的质量和位置，而这些恒星对于波光学衍射积分的数值收敛是必需的，因此从数据中确定性地重构它们计算量过大。我们将此类事件的探测和参数估计表述为随机推断问题，并提出用归一化流实现的解决方案。作为原理验证，我们使用推断出的代理微透镜参数来识别微透镜特征，并表明对于源红移 z_s ≤ 2，第三代引力波探测器网络可以以 ≥3σ 显著性探测到 10.2% 的微透镜事件。代理参数与 underlying stellar field 密度之间的相关性进一步将微透镜探测与透镜星系性质联系起来。该方法为探测微透镜效应及其 underlying stellar fields 的性质打开了大门。除了微透镜引力波之外，类似构造还可应用于其他本质随机的推断问题，例如探测双中子星并合后引力波以及核心坍缩超新星信号。

English: When strongly lensed gravitational waves pass through the stellar field of a lensing galaxy, they acquire additional phase and amplitude modulations from gravitational microlensing by stars and stellar remnants along the line of sight. These microlensed waveforms depend on the masses and positions of thousands or more of the most relevant stars required for numerical convergence of the wave-optics diffraction integral, so that their deterministic reconstruction from the data is computationally prohibitive. We formulate the detection and parameter estimation of such events as a stochastic inference problem and propose a solution with the implementation of normalizing flows. As a proof of principle, we use the inferred surrogate microlensing parameters to identify microlensing signatures and show that 10.2% of microlensed events can be detected at $\ge 3\sigma$ significance with third-generation gravitational-wave detector networks for source redshifts $z_s \le 2$. The correlation between the surrogate parameters and the density of the underlying stellar field further connects microlensing detection to the properties of the lensing galaxy. This approach opens the door to probing microlensing effects and the properties of the underlying stellar fields. Beyond microlensed gravitational waves, a similar construction may also be applied to other intrinsically stochastic inference problems, such as detecting post-merger gravitational waves from binary neutron star coalescence and signals from core-collapse supernovae.

一句话导读：用归一化流对恒星微透镜调制的强透镜引力波进行随机推断，并评估第三代探测器识别微透镜信号的能力。

相关度：high — 论文研究经典引力波在星系恒星场中的微引力透镜效应及随机推断，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，不涉及全息对偶。

含质量转移与自旋修正的旋进致密双星后牛顿轨道演化与引力波波形

Post-Newtonian orbital evolution and gravitational wave forms of inspiralling compact binaries with mass transfer and spin corrections

Yifan He, Jie Yang · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：在本文中，我们关注双星之间的质量转移和恒星自旋对致密双星系统后牛顿（PN）轨道演化和引力波形的影响。我们采用2.5PN近似和质量四极矩公式计算轨道演化和引力波形。在详尽讨论相关天体物理过程后，我们总结了一个一维质量转移模型，统一处理公共包层演化和潮汐瓦解，并推导了通过第一拉格朗日点L1的物质流质量转移率对轨道角速度依赖的近似表达式。进一步，基于微扰开普勒方法，我们提出了一个同时考虑质量转移和恒星自旋修正的致密双星系统轨道演化的二维模型。通过数值模拟，我们研究了具有显著相对论效应的双星系统，即NS-NS（中子星-中子星）、NS-BH（中子星-黑洞）和BH-BH（黑洞-黑洞）系统，并展示了质量转移和自旋修正对这些致密双星系统轨道演化和引力波偏振波形的影响。

English: In this article, we focus on the effects of mass transfer between binary stars and stellar spin on the post-Newtonian (PN) orbital evolution and gravitational waveforms of compact binary systems. We employ the 2.5PN approximation and the mass quadrupole formula to compute the orbital evolution and gravitational waveforms. After an exhaustive discussion of the astrophysical processes relevant to the scenarios of interest, we summarize a one-dimensional mass transfer model that uniformly treats common envelope evolution and tidal disruption, and derive an approximate expression for the dependence of the mass transfer rate of the material flow through the first Lagrange point L1 on the orbital angular velocity. Furthermore, based on the perturbed Keplerian approach, we present a two-dimensional model for the orbital evolution of compact binary systems that simultaneously accounts for mass transfer and stellar spin corrections. Through numerical simulations, we investigate binary systems with significant relativistic effects, namely NS-NS (neutron star-neutron star), NS-BH (neutron star-black hole), and BH-BH (black hole-black hole) systems, and demonstrate the influence of mass transfer and spin corrections on the orbital evolution and polarization waveforms of gravitational waves of these compact binaries systems.

一句话导读：在2.5PN近似下构建含质量转移与自旋修正的致密双星轨道演化与引力波波形模型，并数值研究NS-NS、NS-BH和BH-BH系统。

引力波暗汽笛作为天体物理探针：推断星系-并合关系并识别单个宿主

Gravitational-wave dark sirens as astrophysical probes: inferring galaxy-merger relations and identifying individual hosts

Alessandro Agapito, Michele Mancarella · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：引力波“暗汽笛”技术，即把引力波事件与星系表进行统计关联，迄今一直被用作宇宙学工具。然而这种关联携带着尚未被利用的独特天体物理信息——具体来说，致密双星如何分布于星系中，以及单个宿主的身份。在这项工作中，我们通过在单一层次框架内同时推断这两者，将暗汽笛计划转变为天体物理探针。该方法把众多潜在宿主约化为一个紧凑的、按概率排序的目标列表，为后续跟踪提供直接的决策工具。将其盲目应用于 GW170817，可恢复 NGC 4993 为排名最高的宿主，并约束星系光度权重，轻微偏向非均匀宿主权重。固定星系权重反而可能降低宿主识别效果，甚至偏向错误的宿主。该框架将暗汽笛重新表述为探测电磁暗弱致密双星并合天体物理的潜在独特探针。

English: Gravitational-wave (GW) ``dark siren'' techniques, namely the statistical association of GW events with a galaxy catalog, have so far been used as a cosmological tool. Yet this association carries distinctive astrophysical information that remains unused---specifically, how compact binaries populate galaxies and the identities of individual hosts. In this work, we turn the dark-siren program into an astrophysical probe by inferring both simultaneously within a single hierarchical framework. The method reduces the many potential hosts to a compact, probabilistically ranked target list, providing a direct follow-up decision tool. Applied blindly to GW170817, it recovers NGC~4993 as the highest-ranked host and constrains the galaxy luminosity weighting, mildly favoring non-uniform host weights. Fixing the galaxy weighting can instead degrade host identification and even favor the wrong host. This framework recasts dark sirens as a potentially unique probe of the astrophysics of electromagnetically dark compact-binary mergers.

一句话导读：将引力波暗汽笛从宇宙学工具拓展为同时推断星系-并合关系和识别单个宿主的天体物理探针。

银河系中心热斑旋进运动的贝叶斯证据

Bayesian Evidence for Inspiraling Hotspot Motion in the Galactic Center

Pablo Ruales, Maciek Wielgus, Delilah E. A. Gates, Alejandro Cardenas-Avendano · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：在耀发期间，对银河系中心黑洞人马座 A*（Sgr A*）的偏振观测在 Stokes Q-U 平面上显示出演化的环状轨迹，即 Q-U 环。此前人们用瞬时被激发的轨道特征——热斑——的开普勒模型来再现这些偏振信号。本文发展了一个贝叶斯框架，从偏振光变曲线推断热斑的含时运动学，并采用一般的运动描述。我们将辐射区轨迹建模为 K 个连续分段序列，每段由径向和方位角速度参数描述。我们以 K=1,2,3 进行分析，并与 2017 年 4 月 11 日 ALMA 对 Sgr A* 的毫米波观测比较；该观测包含两个相继的 Q-U 环，从而扩展了运动学观测约束。我们考察局域磁场几何、谱指数以及热斑轨迹的运动学剖面对偏振信号的影响。我们发现统计上显著的证据表明辐射区遵循非测地线的旋进轨迹；当建模更长的数据段时，相对于严格开普勒轨道的偏好显著增强。基于贝叶斯对数证据和约化卡方统计，旋进的非开普勒模型优于纯开普勒模型。这些结果为银河系中心耀发事件及其伴随的间歇性产生热斑的性质提供了新认识。

English: During flaring episodes, polarimetric observations of the Galactic Center black hole Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*) reveal evolving, loop-like trajectories in the Stokes Q-U plane, the so-called Q-$U loops. Keplerian models of transiently energized orbiting features, hotspots, have been employed to reproduce these polarimetric signatures. In this work, we develop a Bayesian framework to infer the time-dependent kinematics of the hotspot from polarized light curves, using a general prescription for its motion. We model the emitting region's trajectory as a continuous, piecewise sequence of K kinematic segments, each described by radial and azimuthal velocity parameters. We perform analyses with K=1,2,3 and compare these models to millimeter-wavelength ALMA observations of Sgr A* from 2017 April 11 that include two subsequent Q-U loops, extending the observational constraints on the kinematics. We examine the effects of the local magnetic field geometry, spectral index, and kinematic profile of the hotspot's trajectory on the polarized signal. We find statistically significant evidence that the emitting region follows a non-geodesic inspiraling trajectory, and this preference over a strictly Keplerian orbit strengthens sharply when a longer data segment is modeled. The inspiraling non-Keplerian models are preferred to a purely Keplerian model based on both the Bayesian log-evidence comparison and the reduced chi-square statistic. Our results offer new insight into the nature of flaring events in the Galactic Center and the episodically produced hotspots associated with them.

一句话导读：用贝叶斯模型比较 Sgr A* 的偏振 Q-U 环，发现热斑更符合非测地线旋进轨迹而非纯开普勒轨道。

快速而流涌：使用归一化流与嵌套采样进行引力波背景贝叶斯模型比较

Fast and Flow-rious: Gravitational Wave Background Bayesian Model Comparison using Normalizing Flows and Nested Sampling

David C. Wright, Aaron D. Johnson, Jeffrey S. Hazboun, William G. Lamb · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：2023年，全球的脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）合作组宣布了纳赫兹引力波背景（GWB）的证据。除了提高探测显著性，下一个主要目标是刻画GWB并确定其来源。PTA分析中典型的模型比较度量是贝叶斯因子（BF）。然而，PTA文献中使用的BF计算方法，如乘积空间采样和热力学积分，当所比较的模型不相似或非嵌套时，计算代价高昂或效率低下。在本工作中，我们引入一种PTA模型比较方法，结合了归一化流、嵌套采样以及一个对所有非GWB参数边缘化后的PTA似然。这些流使用新开发的Python包coppuccino训练，该包学习数据的copula：在变换到均匀边缘分布后的依赖结构。我们在解析目标和模拟PTA数据上验证了该方法，在误差棒内恢复了解析证据，并在将BF视作注入模型的二分类器时达到了0.996的曲线下面积（AUC）分数。结果是，一种在消费级硬件上几分钟内对任意GWB谱模型进行贝叶斯模型比较的方法。

English: In 2023, pulsar timing array (PTA) collaborations around the world announced evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background (GWB). Beyond increasing the detection significance, the next major goal is to characterize the GWB and identify its source(s). The typical model-comparison metric used in PTA analyses is the Bayes factor (BF). However, BF computation methods used in the PTA literature, such as product-space sampling and thermodynamic integration, are computationally expensive or inefficient if the models compared are dissimilar or non-nested. In this work, we introduce a PTA model-comparison method using a combination of normalizing flows, nested sampling, and a PTA likelihood that is marginalized over all non-GWB parameters. The flows are trained using a newly-developed Python package coppuccino, which learns the data's copula: the dependence structure after transforming to uniform marginals. We validate the method on both analytic targets and simulated PTA data, recovering the analytic evidence within error bars and achieving an area-under-the-curve (AUC) score of 0.996 when treating the BFs as binary classifiers of the injected models. The result is a method to perform Bayesian model comparison of arbitrary GWB spectral models in minutes on consumer hardware.

一句话导读：提出用归一化流、嵌套采样和边缘化PTA似然快速计算纳赫兹引力波背景模型贝叶斯因子。

f(R) 引力中常曲率黑洞的轨道稳定性、相对论进动与 QPO 约束

Orbital stability, relativistic precession, and QPO constraints for constant-curvature black holes in $f(R)$ gravity

Kourosh Nozari, Sara Saghafi, Khadijeh Salahshour, Mois\'es Bravo-Gaete · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：我们分析度规 f(R) 引力常曲率真空部分中的圆轨道稳定性、epicyclic 共振、相对论进动以及准周期振荡（QPO）约束。Schwarzschild--(anti-)de Sitter 与 Kerr--(anti-)de Sitter 背景由满足代数迹方程的曲率 R0 刻画。我们导出静止坐标时下的轨道频率和 epicyclic 频率，并确定稳定的类时圆轨道区域。正曲率将稳定运动限制在最内与最外稳定圆轨道之间，二者在临界曲率处合并，并在适当频率比下允许两个共振半径。负曲率允许稳定运动延伸到任意大半径，且 Ωθ/Ωr → 1/2，而渐近平坦极限为 1。我们确定 3:2、2:1、3:1 共振分支和有符号节点进动，并重现 Lense--Thirring 极限。我们还评估角动量加权刚性流动进动和黏性对齐，其中最外稳定轨道界定了正曲率流动。结合 GRO J1655--40 同时 QPO 三重态与独立动力学质量测量的贝叶斯 MCMC 分析给出 R0 M^2 = -5.57^{+12.94}_{-16.15} × 10^{-4}（68% 可信度），其条件为测地线相对论进动方案和采用的时间归一化。Kerr 仍被允许，非零曲率对拟合的改善可忽略。将质量不确定度加倍使曲率区间扩展约 2.1 倍；移除质量似然则显示扩展的、依赖先验的简并。因此这是联合 QPO 与动力学质量约束，没有显著证据表明偏离 Kerr。

English: We analyze circular-orbit stability, epicyclic resonances, relativistic precession, and quasi-periodic-oscillation (QPO) constraints in the constant-curvature vacuum sector of metric $f(R)$ gravity. The Schwarzschild--(anti-)de~Sitter and Kerr--(anti-)de~Sitter backgrounds are characterized by curvature $R_0$ satisfying the algebraic trace equation. We derive stationary-coordinate-time orbital and epicyclic frequencies and determine stable timelike circular-orbit domains. Positive curvature confines stable motion between innermost and outermost stable circular orbits, which merge at a critical curvature, and permits two resonance radii for suitable frequency ratios. Negative curvature allows stable motion to arbitrarily large radii, with $\Omega_\theta/\Omega_r\rightarrow1/2$, compared with unity in the asymptotically flat limit. We determine the $3{:}2$, $2{:}1$, and $3{:}1$ resonance branches and signed nodal precession, recovering the Lense--Thirring limit. We also evaluate angular-momentum-weighted rigid-flow precession and viscous alignment, with the outermost stable orbit bounding positive-curvature flows. A Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo analysis combining the simultaneous GRO J1655--40 QPO triplet with an independent dynamical-mass measurement yields $R_0M^2=-5.57^{+12.94}_{-16.15}\times10^{-4}$ at $68\%$ credibility, conditional on the geodesic relativistic-precession prescription and adopted time normalization. Kerr remains allowed, with negligible fit improvement from nonzero curvature. Doubling the mass uncertainty broadens the curvature interval by approximately $2.1$; removing the mass likelihood reveals an extended, prior-dependent degeneracy. This is therefore a joint QPO and dynamical-mass constraint, with no significant evidence for departure from Kerr.

一句话导读：在 f(R) 常曲率黑洞时空中研究轨道稳定性与相对论进动，并用 GRO J1655-40 QPO 约束曲率；结果与 Kerr 一致，无明显偏离。

扩展 RIFT 1：将 RIFT 扩展至第三代引力波分析

Scaling RIFT 1: Extending RIFT to third-generation gravitational-wave analyses

R. O'Shaughnessy (Rochester Institute of Technology), A. Jan (University of Texas, Austin, California Institute of Technology), J. Lange (Cardiff University), R. Mechum (Rochester Institute of Technology) · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：第三代引力波探测器观测到的致密双星信号的解释因其高信噪比（常达数百至数千），以及由于地球自转和探测器巨大物理尺度引起的时间和频率依赖的探测器响应而变得复杂。基于此前针对 LISA 的工作，我们实现了 RIFT 参数估计流程的通用、稳健扩展，使得可以利用任何现有波形模型解释这些源，而无需借助诸如降阶近似或归一化流之类的中间预训练数据产品。我们在一个三站点下一代网络中，展示了在信噪比=1000下对有限尺寸双中子星注入的端到端恢复，在单块 GPU 上于数分钟内将源的外禀参数定位到 0.8×10^{-3} 平方度。

English: Interpretation of compact binary signals observed by third-generation gravitational-wave detectors is complicated by their high signal-to-noise ratios, often reaching hundreds to thousands, and by time- and frequency-dependent detector responses arising from Earth's rotation and the detectors' large physical extent. Building on prior work for LISA, we implement generic, robust extensions of the RIFT parameter estimation pipeline that enable interpretation of these sources using any existing waveform model, without recourse to intermediate pretrained data products like reduced-order approximations or normalizing flows. We demonstrate end-to-end recovery of finite-size binary-neutron-star injections in a three-site next-generation network to $\mathrm{SNR}=1000$, localizing the source's extrinsic parameters to $0.8\times10^{-3}\,\mathrm{deg}^2$ in minutes on a single GPU.

一句话导读：将 RIFT 参数估计流程扩展到第三代引力波探测器的高信噪比、含时频响应分析，并演示双中子星注入恢复。

跨数据间隙噪声PSD跳变的引力波推断

Gravitational-Wave Inference For Noise PSD Jumps Across Data Gaps

Jian-Ming Yan, Zong-Kuan Guo · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：长时间引力波（GW）推断不可避免地会遇到数据间隙，这些间隙通常伴随着探测器噪声功率谱密度（PSD）的突然、非平稳变化。传统做法通常分别分析间隙前和间隙后的数据，导致可避免的信息损失，并可能降低参数推断的质量。我们基于Wilson-Daubechies-Meyer（WDM）时频域中的贝叶斯间隙增广，并关注一个实际重要的失效模式：具有大PSD幅度跳变的短间隙。在这种情况下，支撑WDM似然的局部对角（类Whittle）近似在间隙边缘附近的时间方向上不再可靠，除非在不进行完全分段的情况下恢复局部对角有效性，否则可能导致有偏和/或稳健性较差的推断。我们提出了一种两阶段、有效性驱动的补救方法。首先，频域先验预测预白化（PW）结合端点噪声信息，以减轻导致对角行为不佳的主要失配，从而实现更有利的WDM表示，同时保持计算可行性。其次，当时间方向平滑度准则仍然失败时，我们应用自适应间隙扩展（AGE），仅选择性地扩大间隙边界周围所需的最小邻域，以恢复局部对角有效性。使用嵌合PSD过渡的玩具模型模拟表明，与单侧间隙前/间隙后分析相比，WDM+PW+AGE产生显著更紧且更准确的后验，同时保持适合下一代任务的计算效率。

English: Long-duration gravitational-wave (GW) inference inevitably encounters data gaps, which are often accompanied by abrupt, non-stationary changes in the detector noise power spectral density (PSD). Conventional practice typically analyzes the pre-gap and post-gap data separately, causing avoidable information loss and potentially degrading parameter inference. We build on Bayesian gap augmentation in the Wilson--Daubechies--Meyer (WDM) time--frequency domain and focus on a practically important failure mode: short gaps with large PSD amplitude jumps. In this regime, the local diagonal (Whittle-like) approximation that underpins the WDM likelihood can no longer be relied upon in the time direction near the gap edges, which may lead to biased and/or less robust inference unless the local diagonal validity is restored without resorting to full segmentation. We propose a two-stage, validity-driven remedy. First, frequency-domain prior-predictive prewhitening (PW) incorporates endpoint-informed noise information to mitigate the dominant mismatch responsible for poor diagonal behavior, enabling a more favorable WDM representation while retaining computational tractability. Second, when a time-direction smoothness criterion still fails, we apply adaptive gap expanding (AGE), selectively enlarging only the minimal neighborhood around the gap boundaries needed to restore local diagonal validity. Toy-model simulations with chimeric PSD transitions show that WDM+PW+AGE yields substantially tighter and more accurate posteriors than single-sided pre-gap/post-gap analyses, while maintaining computational efficiency suitable for next-generation missions.

一句话导读：提出WDM+PW+AGE两阶段方法，解决数据间隙中噪声PSD跳变导致的引力波推断偏差问题。

极端质量比旋近对暗物质尖峰的不可逆耗尽

The Irreversible Depletion of Dark Matter Spikes by Extreme-Mass-Ratio Inspirals

Charlie Sharpe, Yonadav Barry Ginat, Thomas F. M. Spieksma, Alexander Heger, Bence Kocsis · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：围绕大质量黑洞（MBHs）的致密暗物质尖峰已被广泛预测会在极端质量比旋近（EMRIs）中产生引力波退相位，并有可能被LISA观测到。我们表明，EMRIs——正是用于探测这些尖峰的对象——也会摧毁它们。结合核星团的Fokker-Planck模型与EMRI-暗物质相遇的后牛顿三体模拟，我们证明重复的引力弹弓效应会在十亿年时间尺度上不可逆地将暗物质粒子从星团的损失锥中抛出。对于红移 z = 3、质量 ≲10^5 M⊙ 的MBH，即使保守的EMRI率 O(1-10) Gyr^-1 也足以将尖峰密度耗尽若干数量级；对于更现实的 O(100-300) Gyr^-1 速率，质量范围扩展到 ≲10^6 M⊙。因此，这类系统预期的引力波退相位大大降低，缩小了通过该通道探测暗物质的前景。只有重、高红移且EMRI率足够低的系统——例如红移 z ≳ 5、质量约 10^6 M⊙ 且每十亿年 ≲100 个EMRI——才能产生超过一弧度的退相位。

English: Dense dark matter spikes around massive black holes (MBHs) have been widely predicted to produce gravitational-wave dephasing in extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) that are potentially observable by LISA. We show that EMRIs, the very objects used to probe these spikes, also destroy them. Combining Fokker-Planck models of nuclear star clusters with post-Newtonian three-body simulations of EMRI-dark matter encounters, we demonstrate that repeated gravitational slingshots irreversibly eject dark matter particles from the cluster's loss cone over gigayear time-scales. For MBHs at $z = 3$ with masses $\lesssim 10^5 \,M_\odot$, even conservative EMRI rates of $\mathcal{O}(1-10) \, \mathrm{Gyr}^{-1}$ suffice to deplete the spike density by orders of magnitude; for more realistic rates of $\mathcal{O}(100-300) \, \mathrm{Gyr}^{-1}$, the mass range extends to $\lesssim 10^6 \,M_\odot$. As a result, the gravitational-wave dephasing expected from such systems is greatly reduced, narrowing the prospects of detecting DM through this channel. Only heavy, high-redshift systems with sufficiently low EMRI rates -- for example, a $\sim 10^6 \,M_\odot$ MBH at $z \gtrsim 5$ with $\lesssim 100$ EMRIs per Gyr -- can induce dephasing that exceeds one radian.

一句话导读：EMRI的重复引力弹弓会在Gyr尺度上不可逆地耗尽大质量黑洞周围的暗物质尖峰，从而削弱LISA通过引力波退相位探测暗物质的前景。

自相互作用暗物质诱导的动力学摩擦及其对极端质量比旋近引力波的印记

Self-Interacting Dark Matter-Induced Dynamical Friction and Its Imprint on EMRI Gravitational Waves

Yu Wang, Meilin Liu, Haiguang Xu · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：极端质量比旋近（EMRI）通过其长时标引力波信号，为探测大质量黑洞周围的暗物质环境提供了有前景的手段。本文研究自相互作用暗物质（SIDM）对EMRI动力学和引力波相位演化的影响。受SIDM碰撞玻尔兹曼描述启发，我们构造了对传统Chandrasekhar动力学摩擦力的领头阶有效修正，该修正由动量转移截面 σ_T 和无量纲碰撞参数 n_χ σ_T r = r/λ_mfp 控制。随后计算由此产生的轨道演化、波形修正和累积引力波退相位。在所考虑的增强阻尼区域，增加SIDM自相互作用强度会增强有效动力学摩擦、加速旋近，并相对于无碰撞暗物质情形产生逐渐增大的相位偏差。我们进一步区分了相对于真空的总暗物质诱导退相位与专门由暗物质自相互作用产生的附加相位修正。结果表明，EMRI的累积引力波相位可对暗物质的微观动量转移性质敏感，暗示LISA等未来空间探测器可能为探测大质量黑洞附近的SIDM提供互补手段。

English: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) provide a promising probe of the dark matter environment surrounding massive black holes through their long-duration gravitational-wave signals. In this work, we investigate the influence of self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) on EMRI dynamics and gravitational-wave phase evolution. Motivated by the collisional Boltzmann description of SIDM, we construct a leading-order effective correction to the conventional Chandrasekhar dynamical-friction force, controlled by the momentum-transfer cross section $\sigma_T$ and the dimensionless collisionality parameter $n_\chi\sigma_T r=r/\lambda_{\rm mfp}$. We then compute the resulting orbital evolution, waveform modification, and accumulated gravitational-wave dephasing. In the enhanced-drag regime considered here, increasing the SIDM self-interaction strength increases the effective dynamical friction, accelerates the inspiral, and produces a progressively larger phase deviation relative to the collisionless dark matter case. We further distinguish the total dark-matter-induced dephasing relative to vacuum from the additional phase correction generated specifically by dark matter self-interactions. Our results demonstrate that the cumulative gravitational-wave phase of EMRIs can be sensitive to the microscopic momentum-transfer properties of dark matter, suggesting that future space-based detectors such as LISA may provide a complementary probe of SIDM in the vicinity of massive black holes.

一句话导读：SIDM自相互作用增强EMRI动力学摩擦，加速旋近并增大引力波退相位，可被LISA等未来探测器探测。

超越圆形与赤道轨道：用一般 Kerr 测地线的绝热旋进对矢量荷施加贝叶斯约束

Beyond circular and equatorial orbits: Bayesian constraint on vector charge with the adiabatic inspirals of generic Kerr geodesics

Tieguang Zi, Genliang Li · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：极端质量比旋进（EMRIs）通过其对引力波相位的累积影响，为探测额外基本场提供了强有力的手段。然而，对一般 Kerr 轨道产生的矢量辐射建模需要 Carter 常数的演化，而该常数不能仅由能量和角动量平衡确定。在这里，我们推导了偏心且倾斜、非共振 Kerr 测地线的轨道平均电磁 Carter 常数通量，包括无穷远处和事件视界处的部分。结合引力与电磁能量和角动量通量，我们使用四维 Chebyshev 插值方法构建了一般绝热旋进。我们将相对论轨迹纳入最先进的 FastEMRIWaveform 程序包，并对次级天体携带的矢量荷进行贝叶斯推断。我们的分析揭示了荷与内禀源参数之间存在显著关联，且矢量荷约束对轨道倾角表现出非单调依赖。这些结果为研究一般 EMRI 中额外的矢量辐射通道及其对未来天基引力波观测检验引力的意义建立了一个框架。

English: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) offer a powerful probe of additional fundamental fields through their cumulative influence on gravitational-wave phases. However, modeling vector radiation from generic Kerr orbits requires the evolution of the Carter constant, which cannot be determined from energy and angular-momentum balance alone. Here we derive the orbit-averaged electromagnetic Carter-constant flux for eccentric and inclined, nonresonant Kerr geodesics, including sections at infinity and event horizon. Combining the gravitational and electromagnetic energy and angular-momentum fluxes, we construct generic adiabatic inspirals using a four-dimensional Chebyshev interpolation mathod. We incorporate the relativistic trajectories into the state of the art of FastEMRIWaveform package and perform Bayesian inference of vector charge carried by secondaries. Our analysis reveals substantial correlations between the charge and intrinsic source parameters, with vector charge constraints exhibiting a nonmonotonic dependence on orbital inclination. These results establish a framework for investigating additional vector-radiation channels in generic EMRIs and their implications for tests of gravity with future space-based gravitational wave observations.

一句话导读：用一般 Kerr 测地线的绝热 EMRI 波形对次级矢量荷做贝叶斯限制，发现其与源参数强相关且随轨道倾角非单调变化。
