Weyl几何中的高阶曲率引力：无鬼与无快子条件

Higher-curvature gravity in Weyl geometry: No-ghost and no-tachyon conditions

Tomoya Tachinami · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：Weyl几何允许在时空每一点独立选择长度标度，通过Weyl不变性（即局域标度对称性）为扩展广义相对论提供了自然框架。我们构造了一种引力理论，其拉格朗日量是Weyl几何中标量曲率的任意函数，并确立了该理论在极大对称真空附近无鬼、无快子的条件。对于任意函数，Weyl不变性要求除度规和Weyl向量外还需一个补偿标量场。通过引入辅助场将作用量线性化，我们表明Weyl向量仅通过标量场的单一组合与标量扇区耦合。因此，Weyl向量在被该组合的对数梯度平移后，无需规范固定即成为Weyl不变的有质量向量场。在Einstein框架中，假设引力子无鬼，Weyl向量的无快子条件以及标量子（与高阶曲率项相关的标量模式）的无鬼条件归结为补偿标量场动能系数的正性。当该系数为零时，标量子不传播，只剩下引力子和有质量向量。作为一个例子，我们表明对于包含常数、线性和二次曲率项的拉格朗日量，在整个稳定区域内必然同时存在有质量向量和有质量标量子；而若没有线性项，标量子变为无质量。

English: Weyl geometry, in which the length scale can be chosen independently at each point of spacetime, provides a natural framework for extending general relativity through Weyl invariance, that is, local scale symmetry. We construct a gravitational theory whose Lagrangian is an arbitrary function of the scalar curvature in Weyl geometry and establish the conditions under which the theory is free of ghosts and tachyons around maximally symmetric vacua. For an arbitrary function, Weyl invariance requires a compensating scalar field in addition to the metric and the Weyl vector. By linearizing the action with an auxiliary field, we show that the Weyl vector couples to the scalar sector only through a single combination of the scalar fields. Consequently, the Weyl vector, shifted by the logarithmic gradient of this combination, becomes a Weyl-invariant massive vector field without gauge fixing. In the Einstein frame, given that the graviton is ghost-free, the no-tachyon condition for the Weyl vector, together with the no-ghost condition for the scalaron, the scalar mode associated with the higher-curvature terms, reduces to the positivity of the kinetic coefficient of the compensating scalar. When this coefficient vanishes, the scalaron does not propagate, leaving only the graviton and the massive vector. As an example, we show that for a Lagrangian containing constant, linear, and quadratic curvature terms, both a massive vector and a massive scalaron are necessarily present throughout the stability region, whereas without the linear term the scalaron becomes massless.

Correspondence between multileaf topology of closed geodesics and spatiotemporal autocorrelations of hotspot images in Schwarzschild spacetime

Fengting Xie, Qing-Hua Zhu, Xin Li · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：相对论闭合轨道的多叶结构分类为强场动力学研究提供了框架，但在天文图像中识别这些结构仍具挑战。我们使用光线追踪，构造沿Schwarzschild黑洞束缚闭合测地线运动的点状热点的初级图像的时空自相关。这些轨道由三个整数(z,w,v)分类，其中z计数叶数，w计数每个径向周期内的额外环绕，v指定轨道叶被追踪的顺序。对于所考察的轨道族，数值结果建立了拓扑整数(z,w,v)与相关带数N_band和回归点数N_rec之间的对应。整数可由 z=N_rec-1、w=floor((N_band+1)/(N_rec-1))-1 和 v=(N_band+1) mod (N_rec-1) 恢复。这些关系提供了从热点图像自相关恢复闭合轨道拓扑的定量方法。

English: The classification of relativistic closed orbits by their multileaf structures provides a framework for studying strong-field dynamics. Identifying these structures in astronomical images remains challenging. Using ray tracing, we construct the spatiotemporal autocorrelations of the primary image of a pointlike hotspot moving along bound closed geodesics around a Schwarzschild black hole. These orbits are classified by three integers $(z,w,v)$, where $z$ counts the leaves, $w$ counts the additional whirls during each radial period, and $v$ specifies the order in which the orbital leaves are traced. For the orbit families examined, our numerical results establish a correspondence between the topological integers $(z,w,v)$ and the numbers of correlation bands $N_{\rm band}$ and recurrence points $N_{\rm rec}$. The integers are recovered as $z=N_{\rm rec}-1$, $w=\left\lfloor (N_{\rm band}+1)/(N_{\rm rec}-1)\right\rfloor-1$, and $v=(N_{\rm band}+1)\bmod(N_{\rm rec}-1)$. Here, $\lfloor x\rfloor$ denotes the greatest integer not exceeding $x$, and $\bmod$ denotes the remainder operation. These relations provide a quantitative method for recovering closed-orbit topology from hotspot image autocorrelations.

English: We study how first-order differential observables affect the zero-frequency behavior of black-hole wave equations. Quasinormal modes and late-time tails do not always change in the same way. We give a simple condition for when an observable removes the leading threshold term of a Green function. For Schwarzschild Regge-Wheeler modes, the relevant operator is determined by the regular static solution. The transformation is nondegenerate at nonzero frequency but becomes globally degenerate at zero frequency. As a result, the nonzero quasinormal-mode problem is unchanged, while the leading fixed-radius late-time tail gains one extra inverse power of time.

计算小质量比极限下高偏心率束缚双星的引力辐射

Computing gravitational radiation from highly eccentric bound binaries in the small-mass-ratio limit

Diego Andr\'es Rivera Orona, Scott A. Hughes · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：精确的强引力模型描述束缚致密双星系统的演化，可提供有关其产生的引力辐射以及辐射反作用如何驱动演化的信息。极高偏心率极限 e→1 难以建模：频域技术需要大量谐波才能准确描述该极限下的辐射，而时域技术由于系统时间尺度长可能收敛缓慢。尽管如此，许多近期天体物理分析仍强调理解该区域引力波辐射的重要性，指出许多系统可能在变得可探测之前经历 e≃1，并可能以显著偏心率进入探测器敏感频带。本文展示如何改造小质量比极限下计算引力辐射的频域方法，以有效处理高偏心率。该分析的关键是对频域 Teukolsky 方程源项的一个积分。我们考察了该积分在 e→1 时难以计算的特征，并研究了规避这些困难的方法。我们发现一个简单修正，可轻松计算偏心率直到 e=0.99 的引力波振幅及相关的能量和角动量通量；凭借耐心和毅力，我们推进到 e=0.999，但在如此极端情形下数值精度似乎下降。有趣的是，我们发现著名且常用的 Peters 和 Mathews 经典公式存在系统误差，该误差在相当宽的分离下仍然存在。这对经历 e≃1 的致密双星形成模型具有启示。

English: Precise strong-gravity models describing the evolution of bound compact binary systems provide important information about the gravitational radiation such binaries generate and how they evolve due to the radiation's backreaction. The limit of very high eccentricity, $e \to 1$, is challenging to model: frequency-domain techniques require many harmonics to accurately describe radiation in this limit, and time-domain techniques can be slow to converge due to the systems' long timescales. Many recent astrophysical analyses have nonetheless emphasized the importance of understanding gravitational-wave emission in this regime, highlighting the fact that many systems may evolve through $e \simeq 1$ en route to becoming detectable sources, and may enter the sensitive band of detectors with substantial eccentricity. In this paper, we show how to adapt frequency-domain methods for computing gravitational radiation in the small-mass-ratio limit to effectively handle high eccentricity. The key piece of this analysis is an integral over the source of the frequency-domain Teukolsky equation. We examine features of this integral that make it difficult to evaluate as $e \to 1$, and study methods to circumvent these difficulties. We find a simple fix which allows us to compute gravitational-wave amplitudes and the associated fluxes of energy and angular momentum with ease up to eccentricities $e = 0.99$; with patience (and stamina), we have pushed to $e = 0.999$, though numerical accuracy appears to degrade for such extreme cases. Interestingly, we find that the well-known and often used classic formulas of Peters and Mathews are subject to a systematic error which persists at quite wide separation. This has implications for models of compact binary formation which evolve through $e \simeq 1$.

一句话导读：通过改进频域 Teukolsky 源积分，将小质量比高偏心双星引力辐射计算推进到 e=0.999，并指出 Peters-Mathews 公式的系统误差。

LISA 任务结束后才并合的极端质量比旋进有多大比例可被探测？

What Fraction of Extreme Mass Ratio Inspirals That Merge After the LISA Mission Ends Are Detectable?

Daniel J. Oliver, Aaron D. Johnson, Jonathan E. Thompson, Curt J. Cutler · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：在星系核中旋入大质量黑洞的恒星级致密天体（称为“极端质量比旋进”，EMRI）将成为激光干涉空间天线（LISA）的一类重要源。一个恒星级致密天体可在毫赫兹频段辐射数年到数十年，然后才坠入其大质量黑洞，因此 LISA 可探测的 EMRI 中有相当一部分在任务结束时仍处于旋进阶段。我们计算可探测 EMRI 中将在任务结束后坠入的比例，并针对这些源计算它们随各种参数（例如任务结束后的剩余寿命）的分布。为此，我们从具有天体物理动机的种群中抽样，对给定坠入时间的完全相对论性 Kerr FastEMRIWaveforms 轨迹进行反向积分，并计算在四年名义观测窗口和十年扩展观测窗口内的完整 LISA 响应。我们在信噪比（SNR）阈值 rho=10、20 和 30 下，将可探测比例计算为距坠入时间的显式函数。我们发现，在四年任务期间、rho>20 时，任务结束后坠入的 EMRI 约占 LISA 可探测种群的 1/4；在十年扩展任务中约占 1/6。在我们运行的大质量黑洞自旋和次级质量范围内，rho>20 时窗口内可探测比例变化近六倍；而在所有情况下，四年任务中的份额保持在 25% 到 33% 之间，十年任务中保持在 13% 到 20% 之间。对任务结束后超过约 1 年才坠入的 EMRI 的搜索，可能需要不同于任务期间坠入 EMRI 所用算法的算法；而任务结束后探测占全部探测的相当一部分，这为开发适合它们的探测流程带来一定紧迫性。

English: Stellar-mass compact objects spiraling into massive black holes in galactic nuclei (referred to as "extreme-mass-ratio inspirals", or EMRIs) will be an important class of sources for the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). A stellar-mass compact object can radiate in the millihertz band for years to decades before it plunges into its massive black hole, so a substantial fraction of the EMRIs that LISA can detect will still be inspiraling when the mission ends. We calculate what fraction of detectable EMRIs will plunge after the mission ends, and for those we calculate how they are distributed as a function of various parameters, such as their post-mission lifetime. To do this, we draw from astrophysically motivated populations, backward-integrate fully relativistic Kerr FastEMRIWaveforms trajectories for a given time to plunge, and compute the full LISA response over both the four-year nominal and ten-year extended observing windows. We calculate the detectable fraction as an explicit function of time to plunge at signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) thresholds of $\rho=10$, 20, and 30. We find that post-mission EMRIs are roughly one in four of the LISA-detectable population at $\rho>20$ over the four-year mission, and roughly one in six over the ten-year extended mission. The in-window detectable fraction varies by nearly a factor of six at $\rho>20$ across the massive black hole spins and secondary masses we ran, while the share stays between 25% and 33% for the four-year mission and between 13% and 20% for the ten-year one across all of them. The search for EMRIs that plunge more than $\sim 1$ year after the mission ends may require a different algorithm than the one used for EMRIs that plunge during the mission, and the fact that post-mission detections are a substantial fraction of all detections gives some urgency to developing a detection pipeline suitable for them.

一句话导读：计算 LISA 任务结束后才坠入的 EMRI 中可探测比例，并指出其占全部可探测 EMRI 的相当一部分。

来自坍缩星盘中亚太阳质量中子星的随机引力波背景

Stochastic gravitational-wave background from subsolar neutron stars in collapsar disks

Valerio De Luca, Loris Del Grosso, Emanuele Berti · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：最近，围绕坍缩星中形成的黑洞的中微子冷却吸积盘碎裂，被提出作为产生质量远低于标准核心坍缩下限的中子星的天体物理通道。这些盘生天体要么彼此并合，要么与中心黑洞并合；所有这些并合在宇宙历史中的叠加会源生一个随机引力波背景。在本工作中，我们针对两种并合通道计算该背景的能量密度，并采用与观测到的长伽马射线暴发生率相联系的形成历史。我们发现，亚太阳质量中子星与中心黑洞的并合是最响亮的通道，已受到当前数据约束，并在下一代天文台的探测范围内；而双中子星通道至多暗两个数量级，其中最宽的双星仍可被下一代探测器探测到。将这些预言与 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA 合作组的第四次观测运行相对照，我们推导出坍缩星中其盘产生此类并合的比率的两项上限：一项来自各向同性背景未探测的稳健上限，另一项更严格的上限则可通过在当前数据中专门搜寻可分辨的亚太阳质量事件而达到。来自坍缩星盘本身非轴对称形变的引力波将提供坍缩星情景的额外独立信号，使人们能够与未来的分赫兹探测器开展互相关研究。总体而言，这里计算的背景为盘生亚太阳质量中子星提供了族群层面的探针，下一代探测器可将其明确带入视野。

English: The fragmentation of the neutrino-cooled accretion disks that surround the black holes formed in collapsars has recently been proposed as an astrophysical channel for the production of neutron stars with masses well below the standard core-collapse floor. These disk-born objects merge either with one another or with the central black hole, and the superposition of all such mergers across cosmic history sources a stochastic gravitational-wave background. In this work we compute the energy density of this background for both merger channels, adopting a formation history tied to the observed rate of long gamma-ray bursts. We find that the merger of a subsolar neutron star with the central black hole is the loudest channel, already constrained by current data and within reach of next-generation observatories, while the binary neutron-star channel is at most two orders of magnitude fainter, with its widest binaries remaining accessible to next-generation detectors. Confronting these predictions with the fourth observing run of the LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA Collaboration, we derive two upper bounds on the fraction of collapsars whose disks produce such mergers: a robust one from the non-detection of an isotropic background, and a tighter one that could be achieved by a dedicated search for resolvable subsolar events in current data. Gravitational waves from non-axisymmetric deformations of the collapsar disk itself would provide an additional independent signature for the collapsar scenario, enabling cross-correlation studies with future deci-Hz detectors. Overall, the background computed here provides a population-level probe of disk-born subsolar neutron stars, which next-generation detectors could bring firmly into view.

一句话导读：计算坍缩星盘中形成的亚太阳质量中子星并合产生的随机引力波背景，并给出坍缩星盘形成率上限及下一代探测器探测前景。

时域中的谱不稳定性

Spectral instabilities in the time domain

Taillte May, Adrien Kuntz, Nicola Franchini, Valentin Boyanov, Vitor Cardoso · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-30

中文摘要：我们利用一维双 Pöschl-Teller 模型研究谱不稳定性对时域波形的影响。通过解析地追踪主势垒与一个弱的、空间分离的微扰之间的连续散射，我们识别出一个在势垒间一次因果往返之后首次出现的长期贡献。在第一次回波之前，所有 overtone（高阶模）仍保持其未扰动频率。第一次回波到达观测者之后，出现一个随时间的线性长期修正。当该修正为微扰时，它可以被解释为准正模频率的移动。在这种情况下，我们证明其系数再现了频域结果。更一般地，它产生有限时间的有效频率，这些频率不必与未扰动或完全扰动的准正模谱一致。我们用数值时域演化确认了解析计算的结果。

English: We investigate the effect of a spectral instability on the time domain waveform using a one-dimensional double P\"oschl-Teller model. By analytically following successive scatterings between the primary potential barrier and a weak, spatially separated perturbation, we identify a secular contribution that first appears after one causal round trip between the barriers. Before the first echo, all overtones remain at their unperturbed frequencies. After the first echo reaches the observer, there is a secular, linear-in-time correction. When this correction is perturbative, it can be interpreted as a shift of the quasinormal mode frequency. In that case, we show that its coefficient reproduces the frequency-domain result. More generally, it generates finite-time effective frequencies that need not coincide with either the unperturbed or fully perturbed quasi-normal mode spectrum. We confirm the results of our analytic calculation using numerical time-domain evolutions.

一句话导读：在一维双 Pöschl-Teller 模型中，谱不稳定性使时域波形在首次回波后出现线性时间修正，并在微扰极限下重现频域 QNM 频移。

中子星中的迹反常与有效拓扑源

Trace Anomaly and Effective Topological Sources in Neutron Stars

Federico Nola · nucl-th, astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：本工作研究在张量多标量引力中，迹反常能否诊断恒星对拓扑标量场的响应。检查了十一个冷制表状态方程，在制表密度范围内经过保守的广义相对论稳定性和声速检验后选出六个。在互补匹配规定下，将其基准拓扑构型与相应的广义相对论模型进行比较。在控制恒星质量和状态方程依赖后，广义相对论迹源强度 S_T 仍与拓扑质量响应强相关，在所采样的基准序列中偏 Spearman 系数 rho = 0.975。在 1.4 M_sun 附近，拓扑构型系统性地更致密，固定重子质量下 Jordan 框架半径减小 6.7--8.7%，固定引力质量下减小 0.87--1.29 km。这些偏移与当前 NICER 不确定度相当，其观测影响取决于源。尽管存在整体形变，内部有效源仍以物质为主，拓扑贡献中位数约为 0.8%。因此，广义相对论物质迹成为基准拓扑恒星响应的有用诊断。

English: This work investigates whether the trace anomaly can diagnose the stellar response to a topological scalar field in tensor multi-scalar gravity. Eleven cold tabulated equations of state (EoSs) were examined, with six selected after conservative GR stability and speed of sound checks over the tabulated density range. Their fiducial topological configurations were compared with the corresponding GR models under complementary matching prescriptions. After controlling for stellar mass and EoS dependence, the GR trace source strength $S_T$ remained strongly correlated with the topological mass response, with a partial Spearman coefficient $\rho = 0.975$ within the sampled fiducial sequences. Near $1.4\,M_\odot$, the topological configurations were systematically more compact, with reductions in the Jordan frame radius of $6.7$--$8.7\%$ at fixed baryonic mass and $0.87$--$1.29\,\mathrm{km}$ at fixed gravitational mass. These shifts are comparable to current uncertainties from the Neutron Star Interior Composition Explorer (NICER) and their observational impact depends on the source. Despite the global deformation, the interior effective source remained dominated by matter, with a median topological contribution of about $0.8\%$. The GR matter trace therefore emerges as a useful diagnostic of the fiducial topological stellar response.

一句话导读：在中子星中，广义相对论迹源强度可强相关地诊断张量多标量引力拓扑标量场的恒星响应；拓扑构型更致密，但内部仍由物质主导。

原始夸克团能解决暗物质难题吗？

Do primordial quark pellets solve the dark matter puzzle?

Domenec Espriu · hep-ph, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们表明，原始夸克团（PQPs）——在 T∼1 GeV 时形成的超致密夸克物质迷你星——如果由收缩的 Peccei-Quinn 畴壁或类似超视界结构产生稀有重子过密区，则可以在辐射主导的早期宇宙中自然出现。用热夸克物态方程求解 Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff 方程，我们找到稳定解，最大理论质量为 10^{-2} 太阳质量，半径量级为 100 m，尽管形成机制倾向于更轻的天体，而这些轻天体确实会占主导。一旦形成，PQPs 会冷却并演化为迷你中子星或稳定的奇异物质块，取决于 QCD 基态。我们提出的机制可能足以再现当前暗物质密度，而无需改变大爆炸核合成或要求后期熵注入。如果 PQPs 的质量低于 10^{-8} 太阳质量，它们可能避开当前微引力透镜限制；鉴于其质量函数，这一范围可以轻松容纳很大一部分暗物质。因此，PQPs 可能构成一种保守的、基于标准模型的且可观测检验的候选者。

English: We show that primordial quark pellets (PQPs) - ultra-dense quark-matter mini-stars formed at $T\sim 1$ GeV - could naturally arise in a radiation dominated early universe if rare baryon overdensities are produced by contracting Peccei-Quinn domain walls or similar super-horizon structures. Solving the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equation with a hot quark equation of state, we find stable solutions with a maximum theoretical mass of $10^{-2}$ solar masses and radii of order 100 m, although the formation mechanism favours much lighter objects that would indeed be dominant. Once formed, PQPs cool and evolve into either mini neutron stars or stable strange-matter nuggets, depending on the QCD ground state. The mechanism we present could suffice to reproduce the present dark matter density without altering Big Bang Nucleosynthesis or requiring a posterior entropy injection. PQPs may evade current microlensing constraints if their masses are below $10^{-8}$ solar masses, a range that in view of their mass function could easily accommodate a large fraction of dark matter. PQPs thus potentially constitute a conservative Standars-Model based, and observationally testable candidate.

一句话导读：早期宇宙Peccei-Quinn畴壁塌缩形成原始夸克团，经TOV方程给出稳定致密星体，可能作为暗物质候选并避开微引力透镜限制。

面向脉冲星计时阵列数据中偏心双黑洞鲁棒探测的物理信息编码Transformer与模拟推断

Transformers with Physics-Informed Encodings and Simulation-Based Inference for Robust Detection of Eccentric Binary Black Holes in Pulsar Timing Array Data

Subhajit Dandapat, Alvin J. K. Chua · cs.LG, astro-ph.IM, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）为纳赫兹引力波提供了独特窗口，但由于参数空间维度高、噪声模型复杂且相关、以及重复似然评估成本高，从含噪长基线计时残差中提取天体物理参数对传统贝叶斯方法仍然计算困难。我们提出一种带有物理信息位置编码框架的Transformer，用于从PTA数据中高效推断相对论轨道上的偏心双黑洞。该方法将解析引力波相位演化通过结构化位置编码直接嵌入模型，使网络能够从原始PTA计时残差中学习具有物理意义的表示。随后，我们使用生成模型（包括离散和连续条件归一化流）在基于模拟的推断框架内推断后验分布。在一系列信噪比下，与物理无关基线相比，所提方法实现了更高精度、更尖锐后验和更快推断。虽然本文针对确定性白噪声信号展示，但该模块化框架可自然推广到包含红噪声和额外成分的实际PTA分析。本工作凸显了物理感知深度学习模型作为下一代PTA数据集可扩展推断流程替代方案的潜力。

English: Pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) provide a unique window into nanohertz gravitational waves (GWs), but extracting astrophysical parameters from noisy, long-baseline timing residuals remains computationally challenging with traditional Bayesian techniques due to the high dimensionality of the parameter space, complex and correlated noise models, and the cost of repeated likelihood evaluations. We introduce a Transformer with a physics-informed positional-encoding framework for the efficient inference of eccentric binary black holes in relativistic orbits from PTA data. Our approach embeds analytical GW phase evolution directly into the model through structured positional encodings, enabling the network to learn physically meaningful representations from raw PTA timing residuals. We then use generative models, including discrete and continuous conditional normalizing flows, to infer posterior distributions within a simulation-based inference framework. Across a range of signal-to-noise ratios, the proposed method achieves improved accuracy, sharper posteriors, and faster inference compared to physics-agnostic baselines. While presented for deterministic white-noise signals, the modular framework readily generalizes to realistic PTA analyses incorporating red noise and additional components. This work highlights the potential of physics-aware deep learning models as scalable alternatives to conventional inference pipelines for next-generation PTA datasets.

一句话导读：利用物理信息Transformer与模拟推断从脉冲星计时阵列数据中高效探测偏心双黑洞引力波。

近距离白矮星双星与旋转黑洞的潮汐相遇

Tidal encounters of close white dwarf binaries with spinning black holes

Aryabrat Mahapatra, Adarsh Pandey, Pritam Banerjee, Tapobrata Sarkar · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：当恒星双星与旋转黑洞相遇时，双星自旋、轨道角动量与黑洞自旋之间的相互作用可能产生有趣现象。本文考虑中等质量旋转黑洞与近距离相同白矮星双星系统之间的此类相遇，其质心沿抛物线轨迹运动。在点粒子近似下研究相应三体问题后，我们对这些情形进行了一组基于光滑粒子流体动力学的数值模拟。为此，我们积分旋转黑洞的测地线方程，同时在牛顿近似下考虑流体动力学以及恒星的自引力和相互引力相互作用，该近似由理论中的参数选择所证明。我们考虑双星质心的各种初始构型，导致赤道和非赤道轨道，以及双星初始自旋角动量与其初始轨道角动量之间的各种初始倾角。我们发现黑洞自旋效应清楚地表现在双星组分的潮汐动力学中，而潮汐相遇的可观测量（如质量回落率）强烈依赖于初始倾角。我们表明，对于双星自旋对准的不同初始构型，黑洞自旋的影响以不同方式出现。我们确定，在Hills机制范围内，某些情况下回落率可能显示出三峰结构，这是由于单个恒星的潮汐碎片之间的相互作用。

English: When a stellar binary encounters a spinning black hole, interesting phenomena might result due to the mutual interaction between the binary spin, orbital angular momentum and the black hole spin. Here we consider such encounters between an intermediate mass spinning black hole and a close identical white dwarf binary system whose center of mass follows a parabolic trajectory. After studying a corresponding three-body problem in the point particle approximation, we perform a suite of smoothed particle hydrodynamics based numerical simulations of such scenarios. For this, we integrate the geodesic equations for the spinning black hole, while considering the hydrodynamics and the self and mutual gravitational interactions of the stars in a Newtonian approximation, an approach justified by the choice of parameters in the theory. We consider various initial configurations of the binary center of mass leading to equatorial and off-equatorial orbits, as also various initial inclinations between the binary's initial spin angular momentum and its initial orbital angular momentum. We find that the effects of black hole spin manifest clearly in the tidal dynamics of the binary components, while the observables of tidal encounters such as mass fallback rates are strongly dependent on the initial inclination angle. We show that the influence of the black hole spin emerges in distinct ways for different initial configurations of the binary's spin alignment. We establish that within the ambits of the Hills mechanism, in certain cases, the fallback rate may show a three-hump structure, due to interactions between tidal debris of the individual stars.

一句话导读：通过三体计算与SPH模拟研究中等质量旋转黑洞与近距白矮星双星的潮汐相遇，发现黑洞自旋和初始倾角显著影响潮汐动力学及回落率，并可能出现三峰结构。

Rastall 引力中带电 Kiselev 黑洞的轴向扰动：物质响应与准正模

Axial Perturbations of Charged Kiselev Black Holes in Rastall Gravity: Matter Response and Quasinormal Modes

Yan Wang, Yun-tao Gu, Wen-Di Guo · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们研究 Rastall 引力中由类尘埃 Kiselev 型各向异性物质包围的带电黑洞的轴向引力电磁扰动。我们推导轴向物质相容性条件，并在忽略协变各向异性方向矢量扰动的闭合方案下得到两个耦合的薛定谔型主方程。这些方程在 Reissner-Nordström 和广义相对论类尘埃极限下允许与 r 无关的代数解耦；而在具有非零周围物质的一般带电 Rastall 背景中，额外的径向结构阻碍这种解耦。对于所考虑的非极端背景，我们在该闭合方案下建立轴向模稳定性：矩阵 S-形变排除了 ℓ≥2 的指数增长耦合模，物理电磁偶极具有正的有效势。Chebyshev 伪谱计算，并与 Reissner-Nordström 谱和谱收敛性核对，刻画了基频。在小耦合区域，增大 Rastall 耦合会同时降低振荡频率和阻尼率；在大耦合区域，振荡频率升高而阻尼率非单调变化。较大的电荷通常提高振荡频率，而较强的周围物质贡献倾向于产生更长寿的模。辅助的冻结源截断通常违反物质约束，但对所考察的代表性位形给出亚百分比的频率差异，表明谱接近并不能确立约束相容性。

English: We investigate axial gravitoelectromagnetic perturbations of charged black holes surrounded by dust-like Kiselev-type anisotropic matter in Rastall gravity. We derive the axial matter compatibility condition and obtain two coupled Schr\"odinger-type master equations under a closure that neglects perturbations of the covariant anisotropy-direction vector. The equations admit an $r$-independent algebraic decoupling in the Reissner--Nordstr\"om and general-relativistic dust-like limits, whereas additional radial structure obstructs such a decoupling in generic charged Rastall backgrounds with nonzero surrounding matter. For the nonextremal backgrounds considered, we establish axial mode stability under this closure: a matrix $S$-deformation excludes exponentially growing coupled modes for $\ell\geq2$, and the physical electromagnetic dipole has a positive effective potential. A Chebyshev pseudospectral calculation, checked against the Reissner--Nordstr\"om spectrum and spectral convergence, characterizes the fundamental frequencies. Increasing the Rastall coupling lowers both the oscillation frequency and the damping rate in the small-coupling region; in the large-coupling region, the oscillation frequency rises while the damping rate varies nonmonotonically. A larger charge generally raises the oscillation frequency, whereas stronger surrounding-matter contributions tend to produce longer-lived modes. An auxiliary frozen-source truncation generally violates the matter constraint but yields sub-percent frequency differences for the representative configurations examined, showing that spectral proximity does not establish constraint compatibility.

一句话导读：研究 Rastall 引力中带电 Kiselev 黑洞轴向引力电磁扰动，导出耦合主方程并分析稳定性与准正模频率随耦合、电荷和周围物质的变化。

利用群等变神经后验估计搜寻引力波回声

Searching for gravitational wave echo with group equivariant neural posterior estimation

Jian-Wei Luo, Yun-Song Piao · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：当前引力波回声搜寻方法通常需要大量计算时间和资源。群等变神经后验估计（GNPE）的最新进展已显示出显著加速后验推断的潜力。在这项工作中，我们采用该框架并训练一个 GNPE 模型来执行回声搜寻，在保持相当推断精度的同时显著提高计算效率。我们将其应用于 O4a 事件，未发现引力波回声的显著证据。

English: Current methods for the gravitational-wave (GW) echo searches generally require substantial computational time and resources. Recent advances in group equivariant neural posterior estimation (GNPE) have demonstrated the potential to substantially accelerate posterior inference. In this work, we adopt this framework and train a GNPE model to perform echo searches, significantly improving computational efficiency while maintaining comparable inference accuracy. We apply it to the O4a events and find no significant evidence for the GW echo.

一句话导读：训练群等变神经后验估计模型加速引力波回声搜寻，并在 O4a 事件中未发现显著回声证据。

经由连续偏序集的时空：旧基础与新进展

Spacetimes via Continuous posets: Old foundations and new developments

Ettore Minguzzi · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们向读者介绍时空几何的连续偏序集方法，这一主题由 Martin 与 Panangaden（MP）开创；我们提供相关的域论证明，以便来自洛伦兹几何与广义相对论的读者过渡。随后，我们给出关于时空解释的新结果。将 way-below 关系等同于时序关系 I，我们确定使每种偏序集性质成立时 ≤ 与因果条件的唯一选择：连续偏序集要求 ≤ = D_p 以及“past-distinction、(SC) 与 future-reflectivity”；双连续偏序集是因果连续时空，且 ≤ = D；整体双曲偏序集恰好是整体双曲时空，且 ≤ = J，这是一个超出 MP 充分性结果的必要性结果。因果单纯性通过链可实现性条件恢复，稳定因果性通过拓扑 τ 的 Hausdorff 性恢复，因此因果阶梯在抽象层面被完全确定，解决了 MP 提出的一个问题。由于完全用偏序集表述，该理论具有低正则性。我们引入拓扑 Kronheimer–Penrose 因果空间，其一般性足以涵盖文献中的洛伦兹长度空间，并给出使其成为（双）连续偏序集的弱条件。域论构造于是可直接应用；例如，Lawson 的 round-ideal 完备化——对保持连续性而言最自然——被证明等于未来 GKP 完备化，Gigli 等人的有向完备化也是如此；对于后者，我们在强因果性下移除了 (SC) 假设。通过反转理论的逻辑顺序，我们刻画了那些诱导出以它们为 way-below 关系的连续偏序集的关系。最后，关于 past-reflectivity 在黑洞蒸发中关键作用的物理考虑，使我们提出：在基本层面上，时空是一个余连续偏序集。

English: We introduce the reader to the continuous posets approach to spacetime geometry, a topic pioneered by Martin and Panangaden (MP), supplying the relevant domain-theoretic proofs to ease the transition for readers from Lorentzian geometry and general relativity. We then present new results for the spacetime interpretation. Identifying the way-below relation with the chronological relation $I$, we determine the unique choice of $\le$ and of causality condition yielding each poset property: continuous posets require $\le\,=D_p$ and ``past-distinction, (SC) and future-reflectivity'', bicontinuous posets are causally continuous spacetimes with $\le\,=D$, and globally hyperbolic posets are precisely globally hyperbolic spacetimes with $\le\,=J$, a necessity result beyond MP's sufficiency. Causal simplicity is recovered through a chain realizability condition, stable causality through the Hausdorffness of a topology $\tau$, so the causal ladder is fully determined at the abstract level, solving a problem posed by MP. Being phrased entirely in terms of a poset, the theory is of low regularity. We introduce topological Kronheimer--Penrose causal spaces, general enough to encompass the Lorentzian length spaces in the literature, and give weak conditions making them (bi)continuous posets. Domain-theoretic constructions then apply directly; e.g., Lawson's round-ideal completion, the most natural for preserving continuity, is proved to equal the future GKP completion, as is the directed completion of Gigli et al., for which we remove the (SC) assumption under strong causality. Reversing the logical order of the theory, we characterize the relations that induce a continuous poset having them as way-below relation. Finally, physical considerations on the key role of past-reflectivity in black hole evaporation lead us to suggest that spacetime is, at the fundamental level, a co-continuous poset.

一句话导读：通过连续偏序集与域论刻画时空因果结构，确定因果阶梯，并讨论黑洞蒸发中的 past-reflectivity 与余连续偏序集。

大角动量 Kerr 时空中 Morawetz 能量估计的物理空间推导

A Physical space derivation of Morawetz-Energy estimates in Kerr spacetimes with large angular momentum

Lili He, Sergiu Klainerman · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们重新审视 Kerr 时空 K(a,m) 的外通信域中标量波动方程的 Morawetz 能量估计推导。目标是在物理空间中发展稳健方法，以便推广到 Kerr 的现实扰动。证明依赖若干要素。首先，我们利用俘获零测地线完整 r 范围的物理空间刻画，推导条件 Morawetz 估计，推广 Andersson 与 Blue 开创、后由 GKS 适配到慢转 Kerr 扰动的物理空间技术。其次，我们采用 Stogin 在轴对称情形引入的想法处理 Morawetz 估计中的低频困难。一般情形下，低阶项的控制还要求充分利用 Morawetz 体范数中的主俘获项，并新颖地使用 Hardy 型不等式。一个关键新要素是控制 Morawetz 估计产生的边界项。我们以伴随论文 [He-K2] 的结果为输入；该文基于 Whiting 变换的纯物理空间版本给出与频率无关的 flux 估计。最后，连续性论证给出无条件的全局时间 Morawetz 估计，而通过构造一个在俘获集上为 Killing 的因果向量场得到新的能量估计。在新版本中，我们增加了一个更简单的新证明，覆盖完整次极端情形。这里证明的结果限于自旋 0 的标量波动方程，范围 |a|/m ≤ 0.75。我们预期这一限制是技术性的，本文发展的方法可推广到 Teukolsky 方程。

English: We revisit the derivation of Morawetz-energy estimates for scalar wave equations in the domain of outer communication of a Kerr spacetime $\KK(a,m)$. Our goal is to develop robust physical space methods which are well suited for extension to realistic perturbations of Kerr. The proof rests on several ingredients. First, we derive conditional Morawetz estimates which extend the physical space techniques initiated by Andersson and Blue \cite{AB}, and later adapted in \cite{GKS} to perturbations of slowly rotating Kerr, by exploiting a physical-space characterization of the full $r$-range of trapped null geodesics. Second, we use an idea introduced by Stogin \cite{St} in the axially symmetric case to handle the low-frequency difficulties in the Morawetz estimates. In the general case, the control of the lower order terms also requires making full use of the principal trapping term in the Morawetz bulk norm, together with a new use of Hardy-type inequalities. A crucial new ingredient is the control of the boundary terms generated by the Morawetz estimates. We use as input the results of our companion paper \cite{He-K2}, which provides a frequency independent estimate for the flux based on a purely physical space version of the seminal Whiting transform \cite{W}. Finally, a continuity argument yields an unconditional global-in-time Morawetz estimate, while a new energy estimate is obtained from the construction of a causal vectorfield which is Killing on the trapping set. In this new version we have added a new, much simpler, proof which covers the full subextremal case. The results proved here are restricted to scalar wave equations, corresponding to spin $0$, in the range $|a|/m\leq 0.75$. We expect this restriction to be technical, and the methods developed in this paper to extend to the Teukolsky equation.

一句话导读：在 Kerr 时空物理空间中推导大角动量下 Morawetz 能量估计，为推广到 Teukolsky 方程和现实扰动提供方法。

给正则黑洞充电

Charging up regular black holes

Ra\'ul Carballo-Rubio, Chiara Coviello, Vania Vellucci · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们提出一种带电正则黑洞的一般构造，作为球对称下 Einstein–Maxwell 场方程推广的解；其中 Einstein 张量被形变为一个恒等守恒的张量，最多包含引力场的二阶导数。该构造的普适性使我们能够定义一般正则黑洞在带电时所满足的场方程。保证带电解正则性的条件被评估，并表明它们比不带电溶液的正则性条件更严格。特别地，这意味着 Bardeen 和 Hayward 黑洞的带电版本会变成奇异。我们提出 Bardeen 和 Hayward 度规的改进版本，使其在带电时仍保持正则。结果表明，一般来说，仅将广义相对论的真空解正则化，并不足以在其他物理感兴趣的情形中给出正则解。我们讨论了这些结果对构造现实正则黑洞（考虑转动和物质场存在等）的启示。

English: We present a general construction of charged regular black holes as solutions of a generalization of the Einstein--Maxwell field equations in spherical symmetry in which the Einstein tensor is deformed into an identically conserved tensor containing up to second derivatives of the gravitational field. The generality of the construction allows us to define the field equations satisfied by generic regular black holes when becoming charged. The conditions that guarantee regularity of charged solutions are evaluated and shown to be more stringent than the regularity conditions for uncharged solutions. This implies, in particular, that the charged versions of the Bardeen and Hayward black holes become singular. Improved versions of the Bardeen and Hayward metrics that remain regular when charged are proposed. Our results indicate that regularizing the vacuum solutions of general relativity is, in general, not enough to yield regular solutions in other situations of physical interest. The implications that follow for the construction of realistic regular black holes, in which aspects such as rotation and the presence of matter fields are taken into account, are discussed.

一句话导读：在推广的 Einstein–Maxwell 方程中构造带电正则黑洞，并发现 Bardeen/Hayward 带电后奇异，给出改进正则解。

黑洞何时能穿裤子

When Black Holes Can Wear Pants

Giacomo Cacciapaglia, Manuel Del Piano, Francesco Sannino, Vania Vellucci · gr-qc, hep-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们研究黑洞碎裂——即黑洞视界分裂成多个更小视界——可能发生的条件。最简单的实现是单个黑洞视界分裂为两个，产生同名的“裤子”拓扑。在经典广义相对论中，Bekenstein-Hawking 面积定律禁止 Schwarzschild 黑洞发生此类过程。对于旋转 Kerr 黑洞，纯运动学分析给出了阻止碎裂的限制，即使在熵考虑可能允许的情况下也是如此，除非可能处于近极端情形。随后我们寻找黑洞可以“穿裤子”的场景：从高维中著名的 Gregory-Laflamme 不稳定性，到非轴对称辐射囚禁中超辐射不稳定性的潜在效应，最后到修改四维中熵和/或视界半径与黑洞质量关系的引力模型。在所有这些情形中，发射小碎片可以在熵意义上有利，但其发生仍取决于初始状态的运动学构型。我们的分析澄清了黑洞可能发生碎裂的理论图景，这对原初黑洞以及黑洞并合等灾变事件尤其相关。

English: We investigate the conditions under which black hole fragmentation, the splitting of a black hole horizon into multiple smaller ones, may occur. The simplest realization is that of a single black hole horizon splitting into two, giving rise to the eponymous pants topology. In classical general relativity, the Bekenstein-Hawking area law forbids such processes for Schwarzschild black holes. For spinning Kerr black holes, purely kinematic analyses impose constraints that prevent fragmentation, even in regimes where entropy considerations might allow it, except possibly in near-extremal cases. We then hunt for scenarios where black holes can wear pants: from the well-known Gregory-Laflamme instability in higher dimensions, to the potential effect of superradiant instabilities in non-axisymmetric radiation trapping, to finally gravitational models that modify the relations between entropy and/or horizon radius and the black hole mass in four dimensions. In all such cases, emission of small fragments can be entropically favored, however its occurrence still depends on the kinematic configuration of the initial state. Our analysis clarifies the theoretical landscape where black holes may fragment, which is particularly relevant for primordial black holes and catastrophic events such as black hole mergers.

一句话导读：讨论黑洞视界分裂成多个小视界（“裤子”拓扑）的条件，指出经典面积定律与 Kerr 运动学限制，并考察 Gregory-Laflamme、超辐射及修改引力等可能途径。

非最小耦合产生的一种潜在黑洞模仿者

A Potential Black Hole Mimicker From Non-Minimal Coupling

Debanjan Debnath, Rikpratik Sengupta, Kaushik Bhattacharya · gr-qc, astro-ph.HE, hep-ph · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们提出了一类无事件视界、规则的超致密天体，它们出现在允许曲率-流体耦合的引力理论中。流体变量与Ricci标量之间的非最小相互作用在内部产生类真空物态方程，而外部保持精确的Schwarzschild解。两个时空通过连接处的薄壳粘合。内部度规非奇异，薄壳获得硬物质物态方程，且近视界致密性使该构型能够在没有事件视界的情况下模仿黑洞现象学。对于天体物理动机的5–7 km半径范围（作为外部输入而非理论预言），在适当选择曲率-流体耦合系数时，模型的质-致密性关系将该半径窗口映射到1.4–2.1 M⊙的质量窗口。我们在冻结体近似下对薄壳进行了详细稳定性分析，确定了内部处处规则且薄壳稳定的致密性窗口，并通过显式绝热参数量化冻结体近似的精度。然后，假设超致密天体起源于类一级相变，我们发展了薄壳的表面热力学。该想法导致壳层温度和辐射，壳层温度标度 T_Σ ∝ M^{-1/2} 成为模型可证伪的预言。

English: We present a class of horizonless, regular ultra-compact objects arising in a theory of gravity that allows curvature-fluid coupling. The non-minimal interaction between fluid variables and the Ricci scalar generates a vacuum-like equation of state in the interior, while the exterior remains exactly Schwarzschild. The two spacetimes are glued through a thin shell at the junction. The interior metric is non-singular, the shell acquires a stiff-matter equation of state, and near-horizon compactness allows the configuration to mimic black-hole phenomenology without an event horizon. For radii in the astrophysically motivated range $5$--$7$ km, imposed as an external input rather than predicted by the theory, the model's mass-compactness relation maps this radius window onto a mass window of $1.4$-$2.1 M_\odot$ for a suitable choice of the curvature-fluid coupling coefficient. We carry out a detailed stability analysis of the shell in the frozen-bulk approximation, identify the compactness window in which the interior is everywhere regular and the shell is stable, and quantify the accuracy of the frozen-bulk approximation through an explicit adiabaticity parameter. We then develop the surface thermodynamics of the shell assuming a first order phase transition-like origin of the ultra-compact object. This idea then gives rise to shell temperature and radiation, the shell temperature scaling $T_\Sigma \propto M^{-1/2}$ turns out to be a falsifiable predictions of the model.

一句话导读：非最小曲率-流体耦合给出无事件视界、外为Schwarzschild的超致密天体，其薄壳稳定性和T∝M^{-1/2}表面热力学可作为黑洞模仿者的可检验预言。

黑洞铃宕中避免交叉的可探测性

Detectability of avoided crossings in black hole ringdowns

Hayato Imafuku, Naritaka Oshita, Hiroki Takeda · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：黑洞的准正规模（QNM）可以表现出避免交叉（AC）：某些 QNM 频率相互靠近，同时其振幅增强并获得几乎相反的相位，从而导致特征性干涉。通过黑洞光谱学分辨这类间距很近的模式在观测上具有挑战性。本文在贝叶斯框架下，使用三种波形模型，研究存在 AC 时近简并 QNM 的可探测性。我们考察复频率和振幅的推断如何依赖于两个 QNM 频率之间的间距以及模板波形的选择。我们发现，即使在乐观条件下，分辨单个 QNM 频率也很困难。另一方面，与 AC 相关的集体波形特征仍可能通过互补的波形描述被识别，前提是 AC 相关模式主导观测到的铃宕信号，并且来自阻尼更慢模式的污染可忽略或可以被移除。

English: Quasinormal modes (QNMs) of black holes can exhibit avoided crossings (ACs), in which specific QNM frequencies approach each other while their amplitudes are enhanced and acquire nearly opposite phases, leading to characteristic interference. Resolving such closely spaced modes through black hole spectroscopy is observationally challenging. In this paper, we investigate the detectability of nearly degenerate QNMs in the presence of an AC within a Bayesian framework using three waveform models. We examine how the inference of the complex frequencies and amplitudes depends on the separation between the two QNM frequencies and on the choice of template waveform. We find that resolving the individual QNM frequencies is difficult even under optimistic conditions. On the other hand, collective waveform signatures associated with ACs may still be identified through complementary waveform descriptions, provided that the AC-related modes dominate the observed ringdown signal and contamination from more slowly damped modes is negligible or can be removed.

一句话导读：在贝叶斯分析中评估黑洞铃宕里避免交叉导致的近简并准正规模能否被分辨，发现单个模式频率难以分辨，但集体波形特征在有利条件下可能被识别。

自旋先验对广义相对论参数化检验的影响

The Impact of Spin Priors on Parameterized Tests of General Relativity

Tian-hao Wu, Shu-Jun Rong · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：自旋先验在引力波参数估计中起着基础性作用，但其对广义相对论（GR）参数化检验的影响仍未得到充分理解。我们利用真实引力波事件，系统研究了自旋先验选择如何影响1.5PN偏离参数 $\delta \hat{\phi}_3$。先验诱导效应通过Jensen--Shannon散度和后验中位数偏移来量化。我们发现，$\chi_p$ 对自旋先验的敏感性显著高于 $\chi_{\rm eff}$，而 $\delta \hat{\phi}_3$ 总体稳健，但在低信息区间可能表现出较大偏移。GW231123_135430 表现出特别强的敏感性，但其推断性质受波形模型和事件特定系统误差影响，因此在解释受该事件强烈影响的结果时需要谨慎。当 $\delta \hat{\phi}_3$ 被纳入参数估计模型时，$\chi_{\rm eff}$ 与 $\delta \hat{\phi}_3$ 的先验敏感性之间出现强关联，这与它们在1.5PN阶的部分简并一致，而 $\chi_p$ 仍仅弱相关。留一法检验表明，GW231123_135430 显著影响关联强度，但移除该事件后关联仍然存在。这些结果表明，自旋先验选择会传播到GR参数化检验中，在解释表观偏离GR时应当仔细考虑。

English: Spin priors play a fundamental role in gravitational-wave parameter estimation, yet their impact on parameterized tests of General Relativity (GR) remains insufficiently understood. We systematically investigate how spin-prior choices affect the 1.5PN deviation parameter $\delta \hat{\phi}_3$ using real gravitational-wave events. Prior-induced effects are quantified through the Jensen--Shannon divergence and posterior median shifts. We find that $\chi_p$ is significantly more sensitive to the spin prior than $\chi_{\rm eff}$, while $\delta \hat{\phi}_3$ is generally robust but can exhibit larger shifts in low-information regimes. GW231123_135430 shows particularly strong sensitivity, but its inferred properties are subject to waveform-model and event-specific systematics, warranting caution in interpreting results strongly influenced by this event. When $\delta \hat{\phi}_3$ is included in the parameter-estimation model, a strong correlation emerges between the prior sensitivities of $\chi_{\rm eff}$ and $\delta \hat{\phi}_3$, consistent with their partial degeneracy at the 1.5PN order, whereas $\chi_p$ remains weakly correlated. A leave-one-out test shows that GW231123\_135430 significantly affects the correlation strength, but the correlation persists when this event is removed. These results demonstrate that spin-prior choices can propagate into parameterized tests of GR and should be carefully accounted for when interpreting apparent deviations from GR.

一句话导读：研究表明自旋先验选择会影响引力波参数化检验中的1.5PN偏离参数，需谨慎解释表观GR偏离。

对称远平行引力的形成期

The formative years of symmetric teleparallel gravity

Muzaffer Adak · gr-qc, physics.hist-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：在广义相对论重合表述提出以及2018年后 f(Q) 引力迅速发展之后，对称远平行引力已成为修改引力中最活跃的研究领域之一。随着该领域快速扩张，其形成期（2004—2013年）建立的一些概念与几何发展在当代文献中变得不那么显眼。本文回顾对称远平行引力的早期发展，并将这些贡献置于度量-仿射引力更广泛的历史演进中。特别关注 Einstein 等价场方程、五参数二次非度规拉格朗日量及其场方程、自然（纯）规范下的度规表述、精确解以及旋量耦合。其中若干发展最初发表在 Turkish Journal of Physics，包括术语“symmetric teleparallel gravity”及其缩写“STPG”的使用。我们将这些贡献与 Nester 和 Yo 更早的对称远平行表述区分开，后者已在坐标架中使用消失联络。与近期 f(Q) 引力代表性工作的简短比较将这一历史叙述置于当前语境。本文记录了该领域早期几何基础与后续发展之间的连续性。

English: Following the introduction of the coincident formulation of General Relativity and the rapid development of $f(Q)$ gravity after 2018, symmetric teleparallel gravity has become one of the most active research areas in modified gravity. As the field has expanded rapidly, some of the conceptual and geometric developments established during its formative years have become less visible in the contemporary literature. This article revisits the early development of symmetric teleparallel gravity between 2004 and 2013 and places these contributions within the broader historical evolution of metric-affine gravity. Particular attention is devoted to Einstein-equivalent field equations, five-parameter quadratic non-metricity Lagrangians and their field equations, the metric formulation in the natural (pure) gauge, exact solutions, and spinor couplings. Several of these developments were originally published in the Turkish Journal of Physics, including the use of the terminology ``symmetric teleparallel gravity'' and its abbreviation ``STPG''. We distinguish these contributions from the earlier symmetric teleparallel formulation of Nester and Yo, who had already used a vanishing connection in a coordinate frame. A short comparison with representative recent work on $f(Q)$ gravity places the historical account in its present context. This letter documents the continuity between the early geometric foundations and subsequent developments of the field.

一句话导读：回顾2004—2013年对称远平行引力的早期几何基础、场方程与历史脉络，并联系当代 f(Q) 引力。

一类 d 维规则黑洞：阴影、热力学与引力坍缩

A class of $d$-dimensional regular black holes: Shadows, Thermodynamics and Gravitational collapse

A. Sadeghi, F. Shojai · gr-qc · v4 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们研究了一类由 de Sitter 核心刻画的一般 d 维规则黑洞，它来自具有任意多方指数 n 的多方恒星的引力坍缩。该框架将著名的 Bardeen 和 Hayward 黑洞推广到更高维，并确认带有磁单极荷的非线性电动力学是保证曲率正则性的物理源。几何结构和能量条件表明，弱能量条件与零能量条件满足，而强能量条件被违背，这是避免曲率奇点所必需的特征。对光学性质的研究揭示了稳定与不稳定光子球的存在，阴影只持续到临界磁荷极限；超过该阈值后，该客体变成无视界的致密天体。数值结果表明，阴影尺寸随维度 d、电荷 q 或指数 n 增大而减小，从而可利用 M87* 与 Sgr A* 的 EHT 观测给出限制。在热力学上，与不稳定的 Schwarzschild-Tangherlini 解不同，这些规则黑洞表现出局部稳定区域和相变，且在高维中熵偏离标准面积律。最后，我们将 Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt 坍缩情景推广到该背景。我们追踪视界的演化，并推导出物理黑洞形成所需的初始恒星半径的临界下界。结果表明，增大维数和多方指数会延迟坍缩的固有时，而磁荷通过减小最小初始半径促进该过程。这些发现为曲率规则黑洞作为高维引力中可能的无曲率奇点坍缩终态提供了新见解。

English: We investigate a general class of $d$-dimensional regular black holes characterized by a de Sitter core, which arises from the gravitational collapse of a polytropic star with an arbitrary polytropic index $n$. This framework generalizes the well-known Bardeen and Hayward black holes to higher dimensions and identifies nonlinear electrodynamics with a magnetic monopole charge as the physical source ensuring curvature regularity. Geometric structure and energy conditions, demonstrate that while the Weak and Null Conditions are satisfied, the Strong Energy Condition is violated, a necessary feature for curvature singularity avoidance. Our study of optical properties reveals the existence of stable and unstable photon spheres, with shadows persisting only up to a critical magnetic charge limit; beyond this threshold, the object becomes a horizonless compact object. Numerical results indicate that the shadow size decreases as the dimension $d$, charge $q$, or index $n$ increases, allowing for constraints based on EHT observations of M87* and SgrA*. Thermodynamically, unlike the unstable Schwarzschild-Tangherlini solution, these regular black holes exhibit regions of local stability and phase transitions, with entropy deviating from the standard area law in higher dimensions. Finally, we generalize the Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt collapse scenario to this background. We track the evolution of horizons, and derive a critical lower bound for the initial stellar radius required for physical black hole formation. Our results show that increasing dimensions and the polytropic index delay the collapse proper time, while magnetic charge facilitates the process by reducing the minimum initial radius. These findings provide new insights into the viability of curvature-regular black holes as possible curvature-singularity-free endpoints of gravitational collapse in higher-dimensional gravity.

中文摘要：我们研究一个旋转虫洞，其锥形亏损沿固有径向方向变化。变化的亏损产生混合爱因斯坦方程以及普通恒定张力锥形弦所没有的额外近轴应力。同一径向变化改变了标量波问题：非轴对称模式不再分离为独立的径向和角向方程，而是形成耦合的角向通道。我们以闭合形式得到耦合系数，证明精确的宇称选择规则，并导出领头弱缺陷通道转换振幅。有限通道数值计算证实转换概率的预期二次标度，并在所测试的角向截断下显示稳定的低通道结果。

We obtain the coupling coefficients in closed form, prove an exact parity selection rule, and derive the leading weak-defect channel-conversion amplitude. A finite-channel numerical calculation confirms the expected quadratic scaling of the conversion probability and shows stable low-channel results over the angular truncations tested.

English: We construct one-parameter families of static spherically symmetric asymptotically anti-de Sitter black hole solutions $(\mathcal{M},g_{\epsilon},\phi_{\epsilon})$ to the Einstein-Maxwell-(charged) Klein-Gordon equations. For a co-dimensional one set of black hole parameters, we show that Dirichlet (respectively Neumann) boundary conditions can be imposed for the scalar field. The construction provides a counter-example to a version of the no-hair conjecture in the context of a negative cosmological constant. Our result is based on our companion work [W. Zheng, \emph{Exponentially-growing Mode Instability on the Reissner-Nordstr\"om-Anti-de-Sitter black holes}], in which the existence of linear hair and growing mode solutions has been established. In the charged scalar field case, our result provides the first rigorous mathematical construction of the so-called holographic superconductors, which are of particular significance in high-energy physics.

自旋进动双星中的宇称破缺：动力学 Chern-Simons 引力中黑洞旋近的引力波

Parity Violation in Spin-Precessing Binaries: Gravitational Waves from the Inspiral of Black Holes in Dynamical Chern-Simons Gravity

Nicholas Loutrel, Nicolas Yunes · gr-qc · v3 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：致密双星中的自旋进动与构成双星的天体的多极结构精细相关。对于黑洞，广义相对论修正诱导的无毛定理违反会修正进动动力学，进而印记在双星所发射引力波的振幅和相位调制上。最近，针对动力学 Chern-Simons 引力这一宇称破缺的修改引力理论，自旋进动方程已被推导至自旋二阶。我们在此求解这些方程，并首次利用后牛顿近似，为修改引力理论中自旋进动黑洞双星的准圆旋近构建了时域和频域引力波的解析表达式。在小耦合近似下并使用多尺度分析，我们表明对章动相位的修正以相对 1PN 阶进入，对进动角和 Thomas 相位的修正以相对 0PN 阶进入。利用驻相近似和移位均匀渐近，我们发现波形的傅里叶相位由三项修正刻画：两项来自进动动力学对自旋-轨道和自旋-自旋耦合的反作用，分别以 1.5PN 和 2PN 阶进入；还有一项 2PN 修正来自偶极辐射的发射。我们还发现，进动动力学的反作用迫使 dCS 对傅里叶振幅的修正以 0PN 阶进入，而不是自旋对齐双星中预期的 2PN 阶。我们的工作为构建修改引力理论中自旋进动双星的旋近-并合-铃宕唯象模型奠定了首批基础。

English: Spin precession in compact binaries is intricately tuned to the multipole structure of the underlying bodies. For black holes, violations of the no-hair theorems induced by modifications to general relativity correct the precession dynamics, which in turn imprints onto the amplitude and phase modulations of the gravitational waves emitted by the binary. Recently, the spin precession equations were derived up to second order in spin for dynamical Chern-Simons gravity, a parity violating modified theory of gravity. We here solve these equations and construct, for the first time, analytic expressions for the time- and frequency-domain gravitational waves emitted in the quasi-circular inspiral of spin-precessing black hole binaries in a modified theory of gravity using the post-Newtonian approximation. Working within the small coupling approximation and using multiple scale analysis, we show that the corrections to the nutation phase enter at relative 1PN order, and the corrections to the precession angle and Thomas phase enter at relative 0PN order. Making use of the stationary phase approximation and shifted uniform asymptotics, we find that the Fourier phase of the waveform is characterized by three modifications, two due to the back-reaction of the precession dynamics onto the spin-orbit and spin-spin couplings that enter at 1.5PN and 2PN orders, and a 2PN modification due to the emission of dipole radiation. We also find that back-reaction of the precession dynamics forces the dCS corrections to the Fourier amplitude to enter at 0PN order, as opposed to 2PN order, as expected for spin-aligned binaries. Our work lays the first foundational stones to build an inspiral-merger-ringdown phenomenological model for spin-precessing binaries in a modified theory of gravity.

接近力矩平衡的吸积中子星自旋游走：对引力波搜寻的意义

Spin wandering of an accreting neutron star near torque balance: implications for gravitational wave searches

Andrew Melatos · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：引力辐射反作用与磁离心吸积之间的力矩平衡是吸积中子星自转慢于离心解体速度的原因之一。吸积盘中的随机过程，如瑞利-泰勒不稳定性和闪烁噪声，会驱动自旋频率 f_* 和引力波频率 f_gw ∝ f_* 在力矩平衡值附近随机游走。本文通过理想化 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 模型从理论上表明，f_gw 的标准差为 σ_{f_gw}(h_0) ∝ f_gw h_0 D β T^{1/2}，或等价地 σ_{f_gw}(F_X) ∝ f_gw^{1/2} F_X^{1/2} D β T^{1/2}，其中 h_0 是特征波应变，F_X 是 X 射线通量，D 是源距离，β 和 T 是随机力矩的分数振幅和自相关时间尺度。可以用 σ_{f_gw}(h_0) 和 σ_{f_gw}(F_X) 与观测到的 σ_{f_gw} 比较，以检验引力波搜寻中候选探测的物理自洽性。自旋游走影响搜寻设计，因为它设定了最大时间间隔 max(T_coh)，在此期间信号可视为相干。Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 计算预测，对于瑞利-泰勒不稳定性和闪烁噪声，10^{-1} ≲ max(T_coh)/(1 天) ≲ 10^3，且 3×10^{-2} ≲ β T^{1/2}/(1 s^{1/2}) ≲ 4。预测的 max(T_coh) 通常短于当今音频波段干涉仪为期一年的观测运行，这强调了半相干搜寻算法的实用性，该算法将数据分成多个持续时间为 max(T_coh) 的相干段。

English: Torque balance between gravitational radiation reaction and magnetocentrifugal accretion is one reason why accreting neutron stars rotate slower than centrifugal break-up. Random processes in the accretion disk, such as Rayleigh-Taylor instabilities and flicker noise, drive the spin frequency $f_\ast$ and gravitational wave frequency $f_{\rm gw}\propto f_\ast$ to wander stochastically around their torque balance values. Here it is shown theoretically, in terms of an idealized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck model, that the standard deviation of $f_{\rm gw}$ is given by $\sigma_{f_{\rm gw}}(h_0) \propto f_{\rm gw} h_0 D \beta T^{1/2}$, or equivalently $\sigma_{f_{\rm gw}}(F_{\rm X}) \propto f_{\rm gw}^{1/2} F_{\rm X}^{1/2} D \beta T^{1/2}$, where $h_0$ is the characteristic wave strain, $F_{\rm X}$ is the X-ray flux, $D$ is the source distance, and $\beta$ and $T$ are the fractional amplitude and autocorrelation time-scale of the stochastic torque. One can use $\sigma_{f_{\rm gw}}(h_0)$ and $\sigma_{f_{\rm gw}}(F_{\rm X})$ to check the physical consistency of a detection candidate in a gravitational wave search by comparing with $\sigma_{f_{\rm gw}}$ observed. Spin wandering impacts search design, because it sets the maximum time interval $\max(T_{\rm coh})$, during which the signal may be treated as coherent. The Ornstein-Uhlenbeck calculation predicts $10^{-1} \lesssim \max(T_{\rm coh}) / (1\, {\rm day}) \lesssim 10^3$, with $3\times 10^{-2} \lesssim \beta T^{1/2} / (1 \, {\rm s^{1/2}} ) \lesssim 4$, for Rayleigh-Taylor instabilities and flicker noise. The predicted $\max(T_{\rm coh})$ is shorter typically than the year-long observation runs of audio-band interferometers operating today, emphasizing the utility of semi-coherent search algorithms, which divide the data into multiple coherent segments of duration $\max(T_{\rm coh})$.

并非所有在星团中形成的黑洞双星自旋都是各向同性的，也并非所有孤立形成的黑洞双星自旋都是对齐的

Not all spins of black-hole binaries formed in clusters are isotropic and not all spins of black-hole binaries formed in isolation are aligned

Sofia Dossena, Davide Gerosa, Tristan Bruel · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：自旋方向是借助引力波观测区分恒星级双黑洞并合形成通道的有前景观测量。在本工作中，我们挑战标准预期：通过星团中的动力学相互作用形成的双星具有各向同性分布的自旋，而孤立形成的双星自旋与轨道角动量对齐。对于动力学形成的双星，我们考虑了观测结果所暗示的星团恒星自旋可能具有某种偏好对齐程度，并构建了由此产生的黑洞自旋方向的简单几何描述。这给出了第一代黑洞双星极角的解析联合分布，其关键特征是两个自旋-轨道倾角之间存在相关性。我们表明，在合理假设下且独立于初始自旋构型，自旋在一次黑洞并合后完全随机化，这意味着通过层级并合形成的双星具有各向同性分布的自旋取向。对于孤立双星，我们引入一个简单模型，将自旋演化表示为第一次超新星爆发所赋予的 natal kick 的函数，同时考虑潮汐相互作用和质量比反转。所得分布也是完全解析的。我们研究了相对论性自旋进动以及星团有限逃逸速度对几何推导分布的影响。我们的结果为在引力波族群拟合中建模并合黑洞的自旋方向提供了一个简单的解析框架。

English: Spin directions are promising observables for distinguishing between the formation channels of merging stellar-mass binary black holes with gravitational-wave observations. In this work, we challenge the standard expectation that binaries formed via dynamical interactions in stellar clusters have isotropically distributed spins and that binaries formed in isolation have spins aligned with the orbital angular momentum. For dynamically formed binaries, we account for observational findings suggesting that the spins of stars in clusters may exhibit a preferred degree of alignment and construct a simple geometrical description of the resulting black-hole spin directions. This results in an analytical joint distribution for the polar angles of first-generation black-hole binaries, whose key feature is a correlation between the two spin-orbit tilts. We show that, under reasonable assumptions and independently of the initial spin configuration, spins are fully randomized after a single black-hole merger, implying that binaries formed through hierarchical mergers have isotropically distributed spin orientations. For isolated binaries, we introduce a simple model for spin evolution as a function of the natal kick imparted during the first supernova explosion, while accounting for tidal interactions and mass-ratio reversal. The resulting distribution is also fully analytic. We investigate the impact of relativistic spin precession, as well as that of the finite escape speed of clusters, on our geometrically derived distributions. Our results provide a simple analytical framework for modeling the spin directions of merging black holes in gravitational-wave population fits.

从密度到质量：黑洞周围暗物质环境的新参数化框架

From Density to Mass: A New Parametrized Framework for Dark Matter Environment Around Black Holes

Rajes Ghosh, Nicholas Speeney, Avijit Chowdhury, Chiranjeeb Singha, Miguel A. S. Pinto, Emanuele Berti · gr-qc, astro-ph.GA · v1 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：天体物理黑洞并非孤立真空天体，而是预期处在暗物质晕和重子分布等复杂环境中。此类环境会修改黑洞周围时空几何，并在引力波信号中留下可观测印记，包括准正规模谱、潮汐勒夫数以及极端质量比旋近的旋近动力学变化。我们发展了一个描述暗物质包裹黑洞时空的一般框架：直接以包围质量函数而非传统基于密度的轮廓来参数化几何。这种基于质量的表述自然联系到总引力场，可将若干常见晕轮廓作为极限情形，并纳入正则性、因果性和适当渐近行为等基本物理一致性要求。在此框架内，我们研究环境对 QNM、TLN 以及 EMRI 引力波通量的印记。我们发现对晕结构存在互补敏感性：QNM 主要探测环境的内区，而静态 TLN 对环境外区更敏感；EMRI 通量则通过影响轨道运动和引力波传播来探测物质分布。我们的结果确立了包围质量表述作为一个灵活且物理可控的框架，用于连接天体物理环境模型与精密引力波观测量。

English: Astrophysical black holes (BHs) are not isolated vacuum objects but are expected to reside within complex environments, such as dark matter (DM) halos and baryonic distributions. Such environments can modify the spacetime geometry surrounding the BH and leave observable imprints on gravitational-wave (GW) signals, including shifts in the quasinormal mode (QNM) spectrum, tidal Love numbers (TLNs), and the inspiral dynamics of extreme-mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs). We develop a general framework for describing DM-dressed BH spacetimes by parameterizing the geometry directly in terms of the enclosed mass function, rather than the traditional density-based profile. This mass-based formulation is naturally connected to the total gravitational field, accommodates several common halo profiles as limiting cases, and incorporates basic physical consistency requirements such as regularity, causality, and appropriate asymptotic behavior. Within this framework, we investigate the environmental imprints on QNMs, TLNs, and GW fluxes from EMRIs. We find a complementary sensitivity to the halo structure: QNMs predominantly probe the inner regions of the environment, whereas static TLNs are more sensitive to its outer structure. EMRI fluxes, in contrast, probe the matter distribution through its influence on the orbital motion and GW propagation. Our results establish the enclosed-mass formulation as a flexible and physically controlled framework for connecting astrophysical environment models with precision GW observables.

一句话导读：提出以包围质量函数直接参数化暗物质包裹黑洞时空的框架，并揭示 QNM、TLN 与 EMRI 通量对环境内外结构及轨道传播的互补敏感性。

耦合场下黑洞铃宕中的避免交叉与共振：以爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-轴子系统为例

Avoided crossings and resonances in black hole ringdown with coupled fields: A case study of the Einstein-Maxwell-axion system

Takuya Takahashi, Hayato Motohashi, Kazufumi Takahashi · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：黑洞准正规模（QNM）谱中的避免交叉展现出特征性的共振性质，包括增强的激发因子。我们将这一现象的研究推广到具有多个耦合场的微扰系统，并考察其对铃宕波形的影响。作为具体例子，我们考虑爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦-轴子系统中的一个带电黑洞，其 QNM 分支可按在解耦极限下各自连续连接到的引力、电磁和轴子模式进行分类。我们关注按上述方式定义的、由引力主导和电磁主导的两个分支之间的一个避免交叉。我们验证 QNM 重构能准确再现直接演化的时域波形的铃宕部分。在避免交叉附近，对于特定初始微扰会出现有效更慢的衰减，而两个 QNM 的共振增强贡献在物理波形中在很大程度上相互抵消。QNM 分解进一步揭示，两个分支的物理特征在共振两侧发生交换。这些结果刻画了多耦合场系统中共振在黑洞铃宕上的印记。

English: Avoided crossings in black hole quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectra exhibit characteristic resonant properties, including enhanced excitation factors. We extend the study of this phenomenon to perturbation systems with multiple coupled fields and investigate its consequences for ringdown waveforms. As a concrete example, we consider a charged black hole in the Einstein-Maxwell-axion system, whose QNM branches can be classified according to the gravitational, electromagnetic, and axion modes to which they continuously connect in the decoupling limit. We focus on an avoided crossing between the gravity- and electromagnetic-led branches thus defined. We verify that the QNM reconstruction accurately reproduces the ringdown portion of the directly evolved time-domain waveform. Near the avoided crossing, an effectively slower decay emerges for particular initial perturbations, while the resonantly enhanced contributions from the two QNMs largely cancel in the physical waveform. The QNM decomposition further reveals an exchange of the physical characters of the two branches across the resonance. These results characterize the imprint of resonances on black hole ringdown in systems with multiple coupled fields.

中文摘要：引力波（GW）观测为探测新基本场提供了强大手段。一个动机充分的源是黑洞（BH）-玻色云系统：其中超轻标量场通过超辐射在旋转黑洞周围形成云，并发出长寿命、近单色引力波。本文计算了这类系统产生的随机引力波背景（SGWB），通过包含标量自相互作用扩展了先前工作，并讨论了下一代地面引力波探测器对其的可探测性。我们发现自相互作用会抑制SGWB，从而放宽由零结果搜索得到的现有LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA限制。也就是说，设计灵敏度的LIGO探测器对衰减常数 f_s ≲ 3×10^17 GeV 的标量场产生的SGWB不敏感，且与标量场质量无关。展望未来，我们表明中等自相互作用的云仍能产生可被下一代探测器探测到的SGWB。在保守假设下，对于衰减常数 f_s = 10^17 GeV，Einstein Telescope (ET) 将对约 [10^{-13.0},10^{-11.8}] eV 范围内的标量质量敏感，而 Cosmic Explorer (CE) 将对约 [10^{-13.2},10^{-11.7}] eV 范围内的标量质量敏感。我们还发现，对于ET和CE，仍能产生可探测SGWB的最小衰减常数分别约为 f_s ∼ 6×10^16 GeV 和 ∼3×10^16 GeV。

English: Gravitational-wave (GW) observations offer a powerful probe of new fundamental fields. One well-motivated source is black hole (BH)--boson cloud systems, in which an ultralight scalar field forms a cloud around a rotating BH via superradiance and emits long-lived nearly monochromatic GWs. In this work, we compute the stochastic GW background (SGWB) from such systems, extending previous work by including scalar self-interactions, and discuss its detectability with next-generation ground-based GW detectors. We find that self-interactions can suppress the SGWB and thereby relax existing LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA constraints inferred from null searches. Namely, the LIGO detectors at design sensitivity are insensitive to a SGWB produced by scalar fields with a decay constant $f_\mathrm{s} \lesssim 3\times 10^{17}$ GeV, independently of the scalar field mass. Looking ahead, we show that a moderately self-interacting cloud can still produce a detectable SGWB with next-generation detectors. Under conservative assumptions, for a decay constant $f_\mathrm{s} = 10^{17}$ GeV, the Einstein Telescope (ET) will be sensitive to scalar masses in the range $\sim[10^{-13.0},10^{-11.8}]$ eV, while Cosmic Explorer (CE) will be sensitive to scalar masses in the range $\sim[10^{-13.2},10^{-11.7}]$ eV. We also find that the minimum decay constants that still yield a detectable SGWB for ET and CE are $f_\mathrm{s}\sim 6\times10^{16}\,$GeV and $\sim 3\times10^{16}\,$GeV, respectively.

English: We study scalar and electromagnetic quasinormal modes of the Hayward black hole and the axial spectrum of a specified Regge--Wheeler-type effective model, from the Schwarzschild limit to exact extremality. Multiprecision Chebyshev collocation reproduces most available low-lying oscillatory benchmarks and supplies further overtone candidates. The spin-2 equation is model dependent. It differs from the effective-source potential used in recent Hayward studies, and we quantify representative frequency differences. The discretisation also produces purely imaginary eigenvalue sequences, whose physical classification requires special care because highly reproducible imaginary-axis ladders need not be poles of the continued Green function. Accordingly, the imaginary-axis entries reported here are retained as unclassified spectral candidates, not established QNMs. We quantify their finite-table gap dispersion and sensitivity to the number of included gaps. Their spacings near one quarter in $M\omega$, and the extremal product near $1/3$ with the throat radius, remain properties of the tabulated candidates, and they do not establish universal QNM spacing or throat-controlled damping.

Zoey Zhiyuan Dong, Hao-Jui Kuan, Nicolas Yunes · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：中子星内部的一阶相变可以在极向准正规模谱中留下印记。我们对具有尖锐强子—夸克界面的冷、非转动混合星，在完整广义相对论下计算了复四极 f 模和 p1 模谱。我们通过将强子 SLy4 相与常声速夸克相匹配来建模状态方程。我们比较慢速相变，其中流体元保持其相态且界面随流体运动，与快速相变，其中物质穿过边界时改变相态且界面遵循相平衡而非流体，并给出这两种极限之间的代数插值。在相同的平衡背景上，两种物理极限在 p1 模频率实部产生显著分离。当本征函数的局域切向位移分数在界面处快速变化时，这种 p1 频率分离最大。在所考察的状态方程参数空间内，快速相变通常相对于慢速相变降低 p1 模频率，在断开的双星分支上，紧致度平均的分离可达约 3.5 kHz。最大分离出现在相对较低的转变压强和较大的密度不连续处。相比之下，对于单个恒星模型，f 模仅受界面条件弱影响。在所采样的常声速参数空间中，超过强子 SLy4 参考残差的偏离主要出现在低转变压强、大密度不连续或两者兼有时，并且实部和虚部拟合变量的边界不同。因此，p1 模探测局域界面响应，而所追踪的 f 模反映混合星序列相对于强子校准的整体偏离。

English: First-order phase transitions in neutron-star interiors can leave signatures in the polar quasi-normal-mode spectrum. We compute the complex quadrupolar $f$- and $p_1$-mode spectra in full general relativity for cold, nonrotating hybrid stars with a sharp hadron--quark interface. We model the equation of state by matching a hadronic SLy4 phase to a constant-sound-speed quark-phase. We compare slow phase conversion, in which fluid elements retain their phase and the interface moves with the fluid, with rapid phase conversion, in which matter changes phase as it crosses the boundary and the interface follows phase equilibrium rather than the fluid, together with an algebraic interpolation between these limits. On identical equilibrium backgrounds, the two physical limits produce a sizable separation in the real part of the $p_1$-mode frequency. This $p_1$ frequency separation is largest when the local tangential-displacement fraction of the eigenfunction changes rapidly across the interface. Across the surveyed EOS parameter space, rapid conversion generally lowers the $p_1$-mode frequency relative to slow conversion, with compactness-averaged separations reaching $\sim3.5\,{\rm kHz}$ on disconnected twin-star branches. The largest separations occur at relatively low transition pressures and large density discontinuities. By contrast, the $f$-mode is only weakly affected by the interface condition for individual stellar models. Across the sampled constant-sound-speed parameter space, departures exceeding the hadronic SLy4 reference residual occur mainly at low transition pressure, large density discontinuity, or both, with different boundaries for the real- and imaginary-part fitting variables. Thus, the $p_1$-mode probes the local interface response, whereas the tracked $f$-mode reflects the global departure of the hybrid sequence from the hadronic calibration.

中文摘要：研究引力波（GWs）为量子物质与时空动力学之间的相互作用提供了独特探针。我们通过在线性化引力背景中量子化电磁场，建立了一个在弱经典引力波存在时描述自发辐射的 QED 框架。我们表明，经过的引力波会动态地对真空电磁模式进行相位调制，将光子态缀饰为以引力波频率间隔的 Floquet 边带阶梯。虽然总自发衰变速率在引力波应变一阶下保持不变，但发射图样会出现特征性的自旋-2 四极角向重分布，并受引力波相位调制。对于有限相互作用时间，载波与 Floquet 边带之间的干涉会在瞬态发射谱中产生依赖相位的谱不对称。为探索实验可观测性，我们构建了腔 QED 主方程描述，并提出了一种采用里德堡系综或高电荷离子的差分跨腔探测协议。这些结果确立了腔 QED 作为探索动态时空中量子电动力学以及高频引力波探测的有前景平台。

English: Studying Gravitational Waves (GWs) provide a unique probe of the interplay between quantum matter and the dynamics of spacetime. We develop a QED framework for spontaneous emission in the presence of a weak classical GW by quantizing the electromagnetic field in a linearized gravitational background. We show that a passing GW dynamically phase-modulates vacuum electromagnetic modes, dressing photon states into a Floquet ladder of sidebands separated by the GW frequency. While the total spontaneous decay rate remains unchanged to first order in the GW strain, the emission pattern develops a characteristic spin-2 quadrupolar angular redistribution modulated with the GW phase. For finite interaction times, interference between the carrier and Floquet sidebands generates phase-dependent spectral asymmetries in the transient emission spectrum. To explore experimental observability, we formulate a cavity-QED master equation description and propose a differential cross-cavity detection protocol employing Rydberg ensembles or highly charged ions. These results establish cavity QED as a promising platform for exploring quantum electrodynamics in dynamical spacetime and for high-frequency gravitational-wave detection.

Memory effect from neutron star merger counterparts

T. Brabant, M. Pillas, H. Inchausp\'e, Z. Lin, F. Foucart, M. Bulla · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：引力波记忆效应是广义相对论的预言，表现为时空几何的永久改变。它尚未被观测到，但ET和LISA等下一代探测器有望首次探测。引力波记忆包含两部分：由引力波自相互作用产生的非线性记忆，以及由天体暂现源中物质和辐射各向异性发射产生的线性记忆。本文量化了双中子星并合过程中产生的非线性与线性记忆贡献，涵盖引力波、伽马射线暴、余辉、中微子、动力学与盘风抛射物以及千新星辐射。我们通过两个应用评估ET和LISA对所得记忆信号的探测能力。首先，将分析应用于多信使事件GW170817-GRB 170817A-AT2017gfo，发现该事件的组合记忆信号本可被ET以信噪比10.7探测到，且以非线性记忆为主。我们还评估了合成伽马射线暴族群中GRB记忆的可探测性，发现只有极端能量且联合有利的构型才可能在ET中产生可探测信号。这些结果表明，下一代探测器将探测非线性记忆，而观测双中子星对应体的线性记忆仍将十分困难，除非在最优越的情形下。

English: The gravitational-wave (GW) memory effect is a prediction of general relativity, characterized by a permanent change in spacetime geometry. Although it has not yet been observed, next-generation detectors such as the Einstein Telescope (ET) and the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA) are expected to provide the sensitivity required for its first detection. GW memory comprises two distinct contributions: the nonlinear memory, generated by the self-interaction of GWs, and the linear memory, originating from the anisotropic emission of matter and radiation associated with astrophysical transients. In this work, we quantify both nonlinear and linear memory contributions produced during binary neutron star mergers (BNSs), including those associated with GWs, gamma-ray bursts (GRBs), afterglows, neutrinos, dynamical and disk-wind ejecta, and kilonova emission. We evaluate the detectability of the resulting memory signals with ET and LISA through two applications. First, we apply our analysis to the multi-messenger event GW170817 - GRB 170817A - AT2017gfo. We find that the combined memory signal from this event would have been detectable by ET with a signal-to-noise ratio of 10.7 dominated by the nonlinear memory. We also assess the detectability of the GRB memory across a synthetic population of GRBs, and find that only extreme-energy and jointly favorable configurations could produce a detectable signal in ET. Together, these results demonstrate that while next-generation detectors will probe nonlinear memory, observing linear memory from BNS counterparts will remain elusive except in the most favorable scenarios.

中文摘要：本文研究了正则声学黑洞在非最小耦合标量场、电磁场和狄拉克场扰动下的稳定性。利用三阶 WKB 近似方法计算准正规模（QNMs）。结果表明，对于这三类扰动，有效势均为正，而 QNMs 的虚部为负，因此正则声学黑洞是稳定的。具体而言，对标量场扰动，有效势和 QNMs 依赖于角量子数 l、泛音数 n 和耦合参数 ζ，扰动随 ζ 增大而衰减更快。对电磁场扰动，有效势和 QNMs 依赖于 l 和 n。对狄拉克场扰动，有效势和 QNMs 依赖于 n 和总角量子数 |k|。

The quasi-normal modes(QNMs) are computed using the three-order WKB approximation method. The results show that, for all these three kinds of perturbation, the values of the effective potential are positive, while the imaginary parts of QNMs are negative, the canonical acoustic black hole is a table. In details respectively, for scalar field perturbation, the effective potential and the QNMs depend on the angular quantum number $l$, the overtone number $n$, and the coupling parameter {\zeta}, the perturbation decays more rapidly for bigger {\zeta}. For electromagnetic field perturbation, the effective potential and QNMs depend on $l$ and $n$. For Dirac field perturbation, the effective potential and QNMs depend on $n$ and the total angular quantum number | k |.

Lavinia Heisenberg, Shayan Hemmatyar · gr-qc, cs.LG, physics.data-an · v1 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们使用带分类头和回归头的神经网络研究引力波相位偏差能被多好地识别。分类头区分广义相对论与六类参数化后爱因斯坦相位族，指数 b∈{-7,-5,-3,-1,+1,+2}；回归头预测耦合强度对数值 log10|β|。网络输入是量化波形失配对波形形变敏感性的响应函数。使用 Advanced LIGO 设计谱的平稳高斯噪声（262 个源）和第三次观测运行（O3）的 Hanford 实测谱（132 个源），并测试注入实测 Hanford 应变。在两个高斯数据集上，网络以 0.427 和 0.329 的准确率明显高于噪声地识别偏差指数。为解释结果，我们将网络与由六个相位族的预测波形残差构建的近似分类器比较；两个分类器经常混淆相同族。通过检查不同相位修正留下的残差，我们将这些错误与底层偏差之间的相似性联系起来。在选定实测 Hanford 应变上，用模拟或实测噪声训练的网络总体分类准确率接近模拟 Hanford 噪声上的结果。在 Advanced LIGO 设计数据集上测试的 13 种神经网络变体中，循环网络对响亮偏差的平均分类准确率最高，但所有变体仍低于近似分类器。网络几乎达到该分类器的准确率，表明在已知内禀源参数下，识别受限于相邻相位族之间的相似性，而非网络本身。

English: We study how well gravitational-wave phase deviations can be identified using a neural network with classification and regression heads. The classification head distinguishes general relativity (GR) from six parametrized post-Einsteinian phase families with exponents $b\in\{-7,-5,-3,-1,+1,+2\}$; the regression head predicts the logarithm of the coupling magnitude, $\log_{10}|\beta|$. The network input is a response function quantifying the sensitivity of waveform mismatch to waveform deformations. We use stationary Gaussian noise with the Advanced LIGO design spectrum for 262 sources and a measured Hanford spectrum from the third observing run (O3) for 132 sources, and also test injections into recorded Hanford strain. On the two Gaussian datasets, the network identifies the exponent of deviations clearly above the noise with accuracies of $0.427$ and $0.329$. To interpret these results, we compare the network with an approximate classifier built from predicted waveform residuals for the six phase families and same sources. The two classifiers often confuse the same families. Examining residuals left by different phase corrections, we link these errors to similarities between the underlying deviations. On selected recorded Hanford strain, networks trained on simulated or recorded noise achieve overall classification accuracies close to those on simulated Hanford noise. Of thirteen neural-network variants tested on the Advanced LIGO design dataset, the recurrent network has the highest mean classification accuracy for loud deviations, although all variants remain below the approximate classifier. The network nearly matches that classifier's accuracy, indicating that identification is limited by similarities between neighboring phase families rather than by the network, for known intrinsic source parameters.

一句话导读：用多头神经网络与近似分类器研究引力波相位偏差的可识别性，发现混淆主要来自相邻相位族相似性而非网络能力。

代表性红外改进软墙全息 QCD 模型中的强子真空极化与光-光散射

Hadronic vacuum polarization and light-by-light scattering in representative infrared-improved soft-wall holographic QCD models

Jin-Yang Shen, Wen-Yuan Peng, Ling-Yun Dai, Zhen Fang · hep-ph · v3 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们在三个代表性的红外改进软墙 AdS/QCD 模型中研究了强子对缪子反常磁矩 a_mu 的贡献，重点关注领头阶强子真空极化（LO-HVP）和强子光-光散射（HLbL）贡献。模型参数由基态 rho 介子质量、π 介子质量和 π 介子衰变常数确定，并用低激发谱作为额外唯象约束。我们发现 LO-HVP 贡献低于色散关系确定值，主要因为 rho 介子衰变常数被低估。在 HLbL 部分，标准 Chern-Simons 项给出定义良好的基态赝标量极点贡献，但在软墙模型中导致激发态求和发散。因此我们还采用由膜-反膜构造启发的标量扩展 Chern-Simons 项，它提供红外压低，并允许对赝标量激发和轴矢量介子给出有限估计。所得 HLbL 预言内部收敛，但仍在定量上依赖模型，表明需要进一步改进红外完备和短距离约束。

English: We investigate the hadronic contributions to the anomalous magnetic moment of the muon $a_\mu$ in three representative infrared-improved soft-wall AdS/QCD models, focusing on the leading-order hadronic vacuum polarization (LO-HVP) and hadronic light-by-light (HLbL) contributions. The model parameters are fixed by the ground-state $\rho$-meson mass, pion mass, and pion decay constant, with the low-lying excited spectrum used as an additional phenomenological constraint. We find that the LO-HVP contribution remains below dispersive determinations, mainly because the $\rho$-meson decay constant is underestimated. In the HLbL sector, the standard Chern-Simons term gives well-defined ground-state pseudoscalar-pole contributions but leads to divergent excited-state sums in soft-wall models. We therefore also adopt a scalar-extended Chern-Simons term motivated by the brane--antibrane construction, which provides infrared suppression and allows finite estimates for pseudoscalar excitations and axial-vector mesons. The resulting HLbL predictions are internally convergent but still quantitatively model dependent, showing that further refinement of the infrared completion and short-distance constraints is required.

一句话导读：在三个红外改进软墙 AdS/QCD 模型中计算缪子 g-2 的 LO-HVP 与 HLbL，发现 HVP 偏低、HLbL 需标量扩展 Chern-Simons 项才能获得有限估计。

光前全息QCD中轻赝标量介子与矢量介子的径向激发谱

Radial Excitation Spectra of Light Pseudoscalar and Vector Mesons in Light-Front Holographic QCD

Abhisth Srivastava · hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：量子色动力学（QCD）的非微扰区域对解析处理提出了重大挑战。光前全息QCD（LFHQCD）通过禁闭的全息对偶描述，为探索强子结构提供了一个有效的半经典框架。虽然标准软墙模型以及Brodsky-de Téramond（BdT）纵向方案对介子基态给出了令人满意的结果，但对于π介子家族的径向激发，它显示出约17%到18%的偏差。在这项工作中，我们通过在标准软墙框架之外添加库仑贡献和对数贡献来扩展横向禁闭势。我们数值求解所得的光前薛定谔方程，并将横向质量谱与BdT纵向方案相结合，以获得完整的介子质量谱。我们计算了π、ρ和K*介子家族的径向激发谱，并分析了它们的Regge轨迹。与标准软墙模型相比，修改后的框架将相对于实验数据的总体平均偏差从约7.6%降低到5.2%，对于拟合的九态数据集，在描述径向激发态方面代表约32%的改进。结果表明，短程库仑贡献和中程对数贡献对于在光前全息方法中改进径向介子谱很重要。

English: The non-perturbative regime of Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD) poses significant challenges for analytical treatment. Light-Front Holographic QCD (LFHQCD) offers an effective semiclassical framework for exploring hadronic structure through a holographic dual description of confinement. While the standard soft-wall model, along with the Brodsky-de T\'eramond (BdT) longitudinal prescription, provides satisfactory results for meson ground states, it shows deviations of around 17 to $18\%$ for radial excitations of the pion family. In this work, we extend the transverse confining potential by adding Coulombic and logarithmic contributions beyond the standard soft-wall framework. We solve the resulting light-front Schr\"odinger equation numerically, and we combine the transverse mass spectrum with the BdT longitudinal prescription to obtain the complete meson mass spectrum. We compute the radial excitation spectra of the $\pi$, $\rho$, and $K^{*}$ meson families and analyze their Regge trajectories. The modified framework reduces the overall average deviation from experimental data from about $7.6\%$ to $5.2\%$ compared to the standard soft-wall model, representing a $\sim 32\%$ improvement for the fitted nine-state dataset in describing radially excited states. The results show that short-range Coulombic and intermediate-range logarithmic contributions are important for refining the radial meson spectrum within the light-front holographic approach.

一句话导读：在光前全息QCD软墙模型中加入库仑与对数修正，数值求解光前薛定谔方程以改进π、ρ、K*介子径向激发谱和Regge轨迹。

全息QCD模型中的伪谱

Pseudospectra in Holographic QCD Models

Luiz F. Ferreira · hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：我们利用伪谱分析研究了非共形全息QCD模型中准正规模的谱稳定性。首先考虑软墙模型，聚焦标量场和矢量场，然后将分析推广到解析改进全息QCD（IHQCD）模型，研究张量胶球涨落。两种情形下，运动方程均被表述为线性本征值问题，从而可通过伪谱量化准正规模谱对小扰动的不稳定性。我们发现准正规模的谱稳定性对温度具有非平凡依赖，反映了全息QCD模型中内禀有量纲标度的存在。随着温度升高，准正规模频率虚部的幅度增大，表明衰减率增加以及相应强子激发逐渐失去相干性。在足够高的温度下，准正规模频率近似呈对温度的线性依赖，但该区域只有在相关强子态熔化之后才会达到。我们进一步将伪谱不稳定性与相应谱函数的行为进行比较。结果表明，伪谱不稳定性的增长为谱稳定性的丧失提供了互补刻画，并可作为全息QCD中强子解离与熔化的有用诊断。

English: We investigate the spectral stability of quasinormal modes in nonconformal holographic QCD models using pseudospectral analysis. We first consider the soft-wall model, focusing on scalar and vector fields, and then extend the analysis to the analytic Improved Holographic QCD (IHQCD) model, where we study tensor glueball fluctuations. In both cases, the equations of motion are formulated as linear eigenvalue problems, allowing the instability of the quasinormal spectrum to small perturbations to be quantified through the pseudospectrum. We find that the spectral stability of the quasinormal modes exhibits a nontrivial dependence on temperature, reflecting the presence of intrinsic dimensionful scales in holographic QCD models. As the temperature increases, the magnitude of the imaginary part of the quasinormal frequencies grows, signaling an increasing decay rate and the progressive loss of coherence of the corresponding hadronic excitations. At sufficiently high temperatures, the quasinormal frequencies approach an approximately linear dependence on temperature, although this regime is reached only after the associated hadronic states have melted. We further compare the pseudospectral instability with the behavior of the corresponding spectral functions. Our results indicate that the growth of pseudospectral instability provides a complementary characterization of the loss of spectral stability and can serve as a useful diagnostic of hadronic dissociation and melting in holographic QCD.

一句话导读：用伪谱分析研究软墙与IHQCD模型中准正规模谱稳定性及其温度依赖，并关联强子熔化。

带引力的手征夸克孤子模型的孤子解：广义相对论中的动力学费米子与狄拉克海

Soliton solution of a gravitating chiral quark soliton model: dynamical fermion and Dirac-sea in general relativity

Ryoma Mizutani, Daiki Niiyama, Nobuyuki Sawado · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-29

中文摘要：本文在静态球对称时空中研究基于狄拉克费米子与非线性手征场耦合的 Einstein-Dirac 系统。我们考察引力对费米子动力学质量的影响。手征夸克孤子模型 (CQSM) 原本是受大 N_c QCD 低能区启发的强子模型，通过完整包含狄拉克海的正则化单费米子圈实现局域化费米子。我们将 CQSM 推广到球对称弯曲时空并与 Einstein 引力耦合。我们成功自洽求解 CQSM 和 Einstein 方程，并得到费米子能量以及 ADM 质量的谱流。狄拉克海稀释了能量-动量张量的效应，这导致即使存在局域化物质，对引力的影响也存在一个不活跃点。对于更大的动力学质量 M ~ ⟨ψ̄ψ⟩，狄拉克海效应变得主导，导致出现负 ADM 质量。

English: In this paper, we study Einstein-Dirac system based on a Dirac fermion coupled with a nonlinear chiral field on static spherically symmetric spacetime. Gravitational effects on the dynamical mass of fermions are examined. The chiral quark soliton model (CQSM) originally was a model of hadron inspired by the low-energy regime of large-$N_\textrm{c}$ QCD, realizing localized fermions with the full inclusion of the Dirac-sea, which is derived from a regularized one-fermion loop. We extend the CQSM in spherically symmetric curved spacetime and coupled with the Einstein gravity. We successfully solve the CQSM and the Einstein equation self-consistently, and obtain the spectral flow of the fermion energies and also of the ADM mass. The Dirac-sea dilutes the effect of the energy-momentum tensor, which induces an inactive point for the impact of gravity even when the localizing matter exists. The Dirac-sea effect becomes dominant for larger dynamical mass $M\sim \langle\bar{\psi}\psi\rangle$, leading to the emergence of the negative ADM mass.

一句话导读：在静态球对称弯曲时空中自洽求解耦合 Einstein 引力的手征夸克孤子模型，发现狄拉克海会稀释引力效应并可导致负 ADM 质量。
