通过混合尺度因子研究加速非线性 f(T) 引力中的晚期动力学：贝叶斯分析与宇宙学启示

Late-Time Dynamics in Accelerating Nonlinear $f(T)$ Gravity via Hybrid Scale Factor : Bayesian Analysis and Cosmological implications

Suraj Kumar Behera, Pratik P. Ray · gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：本研究利用混合尺度因子，对具有三种不同非线性且新颖形式的 f(T) 引力模型进行了综合重构，以描述宇宙的膨胀历史。我们考察了一种有物理动机的宇宙学参数化，该混合尺度因子可解释从早期减速阶段到当前加速演化的平滑过渡，并由此导出相应的模型参数。利用贝叶斯统计和 MCMC 分析，结合 Hubble、重子声学振荡（BAO）和 Pantheon+SH0ES 晚期观测数据，对这些参数进行了严格约束。对状态方程参数和宇宙学参数等动力学量的研究显示，当前和晚期都符合加速膨胀阶段。通过检验能量条件验证模型，尤其强调强能量条件被违反，表明在修改引力场景中暗能量占主导。该研究有助于确定与宇宙学观测和理论要求一致的模型。重构的模型形式在晚期能有效模拟 ΛCDM，为广义相对论的可能扩展提供了重要见解，并支持 f(T) 引力理论作为宇宙加速的稳健解释。

English: This study offers a comprehensive reconstruction of $f(T)$ gravity model with three distinct non-linear as well as novel forms employing a hybrid scale factor to depict the expansion history of the universe. We investigate a physically motivated cosmological parametrization through this hybrid scale factor that can explain a smooth transition from an early decelerated epoch to the present accelerated evolution. This scale factor is then used to derive the corresponding model parameters. These parameters are rigorously constrained using the Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) analysis with the help of Bayesian statistics and incorporating late-time observations from Hubble, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) and Patheon+SH0ES datasets. The investigation of dynamical parameters such as the equation of state parameter and cosmological parameters indicates alignment with an accelerated expansion phase in both the present and late time epochs. Validation is conducted by assessing the energy conditions, verifying the feasibility of the model forms with particular emphasis on the violation of the strong energy condition that indicates dark energy dominance in modified gravity scenarios. This investigation has been instrumental in determining models that remain consistent with cosmological observations and theoretical requirements. The reconstructed forms of the model effectively mimic $\Lambda$CDM at late times, providing significant insights into possible extensions of general relativity and bolstering $f(T)$ gravity theory as a robust explanation for cosmic acceleration.

一句话导读：论文用混合尺度因子重构非线性 f(T) 引力模型，并结合晚期宇宙学观测做贝叶斯参数约束与能量条件检验。

PANGU I：基于 Parthenon 的固定时空 GRMHD 框架

PANGU I: A Parthenon-Based Framework for Fixed-Spacetime GRMHD

Yuehang Li, Fan Zhou, Mingyang Luan, Minyong Guo, Bin Chen · astro-ph.HE, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：现有广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）程序各有互补能力，但这些能力分散在不同框架中。为统一它们，我们提出 PANGU——Parthenon-Based Astrophysics for Numerical Relativity and GRMHD in a Unified Framework——一个模块化计算框架，在单一架构内整合跨物理区域的共享求解器、灵活的时空几何和可扩展计算基础设施。在本系列第一篇论文中，我们展示并验证 PANGU 的固定时空 GRMHD 组件。该共享求解器将有限体积 Godunov 方法与约束传输（constrained transport）结合，适用于均匀网格和块结构静态加密网格，并覆盖牛顿、狭义相对论和广义相对论区域下的流体力学与磁流体力学。PANGU 提供灵活的几何接口，支持坐标选择以及在线或预计算指定的稳态时空，本文在 Kerr 时空中用笛卡尔 Kerr-Schild 和修改 Kerr-Schild 坐标进行演示；附加组件可加入而无需重构核心求解器。验证涵盖均匀与静态加密网格上的全部三个区域：光滑牛顿和狭义相对论问题相对解析解达到二阶收敛，且特意匹配的双精度轨迹与 AthenaK 符合到舍入误差；在固定时空 GRMHD 中，稳态解析解被二阶精度保持，湍流吸积复现与 BHAC 相同的流动和通量尺度。这些结果确立了更广泛 PANGU 框架的固定时空物质区基础。数值相对论与耦合动态时空 GRMHD 能力将在后续工作展示。

English: Existing general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics (GRMHD) codes offer complementary capabilities, but these capabilities remain distributed across different frameworks. To unify them, we introduce PANGU--Parthenon-Based Astrophysics for Numerical Relativity and GRMHD in a Unified Framework--a modular computational framework that integrates a shared solver across physical regimes, flexible spacetime geometry, and extensible computational infrastructure within a single architecture. In the first paper of this series, we present and validate the fixed-spacetime GRMHD component of PANGU. The shared solver combines finite-volume Godunov methods with constrained transport on uniform and block-structured, statically refined meshes, and covers hydrodynamics and magnetohydrodynamics in Newtonian, special-relativistic, and general-relativistic regimes. PANGU provides a flexible geometry interface supporting coordinate selection and either on-the-fly or precomputed evaluation of prescribed stationary spacetimes, demonstrated here in Kerr spacetime with Cartesian Kerr-Schild and modified Kerr-Schild coordinates; additional components can be incorporated without restructuring the core solver. Verification covers all three regimes on uniform and statically refined meshes: smooth Newtonian and special-relativistic problems approach second order against their analytic solutions, with deliberately matched double-precision trajectories agreeing with AthenaK to roundoff; in fixed-spacetime GRMHD, the stationary analytic solutions are preserved to second order, and the turbulent accretion reproduces the same flow and flux scales as BHAC. Together, these results establish the fixed-spacetime matter-sector foundation for the broader PANGU framework. Numerical-relativity and coupled dynamical-spacetime GRMHD capabilities will be presented in subsequent work.

一句话导读：提出并验证 PANGU 的固定时空 GRMHD 模块，统一处理牛顿、狭义与广义相对论磁流体，并在 Kerr 时空中对标 AthenaK/BHAC。

致密天体并合与微潮汐瓦解事件：致密恒星环境的多信使探针

Compact Object Mergers and Micro-Tidal Disruption Events: A Multi-Messenger Probe of Dense Stellar Environments

Konstantinos Kritos, Francesco Iacovelli, Rosalba Perna, Emanuele Berti · astro-ph.HE, astro-ph.GA, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：致密恒星环境（如球状星团和年轻大质量星团）既产生可在引力波中探测到的致密天体并合，也产生可通过电磁波观测到的潮汐瓦解事件。我们使用 Rapster 代码进行快速蒙特卡洛星团模拟，研究这些环境中的致密天体并合、潮汐瓦解事件和微潮汐瓦解事件（μTDEs），并将处理扩展到在盘吸积下中子星（NS）到黑洞（BH）转变过程中 NS 和 BH 自旋演化的统一描述，以及由单个致密天体瓦解和 BH-BH 双星瓦解的新动力学通道。模拟 10^5 个星团、十种模型变体和两种形成历史，我们发现 BH-BH 并合率密度在 z≈2–3 达到峰值，为数十 Gpc^-3 yr^-1，与本地 LVK 速率一致，而 μTDEs 的累积数量比并合多几倍。由于我们只包含动力学形成的双星，约 90% 的 μTDEs 通过单致密天体-恒星相遇发生，我们的速率是保守下限。μTDEs 期间的顺行吸积使致密天体加速自旋，提供一种纯动力学、随机取向的产生高自旋 BH 的途径，并可驱动 NS 吸积诱导坍缩为 BH，从而填充低质量间隙。

English: Dense stellar environments such as globular clusters and young massive clusters produce both compact-object mergers detectable in gravitational waves and tidal disruption events observable electromagnetically. We investigate compact-object mergers, tidal disruption events, and micro-tidal disruption events ($\mu$TDEs) in these environments using rapid Monte Carlo star-cluster simulations with the Rapster code, extended with a unified treatment of neutron-star (NS) and black-hole (BH) spin evolution under disk accretion across the NS-to-BH transition, as well as new dynamical channels for disruptions by single compact objects and by BH-BH binaries. Simulating $10^5$ clusters across ten model variations and two formation histories, we find a BH-BH merger-rate density peaking at $z\approx2$-$3$ at several tens ${\rm Gpc}^{-3}\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$, consistent with the local LVK rate, while the cumulative number of $\mu$TDEs exceeds that of mergers by a factor of a few. Since we include only dynamically formed binaries, $\approx90\%$ of $\mu$TDEs proceed through single compact-object-star encounters, and our rates are conservative lower limits. Prograde accretion during $\mu$TDEs spins up compact objects, providing a purely dynamical, randomly oriented pathway for producing high-spin BHs, and can drive accretion-induced collapse of NSs to BHs that populate the lower mass gap.

一句话导读：用星团蒙特卡洛模拟表明致密环境中的微潮汐瓦解事件可产生高自旋黑洞并填充低质量间隙，且其事件率高于并合。

Twin Universes and Bimetric Gravity: From Sakharov's Cosmological Symmetry to Modern Speculations on Negative Mass

Jean-Pierre Luminet · physics.gen-ph, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们回顾孪生宇宙模型的概念与理论现状：从萨哈罗夫关于重子生成、CPT对称性和时间箭头反转的早期思想，到近来涉及成对产生纠缠宇宙的量子宇宙学情景。特别关注区分萨哈罗夫型宇宙学对称性、现代双度规引力理论，以及涉及负质量部门的思辨模型。我们总结双度规引力面临的主要一致性条件，包括Boulware-Deser鬼、Higuchi型界限、协变守恒律，以及正负质量部门的不可能性结果。随后考察Janus宇宙学模型及相关的黑洞替代方案，强调启发性孪生宇宙叙事与完整指定的相对论场论之间的差别。我们认为，尽管孪生宇宙思想对于时间箭头、正反物质不对称和宇宙量子起源等问题仍是有益框架，但结合双度规引力、负质量、暗部门现象学以及Kerr黑洞替代方案的理论模型仍面临沉重的数学与观测证明负担。

English: We review the conceptual and theoretical status of twin-universe models, from Sakharov's early ideas on baryogenesis, CPT symmetry, and reversed arrows of time to recent quantum-cosmological scenarios involving pair-created entangled universes. Particular attention is given to the distinction between Sakharov-type cosmological symmetry, modern bimetric theories of gravity, and speculative models involving negative mass sectors. We summarize the main consistency conditions faced by bimetric gravity, including the Boulware-Deser ghost, Higuchi-type bounds, covariant conservation laws, and no-go results for positive- and negative-mass sectors. We then examine the Janus cosmological model and related black-hole replacement proposals, emphasizing the difference between heuristic twin-universe narratives and fully specified relativistic field theories. We argue that while twin-universe ideas remain a fertile framework for questions about the arrow of time, matter-antimatter asymmetry, and the quantum origin of the universe, models combining bimetric gravity, negative mass, dark-sector phenomenology, and alternatives to Kerr black holes face a substantial burden of mathematical and observational proof.

一句话导读：综述孪生宇宙、双度规引力与负质量模型的现状、一致性条件及黑洞替代方案，指出其数学与观测证明负担沉重。

动态 Chern-Simons 引力中的脉冲星磁层：死亡线条件与极冠粒子加速

Pulsar magnetospheres in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity: deathline conditions and polar-cap particle acceleration

Sherzod Sayfiyev, Bobomurat Ahmedov, Chengxun Yuan, Javlon Rayimbaev, Bahodir Ahmedov, Asadbek Shermanov · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：中子星表面引力在高度磁化、致密天体（紧致度 M/R≈0.2）周围等离子体磁层的辐射机制中作用显著，因此可作为检验主导星体外部区域的引力理论的天体实验室。本文在慢转动、弱耦合近似下考察动态 Chern-Simons（dCS）引力如何修正脉冲星电动力学；最低阶修正只影响非对角度规分量 g_{tφ}，而对角度规分量仍与广义相对论（GR）相同。作者先在 dCS 框架下求解麦克斯韦方程，得到电磁场分量的解析解，表明磁场分量与 GR 相同，而电场分量被修正。随后推导感应电荷密度即 Goldreich-Julian（GJ）电荷密度的解析表达式，该密度由磁场与星体转动产生感应电场。在 dCS 中，GJ 电荷密度比 GR 更大，而平行于磁力线的加速电场更弱。接着考虑极冠区通过逆康普顿散射关闭正负电子辐射的死亡线条件，发现死亡线在 P-P 图中上移，可解释寿命更短的脉冲星。最后研究极冠区带电粒子加速，表明电子在更短距离内达到比 GR 更高的能量。

English: The role of surface gravity in neutron stars (NSs) is considerable in the radiation mechanisms of the surrounding plasma magnetosphere near the star surface, as they are highly magnetized, compact gravitating objects with compactness $M/R \simeq 0.2$. In this context, they serve as a celestial laboratory for testing gravity theories that dominate the stars' exteriors through plasma magnetospheric radiation. In this paper, we examine how dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity modifies pulsar electrodynamics in the slow-rotation, weak-coupling regime; the leading-order correction affects only the off-diagonal metric component $g_{t\phi}$, while the diagonal components remain as in General Relativity (GR). We first solve the Maxwell equations in the dCS framework for the electromagnetic field components and obtain analytical solutions for the electric and magnetic fields. We show that the magnetic field components are the same as in GR, while the electric field components are modified in dCS. We then derive analytic expressions for the induced electric charge density, known as the Goldreich-Julian (GJ) charge density, which sources the induced electric field arising from the magnetic field and the star's rotation. In dCS, it is larger than in the GR case, whereas the accelerating electric field parallel to the magnetic field lines is weaker. Next, we consider the deathline condition for switching off electron and positron radiation via inverse Compton scattering in the star's polar cap zone and show that the line shifts upward in the $P-\dot{P}$ diagram, explaining the physics of shorter-lived pulsars. Lastly, we study charged-particle acceleration in the polar cap region and show that electrons reach higher energies over shorter distances than in the GR case.

A Catalog-Wide Study of Gravitational-Wave Residuals in GWTC-4 and GWTC-5

Junlin Qin, Zhan-Feng Mai, Dicong Liang, Hai-Tian Wang, En-Wei Liang · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA探测器灵敏度的提升使引力波事件目录不断增大，从而为通过目录级残差分析评估波形模型性能提供了机会。我们研究GWTC-4和GWTC-5中至少在一个探测器中信噪比大于12的事件，对减去IMRPhenomXPHM和SEOBNRv5PHM波形模型后所得白化残差的归一化Q变换能量施加三种拟合优度检验。在整个目录中，残差与高斯噪声一致，在多探测器事件或有效单探测器事件中均无系统偏离证据。对于参数估计中表现出强模型依赖的事件，不同波形模型之间的变化同样未产生持续残差结构。这些结果表明，与波形建模相关的参数估计偏差不一定在残差中表现为可探测特征。因此，残差分析为在探测器灵敏度范围内验证引力波波形模型提供了数据空间中的互补诊断。

English: Improved sensitivity of the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA detectors has enabled the accumulation of a large gravitational-wave event catalog, providing an opportunity for catalog-wide residual analyses to assess waveform-model performance. We study GWTC-4 and GWTC-5 events with signal-to-noise ratio $>12$ in at least one detector, applying three goodness-of-fit tests to the normalized Q-transform energies of whitened residuals obtained by subtracting the IMRPhenomXPHM and SEOBNRv5PHM waveform models. Across the catalog, the residuals are consistent with Gaussian noise, with no evidence of systematic deviations in either multi-detector events or valid single-detector events. For events exhibiting strong model dependence in parameter estimation, variations between waveform models likewise do not produce persistent residual structures. These results demonstrate that parameter-estimation biases associated with waveform modeling do not necessarily manifest as detectable features in the residuals. Residual analyses therefore provide a complementary diagnostic in data space for validating gravitational-wave waveform models within the detector sensitivity.

神经网络引导的参数空间约束用于双黑洞引力波搜索

Neural Network Guided Parameter Space Constraints for Gravitational Wave Searches from Binary Black Holes

Chetan Verma, Amit Reza, Gurudatt Gaur, Dilip Krishnaswamy, Sarah Caudill · gr-qc, astro-ph.IM · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：利用匹配滤波从致密双星并合中探测引力波在计算上十分昂贵，因为探测器数据必须与覆盖高维内禀参数空间的众多模板波形进行相关。在我们先前的工作中，我们表明卷积神经网络（CNN）能够将含噪信号与纯噪声分类，并约束真实无自旋双黑洞（BBH）信号的内禀参数空间，从而得到更窄的匹配滤波搜索区域并降低计算成本。这里，我们将该框架扩展至对齐自旋 BBH 系统，并研究不同参数空间表示如何影响基于 CNN 的分块识别。使用覆盖对齐自旋 BBH 参数空间的 IMRPhenomD 波形和 Advanced LIGO 设计灵敏度，我们表明，仅在对齐自旋模板库上训练的 CNN 在独立生成的均匀采样 BBH 信号上达到超过 99.8% 的信号-噪声分类准确率，这表明额外的均匀采样训练数据并非必要。我们使用基于主成分分析（PCA）的分位数方案将模板库划分为四个近似平衡的分块，并评估五种参数空间表示用于分块识别。啁啾质量-持续时间表示取得最高平均准确率（93.2%），其次是啁啾质量（91.6%）和分量质量（90.5%）。后牛顿坐标 tau_0-tau_3 和 theta_0-theta_3-theta_3s 的准确率显著更低。这些结果表明，现有模板库足以用于训练和高准确率信号检测，而参数空间表示的选择对于约束真实信号的参数至关重要。

English: The detection of gravitational waves (GWs) from compact binary coalescences (CBCs) using matched filtering is computationally demanding because detector data must be correlated with many template waveforms spanning a high-dimensional intrinsic parameter space. In our previous work, we showed that a convolutional neural network (CNN) can classify noisy signals against pure noise and constrain the intrinsic parameter space of a true non-spinning binary black hole (BBH) signal, enabling a narrower matched-filter search region and reducing computational cost. Here, we extend this framework to aligned-spin BBH systems and investigate how different parameter-space representations affect CNN-based patch identification. Using IMRPhenomD waveforms over the aligned-spin BBH parameter space and Advanced LIGO design sensitivity, we show that a CNN trained solely on the aligned-spin template bank achieves more than 99.8% signal-noise classification accuracy on independently generated uniformly sampled BBH signals, indicating that additional uniformly sampled training data are unnecessary. We partition the template bank into four approximately balanced patches using a Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-based quantile scheme and evaluate five parameter-space representations for patch identification. The chirp mass-duration representation achieves the highest average accuracy (93.2%), followed by chirp mass (91.6%) and component masses (90.5%). The post-Newtonian coordinates tau_0-tau_3 and theta_0-theta_3-theta_3s yield substantially lower accuracies. These results show that the existing template bank is sufficient for training and high-accuracy signal detection, while the choice of parameter-space representation is critical for constraining the parameters of the true signal.

一句话导读：用 CNN 对对齐自旋双黑洞模板库进行分类与参数空间分块，以缩小匹配滤波搜索区域。

广义相对论的非线性牛顿近似

A nonlinear Newtonian approximation to General Relativity

Oliver F. Piattella · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们研究广义相对论的一种非相对论近似，该近似不要求度规系数是闵可夫斯基度规的弱微扰。相反，我们假设一种微分层级，其中曲率中包含度规二阶导数的贡献支配那些一阶导数的二次项，而乘以保留项的度规相关系数则完全保持非线性。由于这种分离不是协变的，我们在调和坐标中表述该近似，在那里它对应于保留约化爱因斯坦方程的主部。我们证明，截断的爱因斯坦张量在微分层级所忽略的阶数内满足缩并的比安基恒等式，从而保证了在保留阶数与能量-动量守恒的相容性。标准牛顿方程在弱场区域被恢复，而在其之外，动力学保持对时滞函数和空间度规的非线性依赖。特别地，零测地线在领头阶探测空间几何，这表明引力透镜是可能出现对标准弱场描述的可观测偏离的自然场景。我们用一个静态空间各向同性的构型来说明该构造，并讨论该近似的适用范围和局限性。

English: We investigate a nonrelativistic approximation to general relativity that does not require the metric coefficients to be weak perturbations of the Minkowski metric. Instead, we assume a differential hierarchy in which the contributions to the curvature containing second derivatives of the metric dominate over those quadratic in its first derivatives, while the metric-dependent coefficients multiplying the retained terms are kept fully nonlinear. Since this separation is not covariant, we formulate the approximation in harmonic coordinates, where it corresponds to retaining the principal part of the reduced Einstein equations. We show that the truncated Einstein tensor satisfies the contracted Bianchi identities up to the order neglected in the derivative hierarchy, ensuring compatibility with energy--momentum conservation at the retained order. The standard Newtonian equations are recovered in the weak-field regime, whereas outside it the dynamics retains a nonlinear dependence on the lapse and spatial metric. In particular, null geodesics probe the spatial geometry at leading order, suggesting gravitational lensing as a natural setting in which observable departures from the standard weak-field description may arise. We illustrate the construction with a static spatially isotropic configuration and discuss the scope and limitations of the approximation.

一句话导读：提出一种不要求弱场度规的非线性牛顿近似，在调和坐标下保留约化爱因斯坦方程主部，并讨论其与牛顿极限、比安基恒等式及引力透镜的关系。

动态黑洞标量化过程中圆轨道的演化与破坏

Evolution and disruption of circular orbits during dynamic black hole scalarization

Yu-Peng Zhang, Shao-Wen Wei, Yu-Xiao Liu · gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：动态黑洞标量化描述“无毛”黑洞向带标量毛的黑洞态转变的过程。这一转变显著改变时空几何，包括测试粒子的稳定圆轨道结构，而这些轨道对天体物理观测和引力检验至关重要。在本工作中，我们采用数值相对论模拟来建模一个经历标量化的真空黑洞的时间依赖演化。通过在动态变化的时空背景中演化类时测地线方程，我们研究了标量化过程如何影响初始稳定的圆轨道。结果表明，标量毛发的增长破坏了这些轨道的圆轨道性质，迫使它们要么变为偏心轨道，要么坠入黑洞。这种轨道失稳源于标量场引起的时空曲率快速变化。我们的发现为标量场与黑洞动力学之间的相互作用提供了新见解，并对引力波信号、吸积盘稳定性以及扩展引力理论的观测检验具有重要意义。

English: Dynamical black hole scalarization describes the process by which a ``no-hair" black hole transitions to a scalarized hairy state. This transition significantly alters the spacetime geometry, including the structure of stable circular orbits of the test particles, which are critical for astrophysical observations and tests of gravity. In this work, we employ numerical relativity simulations to model the time-dependent evolution of a vacuum black hole undergoing scalarization. By evolving timelike geodesic equations within the dynamically changing spacetime background, we investigate how the scalarization process impacts initially stable circular orbits. Our results reveal that the growth of the scalar hair destroys the circular nature of these orbits, forcing them to either become eccentric or plunge into the black hole. This orbital destabilization arises from the rapid change of spacetime curvature induced by the scalar field. Our findings provide novel insights into the interplay between scalar fields and black hole dynamics, with significant implications for gravitational-wave signatures, accretion disk stability, and observational tests of extended theories of gravity.

一句话导读：数值相对论显示，黑洞动态标量化过程中标量毛发增长会破坏测试粒子的稳定圆轨道，使其偏心或坠入黑洞。

带径向压强的星系晕中黑洞的准正规模红移

Quasinormal-mode redshifts of black holes in galactic halos with radial pressures

Che-Yu Chen, Hassan Hassanabadi, Soroush Zare · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO, astro-ph.GA, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们研究了由具有非零径向压强的星系暗物质晕诱导的黑洞准正规模红移。该晕由各向异性流体描述，具有广义密度剖面和恒定的径向状态方程参数 w。我们构造相应的静态球对称时空，并研究其对不稳定光子环和准正规模谱的修正。对于稀薄晕和 w≠−1，光子环角频率与 Lyapunov 指数获得相同的领头阶引力红移，意味着准正规模频率实部和虚部有普适移动。该效应的幅度取决于晕结构和径向压强。这一普适红移关系不仅在文献中已发现的 w=0 情形成立，也在更广泛情形成立，支持其在黑洞光谱学中的重要性。另一方面，w=−1 情形定性不同：对应领头共同红移的因子消失，修正进一步受到黑洞尺度与晕尺度层级关系的抑制，普适关系被破坏，主导贡献由内晕剖面控制。我们对标量场准正规模谱的数值计算证实了解析 eikonal 结果。

English: We investigate the black-hole quasinormal mode redshifts induced by a galactic dark-matter halo with nonvanishing radial pressure. The halo is described by an anisotropic fluid with a generalized density profile and a constant radial equation-of-state parameter $w$. We construct the corresponding static, spherically symmetric spacetime and study the resulting corrections to the unstable light ring and quasinormal-mode spectrum. For dilute halos and $w\neq -1$, the light-ring angular frequency and Lyapunov exponent acquire the same leading-order gravitational redshift, implying a universal shift of the real and imaginary parts of the quasinormal frequencies. The magnitude of this effect depends on both the halo structure and the radial pressure. This universal redshift relation holds not only in the case of $w=0$ that has been discovered in the literature but also in a much wider scenario, supporting its importance in black hole spectroscopy. On the other hand, the case $w=-1$ is qualitatively different: the factor that corresponds to the leading common redshift vanishes, the corrections are further suppressed by the hierarchy between the black-hole and halo scales, and the universal relation is broken, with the dominant contribution controlled by the inner halo profile. Our numerical computations of scalar-field quasinormal mode spectra confirm the analytic eikonal results.

一句话导读：在带径向压强的暗物质晕中，黑洞准正规模实部与虚部获得相同领头阶引力红移，而 w=-1 时该普适关系被破坏。

修正随机引力波背景模板化背景搜索中的证据不确定性

Correcting for Evidence Uncertainty in the Templated Background Search for the Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background

Xiao-Xiao Kou, Argyro Sasli, Muhammed Saleem, Vuk Mandic · gr-qc, astro-ph.CO · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们报告了用于天体物理随机引力波背景的贝叶斯模板化背景搜索（TBS）中的一个新系统偏差来源。该偏差来自分段层面嵌套采样证据估计的统计不确定性，并且即使似然模型准确刻画数据时也会持续存在。使用一个解析可处理的模型和带有天体物理动机双黑洞种群的频域模拟数据分析，我们表明当累积数百万个分段时，这种不确定性会相干地将推断的占空比抬高最多一个数量级。我们提出一种简单高效的校正，并证明其在所有测试配置中的有效性。我们还发现，限制在高最优信噪比（SNR）的搜索先验会错误归因中等强度信号，而将先验扩展到支持更弱信号会放大证据不确定性。随着TBS分析扩展到即将到来的观测运行，校正和仔细的搜索先验设计对于稳健推断都至关重要。

English: We report a new source of systematic bias in the Bayesian Templated Background Search (TBS) for the astrophysical stochastic gravitational-wave background. This bias arises from the statistical uncertainty in nested sampling evidence estimates at the segment level and persists even when the likelihood model accurately characterizes the data. Using an analytically tractable model and a frequency-domain mock data analysis with an astrophysically motivated binary black hole population, we show that this uncertainty coherently inflates the inferred duty cycle by up to an order of magnitude when millions of segments are accumulated. We propose a simple and efficient correction and demonstrate its effectiveness across all tested configurations. We also find that a search prior restricted to high optimal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) misattributes intermediate-strength signals, while extending the prior to support weaker signals amplifies the evidence uncertainty. Both the correction and careful search prior design are essential for robust inference as TBS analyses scale to upcoming observing runs.

Bianchi I 时空中的零测地完备性与方向刚性

Null Completeness and Directional Rigidity in Bianchi I Spacetimes

Ye Zhou, Alan Zhang · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：一个光滑的 Bianchi I 时空，若在每个零方向满足零收敛条件，并且包含一条向过去和未来都完备的零测地线，则它是静态的。我们为一般空间度规证明这一结果，允许非对角演化和主膨胀率的任意符号。证明从仿射 Raychaudhuri 演化出发。在一个正则无扭转汇的完备生成元上，独立或固定比例 sharp-cutoff 下界的非负性迫使整个光学张量消失。膨胀平方权重给出精确求和规则，等于负的总光学平方积分，且不假设膨胀的端点极限。在 Bianchi I 中，这种光学饱和固定守恒空间余向量核上的度规。我们分类所得几何：非静态度规至多有两条饱和的无向线，对应四条有向射线；两条线迫使可由常数空间变换对角化，而第三条线迫使静态性。周期和有限持续时间几何达到该界。对于具有共同静态外部的有限脉冲，我们推导负仿射曲率积分、其弱振幅角依赖，以及由三个方向积分预算给出的度规偏离的非微扰界。无质量最小耦合试探标量的饱和模式在穿过脉冲时传播没有 Bogoliubov 混合。我们还陈述了这些几何结果蕴含物质或半经典刚性的场方程与平均能量假设。

English: A smooth Bianchi I spacetime satisfying the null convergence condition in every null direction is static if it contains a single null geodesic complete to both the past and the future. We prove this result for a general spatial metric, allowing non-diagonal evolution and arbitrary signs of the principal expansion rates. The proof starts from affine Raychaudhuri evolution. On a complete generator of a regular twist-free congruence, nonnegativity of an independent or fixed-ratio sharp-cutoff lower limit forces the full optical tensor to vanish. Dilated square weights give an exact sum rule equal to minus the total optical-square integral, with no assumed endpoint limits for the expansion. In Bianchi I, this optical saturation fixes the metric on the kernel of the conserved spatial covector. We classify the resulting geometry: a non-static metric has at most two saturated unoriented lines, corresponding to four oriented rays; two lines force diagonalizability by a constant spatial transformation, and a third forces staticity. Periodic and finite-duration geometries attain the bound. For finite pulses with a common static exterior, we derive the negative affine curvature integrals, their weak-amplitude angular dependence, and a nonperturbative bound on the metric excursion from three directional integral budgets. Saturated modes of a massless minimally coupled test scalar propagate without Bogoliubov mixing across the pulse. We also state the field-equation and averaged-energy assumptions under which these geometric results imply matter or semiclassical rigidity.

一句话导读：Bianchi I 时空中单条双向完备零测地线迫使静态，并给出方向刚性分类与有限脉冲非微扰界。

暗能量主导宇宙中的非奇异旋转黑洞

Nonsingular Rotating Black Holes in the Dark-Energy Dominated Universe

Ramon Torres · gr-qc, hep-th · v2 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：受量子引力场景（用正则核心取代经典黑洞奇点）以及暗能量部门可能尺度依赖的可能性启发，我们构建了一大类非奇异旋转黑洞时空，嵌入在改进的类 de Sitter 背景中，其中 Λ 要么为常数，要么跑动。由于 Newman-Janis 算法通常与宇宙学常数流体不相容，我们转而提出一种在（可能尺度依赖 Λ 的）de Sitter 种子上的广义 Kerr-Schild 构造，得到由质量函数和 Λ 函数刻画的 Carter 型度规。我们的构造提供了从静态球对称正则模型到其旋转对应物的直接映射。我们推导了环处的严格正则性条件，并识别出最小阶子类。我们分析时序，并表明对于非负质量函数以及高于某一负极限的 Λ，这些时空是稳定因果的。对于非负质量的最小阶几何，我们证明弱能量条件必须被破坏。最后，我们用一个受渐近安全启发的模型说明该框架，并讨论视界结构、表面引力与共形图。这些结果为在暗能量背景中检验正则旋转黑洞提供了受控且面向观测的平台，以应对快速改进的引力波和视界尺度成像数据。

English: Motivated by quantum-gravity scenarios that replace the classical black hole singularity with a regular core, and by the possibility that the dark-energy sector may be scale dependent, we construct a broad class of nonsingular rotating black-hole spacetimes embedded in an improved de Sitter--like background with either constant or running $\Lambda$. Because the Newman--Janis algorithm is generically incompatible with a cosmological-constant fluid, we instead propose a generalized Kerr--Schild construction on a (possibly scale-dependent $\Lambda$) de Sitter seed, yielding a Carter-type metric characterized by a mass function and a $\Lambda$ function. Our construction provides a direct map from static, spherically symmetric regular models to their rotating counterparts. We derive sharp regularity conditions at the ring and we identify a minimal-order subclass. We analyze chronology and show that, for non-negative mass function and $\Lambda$ above a certain negative limit, the spacetimes are stably causal. For minimal-order geometries with non-negative mass, we prove that the weak energy condition must be violated. Finally, we illustrate the framework with an asymptotic-safety--inspired model and discuss horizon structure, surface gravities, and conformal diagrams. English: In this paper, we provide a systematic construction of quantum modules associated with coadjoint orbits of asymptotic symmetry groups through the path integral quantization at one-loop order. 中文摘要：我们研究天球 Einstein 振幅的度规源响应，同时保留其动量守恒分布。连续的相反螺旋度响应与任意硬粒子多重数下的同时引力接触项相关。它们的差包含一个湮灭守恒 delta 函数的 Lorentz 变换，从而确定法向反冲贡献及其与未微分系数的关系。一个六引力子树图计算在真实散射道中评估这两个系数。对于求和后的齐次接触项，动量守恒抵消了领头角奇异性。在重合软方向和硬穿刺处的均匀界给出积分端点估计，从而在光滑源抹平后确定有序 Mellin 留数。混合 Mellin 除子还在一般共形权重下保留软-硬不变量比值的对数。在 Weyl--Beltrami 变量中，二次参考 Ward 响应将软腿、shadow 映射和自旋标架项组合为输运的度规 Hessian，并具有非零的对称混合感受率。相对 shadow 原语在对数割线两侧表示时需要边界流；其源变分固定了伴随的围道贡献。联合因子化与角展开将额外的 NMHV 相对围道项组织为留数系数，这些系数区分度规可积性与匹配到指定源泛函。一个独立真空完备化提供 Euler 响应，其中固定面积的调和组合在有界导数阶数下与局部曲率项分离。

English: We study metric-source responses of celestial Einstein amplitudes while retaining their momentum-conservation distribution. Uniform bounds at coincident soft directions and hard punctures yield integrated endpoint estimates that determine the ordered Mellin residues after smooth source smearing. The mixed Mellin divisor also retains logarithms of soft--hard invariant ratios at generic conformal weight. In Weyl--Beltrami variables, the quadratic reference Ward response combines soft-leg, shadow-map and spin-frame terms into the transported metric Hessian, with a nonzero symmetric mixed susceptibility. Relative shadow primitives require boundary currents when represented across logarithmic cuts; their source variation fixes the accompanying contour contribution. Joint factorization and angular expansions organize the additional NMHV relative-contour terms into residue coefficients that distinguish metric integrability from matching to a specified source functional. An independent vacuum completion supplies the Euler response, which fixed-area harmonic combinations separate from local curvature terms at bounded derivative order.

English: We derive a set of on-shell recursion relations for amplitudes in worldline quantum field theory (WQFT), an effective theory of gravity coupled to a massive worldline which is relevant for computing classical gravitational observables. 中文摘要：1999年，Lisa Randall 和 Raman Sundrum 引入五维反德西特（AdS）背景中的翘曲额外维，以解决粒子物理中的规范等级问题。作为额外收获，人们发现了其与四维共形场论（CFT）的全息解释。有趣的是，另一个五维背景——线性伸缩子（LD）——被发现具有基于小弦理论的全息解释。在这篇综述中，我们将展示一组由实参数 ν 参数化的五维背景如何推广这两种理论，特别地，ν=0 给出 AdS，ν=1 给出 LD。进一步，在五维理论中，我们将考虑 LD 背景在以下方面的应用：(i) 粒子物理，使五维普朗克尺度可以降低到亚普朗克值；(ii) 膜世界宇宙学（BWC），基于由一个五维黑洞表征的额外真空的出现。在所有情形中，我们发现体传播场具有带隙连续谱，这与 unparticles（非粒子）相关。在 BWC 情形中，我们还指出存在一种无压全息流体，可能充当暗物质（DM），与标准模型（SM）仅有微弱（引力）相互作用，与热的标准模型浴退耦，并在暴胀后通过 freeze-in 机制产生。我们还指出另一种可能性：将暗物质等同于一个长寿命、微弱相互作用的大质量引力子，作为由对连续谱引力子传播子自能的辐射修正所产生的孤立共振。

English: A warped extra dimension in a five-dimensional (5D) anti-de Sitter (AdS) background was introduced in 1999 by Lisa Randall and Raman Sundrum to solve the gauge hierarchy problem in particle physics. As a bonus, a holographic interpretation in terms of four-dimensional (4D) conformal field theories (CFTs) was found. Interestingly enough, another 5D background, linear dilaton (LD), was found to have a holographic interpretation in terms of Little String Theory. In this review, we will show how a set of 5D backgrounds, parametrized in terms of a real parameter $\nu$, generalizes both theories and gives rise, in particular, to AdS for $\nu=0$ and to LD for $\nu=1$. Furthermore, working in the 5D theory, we will consider applications of the LD background to: (i) particle physics, so that the 5D Planck scale can be lowered to sub-Planckian values, and (ii) Brane World Cosmology (BWC), based on the appearance of an extra vacuum characterized by a 5D black hole. In all cases, we find a gapped continuum for bulk propagating fields, which makes a connection with unparticles. In the case of BWC, we also point out the existence of a pressureless holographic fluid that could play the role of dark matter (DM), with feeble (gravitational) interactions with the Standard Model (SM), decoupled from the thermal SM bath, and generated by a freeze-in mechanism after inflation. We also point out the additional possibility of identifying DM with a long-lived, feebly interacting massive graviton, as an isolated resonance generated by radiative corrections to the continuum graviton propagator self-energy.

English: We consider the classical scattering of two gravitating compact objects in the presence of a massive scalar mediator, providing a simple model of exotic phenomena. Through dimensional analysis, we argue that such a process can only be classical in the presence of gravity, a consequence of which is that perturbing in the coupling of the scalar to a worldline is not separate from the post-Minkowskian expansion. When computing asymptotic observables, the massive mediator complicates the Fourier transforms to impact-parameter space at next-to-leading order. We reduce these to univariate parametric integrals - amenable to numerical integration - and produce analytic results for the linear impulse and the scattering angle to the second post-Minkowskian order. The scattering angle exhibits a maximum when the range of the scalar-mediated force is comparable to the impact parameter, a possible signature of a massive scalar mediator. In the opposite, large-mass regime we uncover a screening effect: integrating out the scalar sourced by each compact object reduces its gravitational mass by an amount linear in the scalar's mass. Both of these phenomena are next-to-leading-order effects.

Leopoldo A. Pando Zayas, Jingchao Zhang · hep-th, cond-mat.str-el, gr-qc · v2 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：近极端黑洞在其近视界 near-AdS2 喉区包含红外增强的量子涨落，部分由 Schwarzian 模支配。我们研究这些涨落对近极端渐近 AdS4 Reissner-Nordström 黑膜零频应力张量响应的影响，其横向方向由有限环面商调控。直接在四维中工作，我们计算弱耦合 Schwarzian 区域 T_q << T << r_0/L^2 的首项修正。在一圈阶，剪切微扰与 n=2 的准零模耦合，并产生正比于 T_q/T 的修正。与熵的对数修正一起，这给出 η/s 的有限体积修正。我们的计算提供了一个直接的四维基准，补充精确的二维处理，同时显式保留渐近 AdS4 源。

English: Near-extremal black holes contain infrared-enhanced quantum fluctuations in their near-horizon near-AdS$_2$ throat, governed in part by Schwarzian modes. We study the effect of these fluctuations on the zero-frequency stress-tensor response of a near-extremal asymptotically AdS$_4$ Reissner--Nordstr\"om black brane whose transverse directions are regulated by a finite toroidal quotient. Working directly in four dimensions, we compute the leading correction in the weakly coupled Schwarzian regime $T_q\ll T\ll r_0/L^2$. At one loop, the shear perturbation couples to the $n=2$ would-be zero mode and produces a correction proportional to $T_q/T$. Together with the logarithmic correction to the entropy, this yields a finite-volume correction to $\eta/s$. Our calculation provides a direct four-dimensional benchmark, complementary to exact two-dimensional treatments, while keeping the asymptotic AdS$_4$ source explicit.

一句话导读：在近极端 AdS4 Reissner-Nordström 黑膜中，利用一圈 Schwarzian 修正计算低温下 η/s 的有限体积修正。

具有平移对称破缺的全息Schwinger效应

Holographic Schwinger effect with Translational Symmetry Breaking

Sara Tahery, Wenxing Cheng, Zi-qiang Zhang, Qin Chang · hep-th · v3 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们研究了在有限化学势下具有平移对称破缺（TSB）背景中的全息Schwinger效应。引力背景由两个独立参数刻画：控制动量弛豫的TSB参数 α，以及决定对偶场论有限密度的化学势 μ。使用势分析方法，我们推导了控制对产生过程的总势，并考察了其对 α、μ、外磁场以及比值 β=E/E_c 的依赖。结果表明，α 和 μ 对Schwinger过程的影响强烈依赖于动力学区域。在亚临界区域，增大 α 或 μ 都会降低势垒并促进对产生。然而，在临界电场附近及以上，这两个参数的作用在定性上变得不同。增大化学势会降低总势并增强全息Schwinger对产生过程，而增大平移对称破缺参数则使势上移并抑制产生过程。我们进一步表明，在固定 β=E/E_c 时，垂直外磁场会降低有效势垒，从而促进Schwinger过程，同时物理电场通过 E_c 的磁场依赖性相应改变。相应的对产生率并未独立计算；相反，其定性行为通过由总势导出的代理量来刻画。总体而言，我们的分析全面展示了平移对称破缺、有限密度和外磁场如何影响全息非微扰对产生。

English: We investigate the holographic Schwinger effect in a background with translational symmetry breaking (TSB) at finite chemical potential. The gravitational background is characterized by two independent parameters: the TSB parameter \(\alpha\), which controls momentum relaxation, and the chemical potential \(\mu\), which determines the finite density of the dual field theory. Using the potential analysis method, we derive the total potential governing the pair production process and examine its dependence on \(\alpha\), \(\mu\), the external magnetic field, and the ratio \(\beta=E/E_c\). Our results show that the effects of \(\alpha\) and \(\mu\) on the Schwinger process strongly depend on the dynamical regime. In the subcritical regime, increasing either \(\alpha\) or \(\mu\) lowers the potential barrier and facilitates pair production. However, near and above the critical electric field, the roles of these two parameters become qualitatively different. While increasing the chemical potential lowers the total potential and enhances the Schwinger pair production process, increasing the translational symmetry breaking parameter shifts the potential upward and suppresses the production process. We further show that, at fixed $\beta=E/E_c$, a perpendicular external magnetic field lowers the effective potential barrier and thereby facilitates the Schwinger process, while the physical electric field changes accordingly through the magnetic-field dependence of $E_c$. The corresponding pair production rate is not independently calculated; instead, its qualitative behavior is characterized through a proxy derived from the total potential. Overall, our analysis provides a comprehensive picture of how translational symmetry breaking, finite density, and external magnetic fields influence holographic non-perturbative pair production.

一句话导读：在有限化学势和动量弛豫背景下，用势分析研究平移对称破缺、有限密度和外磁场对全息Schwinger对产生的影响。

相关度：medium — 属于AdS/CFT理论全息研究，涉及非平衡对产生、临界电场以及有限密度/平移对称破缺背景；与‘相变与气泡成核’有部分概念重叠，但未直接对应全息超流超导、p波、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7/D3-D5、经典引力等具体重点支线。

熵在宇宙学中的应用：时空热力学、全息暗能量、熵引力及其他——综述

Entropy applications in cosmology: spacetime thermodynamics, holographic dark energy, entropic gravity and beyond - a review

Emmanuel N. Saridakis, Giuseppe Gaetano Luciano, Andreas Lymperis, Eirini C. Telali · astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：熵已成为引力、量子理论与宇宙学交叉领域的关键概念，揭示了几何、信息与热力学之间的深刻联系。黑洞是热力学系统，其熵正比于视界面积，这一认识提供了时空本身可能具有微观结构的证据。此后，熵在量子场论、全息、量子引力与宇宙学中取得了核心地位。在这篇综述中，我们对引力和宇宙学语境中的熵给出统一论述。我们首先综述引力系统中的熵，聚焦黑洞热力学、熵界、全息原理、纠缠熵与面积律，以及由量子场论、广义不确定性原理、修改统计和扩展引力理论带来的主要修正与推广。随后我们讨论熵在宇宙学中被使用的三种概念上不同的方式。第一种是时空热力学猜想，其中引力动力学由应用于宇宙学视界的热力学关系涌现，而广义熵形式随之导致修改后的宇宙学演化。第二种是全息方法，其中熵界约束宇宙真空能，产生全息暗能量场景及其多种扩展。第三种是熵引力，其中引力被解释为熵起源的涌现现象，并带来有趣的宇宙学现象学。通过回顾这些熵框架的理论基础与宇宙学含义，我们旨在阐明熵的作用，讨论开放问题，并勾勒通向对引力与宇宙学更深刻热力学与信息理解的方向。

English: Entropy has emerged as a key concept at the intersection of gravity, quantum theory, and cosmology, revealing deep connections between geometry, information, and thermodynamics. The realization that black holes are thermodynamic systems, characterized by an entropy proportional to their horizon area, has provided evidence that spacetime itself may possess a microscopic structure. Since then, entropy has acquired a central role across quantum field theory, holography, quantum gravity, and cosmology. In this review, we present a unified account of entropy in gravitational and cosmological contexts. We first survey entropy in gravitational systems, focusing on black-hole thermodynamics, entropy bounds, the holographic principle, entanglement entropy, and the area law, together with the main corrections and generalizations arising from quantum field theory, generalized uncertainty principles, modified statistics, and extended theories of gravity. We then discuss three conceptually distinct ways in which entropy is employed in cosmology. The first is through the spacetime-thermodynamics conjecture, in which gravitational dynamics emerge from thermodynamic relations applied to cosmological horizons, and generalized entropy forms consequently lead to modified cosmological evolution. The second is the holographic approach, in which entropy bounds constrain the vacuum energy of the Universe, giving rise to the holographic dark energy scenario and its various extensions. The third is entropic gravity, where gravity is interpreted as an emergent phenomenon of entropic origin, leading to interesting cosmological phenomenology. By reviewing the theoretical foundations and cosmological implications of these entropic frameworks, we aim to clarify the role of entropy, discuss open issues and outline directions toward a deeper thermodynamic and informational understanding of gravity and cosmology.

一句话导读：一篇统一综述引力与宇宙学中熵的角色，涵盖黑洞热力学、全息原理、时空热力学、全息暗能量与熵引力。

相关度：medium — 该综述涉及全息原理、全息暗能量和引力热力学，与全息及引力学主题相关；但它不是专门针对用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、探针膜、QNM或冷原子等具体支线。

三维Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力中的黑洞与标量传播

Black Holes and Scalar Propagation in Three-Dimensional Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet Gravity

Cendikiawan Suryaatmadja · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们在三维标量-张量Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力中，针对正耦合，推导出一类解析黑洞解族。单个隐式方程确定了静态圆对称度规以及一个随时间线性变化的标量。我们证明，在所述AdS边界条件且标量中时间系数固定非零的情况下，这些解穷尽了规则非极端外部解。耦合的度规与标量扰动只有一个传播自由度。在其中一个分支上，其动能系数为正，其方程在整个外部区域为双曲型，且对于紧支撑扰动，其体空间能量为正。标量信号可以向外穿过度规视界，因此外部演化需要来自内部的信息。对于固定原度规与标量边界值的线性扰动，具有零速度的非零紧支撑初始主位移只能演化到它们第一次接触AdS边界为止。我们从原度规与标量方程推导出这一限制。

English: We derive an analytic black-hole family in three-dimensional scalar--tensor Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet gravity with positive coupling. A single implicit equation determines the static circular metric and a scalar linear in time. We show that these solutions exhaust regular nonextremal exteriors with the stated AdS boundary conditions and a fixed nonzero coefficient of time in the scalar. The coupled metric and scalar perturbations have one propagating degree of freedom. On one branch, its kinetic coefficient is positive, its equation is hyperbolic throughout the exterior, and its bulk spatial energy is positive for perturbations of compact support. Scalar signals can cross the metric horizon outward, so exterior evolution needs information from the interior. For linear perturbations with the original metric and scalar boundary values fixed, nonzero compact initial master displacements with zero velocity can evolve only until their first contact with the AdS boundary. We derive this restriction from the original metric and scalar equations.

一句话导读：三维正耦合标量-张量Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet引力中给出解析黑洞解族，并分析耦合标量/度规扰动的传播、视界穿越与AdS边界限制。

相关度：high — 该文主要研究三维Einstein--Gauss--Bonnet修改引力中的经典黑洞解与标量扰动传播，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；摘要未涉及AdS/CFT对偶或量子引力信息。

关于史瓦西黑洞视界处的模式

On the Modes at the Schwarzschild Black Hole Horizon

Dimitrios Giataganas, Alex Kehagias, Antonio Riotto · gr-qc, hep-ph, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们讨论了出现在史瓦西黑洞视界处、并以表面引力的整数倍衰减的模式的起源。我们认为，由粒子坠入黑洞在视界处产生的激发不能离开视界。我们的论证基于如下事实：当粒子趋近视界时，其速度必然被加速到超相对论值，其近视界引力场变为 Dray-'t Hooft 冲击波，而这是爱因斯坦方程的一个精确、非解析且非微扰的解。相应的度规扰动局域在视界处，永远无法到达远处观测者。

English: We discuss the origin of the modes appearing at the Schwarzschild black hole horizon and decaying at integer multiples of the surface gravity. We argue that no excitations generated at the horizon by the plunging of a particle into a black hole can leave it. Our argument is based on the fact that, when the particle approaches the horizon, its speed is necessarily boosted to ultra-relativistic values and its near-horizon gravitational field becomes a Dray-'t Hooft shockwave, which is an exact, nonanalytic, and nonperturbative solution of Einstein's equations. The corresponding metric perturbations are localized at the horizon and can never reach a distant observer.

一句话导读：粒子坠入史瓦西黑洞时，近视界引力场成为 Dray-'t Hooft 冲击波；视界处产生的模式被局域化，无法逃逸到远处观测者。

协变相空间形式中依赖场的对称生成元的守恒荷与黑洞第一定律

Conserved charges and the first law of black holes for field dependent symmetry generators in the covariant phase space formalism

Hai-Feng Ding · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：本文推广了与场依赖矢量共轭的协变相空间形式，以在存在规范场时纳入内部规范变换。在我们的形式中，对称生成元是微分同胚加内部规范变换的组合，并依赖于场构型。当在协变相空间形式中考虑对称生成元的场依赖性时，对于一般协变引力理论，黑洞热力学第一定律是一个直接结果。为检验该形式的有效性，我们研究了爱因斯坦-麦克斯韦理论中环面状黑洞以及爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森堡非线性电动力学中带电的爱因斯坦-欧拉-海森堡 AdS 黑洞的守恒荷与热力学第一定律。

English: In this paper, we generalize the covariant phase space formalism conjugate to field dependent vectors to include internal gauge transformations when gauge fields are present. In our formalism, the symmetry generators are combination of diffeomorphisms plus internal gauge transformations and depend on the field configuration. When the field dependence of the symmetry generators is considered in the covariant phase space formalism, the first law of black hole thermodynamics is a direct result for generally invariant gravitational theories. To check the validity of our formalism, we investigate the conserved charges and the first laws of thermodynamics for a torus-like black hole in Einstein-Maxwell theory and a charged Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg AdS black hole in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg nonlinear electrodynamics.

一句话导读：将协变相空间形式推广到场依赖的微分同胚加规范生成元，并导出一般协变引力理论中的黑洞第一定律，在 Einstein-Maxwell 环面黑洞与 Euler-Heisenberg AdS 黑洞中验证。

五阶后闵可夫斯基有效单体理论中自旋双星系统的演化动力学

Evolution dynamics of spinning binaries in effective-one-body theory to fifth Post-Minkowskian order

Jiliang Jing, Sheng Long, Weike Deng, Jieci Wang · gr-qc, hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：本文研究了为描述自旋双星系统动力学而建立的自洽有效单体（EOB）理论。我们利用场论原理系统推导了进入哈密顿方程的表达式和量，这些方程支配该系统的动力学演化。基于我们最近得到的直到五阶后闵可夫斯基（PM）阶的有效旋转度规，我们构造了哈密顿量和应力-能量张量。随后，我们推导了带有源项的、解耦可分离的类Teukolsky方程，用于Newman-Penrose外尔标量 ψ4^B，并给出其形式解。最后，利用该解，我们得到了自旋双星产生的能量通量、辐射反作用力以及“加”和“叉”偏振的引力波波形。该EOB理论适用于任意质量比系统，填补了可比质量比与极端质量比之间的空白。

English: This paper investigates a self-consistent effective-one-body (EOB) theory developed to describe the dynamics of spinning binary systems. We systematically derive, using field-theoretic principles, all expressions and quantities entering Hamilton's equations, which govern the dynamical evolution of the system. Based on the effective rotating metric up to fifth post-Minkowskian (PM) order recently obtained by us, we construct the Hamiltonian and the stress-energy tensor. We then derive a decoupled, separable Teukolsky-like equation with a source term for the Newman--Penrose Weyl scalar $\psi_4^B$ and present its formal solution. Finally, using this solution, we obtain the energy flux, radiation-reaction force, and gravitational waveforms for the ``plus'' and ``cross'' polarizations generated by spinning binaries. The EOB theory applies to systems with arbitrary mass ratio, which filling the gap between comparable mass ratios and extreme mass ratios.

一句话导读：在五阶后闵可夫斯基阶构建自旋双星的有效单体理论，推导哈密顿量、类Teukolsky方程并给出引力波波形与辐射反作用。

标量 Gauss-Bonnet 虫洞与虚距离界限

Scalar Gauss-Bonnet Wormholes and the Imaginary Distance Bound

Alex Kehagias, Antonio Riotto · hep-th, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们研究了四维引力中 O(4) 对称欧几里得虫洞，其中无质量标量与 Gauss-Bonnet 不变量线性耦合。在非零耦合下，Einstein 虫洞变为规则复鞍点，并满足 Kontsevich-Segal-Witten 判据，直到其分支在有限耦合处结束。在渐近平直空间中，Gauss-Bonnet 项修正有限虫洞的标量位移和壳上作用量，但两者中依赖尺寸的修正在大喉极限下消失；因此原虚距离阈值保持不变。负宇宙学常数已使 Einstein 大喉虚距离低于平直空间值。当也存在 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合时，标量不再是模量，因为它产生对数跑动且其轨迹长度无限。减去对数渐近行为后留下有限正则化位移。其大喉值被 Gauss-Bonnet 相互作用从 Einstein AdS 结果向上移动，并决定重整化固定电荷作用量的大电荷主导行为。

English: We study $O(4)$ symmetric Euclidean wormholes in four-dimensional gravity with a massless scalar linearly coupled to the Gauss-Bonnet invariant. At nonzero coupling, the Einstein wormhole becomes a regular complex saddle that satisfies the Kontsevich-Segal-Witten criterion until its branch ends at a finite coupling. In asymptotically flat space, the Gauss-Bonnet term modifies the scalar displacement and the on-shell action for finite wormholes, but the size dependent parts of both corrections vanish in the large throat limit. The original imaginary distance threshold therefore remains unchanged. A negative cosmological constant already lowers the Einstein large throat imaginary distance relative to its flat space value. When the Gauss-Bonnet coupling is also present, the scalar is no longer a modulus as it develops a logarithmic running and its trajectory has infinite length. Subtracting the logarithmic asymptotic behavior leaves a finite regulated displacement. Its large throat value is shifted upward from the Einstein AdS result by the Gauss-Bonnet interaction and determines the leading large charge behavior of the renormalized fixed charge action.

一句话导读：在含标量-Gauss-Bonnet 耦合的四维欧几里得虫洞中，平直空间虚距离阈值保持不变，而 AdS 中标量迹出现对数跑动，正则化位移的大喉值上移并主导重整化固定电荷作用量的大电荷行为。

动力学 Chern-Simons 引力中的费米子宇宙弦

Fermionic cosmic strings in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity

Stephon Alexander, Heliudson Bernardo, Shengyuan Zhang · hep-th, astro-ph.CO, gr-qc, hep-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们研究了动态 Chern-Simons (dCS) 引力的一个费米子紫外完成中，由手征相变产生的拓扑缺陷。该模型包含一个复标量场，其与费米子存在手征 Yukawa 耦合。在手征对称性破缺标度以下，积掉有能隙的体模式会产生一个引力 Chern-Simons 耦合；我们论证，这会修改相变产生的宇宙弦解。所得的修正弦度规由 Callan-Harvey 费米子零模解的一个推广所支持，其中这些零模产生的零流提供了宇称破坏的机制。在弱耦合与弱引力区域，我们推导了该外部度规的主导阶约化 dCS 修正。我们还讨论了 dCS 引力中一般弦构型的有效作用量描述。引力 Pontryagin 项提供了必要的反常流入，以抵消手征世界面理论的引力反常。

English: We investigate topological defects produced by a chiral phase transition in a fermionic ultraviolet completion of dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity. The model contains a complex scalar field with a chiral Yukawa coupling to fermions. Below the chiral symmetry breaking scale, integrating out the gapped bulk modes produces a gravitational Chern-Simons coupling which, we argue, modifies cosmic string solutions from the phase transition. The resulting corrected string metric is supported by a generalization of the Callan-Harvey fermionic zero mode solution, in which the null current generated by these zero modes provides a mechanism for parity violation. In the weak-coupling and weak-gravity regime, we derive the leading order-reduced dCS correction to this exterior metric. We also discuss the effective action description for generic string configurations in dCS gravity. The gravitational Pontryagin term provides the anomaly inflow required to cancel the gravitational anomaly of the chiral worldsheet theory.

一句话导读：在手征相变费米子紫外完成中，动态 Chern-Simons 引力修正宇宙弦度规，并由 Callan-Harvey 零模和反常流入支持。

等 GNO 荷扇区与模糊球真空：大荷 ADHM-BMN 指数匹配

Equal-GNO Sectors and Fuzzy-Sphere Vacua: Large-Charge ADHM-BMN Index Matching

Sarthak Duary, Kangning Liu · hep-th · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们建立了三维 ADHM 理论的超共形指数与 BMN 矩阵量子力学的固定真空 Witten 指数之间的受保护扇区关系。该比较选取 ADHM 定域公式中一个正等磁荷扇区，以及由相同模糊球块构成的 BMN 真空。相等磁荷保持完整的重数规范群，并使矢量与伴随行列式不依赖于公共荷。基本场则经历完整磁单极背景并产生磁间隙。在大 GNO 荷极限下，它们的振子行列式与受保护展开的每一固定阶解耦，而相关真空单项式仍保留并固定该扇区的归一化。经过此归一化后，大 GNO 荷极限下的 ADHM 矩阵积分与 BMN 指数的大块极限逐系数一致。因此匹配来自两个物理上不同的机制：在 ADHM 一侧的大 GNO 荷极限中，基本超多重态激发变得磁重并解耦；而在 BMN 一侧的大块极限中，有限的模糊球角动量截断被移除，留下完整的角动量塔。我们逐系数建立该对应关系，区分精确行列式恒等式与大荷渐近行为，并表明 GNO 荷配分在 M 理论升维后成为 BMN 模糊球块之间纵向动量的分布。

English: We establish a protected-sector relation between the superconformal index of the three-dimensional ADHM theory and the fixed-vacuum Witten index of BMN matrix quantum mechanics. The comparison selects a positive equal-magnetic-charge sector of the ADHM localization formula and a BMN vacuum made from identical fuzzy-sphere blocks. Equal magnetic charges preserve the complete multiplicity gauge group and make the vector and adjoint determinants independent of the common charge. Fundamental fields instead experience the full monopole background and develop a magnetic gap. In the large-GNO-charge limit, their oscillator determinant decouples from every fixed order of the protected expansion, while the associated vacuum monomial survives and fixes the normalization of the sector. After this normalization, the ADHM matrix integral in the large-GNO-charge limit agrees coefficientwise with the large-block limit of the BMN index. The matching therefore arises from two physically distinct mechanisms: in the large-GNO-charge limit, the fundamental-hypermultiplet excitations become magnetically heavy and decouple on the ADHM side, while in the large-block limit, the finite fuzzy-sphere angular-momentum cutoff is removed on the BMN side, leaving the complete angular tower. We establish the correspondence coefficientwise, distinguish the exact determinant identities from the large-charge asymptotics, and show that the GNO-charge partition becomes, after the M-theory uplift, the distribution of longitudinal momentum among the BMN fuzzy-sphere blocks.

一句话导读：在大 GNO 荷与模糊球大块极限下，ADHM 超共形指数与 BMN 矩阵量子力学 Witten 指数逐系数匹配。

坍缩至极端性：量子引力中的黑洞热力学第三定律

Collapse to extremality: The third law of black hole thermodynamics in quantum gravity

Gustavo J. Turiaci, Chih-Hung Wu · hep-th, gr-qc · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们提出一个两步构造，在四维带电黑洞中违反经典黑洞热力学第三定律。首先制备一个具有 AdS2×X 喉道的近极端黑洞，然后由带电壳在有限时间内将其驱动至极端。该构造表明第二步对近极端黑洞是普适的，并可用于构造克尔黑洞第三定律的违反。同一描述允许我们在量子引力中研究该过程。经典坍缩条件选择了一个 BF 违背的物质部分，我们为这部分构造了全息字典并推导出量子跃迁振幅。量子效应将经典极端端点替换为一个概率分布，该分布在极端处消失并在正能量处达到峰值。这一阻碍与量子引力中不存在非超对称极端黑洞态一致。我们表明，要使峰值足够接近极端性以使量子引力变得重要，所需的制备时间随黑洞熵标度。

English: We present a two-step construction to violate the classical third law of black hole thermodynamics for charged black holes in four dimensions. A near-extremal black hole with an $\mathrm{AdS}_2\times X$ throat is first prepared and then driven to extremality in finite time by a charged shell. This construction suggests that the second step is universal for near-extremal black holes, and can be used to construct violations of the third law for Kerr black holes. The same description allows us to study the process in quantum gravity. The classical collapse condition selects a BF-violating matter sector, for which we construct a holographic dictionary and derive the quantum transition amplitude. Quantum effects replace the classical extremal endpoint by a probability distribution that vanishes at extremality and peaks at positive energy. This obstruction is consistent with the absence of non-supersymmetric extremal black hole states in quantum gravity. We show that driving the peak close enough to extremality for quantum gravity to become important requires a preparation time that scales with the black hole entropy.

一句话导读：通过带电壳将近极端黑洞驱动至极端性可在经典上违反第三定律；量子引力将其改为在极端处消失的概率分布，且所需准备时间随黑洞熵增长。

Zhengwei Liu, Zishuo Zhao · math-ph, cond-mat.str-el, math.MP, math.OA, quant-ph · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：我们引入了一类基于带有选定对象的酉球面融合范畴的二维量子自旋系统。这些模型具有无阻挫、反射正性但通常非对易的局域相互作用，推广了 Levin-Wen 弦网模型。基于 arXiv:2510.20662 中发展的理论，我们显式实现了 Temperley-Lieb-Jones 代数，并且更一般地，将融合自旋链实现为其边界代数。

English: We introduce a class of $2d$ quantum spin systems based on a unitary spherical fusion category with a chosen object. These models have frustration-free, reflection positive, but generally non-commuting local interactions, generalizing the Levin-Wen string-net models. Based on the theory developed in arXiv:2510.20662, we explicitly realize the Temperley-Lieb-Jones algebra, and more generally fusion spin chains as their boundary algebras.

奇异夸克星与自发标量化

Strange Quark Stars and Spontaneous Scalarization

Mina Mehraeen Nazdik, Zeinab Rezaei · nucl-th, astro-ph.HE · v1 · 更新 2026-09-24

中文摘要：奇异夸克物质作为天体物理中最极端的致密态之一，可以通过相对论性致密天体进行研究。由致密奇异夸克物质构成的假想相对论性恒星，其特征由该物质的物态方程决定。奇异夸克星的自发标量化受到奇异夸克物质物态方程的影响。在这里，我们研究奇异夸克物质物态方程如何影响这些恒星的自发标量化。考虑袋模型中的正常、色味锁定（CFL）和 CFLm 夸克物质，并应用标量-张量引力，我们计算了标量化奇异夸克星的结构。我们研究有效袋常数、微扰 QCD 参数、CFL 配对能隙和奇异夸克质量如何控制质量-半径关系、中心标量场、标量化阈值和标量荷。我们的结果表明，标量-张量引力中的奇异夸克星是可行且可检验的天体，并且它们为利用当前和未来多信使观测来同时限制引力理论和冷夸克物质性质建立了一个完整框架。

English: Strange quark matter, as one of the most extreme dense states in astrophysics, can be explored through relativistic compact objects. Hypothetical relativistic stars composed of dense strange quark matter are characterized by the equation of state of that matter. The spontaneous scalarization of strange quark stars is influenced by the equation of state of strange quark matter. Here, we investigate how the equation of state of strange quark matter influences the spontaneous scalarization of these stars. Considering Normal, color-flavor-locked (CFL), and CFLm quark matter in the bag models and applying the scalar-tensor gravity, we calculate the structure of scalarized strange quark stars. We investigate how the effective bag constant, perturbative QCD parameter, CFL pairing gap, and strange quark mass control the mass-radius relation, the central scalar field, the scalarization thresholds, and the scalar charge. Our results demonstrate that strange quark stars in scalar-tensor gravity are viable, testable objects, and they establish a complete framework for constraining both the gravitational theory and the properties of cold quark matter with current and future multimessenger observations.

一句话导读：在标量-张量引力中研究不同奇异夸克物质物态方程对奇异夸克星自发标量化及星体结构的影响。
